    (hbudget : (r.operations.map CylinderOperation.scale).sum+op.scale < B.ell (B.band γ)/2) :
    (r.append op hord hbudget).cubeValue = op.act r.cubeValue

name: OAI.C0Absorption.GeneratedRepresentation.cubeValue_lipschitz
statement:
theorem cubeValue_lipschitz (r : GeneratedRepresentation B γ) :
    LipschitzWith (4^r.operations.length*B.L0) r.cubeValue

name: OAI.C0Absorption.GeneratedRepresentation.cubeValue_sup
statement:
theorem cubeValue_sup (r : GeneratedRepresentation B γ) :
    ∀ x, |r.cubeValue x| ≤ (2 : ℝ)^r.operations.length*B.A

name: OAI.C0Absorption.GeneratedRepresentation.eventually_append_allowed
statement:
theorem eventually_append_allowed (r : GeneratedRepresentation B γ) :
    ∀ᶠ a in atTop, (∀ p ∈ r.operations, dyadic a ≤ p.scale) ∧
      (r.operations.map CylinderOperation.scale).sum+dyadic a < B.ell (B.band γ)/2

name: OAI.C0Absorption.GeneratedRepresentation.support_bound
statement:
theorem support_bound (r : GeneratedRepresentation B γ) {φ : Cube (B.coordinates γ) → ℝ}
    (hφ : LipschitzWith 1 φ) {b : ℝ} (hu : ∀ x ∈ tsupport (B.base γ), φ x ≤ b) :
    ∀ s ∈ tsupport r.value,
      φ (cubeRestrict (B.coordinates γ) s) ≤ b+(r.operations.map CylinderOperation.scale).sum

name: OAI.C0Absorption.GeneratedRepresentation.value_lipschitz
statement:
theorem value_lipschitz (r : GeneratedRepresentation B γ) :
    LipschitzWith (4^r.operations.length*B.L0) r.value

name: OAI.C0Absorption.GeneratedRepresentation.value_sup
statement:
theorem value_sup (r : GeneratedRepresentation B γ) :
    ∀ x, |r.value x| ≤ (2 : ℝ)^r.operations.length*B.A

name: OAI.C0Absorption.TClass_lipschitz
statement:
theorem TClass_lipschitz {Γ : Type*} (B : CylinderBases Γ) (h : ℕ) {f : C0Ball → ℝ}
    (hf : f ∈ TClass B h) : LipschitzWith (4^h*B.L0) f

name: OAI.C0Absorption.TClass_sup
statement:
theorem TClass_sup {Γ : Type*} (B : CylinderBases Γ) (h : ℕ) {f : C0Ball → ℝ}
    (hf : f ∈ TClass B h) : ∀ s, |f s| ≤ (2 : ℝ)^h*B.A

name: OAI.C0Absorption.TailOperation.factor_abs_le
statement: theorem factor_abs_le (t : TailOperation) (s : C0Ball) : |t.factor s| ≤ 1

name: OAI.C0Absorption.TailOperation.factor_lipschitz
statement: theorem factor_lipschitz (t : TailOperation) : LipschitzWith (2^t.scaleIndex) t.factor

name: OAI.C0Absorption.VClass_lipschitz
statement:
theorem VClass_lipschitz {Γ : Type*} (B : CylinderBases Γ) (h : ℕ) {f : C0Ball → ℝ}
    (hf : f ∈ VClass B h) : LipschitzWith (4^h*B.L0+h*4^h*B.A) f

name: OAI.C0Absorption.VClass_sup
statement:
theorem VClass_sup {Γ : Type*} (B : CylinderBases Γ) (h : ℕ) {f : C0Ball → ℝ}
    (hf : f ∈ VClass B h) : ∀ s, |f s| ≤ (2 : ℝ)^h*B.A

name: OAI.C0Absorption.applyOperations_append
statement:
theorem applyOperations_append {I : Finset ℕ} (rs ss : List (CylinderOperation I))
    (u : Cube I → ℝ) : applyOperations (rs++ss) u = applyOperations ss (applyOperations rs u)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.applyOperations_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem applyOperations_cons {I : Finset ℕ} (r : CylinderOperation I)
    (rs : List (CylinderOperation I)) (u : Cube I → ℝ) :
    applyOperations (r::rs) u = applyOperations rs (r.act u)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.applyOperations_lipschitz
statement:
theorem applyOperations_lipschitz {I : Finset ℕ} (ops : List (CylinderOperation I))
    {K : ℝ≥0} {u : Cube I → ℝ} (hu : LipschitzWith K u) :
    LipschitzWith (4^ops.length*K) (applyOperations ops u)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.applyOperations_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem applyOperations_nil {I : Finset ℕ} (u : Cube I → ℝ) : applyOperations [] u = u

name: OAI.C0Absorption.applyOperations_sup
statement:
theorem applyOperations_sup {I : Finset ℕ} (ops : List (CylinderOperation I))
    {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) {u : Cube I → ℝ} (hu : ∀ x, |u x| ≤ A) :
    ∀ x, |applyOperations ops u x| ≤ 2^ops.length*A

name: OAI.C0Absorption.applyOperations_support_bound
statement:
theorem applyOperations_support_bound {I : Finset ℕ} (ops : List (CylinderOperation I))
    (u : Cube I → ℝ) {φ : Cube I → ℝ} (hφ : LipschitzWith 1 φ) {b : ℝ}
    (hu : ∀ x ∈ tsupport u, φ x ≤ b) :
    ∀ x ∈ tsupport (applyOperations ops u), φ x ≤ b+(ops.map CylinderOperation.scale).sum

name: OAI.C0Absorption.bounded_product_lipschitz
statement:
theorem bounded_product_lipschitz {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    {f g : X → ℝ} {K L A B : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith K f) (hg : LipschitzWith L g)
    (hfB : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ A) (hgB : ∀ x, |g x| ≤ B) :
    LipschitzWith (A*L+B*K) (fun x => f x*g x)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.sourceClasses_even
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceClasses_even {Γ : Type*} (B : CylinderBases Γ) (h : ℕ) :
    sourceClasses B (2*h) = TClass B (h+1)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.sourceClasses_odd
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceClasses_odd {Γ : Type*} (B : CylinderBases Γ) (h : ℕ) :
    sourceClasses B (2*h+1) = VClass B (h+1)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.tailProduct_abs_le
statement: theorem tailProduct_abs_le (ts : List TailOperation) (s : C0Ball) : |tailProduct ts s| ≤ 1

name: OAI.C0Absorption.tailProduct_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem tailProduct_cons (t : TailOperation) (ts : List TailOperation) (s : C0Ball) :
    tailProduct (t::ts) s = t.factor s * tailProduct ts s

name: OAI.C0Absorption.tailProduct_lipschitz
statement:
theorem tailProduct_lipschitz (ts : List TailOperation) :
    LipschitzWith ((ts.map (fun t => (2 : ℝ≥0)^t.scaleIndex)).sum) (tailProduct ts)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.tailProduct_lipschitz_bound
statement:
theorem tailProduct_lipschitz_bound (ts : List TailOperation) (h : ℕ)
    (hlen : ts.length ≤ h) (hscale : ∀ t ∈ ts, t.scaleIndex ≤ h) :
    LipschitzWith ((h : ℝ≥0)*2^h) (tailProduct ts)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.tailProduct_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem tailProduct_nil (s : C0Ball) : tailProduct [] s = 1

name: OAI.C0Absorption.tsupport_comp_subset
statement:
theorem tsupport_comp_subset {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (f : Y → ℝ) {π : X → Y} (hπ : Continuous π) :
    tsupport (f ∘ π) ⊆ π ⁻¹' tsupport f

name: OAI.C0Absorption.tsupport_product_subset_left
statement:
theorem tsupport_product_subset_left {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (f g : X → ℝ) :
    tsupport (fun x => f x*g x) ⊆ tsupport f

name: OAI.C0Absorption.BoundedTest.add
statement:
theorem BoundedTest.add {f g : S → ℝ} (hf : BoundedTest L o f) (hg : BoundedTest L o g) :
    BoundedTest L o (fun s => f s+g s)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.BoundedTest.smul
statement:
theorem BoundedTest.smul {f : S → ℝ} (hf : BoundedTest L o f) (a : ℝ) :
    BoundedTest L o (fun s => a*f s)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.GeneratedRepresentation.exists_flatten
statement:
theorem exists_flatten (r : GeneratedRepresentation B γ) (ts : List TailOperation)
    (h : ℕ) (hr : r.operations.length ≤ h) (hj : B.band γ ≤ h)
    (ht : ts.length ≤ h) (hs : ∀ t ∈ ts, t.scaleIndex ≤ h)
    (v : Cube (B.coordinates γ)) (z : SourceSpace B) {δ cap : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcap : 0 < cap) :
    ∃ (a : ℕ) (r' : GeneratedRepresentation B γ),
      dyadic a < cap ∧ r'.operations = r.operations++[flattenOperation (B.coordinates γ) a v] ∧
      |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (fun s => r'.value s*tailProduct ts s) z-
        completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (fun s => r.value s*tailProduct ts s) z| < δ ∧
      (∀ s, dist (cubeRestrict (B.coordinates γ) s) v < 3*dyadic a/8 →
        r'.value s = r.cubeValue (flattenOperation (B.coordinates γ) a v).point) ∧
      (∀ s, |r'.value s| ≤ (2 : ℝ)^r.operations.length*B.A)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.GeneratedRepresentation.exists_flatten_T
statement:
theorem exists_flatten_T (r : GeneratedRepresentation B γ)
    (h : ℕ) (hr : r.operations.length ≤ h)
    (v : Cube (B.coordinates γ)) (z : SourceSpace B) {δ cap : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcap : 0 < cap) :
    ∃ (a : ℕ) (r' : GeneratedRepresentation B γ),
      dyadic a < cap ∧ r'.operations = r.operations++[flattenOperation (B.coordinates γ) a v] ∧
      |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin r'.value z-
        completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin r.value z| < δ ∧
      (∀ s, dist (cubeRestrict (B.coordinates γ) s) v < 3*dyadic a/8 →
        r'.value s = r.cubeValue (flattenOperation (B.coordinates γ) a v).point) ∧
      (∀ s, |r'.value s| ≤ (2 : ℝ)^r.operations.length*B.A)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.TClass_bounded
statement:
theorem TClass_bounded {h : ℕ} {f : C0Ball → ℝ} (hf : f ∈ TClass B h) :
    BoundedTest (sourceClasses B) c0Origin f

name: OAI.C0Absorption.TClass_mono
statement: theorem TClass_mono {h k : ℕ} (hk : h ≤ k) : TClass B h ⊆ TClass B k

name: OAI.C0Absorption.TClass_pairing_bound
statement:
theorem TClass_pairing_bound (B : CylinderBases Γ) (h : ℕ) :
    ∃ A : ℝ≥0, ∀ f ∈ TClass B h, ∀ m : PreSpace (sourceClasses B) c0Origin,
      |pairing C0Ball f m| ≤ A*‖m‖

name: OAI.C0Absorption.VClass_bounded
statement:
theorem VClass_bounded {h : ℕ} {f : C0Ball → ℝ} (hf : f ∈ VClass B h) :
    BoundedTest (sourceClasses B) c0Origin f

name: OAI.C0Absorption.VClass_mono
statement: theorem VClass_mono {h k : ℕ} (hk : h ≤ k) : VClass B h ⊆ VClass B k

name: OAI.C0Absorption.VClass_pairing_bound
statement:
theorem VClass_pairing_bound (B : CylinderBases Γ) (h : ℕ) :
    ∃ A : ℝ≥0, ∀ f ∈ VClass B h, ∀ m : PreSpace (sourceClasses B) c0Origin,
      |pairing C0Ball f m| ≤ A*‖m‖

name: OAI.C0Absorption.class_pairing_bound
statement:
theorem class_pairing_bound (j : ℕ) (K : ℝ≥0)
    (hK : ∀ f ∈ L j, LipschitzWith K f) :
    ∃ A : ℝ≥0, ∀ f ∈ L j, ∀ m : PreSpace L o, |pairing S f m| ≤ A*‖m‖

name: OAI.C0Absorption.completedPairing_add
statement:
theorem completedPairing_add (f g : S → ℝ) (hf : BoundedTest L o f) (hg : BoundedTest L o g)
    (z : TestSpace L o) : completedPairing L o (fun s => f s+g s) z =
      completedPairing L o f z+completedPairing L o g z

name: OAI.C0Absorption.completedPairing_smul
statement:
theorem completedPairing_smul (a : ℝ) (f : S → ℝ) (hf : BoundedTest L o f)
    (z : TestSpace L o) : completedPairing L o (fun s => a*f s) z = a*completedPairing L o f z

name: OAI.C0Absorption.flattenOperation_act
statement:
@[simp] theorem flattenOperation_act (I : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ) (v : Cube I) (u : Cube I → ℝ) :
    (flattenOperation I a v).act u = localG (flattenOperation I a v).point (dyadic a) u

name: OAI.C0Absorption.flattenOperation_center
statement:
theorem flattenOperation_center (I : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ) (v : Cube I) :
    dist v (flattenOperation I a v).point ≤ dyadic a/16

name: OAI.C0Absorption.flattenOperation_difference
statement:
theorem flattenOperation_difference (I : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ) (v : Cube I)
    {u : Cube I → ℝ} {K : ℝ≥0} (hu : LipschitzWith K u) (x : Cube I) :
    |(flattenOperation I a v).act u x-u x| ≤ dyadic a*K

name: OAI.C0Absorption.flattenOperation_plateau
statement:
theorem flattenOperation_plateau (I : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ) (v : Cube I) (u : Cube I → ℝ)
    (x : Cube I) (hx : dist x v < 3*dyadic a/8) :
    (flattenOperation I a v).act u x = u (flattenOperation I a v).point

name: OAI.C0Absorption.flattenOperation_scale
statement:
@[simp] theorem flattenOperation_scale (I : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ) (v : Cube I) :
    (flattenOperation I a v).scale = dyadic a

name: OAI.C0Absorption.pairing_add
statement:
theorem pairing_add {S : Type*} [MetricSpace S]
    (f g : S → ℝ) (m : Molecule S) :
    pairing S (fun s => f s+g s) m = pairing S f m+pairing S g m

name: OAI.C0Absorption.pairing_smul
statement:
theorem pairing_smul {S : Type*} [MetricSpace S]
    (a : ℝ) (f : S → ℝ) (m : Molecule S) :
    pairing S (fun s => a*f s) m = a*pairing S f m

name: OAI.C0Absorption.representation_mem_VClass
statement:
theorem representation_mem_VClass {γ : Γ} (r : GeneratedRepresentation B γ) {h : ℕ}
    (hr : r.operations.length ≤ h) (hj : B.band γ ≤ h) : r.value ∈ VClass B h

name: OAI.C0Absorption.sourceClasses_lipschitz
statement:
theorem sourceClasses_lipschitz (B : CylinderBases Γ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∀ f ∈ sourceClasses B n, LipschitzWith K f

name: OAI.C0Absorption.TagLocalization.projected_concentration
statement:
theorem projected_concentration (γ : ℕ → Γ) (r : ∀ i, GeneratedRepresentation B (γ i))
    (hj : Tendsto (fun i => B.band (γ i)) atTop atTop)
    (v : ℕ → Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (hv : Tendsto (fun i => loc.tag (γ i)) atTop (nhds v))
    (I : Finset ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∀ s ∈ tsupport (r i).value,
      dist (cubeRestrict I s) (fun k : I => v k.val) < ε

name: OAI.C0Absorption.TagLocalization.representation_support
statement:
theorem representation_support {γ : Γ} (r : GeneratedRepresentation B γ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k < B.band γ) (s : C0Ball) (hs : s ∈ tsupport r.value) :
    dist (s.val k) (loc.tag γ k).val ≤ 2*dyadic (B.band γ)+B.ell (B.band γ)/2

name: OAI.C0Absorption.choose_mono_sequence
statement:
theorem choose_mono_sequence {P : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (hP : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, P i j) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ i, P i (φ i)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.constant_or_injective_subsequence
statement:
theorem constant_or_injective_subsequence {A : Type*} (f : ℕ → A) :
    (∃ a, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ i, f (φ i)=a) ∨
    (∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ Function.Injective (f ∘ φ))

name: OAI.C0Absorption.finite_constant_subsequence
statement:
theorem finite_constant_subsequence {A : Type*} [Finite A] (f : ℕ → A) :
    ∃ a, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ i, f (φ i)=a

name: OAI.C0Absorption.finite_subsequence_selection
statement:
theorem finite_subsequence_selection {A : Type*} [Finite A]
    (P : A → (ℕ → ℕ) → Prop)
    (hstable : ∀ a (φ ψ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono φ → StrictMono ψ → P a φ → P a (φ ∘ ψ))
    (hselect : ∀ a (φ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono φ → ∃ ψ, StrictMono ψ ∧ P a (φ ∘ ψ)) :
    ∃ φ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ a, P a φ

name: OAI.C0Absorption.high_bands_compatible
statement:
theorem high_bands_compatible {Γ : Type*} {B : CylinderBases Γ} (loc : TagLocalization B)
    (γ : ℕ → Γ) (r : ∀ i, GeneratedRepresentation B (γ i)) (h : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ i, (r i).operations.length ≤ h)
    (hj : Tendsto (fun i => B.band (γ i)) atTop atTop)
    (m : ℕ → SourceSpace B) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : ∀ i, δ ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (r i).value (m i)|) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ F : ℕ → C0Ball → ℝ,
      (∀ i, F i ∈ TClass B (h+1)) ∧
      (∀ i, δ/2 ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (F i) (m (φ i))|) ∧
      ∀ n (ε : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, |ε i|=1) →
        LipschitzWith (4^(h+1)*B.L0+1) (fun s => ∑ i, ε i*F i s)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.nat_constant_or_tendsto
statement:
theorem nat_constant_or_tendsto (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (∃ a, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ i, f (φ i)=a) ∨
    Tendsto f atTop atTop

name: OAI.C0Absorption.nested_selection_lipschitz
statement:
theorem nested_selection_lipschitz {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {S : Set E} (hS : Convex ℝ S) (u b : ℕ → S → ℝ) (C : ℕ → Set S) (e : ℕ → ℝ)
    (K Kb : ℝ≥0) (hu : ∀ i, Continuous (u i)) (hb : ∀ i, LipschitzWith Kb (b i))
    (hF : ∀ i, LipschitzWith K (fun x => u i x*b i x))
    (hC : ∀ i, IsOpen (C i)) (hc : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ C i, u i x=e i)
    (hnest : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, tsupport (u j) ⊆ C i)
    (hsmall : Tendsto (fun i => |e i| *(Kb : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
      ∀ n (ε : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, |ε i|=1) →
        LipschitzWith (K+1) (fun x => ∑ i, ε i * (u (φ i) x*b (φ i) x))

name: OAI.C0Absorption.thin_sequence
statement:
theorem thin_sequence {r : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (hr : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, r i j) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ i j, i < j → r (φ i) (φ j)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.RadiusLocalization.low_bands_disjoint
statement:
theorem low_bands_disjoint (γ : ℕ → Γ) (r : ∀ i, GeneratedRepresentation B (γ i))
    (ts : ℕ → List TailOperation) (h j : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ i, (r i).operations.length ≤ h) (hj : ∀ i, B.band (γ i)=j) (hjh : j ≤ h)
    (ht : ∀ i, (ts i).length ≤ h) (ha : ∀ i t, t ∈ ts i → t.scaleIndex ≤ h)
    (hγ : Function.Injective γ) (m : ℕ → SourceSpace B) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : ∀ i, δ ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin
      (fun s => (r i).value s*tailProduct (ts i) s) (m i)|) :
    ∃ H, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ F : ℕ → C0Ball → ℝ,
      (∀ i, F i ∈ VClass B H) ∧
      (∀ i, δ/2 ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (F i) (m (φ i))|) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i k => Disjoint (tsupport (F i)) (tsupport (F k)))

name: OAI.C0Absorption.RadiusLocalization.representation_tail_lower
statement:
theorem representation_tail_lower {γ : Γ} (r : GeneratedRepresentation B γ)
    (ht : ¬loc.terminal γ) (N : ℕ) (hN : N < loc.firstCoordinate γ)
    (s : C0Ball) (hs : s ∈ tsupport r.value) :
    B.ell (B.band γ)/2 ≤ tau N s.val

name: OAI.C0Absorption.VClass_mul_tail
statement:
theorem VClass_mul_tail {h : ℕ} {f : C0Ball → ℝ} (hf : f ∈ VClass B h) (a N : ℕ) :
    (fun s => f s*tailFactor (dyadic a) (N+1) s.val) ∈ VClass B (h+a+1)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.small_supports_compatible
statement:
theorem small_supports_compatible {Γ : Type*} {B : CylinderBases Γ} {γ : Γ}
    (r : ℕ → GeneratedRepresentation B γ) (ts : ℕ → List TailOperation) (h : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ i, (r i).operations.length ≤ h) (hj : B.band γ ≤ h)
    (ht : ∀ i, (ts i).length ≤ h) (ha : ∀ i t, t ∈ ts i → t.scaleIndex ≤ h)
    (q : ℕ → Cube (B.coordinates γ)) (a b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (haPos : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (ha0 : Tendsto a atTop (nhds 0)) (hb0 : Tendsto b atTop (nhds 0))
    (hsup : ∀ i x, |(r i).cubeValue x| ≤ b i)
    (hsupp : ∀ i x, x ∈ tsupport (r i).cubeValue → dist x (q i) ≤ a i)
    (m : ℕ → SourceSpace B) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hd : ∀ i, δ ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin
      (fun s => (r i).value s*tailProduct (ts i) s) (m i)|) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ F : ℕ → C0Ball → ℝ,
      (∀ i, F i ∈ VClass B (h+1)) ∧
      (∀ i, δ/2 ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (F i) (m (φ i))|) ∧
      ∀ n (ε : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, |ε i|=1) →
        LipschitzWith (4^(h+1)*B.L0+(h+1)*4^(h+1)*B.A+1)
          (fun s => ∑ i, ε i*F i s)

name: OAI.C0Absorption.tail_separation
statement:
theorem tail_separation {h : ℕ} (F : ℕ → C0Ball → ℝ) (m : ℕ → SourceSpace B)
    (hF : ∀ i, F i ∈ VClass B h) {δ cstar : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hcstar : 0 < cstar)
    (hdetect : ∀ i, δ ≤ |completedPairing (sourceClasses B) c0Origin (F i) (m i)|)
    (M : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : Tendsto M atTop atTop)
    (hsupport : ∀ i s, s ∈ tsupport (F i) → cstar ≤ tau (M i) s.val) :

      m * q < 1 ∧ m * q + h⁻¹ * (2 * m * r + (1 - m * q)⁻¹ - 1) < h ∧

    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {g : B × R → ℝ} {ψ U : B → ℝ}
    (hg : Integrable g (μ.prod ν)) (hψ : Integrable ψ μ) (hU : Integrable U μ)
    (hU0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ U b) {m r q h : ℝ} (hm : ∫ b, U b ∂μ = m)
    (hm0 : 0 ≤ m) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hmq : m * q < 1) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hg1 : ∫ z, |g z| ∂(μ.prod ν) ≤ 1)
    {D : Set R} (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hDprob : 1 - m * q ≤ ν.real D)
    (hgood : ∀ b v, v ∈ D → |g (b, v) - ψ b| ≤ r * U b) :
    (∫ b, |normalizeFunction μ ψ b| ∂μ) ≤ 1 ∧
    (μ.prod ν).real {z | h < |g z - normalizeFunction μ ψ z.1|} ≤
      m * q + h⁻¹ * (2 * m * r + (1 - m * q)⁻¹ - 1)

statement:
lemma arrayMultiplier_tail {p c : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (hc : scale p ≤ c) (k : κ) (j : ι) :
    (arrayMeasure κ ι).real {v | c < arrayMultiplier p k j v} = (scale p / c)^p

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.array_coordinate_mp
statement:
lemma array_coordinate_mp (k : κ) (j : ι) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun v : κ → cube ι => v k j) (arrayMeasure κ ι) volume

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.atomL1_ae
statement:
lemma atomL1_ae [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p)
    (u : Lp ℝ 1 μ) (k : κ) (j : ι) :
    atomL1 hp u k j =ᵐ[μ.prod (arrayMeasure κ ι)]
      fun z => u z.1 * arrayMultiplier p k j z.2

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.atomL1_near_additive
statement:
lemma atomL1_near_additive {p c h : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hpc : scale p ≤ c)
    (herr : 2 * ((scale p / c)^p + c) < h) {w u : Lp ℝ 1 μ}
    (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (k : κ) (j : ι) :
    2 - h ≤ ‖oldL1 w + atomL1 hp u k j‖

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.integrable_arrayMultiplier
statement:
lemma integrable_arrayMultiplier {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (k : κ) (j : ι) :
    Integrable (arrayMultiplier p k j) (arrayMeasure κ ι)

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.integral_arrayMultiplier
statement:
lemma integral_arrayMultiplier {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (k : κ) (j : ι) :
    (∫ v, arrayMultiplier p k j v ∂arrayMeasure κ ι) = 1

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.measurable_arrayMultiplier
statement:
lemma measurable_arrayMultiplier [Fintype κ] [Fintype ι] (p : ℝ) (k : κ) (j : ι) :
    Measurable (arrayMultiplier p k j)

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.norm_atomL1
statement:
lemma norm_atomL1 {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (u : Lp ℝ 1 μ) (k : κ) (j : ι) :
    ‖atomL1 hp u k j‖ = ‖u‖

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.productOperator_ae
statement:
lemma productOperator_ae {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (x : Lp ℝ 1 μ) (u : κ → Lp ℝ 1 μ) (a : κ → ι → ℝ) :
    productOperator hp u (x,a) =ᵐ[μ.prod (arrayMeasure κ ι)]
      enlargedFunction p x (fun k => (u k : B → ℝ)) a

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.productOperator_zero_coeff
statement:
lemma productOperator_zero_coeff [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p)
    (u : κ → Lp ℝ 1 μ) (x : Lp ℝ 1 μ) :
    productOperator (ι := ι) hp u (x,0) = oldL1 x

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.atoms_average_norm
statement:
lemma atoms_average_norm {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) {n : ℕ} (u : Lp ℝ 1 μ) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (k : κ) :
    ‖oldL1 u - (n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ j : Fin n, atomL1 hp u k j‖ =
      ∫ v : cube (Fin n), |(n : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∑ j, multiplier p (v j)) - 1| ∂cubeMeasure (Fin n)

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.normalizeL1_ae
statement:
lemma normalizeL1_ae (f : Lp ℝ 1 μ) {g : B → ℝ} (hfg : f =ᵐ[μ] g) :
    normalizeL1 f =ᵐ[μ] normalizeFunction μ g

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.normalizeL1_mem
statement:
lemma normalizeL1_mem (G : Submodule ℝ (Lp ℝ 1 μ)) {f : Lp ℝ 1 μ} (hf : f ∈ G) :
    normalizeL1 f ∈ G

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.normalizeL1_norm
statement: lemma normalizeL1_norm (f : Lp ℝ 1 μ) : ‖normalizeL1 f‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.oldCombination_ae
statement:
lemma oldCombination_ae (x : Lp ℝ 1 μ) {κ : Type uKappa} [Fintype κ]
    (u : κ → Lp ℝ 1 μ) (c : κ → ℝ) :
    (x + ∑ k, c k • u k : Lp ℝ 1 μ) =ᵐ[μ] oldCombination x (fun k => (u k : B → ℝ)) c

name: OAI.ExactModuli.measureDistance_le_of_tail
statement:
lemma measureDistance_le_of_tail [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f g : Lp ℝ 1 μ) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (ht : μ.real {b | h < |f b - g b|} < h) : measureDistance μ f g ≤ h

name: OAI.ExactModuli.measureDistance_pullback
statement:
lemma measureDistance_pullback [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {F : B → R} (hF : MeasurePreserving F μ ν) (f g : Lp ℝ 1 ν) :
    measureDistance μ (Lp.compMeasurePreserving F hF f) (Lp.compMeasurePreserving F hF g) =
      measureDistance ν f g

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.finiteDimensional_model
statement:
lemma finiteDimensional_model (L : X →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Y) (G : Submodule ℝ Y) [FiniteDimensional ℝ G] :
    FiniteDimensional ℝ (G.comap L.toLinearMap)

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.joinedCoordinates_mp
statement:
lemma joinedCoordinates_mp (d : β ⊕ (κ × ι) → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d) :
    MeasurePreserving (joinedCoordinates d) kwMeasure ((cubeMeasure β).prod (arrayMeasure κ ι))

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.joinedL1_measureDistance
statement:
lemma joinedL1_measureDistance (d : β ⊕ (κ × ι) → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d)
    (f g : Lp ℝ 1 ((cubeMeasure β).prod (arrayMeasure κ ι))) :
    measureDistance kwMeasure (joinedL1 d hd f) (joinedL1 d hd g) =
      measureDistance ((cubeMeasure β).prod (arrayMeasure κ ι)) f g

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.joinedL1_old
statement:
lemma joinedL1_old (c : β → ℕ) (hc : Function.Injective c)
    (d : β ⊕ (κ × ι) → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (hdc : ∀ b, d (Sum.inl b) = c b)
    (f : Lp ℝ 1 (cubeMeasure β)) :
    joinedL1 d hd (oldL1 f) = coordinatesL1 c hc f

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.joinedL1_range
statement:
lemma joinedL1_range (d : β ⊕ (κ × ι) → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d) :
    (joinedL1 d hd).toLinearMap.range ≤ (coordinatesL1 d hd).toLinearMap.range

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.productOperator_single
statement:
lemma productOperator_single [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p)
    (u : κ → Lp ℝ 1 μ) (k : κ) (j : ι) :
    ∃ a : κ → ι → ℝ, productOperator hp u (0,a) = atomL1 hp (u k) k j

name: OAI.ExactModuli.KW.normalizeL1_approx
OAI.ExactModuli.KW.sphere_normalize_approx
statement:
lemma sphere_normalize_approx {X : Type uX} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    (x y : X) (hx : ‖x‖ = 1) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    ‖x - ‖y‖⁻¹ • y‖ ≤ 2 * ‖x-y‖

name: OAI.ExactModuli.measureDistance_le_of_norm_sub_lt_sq
statement:
lemma measureDistance_le_of_norm_sub_lt_sq (f g : Lp ℝ 1 μ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hfg : ‖f - g‖ < ε ^ 2) : measureDistance μ f g ≤ ε

name: OAI.ExactModuli.measureDistance_self
statement: lemma measureDistance_self (f : Lp ℝ 1 μ) : measureDistance μ f f = 0

name: OAI.ExactModuli.measureDistance_symm
statement:
lemma measureDistance_symm [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f g : Lp ℝ 1 μ) :
    measureDistance μ f g = measureDistance μ g f

name: OAI.ExactModuli.measureDistance_triangle
statement:
lemma measureDistance_triangle (f g k : Lp ℝ 1 μ) :
    measureDistance μ f k ≤ measureDistance μ f g + measureDistance μ g k

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.FiniteAverage.double_product
statement:
lemma double_product (w f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    (∑ ω, w ω * f ω) * (∑ ω, w ω * g ω) =
      ∑ ω, ∑ ν, w ω * w ν * (f ω * g ν)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.FiniteAverage.jensen_sq
statement:
lemma jensen_sq (w f : Ω → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) (hs : ∑ ω, w ω = 1) :
    (∑ ω, w ω * f ω) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ ω, w ω * f ω ^ 2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.FiniteAverage.joint_budget
statement:
lemma joint_budget (w : Ω → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ω,0 ≤ w ω) (hs : ∑ ω,w ω=1)
    (I : Ω → Type*) [∀ ω,Fintype (I ω)] (a b : ∀ ω,I ω→ℝ) {r R : ℝ}
    (he : ∀ ω,(∑ i,a ω i^2) ≤ R^2)
    (hc : (∑ ω,w ω*(∑ i,a ω i*b ω i)) = r^2) :
    (∑ ω,w ω*(∑ i,(a ω i-b ω i)^2)) +
      (∑ ω,w ω*(r^2-∑ i,b ω i^2)) ≤ R^2-r^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.FiniteAverage.norm_mean_le_sqrt
statement:
lemma norm_mean_le_sqrt {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (w : Ω → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) (hs : ∑ ω,w ω = 1)
    (z : Ω → E) {V : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hz : (∑ ω, w ω * ‖z ω‖ ^ 2) ≤ V) :
    ‖∑ ω, w ω • z ω‖ ≤ Real.sqrt V

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.FiniteAverage.pooled_mass
statement:
lemma pooled_mass {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (w : Ω → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) (hs : ∑ ω,w ω = 1)
    (b W : Ω → κ → ℝ) (V L : Ω → ℝ)
    (hmean : ∀ g, (∑ ω,w ω*b ω g) = -(∑ ω,w ω*W ω g))
    (hW : ∀ ω, (∑ g,W ω g ^ 2) ≤ V ω)
    (hopp : ∀ ω ν, (∑ g, (|b ω g| * |b ν g| - b ω g*b ν g)) ≤ L ω + L ν) :
    (∑ g, (∑ ω,w ω* |b ω g|)^2) ≤ (∑ ω,w ω*V ω) + 2*(∑ ω,w ω*L ω)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.FiniteAverage.sqrt_pooled
statement:
lemma sqrt_pooled {η θ : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :
    Real.sqrt η + Real.sqrt (η+2*θ) ≤ 2*Real.sqrt (η+θ)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.FiniteAverage.sum_mul_sq_le
statement:
lemma sum_mul_sq_le (w : Ω → ℝ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω)
    (hs : ∑ ω,w ω = 1) (f : Ω → ℝ) {V : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hf : (∑ ω, w ω * f ω ^ 2) ≤ V) :
    |∑ ω, w ω * f ω| ≤ Real.sqrt V

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.Family.seminorm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem Family.seminorm_apply (F : T.Family) (u : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    F.seminorm u = ‖F.test u‖

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.Family.test_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem Family.test_apply (F : T.Family) (u : ι →₀ ℝ) (i : Fin F.n) :
    F.test u i = ∑ v ∈ F.seg i, u v

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.Family.test_le_l1
statement:
lemma Family.test_le_l1 (F : T.Family) (u : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    ‖F.test u‖ ≤ u.sum (fun _ r => |r|)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.Family.test_single_le
statement:
lemma Family.test_single_le (F : T.Family) (v : ι) (r : ℝ) :
    ‖F.test (Finsupp.single v r)‖ ≤ |r|

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.coordinate_le_primal
statement: lemma coordinate_le_primal (u : ι →₀ ℝ) (v : ι) : |u v| ≤ T.primalSeminorm u

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.families_bddAbove
statement: lemma families_bddAbove : BddAbove (Set.range (Family.seminorm (T := T)))

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.headArray_outside
statement:
lemma headArray_outside (H : Finset ι) (u : T.JamesSpace) {v : ι} (hv : v ∉ H) :
    T.headArray H u v = 0

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.ofPrimal_filter
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofPrimal_filter (p : ι → Prop) (u : T.Primal) :
    T.ofPrimal (T.filterPrimal p u) = (T.ofPrimal u).filter p

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.primal_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma primal_eq_zero_iff (u : ι →₀ ℝ) : T.primalSeminorm u = 0 ↔ u = 0

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.primal_le_l1
statement:
lemma primal_le_l1 (u : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    T.primalSeminorm u ≤ u.sum (fun _ r => |r|)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.test_energy_le
statement:
lemma test_energy_le {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (S : κ → Finset ι)
    (hS : ∀ i, T.IsSegment (S i))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (S i) (S j))) (u : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    (∑ i, (∑ v ∈ S i, u v) ^ 2) ≤ (T.primalSeminorm u) ^ 2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.test_energy_le_allow_empty
statement:
lemma test_energy_le_allow_empty {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (S : κ → Finset ι)
    (hS : ∀ i, (S i).Nonempty → T.IsSegment (S i))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (S i) (S j))) (u : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    (∑ i, (∑ v ∈ S i, u v) ^ 2) ≤ (T.primalSeminorm u) ^ 2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.test_le_primal
statement:
lemma test_le_primal (F : T.Family) (u : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    ‖F.test u‖ ≤ T.primalSeminorm u

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.ancestral_not_above
statement: lemma ancestral_not_above (c : ι) : A.Ancestral {v | ¬ c ≤ v}

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.boundaryCoeff_eq
statement:
lemma boundaryCoeff_eq (F : A.segments.Family) (p : ι →₀ ℝ)
    (i : Fin F.n) {g : ι} (hg : g ∈ F.seg i) :
    A.boundaryCoeff F p g = ∑ v ∈ F.seg i, p v

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.boundaryCoeff_nonzero_mem
statement:
lemma boundaryCoeff_nonzero_mem (F : A.segments.Family) (p : ι →₀ ℝ)
    {g : ι} (h : A.boundaryCoeff F p g ≠ 0) : ∃ i, g ∈ F.seg i

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.crossing_cut_sum
statement:
lemma crossing_cut_sum {H : Set ι} (hH : A.Ancestral H) (p : ι →₀ ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ v, v ∉ H → p v = 0) (F G : A.segments.Family)
    (i : Fin F.n) (j : Fin G.n) {g : ι} (hg : g ∉ H)
    (hgF : g ∈ F.seg i) (hgG : g ∈ G.seg j)
    (hfirst : A.first F i ≤ A.first G j) :
    (∑ v ∈ (F.seg i).filter (fun v => A.first G j ≤ v), p v) =
      ∑ v ∈ G.seg j, p v

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.exists_gate_le
statement:
lemma exists_gate_le {H : Set ι} {K : Finset ι} (hK : A.Ancestral (K : Set ι))
    {v : ι} (hvK : v ∈ K) (hvH : v ∉ H) :
    ∃ g ∈ K, A.Gate H g ∧ g ≤ v

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.finite_heads_of_predecessors
statement:
lemma finite_heads_of_predecessors
    (hpred : ∀ b : ι, ({a : ι | a ≤ b} : Set ι).Finite) :
    ∀ S : Finset ι, ∃ K : Finset ι, S ⊆ K ∧ A.Ancestral (K : Set ι)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.first_le_of_mem
statement:
lemma first_le_of_mem (F : A.segments.Family) (i : Fin F.n) {v : ι}
    (hv : v ∈ F.seg i) : A.first F i ≤ v

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.first_mem
statement: lemma first_mem (F : A.segments.Family) (i : Fin F.n) : A.first F i ∈ F.seg i

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.first_spec
statement:
lemma first_spec (F : A.segments.Family) (i : Fin F.n) :
    ∃ b, A.first F i ≤ b ∧ ∀ v, v ∈ F.seg i ↔ A.first F i ≤ v ∧ v ≤ b

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.gate_on_nonzero_segment
statement:
lemma gate_on_nonzero_segment {H K : Finset ι} (hH : A.Ancestral (H : Set ι))
    (hK : A.Ancestral (K : Set ι)) (F : A.segments.Family)
    (hFK : ∀ i, F.seg i ⊆ K) (p : ι →₀ ℝ) (hp : ∀ v, v ∉ H → p v = 0)
    (i : Fin F.n) (hi : (∑ v ∈ F.seg i, p v) ≠ 0) {v : ι}
    (hvi : v ∈ F.seg i) (hvH : v ∉ H) :
    ∃ g ∈ K, A.Gate (H : Set ι) g ∧ g ∈ F.seg i

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.gate_unique_in_segment
OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.gates_eq_of_common_upper
statement:
lemma gates_eq_of_common_upper {H : Set ι} {g h v : ι} (hg : A.Gate H g)
    (hh : A.Gate H h) (hgv : g ≤ v) (hhv : h ≤ v) : g = h

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.gates_eq_of_le
statement:
lemma gates_eq_of_le {H : Set ι} {g h : ι} (hg : A.Gate H g)
    (hh : A.Gate H h) (hgh : g ≤ h) : g = h

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.interval_chain
statement:
lemma interval_chain {S : Finset ι} (hS : A.segments.IsSegment S) :
    ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, a ≤ b ∨ b ≤ a

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.localize_family_energy
statement:
lemma localize_family_energy {K : Finset ι} (hK : A.Ancestral (K : Set ι))
    (F : A.segments.Family) (p : ι →₀ ℝ) (hp : ∀ v, v ∉ K → p v = 0) :
    ∃ G : A.segments.LocalFamily K,
      (∑ i, (∑ v ∈ F.seg i, p v) ^ 2) =
        ∑ S : A.segments.LocalIndex G, (∑ v ∈ S.val, p v) ^ 2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.matched_split_gain_le
statement:
lemma matched_split_gain_le {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (F : A.segments.Family) (e : κ ↪ Fin F.n) (c : κ → ι) (p : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    (∑ i, (∑ v ∈ F.seg i, p v) ^ 2) +
      2 * (∑ a, ((∑ v ∈ (F.seg (e a)).filter (fun v => c a ≤ v), p v) ^ 2 -
        (∑ v ∈ F.seg (e a), p v) *
          (∑ v ∈ (F.seg (e a)).filter (fun v => c a ≤ v), p v))) ≤
      (A.segments.primalSeminorm p) ^ 2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.mem_gateSet
statement:
lemma mem_gateSet {H K : Finset ι} {g : ι} :
    g ∈ A.gateSet H K ↔ g ∈ K ∧ A.Gate (H : Set ι) g

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.opposite_crossing_le
statement:
lemma opposite_crossing_le {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    {H : Set ι} (hH : A.Ancestral H) (p : ι →₀ ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ v, v ∉ H → p v = 0) (F G : A.segments.Family)
    (gate : κ ↪ ι) (hgate : ∀ a, A.Gate H (gate a)) :
    (∑ a, (|A.boundaryCoeff F p (gate a)| * |A.boundaryCoeff G p (gate a)| -
      A.boundaryCoeff F p (gate a) * A.boundaryCoeff G p (gate a))) ≤
      ((A.segments.primalSeminorm p) ^ 2 - ∑ i, (∑ v ∈ F.seg i, p v) ^ 2) +
      ((A.segments.primalSeminorm p) ^ 2 - ∑ j, (∑ v ∈ G.seg j, p v) ^ 2)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.opposite_matching_le
statement:
lemma opposite_matching_le {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    {H : Set ι} (hH : A.Ancestral H) (p : ι →₀ ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ v, v ∉ H → p v = 0) (F G : A.segments.Family)
    (eF : κ ↪ Fin F.n) (eG : κ ↪ Fin G.n) (g : κ → ι)
    (hgH : ∀ a, g a ∉ H) (hgF : ∀ a, g a ∈ F.seg (eF a))
    (hgG : ∀ a, g a ∈ G.seg (eG a))
    (hopp : ∀ a, (∑ v ∈ F.seg (eF a), p v) * (∑ v ∈ G.seg (eG a), p v) < 0) :
    2 * (∑ a, |(∑ v ∈ F.seg (eF a), p v) * (∑ v ∈ G.seg (eG a), p v)|) ≤
      ((A.segments.primalSeminorm p) ^ 2 - ∑ i, (∑ v ∈ F.seg i, p v) ^ 2) +
      ((A.segments.primalSeminorm p) ^ 2 - ∑ j, (∑ v ∈ G.seg j, p v) ^ 2)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.primal_filter_le
statement:
lemma primal_filter_le {H : Set ι} (hH : A.Ancestral H) (u : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    A.segments.primalSeminorm (u.filter (· ∈ H)) ≤ A.segments.primalSeminorm u

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.primal_filter_tail_le
statement:
lemma primal_filter_tail_le {H : Set ι} (hH : A.Ancestral H) (u : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    A.segments.primalSeminorm (u.filter (· ∉ H)) ≤ A.segments.primalSeminorm u

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.primal_le_of_local_energies
statement:
lemma primal_le_of_local_energies {K : Finset ι} (hK : A.Ancestral (K : Set ι))
    (p : ι →₀ ℝ) (hp : ∀ v, v ∉ K → p v = 0) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hlocal : ∀ G : A.segments.LocalFamily K,
      (∑ S : A.segments.LocalIndex G, (∑ v ∈ S.val, p v) ^ 2) ≤ M ^ 2) :
    A.segments.primalSeminorm p ≤ M

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.segment_filter_head
statement:
lemma segment_filter_head {S : Finset ι} (hS : A.segments.IsSegment S)
    {H : Set ι} (hH : A.Ancestral H) :
    (S.filter (· ∈ H)).Nonempty → A.segments.IsSegment (S.filter (· ∈ H))

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.segment_filter_tail
statement:
lemma segment_filter_tail {S : Finset ι} (hS : A.segments.IsSegment S)
    {H : Set ι} (hH : A.Ancestral H) :
    (S.filter (· ∉ H)).Nonempty → A.segments.IsSegment (S.filter (· ∉ H))

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.split_energy_le
statement:
lemma split_energy_le (F : A.segments.Family) (H : Fin F.n → Set ι)
    (hH : ∀ i, A.Ancestral (H i)) (u : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ((∑ v ∈ (F.seg i).filter (· ∈ H i), u v) ^ 2 +
      (∑ v ∈ (F.seg i).filter (· ∉ H i), u v) ^ 2)) ≤
      (A.segments.primalSeminorm u) ^ 2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.split_gain_le
statement:
lemma split_gain_le (F : A.segments.Family) (H : Fin F.n → Set ι)
    (hH : ∀ i, A.Ancestral (H i)) (u : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    (∑ i, (∑ v ∈ F.seg i, u v) ^ 2) +
      2 * (∑ i : Fin F.n, ((∑ v ∈ (F.seg i).filter (· ∉ H i), u v) ^ 2 -
        (∑ v ∈ F.seg i, u v) * (∑ v ∈ (F.seg i).filter (· ∉ H i), u v))) ≤
        (A.segments.primalSeminorm u) ^ 2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.sum_extend_zero
statement:
lemma sum_extend_zero {κ ν : Type*} [Fintype κ] [Fintype ν]
    (e : κ ↪ ν) (f : κ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, Function.extend e f (fun _ => 0) i) = ∑ a, f a

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.tailAt_allowed
OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.tailAt_cone
statement:
lemma tailAt_cone {F : A.segments.Family} {H : Finset ι} {g v : ι}
    (hg : A.Gate (H : Set ι) g) (hv : v ∈ A.tailAt F H g) : g ≤ v

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.tailAt_eq
statement:
lemma tailAt_eq (F : A.segments.Family) (H : Finset ι)
    (i : Fin F.n) {g : ι} (hg : g ∈ F.seg i) :
    A.tailAt F H g = (F.seg i).filter (· ∉ H)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.tailAt_mem
statement:
lemma tailAt_mem {F : A.segments.Family} {H : Finset ι} {g v : ι}
    (hv : v ∈ A.tailAt F H g) : ∃ i, g ∈ F.seg i ∧ v ∈ F.seg i ∧ v ∉ H

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.tailAt_outside
statement:
lemma tailAt_outside {F : A.segments.Family} {H : Finset ι} {g v : ι}
    (hv : v ∈ A.tailAt F H g) : v ∉ H

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Ancestry.tailAt_pairwise
OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.block_add_sq
statement:
lemma block_add_sq (c : ι → κ)
    (hsame : ∀ S, T.IsSegment S → ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ v ∈ S, c u=c v)
    (p q : ι →₀ ℝ) (hd : Disjoint (T.colorSupport c p) (T.colorSupport c q)) :
    (T.primalSeminorm (p+q))^2 ≤ (T.primalSeminorm p)^2+(T.primalSeminorm q)^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.coordinate_energy_le
statement:
lemma coordinate_energy_le (p : ι →₀ ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    (∑ v ∈ S,p v^2) ≤ (T.primalSeminorm p)^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.finiteArray_apply
statement:
lemma finiteArray_apply (S : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℝ) (v : ι) :
    finiteArray S a v = if v ∈ S then a v else 0

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.finiteArray_energy
statement:
lemma finiteArray_energy (S : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ v ∈ (finiteArray S a).support,finiteArray S a v^2) = ∑ v ∈ S,a v^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.finiteArray_support
statement: lemma finiteArray_support (S : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℝ) : (finiteArray S a).support ⊆ S

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.finite_square_tails
OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.primal_sq_le
statement:
lemma primal_sq_le (p : ι →₀ ℝ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hF : ∀ F : T.Family, (∑ i, (∑ v ∈ F.seg i,p v)^2) ≤ M) :
    (T.primalSeminorm p)^2 ≤ M

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.primal_sq_le_of_segment
statement:
lemma primal_sq_le_of_segment (p : ι →₀ ℝ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hS : ∀ S, T.IsSegment S → (∑ v ∈ S,p v)^2 ≤ L*(∑ v ∈ S,p v^2)) :
    (T.primalSeminorm p)^2 ≤ L*(∑ v ∈ p.support,p v^2)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.SegmentSystem.sum_sq_le_support
statement:
lemma sum_sq_le_support (p : ι →₀ ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    (∑ v ∈ S,p v^2) ≤ ∑ v ∈ p.support,p v^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Forest.component_set_ancestral
statement:
lemma component_set_ancestral (C : Finset ℕ) :
    Ancestry.Ancestral (A := forestAncestry) {v : ForestNode | component v ∈ C}

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Forest.primal_sq_bounded_components
statement:
lemma primal_sq_bounded_components (C : Finset ℕ) (p : ForestNode →₀ ℝ)

    (forestSegments.primalSeminorm p)^2 ≤ (((C.sup (id : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ)+1)*(∑ v ∈ p.support,p v^2)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Forest.same_component
statement:
lemma same_component (S : Finset ForestNode) (hS : forestSegments.IsSegment S)
    (u : ForestNode) (hu : u ∈ S) (v : ForestNode) (hv : v ∈ S) :
    component u=component v

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Forest.segment_card_le
statement:
lemma segment_card_le (S : Finset ForestNode) (hS : forestSegments.IsSegment S)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.forest_finite_heads

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.adj_endpoint
statement:
lemma adj_endpoint (n : ℕ) (e : Edge n) :
    (graph n).Adj (endpoint n e false) (endpoint n e true)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.adj_iff
statement:
lemma adj_iff {n : ℕ} {u v : Vertex n} : (graph n).Adj u v ↔
    ∃ e : Edge n, (u=endpoint n e false ∧ v=endpoint n e true) ∨
      (u=endpoint n e true ∧ v=endpoint n e false)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.adj_old_mid
statement:
lemma adj_old_mid {n : ℕ} {u : Vertex n} {e : Edge n} {i : ℕ} :
    (graph (n+1)).Adj (Sum.inl u) (Sum.inr (e,i)) ↔
      u=endpoint n e false ∨ u=endpoint n e true

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.connected
statement: lemma connected (n : ℕ) : (graph n).Connected

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.deviation_separated
OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.deviation_sub
statement:
lemma deviation_sub {n : ℕ} (f : Vertex (n+1) → X) (e : Edge n) (i j : ℕ) :
    deviation f e i-deviation f e j=
      (2:ℝ)^(n+1) • (f (Sum.inr (e,i))-f (Sum.inr (e,j)))

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.dist_old
statement:
lemma dist_old (n : ℕ) (u v : Vertex n) :
    (graph (n+1)).dist (Sum.inl u) (Sum.inl v)=2*(graph n).dist u v

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.dist_siblings
statement:
lemma dist_siblings (n : ℕ) (e : Edge n) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (graph (n+1)).dist (Sum.inr (e,i)) (Sum.inr (e,j))=2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.distance_edge
statement:
lemma distance_edge (n : ℕ) (e : Edge n) :
    distance n (endpoint n e false) (endpoint n e true)=1/(2:ℝ)^n

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.distance_old
statement:
lemma distance_old (n : ℕ) (u v : Vertex n) :
    distance (n+1) (Sum.inl u) (Sum.inl v)=distance n u v

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.distance_potential
statement:
lemma distance_potential (n : ℕ) (a : Vertex n) :
    ∀ u v,(graph n).Adj u v →
      |((graph n).dist a u : ℝ)-(graph n).dist a v| ≤ 1

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.distance_siblings
statement:
lemma distance_siblings (n : ℕ) (e : Edge n) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    distance (n+1) (Sum.inr (e,i)) (Sum.inr (e,j))=2/(2:ℝ)^(n+1)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.distortion_bound
statement:
lemma distortion_bound (hX : QuadraticLens X) (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X)
    (D s : ℝ) (h : HasDistortion k f D s) : 1+(k:ℝ)/4 ≤ D^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.endpoint_ne
statement: lemma endpoint_ne (n : ℕ) (e : Edge n) : endpoint n e false ≠ endpoint n e true

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.extendPotential_adj
statement:
lemma extendPotential_adj {n : ℕ} (φ : Vertex n → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ u v,(graph n).Adj u v → |φ u-φ v| ≤ 1) :
    ∀ u v,(graph (n+1)).Adj u v → |extendPotential φ u-extendPotential φ v| ≤ 1

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.not_adj_new
statement:
lemma not_adj_new {n : ℕ} (u v : Edge n × ℕ) :
    ¬(graph (n+1)).Adj (Sum.inr u) (Sum.inr v)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.not_adj_old
statement:
lemma not_adj_old {n : ℕ} (u v : Vertex n) :
    ¬(graph (n+1)).Adj (Sum.inl u) (Sum.inl v)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.potential_walk
statement:
lemma potential_walk {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} (φ : V → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ u v,G.Adj u v → |φ u-φ v| ≤ 1) {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) :
    |φ u-φ v| ≤ p.length

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.replace_adj
statement:
lemma replace_adj {n : ℕ} {u v : Vertex n} (h : (graph n).Adj u v) :
    ∃ p : (graph (n+1)).Walk (Sum.inl u) (Sum.inl v), p.length=2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.replace_walk
statement:
lemma replace_walk {n : ℕ} {u v : Vertex n} (p : (graph n).Walk u v) :
    ∃ q : (graph (n+1)).Walk (Sum.inl u) (Sum.inl v),q.length=2*p.length

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.slope_minus_deviation
statement:
lemma slope_minus_deviation {n : ℕ} (f : Vertex (n+1) → X) (e : Edge n) (i : ℕ) :
    slope (fun v => f (Sum.inl v)) e-deviation f e i=slope f (e,i,true)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.slope_plus_deviation
statement:
lemma slope_plus_deviation {n : ℕ} (f : Vertex (n+1) → X) (e : Edge n) (i : ℕ) :
    slope (fun v => f (Sum.inl v)) e+deviation f e i=slope f (e,i,false)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.squared_stretch_loss
statement:
lemma squared_stretch_loss (hX : QuadraticLens X) (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X)
    {s B : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hl : ∀ u v,s*distance k u v ≤ ‖f u-f v‖)
    (hb : ∀ e,‖slope f e‖^2 ≤ B) : s^2*(1+(k:ℝ)/4) ≤ B

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.two_atLeastTwo
statement: theorem two_atLeastTwo : Nat.AtLeastTwo (1 + 1)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.headline
statement: theorem headline : Headline

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.backward
statement:
theorem backward {α ρ : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (_hα1 : α ≤ 1) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1)
    (hX : UnitLensBound X (2*α) ρ) (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X)
    (hl : ∀ u v,α*distance k u v ≤ ‖f u-f v‖)
    (hu : ∀ u v,‖f u-f v‖ ≤ distance k u v) : α ≤ ρ^k

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.iterate_additive
statement:
lemma iterate_additive {s D δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hstep : ∀ (x : X) (z : ℕ → X) (R : ℝ),0 ≤ R → R ≤ D → s ≤ ‖x‖ →
      (∀ i,‖x+z i‖ ≤ R) → (∀ i,‖x-z i‖ ≤ R) →
      (∀ i j,i ≠ j → 2*s ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) → ‖x‖ ≤ R-δ)
    (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLD : L ≤ D)
    (hl : ∀ u v,s*distance k u v ≤ ‖f u-f v‖)
    (hb : ∀ e,‖slope f e‖ ≤ L) : s+(k:ℝ)*δ ≤ L

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.iterate_contraction
statement:
lemma iterate_contraction {s D c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1)
    (hstep : ∀ (x : X) (z : ℕ → X) (R : ℝ),0 ≤ R → R ≤ D → s ≤ ‖x‖ →
      (∀ i,‖x+z i‖ ≤ R) → (∀ i,‖x-z i‖ ≤ R) →
      (∀ i j,i ≠ j → 2*s ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) → ‖x‖ ≤ c*R)
    (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLD : L ≤ D)
    (hl : ∀ u v,s*distance k u v ≤ ‖f u-f v‖)
    (hb : ∀ e,‖slope f e‖ ≤ L) : s ≤ c^k*L

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.norm_center_le
statement:
lemma norm_center_le {x y : X} {R : ℝ} (hp : ‖x+y‖ ≤ R) (hm : ‖x-y‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ R

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.norm_deviation_le
statement:
lemma norm_deviation_le {x y : X} {R : ℝ} (hp : ‖x+y‖ ≤ R) (hm : ‖x-y‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖y‖ ≤ R

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.normalized_distortion
OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.old_lower
OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.radial_transfer
statement:
theorem radial_transfer {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hX : RadialLens X C)
    (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X) (D s : ℝ) (hf : HasDistortion k f D s) :
    (k:ℝ) ≤ C^2*D*(D-1)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.slope_lower
statement:
lemma slope_lower {k : ℕ} (f : Vertex k → X) {s : ℝ}
    (hl : ∀ u v,s*distance k u v ≤ ‖f u-f v‖) (e : Edge k) : s ≤ ‖slope f e‖

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.slope_upper
statement:
lemma slope_upper {k : ℕ} (f : Vertex k → X) {L : ℝ}
    (hu : ∀ u v,‖f u-f v‖ ≤ L*distance k u v) (e : Edge k) : ‖slope f e‖ ≤ L

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.squared_stretch_loss_general
statement:
lemma squared_stretch_loss_general {b : ℝ} (hX : SquareLens X b) (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X)
    {s B : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hl : ∀ u v,s*distance k u v ≤ ‖f u-f v‖)
    (hb : ∀ e,‖slope f e‖^2 ≤ B) : s^2*(1+4*b*(k:ℝ)) ≤ B

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.squared_transfer
statement:
lemma squared_transfer {b : ℝ} (_hb : 0 < b) (hX : SquareLens X b)
    (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X) (D s : ℝ) (h : HasDistortion k f D s) :
    1+4*b*(k:ℝ) ≤ D^2

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.upper_one_normalization
statement:
lemma upper_one_normalization {k : ℕ} (f : Vertex k → X) {D s : ℝ}
    (h : HasDistortion k f D s) :
    ∀ u v,D⁻¹*distance k u v ≤ ‖(D*s)⁻¹ • f u-(D*s)⁻¹ • f v‖ ∧
      ‖(D*s)⁻¹ • f u-(D*s)⁻¹ • f v‖ ≤ distance k u v

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.Heads.parametric_lens
OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.Heads.pure_pair
statement:
lemma Heads.pure_pair (A : Heads ι X) {x : X} (z : ℕ → X) {R ε η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (hp : ∀ i,‖x+z i‖ ≤ R) (hm : ∀ i,‖x-z i‖ ≤ R)
    (hs : ∀ i j,i ≠ j → ε ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) :
    ∃ (H : ι) (p y : X),A.projection H p=p ∧ A.projection H y=0 ∧
      ‖x‖-η ≤ ‖p‖ ∧ ε/2-η ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖p+y‖ ≤ R+2*η ∧ ‖p-y‖ ≤ R+2*η

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.Heads.radial_lens
statement:
theorem Heads.radial_lens (A : Heads ι X) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hinput : A.RadialInput C) :
    Diamond.RadialLens X C

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.Heads.square_lens
statement:
theorem Heads.square_lens (A : Heads ι X) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hinput : A.SquareInput a) :
    Diamond.SquareLens X (a/4)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.average_lens
OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.finite_dimensional_pair
statement:
lemma finite_dimensional_pair [FiniteDimensional ℝ Y] (P : X →L[ℝ] Y)
    (z : ℕ → X) {R η : ℝ} (hz : ∀ i,‖z i‖ ≤ R) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ i j : ℕ,i ≠ j ∧ ‖P ((1/2:ℝ) • (z i-z j))‖ < η

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.finite_rank_pair
statement:
lemma finite_rank_pair (P : X →L[ℝ] X)
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ (LinearMap.range P.toLinearMap)]
    (z : ℕ → X) {R η : ℝ} (hz : ∀ i,‖z i‖ ≤ R) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ i j : ℕ,i ≠ j ∧ ‖P ((1/2:ℝ) • (z i-z j))‖ < η

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.pair_errors
statement:
lemma pair_errors (P : X →L[ℝ] X)
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ (LinearMap.range P.toLinearMap)]
    {x p : X} (z : ℕ → X) {R ε η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (hclose : ‖x-p‖ < η) (hp : ∀ i,‖x+z i‖ ≤ R) (hm : ∀ i,‖x-z i‖ ≤ R)
    (hs : ∀ i j,i ≠ j → ε ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) :
    ∃ i j : ℕ,i ≠ j ∧
      let w := (1/2:ℝ) • (z i-z j)
      let y := w-P w
      ‖P w‖ < η ∧ ε/2-η ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖x‖-η ≤ ‖p‖ ∧
        ‖p+y‖ ≤ R+2*η ∧ ‖p-y‖ ≤ R+2*η ∧ ‖x+w‖ ≤ R ∧ ‖x-w‖ ≤ R

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.positive_limit_le
statement:
lemma positive_limit_le (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousAt f 0) (hg : ContinuousAt g 0)
    (h : ∀ η,0 < η → f η ≤ g η) : f 0 ≤ g 0

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.quotient_actual_child
statement:
lemma quotient_actual_child {t g D : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hD : 1 ≤ D) (htD : t ≤ 1/(2*D)) (hX : QuotientGain X t g)
    {x : X} (z : ℕ → X) (hx : 1 ≤ ‖x‖) (hxD : ‖x‖ ≤ D)
    (hs : ∀ i j,i ≠ j → 2 ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) :
    ∃ i,‖x‖*(1+g/2) < max ‖x+z i‖ ‖x-z i‖

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.quotient_pair
statement:
lemma quotient_pair (F : Submodule ℝ X) [IsClosed (F : Set X)]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ (X ⧸ F)] (z : ℕ → X) {R η : ℝ}
    (hz : ∀ i,‖z i‖ ≤ R) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ (i j : ℕ) (v : X),i ≠ j ∧ v ∈ F ∧ ‖(1/2:ℝ) • (z i-z j)-v‖ < η

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Midpoint.quotient_parent_full_gain
statement:
lemma quotient_parent_full_gain {t g D L : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hD : 1 ≤ D) (htD : t ≤ 1/(2*D)) (hX : QuotientGain X t g)
    {x : X} (z : ℕ → X) (hx : 1 ≤ ‖x‖) (hxD : ‖x‖ ≤ D)
    (hp : ∀ i,‖x+z i‖ ≤ L) (hm : ∀ i,‖x-z i‖ ≤ L)
    (hs : ∀ i j,i ≠ j → 2 ≤ ‖z i-z j‖) : ‖x‖ ≤ L/(1+g)

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.absence_stable_growth
statement:
lemma absence_stable_growth {c s : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X)
    (hl : ∀ u v,s*distance k u v ≤ ‖f u-f v‖) (hn : ¬ StableParent c k f) :

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.enlarged_backward
statement:
theorem enlarged_backward {D β s : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hX : EnlargedLensExcluded X (2/D) β) (k : ℕ) (f : Vertex k → X)
    (hf : HasDistortion k f D s) : 1 ≤ D/(1+β)^k

name: OAI.DiamondDistortion.Diamond.enlarged_parent
statement:
lemma enlarged_parent {D β L : ℝ} (_hD : 1 ≤ D) (hβ : 0 < β)

theorem re_trace_mul_nonneg {ι : Type u_5} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    0 ≤ (Matrix.trace (A * B)).re

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.isUnit_resolvent_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem isUnit_resolvent_of_not_mem {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∉ numericalRange A) : IsUnit (z • 1 - A)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.mem_numericalRange_of_eigenvector
statement:
theorem mem_numericalRange_of_eigenvector {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    {z : ℂ} {x : Fin n → ℂ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (he : A *ᵥ x = z • x) :
    z ∈ numericalRange A

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.posSemidef_of_unit_quadratic
statement:
theorem posSemidef_of_unit_quadratic {n : ℕ} {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (hu : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n), ‖u‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ (quadratic H u).re) :
    H.PosSemidef

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.positive_resolvent
statement:
theorem positive_resolvent {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (z q : ℂ) (hz : z ∉ numericalRange A)
    (hs : ∀ w ∈ numericalRange A, 0 ≤ (star q * (z - w)).re) :
    (q • (z • 1 - A)⁻¹ + (q • (z • 1 - A)⁻¹)ᴴ).PosSemidef

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.positive_resolvent_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem positive_resolvent_of_isUnit {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (z q : ℂ) (hB : IsUnit (z • 1 - A))
    (hs : ∀ w ∈ numericalRange A, 0 ≤ (star q * (z - w)).re) :
    (q • (z • 1 - A)⁻¹ + (q • (z • 1 - A)⁻¹)ᴴ).PosSemidef

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.quadratic_add
statement:
theorem quadratic_add {n : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
    quadratic (A + B) u = quadratic A u + quadratic B u

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.quadratic_one
statement:
theorem quadratic_one {n : ℕ} (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
    quadratic 1 u = (‖u‖ : ℂ) ^ 2

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.quadratic_smul
statement:
theorem quadratic_smul {n : ℕ} (c : ℂ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
    quadratic (c • A) u = c * quadratic A u

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.quadratic_star
statement:
theorem quadratic_star {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
    quadratic Aᴴ u = star (quadratic A u)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.quadratic_sub
statement:
theorem quadratic_sub {n : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) :
    quadratic (A - B) u = quadratic A u - quadratic B u

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.quadratic_toLp
statement:
theorem quadratic_toLp {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (u : Fin n → ℂ) :
    quadratic A (WithLp.toLp 2 u) = star u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ u)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.quadratic_vector_smul
statement:
theorem quadratic_vector_smul {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)) (c : ℂ) :
    quadratic A (c • u) = (star c * c) * quadratic A u

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.resolvent_congruence
statement:
theorem resolvent_congruence {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hB : IsUnit B) (q : ℂ) :
    Bᴴ * ((q • B⁻¹) + (q • B⁻¹)ᴴ) * B = star q • B + q • Bᴴ

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.supported_matrix_posSemidef
statement:
theorem supported_matrix_posSemidef {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (z q : ℂ)
    (hs : ∀ w ∈ numericalRange A, 0 ≤ (star q * (z - w)).re) :
    (star q • (z • 1 - A) + q • (z • 1 - A)ᴴ).PosSemidef

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.exteriorKernel_nonneg_off_diagonal
statement:
theorem exteriorKernel_nonneg_off_diagonal (h q : ℂ → ℂ)
    {ζ μ : ℂ} (hζ : ‖ζ‖ = 1) (hμ : ‖μ‖ = 1) (hne : ζ ≠ μ)
    (hs : 0 ≤ (star (q ζ) * (h ζ - h μ)).re) :
    0 ≤ exteriorKernel h q ζ μ

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.kronecker_pow_one
statement:
theorem kronecker_pow_one {n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)) ^ k = (A ^ k) ⊗ₖ 1

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.re_circle_fraction
statement:
theorem re_circle_fraction {ζ μ : ℂ} (hζ : ‖ζ‖ = 1) (hμ : ‖μ‖ = 1)
    (hne : ζ ≠ μ) : 2 * (ζ / (ζ - μ)).re = 1

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.tensorPolynomial_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorPolynomial_C {n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) :
    tensorPolynomial A (Polynomial.C B) = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) ⊗ₖ B

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.tensorPolynomial_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem tensorPolynomial_X {n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    tensorPolynomial (m := m) A Polynomial.X = A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.tensorPolynomial_coefficientPolynomial
statement:
theorem tensorPolynomial_coefficientPolynomial {n m d : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (B : Fin (d + 1) → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) :
    tensorPolynomial A (coefficientPolynomial B) = tensorEvaluation A B

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.tensorPolynomial_mul
statement:
theorem tensorPolynomial_mul {n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (F G : Polynomial (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)) :
    tensorPolynomial A (F * G) = tensorPolynomial A F * tensorPolynomial A G

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.entryPair_conj
statement:
theorem entryPair_conj {ι : Type u_20} {κ : Type u_21} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (M : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : entryPair M (M.map star) = (hsSq M : ℂ)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.entryPair_eq_inner
statement:
theorem entryPair_eq_inner {ι : Type u_30} {κ : Type u_31} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (M C : Matrix ι κ ℂ) :
    entryPair M C = inner ℂ (hsVector (M.map star)) (hsVector C)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.hsSq_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem hsSq_conjTranspose {ι : Type u_14} {κ : Type u_15} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (M : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : hsSq Mᴴ = hsSq M

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.hsSq_eq_norm_hsVector_sq
statement:
theorem hsSq_eq_norm_hsVector_sq {ι : Type u_12} {κ : Type u_13} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (M : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : hsSq M = ‖hsVector M‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.hsSq_eq_sum_norm_sq
statement:
theorem hsSq_eq_sum_norm_sq {ι : Type u_8} {κ : Type u_9} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (M : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : hsSq M = ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖M i j‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.hsSq_map_star
statement:
theorem hsSq_map_star {ι : Type u_22} {κ : Type u_23} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (M : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : hsSq (M.map star) = hsSq M

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.hsSq_mul_le
statement:
theorem hsSq_mul_le {ι : Type u_24} {κ : Type u_25} {τ : Type u_26} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [Fintype τ]
    [DecidableEq κ] (F : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (G : Matrix κ τ ℂ) :
    hsSq (F * G) ≤ ‖F‖ ^ 2 * hsSq G

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.hsSq_mul_le_right
statement:
theorem hsSq_mul_le_right {ι : Type u_27} {κ : Type u_28} {τ : Type u_29} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [Fintype τ]
    [DecidableEq τ] [DecidableEq κ] (F : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (G : Matrix κ τ ℂ) :
    hsSq (F * G) ≤ hsSq F * ‖G‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.hsSq_smul
statement:
theorem hsSq_smul {ι : Type u_16} {κ : Type u_17} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (c : ℂ) (M : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : hsSq (c • M) = ‖c‖ ^ 2 * hsSq M

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.norm_entryPair_sq_le
statement:
theorem norm_entryPair_sq_le {ι : Type u_32} {κ : Type u_33} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (M C : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : ‖entryPair M C‖ ^ 2 ≤ hsSq M * hsSq C

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.norm_sum_entryPair_sq_le
statement:
theorem norm_sum_entryPair_sq_le {ρ : Type u_34} {ι : Type u_35} {κ : Type u_36} [Fintype ρ]
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (M C : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ) :
    ‖∑ k, entryPair (M k) (C k)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ k, hsSq (M k)) * ∑ k, hsSq (C k)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.entryPair_smul_right
statement:
theorem entryPair_smul_right {ι : Type u_39} {κ : Type u_40} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (M C : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (c : ℂ) : entryPair M (c • C) = c * entryPair M C

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.exists_norm_attainer
statement:
theorem exists_norm_attainer {ι : Type u_37} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (T : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    ∃ x : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι, ‖x‖ = 1 ∧ ‖T x‖ = ‖T‖

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.exists_singular_pair
statement:
theorem exists_singular_pair {ι : Type u_38} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (T : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hT : 0 < ‖T‖) :
    ∃ x y : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι, ‖x‖ = 1 ∧ ‖y‖ = 1 ∧
      T x = (‖T‖ : ℂ) • y ∧
      ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T y = (‖T‖ : ℂ) • x

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.hsVector_matrixify
statement:
@[simp] theorem hsVector_matrixify {n m : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n × Fin m)) :
    hsVector (matrixify x) = x

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.positive_compression_blocks
statement:
theorem positive_compression_blocks {n m : ℕ}
    (R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) (hR : (R + Rᴴ).PosSemidef) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks
      (Xᴴ * R * X + (Xᴴ * R * X)ᴴ)
      ((Yᴴ * R * X + (Xᴴ * R * Y)ᴴ)ᴴ)
      (Yᴴ * R * X + (Xᴴ * R * Y)ᴴ)
      (Yᴴ * R * Y + (Yᴴ * R * Y)ᴴ)).PosSemidef

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.tensor_entryPair
statement:
theorem tensor_entryPair {n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (C : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) :
    inner ℂ (hsVector Y)
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (A ⊗ₖ C) (hsVector X)) =
      entryPair (Yᴴ * A * X) C

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.weighted_coefficient_dual
statement:
theorem weighted_coefficient_dual {ρ : Type u_41} {ι : Type u_42} {κ : Type u_43}
    [Fintype ρ] [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (P : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ) (w : ρ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k)
    (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (h : ∀ C : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ,
      ‖∑ k, entryPair (P k) (C k)‖ ^ 2 ≤ b * ∑ k, w k * hsSq (C k)) :
    (∑ k, hsSq (P k) / w k) ≤ b

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.weighted_integral_norm_sq_le
statement:
theorem weighted_integral_norm_sq_le {α : Type u_44} {E : Type u_45} [MeasurableSpace α]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (μ : Measure α) (k : α → ℝ) (u : α → E)
    (hk : ∀ x, 0 ≤ k x) (hki : Integrable k μ)
    (hui : Integrable (fun x => k x • u x) μ)
    (hsqi : Integrable (fun x => k x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2) μ)
    (hmass : ∫ x, k x ∂μ = 1) :
    ‖∫ x, k x • u x ∂μ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x, k x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.norm_entry_le_l2_opNorm
statement:
theorem norm_entry_le_l2_opNorm {ι : Type u_46} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (i j : ι) : ‖A i j‖ ≤ ‖A‖

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.norm_le_one_of_mem_sharpnessRange
statement:
theorem norm_le_one_of_mem_sharpnessRange {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ numericalRange sharpnessMatrix) : ‖z‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.sharpness_polynomialValue
statement:
@[simp] theorem sharpness_polynomialValue (z : ℂ) :

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.sharpness_rangeMaximum_le_one
statement:
theorem sharpness_rangeMaximum_le_one :

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.sharpness_tensorEvaluation
statement:
@[simp] theorem sharpness_tensorEvaluation :

      sharpnessMatrix ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℂ)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.sharpness_tensor_norm_ge_two
statement:
theorem sharpness_tensor_norm_ge_two :
    2 ≤ ‖tensorEvaluation (d := 1) sharpnessMatrix sharpnessCoefficients‖

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.uniform_sharpness
statement: theorem uniform_sharpness (c : ℝ) (hc : UniversalBound c) : 2 ≤ c

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.compressionCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem compressionCLM_apply {n m : ℕ} (X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) : compressionCLM X Y R = Yᴴ * R * X

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.conjugateTransposeCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugateTransposeCLM_apply {ι : Type u_69} {κ : Type u_70} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : conjugateTransposeCLM A = Aᴴ

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.continuous_hsSq
statement:
theorem continuous_hsSq {ι : Type u_61} {κ : Type u_62} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] :
    Continuous (hsSq : Matrix ι κ ℂ → ℝ)

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.continuous_integrable_compact
statement:
theorem continuous_integrable_compact {α : Type u_47} {E : Type u_48} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [OpensMeasurableSpace α] [CompactSpace α]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {f : α → E} (hf : Continuous f) : Integrable f μ

name: OAI.DirectCrouzeix.continuous_integral_compact
statement:
theorem continuous_integral_compact {α : Type u_49} {β : Type u_50} {E : Type u_51}
    [TopologicalSpace α] [FirstCountableTopology α] [LocallyCompactSpace α]
    [TopologicalSpace β] [MeasurableSpace β] [OpensMeasurableSpace β]
