    (hp : 1 < p) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (f : GridIndex I → E → ℝ)
    (hf0 : f none = 0)
    (hf : ∀ i j, lpPower p (f i-f j) = lpPower p (gridVector i-gridVector j)) :
    (Fintype.card I)^2 ≤ Fintype.card E

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.row_col_not_disjoint
statement:
lemma row_col_not_disjoint (i j : I) :
    ¬ (∀ ab, rowVector i ab = 0 ∨ colVector j ab = 0)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.row_disjoint
statement:
lemma row_disjoint (i i' : I) (hne : i ≠ i') (ab : I × I) :
    rowVector i ab = 0 ∨ rowVector i' ab = 0

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.lpDifference_integrable
statement:
lemma lpDifference_integrable (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) {Ω : Type uΩ} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (f g : Lp ℝ (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ) :
    Integrable (fun t => |f t-g t|^p) μ

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.normalizedLabels_compact
statement:
lemma normalizedLabels_compact (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) {n : ℕ} (i₀ : Fin n) :
    IsCompact (normalizedLabels p i₀)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.normalizedPowers_compact
statement:
lemma normalizedPowers_compact (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) {n : ℕ} (i₀ : Fin n) :
    IsCompact (normalizedPowers p i₀)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.normalizedPowers_sum
statement:
lemma normalizedPowers_sum (p : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (i₀ : Fin n) {v : PairIndex n → ℝ}
    (hv : v ∈ normalizedPowers p i₀) : ∑ e, v e = 1

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pad_coordinates
statement:
lemma pad_coordinates {I : Type uI} (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) {k d : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ d)
    (y : I → Fin k → ℝ) : ∃ Y : I → Fin d → ℝ, ∀ i j,
      (∑ a, |Y i a-Y j a|^p) = ∑ a, |y i a-y j a|^p

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pairIndex_card
statement: lemma pairIndex_card (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (PairIndex n) = n.choose 2

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pairPower_continuous
statement: lemma pairPower_continuous (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (n : ℕ) : Continuous (pairPower (n := n) p)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pairPower_nonneg
statement:
lemma pairPower_nonneg (p : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (z : Fin n → ℝ) (e : PairIndex n) :
    0 ≤ pairPower p z e

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pairPower_normalize
statement:
lemma pairPower_normalize (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) {n : ℕ} (i₀ : Fin n) (z : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < ∑ e, pairPower p z e) :
    (∑ e, pairPower p z e)⁻¹ • pairPower p z ∈ normalizedPowers p i₀

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pairPower_pair_le_sum
statement:
lemma pairPower_pair_le_sum (p : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (z : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    |z i-z j|^p ≤ ∑ e, pairPower p z e

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pairPower_smul_sub
statement:
lemma pairPower_smul_sub (p : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (z : Fin n → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) :
    pairPower p (fun i => a * (z i-b)) = |a|^p • pairPower p z

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pairPower_sum_bound
statement:
lemma pairPower_sum_bound (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) {n : ℕ} (z : Fin n → ℝ)
    (i₀ : Fin n) (hz : z i₀ = 0) (hs : ∑ e, pairPower p z e = 1) :
    ∀ i, |z i| ≤ 1

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.GoodDimension.mono_distortion
statement:
lemma GoodDimension.mono_distortion {p D D' : ℝ} {n d : ℕ}
    (h : GoodDimension.{u} p n D d) (hDD : D ≤ D') : GoodDimension.{u} p n D' d

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.coordinateDistance_norm
statement:
lemma coordinateDistance_norm (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) {d : ℕ} (x y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    coordinateDistance p x y =
      ‖WithLp.toLp (ENNReal.ofReal p) x - WithLp.toLp (ENNReal.ofReal p) y‖

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.packing_card_bound
statement:
lemma packing_card_bound {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (s : Finset E) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hs : ∀ c ∈ s, ‖c‖ ≤ R) (h : ∀ c ∈ s, ∀ d ∈ s, c ≠ d → 1 ≤ ‖c-d‖) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (1+2*R)^finrank ℝ E

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.packing_family_bound
statement:
lemma packing_family_bound {E : Type uE} {I : Type uI} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [Fintype I] (f : I → E) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hf : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ R) (hsep : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 1 ≤ ‖f i-f j‖) :
    (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤ (1+2*R)^finrank ℝ E

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.quadratic_growth_log_limit
statement:
lemma quadratic_growth_log_limit (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hlo : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ((n-1)/4)^2 ≤ f n)
    (hhi : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, f n ≤ n^2) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (f n : ℝ) / Real.log (n:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 2)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.convex_cost_selection
statement:
lemma convex_cost_selection {X : Type uX} {E : Type uE} [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℝ X]
    [Fintype E] [Nonempty E] {A : Set X} (hA : Convex ℝ A)
    (c : E → X → ℝ) (hc : ∀ e, ConvexOn ℝ A (c e))
    (hcn : ∀ e x, x ∈ A → 0 ≤ c e x) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hw : ∀ w : E → ℝ, (∀ e, 0 < w e) → (∑ e, w e) = 1 →
      ∃ x ∈ A, (∑ e, w e*c e x) ≤ B) :
    ∃ x ∈ A, ∀ e, c e x < 2*B

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.hilbertMul_add
statement:
lemma hilbertMul_add (P Q : Matrix E E ℝ) (x : E → H) :
    hilbertMul (P+Q) x = hilbertMul P x+hilbertMul Q x

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.hilbertMul_contraction
statement:
lemma hilbertMul_contraction (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (hs : P.IsSymm) (hi : P*P=P)
    (x : E → H) : (∑ e, ‖hilbertMul P x e‖^2) ≤ ∑ e, ‖x e‖^2

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.hilbertMul_inner
statement:
lemma hilbertMul_inner (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (x y : E → H) :
    (∑ e, inner ℝ (hilbertMul P x e) (y e)) = ∑ e, inner ℝ (x e) (hilbertMul P.transpose y e)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.hilbertMul_mul
statement:
lemma hilbertMul_mul (P Q : Matrix E E ℝ) (x : E → H) :
    hilbertMul (P*Q) x = hilbertMul P (hilbertMul Q x)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.hilbertMul_smul
statement:
lemma hilbertMul_smul (a : ℝ) (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (x : E → H) :
    hilbertMul (a • P) x = a • hilbertMul P x

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.simultaneous_convex_cost_selection
statement:
lemma simultaneous_convex_cost_selection {X : Type uX} {E : Type uE} {J : Type uJ}
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℝ X] [Fintype E] [Nonempty E] [Fintype J]
    {A : Set X} (hA : Convex ℝ A) (r : E → X → ℝ) (q : J → X → ℝ)
    (hrc : ∀ e, ConvexOn ℝ A (r e)) (hqc : ∀ j, ConvexOn ℝ A (q j))
    (hrn : ∀ e x, x ∈ A → 0 ≤ r e x) (hqn : ∀ j x, x ∈ A → 0 ≤ q j x)
    (hw : ∀ w : E → ℝ, (∀ e, 0 < w e) → (∑ e, w e) = 1 →
      ∃ x ∈ A, (∑ e, w e*r e x) ≤ 2 ∧ ∀ j, q j x ≤ 2) :
    ∃ x ∈ A, (∀ e, r e x < 4) ∧ ∀ j, q j x < 4

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.weighted_error_to_uniform
statement:
lemma weighted_error_to_uniform {E : Type uE} [Fintype E] [Nonempty E]
    {C : Set (E → ℝ)} (hC : Convex ℝ C) (b ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hw : ∀ w : E → ℝ, (∀ e, 0 < w e) → (∑ e, w e) = 1 →
      ∃ m ∈ C, (∑ e, w e * |m e-b|) ≤ ε) :
    ∃ m ∈ C, ∀ e, |m e-b| < 2*ε

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.gramProjection_factor
statement:
lemma gramProjection_factor (A : Matrix E V ℝ) :
    ∃ B : Matrix V E ℝ, gramProjection A = A*B

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.hilbertMul_diagonal
statement:
lemma hilbertMul_diagonal {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (d : E → ℝ) (x : E → H) (e : E) : hilbertMul (diagonal d) x e = d e • x e

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.matrixRowNorm_convex
statement:
lemma matrixRowNorm_convex (A : Matrix E V ℝ) (e : E) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (retractions A) (fun P => matrixRowNorm P e)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.matrixRowNorm_nonneg
statement: lemma matrixRowNorm_nonneg (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (e : E) : 0 ≤ matrixRowNorm P e

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.projectionEnergy_convex
statement:
lemma projectionEnergy_convex {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (A : Matrix E V ℝ) (lam : E → ℝ) (hlam : ∀ e, 0 ≤ lam e) (x : E → H) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (retractions A) (fun P => ∑ e, lam e * ‖hilbertMul P x e‖^2)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.retractions_convex
statement: lemma retractions_convex (A : Matrix E V ℝ) : Convex ℝ (retractions A)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.scaled_normalizedGradient
statement:
lemma scaled_normalizedGradient (src dst : E → V) (δ σ : E → ℝ)
    (hδ : ∀ e, 0 < δ e) (hσ : ∀ e, 0 < σ e) :
    diagonal (fun e => Real.sqrt (σ e)) * normalizedGradient src dst δ =
      conductorMatrix src dst (fun e => σ e/(δ e)^2)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.sqrt_diagonal_inv
statement:
lemma sqrt_diagonal_inv (σ : E → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ e, 0 < σ e) :
    diagonal (fun e => (Real.sqrt (σ e))⁻¹) * diagonal (fun e => Real.sqrt (σ e)) = 1

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.weightedProjection_energy
statement:
lemma weightedProjection_energy {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (A : Matrix E V ℝ) (σ : E → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ e, 0 < σ e) (x : E → H) :
    (∑ e, σ e * ‖hilbertMul (weightedProjection A σ) x e‖^2) ≤
      ∑ e, σ e * ‖x e‖^2

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.weightedProjection_mem
statement:
lemma weightedProjection_mem (A : Matrix E V ℝ) (σ : E → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ e, 0 < σ e) :
    weightedProjection A σ ∈ retractions A

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.bounded_sample_exists
statement:
lemma bounded_sample_exists {E : Type uE} {Ω : Type uΩ} [Fintype E] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → E → ℝ)
    (hXm : ∀ e, Measurable (fun ω => X ω e)) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hX : ∀ ω e, X ω e ∈ Set.Icc 0 M)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hprob : (2*Fintype.card E:ℝ)*Real.exp (-((d:ℝ)*ε)^2/(2*d*(M/2)^2)) < 1) :
    ∃ ω : Fin d → Ω, ∀ e,
      |(∑ a, X (ω a) e)/(d:ℝ) - ∫ t, X t e ∂μ| < ε

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.sample_convexHull
statement:
lemma sample_convexHull {E : Type uE} [Fintype E] {S : Set (E → ℝ)}
    {v : E → ℝ} (hv : v ∈ convexHull ℝ S) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hS : ∀ z ∈ S, ∀ e, z e ∈ Set.Icc 0 M)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hprob : (2*Fintype.card E:ℝ)*Real.exp (-((d:ℝ)*ε)^2/(2*d*(M/2)^2)) < 1) :
    ∃ z : Fin d → E → ℝ, (∀ a, z a ∈ S) ∧
      ∀ e, |(∑ a, z a e)/(d:ℝ)-v e| < ε

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.weighted_moments_samples
statement:
lemma weighted_moments_samples {E : Type uE} [Fintype E] [Nonempty E]
    {S : Set (E → ℝ)} (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hS : ∀ z ∈ S, ∀ e, z e ∈ Set.Icc 0 M)
    (b ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hw : ∀ w : E → ℝ, (∀ e, 0 < w e) → (∑ e, w e) = 1 →
      ∃ m ∈ closedConvexHull ℝ S, (∑ e, w e * |m e-b|) ≤ ε)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hprob : (2*Fintype.card E:ℝ)*Real.exp (-((d:ℝ)*ε)^2/(2*d*(M/2)^2)) < 1) :
    ∃ z : Fin d → E → ℝ, (∀ a, z a ∈ S) ∧
      ∀ e, |(∑ a, z a e)/(d:ℝ)-b| < 3*ε

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.charFun_defect_le_capped
OAI.SubpolynomialLp.exists_small_power
statement:
lemma exists_small_power (r k : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hk : 0 < k) :
    ∃ d : ℝ, 0 < d ∧ d ≤ 1 ∧ d^r ≤ k

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.exp_defect_lower
statement:
lemma exp_defect_lower (c z : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hzc : z ≤ c) :
    Real.exp (-c)*z ≤ 1-Real.exp (-z)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.fourierCutoff_average
statement:
lemma fourierCutoff_average (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (b : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, fourierCutoff (b*x) ∂μ) =
      ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, 1-(charFun μ (t*b)).re

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.fourierCutoff_continuous
statement: @[fun_prop] lemma fourierCutoff_continuous : Continuous fourierCutoff

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.fourierCutoff_eq
statement:
lemma fourierCutoff_eq (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    fourierCutoff x = 1-Real.sin x/x

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.fourierCutoff_ge_half
statement: lemma fourierCutoff_ge_half (x : ℝ) (hx : 2 ≤ |x|) : 1/2 ≤ fourierCutoff x

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.fourierCutoff_le_two
statement: lemma fourierCutoff_le_two (x : ℝ) : fourierCutoff x ≤ 2

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.fourierCutoff_nonneg
statement: lemma fourierCutoff_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ fourierCutoff x

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.fourierCutoff_quadratic
statement: lemma fourierCutoff_quadratic (x : ℝ) : min (x^2) 1 ≤ 24*fourierCutoff x

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.one_sub_cos_quadratic_lower
statement:
lemma one_sub_cos_quadratic_lower (x : ℝ) (hx : |x| ≤ 2) :
    x^2/8 ≤ 1-Real.cos x

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.real_charFun
statement:
lemma real_charFun (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (t : ℝ) :
    (charFun μ t).re = ∫ x, Real.cos (t*x) ∂μ

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.stable_capped_second_upper
statement:
lemma stable_capped_second_upper (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (p c : ℝ)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hcf : ∀ t : ℝ, (charFun μ t).re = Real.exp (-c*|t|^p))
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∫ x, min (x^2) (a^2) ∂μ) ≤ 24*c*a^(2-p)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.stable_fourier_average_upper
statement:
lemma stable_fourier_average_upper (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (p c b : ℝ)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hcf : ∀ t : ℝ, (charFun μ t).re = Real.exp (-c*|t|^p)) :
    (∫ x, fourierCutoff (b*x) ∂μ) ≤ c*|b|^p

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.stable_tail_lower
statement:
lemma stable_tail_lower (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (p c : ℝ)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp2 : p < 2) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hcf : ∀ t : ℝ, (charFun μ t).re = Real.exp (-c*|t|^p)) :
    ∃ k : ℝ, 0 < k ∧ ∀ a : ℝ, 1 ≤ a → k*a^(-p) ≤ μ.real {x : ℝ | a < |x|}

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.stable_tail_upper
statement:
lemma stable_tail_upper (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (p c : ℝ)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hcf : ∀ t : ℝ, (charFun μ t).re = Real.exp (-c*|t|^p))
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    μ.real {x : ℝ | a < |x|} ≤ (2*c*2^p)*a^(-p)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.bounded_capped_integrable
statement:
lemma bounded_capped_integrable {Ω : Type uΩ} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : Ω → ℝ) (hm : Measurable f)
    (p a : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    Integrable (fun x => (min |f x| a)^p) μ

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.bounded_power_integrable
statement:
lemma bounded_power_integrable {Ω : Type uΩ} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : Ω → ℝ) (hm : Measurable f)
    (p K : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (_hK : 0 ≤ K) (hf : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ K) :
    Integrable (fun x => |f x|^p) μ

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.capped_moment_layercake
statement:
lemma capped_moment_layercake (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (q a : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∫ x, (min |x| a)^q ∂μ) =
      ∫ t in Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) a, (q*t^(q-1))*μ.real {x : ℝ | t < |x|}

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.capped_moment_lower_log
statement:
lemma capped_moment_lower_log (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (p k a : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) (_hk : 0 ≤ k) (ha : 1 ≤ a)
    (htail : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → k*t^(-p) ≤ μ.real {x : ℝ | t < |x|}) :
    k*p*Real.log a ≤ ∫ x, (min |x| a)^p ∂μ

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.capped_power_lipschitz
statement:
lemma capped_power_lipschitz (p a : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (x y : ℝ) :
    |(min |x| a)^p-(min |y| a)^p| ≤ p*a^(p-1)*|x-y|

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.capped_power_tail_bound
statement:
lemma capped_power_tail_bound (p a x : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hp2 : p < 2) (ha : 0 < a) :
    0 ≤ |x|^p-(min |x| a)^p ∧ |x|^p-(min |x| a)^p ≤ a^(p-2)*x^2

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.clip_abs
statement: lemma clip_abs (a x : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : |clip a x| = min |x| a

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.clip_error
statement: lemma clip_error (a x : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : |x-clip a x| = max (|x|-a) 0

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.clip_measurable
statement: lemma clip_measurable (a : ℝ) : Measurable (clip a)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.excess_first_moment
statement:
lemma excess_first_moment (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (p C a : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a)
    (htail : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → μ.real {x : ℝ | t < |x|} ≤ C*t^(-p)) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => max (|x|-a) 0) μ ∧
      (∫ x, max (|x|-a) 0 ∂μ) ≤ C*(1+1/(p-1))*a^(1-p)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.integral_power_derivative
statement:
lemma integral_power_derivative (q u : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (_hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..u, q*t^(q-1)) = u^q

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.matrix_clip_bounds
statement:
lemma matrix_clip_bounds {E : Type uE} [Fintype E] (P : Matrix E E ℝ)
    (Y : E → ℝ) (T H : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hrow : ∀ e, (∑ f, |P e f|) ≤ H) (hPY : P.mulVec Y = Y) :
    (∀ e, |P.mulVec (fun f => clip T (Y f)) e| ≤ H*T) ∧
    (∀ e, |Y e-P.mulVec (fun f => clip T (Y f)) e| ≤
      ∑ f, |P e f| *max (|Y f|-T) 0)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.tail_measurable
statement:
lemma tail_measurable (μ : Measure ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.tail_real_measurable
statement:
lemma tail_real_measurable (μ : Measure ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.L2_hilbertMul_energy
statement:
lemma L2_hilbertMul_energy {Ω : Type uΩ} {E : Type uE} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype E]
    (μ : Measure Ω) (f : E → Ω → ℝ) (hf : ∀ e, MemLp (f e) 2 μ)
    (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (e : E) :
    ‖hilbertMul P (fun e => (hf e).toLp (f e)) e‖^2 =
      ∫ x, (∑ a, P e a*f a x)^2 ∂μ

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.L2_norm_sq
statement:
lemma L2_norm_sq {Ω : Type uΩ} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : MemLp f 2 μ) : ‖hf.toLp f‖^2 = ∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂μ

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.Lp_coe_sum
statement:
lemma Lp_coe_sum {Ω : Type uΩ} {ι : Type uι} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Lp ℝ 2 μ) :
    (fun x => (∑ i ∈ s, f i) x) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, f i x)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.below_projection_moments
statement:
lemma below_projection_moments {Ω : Type uΩ} {E : Type uE} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype E]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Y : Ω → E → ℝ)
    (hm : ∀ e, Measurable (fun x => Y x e)) (P : Matrix E E ℝ)
    (lam : E → ℝ) (hlam : ∀ e, 0 ≤ lam e) (hls : ∑ e, lam e = 1)
    (p T a H b err B : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) (hp2 : p < 2) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (herr : 0 ≤ err)
    (hrow : ∀ e, (∑ f, |P e f|) ≤ H) (hPY : ∀ x, P.mulVec (Y x) = Y x)
    (hex : ∀ e, Integrable (fun x => max (|Y x e|-T) 0) μ)
    (hexm : ∀ e, (∫ x, max (|Y x e|-T) 0 ∂μ) ≤ err)
    (hb : ∀ e, (∫ x, (min |Y x e| a)^p ∂μ) = b)
    (henergy : (∑ e, lam e*(∫ x, (P.mulVec (fun f => clip T (Y x f)) e)^2 ∂μ)) ≤ B) :
    (∑ e, lam e*|(∫ x, |P.mulVec (fun f => clip T (Y x f)) e|^p ∂μ)-b|) ≤
      (p*a^(p-1))*H*err+a^(p-2)*B

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.charFun_linear_sum
statement:
lemma charFun_linear_sum {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] (μ : ι → Measure ℝ)
    [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] (g : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    charFun ((Measure.pi μ).map (fun x : ι → ℝ => ∑ i, g i*x i)) t =
      ∏ i, charFun (μ i) (t*g i)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.clip_sq
statement: lemma clip_sq (T x : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) : (clip T x)^2 = min (x^2) (T^2)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.powerIntensity_critical_moment

lemma powerIntensity_critical_moment (p a b : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.powerIntensity_integral
OAI.SubpolynomialLp.powerIntensity_large_moment
statement:
lemma powerIntensity_large_moment (p q a : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hqp : q < p)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.powerIntensity_restrict_integral
OAI.SubpolynomialLp.powerIntensity_tail
statement:
lemma powerIntensity_tail (p a : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (ha : 0 < a) :

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.stableKernel_abs_le_large
statement:
lemma stableKernel_abs_le_large (p t r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    |stableKernel p t r| ≤ 2*r^(-p-1)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.stableKernel_abs_le_quadratic
statement:
lemma stableKernel_abs_le_quadratic (p t r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    |stableKernel p t r| ≤ (t^2/2)*r^(1-p)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.stableKernel_integrable
statement:
lemma stableKernel_integrable (p t : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hp2 : p < 2) :
    IntegrableOn (stableKernel p t) (Set.Ioi 0)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.stableKernel_scaling
statement:
lemma stableKernel_scaling (p t : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∫ r in Set.Ioi 0, stableKernel p t r) =
      |t|^p * ∫ r in Set.Ioi 0, stableKernel p 1 r

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.stableKernel_scaling_pos
statement:
lemma stableKernel_scaling_pos (p t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (∫ r in Set.Ioi 0, stableKernel p t r) =
      t^p * ∫ r in Set.Ioi 0, stableKernel p 1 r

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.bounded_exp_integrable
statement:
lemma bounded_exp_integrable (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (B : ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |x| ≤ B) (t : ℝ) : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (t*x)) μ

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.charFun_compoundPoisson
statement:
lemma charFun_compoundPoisson (r : ℝ≥0) (μ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (t : E) :
    charFun (compoundPoisson r μ) t = Complex.exp (r * (charFun μ t-1))

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.charFun_convolutionPower
statement:
lemma charFun_convolutionPower (μ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (n : ℕ) (t : E) :
    charFun (convolutionPower μ n) t = (charFun μ t)^n

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.charFun_symmetrize
statement:
lemma charFun_symmetrize (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (t : ℝ) :
    charFun (symmetrize μ) t = (∫ x, Real.cos (t*x) ∂μ : ℝ)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.exp_convolutionPower
statement:
lemma exp_convolutionPower (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (t : ℝ)
    (hμ : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (t*x)) μ) (n : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (t*x)) (convolutionPower μ n) ∧
    (∫ x, Real.exp (t*x) ∂convolutionPower μ n) = (∫ x, Real.exp (t*x) ∂μ)^n

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.exp_integrable_conv
statement:
lemma exp_integrable_conv (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (t : ℝ) (hμ : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (t*x)) μ)
    (hν : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (t*x)) ν) :
    Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (t*x)) (μ ∗ ν)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.exp_integral_conv
statement:
lemma exp_integral_conv (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (t : ℝ) (hμ : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (t*x)) μ)
    (hν : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (t*x)) ν) :
    (∫ x, Real.exp (t*x) ∂(μ ∗ ν)) =
      (∫ x, Real.exp (t*x) ∂μ) * ∫ x, Real.exp (t*x) ∂ν

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.integral_compoundPoisson
statement:
lemma integral_compoundPoisson {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (r : ℝ≥0) (μ : Measure E) (f : E → F) (hf : Integrable f (compoundPoisson r μ)) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂compoundPoisson r μ) =
      ∑' n, (Real.exp (-r)*r^n/(n.factorial):ℝ) • ∫ x, f x ∂convolutionPower μ n

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.integral_symmetrize
statement:
lemma integral_symmetrize {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (f : ℝ → F) (hf : Integrable f μ)
    (hn : Integrable (fun x => f (-x)) μ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂symmetrize μ) = (1/2:ℝ) • ((∫ x, f x ∂μ)+(∫ x, f (-x) ∂μ))

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.exists_probability_charFun_limit
statement:
lemma exists_probability_charFun_limit
    {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure E) (f : E → ℂ) (hf : ContinuousAt f 0)
    (h : ∀ t, Tendsto (fun n => charFun (μ n) t) atTop (𝓝 (f t))) :
    ∃ ν : ProbabilityMeasure E, (∀ t, charFun ν t = f t) ∧ Tendsto μ atTop (𝓝 ν)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.paretoJump_cos_exponent
statement:
lemma paretoJump_cos_exponent (p a t : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (ha : 0 < a) :
    a^(-p) * ((∫ r, Real.cos (t*r) ∂paretoJump p a)-1) =
      p * ∫ r in Set.Ioi a, stableKernel p t r

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.paretoJump_probability

lemma paretoJump_probability (p a : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (ha : 0 < a) :

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.positive_cutoff_union
statement:
lemma positive_cutoff_union :
    (⋃ n : ℕ, Set.Ioi ((n+1:ℝ)⁻¹)) = Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.stableConstant_pos
statement: lemma stableConstant_pos (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hp2 : p < 2) : 0 < stableConstant p

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.stableKernel_cutoff_limit
statement:
lemma stableKernel_cutoff_limit (p t : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hp2 : p < 2) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ r in Set.Ioi ((n+1:ℝ)⁻¹), stableKernel p t r)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.distortion_ratio
statement:
lemma distortion_ratio (p D : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hD : 1 < D) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 3 < R ∧ ∀ b ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → R*ε ≤ b →
      0 < b-3*ε ∧ b+3*ε ≤ D^p*(b-3*ε)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.moment_integral_mem
statement:
lemma moment_integral_mem {Ω : Type uΩ} {E : Type uE} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype E]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (S : Set (E → ℝ)) (F : Ω → E → ℝ)
    (hF : Measurable F) (hFS : ∀ x, F x ∈ S) (M : ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ x e, ‖F x e‖ ≤ M) :
    (fun e => ∫ x, F x e ∂μ) ∈ closedConvexHull ℝ S

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.normalizedGradient_apply
statement:
lemma normalizedGradient_apply {E : Type uE} {V : Type uV} [Fintype E] [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq E] [DecidableEq V] (src dst : E → V) (δ : E → ℝ)
    (z : V → ℝ) (e : E) :
    (normalizedGradient src dst δ).mulVec z e = (z (src e)-z (dst e))/δ e

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.normalized_coordinate_gradient
statement:
lemma normalized_coordinate_gradient (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) {n k : ℕ}
    (y : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ) (δ : PairIndex n → ℝ) (hδ : ∀ e, 0 < δ e)
    (hy : ∀ e : PairIndex n, coordinateDistance p (y e.val.1) (y e.val.2) = δ e) :
    ∀ e : PairIndex n, ∑ a : Fin k,
      |(normalizedGradient (fun e : PairIndex n => e.val.1) (fun e => e.val.2) δ).mulVec
        (fun i => y i a) e|^p = 1

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pairIndex_connected
statement:
lemma pairIndex_connected (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ∃ e : PairIndex n, (e.val.1 = i ∧ e.val.2 = j) ∨ (e.val.1 = j ∧ e.val.2 = i)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pairIndex_incident
statement:
lemma pairIndex_incident (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) :
    ∃ e : PairIndex n, e.val.1 = i ∨ e.val.2 = i

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pairIndex_nonempty
statement: lemma pairIndex_nonempty (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : Nonempty (PairIndex n)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.sampled_labels_embedding
statement:
lemma sampled_labels_embedding (p D b ε : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hb : 0 < b-3*ε) (hDb : b+3*ε ≤ D^p*(b-3*ε))
    {n d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (δ : PairIndex n → ℝ) (hδ : ∀ e, 0 < δ e)
    (z : Fin d → Fin n → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ e : PairIndex n,
      |(∑ a, |(normalizedGradient (fun e : PairIndex n => e.val.1) (fun e => e.val.2) δ).mulVec
        (z a) e|^p)/(d:ℝ)-b| < 3*ε) :
    ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ ∀ e : PairIndex n,
      s*δ e ≤ coordinateDistance p (fun a => z a e.val.1) (fun a => z a e.val.2) ∧
      coordinateDistance p (fun a => z a e.val.1) (fun a => z a e.val.2) ≤ D*s*δ e

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.weighted_gradient_samples
statement:
lemma weighted_gradient_samples {Ω : Type uΩ} {E : Type uE} {V : Type uV} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [Fintype E] [Fintype V] [Nonempty E] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (A : Matrix E V ℝ) (p K b ε : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hw : ∀ w : E → ℝ, (∀ e, 0 < w e) → (∑ e, w e)=1 →
      ∃ F : Ω → E → ℝ, Measurable F ∧
        (∀ x, ∃ z, A.mulVec z = F x) ∧ (∀ x e, |F x e| ≤ K) ∧
        (∑ e, w e*|(∫ x, |F x e|^p ∂μ)-b|) ≤ ε)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hprob : (2*Fintype.card E:ℝ)*Real.exp (-((d:ℝ)*ε)^2/(2*d*(K^p/2)^2)) < 1) :
    ∃ z : Fin d → V → ℝ, ∀ e,
      |(∑ a, |A.mulVec (z a) e|^p)/(d:ℝ)-b| < 3*ε

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.all_pairs_of_edge_bounds
statement:
lemma all_pairs_of_edge_bounds {X : Type uX} [SeminormedAddCommGroup X] (p D s : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p)
    {n d : ℕ} (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ e : PairIndex n,
      s*‖x e.val.1-x e.val.2‖ ≤ coordinateDistance p (y e.val.1) (y e.val.2) ∧
      coordinateDistance p (y e.val.1) (y e.val.2) ≤ D*s*‖x e.val.1-x e.val.2‖) :
    ∀ i j, s*‖x i-x j‖ ≤ coordinateDistance p (y i) (y j) ∧
      coordinateDistance p (y i) (y j) ≤ D*s*‖x i-x j‖

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.coordinateDistance_comm
statement:
lemma coordinateDistance_comm (p : ℝ) {d : ℕ} (x y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    coordinateDistance p x y = coordinateDistance p y x

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.coordinateDistance_self
statement:
lemma coordinateDistance_self (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    coordinateDistance p x x = 0

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.log_nat_lower
statement: lemma log_nat_lower (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : (1/2:ℝ) ≤ Real.log n

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pairIndex_card_le_square
statement: lemma pairIndex_card_le_square (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (PairIndex n) ≤ n^2

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.sampling_dimension_estimate
OAI.SubpolynomialLp.sampling_probability_estimate
statement:
lemma sampling_probability_estimate (M ε : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hε : 1 ≤ ε)
    (n N : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hN : 0 < N) (hNn : N ≤ n^2) :
    let H := 4*Real.log (n:ℝ)
    let d := ⌈M^2*(H+1)⌉₊+1
    (2*N:ℝ)*Real.exp (-((d:ℝ)*ε)^2/(2*d*(M/2)^2)) < 1

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.bounded_abs_moment_integrable
statement:
lemma bounded_abs_moment_integrable (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (B q : ℝ) (hB : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |x| ≤ B) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    Integrable (fun x => |x|^q) μ

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.bounded_abs_shift_integrable
statement:
lemma bounded_abs_shift_integrable (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (B q a : ℝ) (hB : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |x| ≤ B) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    Integrable (fun x => |a+x|^q) μ

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.bounded_conv
statement:
lemma bounded_conv (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (A B : ℝ) (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |x| ≤ A) (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, |x| ≤ B) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ ∗ ν), |x| ≤ A+B

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.bounded_moment_interpolation
statement:
lemma bounded_moment_interpolation (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (B q : ℝ) (hq : 2 < q) (hB : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |x| ≤ B) :
    (∫ x, |x|^(q-2) ∂μ) ≤ (∫ x, |x|^q ∂μ)^((q-2)/q)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.convolutionPower_bounded
statement:
lemma convolutionPower_bounded (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |x| ≤ B) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂convolutionPower μ n, |x| ≤ (n:ℝ)*B

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.convolutionPower_near_moment
statement:
lemma convolutionPower_near_moment (q ε : ℝ) (hq : 2 < q) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
      (B : ℝ), (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |x| ≤ B) → μ.map (fun x => -x) = μ → ∀ n : ℕ,
      (n:ℝ)*(∫ x, |x|^q ∂μ) ≤ ∫ x, |x|^q ∂convolutionPower μ n ∧
      (∫ x, |x|^q ∂convolutionPower μ n) ≤
        (1+ε)^2*(n:ℝ)*(∫ x, |x|^q ∂μ)+C*((n:ℝ)*(∫ x, x^2 ∂μ))^(q/2)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.near_additive_recurrence
statement:
lemma near_additive_recurrence (r δ C m a : ℝ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hm : 0 ≤ m) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (M : ℕ → ℝ) (hzero : M 0 = 0) (hstep : ∀ k,
      M k+m ≤ M (k+1) ∧ M (k+1) ≤ M k+(1+δ)*m+C*a*(M k)^r) (N : ℕ) :
    (N:ℝ)*m ≤ M N ∧ M N ≤ (1+δ)^2*(N:ℝ)*m+
      (C*(1+δ)/δ)^(1/(1-r))*((N:ℝ)*a)^(1/(1-r))

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.sq_rpow_half_abs
statement: lemma sq_rpow_half_abs (x q : ℝ) : (x^2)^(q/2) = |x|^q

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.sublinear_absorption
statement:
lemma sublinear_absorption (r δ a b x : ℝ) (_hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (h : x ≤ a+b*x^r) :
    x ≤ (1+δ)*a+(b*(1+δ)/δ)^(1/(1-r))

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.symmetric_conv_moment
statement:
lemma symmetric_conv_moment (q ε C : ℝ) (hq : 2 < q) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hscalar : ∀ a b : ℝ,
      (|a+b|^q+|a-b|^q)/2 ≤ |a|^q+(1+ε)* |b|^q+C* |a|^(q-2)*b^2)
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (A B : ℝ) (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |x| ≤ A) (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, |x| ≤ B)
    (hs : ν.map (fun x => -x) = ν) :
    (∫ x, |x|^q ∂μ)+(∫ x, |x|^q ∂ν) ≤ ∫ x, |x|^q ∂(μ ∗ ν) ∧
    (∫ x, |x|^q ∂(μ ∗ ν)) ≤ (∫ x, |x|^q ∂μ)+(1+ε)*(∫ x, |x|^q ∂ν)+
      C*(∫ x, |x|^q ∂μ)^((q-2)/q)*(∫ x, x^2 ∂ν)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.symmetric_integral
statement:
lemma symmetric_integral (μ : Measure ℝ) (hs : μ.map (fun x => -x) = μ)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) :
    (∫ x, f (-x) ∂μ) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.symmetric_power_abs
statement:
lemma symmetric_power_abs (q a b : ℝ) :
    |a+b|^q+|a-b|^q = (|a|+|b|)^q+|(|a|-|b|)|^q

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.symmetric_power_lower
statement:
lemma symmetric_power_lower (q : ℝ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (a b : ℝ) :
    |a|^q+|b|^q ≤ (|a+b|^q+|a-b|^q)/2

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.symmetric_power_near
statement:
lemma symmetric_power_near (q : ℝ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → u ≤ 1/2 →
      ((1+u)^q+(1-u)^q)/2 ≤ 1+C*u^2

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.symmetric_power_unit_upper
statement:
lemma symmetric_power_unit_upper (q ε : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u →
      (|1+u|^q+|1-u|^q)/2 ≤ 1+(1+ε)*u^q+C*u^2

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.symmetric_power_upper
statement:
lemma symmetric_power_upper (q ε : ℝ) (hq : 2 < q) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ a b : ℝ,
      (|a+b|^q+|a-b|^q)/2 ≤ |a|^q+(1+ε)* |b|^q+C* |a|^(q-2)*b^2

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.power_difference_epsilon
statement:
lemma power_difference_epsilon (p ε : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ a b : ℝ,
      abs (|a+b|^p-|a|^p) ≤ ε*|a|^p+C*|b|^p

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.rpow_le_constant_exp
statement:
lemma rpow_le_constant_exp (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x^p ≤ C*Real.exp x

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.symmetric_exp_quadratic
statement:
lemma symmetric_exp_quadratic (x : ℝ) (hx : |x| ≤ 1) :
    (Real.exp x+Real.exp (-x))/2 ≤ 1+x^2

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pareto_even_scaling
statement:
lemma pareto_even_scaling (p c : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f (-x) = f x) (hzero : ∀ x, |x| ≤ 1 → f x = 0) :
    (∫ r, f (c*r) ∂pareto p) = |c|^p * ∫ r, f r ∂pareto p

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pareto_integral_eq_full
statement:
lemma pareto_integral_eq_full (p c : ℝ) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, |x| ≤ 1 → f x = 0) :
    (∫ r, f (c*r) ∂pareto p) = ∫ r, f (c*r) ∂powerIntensity p

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pareto_probability
statement: lemma pareto_probability (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) : IsProbabilityMeasure (pareto p)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.powerIntensity_even_scaling
statement:
lemma powerIntensity_even_scaling (p c : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, f (-x) = f x) (hf0 : f 0 = 0) :
    (∫ r, f (c*r) ∂powerIntensity p) = |c|^p * ∫ r, f r ∂powerIntensity p

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.powerIntensity_scaling
statement:
lemma powerIntensity_scaling (p c : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hc : 0 < c) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.powerIntensity_supported_positive
statement: lemma powerIntensity_supported_positive (p : ℝ) : ∀ᵐ r ∂powerIntensity p, 0 < r

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.dyadic_cauchy
statement:
lemma dyadic_cauchy (q : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (N m : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Ico m N, a k)^2 ≤
      (∑ k ∈ range N, (q^k)⁻¹*(a k)^2) * (q^m/(1-q))

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.dyadic_interpolation
statement:
lemma dyadic_interpolation (p : ℝ) (hp : 2 < p) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ) (A : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < A →
      (∀ k, 0 ≤ a k) → (∀ k < N, a k ≤ A*2^k) →
      (∑ k ∈ range N, a k)^p ≤ C*A^(p-2)*
        ∑ k ∈ range N, (((2:ℝ)^(2-p))^k)⁻¹ * (a k)^2

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.geometric_tail_bound
statement:
lemma geometric_tail_bound (q : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (m N : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Ico m N, q^k) ≤ q^m/(1-q)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.two_sum_bound
statement: lemma two_sum_bound (N : ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range N, (2:ℝ)^k) ≤ 2^N

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.dyadicRamp_plateau

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.dyadic_variance_weight

lemma dyadic_variance_weight (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (((2:ℝ)^((2-p)/2))^k)⁻¹*((2:ℝ)^k)^(2-p) = ((2:ℝ)^((2-p)/2))^k

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pareto_dyadicRamp_energy_lower
statement:
lemma pareto_dyadicRamp_energy_lower (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    p*Real.log 2*(m:ℝ)^(p+1) ≤ ∫ r, |dyadicRamp (2*m) r|^p ∂pareto p

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pareto_dyadicRamp_variance

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.pareto_tail_sq_moment

lemma pareto_tail_sq_moment (p a c : ℝ) (hp : 2 < p) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) :

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.tailPart_abs_le

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.normalized_coefficients_bounded

lemma normalized_coefficients_bounded (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (g : I → E → ℝ)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.paretoVectorLaw_integrable
statement:
lemma paretoVectorLaw_integrable (p : ℝ) (g : I → E → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : Measurable f) (e : E)
    (hi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun r => f (g i e*r)) (pareto p)) :
    Integrable (fun z => f (z e)) (paretoVectorLaw p g)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.paretoVectorLaw_moment
statement:
lemma paretoVectorLaw_moment (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (g : I → E → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ e, ∑ i, |g i e|^p = 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hn : ∀ x, f (-x)=f x) (hz : ∀ x, |x| ≤ 1 → f x=0) (e : E)
    (hi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun r => f (g i e*r)) (pareto p)) :
    (∫ z, f (z e) ∂paretoVectorLaw p g) = (∫ r, f r ∂pareto p)/(Fintype.card I : ℝ)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.paretoVectorLaw_probability
statement:
lemma paretoVectorLaw_probability (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (g : I → E → ℝ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (paretoVectorLaw p g)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.paretoVectorLaw_ramp_integrable
statement:
lemma paretoVectorLaw_ramp_integrable (p q : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (g : I → E → ℝ) (ℓ : ℕ) (e : E) :
    Integrable (fun z => |dyadicRamp ℓ (z e)|^q) (paretoVectorLaw p g)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.paretoVectorLaw_ramp_moment
statement:
lemma paretoVectorLaw_ramp_moment (p q : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (g : I → E → ℝ) (hg : ∀ e, ∑ i, |g i e|^p=1) (ℓ : ℕ) (e : E) :
    (∫ z, |dyadicRamp ℓ (z e)|^q ∂paretoVectorLaw p g) =
      (∫ r, |dyadicRamp ℓ r|^q ∂pareto p)/(Fintype.card I : ℝ)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.paretoVectorLaw_range
statement:
lemma paretoVectorLaw_range {V : Type uV} [Fintype V]
    (p : ℝ) (g : I → E → ℝ) (A : Matrix E V ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ i, ∃ x, A.mulVec x=g i) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂paretoVectorLaw p g, ∃ x, A.mulVec x=z

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.paretoVectorLaw_tail_integrable
statement:
lemma paretoVectorLaw_tail_integrable (p a : ℝ) (hp : 2 < p) (g : I → E → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ e, ∑ i, |g i e|^p = 1) (e : E) :
    Integrable (fun z => (tailPart a (z e))^2) (paretoVectorLaw p g)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.paretoVectorLaw_tail_moment
statement:
lemma paretoVectorLaw_tail_moment (p a : ℝ) (hp : 2 < p) (ha : 1 ≤ a)
    (g : I → E → ℝ) (hg : ∀ e, ∑ i, |g i e|^p=1) (e : E) :
    (∫ z, (tailPart a (z e))^2 ∂paretoVectorLaw p g) =
      (p/(p-2)*a^(2-p))/(Fintype.card I : ℝ)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.cut_error_eq_neg_tail_error
statement:
lemma cut_error_eq_neg_tail_error {E : Type uE} [Fintype E]
    (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (v : E → ℝ) (hv : P.mulVec v=v) (a : ℝ) (e : E) :
    P.mulVec (fun f => cutPart a (v f)) e-cutPart a (v e) =
      -(P.mulVec (fun f => tailPart a (v f)) e-tailPart a (v e))

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.matrix_integral_sq_bound
statement:
lemma matrix_integral_sq_bound {Ω : Type uΩ} {E : Type uE} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype E]
    (μ : Measure Ω) (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (f : E → Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ e, MemLp (f e) 2 μ) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hbound : ∀ e, (∫ x, (f e x)^2 ∂μ) ≤ B) (e : E) :
    (∫ x, (P.mulVec (fun a => f a x) e)^2 ∂μ) ≤ (matrixRowNorm P e)^2*B

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.matrix_memLp
statement:
lemma matrix_memLp {Ω : Type uΩ} {E : Type uE} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype E]
    (μ : Measure Ω) (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (f : E → Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ e, MemLp (f e) 2 μ) (e : E) : MemLp (fun x => P.mulVec (fun a => f a x) e) 2 μ

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.matrix_mulVec_bound
statement:
lemma matrix_mulVec_bound {E : Type uE} [Fintype E]
    (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (v : E → ℝ) (K : ℝ) (hK : ∀ e, |v e| ≤ K) (e : E) :
    |P.mulVec v e| ≤ matrixRowNorm P e * K

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.ramp_error_le_cut_errors
statement:
lemma ramp_error_le_cut_errors {E : Type uE} [Fintype E]
    (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (v : E → ℝ) (ℓ : ℕ) (e : E) :
    |P.mulVec (fun a => dyadicRamp ℓ (v a)) e - dyadicRamp ℓ (v e)| ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2*ℓ),
        |P.mulVec (fun a => cutPart ((2:ℝ)^k) (v a)) e-cutPart ((2:ℝ)^k) (v e)|

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.retraction_fixes
statement:
lemma retraction_fixes {E : Type uE} {V : Type uV} [Fintype E] [Fintype V]
    (A : Matrix E V ℝ) (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (hP : P ∈ retractions A)
    (v : E → ℝ) (hv : ∃ x, A.mulVec x = v) : P.mulVec v = v

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.retraction_range
statement:
lemma retraction_range {E : Type uE} {V : Type uV} [Fintype E] [Fintype V]
    (A : Matrix E V ℝ) (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (hP : P ∈ retractions A)
    (v : E → ℝ) : ∃ x, A.mulVec x = P.mulVec v

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.cut_error_bound
statement:
lemma cut_error_bound {E : Type uE} [Fintype E] (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (H a : ℝ)
    (hH : 1 ≤ H) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hr : ∀ e, matrixRowNorm P e ≤ H)
    (v : E → ℝ) (e : E) :
    |P.mulVec (fun f => cutPart a (v f)) e-cutPart a (v e)| ≤ 2*H*a

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.ramp_error_bound
statement:
lemma ramp_error_bound {E : Type uE} [Fintype E] (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (H : ℝ)
    (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hr : ∀ e, matrixRowNorm P e ≤ H)
    (ℓ : ℕ) (v : E → ℝ) (e : E) :
    |P.mulVec (fun f => dyadicRamp ℓ (v f)) e-dyadicRamp ℓ (v e)| ≤ 2*H*2^(2*ℓ)

name: OAI.SubpolynomialLp.ramp_projection_error
statement:
lemma ramp_projection_error (p : ℝ) (hp : 2 < p) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (E : Type uE) [Fintype E]
      (μ : Measure (E → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
      (P : Matrix E E ℝ) (w : E → ℝ) (_hw : ∀ e, 0 ≤ w e) (_hws : ∑ e, w e=1)
      (H B : ℝ) (_hH : 1 ≤ H) (_hB : 0 ≤ B) (ℓ : ℕ),
      (∀ e, matrixRowNorm P e ≤ H) →
      (∀ᵐ v ∂μ, P.mulVec v=v) →
      (∀ k < 2*ℓ, ∀ e, Integrable (fun v => (tailPart ((2:ℝ)^k) (v e))^2) μ) →
      (∀ k < 2*ℓ, ∀ e, (∫ v, (tailPart ((2:ℝ)^k) (v e))^2 ∂μ) ≤ B*((2:ℝ)^(2-p))^k) →
      (∀ k < 2*ℓ, (∑ e, w e*(∫ v, (P.mulVec (fun a => tailPart ((2:ℝ)^k) (v a)) e)^2 ∂μ)) ≤
        4*B*((2:ℝ)^(2-p))^k) →
      (∑ e, w e*(∫ v, |P.mulVec (fun a => dyadicRamp ℓ (v a)) e-dyadicRamp ℓ (v e)|^p ∂μ)) ≤
        C*H^(p-2)*(ℓ:ℝ)*B

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.DependentTensor.tensor_mixture
statement:
lemma tensor_mixture {K : I → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (K i)]
    (w : ∀ i, K i → ℂ) (A : ∀ i, K i → Matrix (J i) (J i) ℂ) :
    tensor (fun i => ∑ k, w i k • A i k)=
      ∑ x : ∀ i, K i, (∏ i, w i (x i)) • tensor (fun i => A i (x i))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.DependentTensor.tensor_moment
statement:
lemma tensor_moment (A : ∀ i, Matrix (J i) (J i) ℂ) (q : ℕ) :

      ∏ i, Matrix.trace (((A i).conjTranspose*A i)^q)

statement:
lemma tensor_mul (A B : ∀ i, Matrix (J i) (J i) ℂ) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.DependentTensor.tensor_one

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.DependentTensor.tensor_posSemidef
statement:
lemma tensor_posSemidef (A : ∀ i, Matrix (J i) (J i) ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).PosSemidef) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.DependentTensor.tensor_pow

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.DependentTensor.tensor_smul
statement:
lemma tensor_smul (c : I → ℂ) (A : ∀ i, Matrix (J i) (J i) ℂ) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.DependentTensor.tensor_star
statement:
lemma tensor_star (A : ∀ i, Matrix (J i) (J i) ℂ) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.DependentTensor.tensor_sum
statement:
lemma tensor_sum {K : I → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (K i)]
    (A : ∀ i, K i → Matrix (J i) (J i) ℂ) :
    tensor (fun i => ∑ k, A i k)=∑ x : ∀ i, K i, tensor (fun i => A i (x i))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.DependentTensor.tensor_trace

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.domination_pad
statement:
lemma domination_pad (A B : Matrix J J ℂ) (a b : ℂ) (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (h : (a • B-A).PosSemidef) : (b • B-A).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.domination_trans
statement:
lemma domination_trans (A B C : Matrix J J ℂ) (a b : ℂ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)

    ((a*b) • C-A).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.inclusion_isometry
statement: lemma inclusion_isometry (e : K ↪ J) : (inclusion e).conjTranspose * inclusion e = 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.inclusion_mulVec_image
statement:
lemma inclusion_mulVec_image (e : K ↪ J) (v : K → ℂ) (k : K) :
    (inclusion e).mulVec v (e k) = v k

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.inclusion_mulVec_notin
statement:
lemma inclusion_mulVec_notin (e : K ↪ J) (v : K → ℂ) (j : J)
    (hj : j ∉ Set.range e) : (inclusion e).mulVec v j = 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.inclusion_trace_outer
statement:
lemma inclusion_trace_outer (e : K ↪ J) (v : K → ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace (Matrix.vecMulVec ((inclusion e).mulVec v) (star ((inclusion e).mulVec v))) =
      Matrix.trace (Matrix.vecMulVec v (star v))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.mul_outer_mul_star
statement:
lemma mul_outer_mul_star (B : Matrix J K ℂ) (v : K → ℂ) :
    B * Matrix.vecMulVec v (star v) * B.conjTranspose =
      Matrix.vecMulVec (B.mulVec v) (star (B.mulVec v))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.outer_sum_domination
statement:
theorem outer_sum_domination (v : K → J → ℂ) :
    ((Fintype.card K : ℂ) • (∑ k, outer (v k)) - outer (∑ k, v k)).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.pair_product_partialTrace
statement:
lemma pair_product_partialTrace (z : I → Matrix A A ℂ) (u v : I → A) :
    (∑ w : I → A, (∏ i, z i (u i) (w i)) * star (∏ i, z i (v i) (w i))) =
      productMatrix (fun i => z i*(z i).conjTranspose) u v

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.partialTrace_outer_matrix
statement:
lemma partialTrace_outer_matrix (A : Matrix J K ℂ) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.partialTrace_posSemidef
statement:
lemma partialTrace_posSemidef (A : Matrix (J × K) (J × K) ℂ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.partialTrace_sum
statement:
lemma partialTrace_sum (A : L → Matrix (J × K) (J × K) ℂ) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.productMatrix_mono
statement:
lemma productMatrix_mono (r t : I → Matrix A A ℂ) (hr : ∀ i, (r i).PosSemidef)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.productMatrix_mul
statement:
lemma productMatrix_mul (r t : I → Matrix A A ℂ) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.productMatrix_posSemidef
statement:
lemma productMatrix_posSemidef (r : I → Matrix A A ℂ) (hr : ∀ i, (r i).PosSemidef) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.productMatrix_smul
statement:
lemma productMatrix_smul (c : I → ℂ) (r : I → Matrix A A ℂ) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.productMatrix_star
statement:
lemma productMatrix_star (r : I → Matrix A A ℂ) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.productMatrix_sum
statement:
lemma productMatrix_sum {K : Type*} [Fintype K] (r : I → K → Matrix A A ℂ) :
    productMatrix (fun i => ∑ k, r i k) = ∑ w : I → K, productMatrix (fun i => r i (w i))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.productMatrix_trace
statement:
lemma productMatrix_trace (r : I → Matrix A A ℂ) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.projection_trace_domination
statement:
theorem projection_trace_domination (A P : Matrix J J ℂ) (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (hP : P.IsHermitian) (hP2 : P*P=P) (hPA : P*A=A) :
    (Matrix.trace A • P - A).PosSemidef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.PositiveTensor.trace_domination
statement:
theorem trace_domination (A : Matrix J J ℂ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TensorBoard.average_regularization_posDef
statement:
lemma average_regularization_posDef (r : R → Matrix J J ℂ)
    (hr : ∀ i, (r i).PosSemidef) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (((Fintype.card R : ℂ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, r i) + (ε : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix J J ℂ) |>.PosDef

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TensorBoard.exists_whitening
statement:
lemma exists_whitening (B : Matrix J J ℂ) (hB : B.PosDef) :

      ∀ D : Matrix J J ℂ, Commute B D → Commute A D

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TensorBoard.free_tensor_trace

lemma free_tensor_trace (F : Finset I) (A B C : I → Matrix J J ℂ) :
    Matrix.trace (tensor (fun i : F => A i.val) * tensor (fun i : F => B i.val) *
      tensor (fun i : F => C i.val)) = ∏ i : F, Matrix.trace (A i.val*B i.val*C i.val)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TensorBoard.tensor_posSemidef
statement:
lemma tensor_posSemidef (A : I → Matrix J J ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).PosSemidef) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TensorBoard.tensor_star
statement:
lemma tensor_star (A : I → Matrix J J ℂ) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TensorBoard.tensor_trace

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TensorBoard.trace_mono_right

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TensorBoard.trace_mul_nonneg

lemma trace_mul_nonneg {A B : Matrix J J ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TensorBoard.trace_whitened_sum_le
statement:
lemma trace_whitened_sum_le (r : R → Matrix J J ℂ)
    (v A : Matrix J J ℂ) (hv : v.PosSemidef) (ht : Matrix.trace v=1)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TensorBoard.whitening_sum_bound

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.matrix_unitary_norm_le

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.unitary_average_norm_le

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TraceHolder.contraction_power_from_overlap
statement:
lemma contraction_power_from_overlap {t B c : ℝ} (q : ℕ)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hcq : c ≤ q)
    (hB : t^2 ≤ Real.exp B) :
    t^(2*q) ≤ Real.exp (c*B)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TraceHolder.diagonal_trace_holder
statement:
theorem diagonal_trace_holder {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (U V : Fin m → Matrix n n ℂ) (dval : Fin m → n → ℝ)
    (hU : ∀ j, ‖U j‖ ≤ 1) (hV : ∀ j, ‖V j‖ ≤ 1) (hdval : ∀ j i, 0 ≤ dval j i ∧ dval j i ≤ 1)
    (hs : ∀ j, ∑ i, (dval j i)^m ≤ 1) :
    ‖Matrix.trace ((List.ofFn (fun j => U j*Matrix.diagonal
      (fun i => ((dval j i : ℝ) : ℂ))*V j)).prod)‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TraceHolder.differentiable_framed_diag_entries
statement:
lemma differentiable_framed_diag_entries {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    (U V : Matrix n n ℂ) (f : n → E → ℂ)
    (hf : ∀ i, Differentiable ℂ (f i)) (a b : n) :

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TraceHolder.row_column_moment
statement:
theorem row_column_moment {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (PR : I → Matrix n n ℂ) (PC : J → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hR : ∑ i, PR i=1) (hC : ∑ j, PC j=1)
    (hR2 : ∀ i, PR i*PR i=PR i) (hC2 : ∀ j, PC j*PC j=PC j)
    (P X Y : Matrix n n ℂ) (FR : I → ℝ) (FC : J → ℝ) (F A B c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hcq : c ≤ q)
    (hchild : ∀ i j,
      (Matrix.trace (((PR i*X).conjTranspose*(PR i*X))^q)).re *
        (Matrix.trace (((Y*PC j).conjTranspose*(Y*PC j))^q)).re ≤
          Real.exp (-c*(FR i+FC j)+A))
    (hoverlap : ∀ i j, ‖PC j*P*PR i‖^2 ≤ Real.exp (FR i+FC j-F+B))
    (hcontract : ∀ i j, ‖PC j*P*PR i‖ ≤ 1) :
    (Matrix.trace (((Y*P*X).conjTranspose*(Y*P*X))^q)).re ≤
      ((Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J : ℕ) : ℝ)^(2*q)*Real.exp (-c*F+A+c*B)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.TraceHolder.row_column_schatten
statement:
theorem row_column_schatten {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (PR : I → Matrix n n ℂ) (PC : J → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hR : ∑ i, PR i=1) (hC : ∑ j, PC j=1)
    (hR2 : ∀ i, PR i*PR i=PR i) (hC2 : ∀ j, PC j*PC j=PC j)
    (P X Y : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    schatten (2*q) (Y*P*X) ≤
      ∑ ij : J × I, schatten (2*q) (Y*PC ij.1)*
        ‖PC ij.1*P*PR ij.2‖*schatten (2*q) (PR ij.2*X)

statement:
lemma product_entry {n : ℕ} (A : Fin n → Matrix Ω Ω R) (i j : Ω) :
    ((List.ofFn A).prod) i j=
      ∑ x : Fin n → Ω, if (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Ω) x j) 0=i then walk A (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Ω) x j) else 0

statement:
theorem assignedIndicator_le_ballIndicator
    (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (v : Y → X) (T : Y → Finset ι)
    (i : ι) (j : ℕ) (centers rep : K → X) (assignment : Y → Option K)
    (hassign : ∀ y k, assignment y = some k →
      i ∈ T y ∧ PartitionGraph.near L (T y) j (centers k) (v y))
    (hrep : ∀ k, L i (rep k) = L i (centers k)) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    assignedIndicator L T rep assignment j x y ≤
      ballIndicator L (T y) (3 * j + 2) x (v y)

    (μ : Y → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) (i : ι) (j : ℕ)
    (centers rep : K → X) (assignment : Y → Option K)
    (hassign : ∀ y k, assignment y = some k →
      i ∈ T y ∧ PartitionGraph.near L (T y) j (centers k) (v y))
    (hrep : ∀ k, L i (rep k) = L i (centers k)) (x : X) :
    assignedValue L T rep assignment μ j x ≤ levelValue L v T μ (3 * j + 2) x

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.CompressionLevels.ballIndicator_le_assignedIndicator_add
statement:
theorem ballIndicator_le_assignedIndicator_add
    (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (v : Y → X) (T : Y → Finset ι)
    (i : ι) (j : ℕ) (centers rep : K → X) (assignment : Y → Option K)
    (hassign : ∀ y k, assignment y = some k →
      i ∈ T y ∧ PartitionGraph.near L (T y) j (centers k) (v y))
    (hrep : ∀ k, L i (rep k) = L i (centers k)) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    ballIndicator L (T y) j x (v y) ≤
      assignedIndicator L T rep assignment j x y +
        (if i ∉ T y then 1 else 0) +
        (if i ∈ T y ∧ PartitionGraph.near L (T y) j x (v y) ∧
          assignment y = none then 1 else 0)

statement:
theorem levelValue_sub_two_mul_le_assignedValue
    (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (v : Y → X) (T : Y → Finset ι)
    (μ : Y → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) (i : ι) (j : ℕ)
    (centers rep : K → X) (assignment : Y → Option K)
    (hassign : ∀ y k, assignment y = some k →
      i ∈ T y ∧ PartitionGraph.near L (T y) j (centers k) (v y))
    (hrep : ∀ k, L i (rep k) = L i (centers k)) {θ : ℝ}
    (homit : (∑ y ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun y => i ∉ T y), μ y) ≤ θ)
    (hrem : ∀ x, (∑ y ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun y =>
      i ∈ T y ∧ PartitionGraph.near L (T y) j x (v y) ∧
        assignment y = none), μ y) ≤ θ) (x : X) :
    levelValue L v T μ j x - 2 * θ ≤ assignedValue L T rep assignment μ j x

    (hw0 : ∀ k T, 0 ≤ w k T) (hb0 : ∀ k T, 0 ≤ b k T)
    (hb1 : ∀ k T, b k T ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ (∑ k, ∑ T, w k T * b k T) -
        ∑ k, ∑ T, roundWeight (roundingStep θ s u) (w k T) * b k T ∧

    0 ≤ (∑ i, w i * b i) - ∑ i, roundWeight δ (w i) * b i ∧

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.roundingStep_pos
statement:
theorem roundingStep_pos {θ : ℝ} {s u : ℕ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (hs : 0 < s) :

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.slotTag_card
statement:
theorem slotTag_card (s u : ℕ) :

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.weightCodeSize_le
statement:
theorem weightCodeSize_le {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (weightCodeSize δ : ℝ) ≤ 1 + 1 / δ

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.weightCodeSize_pos
statement: theorem weightCodeSize_pos (δ : ℝ) : 0 < weightCodeSize δ

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.weightCodeSize_roundingStep
statement:
theorem weightCodeSize_roundingStep (θ : ℝ) (s u : ℕ) :
    weightCodeSize (roundingStep θ s u) =
      Nat.floor (((s : ℝ) * 2 ^ u) / θ) + 1

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.weightCode_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightCode_val (δ w : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hw0 : 0 ≤ w)
    (hw1 : w ≤ 1) :
    (weightCode δ w hδ hw0 hw1).val = Nat.floor (w / δ)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.compressionDecode_mem_compressionList
statement:
theorem compressionDecode_mem_compressionList
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (E : FixedLabels L q) (h s : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (code : CompressionCode u q h s (weightCodeSize (roundingStep θ s u))) :
    compressionDecode L E h s θ code ∈ compressionList L E h s θ

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.compressionList_card_le
statement:
theorem compressionList_card_le
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (E : FixedLabels L q) (h s : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hθ : 0 < θ) (hs : 0 < s) :
    ((compressionList L E h s θ).card : ℝ) ≤
      (u : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ (h * s) *
        (1 + (s : ℝ) * 2 ^ u / θ) ^ (h * s * 2 ^ u)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.compressionList_card_le_nat
statement:
theorem compressionList_card_le_nat
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (E : FixedLabels L q) (h s : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (compressionList L E h s θ).card ≤
      u * q ^ (h * s) * weightCodeSize (roundingStep θ s u) ^ (h * s * 2 ^ u)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.compressionList_nonempty
statement:
theorem compressionList_nonempty
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (E : FixedLabels L q) (h s : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hu : 0 < u) (hq : 0 < q) : (compressionList L E h s θ).Nonempty

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.mem_compressionList
statement:
theorem mem_compressionList (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (E : FixedLabels L q)
    (h s : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (a : X → ℝ) :
    a ∈ compressionList L E h s θ ↔
      ∃ code : CompressionCode u q h s (weightCodeSize (roundingStep θ s u)),
        compressionDecode L E h s θ code = a

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.groupedWeight_eq_zero_of_unused
statement:
theorem groupedWeight_eq_zero_of_unused (assignment : Y → Option K)
    (tag : Y → T) (μ : Y → ℝ) (k : K)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.groupedWeight_le_one
statement:
theorem groupedWeight_le_one (assignment : Y → Option K) (tag : Y → T)

    (k : K) (t : T) :

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.groupedWeight_le_totalMass
statement:
theorem groupedWeight_le_totalMass (assignment : Y → Option K) (tag : Y → T)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.groupedWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem groupedWeight_nonneg (assignment : Y → Option K) (tag : Y → T)
    (μ : Y → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) (k : K) (t : T) :
    0 ≤ groupedWeight assignment tag μ k t

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.sum_groupedWeight_eq
statement:
theorem sum_groupedWeight_eq (assignment : Y → Option K) (tag : Y → T)
    (μ : Y → ℝ) :
    (∑ k, ∑ t, groupedWeight assignment tag μ k t) =
      ∑ y, (match assignment y with
        | none => 0
        | some _ => μ y)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.sum_groupedWeight_le_one
statement:
theorem sum_groupedWeight_le_one (assignment : Y → Option K) (tag : Y → T)
    (μ : Y → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) (hmass : ∑ y, μ y ≤ 1) :
    (∑ k, ∑ t, groupedWeight assignment tag μ k t) ≤ 1

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.sum_groupedWeight_le_totalMass
statement:
theorem sum_groupedWeight_le_totalMass (assignment : Y → Option K)
    (tag : Y → T) (μ : Y → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) :
    (∑ k, ∑ t, groupedWeight assignment tag μ k t) ≤ ∑ y, μ y

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.sum_groupedWeight_mul
statement:
theorem sum_groupedWeight_mul (assignment : Y → Option K) (tag : Y → T)
    (μ : Y → ℝ) (B : K → T → ℝ) :
    (∑ k, ∑ t, groupedWeight assignment tag μ k t * B k t) =
      ∑ y, μ y * (match assignment y with
        | none => 0
        | some k => B k (tag y))

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GraphProfile.abs_row_sub_le_one
statement:
theorem abs_row_sub_le_one (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i)
    (𝒯 : Finset (Finset ι)) {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (x z : X) (y : Columns X 𝒯) :
    |row L 𝒯 h x y - row L 𝒯 h z y| ≤ 1

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GraphProfile.column_eq_sum
statement:
theorem column_eq_sum (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (𝒯 : Finset (Finset ι))
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (y : Columns X 𝒯) (x : X) :
    column L 𝒯 h y x = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range h,
      if PartitionGraph.distance L y.2.val x y.1 ≤ (j : ℕ∞)
      then LogProfile.gamma h j else 0

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GraphProfile.column_eq_zero_of_le
statement:
theorem column_eq_zero_of_le (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i)
    (𝒯 : Finset (Finset ι)) {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)

    (hd : (h : ℕ∞) ≤ PartitionGraph.distance L y.2.val x y.1) :

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GraphProfile.column_le_one
statement:
theorem column_le_one (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (𝒯 : Finset (Finset ι))

theorem column_self (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (𝒯 : Finset (Finset ι))

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GraphProfile.dist_row_eq_one
statement:
theorem dist_row_eq_one [Fintype X]
    (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (𝒯 : Finset (Finset ι))
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (x z : X)
    (hsep : ∃ T ∈ 𝒯, (h : ℕ∞) < PartitionGraph.distance L T x z) :

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GraphProfile.exists_column_abs_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_column_abs_eq_one (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GraphProfile.norm_row_sub_eq_one
statement:
theorem norm_row_sub_eq_one [Fintype X]
    (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (𝒯 : Finset (Finset ι))
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (x z : X)
    (hsep : ∃ T ∈ 𝒯, (h : ℕ∞) < PartitionGraph.distance L T x z) :

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.ProfileMixtures.dilated_level_sum_le
statement:
theorem dilated_level_sum_le (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (v : Y → X)
    (T : Y → Finset ι) (μ : Y → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y)
    (hmass : ∑ y, μ y ≤ 1) {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) {θ : ℝ}
    (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hprofile : Real.log 3 / Real.log ((h : ℝ) + 1) ≤ θ) (x : X) :
    (∑ j : Fin h, LogProfile.gamma h j.val *
      CompressionLevels.levelValue L v T μ (3 * j.val + 2) x) ≤
        profileMixture L v T h μ x + θ

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.ProfileMixtures.profileMixture_columns
statement:
theorem profileMixture_columns [Fintype X]
    (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (𝒯 : Finset (Finset ι)) (h : ℕ)
    (μ : GraphProfile.Columns X 𝒯 → ℝ) (x : X) :
    profileMixture L (fun y : GraphProfile.Columns X 𝒯 => y.1)
        (fun y => y.2.val) h μ x =
      columnCombination (GraphProfile.column L 𝒯 h) μ x

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.ProfileMixtures.profileMixture_eq_sum
statement:
theorem profileMixture_eq_sum (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (v : Y → X)
    (T : Y → Finset ι) {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (μ : Y → ℝ) (x : X) :
    profileMixture L v T h μ x = ∑ j : Fin h,
      LogProfile.gamma h j.val * CompressionLevels.levelValue L v T μ j.val x

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.ProfileMixtures.rounded_level_sum_bounds
statement:
theorem rounded_level_sum_bounds (L : (i : ι) → X → Label i) (v : Y → X)
    (T : Y → Finset ι) (μ : Y → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y)
    (hmass : ∑ y, μ y ≤ 1) {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) {θ : ℝ}
    (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hprofile : Real.log 3 / Real.log ((h : ℝ) + 1) ≤ θ)
    (x : X) (assigned rounded : Fin h → ℝ)
    (hlower : ∀ j, CompressionLevels.levelValue L v T μ j.val x - 2 * θ ≤ assigned j)
    (hupper : ∀ j, assigned j ≤ CompressionLevels.levelValue L v T μ (3 * j.val + 2) x)
    (hround : ∀ j, 0 ≤ assigned j - rounded j ∧ assigned j - rounded j ≤ θ) :
    profileMixture L v T h μ x - 3 * θ ≤
        ∑ j : Fin h, LogProfile.gamma h j.val * rounded j ∧
      (∑ j : Fin h, LogProfile.gamma h j.val * rounded j) ≤
        profileMixture L v T h μ x + θ

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.ProfileMixtures.sum_gamma_fin
statement:
theorem sum_gamma_fin {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    (∑ j : Fin h, LogProfile.gamma h j.val) = 1

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GreedyPivots.bad_of_subset
statement:
theorem bad_of_subset (μ : Y → ℝ) (I : X → Finset Y) (θ : ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) {U V : Finset Y} (hUV : U ⊆ V)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GreedyPivots.choosePivot_spec
statement:
theorem choosePivot_spec (μ : Y → ℝ) (I : X → Finset Y) (θ : ℝ) (U : Finset Y)
    (h : ∃ x, θ < mass μ (I x \ U)) :
    θ < mass μ (I (choosePivot μ I θ U) \ U)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GreedyPivots.covered_mono
statement:
theorem covered_mono (μ : Y → ℝ) (I : X → Finset Y) (θ : ℝ) :
    Monotone (covered μ I θ)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GreedyPivots.covered_subset_succ
statement:
theorem covered_subset_succ (μ : Y → ℝ) (I : X → Finset Y) (θ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    covered μ I θ n ⊆ covered μ I θ (n + 1)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GreedyPivots.covered_succ
statement:
theorem covered_succ (μ : Y → ℝ) (I : X → Finset Y) (θ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    covered μ I θ (n + 1) =
      covered μ I θ n ∪ I (choosePivot μ I θ (covered μ I θ n))

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GreedyPivots.covered_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem covered_zero (μ : Y → ℝ) (I : X → Finset Y) (θ : ℝ) :
    covered μ I θ 0 = ∅

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GreedyPivots.mass_covered_succ
statement:
theorem mass_covered_succ (μ : Y → ℝ) (I : X → Finset Y) (θ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    mass μ (covered μ I θ (n + 1)) = mass μ (covered μ I θ n) +
      mass μ (I (choosePivot μ I θ (covered μ I θ n)) \ covered μ I θ n)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GreedyPivots.mass_lt_of_bad
statement:
theorem mass_lt_of_bad (μ : Y → ℝ) (I : X → Finset Y) (θ : ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) (n : ℕ) :
    (∃ x, θ < mass μ (I x \ covered μ I θ n)) →
      n = 0 ∨ (n : ℝ) * θ < mass μ (covered μ I θ n)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GreedyPivots.mass_mono
statement:
theorem mass_mono (μ : Y → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y)
    {U V : Finset Y} (hUV : U ⊆ V) : mass μ U ≤ mass μ V

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GreedyPivots.mass_union
statement:
theorem mass_union (μ : Y → ℝ) (U V : Finset Y) :
    mass μ (U ∪ V) = mass μ U + mass μ (V \ U)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GreedyPivots.mem_covered_iff
statement:
theorem mem_covered_iff (μ : Y → ℝ) (I : X → Finset Y) (θ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (y : Y) :
    y ∈ covered μ I θ n ↔
      ∃ k < n, y ∈ I (choosePivot μ I θ (covered μ I θ k))

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.GreedyPivots.residual_le
statement:
theorem residual_le [Fintype Y] (μ : Y → ℝ) (I : X → Finset Y) (θ : ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) (hmass : ∑ y, μ y ≤ 1) (s : ℕ)
    (hs : 1 ≤ (s : ℝ) * θ) (x : X) :
    mass μ (I x \ covered μ I θ s) ≤ θ

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.exists_greedy_pivots
statement:
theorem exists_greedy_pivots {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] [Fintype Y]
    (μ : Y → ℝ) (I : X → Finset Y) (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y)
    (hmass : ∑ y, μ y ≤ 1) (θ : ℝ) (_hθ : 0 < θ) (s : ℕ)
    (hs : 1 ≤ (s : ℝ) * θ) :
    ∃ centers : Fin s → X, ∃ assigned : Y → Option (Fin s),
      (∀ y k, assigned y = some k → y ∈ I (centers k)) ∧
      (∀ y, (∃ k, y ∈ I (centers k)) ↔ assigned y ≠ none) ∧
      (∀ x, ∑ y ∈ (I x).filter (fun y => assigned y = none), μ y ≤ θ)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.exists_profile_pivots
statement:
theorem exists_profile_pivots {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY}
    [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] [Fintype Y]
    {u : ℕ} {Label : Fin u → Type uLabel}
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (v : Y → X) (T : Y → Finset (Fin u))
    (μ : Y → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) (hmass : ∑ y, μ y ≤ 1)
    (hu : 0 < u) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ (s : ℝ) * θ)
    (hcomp : ∀ y, ((Finset.univ \ T y).card : ℝ) ≤ θ * (u : ℝ)) (h : ℕ) :
    ∃ i : Fin u, ∃ centers : Fin h → Fin s → X,
      ∃ assigned : Fin h → Y → Option (Fin s),
        (∑ y ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun y => i ∉ T y), μ y) ≤ θ ∧
        (∀ j y k, assigned j y = some k →
          i ∈ T y ∧ PartitionGraph.near L (T y) j.val (centers j k) (v y)) ∧
        (∀ j x, (∑ y ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun y =>
          i ∈ T y ∧ PartitionGraph.near L (T y) j.val x (v y) ∧
            assigned j y = none), μ y) ≤ θ)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SignedCompression.card_code
statement:
theorem card_code (A : Finset (RealSpace X)) :

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SignedCompression.decode_mem_differenceList

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SignedCompression.exists_code
statement:
theorem exists_code (hpos : PositiveApproximation g θ A) :
    ∃ c : l1Ball Y → Code A,
      (∀ lam, UniformClose (6 * θ) (columnCombination g lam.val) (decode (c lam))) ∧
      ∀ lam lam', c lam = c lam' →
        UniformClose (12 * θ) (columnCombination g lam.val) (columnCombination g lam'.val)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SignedCompression.exists_code_approximation
statement:
theorem exists_code_approximation (hpos : PositiveApproximation g θ A)

    ∃ c : Code A, UniformClose (6 * θ) (columnCombination g lam) (decode c)

theorem negativePart_nonneg (lam : RealSpace Y) (y : Y) :

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SignedCompression.parts_sub

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SignedCompression.positivePart_nonneg

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.compressionList_bounds
statement:
theorem compressionList_bounds
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (E : FixedLabels L q)
    (𝒯 : Finset (Finset (Fin u)))
    (hu : 0 < u) (hh : 0 < h) (hs : 0 < s)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hsθ : 1 ≤ (s : ℝ) * θ)
    (hprofile : Real.log 3 / Real.log ((h : ℝ) + 1) ≤ θ)
    (hcomp : ∀ T ∈ 𝒯, ((Finset.univ \ T).card : ℝ) ≤ θ * (u : ℝ))
    (μ : GraphProfile.Columns X 𝒯 → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) (hmass : ∑ y, μ y ≤ 1) :
    ∃ a ∈ compressionList L E h s θ, ∀ x,
      columnCombination (GraphProfile.column L 𝒯 h) μ x - 3 * θ ≤ a x ∧
        a x ≤ columnCombination (GraphProfile.column L 𝒯 h) μ x + θ

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.exists_compressionCode
statement:
theorem exists_compressionCode
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i) (E : FixedLabels L q)
    (v : Y → X) (T : Y → Finset (Fin u)) (μ : Y → ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ μ y) (hmass : ∑ y, μ y ≤ 1)
    (hu : 0 < u) (hh : 0 < h) (hs : 0 < s)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hsθ : 1 ≤ (s : ℝ) * θ)
    (hprofile : Real.log 3 / Real.log ((h : ℝ) + 1) ≤ θ)
    (hcomp : ∀ y, ((Finset.univ \ T y).card : ℝ) ≤ θ * (u : ℝ)) :
    ∃ code : CompressionCode u q h s (weightCodeSize (roundingStep θ s u)),
      ∀ x, profileMixture L v T h μ x - 3 * θ ≤ compressionDecode L E h s θ code x ∧
        compressionDecode L E h s θ code x ≤ profileMixture L v T h μ x + θ

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.uniform_compression
statement:
theorem uniform_compression
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i)
    (hlabels : ∀ i, Nat.card (Set.range (L i)) ≤ q)
    (𝒯 : Finset (Finset (Fin u)))
    (hu : 0 < u) (hq : 0 < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hs : 0 < s)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hsθ : 1 ≤ (s : ℝ) * θ)
    (hprofile : Real.log 3 / Real.log ((h : ℝ) + 1) ≤ θ)
    (hcomp : ∀ T ∈ 𝒯, ((Finset.univ \ T).card : ℝ) ≤ θ * (u : ℝ)) :
    ∃ A : Finset (X → ℝ), A.Nonempty ∧
      (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (u : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ (h * s) *
        (1 + (s : ℝ) * 2 ^ u / θ) ^ (h * s * 2 ^ u) ∧
      SignedCompression.PositiveApproximation (GraphProfile.column L 𝒯 h) θ A

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.uniform_signed_compression
statement:
theorem uniform_signed_compression
    (L : (i : Fin u) → X → Label i)
    (hlabels : ∀ i, Nat.card (Set.range (L i)) ≤ q)
    (𝒯 : Finset (Finset (Fin u)))
    (hu : 0 < u) (hq : 0 < q) (hh : 0 < h) (hs : 0 < s)
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hsθ : 1 ≤ (s : ℝ) * θ)
    (hprofile : Real.log 3 / Real.log ((h : ℝ) + 1) ≤ θ)
    (hcomp : ∀ T ∈ 𝒯, ((Finset.univ \ T).card : ℝ) ≤ θ * (u : ℝ)) :
    ∃ A B : Finset (X → ℝ), A.Nonempty ∧
      (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (u : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ (h * s) *
        (1 + (s : ℝ) * 2 ^ u / θ) ^ (h * s * 2 ^ u) ∧
      B.card ≤ A.card ^ 2 ∧
      UniformApproximation (GraphProfile.column L 𝒯 h) (6 * θ) B

theorem form_entropy_ratio_le {r h s p Q : ℕ} {C : ℝ}

    (hQ : Real.log (Q : ℝ) ≤ (h : ℝ) * (s : ℝ) *
      Real.log ((p : ℝ) ^ formDimension r (h - 1)) + C) :
    Real.log ((Q : ℝ) ^ 2) / Real.log ((p : ℝ) ^ formDimension r h) ≤
      2 * (h : ℝ) ^ 2 * (s : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + h - 1) +

      ((p ^ formDimension r (h - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (h * pivotSlots θ) *
        (1 + (pivotSlots θ : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ u / θ) ^
          (h * pivotSlots θ * 2 ^ u)) :
    Real.log ((Q : ℝ) ^ 2) / Real.log ((p : ℝ) ^ formDimension r h) ≤
      2 * (h : ℝ) ^ 2 * (pivotSlots θ : ℝ) / ((r : ℝ) + h - 1) +

      IsSymmetricConvexBody (cube Y) ∧
      Coverable (matrixBody g t) (cube Y) ∧

        Coverable (polar (cube (Fin (Fintype.card Y)))) ((6 * ε + 2 * t) • polar K) ∧
        Fintype.card X ≤ coveringNumber K (cube (Fin (Fintype.card Y))) ∧

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.exists_prime_for_rank
statement:
theorem exists_prime_for_rank {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (B bound : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) :
    let h := compressionRadius a
    let D := formDimension r h
    let u := directionCount r h (accuracy a)
    let C := encodingCost h (accuracy a) u
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ bound < (p : ℝ) ∧ h < p ∧
      h ^ 2 * u ^ (2 * h) < p ∧ Real.exp (B * C / (D : ℝ)) < (p : ℝ) ∧
      0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) ∧ B * C < (D : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ) ∧
      2 * C / ((D : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ)) < 2 / B ∧ 0 < C

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.exists_prime_with_entropy_budget
statement:
theorem exists_prime_with_entropy_budget (h u D : ℕ) (C B bound : ℝ)
    (hD : 0 < D) (hB : 0 < B) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ bound < (p : ℝ) ∧ h < p ∧
      h ^ 2 * u ^ (2 * h) < p ∧ Real.exp (B * C / (D : ℝ)) < (p : ℝ) ∧
      0 < Real.log (p : ℝ) ∧ B * C < (D : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ) ∧
      2 * C / ((D : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ)) < 2 / B

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.entropyPair_of_matrix
statement:
theorem entropyPair_of_matrix {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y] (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hprime : Real.exp (B * encodingCost (compressionRadius a) (accuracy a)
      (directionCount r (compressionRadius a) (accuracy a)) /
        (formDimension r (compressionRadius a) : ℝ)) < (p : ℝ))
    (g : Y → X → ℝ)
    (hrows : Fintype.card X = p ^ formDimension r (compressionRadius a))
    (hcolumns : Fintype.card X ≤ Fintype.card Y)
    (hsep : ∀ x x', x ≠ x' → ∃ y, 1 ≤ |g y x - g y x'|)
    (A : Finset (RealSpace X))
    (hA : UniformApproximation g (6 * accuracy a) A)
    (Q : ℕ) (hAQ : A.card ≤ Q ^ 2)
    (hQ : Real.log (Q : ℝ) ≤
      (compressionRadius a : ℝ) * (pivotSlots (accuracy a) : ℝ) *
        Real.log ((p : ℝ) ^ formDimension r (compressionRadius a - 1)) +
          encodingCost (compressionRadius a) (accuracy a)
            (directionCount r (compressionRadius a) (accuracy a))) :
    Nonempty (EntropyPair a r B)

lemma cutoffFunction_le_one {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    cutoffFunction K r ≤ 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffFunction_nonneg
statement:
lemma cutoffFunction_nonneg {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    0 ≤ cutoffFunction K r

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffFunction_norm_bound
statement:
lemma cutoffFunction_norm_bound {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    cutoffFunction K r * r * cutoffFunction K r ≤ K ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffLeftFunction_continuous
statement:
lemma cutoffLeftFunction_continuous {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    Continuous (cutoffLeftFunction K)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffLeftFunction_mul_right
statement:
lemma cutoffLeftFunction_mul_right {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    cutoffLeftFunction K r * cutoffRightFunction K r = 1 - cutoffFunction K r

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffLeftFunction_sq
statement:
lemma cutoffLeftFunction_sq {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    cutoffLeftFunction K r ^ 2 = (1 - cutoffFunction K r) / max K (Real.sqrt r)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffLeft_loss
statement:
lemma cutoffLeft_loss (a : A) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    (2*K) • (cutoffLeft a K * star (cutoffLeft a K)) ≤
      a * star a - polarCutoff a K * star (polarCutoff a K)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffLeft_mul_right
statement:
lemma cutoffLeft_mul_right (a : A) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    cutoffLeft a K * cutoffRight a K = a - polarCutoff a K

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffRightFunction_continuous
statement:
lemma cutoffRightFunction_continuous {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    Continuous (cutoffRightFunction K)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffRightFunction_sq
statement:
lemma cutoffRightFunction_sq {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    cutoffRightFunction K r ^ 2 = (1 - cutoffFunction K r) * max K (Real.sqrt r)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffRight_loss
statement:
lemma cutoffRight_loss (a : A) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    (2*K) • (star (cutoffRight a K) * cutoffRight a K) ≤
      star a * a - star (polarCutoff a K) * polarCutoff a K

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoff_left_loss
statement:
lemma cutoff_left_loss {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    (2*K) * cutoffLeftFunction K r ^ 2 ≤ 1 - cutoffFunction K r ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoff_right_loss
statement:
lemma cutoff_right_loss {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (2*K) * cutoffRightFunction K r ^ 2 ≤ r - cutoffFunction K r * r * cutoffFunction K r

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_polarCutoff_le
statement:
lemma norm_polarCutoff_le (z : A) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    ‖polarCutoff z K‖ ≤ K

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.polarCutoff_error_le
statement:
lemma polarCutoff_error_le (z : A) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    star (z - polarCutoff z K) * (z - polarCutoff z K) ≤
      (K ^ 2)⁻¹ • (star z * z) ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.polarCutoff_error_square
statement:
lemma polarCutoff_error_square (z : A) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    star (z - polarCutoff z K) * (z - polarCutoff z K) =
      cfc (fun r => (1 - cutoffFunction K r) * r * (1 - cutoffFunction K r))
        (star z * z)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.polarCutoff_square
statement:
lemma polarCutoff_square (z : A) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    star (polarCutoff z K) * polarCutoff z K =
      cfc (fun r => cutoffFunction K r * r * cutoffFunction K r) (star z * z)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.halfGraph_energy_identity
statement:
lemma halfGraph_energy_identity (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (lam : ℝ) (b : H)
    {z q x y : H} (hzq : (z,q) ∈ D.halfGraph)
    (hqb : (q,b-(lam:ℂ) • z) ∈ D.halfGraph) (hxy : (x,y) ∈ D.halfGraph) :
    modularEnergy lam b x y - modularEnergy lam b z q =
      lam * ‖x-z‖ ^ 2 + ‖y-q‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.core_halfGraph
statement:
lemma core_halfGraph (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (ha : a ∈ S.M) :
    (a S.xi, S.J ((star a) S.xi)) ∈ S.D.halfGraph

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.fundamental_resolvent_lift
statement:
lemma fundamental_resolvent_lift (S : StandardModularData H) (r : ℝ)
    (b : H →L[ℂ] H) (hb : b ∈ S.M.commutant) :
    ∃ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ S.M ∧ ‖a‖ ≤ ‖b‖ * (1+(Real.exp r)⁻¹)+1 ∧
      a S.xi = S.D.calculus (modularResolvent r) (b S.xi)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.bounded_orbit_lift
statement:
lemma bounded_orbit_lift (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (xi : H)
    (hsep : ∀ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M → a xi = 0 → a = 0)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) {h : H}
    (hh : h ∈ closure {v : H | ∃ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M ∧ ‖a‖ ≤ C ∧ a xi = v}) :
    ∃ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M ∧ ‖a‖ ≤ C ∧ a xi = h

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.commutant_cyclic
statement:
lemma commutant_cyclic (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (xi : H)
    (hsep : ∀ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M → a xi = 0 → a = 0) :
    Dense (operatorOrbit M.commutant xi : Set H)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffLeft_mem
statement:
lemma cutoffLeft_mem (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ M) (K : ℝ) :
    cutoffLeft a K ∈ M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffLeft_vector_loss
statement:
lemma cutoffLeft_vector_loss (xi : H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    (2*K) * ‖star (cutoffLeft a K) xi‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖(star a) xi‖ ^ 2 - ‖star (polarCutoff a K) xi‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoffRight_vector_loss
statement:
lemma cutoffRight_vector_loss (xi : H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    (2*K) * ‖cutoffRight a K xi‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖a xi‖ ^ 2 - ‖polarCutoff a K xi‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoff_cross_term
statement:
lemma cutoff_cross_term (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (xi : H)
    (a b : H →L[ℂ] H) (ha : a ∈ M) (hb : b ∈ M.commutant) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    2 * (inner ℂ (b xi) ((a-polarCutoff a K) xi)).re ≤
      ‖b‖ * (‖star (cutoffLeft a K) xi‖ ^ 2 + ‖cutoffRight a K xi‖ ^ 2)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.cutoff_energy_le
statement:
lemma cutoff_energy_le (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (xi : H)
    (a b : H →L[ℂ] H) (ha : a ∈ M) (hb : b ∈ M.commutant)
    {lam K : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (hK : 0 < K) (h1 : ‖b‖ ≤ 2*K) (h2 : ‖b‖ ≤ lam*(2*K)) :
    modularEnergy lam (b xi) (polarCutoff a K xi) (star (polarCutoff a K) xi) ≤
      modularEnergy lam (b xi) (a xi) ((star a) xi)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.isClosed_bounded_orbit
statement:
lemma isClosed_bounded_orbit (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (xi : H)

lemma vectorState_star_mul (xi : H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.inner_pair
statement:

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.HilbertPair.pair_add

@[simp] lemma snd_diag (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (v : HilbertPair H) :

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.nonneg_of_jordan_pairing
statement:
lemma nonneg_of_jordan_pairing (φ : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (hp : ∀ a : A, 0 ≤ (φ (star a * a)).re)
    (hf : ∀ a : A, (φ (star a * a)).re = 0 → a = 0)

    (ht : ∀ y : A, 0 ≤ y → 0 ≤ (φ (x*y+y*x)).re) : 0 ≤ x

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.weightedMatrixFunctional_faithful
statement:
lemma weightedMatrixFunctional_faithful (φ : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (w : n → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hp : ∀ a : A, 0 ≤ (φ (star a*a)).re)
    (hf : ∀ a : A, (φ (star a*a)).re = 0 → a = 0)
    (a : CStarMatrix n n A) (ha : (weightedMatrixFunctional φ w (star a*a)).re = 0) : a = 0

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.weightedMatrixFunctional_nonneg
statement:
lemma weightedMatrixFunctional_nonneg (φ : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (w : n → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hp : ∀ a : A, 0 ≤ (φ (star a*a)).re)
    (a : CStarMatrix n n A) :
    0 ≤ (weightedMatrixFunctional φ w (star a*a)).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.weightedMatrixFunctional_star_mul
statement:
lemma weightedMatrixFunctional_star_mul (φ : A →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (w : n → ℝ)
    (a : CStarMatrix n n A) :
    (weightedMatrixFunctional φ w (star a*a)).re =
      ∑ i, w i * ∑ j, (φ (star (a j i) * a j i)).re
