lemma integrable_smul_bounded_orbit {k : ℝ → ℂ} (hk : Integrable k)
    {F : ℝ → E} (hF : Continuous F) {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ t, ‖F t‖ ≤ C) :
    Integrable (fun t => k t • F t)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.integral_comp_simple
statement:
lemma integral_comp_simple {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} {E : Type uE} [MeasurableSpace X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (q : SimpleFunc X Y) (f : Y → E) :
    ∫ x, f (q x) ∂μ = ∑ y ∈ q.range, μ.real (q ⁻¹' {y}) • f y

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.integral_gaussianCutoff_eq
statement:
lemma integral_gaussianCutoff_eq {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → E) :
    (∫ r, gaussianCutoff n r • f r) = gaussianNormalization n •
      ∫ r, f r ∂gaussianReal 0 (gaussianVariance n+gaussianVariance n)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.integral_positive_kernel
statement:
lemma integral_positive_kernel {X : Type uX} [PseudoMetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (x₀ : X) (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (K : X → X → ℂ) (hcont : Continuous (fun p : X × X => K p.1 p.2))
    (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ x y, ‖K x y‖ ≤ C)
    (hpos : ∀ (n : Type uX) [Fintype n] (x : n → X) (c : n → ℂ),
      0 ≤ (∑ i, ∑ j, (starRingEnd ℂ) (c i) * c j * K (x i) (x j)).re) :
    0 ≤ (∫ x, ∫ y, K x y ∂μ ∂μ).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_integral_smul_bounded_orbit
statement:
lemma norm_integral_smul_bounded_orbit {k : ℝ → ℂ} (hk : Integrable k)
    {F : ℝ → E} {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ t, ‖F t‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖∫ t, k t • F t‖ ≤ (∫ t, ‖k t‖) * C

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_strongIntegral_le
statement:
lemma norm_strongIntegral_le (k : ℝ → ℂ) (hk : Integrable k) (F : ℝ → E →L[ℂ] E)
    (hF : ∀ h, Continuous (fun t => F t h)) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound : ∀ t, ‖F t‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖strongIntegral k hk F hF C hbound‖ ≤ (∫ t, ‖k t‖) * C

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.strongIntegral_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma strongIntegral_apply (k : ℝ → ℂ) (hk : Integrable k) (F : ℝ → E →L[ℂ] E)
    (hF : ∀ h, Continuous (fun t => F t h)) (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ t, ‖F t‖ ≤ C) (h : E) :
    strongIntegral k hk F hF C hbound h = ∫ t, k t • F t h

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.continuous_gramKernelPairing

lemma continuous_gramKernelPairing (S : StandardModularData H)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.gramKernelPairing_twisted_positive_definite
statement:
lemma gramKernelPairing_twisted_positive_definite (S : StandardModularData H)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.kernelAverage_add
statement:
lemma kernelAverage_add (S : StandardModularData H) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ)
    (b c : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    S.kernelAverage n t (b+c) = S.kernelAverage n t b + S.kernelAverage n t c

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.kernelAverage_apply
statement:
lemma kernelAverage_apply (S : StandardModularData H) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ)
    (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) (h : H) :
    (S.kernelAverage n t b:H →L[ℂ] H) h =
      ∫ r, gaussianFourierWeight n t r • (S.modularKernel r b:H →L[ℂ] H) h

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.kernelAverage_gram_vector_nonneg
statement:
lemma kernelAverage_gram_vector_nonneg (S : StandardModularData H)
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (b : m → S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) (h : m → H) :
    0 ≤ (∑ i, ∑ j, inner ℂ (h i)
      ((S.kernelAverage n t (star (b j)*b i):H →L[ℂ] H) (h j))).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.kernelAverage_inner
statement:
lemma kernelAverage_inner (S : StandardModularData H) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ)
    (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) (h k : H) :
    inner ℂ h ((S.kernelAverage n t b:H →L[ℂ] H) k) =
      ∫ r, gaussianFourierWeight n t r*inner ℂ h ((S.modularKernel r b:H →L[ℂ] H) k)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.kernelAverage_smul
statement:
lemma kernelAverage_smul (S : StandardModularData H) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.kernelAverage_star
statement:
lemma kernelAverage_star (S : StandardModularData H) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ)
    (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    star (S.kernelAverage n t b) = S.kernelAverage n t (star b)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.kernelAverage_xi
statement:
lemma kernelAverage_xi (S : StandardModularData H) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ)
    (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    (S.kernelAverage n t b:H →L[ℂ] H) S.xi =
      S.D.calculus (kernelMultiplier n t) (S.J ((↑(star b):H →L[ℂ] H) S.xi))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.modularGram_vector_nonneg
statement:
lemma modularGram_vector_nonneg {n : Type uN} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (S : StandardModularData H) (r : n → ℝ) (b : n → S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra)
    (h : n → H) : 0 ≤ (∑ i, ∑ j,
      inner ℂ (h i) ((S.modularKernel (r i-r j) (star (b j)*b i):H →L[ℂ] H) (h j))).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.norm_gramKernelPairing_le
statement:
lemma norm_gramKernelPairing_le (S : StandardModularData H)
    (b : m → S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) (h : m → H) (r : ℝ) :
    ‖S.gramKernelPairing b h r‖ ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖h i‖*(8*‖star (b j)*b i‖*‖h j‖)

lemma tendsto_calculus_of_compact (D : RealSpectralCalculus H)

    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hf : ∀ n, ‖f n‖ ≤ C)
    (he : ∀ q : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ, HasCompactSupport (q : ℝ → ℂ) →
      Tendsto (fun n => f n*q) atTop (𝓝 (g*q))) (h : H) :
    Tendsto (fun n => D.calculus (f n) h) atTop (𝓝 (D.calculus g h))

lemma modular_covariance (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (ha : a ∈ S.M) :
    S.D.unitary t * a * S.D.unitary (-t) ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.modular_covariance_iff
statement:
lemma modular_covariance_iff (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma t a ∈ S.M ↔ a ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.normalizedFourier_on_dense
statement:
lemma normalizedFourier_on_dense (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < (kernelFourier t).re) (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) (x : H) :
    (S.normalizedFourier t b:H →L[ℂ] H) (S.D.unitary t (S.J x)) =
      S.D.unitary t (S.J ((star (b:H →L[ℂ] H)) x))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.normalizedFourier_spatial
statement:
lemma normalizedFourier_spatial (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < (kernelFourier t).re) (b : S.M.commutant.toStarSubalgebra) :
    (S.normalizedFourier t b:H →L[ℂ] H) = S.sigma t (S.jConjugate (star (b:H →L[ℂ] H)))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_add_time
statement:
lemma sigma_add_time (S : StandardModularData H) (s t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma (s+t) a = S.sigma s (S.sigma t a)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_jConjugate_mem
statement:
lemma sigma_jConjugate_mem (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < (kernelFourier t).re) (b : H →L[ℂ] H) (hb : b ∈ S.M.commutant) :
    S.sigma t (S.jConjugate b) ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_mem_of_fourier_positive
statement:
lemma sigma_mem_of_fourier_positive (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < (kernelFourier t).re) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (ha : a ∈ S.M) :
    S.sigma t a ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma sigma_zero (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) : S.sigma 0 a = a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.continuous_sigma_apply
statement:
lemma continuous_sigma_apply (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : H) :
    Continuous (fun t => S.sigma t a h)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.exists_finite_average_pair
statement:
lemma exists_finite_average_pair (S : StandardModularData H)
    (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer) {a b : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ S.M) (hb : b ∈ S.M)
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p t : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) ∧ (∑ i, p i) = 1 ∧
      ‖(∑ i, p i • S.D.unitary (t i) (a S.xi)) - S.state a • S.xi‖ < eps ∧
      ‖(∑ i, p i • S.D.unitary (t i) (b S.xi)) - S.state b • S.xi‖ < eps

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.fixed_eq_state_of_mem_closed_convex_orbit
statement:
lemma fixed_eq_state_of_mem_closed_convex_orbit (S : StandardModularData H)
    (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer) {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ S.M)
    {v : H} (hv : v ∈ closure (convexHull ℝ (Set.range (fun t => S.D.unitary t (a S.xi)))))
    (hfix : ∀ t, S.D.unitary t v = v) : v = S.state a • S.xi

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.fixed_of_fixed_vector
OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.inner_fixed_on_closed_convex_orbit
statement:
lemma inner_fixed_on_closed_convex_orbit (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H)
    {v : H} (hv : v ∈ closure (convexHull ℝ (Set.range (fun t => S.D.unitary t (a S.xi))))) :
    inner ℂ S.xi v = S.state a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.norm_sigma
statement:
lemma norm_sigma (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    ‖S.sigma t a‖ = ‖a‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.norm_star_apply_xi_le
statement:
lemma norm_star_apply_xi_le (S : StandardModularData H) {a : H →L[ℂ] H}
    (ha : a ∈ S.M) {I : Set ℝ} (hband : S.D.HasSpectralSupport I (a S.xi))
    {b : ℝ} (hb : ∀ u ∈ I, u ≤ b) :
    ‖star a S.xi‖ ≤ Real.exp (b / 2) * ‖a S.xi‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.norm_state_le
statement: lemma norm_state_le (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) : ‖S.state a‖ ≤ ‖a‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.norm_state_real_star_mul
statement:
lemma norm_state_real_star_mul (S : StandardModularData H) (y : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    ‖y S.xi‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖y‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.pair_state_mem_closed_convex_orbit
statement:
lemma pair_state_mem_closed_convex_orbit (S : StandardModularData H)
    (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer) {a b : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ S.M) (hb : b ∈ S.M) :
    WithLp.toLp 2 (S.state a • S.xi, S.state b • S.xi) ∈ closure (convexHull ℝ
      (Set.range (fun t => WithLp.toLp 2
        (S.D.unitary t (a S.xi), S.D.unitary t (b S.xi)))))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigmaLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma sigmaLinear_apply (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigmaLinear t a = S.sigma t a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_add
statement:
lemma sigma_add (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a b : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma t (a + b) = S.sigma t a + S.sigma t b

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_apply_xi
statement:
@[simp] lemma sigma_apply_xi (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma t a S.xi = S.D.unitary t (a S.xi)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_mem
statement:
lemma sigma_mem (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ S.M) :
    S.sigma t a ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_mul
statement:
lemma sigma_mul (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a b : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma t (a * b) = S.sigma t a * S.sigma t b

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma sigma_one (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) :
    S.sigma t 1 = 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_real_smul
statement:
lemma sigma_real_smul (S : StandardModularData H) (t c : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma t (c • a) = c • S.sigma t a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_smul
statement:
lemma sigma_smul (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (c : ℂ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma t (c • a) = c • S.sigma t a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_star
statement:
lemma sigma_star (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.sigma t (star a) = star (S.sigma t a)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.sigma_sum
statement:
lemma sigma_sum {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ)
    (a : ι → H →L[ℂ] H) : S.sigma t (∑ i, a i) = ∑ i, S.sigma t (a i)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_covariant_sandwich
statement:
lemma state_covariant_sandwich (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (y a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state (star (S.sigma t y) * a * S.sigma t y) =
      S.state (star y * S.sigma (-t) a * y)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_eq_vectorState
statement:
lemma state_eq_vectorState (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state a = vectorStateLM S.xi a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_mem_closed_convex_orbit
statement:
lemma state_mem_closed_convex_orbit (S : StandardModularData H) (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer)
    {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ S.M) :
    S.state a • S.xi ∈ closure (convexHull ℝ (Set.range (fun t => S.D.unitary t (a S.xi))))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_mul_star
statement:
lemma state_mul_star (S : StandardModularData H) (y : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state (y * star y) = (‖star y S.xi‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_real_smul
statement:
lemma state_real_smul (S : StandardModularData H) (c : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state (c • a) = c • S.state a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_sandwich
statement:
lemma state_sandwich (S : StandardModularData H) (y a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state (star y * a * y) = inner ℂ (y S.xi) (a (y S.xi))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_sigma
statement:
lemma state_sigma (S : StandardModularData H) (t : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state (S.sigma t a) = S.state a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_sq_re
statement:
lemma state_sq_re (S : StandardModularData H) {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) :
    (S.state (a ^ 2)).re = ‖a S.xi‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_star_mul
statement:
lemma state_star_mul (S : StandardModularData H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state (star a * a) = (‖a S.xi‖ ^ 2 : ℝ)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_star_mul_re
statement:
lemma state_star_mul_re (S : StandardModularData H) (y : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (S.state (star y * y)).re = ‖y S.xi‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_sum
statement:
lemma state_sum {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] (S : StandardModularData H)
    (a : ι → H →L[ℂ] H) : S.state (∑ i, a i) = ∑ i, S.state (a i)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.convex_bounded_orbit
statement:
lemma convex_bounded_orbit (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (xi : H) (C : ℝ) :
    Convex ℝ {v : H | ∃ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M ∧ ‖a‖ ≤ C ∧ a xi = v}

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.convex_minimizer_unique
statement:
lemma convex_minimizer_unique {K : Set E} (hK : Convex ℝ K) {v w : E}
    (hv : v ∈ K) (hw : w ∈ K)
    (hvm : ‖(0 : E) - v‖ = ⨅ a : K, ‖(0 : E) - a‖)
    (hwm : ‖(0 : E) - w‖ = ⨅ a : K, ‖(0 : E) - a‖) : v = w

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.exists_fixed_in_closed_convex_orbit
statement:
lemma exists_fixed_in_closed_convex_orbit
    (U : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E) (hadd : ∀ t r, U (t + r) = U t * U r)
    (hnorm : ∀ t v, ‖U t v‖ = ‖v‖) (x : E) :
    ∃ v ∈ closure (convexHull ℝ (Set.range (fun t => U t x))), ∀ t, U t v = v

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.map_mem_closed_convexHull
OAI.BoundedRecovery.re_vectorState_sq
statement:
lemma re_vectorState_sq (xi : H) {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a) :
    (vectorStateLM xi (a ^ 2)).re = ‖a xi‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.re_vectorState_star_mul_nonneg
statement:
lemma re_vectorState_star_mul_nonneg (xi : H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    0 ≤ (vectorStateLM xi (star a * a)).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.small_on_separating_controls_vector
statement:
lemma small_on_separating_controls_vector (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (xi : H)
    (hsep : ∀ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M → a xi = 0 → a = 0)
    (h : H) {C eps : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (heps : 0 < eps) :
    ∃ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta ∧ ∀ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ M → ‖a‖ ≤ C →
      ‖a xi‖ < delta → ‖a h‖ < eps

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.averageReverseSquare_eq
statement:
lemma averageReverseSquare_eq (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ) (y : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (∑ i, p i • (S.sigma (t i) y * star (S.sigma (t i) y))) =
      S.modularAverage p t (y * star y)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.averageSquare_eq
statement:
lemma averageSquare_eq (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ) (y : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (∑ i, p i • (star (S.sigma (t i) y) * S.sigma (t i) y)) =
      S.modularAverage p t (star y * y)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.isSelfAdjoint_averageSquare
statement:
lemma isSelfAdjoint_averageSquare (p : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → H →L[ℂ] H) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (∑ i, p i • (star (z i) * z i))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.modularAverage_apply_xi
statement:
lemma modularAverage_apply_xi (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.modularAverage p t a S.xi = ∑ i, p i • S.D.unitary (t i) (a S.xi)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.modularAverage_mem
statement:
lemma modularAverage_mem (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ) {a : H →L[ℂ] H}
    (ha : a ∈ S.M) : S.modularAverage p t a ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.modularAverage_sandwich
statement:
lemma modularAverage_sandwich (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ) (y b : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (∑ i, p i * (S.state (star (S.sigma (t i) y) * b * S.sigma (t i) y)).re) =
      (inner ℂ (y S.xi) (S.modularAverage p (fun i => -t i) b (y S.xi))).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.norm_modularAverage_apply_xi_sub_le
statement:
lemma norm_modularAverage_apply_xi_sub_le (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hsum : (∑ i, p i) = 1) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (c : ℂ) :
    ‖S.modularAverage p t a S.xi - c • S.xi‖ ≤ ‖a S.xi - c • S.xi‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.norm_modularAverage_le
statement:
lemma norm_modularAverage_le (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hsum : (∑ i, p i) = 1) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    ‖S.modularAverage p t a‖ ≤ ‖a‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.re_inner_operator_le_of_small
statement:
lemma re_inner_operator_le_of_small (h : H) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) (b : ℝ)
    (hsmall : ‖(a - b • (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)) h‖ < 1 / (‖h‖+1)) :
    (inner ℂ h (a h)).re < b * ‖h‖ ^ 2 + 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.real_smul_mem
statement:
lemma real_smul_mem (S : StandardModularData H) {a : H →L[ℂ] H} (ha : a ∈ S.M) (r : ℝ) :
    r • a ∈ S.M

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_sum_probability_smul_le
statement:
lemma norm_sum_probability_smul_le {E : Type uE} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hsum : (∑ i, p i) = 1)
    (f : ι → E) {C : ℝ} (hf : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ C) : ‖∑ i, p i • f i‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.abs_mean_orbitDefect_sub_le
statement:
lemma abs_mean_orbitDefect_sub_le (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ)
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (h k : H) :
    |fixedMean omega (D.orbitDefect T h) - fixedMean omega (D.orbitDefect T k)| ≤
      ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (‖h‖+‖k‖) * ‖h-k‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.mean_orbitDefect_le
statement:
lemma mean_orbitDefect_le (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ)
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : H) :
    fixedMean omega (D.orbitDefect T h) ≤ ‖T‖ ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.mean_orbitDefect_nonneg
statement:
lemma mean_orbitDefect_nonneg (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ)
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : H) : 0 ≤ fixedMean omega (D.orbitDefect T h)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.norm_orbitDefect_le
statement:
lemma norm_orbitDefect_le (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : H) :
    ‖D.orbitDefect T h‖ ≤ ‖T‖ ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.norm_orbitDefect_sub_le
statement:
lemma norm_orbitDefect_sub_le (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (h k : H) :
    ‖D.orbitDefect T h - D.orbitDefect T k‖ ≤ ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (‖h‖+‖k‖) * ‖h-k‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.orbitDefect_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma orbitDefect_apply (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (h : H) (t : ℝ) :
    D.orbitDefect T h t = ‖T (D.unitary t h)‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.orbitDefect_unitary
statement:
lemma orbitDefect_unitary (D : RealSpectralCalculus H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (r : ℝ) (h : H) :
    D.orbitDefect T (D.unitary r h) = translateBCF (D.orbitDefect T h) r

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.exists_finite_moment_average
statement:
lemma exists_finite_moment_average (S : StandardModularData H)
    (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer) {y : H →L[ℂ] H} (hy : y ∈ S.M) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p t : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) ∧ (∑ i, p i) = 1 ∧
      (S.state ((S.modularAverage p t (star y * y)) ^ 2)).re ≤
        (‖y S.xi‖ ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2 ∧
      (∑ i, p i * (S.state (star (S.sigma (t i) y) *
        S.modularAverage p t (y * star y) * S.sigma (t i) y)).re) ≤
        ‖y S.xi‖ ^ 2 * ‖star y S.xi‖ ^ 2 + 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.exists_lt_of_lt_fixedMean
statement:
lemma exists_lt_of_lt_fixedMean (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hω : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop)
    (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : c < fixedMean omega f) :
    ∃ t, c < f t

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.fixedMean_add
statement:
lemma fixedMean_add (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) :
    fixedMean omega (f+g) = fixedMean omega f + fixedMean omega g

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.fixedMean_const
statement:
lemma fixedMean_const (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hω : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop) (c : ℝ) :
    fixedMean omega (fun _ => c) = c

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.fixedMean_mono
statement:
lemma fixedMean_mono (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)
    (hfg : ∀ t, f t ≤ g t) : fixedMean omega f ≤ fixedMean omega g

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.fixedMean_smul
statement:
lemma fixedMean_smul (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) :
    fixedMean omega (c • f) = c * fixedMean omega f

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.fixedMean_translate
statement:
lemma fixedMean_translate (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hω : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop)
    (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    fixedMean omega (translateBCF f r) = fixedMean omega f

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.meanCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma meanCLM_apply (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) :
    meanCLM omega f = fixedMean omega f

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_fixedMean_le
statement:
lemma norm_fixedMean_le (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) :
    ‖fixedMean omega f‖ ≤ ‖f‖

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_symmetricAverage_le
statement:
lemma norm_symmetricAverage_le (f : ℝ → ℝ) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hf : ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ C) (k : ℕ) : ‖symmetricAverage f k‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.norm_symmetricAverage_translate_sub_le
statement:
lemma norm_symmetricAverage_translate_sub_le (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)
    (r : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖symmetricAverage (translateBCF f r) k - symmetricAverage f k‖ ≤
      (2 * (k : ℝ))⁻¹ * (2 * ‖f‖ * |r|)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.symmetricAverage_add
statement:
lemma symmetricAverage_add (f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    symmetricAverage (f+g) k = symmetricAverage f k + symmetricAverage g k

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.symmetricAverage_const
statement:
lemma symmetricAverage_const (c : ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    symmetricAverage (fun _ => c) k = c

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.symmetricAverage_mono
statement:
lemma symmetricAverage_mono (f g : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ)
    (hfg : ∀ t, f t ≤ g t) (k : ℕ) : symmetricAverage f k ≤ symmetricAverage g k

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.symmetricAverage_smul
statement:
lemma symmetricAverage_smul (c : ℝ) (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    symmetricAverage (c • f) k = c * symmetricAverage f k

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.tendsto_symmetricAverage_mean
statement:
lemma tendsto_symmetricAverage_mean (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ)
    (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) :
    Tendsto (symmetricAverage f) (omega : Filter ℕ) (𝓝 (fixedMean omega f))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.tendsto_symmetricAverage_translate_sub
statement:
lemma tendsto_symmetricAverage_translate_sub (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun k => symmetricAverage (translateBCF f r) k - symmetricAverage f k)
      atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.translateBCF_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma translateBCF_apply (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℝ) (r t : ℝ) :
    translateBCF f r t = f (t+r)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.average_sandwich_state_translate
statement:
lemma average_sandwich_state_translate (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ)
    (r : ℝ) (y : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (∑ i, p i * (S.state (star (S.sigma (r+t i) y) *
      S.modularAverage p (fun j => r+t j) (y*star y) * S.sigma (r+t i) y)).re) =
    (∑ i, p i * (S.state (star (S.sigma (t i) y) *
      S.modularAverage p t (y*star y) * S.sigma (t i) y)).re)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.average_square_state_translate
statement:
lemma average_square_state_translate (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ)
    (r : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.state ((S.modularAverage p (fun i => r+t i) a)^2) =
      S.state ((S.modularAverage p t a)^2)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.exists_finite_defect_moment_average
statement:
lemma exists_finite_defect_moment_average (S : StandardModularData H)
    (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer) (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ)
    (hω : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) {y : H →L[ℂ] H}
    (hy : y ∈ S.M) {gamma : ℝ}
    (hg : gamma < fixedMean omega (S.D.orbitDefect T (y S.xi))) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p t : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) ∧ (∑ i, p i) = 1 ∧
      gamma ≤ ∑ i, p i * ‖T (S.sigma (t i) y S.xi)‖ ^ 2 ∧
      (S.state ((S.modularAverage p t (star y * y)) ^ 2)).re +
      (∑ i, p i * (S.state (star (S.sigma (t i) y) *
        S.modularAverage p t (y * star y) * S.sigma (t i) y)).re) ≤
        (‖y S.xi‖ ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2 + ‖y S.xi‖ ^ 2 * ‖star y S.xi‖ ^ 2 + 1

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.exists_translate_defect
statement:
lemma exists_translate_defect (S : StandardModularData H) (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ)
    (hω : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (y : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (p t : ι → ℝ) (hsum : (∑ i, p i) = 1) {gamma : ℝ}
    (hg : gamma < fixedMean omega (S.D.orbitDefect T (y S.xi))) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, gamma < ∑ i, p i * ‖T (S.sigma (r+t i) y S.xi)‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.modularAverage_add_time
statement:
lemma modularAverage_add_time (S : StandardModularData H) (p t : ι → ℝ)
    (r : ℝ) (a : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    S.modularAverage p (fun i => r + t i) a = S.sigma r (S.modularAverage p t a)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.phaseMean_defect
statement:
lemma phaseMean_defect (S : StandardModularData H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (n : ℕ) (p : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (z : Fin n → H →L[ℂ] H) :
    phaseMean n (fun e => ‖T (phaseSum (fun i => Real.sqrt (p i) • z i) e S.xi)‖ ^ 2) =
      ∑ i, p i * ‖T (z i S.xi)‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.phaseMean_fourth_le
statement:
lemma phaseMean_fourth_le (S : StandardModularData H)
    (n : ℕ) (p : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (z : Fin n → H →L[ℂ] H) :
    phaseMean n (fun e => (S.state ((star (phaseSum (fun i => Real.sqrt (p i) • z i) e) *
      phaseSum (fun i => Real.sqrt (p i) • z i) e) ^ 2)).re) ≤
      (S.state ((∑ i, p i • (star (z i) * z i)) ^ 2)).re +
      ∑ i, p i * (S.state (star (z i) * (∑ j, p j • (z j * star (z j))) * z i)).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.real_sqrt_reverse_square
statement:
lemma real_sqrt_reverse_square {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (z : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (Real.sqrt p • z) * star (Real.sqrt p • z) = p • (z * star z)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.real_sqrt_sandwich
statement:
lemma real_sqrt_sandwich {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (z b : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    star (Real.sqrt p • z) * b * (Real.sqrt p • z) = p • (star z * b * z)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.real_sqrt_square
statement:
lemma real_sqrt_square {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (z : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    star (Real.sqrt p • z) * (Real.sqrt p • z) = p • (star z * z)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.state_T_square
statement:
lemma state_T_square (S : StandardModularData H) (T z : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    (S.state (star z * (star T * T) * z)).re = ‖T (z S.xi)‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.exists_phaseMean_le
statement:
lemma exists_phaseMean_le (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → ℝ) :
    ∃ e, phaseMean n f ≤ f e

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_add
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_add (n : ℕ) (f g : (Fin n → Fin 4) → A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => f e + g e) = phaseExpectation n f + phaseExpectation n g

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_const
statement: lemma phaseExpectation_const (n : ℕ) (a : A) : phaseExpectation n (fun _ => a) = a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_fourth
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_fourth (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => (star (phaseSum a e) * phaseSum a e) ^ 2) =
      (∑ i, star (a i) * a i) ^ 2 +
        (∑ i, star (a i) * (∑ j, a j * star (a j)) * a i) -
        ∑ i, (star (a i) * a i) ^ 2

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_map
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_map {B : Type uB} [AddCommMonoid B] [Module ℂ B]
    (L : A →ₗ[ℂ] B) (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => L (f e)) = L (phaseExpectation n f)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_mul_left
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_mul_left (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → A) (a : A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => a * f e) = a * phaseExpectation n f

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_mul_right
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_mul_right (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → A) (a : A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => f e * a) = phaseExpectation n f * a

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_quadratic
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_quadratic (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → A) (b : A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => star (phaseSum a e) * b * phaseSum a e) =
      ∑ i, star (a i) * b * a i

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_reverse_quadratic
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_reverse_quadratic (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → A) (b : A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => phaseSum a e * b * star (phaseSum a e)) =
      ∑ i, a i * b * star (a i)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_reverse_square
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_reverse_square (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => phaseSum a e * star (phaseSum a e)) =
      ∑ i, a i * star (a i)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_smul
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_smul (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → A) (c : ℂ) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => c • f e) = c • phaseExpectation n f

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_square
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_square (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => star (phaseSum a e) * phaseSum a e) =
      ∑ i, star (a i) * a i

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseExpectation_sub
statement:
lemma phaseExpectation_sub (n : ℕ) (f g : (Fin n → Fin 4) → A) :
    phaseExpectation n (fun e => f e - g e) = phaseExpectation n f - phaseExpectation n g

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseMean_add
statement:
lemma phaseMean_add (n : ℕ) (f g : (Fin n → Fin 4) → ℝ) :
    phaseMean n (fun e => f e + g e) = phaseMean n f + phaseMean n g

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseMean_const
statement: lemma phaseMean_const (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) : phaseMean n (fun _ => c) = c

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseMean_mono
statement:
lemma phaseMean_mono (n : ℕ) {f g : (Fin n → Fin 4) → ℝ} (h : ∀ e, f e ≤ g e) :
    phaseMean n f ≤ phaseMean n g

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseMean_mul
statement:
lemma phaseMean_mul (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → ℝ) :
    phaseMean n (fun e => c * f e) = c * phaseMean n f

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseMean_nonneg
statement:
lemma phaseMean_nonneg (n : ℕ) {f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ e, 0 ≤ f e) :
    0 ≤ phaseMean n f

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseMean_re
statement:
lemma phaseMean_re (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Fin 4) → ℂ) :
    phaseMean n (fun e => (f e).re) = (phaseExpectation n f).re

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phaseSum_succ
statement:
lemma phaseSum_succ {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) (i : Fin 4) (e : Fin n → Fin 4) :
    phaseSum a (Fin.cons i e) = phaseSum (fun j => a j.succ) e + phase i • a 0

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phase_fourth_step
statement:
lemma phase_fourth_step (x y : A) :
    phaseAverage (fun i => (star (x + phase i • y) * (x + phase i • y)) ^ 2) =
      (star x * x) ^ 2 + (star y * y) ^ 2 +
        star x * x * (star y * y) + star y * y * (star x * x) +
        star x * (y * star y) * x + star y * (x * star x) * y

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phase_quadratic_step
statement:
lemma phase_quadratic_step (x y b : A) :
    phaseAverage (fun i => star (x + phase i • y) * b * (x + phase i • y)) =
      star x * b * x + star y * b * y

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.phase_reverse_quadratic_step
statement:
lemma phase_reverse_quadratic_step (x y b : A) :
    phaseAverage (fun i => (x + phase i • y) * b * star (x + phase i • y)) =
      x * b * star x + y * b * star y

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.calculus_apply_eq_integral
statement:
lemma calculus_apply_eq_integral (D : RealSpectralCalculus H)
    (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ) (k : ℝ → ℂ) (hk : Integrable k)
    (hfk : ∀ u, f u = ∫ t, k t * spectralCharacter t u) (h : H) :
    D.calculus f h = ∫ t, k t • D.unitary t h

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.calculus_eq_integratedUnitary
statement:
lemma calculus_eq_integratedUnitary (D : RealSpectralCalculus H)
    (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ) (k : ℝ → ℂ) (hk : Integrable k)
    (hfk : ∀ u, f u = ∫ t, k t * spectralCharacter t u) :
    D.calculus f = D.integratedUnitary k hk

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.integral_character_mul
statement:
lemma integral_character_mul (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ)
    (k : ℝ → ℂ) (hk : Integrable k)
    (hfk : ∀ u, f u = ∫ t, k t * spectralCharacter t u)
    (q : BoundedContinuousFunction ℝ ℂ) (hq : HasCompactSupport (q : ℝ → ℂ)) :
    Integrable (fun t => k t • (spectralCharacter t * q)) ∧
      (∫ t, k t • (spectralCharacter t * q)) = f * q

lemma bandMultiplier_contracts (S : StandardModularData H) (s rho : ℝ) (h : H) :

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.bandMultiplier_fixes
statement:
lemma bandMultiplier_fixes (S : StandardModularData H) {s rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.exists_band_representative
statement:
lemma exists_band_representative (S : StandardModularData H) {s rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho)
    {h : H} (hh : S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-rho) (s+rho)) h) (hn : ‖h‖ = 1)

    ∃ y : H →L[ℂ] H, y ∈ S.M ∧ ‖y S.xi‖ ≤ 2 ∧ ‖y S.xi - h‖ < eps ∧
      S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-2*rho) (s+2*rho)) (y S.xi)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.fourierFilter_apply_xi

lemma fourierFilter_apply_xi (S : StandardModularData H)

OAI.BoundedRecovery.RealSpectralCalculus.HasSpectralSupport.sum
OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.bounded_recovery_finite_step
statement:
lemma bounded_recovery_finite_step (S : StandardModularData H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    {s d gamma Q K : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hg : 0 < gamma) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hcut : ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (K ^ 2)⁻¹ * Q ≤ gamma / 4)
    {y : H →L[ℂ] H} (hy : y ∈ S.M)
    (hband : S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-d) (s+d)) (y S.xi))
    (n : ℕ) (p t : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i)
    (hdef : gamma ≤ ∑ i, p i * ‖T (S.sigma (t i) y S.xi)‖ ^ 2)
    (hmom : (S.state ((S.modularAverage p t (star y * y)) ^ 2)).re +
      (∑ i, p i * (S.state (star (S.sigma (t i) y) *
        S.modularAverage p t (y * star y) * S.sigma (t i) y)).re) ≤ Q) :
    ∃ v : H →L[ℂ] H, v ∈ S.M ∧ ‖v‖ ≤ filterL1 * K ∧
      Real.sqrt gamma / 2 ≤ ‖T (v S.xi)‖ ∧
      S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-2*d) (s+2*d)) (v S.xi)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.bounded_recovery_single
statement:
lemma bounded_recovery_single (S : StandardModularData H) (hscalar : S.ScalarCentralizer)
    (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hω : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    {s rho gamma K : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho) (hwidth : 2*rho ≤ 1)
    (hg : 0 < gamma) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hcut : ‖T‖^2 * (K^2)⁻¹ * recoveryMomentBound s ≤ gamma/4)
    {h : H} (hn : ‖h‖ = 1) (hband : S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-rho) (s+rho)) h)
    (hdef : 4*gamma ≤ fixedMean omega (S.D.orbitDefect T h)) :
    ∃ v : H →L[ℂ] H, v ∈ S.M ∧ ‖v‖ ≤ filterL1*K ∧ Real.sqrt gamma/2 ≤ ‖T (v S.xi)‖ ∧
      S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-4*rho) (s+4*rho)) (v S.xi)

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.exists_band_representative_with_defect
statement:
lemma exists_band_representative_with_defect (S : StandardModularData H)
    (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) {s rho gamma : ℝ}
    (hrho : 0 < rho) (hg : 0 < gamma) {h : H} (hn : ‖h‖ = 1)
    (hband : S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-rho) (s+rho)) h)
    (hdef : 4*gamma ≤ fixedMean omega (S.D.orbitDefect T h)) :
    ∃ y : H →L[ℂ] H, y ∈ S.M ∧ ‖y S.xi‖ ≤ 2 ∧
      S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-2*rho) (s+2*rho)) (y S.xi) ∧
      gamma < fixedMean omega (S.D.orbitDefect T (y S.xi))

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.StandardModularData.moment_bound_of_narrow_band

lemma moment_bound_of_narrow_band (S : StandardModularData H) {s rho : ℝ}
    (hwidth : 2*rho ≤ 1) {y : H →L[ℂ] H} (hy : y ∈ S.M) (hn : ‖y S.xi‖ ≤ 2)
    (hband : S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s-2*rho) (s+2*rho)) (y S.xi)) :
    (‖y S.xi‖^2+1)^2 + ‖y S.xi‖^2 * ‖star y S.xi‖^2 + 1 ≤ recoveryMomentBound s

name: OAI.BoundedRecovery.bounded_recovery

    (omega : Ultrafilter ℕ) (hfree : (omega : Filter ℕ) ≤ Filter.atTop)
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (s : ℝ) (delta : ℕ → ℝ) (hdelta : ∀ n, 0 < delta n)
    (hdelta0 : Tendsto delta atTop (𝓝 0)) (h : ℕ → H) (hunit : ∀ n, ‖h n‖ = 1)
    (hband : ∀ n, S.D.HasSpectralSupport (Icc (s - delta n) (s + delta n)) (h n))
    (hpositive : 0 < Filter.limsup
      (fun n => fixedMean omega (fun t => ‖T (S.D.unitary t (h n))‖ ^ 2)) atTop) :
    RecoveryConclusion S T s delta

lemma exteriorCorrection_eq_left {G : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G U) (hi : InjOn G U)
    (hd : ∀ z ∈ U, deriv G z ≠ 0) {w t : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ U) (ht : t ∈ U) :
    exteriorCorrection G w t =
      -t * dslope (fun z => deriv G t / dslope G t z) t w

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.exteriorCorrection_eq_reciprocal
statement:
theorem exteriorCorrection_eq_reciprocal {a b : ℂ} {h : ℂ → ℂ} {x y : ℂ}
    (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (hx : DifferentiableAt ℂ h x) (hy : DifferentiableAt ℂ h y)
    (hs : DifferentiableAt ℂ (dslope h x) y) :
    exteriorCorrection (exteriorMap a b h) x⁻¹ y⁻¹ = reciprocalCorrection a h x y

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.exteriorMarkovKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem exteriorMarkovKernel_nonneg {G : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G U) (hi : InjOn G U)
    (hd : ∀ z ∈ U, deriv G z ≠ 0) (hTU : ∀ t : Circle, (t : ℂ) ∈ U)
    (hsupport : ∀ w t : Circle,
      0 ≤ (conj ((t : ℂ)*deriv G t)*(G t-G w)).re) (w t : Circle) :
    0 ≤ exteriorMarkovKernel G w t

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.re_div_eq_support
statement:
lemma re_div_eq_support (N z : ℂ) :
    (N/z).re = (conj N*z).re / normSq z

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.reciprocalCorrection_analytic_left
statement:
lemma reciprocalCorrection_analytic_left {a : ℂ} {h : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hh : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ h U)
    (hne : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, exteriorDividedDifference a h x y ≠ 0)
    {y : ℂ} (hy : y ∈ U) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun x => reciprocalCorrection a h x y) U

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.reciprocalCorrection_analytic_right
statement:
lemma reciprocalCorrection_analytic_right {a : ℂ} {h : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hh : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ h U)
    (hne : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, exteriorDividedDifference a h x y ≠ 0)
    {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (reciprocalCorrection a h x) U

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.reciprocalCorrection_circleAverage_left
statement:
lemma reciprocalCorrection_circleAverage_left {a : ℂ} {h : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hR : 1 < R) (hh : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ h (ball 0 R))
    (hne : ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) R, ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) R,
      exteriorDividedDifference a h x y ≠ 0) {y : ℂ} (hy : y ∈ ball 0 R) :
    Real.circleAverage (fun w => reciprocalCorrection a h w⁻¹ y) 0 1 = 0

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.reciprocalCorrection_circleAverage_right
statement:
lemma reciprocalCorrection_circleAverage_right {a : ℂ} {h : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hR : 1 < R) (hh : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ h (ball 0 R))
    (hne : ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) R, ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) R,
      exteriorDividedDifference a h x y ≠ 0) {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ ball 0 R) :
    Real.circleAverage (fun t => reciprocalCorrection a h x t⁻¹) 0 1 = 0

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.reciprocalCorrection_eq_deriv
statement:
lemma reciprocalCorrection_eq_deriv {a : ℂ} {h : ℂ → ℂ} {x y : ℂ}
    (hy : DifferentiableAt ℂ h y) :
    reciprocalCorrection a h x y =
      x*y*deriv (dslope (fun z => z*h z) x) y / exteriorDividedDifference a h x y

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.reciprocalCorrection_eq_logDeriv
statement:
lemma reciprocalCorrection_eq_logDeriv {a : ℂ} {h : ℂ → ℂ} {x y : ℂ}
    (hx : DifferentiableAt ℂ h x) (hy : DifferentiableAt ℂ h y)
    (hs : DifferentiableAt ℂ (dslope h x) y) :
    reciprocalCorrection a h x y = x*y*(dslope h x y+y*deriv (dslope h x) y) /
      exteriorDividedDifference a h x y

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.reciprocalCorrection_zero_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma reciprocalCorrection_zero_left (a : ℂ) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (y : ℂ) :
    reciprocalCorrection a h 0 y = 0

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.reciprocalCorrection_zero_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma reciprocalCorrection_zero_right (a : ℂ) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (x : ℂ) :

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.two_re_circle_div

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.analyticOnNhd_compact_integral

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.physicalCauchy_analytic
statement:
lemma physicalCauchy_analytic {G : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hG : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G (sphere 0 1))
    {u : UnitAddCircle → ℂ} (hu : Continuous u) {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hne : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ t : UnitAddCircle, G (t.toCircle : ℂ) ≠ z) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (physicalCauchy G u) U

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.physicalCauchy_decompose
statement:
lemma physicalCauchy_decompose {G : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G U) (hi : InjOn G U)
    (hd : ∀ w ∈ U, deriv G w ≠ 0) (hTU : sphere 0 1 ⊆ U)
    {u : UnitAddCircle → ℂ} (hu : Continuous u) {w : ℂ}
    (hw : w ∈ U) (hwin : w ∈ ball 0 1) :
    physicalCauchy G u (G w) =
      (∫ t : UnitAddCircle, u t*((t.toCircle : ℂ)/((t.toCircle : ℂ)-w))
        ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) + cauchyCorrectionIntegral G u w

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.physicalCauchy_inv_pow
statement:
lemma physicalCauchy_inv_pow {G : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G U) (hi : InjOn G U)
    (hd : ∀ w ∈ U, deriv G w ≠ 0) (hTU : sphere 0 1 ⊆ U)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ U) (hwin : w ∈ ball 0 1) :
    physicalCauchy G (fun t => ((t.toCircle : ℂ)⁻¹)^n) (G w) =
      cauchyCorrectionIntegral G (fun t => ((t.toCircle : ℂ)⁻¹)^n) w

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.physicalCauchy_pow
statement:
lemma physicalCauchy_pow {G : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G U) (hi : InjOn G U)
    (hd : ∀ w ∈ U, deriv G w ≠ 0) (hTU : sphere 0 1 ⊆ U)
    (n : ℕ) {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ U) (hwin : w ∈ ball 0 1) :
    physicalCauchy G (fun t => (t.toCircle : ℂ)^n) (G w) =
      w^n + cauchyCorrectionIntegral G (fun t => (t.toCircle : ℂ)^n) w

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.FourierResolution.orthogonal

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.FourierResolution.proj_proj

name: OAI.CompleteCrouzeix.FourierResolution.weighted_adjoint_bound

name: OAI.IndependentProducts.bounded_tree_no_equivalent_auc
statement:
theorem bounded_tree_no_equivalent_auc (P : Vertex → X) (hP : ∀ v, ‖P v‖ = 1)

lemma agg_children_level (f : ι → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :

      e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ (j+1)) f

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.agg_level_zero
statement: lemma agg_level_zero (f : ι → ℝ) : e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ 0) f = |f T.root|

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.ancestorClosure_initial
statement: lemma ancestorClosure_initial (S : Finset ι) : T.Initial (T.ancestorClosure S)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.ancestors_parent_closed
statement:
lemma ancestors_parent_closed (s : ι) {c : ι} (hc : c ∈ T.ancestors s) :
    T.parent c ∈ T.ancestors s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.child_depth
statement: lemma child_depth {s c : ι} (hc : c ∈ T.children s) : T.depth s < T.depth c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.child_measure
statement:
lemma child_measure {s c : ι} (hc : c ∈ T.children s) :
    T.maxDepth - T.depth c < T.maxDepth - T.depth s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.depth_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma depth_eq_zero_iff {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (T : FiniteRootedTree ι)
    (s : ι) : T.depth s = 0 ↔ s = T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.depth_le_maxDepth
statement:
lemma depth_le_maxDepth {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (T : FiniteRootedTree ι)
    (s : ι) : T.depth s ≤ T.maxDepth

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.extend_coe
statement: @[simp] lemma extend_coe (H : Finset ι) (f : H → ℝ) (s : H) : extend H f s.1 = f s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.extend_mem
statement:
lemma extend_mem (H : Finset ι) (f : H → ℝ) {s : ι} (hs : s ∈ H) :
    extend H f s = f ⟨s, hs⟩

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.extend_nonneg
statement:
lemma extend_nonneg (H : Finset ι) (f : H → ℝ) (hf : ∀ s, 0 ≤ f s) (s : ι) :
    0 ≤ extend H f s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.extend_not_mem
statement:
lemma extend_not_mem (H : Finset ι) (f : H → ℝ) {s : ι} (hs : s ∉ H) :
    extend H f s = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.extend_upper
statement:
lemma extend_upper (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H) (f : H → ℝ)
    (hf : (T.restrict H hH).Upper f) : T.GlobalUpper (extend H f)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_difference
statement:
lemma fields_difference (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.fields v s).1 - (T.fields v s).2 = v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_eq
statement:
lemma fields_eq (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.fields v s = leastPair (v s)
      (Real.sqrt (∑ c ∈ T.children s, (T.fields v c).1 ^ 2))
      (Real.sqrt (∑ c ∈ T.children s, (T.fields v c).2 ^ 2))

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_minimal
statement:
theorem fields_minimal (v p q : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hq : ∀ s, 0 ≤ q s)
    (hdiff : ∀ s, p s - q s = v s) (hpU : T.Upper p) (hqU : T.Upper q) (s : ι) :
    (T.fields v s).1 ≤ p s ∧ (T.fields v s).2 ≤ q s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_nonneg
statement:
lemma fields_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    0 ≤ (T.fields v s).1 ∧ 0 ≤ (T.fields v s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_upper
statement:
lemma fields_upper (v : ι → ℝ) :
    T.Upper (fun s => (T.fields v s).1) ∧ T.Upper (fun s => (T.fields v s).2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.head_initial
statement: lemma head_initial (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : T.Initial (T.head v)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.level_empty
statement:
lemma level_empty {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (T : FiniteRootedTree ι) (h : ℕ)
    (hh : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) : T.headLevel Finset.univ (h+1) = ∅

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.level_succ
statement:
lemma level_succ (j : ℕ) :
    T.childrenOf (T.headLevel Finset.univ j) = T.headLevel Finset.univ (j+1)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.level_zero
statement: lemma level_zero : T.headLevel Finset.univ 0 = {T.root}

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.mem_ancestors_self
statement: lemma mem_ancestors_self (s : ι) : s ∈ T.ancestors s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.mem_restrict_children
statement:
lemma mem_restrict_children (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H) (s c : H) :
    c ∈ (T.restrict H hH).children s ↔ c.1 ≠ T.root ∧ T.parent c.1 = s.1

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_add_le
statement: lemma normSum_add_le (v w : ι →₀ ℝ) : T.normSum (v + w) ≤ T.normSum v + T.normSum w

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma normSum_eq_zero_iff (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : T.normSum v = 0 ↔ v = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_neg
statement: lemma normSum_neg (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : T.normSum (-v) = T.normSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_nonneg
statement: lemma normSum_nonneg (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : 0 ≤ T.normSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_smul
statement: lemma normSum_smul (a : ℝ) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : T.normSum (a • v) = |a| * T.normSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_smul_nonneg
statement:
lemma normSum_smul_nonneg (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    T.normSum (a • v) = a * T.normSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma normSum_zero : T.normSum 0 = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pMaximum_bound
statement:
lemma pMaximum_bound (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.pMaximum e v s ≤ |v s| + e.agg (T.children s) (T.pMaximum e v)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pMaximum_level
statement:
lemma pMaximum_level (v : ι → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ j) (T.pMaximum e v) ≤
      e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ j) v + e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ (j+1)) (T.pMaximum e v)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pMaximum_level_sum
statement:
lemma pMaximum_level_sum (v : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    T.pMaximum e v T.root ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ j) v) +
      e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ n) (T.pMaximum e v)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pMaximum_nonneg
statement: lemma pMaximum_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ T.pMaximum e v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_level_lower
statement:
lemma pRootSum_level_lower (v : ι → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ j) v ≤ T.pRootSum e v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_lower_comparison
statement:
lemma pRootSum_lower_comparison (h : ℕ) (hh : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) (v : ι → ℝ) :
    e.agg Finset.univ v ≤ (h+1 : ℝ) ^ (1/e.val) * T.pRootSum e v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_nonneg
statement: lemma pRootSum_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ T.pRootSum p v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_upper_comparison
statement:
lemma pRootSum_upper_comparison (hp : 1 < e.val) (h : ℕ) (hh : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) (v : ι → ℝ) :
    T.pRootSum e v ≤ 2 * (h+1 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 1/e.val) * e.agg Finset.univ v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_difference
statement:
lemma pfields_difference (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p v s).1 - (T.pfields p v s).2 = v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_eq
statement:
lemma pfields_eq (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.pfields p v s = leastPair (v s)
      (p.agg (T.children s) (fun c => (T.pfields p v c).1))
      (p.agg (T.children s) (fun c => (T.pfields p v c).2))

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_minimal
statement:
theorem pfields_minimal (v a b : ι → ℝ) (ha : ∀ s, 0 ≤ a s) (hb : ∀ s, 0 ≤ b s)
    (hdiff : ∀ s, a s - b s = v s) (haU : T.PUpper p a) (hbU : T.PUpper p b) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p v s).1 ≤ a s ∧ (T.pfields p v s).2 ≤ b s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_nonneg
statement:
lemma pfields_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    0 ≤ (T.pfields p v s).1 ∧ 0 ≤ (T.pfields p v s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_upper
statement:
lemma pfields_upper (v : ι → ℝ) :
    T.PUpper p (fun s => (T.pfields p v s).1) ∧ T.PUpper p (fun s => (T.pfields p v s).2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_add_le
statement:
lemma potentials_add_le (v w : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.P (v + w) s ≤ T.P v s + T.P w s ∧ T.Q (v + w) s ≤ T.Q v s + T.Q w s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_minimal
statement:
lemma potentials_minimal (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (p q : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hq : ∀ s, 0 ≤ q s) (hdiff : ∀ s, p s - q s = v s)
    (hpU : T.GlobalUpper p) (hqU : T.GlobalUpper q) (s : ι) :
    T.P v s ≤ p s ∧ T.Q v s ≤ q s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_neg
statement:
lemma potentials_neg (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.P (-v) s = T.Q v s ∧ T.Q (-v) s = T.P v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_smul_le
statement:
lemma potentials_smul_le (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.P (a • v) s ≤ a * T.P v s ∧ T.Q (a • v) s ≤ a * T.Q v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_smul_nonneg
statement:
lemma potentials_smul_nonneg (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.P (a • v) s = a * T.P v s ∧ T.Q (a • v) s = a * T.Q v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_zero
statement: lemma potentials_zero (s : ι) : T.P 0 s = 0 ∧ T.Q 0 s = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.projectHead_apply
statement:
lemma projectHead_apply (H : Finset ι) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.projectHead H v s = if s ∈ H then v s else 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.projectHead_bound
statement:
lemma projectHead_bound (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    T.normSum (T.projectHead H v) ≤ T.normSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.subset_ancestorClosure
statement: lemma subset_ancestorClosure (S : Finset ι) : S ⊆ T.ancestorClosure S

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_children_on
statement:
lemma sum_children_on (S : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ s ∈ S, ∑ c ∈ T.children s, f c = ∑ c ∈ T.childrenOf S, f c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_level_rpow
statement:
lemma sum_level_rpow {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (T : FiniteRootedTree ι)
    (e : ChildExponent) (h : ℕ) (hh : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) (v : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (h+1), e.agg (T.headLevel Finset.univ j) v ^ e.val) = e.agg Finset.univ v ^ e.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_restrict_children
statement:
lemma sum_restrict_children (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H) (s : H) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ c ∈ (T.restrict H hH).children s, f c.1 =
      ∑ c ∈ H.filter (fun c => c ≠ T.root ∧ T.parent c = s.1), f c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.support_subset_head
statement: lemma support_subset_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : v.support ⊆ T.head v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.zero_off_head
statement: lemma zero_off_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) {s : ι} (hs : s ∉ T.head v) : v s = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Variable.component_height
statement: lemma component_height (h : ℕ+) (c : ComponentNode h) : (componentTree h).depth c ≤ h.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.Variable.component_step
statement:
lemma component_step (h : ℕ+) (c : ComponentNode h) (hc : c ≠ (componentTree h).root) :
    (componentTree h).depth c = (componentTree h).depth ((componentTree h).parent c) + 1

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.heightExponent_gt_one
statement: lemma heightExponent_gt_one (h : ℕ+) : 1 < heightExponent h

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.GlobalUpper.add
statement:
lemma GlobalUpper.add {ι : Type uIndex} [DecidableEq ι] (T : FiniteRootedTree ι) (e : ChildExponent)
    {f g : ι → ℝ} (hf : GlobalUpper T e f) (hg : GlobalUpper T e g) (_hf0 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ f s)
    (_hg0 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ g s) : GlobalUpper T e (f+g)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.GlobalUpper.le_root
statement:
lemma GlobalUpper.le_root {f : ι → ℝ} (hf : GlobalUpper T e f)
    (_hf0 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ f s) (s : ι) : f s ≤ f T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.GlobalUpper.restrict
statement:
lemma GlobalUpper.restrict {f : ι → ℝ} (hf : GlobalUpper T e f) (H : Finset ι)
    (hH : T.Initial H) : (T.restrict H hH).PUpper e (fun s => f s.1)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.GlobalUpper.smul
statement:
lemma GlobalUpper.smul {ι : Type uIndex} [DecidableEq ι] (T : FiniteRootedTree ι)
    (e : ChildExponent) {f : ι → ℝ} (hf : GlobalUpper T e f) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    GlobalUpper T e (a • f)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.P_nonneg
statement: lemma P_nonneg (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ P T e v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.P_sub_Q
statement: lemma P_sub_Q (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) : P T e v s - Q T e v s = v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.P_upper
statement: lemma P_upper (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : GlobalUpper T e (P T e v)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.Q_nonneg
statement: lemma Q_nonneg (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ Q T e v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.Q_upper
statement: lemma Q_upper (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : GlobalUpper T e (Q T e v)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.abs_coordinate_le_normSum
statement: lemma abs_coordinate_le_normSum (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) : |v s| ≤ normSum T e v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.extend_upper
statement:
lemma extend_upper (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H) (f : H → ℝ)
    (hf : (T.restrict H hH).PUpper e f) : GlobalUpper T e (extend H f)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.normSum_add_le
statement: lemma normSum_add_le (v w : ι →₀ ℝ) : normSum T e (v + w) ≤ normSum T e v + normSum T e w

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.normSum_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma normSum_eq_zero_iff (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : normSum T e v = 0 ↔ v = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.normSum_neg
statement: lemma normSum_neg (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : normSum T e (-v) = normSum T e v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.normSum_nonneg
statement: lemma normSum_nonneg (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : 0 ≤ normSum T e v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.normSum_on_head
statement:
lemma normSum_on_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hv : v.support ⊆ H) : normSum T e v = (T.restrict H hH).pRootSum e (fun s => v s.1)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.normSum_smul
statement: lemma normSum_smul (a : ℝ) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) : normSum T e (a • v) = |a| * normSum T e v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.normSum_smul_nonneg
statement:
lemma normSum_smul_nonneg (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    normSum T e (a • v) = a * normSum T e v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.normSum_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma normSum_zero : normSum T e 0 = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_add_le
statement:
lemma potentials_add_le (v w : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    P T e (v + w) s ≤ P T e v s + P T e w s ∧ Q T e (v + w) s ≤ Q T e v s + Q T e w s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_minimal
statement:
lemma potentials_minimal (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (p q : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hq : ∀ s, 0 ≤ q s) (hdiff : ∀ s, p s - q s = v s)
    (hpU : GlobalUpper T e p) (hqU : GlobalUpper T e q) (s : ι) :
    P T e v s ≤ p s ∧ Q T e v s ≤ q s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_neg
statement:
lemma potentials_neg (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    P T e (-v) s = Q T e v s ∧ Q T e (-v) s = P T e v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_on_head
statement:
theorem potentials_on_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hv : v.support ⊆ H) (s : H) :
    P T e v s.1 = ((T.restrict H hH).pfields e (fun c => v c.1) s).1 ∧
    Q T e v s.1 = ((T.restrict H hH).pfields e (fun c => v c.1) s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_smul_le
statement:
lemma potentials_smul_le (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    P T e (a • v) s ≤ a * P T e v s ∧ Q T e (a • v) s ≤ a * Q T e v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_smul_nonneg
statement:
lemma potentials_smul_nonneg (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    P T e (a • v) s = a * P T e v s ∧ Q T e (a • v) s = a * Q T e v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableTree.potentials_zero
statement: lemma potentials_zero (s : ι) : P T e 0 s = 0 ∧ Q T e 0 s = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.leastPair_difference
statement:
lemma leastPair_difference (x a b : ℝ) :
    (leastPair x a b).1 - (leastPair x a b).2 = x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.leastPair_minimal
statement:
lemma leastPair_minimal {x a b p q : ℝ} (hdiff : p - q = x)
    (hp : a ≤ p) (hq : b ≤ q) :
    (leastPair x a b).1 ≤ p ∧ (leastPair x a b).2 ≤ q

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.leastPair_nonneg
statement:
lemma leastPair_nonneg {x a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    0 ≤ (leastPair x a b).1 ∧ 0 ≤ (leastPair x a b).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.sum_add_sq_le
statement:
lemma sum_add_sq_le {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → ℝ) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hf : ∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2)
    (hg : ∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (f i + g i) ^ 2 ≤ (a + b) ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.CofiniteSubspace.exists_unit
statement:
lemma exists_unit (F : CofiniteSubspace E) (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) :
    ∃ y ∈ F.space, ‖y‖ = 1

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.CofiniteSubspace.nontrivial_space
statement:
lemma nontrivial_space (F : CofiniteSubspace E) (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) :
    Nontrivial F.space

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.Initial.child_not_mem
statement:
lemma Initial.child_not_mem {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) {s c : ι}
    (hs : s ∉ H) (hc : c ∈ T.children s) : c ∉ H

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.P_eq_zero_off_head
statement:
lemma P_eq_zero_off_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hv : v.support ⊆ H) {s : ι} (hs : s ∉ H) : T.P v s = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.Q_eq_zero_off_head
statement:
lemma Q_eq_zero_off_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hv : v.support ⊆ H) {s : ι} (hs : s ∉ H) : T.Q v s = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.Upper.add
statement:
lemma Upper.add {p q : ι → ℝ} (hpU : T.Upper p) (hqU : T.Upper q)
    (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hq : ∀ s, 0 ≤ q s) : T.Upper (fun s => p s + q s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.Upper.le_root
statement:
lemma Upper.le_root {p : ι → ℝ} (hpU : T.Upper p) (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (s : ι) :
    p s ≤ p T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.Upper.smul
statement:
lemma Upper.smul {p : ι → ℝ} (hpU : T.Upper p) (a : ℝ) :
    T.Upper (fun s => a * p s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.abs_coordinate_le_rootSum
statement: lemma abs_coordinate_le_rootSum (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) : |v s| ≤ T.rootSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.ancestorClosure_subset_of_initial
statement:
lemma ancestorClosure_subset_of_initial {S H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (hS : S ⊆ H) :
    T.ancestorClosure S ⊆ H

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.ancestors_subset_of_initial
statement:
lemma ancestors_subset_of_initial {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ H) :
    T.ancestors s ⊆ H

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.averaged_feasible
statement:
lemma averaged_feasible (x z : ι → ℝ) :
    T.Upper (fun s => ((T.fields (x + z) s).1 + (T.fields (x - z) s).1) / 2) ∧
    T.Upper (fun s => ((T.fields (x + z) s).2 + (T.fields (x - z) s).2) / 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.commonRoot_finite_cubic
statement:
theorem commonRoot_finite_cubic {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0)
    (hxroot : x T.root = 0) (hz0 : z ≠ 0) :
    T.rootCommon x + (T.rootCommon z) ^ 3 /
        (8 * (2 * T.rootCommon x + T.rootCommon z) ^ 2) ≤
      (T.rootCommon (x + z) + T.rootCommon (x - z)) / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.defect_energy_step
statement:
lemma defect_energy_step (x z : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.children s, energy (T.fields x c).1 (T.fields x c).2 (T.defect x z c) ≤
      energy (T.fields x s).1 (T.fields x s).2 (T.defect x z s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.defect_nonneg
statement: lemma defect_nonneg (x z : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ T.defect x z s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.defect_off_head
statement:
lemma defect_off_head {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) :
    T.defect x z s = ((T.fields z s).1 + (T.fields z s).2) / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.defect_representation
statement:
lemma defect_representation (x z : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    ((T.fields (x + z) s).1 + (T.fields (x - z) s).1) / 2 =
      (T.fields x s).1 + T.defect x z s ∧
    ((T.fields (x + z) s).2 + (T.fields (x - z) s).2) / 2 =
      (T.fields x s).2 + T.defect x z s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_add_le
statement:
lemma fields_add_le (v w : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.fields (v + w) s).1 ≤ (T.fields v s).1 + (T.fields w s).1 ∧
    (T.fields (v + w) s).2 ≤ (T.fields v s).2 + (T.fields w s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_eq_off_head
statement:
theorem fields_eq_off_head {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hvw : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = w s) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) :
    T.fields v s = T.fields w s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_head_zero
statement:
lemma fields_head_zero {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = 0) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) : T.fields v s = (0, 0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_neg
statement:
lemma fields_neg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.fields (-v) s = ((T.fields v s).2, (T.fields v s).1)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_smul
statement:
lemma fields_smul (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.fields (a • v) s = (a * (T.fields v s).1, a * (T.fields v s).2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_smul_le
statement:
lemma fields_smul_le (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.fields (a • v) s).1 ≤ a * (T.fields v s).1 ∧
    (T.fields (a • v) s).2 ≤ a * (T.fields v s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_tight
statement:
lemma fields_tight (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (∑ c ∈ T.children s, (T.fields v c).1 ^ 2 = (T.fields v s).1 ^ 2) ∨
    (∑ c ∈ T.children s, (T.fields v c).2 ^ 2 = (T.fields v s).2 ^ 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_zero
statement: lemma fields_zero (s : ι) : T.fields (fun _ => 0) s = (0, 0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.max_fields_sq_le_children
statement:
lemma max_fields_sq_le_children (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) (hv : v s = 0) :
    (max (T.fields v s).1 (T.fields v s).2) ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ c ∈ T.children s, (max (T.fields v c).1 (T.fields v c).2) ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_cubic
statement:
theorem normSum_cubic (x z : ι →₀ ℝ) {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hx : x.support ⊆ H) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0) :
    (T.normSum z) ^ 3 ≤ 8 * T.meanExcess x z *
      (2 * T.normSum x + T.meanExcess x z) ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_on_head
statement:
lemma normSum_on_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hv : v.support ⊆ H) : T.normSum v = (T.restrict H hH).rootSum (fun s => v s.1)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_le_normSum
statement:
lemma potentials_le_normSum (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.P v s ≤ T.normSum v ∧ T.Q v s ≤ T.normSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_lipschitz
statement:
lemma potentials_lipschitz (v w : ι →₀ ℝ) (s : ι) :
    |T.P v s - T.P w s| ≤ T.normSum (v - w) ∧
    |T.Q v s - T.Q w s| ≤ T.normSum (v - w)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.potentials_on_head
statement:
theorem potentials_on_head (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (H : Finset ι) (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hv : v.support ⊆ H) (s : H) :
    T.P v s.1 = ((T.restrict H hH).fields (fun c => v c.1) s).1 ∧
    T.Q v s.1 = ((T.restrict H hH).fields (fun c => v c.1) s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.restrict_initial
statement:
lemma restrict_initial (K : Finset ι) (hK : T.Initial K) (H : Finset ι)
    (hH : T.Initial H) :
    (T.restrict K hK).Initial (Finset.univ.filter (fun s : K => s.1 ∈ H))

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootCommon_eq_half_sum
statement:
lemma rootCommon_eq_half_sum (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : v T.root = 0) :
    T.rootCommon v = T.rootSum v / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_add_le
statement: lemma rootSum_add_le (v w : ι → ℝ) : T.rootSum (v + w) ≤ T.rootSum v + T.rootSum w

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_cubic
statement:
theorem rootSum_cubic {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0) :
    (T.rootSum z) ^ 3 ≤ 64 * T.defect x z T.root *
      (T.rootSum x + T.defect x z T.root) ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_defect
statement:
lemma rootSum_defect (x z : ι → ℝ) :
    (T.rootSum (x + z) + T.rootSum (x - z)) / 2 =
      T.rootSum x + 2 * T.defect x z T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_eq_twice_max_of_root_zero
statement:
lemma rootSum_eq_twice_max_of_root_zero (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : v T.root = 0) :
    T.rootSum v = 2 * max (T.fields v T.root).1 (T.fields v T.root).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_finite_midpoint_gap
statement:
theorem rootSum_finite_midpoint_gap {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0)
    (hunit : T.rootSum x = 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1)
    (hzt : t ≤ T.rootSum z) :
    1 + t ^ 3 / 128 ≤ (T.rootSum (x + z) + T.rootSum (x - z)) / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma rootSum_neg (v : ι → ℝ) : T.rootSum (-v) = T.rootSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_nonneg
statement: lemma rootSum_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ T.rootSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_pos
statement: lemma rootSum_pos {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 < T.rootSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_smul_nonneg
statement:
lemma rootSum_smul_nonneg (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (v : ι → ℝ) :
    T.rootSum (a • v) = a * T.rootSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.rootSum_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma rootSum_zero : T.rootSum (fun _ => 0) = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.root_mem_ancestors
statement: lemma root_mem_ancestors (s : ι) : T.root ∈ T.ancestors s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_children
statement:
lemma sum_children (e : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ s, ∑ c ∈ T.children s, e c = ∑ c ∈ Finset.univ.erase T.root, e c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_leaves_le_root
statement:
lemma sum_leaves_le_root (e : ι → ℝ)
    (he : ∀ s, ∑ c ∈ T.children s, e c ≤ e s) :
    ∑ b ∈ T.leaves, e b ≤ e T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.tail_energy
statement:
theorem tail_energy {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (x z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hz : ∀ s ∈ H, z s = 0) (s : ι) :
    (max (T.fields z s).1 (T.fields z s).2) ^ 2 ≤
      4 * energy (T.fields x s).1 (T.fields x s).2 (T.defect x z s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.two_field_energy
statement:
theorem two_field_energy (p q d : ι → ℝ) (J : Finset ι) (hJ : J ⊆ T.leaves)
    (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hq : ∀ s, 0 ≤ q s) (hd : ∀ s, 0 ≤ d s)
    (hpU : T.Upper p) (hqU : T.Upper q)
    (hp'U : T.Upper (fun s => p s + d s))
    (hq'U : T.Upper (fun s => q s + d s))
    (htight : ∀ s, (T.children s).Nonempty →
      (∑ c ∈ T.children s, p c ^ 2 = p s ^ 2) ∨
      (∑ c ∈ T.children s, q c ^ 2 = q s ^ 2))
    (_hzero : ∀ b ∈ J, p b = 0 ∧ q b = 0) :
    ∑ b ∈ J, d b ^ 2 ≤ energy (p T.root) (q T.root) (d T.root)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.two_field_energy_all_leaves
statement:
theorem two_field_energy_all_leaves (p q d : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hq : ∀ s, 0 ≤ q s) (hd : ∀ s, 0 ≤ d s)
    (hpU : T.Upper p) (hqU : T.Upper q)
    (hp'U : T.Upper (fun s => p s + d s))
    (hq'U : T.Upper (fun s => q s + d s))
    (htight : ∀ s, (T.children s).Nonempty →
      (∑ c ∈ T.children s, p c ^ 2 = p s ^ 2) ∨
      (∑ c ∈ T.children s, q c ^ 2 = q s ^ 2)) :
    ∑ b ∈ T.leaves, d b ^ 2 ≤ energy (p T.root) (q T.root) (d T.root)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.P_coe
statement: @[simp] lemma P_coe (s : ι) (v : TreeVector T) : P T s (v : TreeSpace T) = T.P v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.P_nonneg
statement: lemma P_nonneg (s : ι) (x : TreeSpace T) : 0 ≤ P T s x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.Q_coe
statement: @[simp] lemma Q_coe (s : ι) (v : TreeVector T) : Q T s (v : TreeSpace T) = T.Q v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.Q_nonneg
statement: lemma Q_nonneg (s : ι) (x : TreeSpace T) : 0 ≤ Q T s x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.averaged_modulus_cubic
statement:
theorem averaged_modulus_cubic [Infinite ι] {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    t ^ 3 / 128 ≤ averagedModulus (TreeSpace T) t

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.continuous_P
statement: @[continuity, fun_prop] lemma continuous_P (s : ι) : Continuous (P T s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.continuous_Q
statement: @[continuity, fun_prop] lemma continuous_Q (s : ι) : Continuous (Q T s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.continuous_meanExcess
statement:
@[continuity, fun_prop] lemma continuous_meanExcess :
    Continuous (fun p : TreeSpace T × TreeSpace T => meanExcess T p.1 p.2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.meanExcess_coe
statement:
@[simp] lemma meanExcess_coe (x z : TreeVector T) :
    meanExcess T (x : TreeSpace T) (z : TreeSpace T) = T.meanExcess x z

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.meanExcess_le
statement: lemma meanExcess_le (x z : TreeSpace T) : meanExcess T x z ≤ ‖z‖

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.meanExcess_nonneg
statement: lemma meanExcess_nonneg (x z : TreeSpace T) : 0 ≤ meanExcess T x z

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeSpace.norm_eq
statement: theorem norm_eq (x : TreeSpace T) : ‖x‖ = P T T.root x + Q T T.root x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeVector.basisVector_apply
statement: lemma basisVector_apply (s c : ι) : basisVector T s c = if s = c then 1 else 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeVector.lipschitz_P
statement: lemma lipschitz_P (s : ι) : LipschitzWith 1 (fun v : TreeVector T => T.P v s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeVector.lipschitz_Q
statement: lemma lipschitz_Q (s : ι) : LipschitzWith 1 (fun v : TreeVector T => T.Q v s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.TreeVector.norm_def
statement: lemma norm_def (v : TreeVector T) : ‖v‖ = T.normSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.averagedGain_lower
statement: lemma averagedGain_lower (x : E) (t : ℝ) (y : E) : ‖x‖ - 1 ≤ averagedGain x t y

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.averagedInner_bddBelow
statement:
lemma averagedInner_bddBelow (x : E) (t : ℝ) (F : CofiniteSubspace E) :
    BddBelow {r : ℝ | ∃ y ∈ F.space, 1 ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ r = averagedGain x t y}

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.averagedInner_le
statement:
lemma averagedInner_le (x : E) (hx : ‖x‖ = 1) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (F : CofiniteSubspace E) (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) : averagedInner x t F ≤ t

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.averagedInner_nonempty
statement:
lemma averagedInner_nonempty (x : E) (t : ℝ) (F : CofiniteSubspace E)
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) :
    {r : ℝ | ∃ y ∈ F.space, 1 ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ r = averagedGain x t y}.Nonempty

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.averagedModulus_lower_of_witness
statement:
theorem averagedModulus_lower_of_witness (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E)
    {t c : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hw : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ F : CofiniteSubspace E, ∀ y ∈ F.space, 1 ≤ ‖y‖ → c - ε ≤ averagedGain x t y) :
    c ≤ averagedModulus E t

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.cube_le_of_sq_le_energy
statement:
lemma cube_le_of_sq_le_energy {r k p q d : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (h : r ^ 2 ≤ k ^ 2 * energy p q d) :
    r ^ 3 ≤ k ^ 3 * (d * (2 * p + d) * (2 * q + d))

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_factor
statement:
lemma energy_factor {p q d : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    energy p q d =
      (d * (2 * p + d)) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * ((2 * q + d) ^ 2) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_nonneg
statement:
lemma energy_nonneg {p q d : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    0 ≤ energy p q d

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_rpow_three_halves
statement:
lemma energy_rpow_three_halves {p q d : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    (energy p q d) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = d * (2 * p + d) * (2 * q + d)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_step
statement:
lemma energy_step {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (p q d : ι → ℝ)
    {P Q D : ℝ} (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) (hq : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i)
    (hd : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ d i)
    (hPupper : ∑ i ∈ s, p i ^ 2 ≤ P ^ 2)
    (hQupper : ∑ i ∈ s, q i ^ 2 ≤ Q ^ 2)
    (hPupper' : ∑ i ∈ s, (p i + d i) ^ 2 ≤ (P + D) ^ 2)
    (hQupper' : ∑ i ∈ s, (q i + d i) ^ 2 ≤ (Q + D) ^ 2)
    (htight : (∑ i ∈ s, p i ^ 2 = P ^ 2) ∨ (∑ i ∈ s, q i ^ 2 = Q ^ 2)) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, energy (p i) (q i) (d i) ≤ energy P Q D

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_step_first
statement:
lemma energy_step_first {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (p q d : ι → ℝ)
    {P Q D : ℝ} (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) (hq : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ q i)
    (hd : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ d i)
    (hPtight : ∑ i ∈ s, p i ^ 2 = P ^ 2)
    (hQupper : ∑ i ∈ s, q i ^ 2 ≤ Q ^ 2)
    (hPupper' : ∑ i ∈ s, (p i + d i) ^ 2 ≤ (P + D) ^ 2)
    (hQupper' : ∑ i ∈ s, (q i + d i) ^ 2 ≤ (Q + D) ^ 2) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, energy (p i) (q i) (d i) ≤ energy P Q D

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_symm
statement: lemma energy_symm (p q d : ℝ) : energy p q d = energy q p d

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.energy_zero_base
statement: lemma energy_zero_base {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) : energy 0 0 d = d ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.holder_two_thirds
statement:
lemma holder_two_thirds {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (u v : ι → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ u i) (hv : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ v i) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (u i) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (v i) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, u i) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ s, v i) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.leastPair_tight
statement:
lemma leastPair_tight (x a b : ℝ) :
    (leastPair x a b).1 = a ∨ (leastPair x a b).2 = b

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.sq_rpow_three_halves
statement:
lemma sq_rpow_three_halves {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (a ^ 2) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = a ^ 3

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.GlobalUpper.zero
statement:
lemma GlobalUpper.zero {ι : Type uIndex} [DecidableEq ι] (T : FiniteRootedTree ι) :
    T.GlobalUpper (0 : ι → ℝ)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.attached_upper
statement:
lemma attached_upper (s : ι) (b : ι → ℝ) (hb0 : ∀ c, 0 ≤ b c)
    (hb : ∀ c, b c ≠ 0 → c ≠ T.root ∧ T.parent c = s)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hsq : ∀ S : Finset ι, ∑ c ∈ S, b c ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2) :
    T.GlobalUpper (fun c => R * T.path s c + b c)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.child_function_zero_on_ancestors
statement:
lemma child_function_zero_on_ancestors (s : ι) (b : ι → ℝ)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.child_not_mem_ancestors
statement:
lemma child_not_mem_ancestors {s c : ι} (hc : c ≠ T.root) (hp : T.parent c = s) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.cutPath_root
statement: lemma cutPath_root (s : ι) : T.cutPath s T.root = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.cutPath_step
statement:
lemma cutPath_step (c : ι) (hc : c ≠ T.root) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.depth_le_of_mem_ancestors
statement:
lemma depth_le_of_mem_ancestors (s : ι) {c : ι} (hc : c ∈ T.ancestors s) :
