name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_cutPath
statement: lemma normSum_cutPath (s : ι) (hs : s ≠ T.root) : T.normSum (T.cutPath s) = 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_path
statement: lemma normSum_path (s : ι) : T.normSum (T.path s) = 1

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_siblings_le
statement:
theorem normSum_siblings_le (s : ι) (v : ι →₀ ℝ)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_single

lemma normSum_single (c : ι) (hc : c ≠ T.root) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.parent_ancestors_injective

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.path_apply
statement: lemma path_apply (s c : ι) : T.path s c = if c ∈ T.ancestors s then 1 else 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.path_fields
statement: theorem path_fields (s c : ι) : T.P (T.path s) c = T.path s c ∧ T.Q (T.path s) c = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.path_nonneg
statement: lemma path_nonneg (s c : ι) : 0 ≤ T.path s c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.path_root
statement: lemma path_root (s : ι) : T.path s T.root = 1

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.path_step
statement:
lemma path_step (c : ι) (hc : c ≠ T.root) :

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.path_upper
statement: lemma path_upper (s : ι) : T.GlobalUpper (T.path s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.positivePart_sq_le
statement: lemma positivePart_sq_le (a : ℝ) : max a 0 ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_sq_le_support
statement:
lemma sum_sq_le_support (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    ∑ c ∈ S, v c ^ 2 ≤ ∑ c ∈ v.support, v c ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.twice_coordinate_le_normSum
statement:
lemma twice_coordinate_le_normSum (v : ι →₀ ℝ) (hv : v T.root = 0) (s : ι) :
    2 * |v s| ≤ T.normSum v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.XJoined_averaged_modulus
statement:
theorem XJoined_averaged_modulus {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    t ^ 3 / 128 ≤ averagedModulus XJoined t

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.XSigma_averaged_modulus
statement:
theorem XSigma_averaged_modulus {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    t ^ 3 / 128 ≤ averagedModulus XSigma t

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.bounded_tree_step
statement:
lemma bounded_tree_step (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) {u : E} (hu : u ≠ 0)
    (d : ℕ → E) (hd : WeaklyNull d) {M c γ : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (huM : ‖u‖ ≤ M) (hdc : ∀ k, c ≤ ‖d k‖) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hmod : γ < A.modulus (A.lower * c / (2 * A.upper * M))) :
    ∃ k, (1 + γ / 2) * A.N u ≤ A.N (u + d k)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.continuous
statement: lemma continuous : Continuous A.N

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma eq_zero_iff (x : E) : A.N x = 0 ↔ x = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.exists_unit
statement:
lemma exists_unit (F : CofiniteSubspace E) (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) :
    ∃ y ∈ F.space, A.N y = 1

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.extend_radius
statement:
lemma extend_radius {x y : E} (hx : A.N x = 1) (_hy : A.N y = 1)
    {t r γ : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (htr : t ≤ r) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hg : 1 + γ ≤ A.N (x + t • y)) : 1 + γ ≤ A.N (x + r • y)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.inner_bddBelow
statement:
lemma inner_bddBelow (x : E) (t : ℝ) (F : CofiniteSubspace E) :
    BddBelow {r : ℝ | ∃ y ∈ F.space, A.N y = 1 ∧ r = A.N (x + t • y) - 1}

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.inner_lower
statement:
lemma inner_lower (x : E) (t : ℝ) (F : CofiniteSubspace E)
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) : -1 ≤ A.inner x t F

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.inner_nonempty
statement:
lemma inner_nonempty (x : E) (t : ℝ) (F : CofiniteSubspace E)
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) :
    {r : ℝ | ∃ y ∈ F.space, A.N y = 1 ∧ r = A.N (x + t • y) - 1}.Nonempty

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.inner_upper
statement:
lemma inner_upper {x : E} (hx : A.N x = 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (F : CofiniteSubspace E) (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) : A.inner x t F ≤ t

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.lipschitz_estimate
statement: lemma lipschitz_estimate (x y : E) : |A.N x - A.N y| ≤ A.upper * ‖x - y‖

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.long_perturbation
statement:
lemma long_perturbation {u w : E} (hu : u ≠ 0) {t γ : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (F : CofiniteSubspace E) (hw : w ∈ F.space) (hwn : t * A.N u ≤ A.N w)
    (hF : ∀ y ∈ F.space, A.N y = 1 →
      1 + γ ≤ A.N ((A.N u)⁻¹ • u + t • y)) :
    (1 + γ) * A.N u ≤ A.N (u + w)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.modulus_le_sup
statement:
lemma modulus_le_sup {x : E} (hx : A.N x = 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) : A.modulus t ≤ sSup (Set.range (A.inner x t))

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.modulus_nonneg
statement: lemma modulus_nonneg (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : 0 ≤ A.modulus t

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.nonneg
statement: lemma nonneg (x : E) : 0 ≤ A.N x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.norming_functional
statement:
lemma norming_functional {x : E} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ f : E →L[ℝ] ℝ, f x = A.N x ∧ ∀ y, ‖f y‖ ≤ A.N y

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.pos
statement: lemma pos {x : E} (hx : x ≠ 0) : 0 < A.N x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.sub_le
statement: lemma sub_le (x y : E) : A.N x - A.N y ≤ A.N (x - y)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.upper_pos
statement: lemma upper_pos : 0 < A.upper

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.EquivalentNorm.witness
statement:
lemma witness {t γ : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hγ : γ < A.modulus t)
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) (x : E) (hx : A.N x = 1) :
    ∃ F : CofiniteSubspace E, ∀ y ∈ F.space, A.N y = 1 →
      1 + γ ≤ A.N (x + t • y)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.normSum_emb_siblings
statement:
lemma normSum_emb_siblings (s : ι) (f : ℕ ↪ ι)
    (hf : ∀ k, f k ≠ T.root ∧ T.parent (f k) = s) (a : ℕ →₀ ℝ) :
    T.normSum (a.embDomain f) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (∑ k ∈ a.support, a k ^ 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.WeaklyNull.approximate_cofinite
statement:
lemma WeaklyNull.approximate_cofinite {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {d : ℕ → E} (hd : WeaklyNull d) (F : CofiniteSubspace E) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∃ w ∈ F.space, ‖d k - w‖ < ε

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.WeaklyNull.quotient_tendsto
statement:
lemma WeaklyNull.quotient_tendsto {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {d : ℕ → E} (hd : WeaklyNull d) (F : CofiniteSubspace E) :
    Tendsto (fun k => F.space.mkQL (d k)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.bounded_trees_modulus_eq_zero
statement:
theorem bounded_trees_modulus_eq_zero {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) (A : EquivalentNorm E) (u : ℕ → List ℕ → E)
    {m M c : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 0 < M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hu : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length ≤ h → m ≤ ‖u h s‖ ∧ ‖u h s‖ ≤ M)
    (hd : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      WeaklyNull (fun k => u h (s ++ [k]) - u h s))
    (hdc : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      ∀ k, c ≤ ‖u h (s ++ [k]) - u h s‖) :
    A.modulus (A.lower * c / (2 * A.upper * M)) = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.bounded_trees_modulus_le_zero
statement:
theorem bounded_trees_modulus_le_zero {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) (A : EquivalentNorm E) (u : ℕ → List ℕ → E)
    {m M c : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 0 < M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hu : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length ≤ h → m ≤ ‖u h s‖ ∧ ‖u h s‖ ≤ M)
    (hd : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      WeaklyNull (fun k => u h (s ++ [k]) - u h s))
    (hdc : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      ∀ k, c ≤ ‖u h (s ++ [k]) - u h s‖) :
    A.modulus (A.lower * c / (2 * A.upper * M)) ≤ 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.bounded_trees_not_AUC
statement:
theorem bounded_trees_not_AUC {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (hE : ¬Module.Finite ℝ E) (A : EquivalentNorm E) (u : ℕ → List ℕ → E)
    {m M c : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hM : 0 < M) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hu : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length ≤ h → m ≤ ‖u h s‖ ∧ ‖u h s‖ ≤ M)
    (hd : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      WeaklyNull (fun k => u h (s ++ [k]) - u h s))
    (hdc : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h → ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      ∀ k, c ≤ ‖u h (s ++ [k]) - u h s‖) : ¬A.AUC

lemma joinedChildren_spec (h : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) (hs : s.length < h) (k : ℕ) :

lemma joinedNode_parent (h : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) (hs : s.length < h) (k : ℕ) :

statement:
lemma sequenceChildren_spec (s : List ℕ) (k : ℕ) :

statement:
lemma weaklyNull_of_finsupp_bound {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (L : (ℕ →₀ ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] E) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.weaklyNull_of_square_sum_bound
statement:
lemma weaklyNull_of_square_sum_bound {E : Type uSpace} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (d : ℕ → E) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (h : ∀ (S : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ),

statement:

statement:
lemma block_square_comparison (v : ι → ℝ) (h : ℕ) (hh : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) :
    ((max (T.fields v T.root).1 (T.fields v T.root).2) ^ 2 ≤
      ((h : ℝ) + 1) * ∑ s, v s ^ 2) ∧
    ((∑ s, v s ^ 2) ≤ 4 * ((h : ℝ) + 1) *
      (max (T.fields v T.root).1 (T.fields v T.root).2) ^ 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.descEnergy_eq
statement:
lemma descEnergy_eq (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.descEnergy v s = v s ^ 2 + ∑ c ∈ T.children s, T.descEnergy v c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.descEnergy_nonneg
statement: lemma descEnergy_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ T.descEnergy v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.descEnergy_root
statement: lemma descEnergy_root (v : ι → ℝ) : T.descEnergy v T.root = ∑ s, v s ^ 2

statement:
lemma max_fields_le (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    max (T.fields v s).1 (T.fields v s).2 ≤
      |v s| + Real.sqrt (∑ c ∈ T.children s, (max (T.fields v c).1 (T.fields v c).2) ^ 2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.max_fields_square_le
statement:
lemma max_fields_square_le (v : ι → ℝ) (h : ℕ) (hh : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) (s : ι) :
    (max (T.fields v s).1 (T.fields v s).2) ^ 2 ≤
      ((h : ℝ) + 1 - T.depth s) * T.descEnergy v s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.upper_sum_square_le
statement:
lemma upper_sum_square_le {p : ι → ℝ} (hp : T.Upper p) (h : ℕ)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.weighted_sum_children
statement:
lemma weighted_sum_children (w e : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ s, w s * ∑ c ∈ T.children s, e c =
      ∑ c ∈ Finset.univ.erase T.root, w (T.parent c) * e c

statement: lemma norm_center_le {x y : E} {R : ℝ} (hp : ‖x+y‖ ≤ R) (hm : ‖x-y‖ ≤ R) : ‖x‖ ≤ R

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.norm_perturbation_le
statement: lemma norm_perturbation_le {x y : E} {R : ℝ} (hp : ‖x+y‖ ≤ R) (hm : ‖x-y‖ ≤ R) : ‖y‖ ≤ R

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.ChildExponent.agg_le_iff
statement:
lemma agg_le_iff {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    p.agg s f ≤ a ↔ (∑ i ∈ s, |f i| ^ p.val) ≤ a ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.ChildExponent.agg_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma agg_neg {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ) : p.agg s (-f) = p.agg s f

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.PUpper.add
statement:
lemma PUpper.add {a b : ι → ℝ} (ha : T.PUpper p a) (hb : T.PUpper p b) :
    T.PUpper p (a+b)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.PUpper.le_root
statement: lemma PUpper.le_root {a : ι → ℝ} (ha : T.PUpper p a) (s : ι) : a s ≤ a T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.PUpper.smul
statement:
lemma PUpper.smul {a : ι → ℝ} (ha : T.PUpper p a) {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 ≤ k) :
    T.PUpper p (fun s => k * a s)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.PUpper.zero
statement: lemma PUpper.zero : T.PUpper p (fun _ => 0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.exists_tight_label
statement:
lemma exists_tight_label (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    ∃ b : Bool, T.pField p v b s ^ p.val = ∑ c ∈ T.children s, T.pField p v b c ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.exitCut_succ
statement:
lemma exitCut_succ {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1) (j : ℕ) :
    T.exitCut H (j+1) = T.childrenOf (T.headLevel H j) ∪ T.stoppedExit H j

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.exitCut_succ_disjoint
OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.exitCut_zero
statement: lemma exitCut_zero {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) : T.exitCut H 0 = {T.root}

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_cut_mass
statement:
lemma fields_cut_mass {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (v : ι → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    ∑ s ∈ T.exitCut H j, (T.pField p v true s ^ p.val + T.pField p v false s ^ p.val) ≤
      T.pRootSum p v ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.fields_subcut_mass
statement:
lemma fields_subcut_mass {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (v : ι → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (S : Finset ι) (hS : S ⊆ T.exitCut H j) :
    ∑ s ∈ S, (T.pField p v true s ^ p.val + T.pField p v false s ^ p.val) ≤
      T.pRootSum p v ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.headLevel_stopped_disjoint
statement:
lemma headLevel_stopped_disjoint (H : Finset ι) (j : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (T.headLevel H j) (T.stoppedExit H j)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pField_nonneg
statement: lemma pField_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) (b : Bool) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ T.pField p v b s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pField_power_sum_le_norm
statement:
lemma pField_power_sum_le_norm (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.pField p v true s ^ p.val + T.pField p v false s ^ p.val ≤
      ((T.pfields p v s).1 + (T.pfields p v s).2) ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pField_power_upper
statement:
lemma pField_power_upper (v : ι → ℝ) (b : Bool) (s : ι) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.children s, T.pField p v b c ^ p.val ≤ T.pField p v b s ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_add_le
statement: lemma pRootSum_add_le (v w : ι → ℝ) : T.pRootSum p (v+w) ≤ T.pRootSum p v + T.pRootSum p w

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_coordinate
statement: lemma pRootSum_coordinate (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) : |v s| ≤ T.pRootSum p v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma pRootSum_neg (v : ι → ℝ) : T.pRootSum p (-v) = T.pRootSum p v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_smul_nonneg
statement:
lemma pRootSum_smul_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    T.pRootSum p (a • v) = a * T.pRootSum p v

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_tail_midpoint
statement:
lemma pRootSum_tail_midpoint (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    T.pRootSum p y ≤ (T.pRootSum p (x+y) + T.pRootSum p (x-y)) / 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pRootSum_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma pRootSum_zero : T.pRootSum p (fun _ => 0) = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_add_le
statement:
lemma pfields_add_le (v w : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p (v+w) s).1 ≤ (T.pfields p v s).1 + (T.pfields p w s).1 ∧
    (T.pfields p (v+w) s).2 ≤ (T.pfields p v s).2 + (T.pfields p w s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_eq_off_head
statement:
lemma pfields_eq_off_head {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hvw : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = w s) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) : T.pfields p v s = T.pfields p w s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_head_le
statement:
lemma pfields_head_le {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v w : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = 0) (hvw : ∀ s ∈ H, v s = w s) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p v s).1 ≤ (T.pfields p w s).1 ∧ (T.pfields p v s).2 ≤ (T.pfields p w s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_head_zero
statement:
lemma pfields_head_zero {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H) (v : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ s ∉ H, v s = 0) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) : T.pfields p v s = (0,0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_neg
statement:
lemma pfields_neg (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.pfields p (-v) s = ((T.pfields p v s).2, (T.pfields p v s).1)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_smul
statement:
lemma pfields_smul (v : ι → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (s : ι) :
    T.pfields p (a • v) s = (a * (T.pfields p v s).1, a * (T.pfields p v s).2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_smul_le
statement:
lemma pfields_smul_le (v : ι → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p (a • v) s).1 ≤ a * (T.pfields p v s).1 ∧
    (T.pfields p (a • v) s).2 ≤ a * (T.pfields p v s).2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_tight
statement:
lemma pfields_tight (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    (T.pfields p v s).1 = p.agg (T.children s) (fun c => (T.pfields p v c).1) ∨
    (T.pfields p v s).2 = p.agg (T.children s) (fun c => (T.pfields p v c).2)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.pfields_zero
statement: lemma pfields_zero (s : ι) : T.pfields p (fun _ => 0) s = (0,0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.root_le_sum_exitCut
statement:
lemma root_le_sum_exitCut {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (f : ι → ℝ) (hf : ∀ s ∈ H, f s ≤ ∑ c ∈ T.children s, f c) (j : ℕ) :
    f T.root ≤ ∑ c ∈ T.exitCut H j, f c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_exitCut_le_root
statement:
lemma sum_exitCut_le_root {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (f : ι → ℝ) (hf : ∀ s ∈ H, ∑ c ∈ T.children s, f c ≤ f s) (j : ℕ) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.exitCut H j, f c ≤ f T.root

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.sum_exitCut_succ
statement:
lemma sum_exitCut_succ {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1) (j : ℕ) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.exitCut H (j+1), f c =
      (∑ s ∈ T.headLevel H j, ∑ c ∈ T.children s, f c) + ∑ c ∈ T.stoppedExit H j, f c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.tightLabel_spec
statement:
lemma tightLabel_spec (v : ι → ℝ) (s : ι) :
    T.pField p v (T.tightLabel p v s) s ^ p.val =
      ∑ c ∈ T.children s, T.pField p v (T.tightLabel p v s) c ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.FiniteRootedTree.uniform_sequential_separation
statement:
theorem uniform_sequential_separation {ι : Type uIndex} [DecidableEq ι]
    (T : FiniteRootedTree ι) (x z : ℕ → ι →₀ ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ n, T.normSum (x n) = 1)
    (hz : ∀ n s, s ∈ T.head (x n) → z n s = 0)
    (hm : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (T.normSum (x n + z n) + T.normSum (x n - z n))/2)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 1)) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => T.normSum (z n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.accumulated_bound
statement:
lemma accumulated_bound {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (K : ℕ → ℝ) (hK : ∀ j, 0 ≤ K j)
    {h : ℕ} (hrec : ∀ j < h, K (j+1) ^ p ≤ p * (3 : ℝ) ^ ((p-1)/p) * K j) :
    ∀ j ≤ h, K j ≤ recurrenceCeiling * K 0 ^ ((1/p)^j)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.accumulated_cut_recursion
statement:
lemma accumulated_cut_recursion {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) {H : Finset ι} (hH : T.Initial H)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (a d : Bool → ι → ℝ) (ha : ∀ σ s, 0 ≤ a σ s) (hd : ∀ σ s, 0 ≤ d σ s)
    (hloc : ∀ σ s, s ∈ H → ∑ c ∈ T.children s, d σ c ^ p ≤
      p * a σ s ^ (p-1) * d σ s)
    (hext : ∀ σ s, s ∉ H → a σ s = d σ s)
    (j : ℕ) (hA : ∑ σ, ∑ s ∈ T.exitCut H j, a σ s ^ p ≤ 3) :
    cutEnergy T p H d (j+1) ^ p ≤
      p * (3 : ℝ) ^ ((p-1)/p) * cutEnergy T p H d j

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.coefficient_nonneg
statement: lemma coefficient_nonneg (σ : Bool) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ coefficient T p H x y σ s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.common_increment
statement:
lemma common_increment (σ b : Bool) (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ H) :
    T.pField p (x + signed y σ) b s = T.pField p x b s + increment T p H x y σ s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.cubic_of_accumulated
statement:
lemma cubic_of_accumulated (h : ℕ+) (K : ℕ → ℝ) (hK : ∀ j, 0 ≤ K j)
    (hrec : ∀ j < h.val, K (j+1) ^ heightExponent h ≤
      heightExponent h * (3 : ℝ) ^ ((heightExponent h - 1) / heightExponent h) * K j)
    {Y : ℝ} (hY0 : 0 ≤ Y) (hY1 : Y ≤ 1) (hY : Y ≤ 2 * K h.val) :
    cubicConstant * Y ^ 3 ≤ K 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.cutEnergy_nonneg
statement:
lemma cutEnergy_nonneg (p : ℝ) (H : Finset ι) (d : Bool → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ σ s, 0 ≤ d σ s) (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ cutEnergy T p H d j

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.cutEnergy_pow
statement:
lemma cutEnergy_pow {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (H : Finset ι) (d : Bool → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ σ s, 0 ≤ d σ s) (j : ℕ) :
    cutEnergy T p H d j ^ p = ∑ σ, ∑ s ∈ T.exitCut H j, d σ s ^ p

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.cutEnergy_zero_le_gap
statement:
lemma cutEnergy_zero_le_gap (hp : 1 < p.val) :
    cutEnergy T p.val H (increment T p H x y) 0 ≤
      (T.pRootSum p (x+y) + T.pRootSum p (x-y)) / 2 - T.pRootSum p x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.endpoint_on_head
statement:
lemma endpoint_on_head {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {H : Finset ι} {x y : ι → ℝ}
    (hy : ∀ s ∈ H, y s = 0) (σ : Bool) (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ H) : (x + signed y σ) s = x s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.exit_sign_mass
statement:
lemma exit_sign_mass (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) :
    (∑ σ, increment T p H x y σ s ^ p.val) =
      T.pField p y true s ^ p.val + T.pField p y false s ^ p.val

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.finite_cubic
statement:
theorem finite_cubic (h : ℕ+) (hp : p.val = heightExponent h)
    (hH : T.Initial H) (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hy : ∀ s ∈ H, y s = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (hheight : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h.val) :
    cubicConstant * T.pRootSum p y ^ 3 ≤
      ((T.pRootSum p (x+y) + T.pRootSum p (x-y)) / 2 - T.pRootSum p x) *
        max (T.pRootSum p (x+y)) (T.pRootSum p (x-y)) ^ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.finite_cubic_normalized
statement:
theorem finite_cubic_normalized (h : ℕ+) (hp : p.val = heightExponent h)
    (hH : T.Initial H) (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0) (hy : ∀ s ∈ H, y s = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (hheight : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h.val)
    (hM : ∀ σ, T.pRootSum p (x + signed y σ) ≤ 1) :
    cubicConstant * T.pRootSum p y ^ 3 ≤
      (T.pRootSum p (x+y) + T.pRootSum p (x-y)) / 2 - T.pRootSum p x

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.head_field_le
statement:
lemma head_field_le (σ b : Bool) (s : ι) :
    T.pField p x b s ≤ T.pField p (x + signed y σ) b s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.heightExponent_le_two
statement: lemma heightExponent_le_two (h : ℕ+) : heightExponent h ≤ 2

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.heightExponent_pow_le_exp
statement: lemma heightExponent_pow_le_exp (h : ℕ+) : heightExponent h ^ h.val ≤ Real.exp 1

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.holder_powers
statement:
lemma holder_powers {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (a d : ι → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ a i) (hd : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ d i) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, a i ^ (p-1) * d i ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, a i ^ p) ^ ((p-1)/p) * (∑ i ∈ s, d i ^ p) ^ (1/p)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.holder_powers_two
statement:
lemma holder_powers_two {ι : Type uIndex} (s : Finset ι) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p)
    (a d : Bool → ι → ℝ) (ha : ∀ σ i, 0 ≤ a σ i) (hd : ∀ σ i, 0 ≤ d σ i) :
    ∑ σ, ∑ i ∈ s, a σ i ^ (p-1) * d σ i ≤
      (∑ σ, ∑ i ∈ s, a σ i ^ p) ^ ((p-1)/p) *
      (∑ σ, ∑ i ∈ s, d σ i ^ p) ^ (1/p)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.increment_nonneg
statement: lemma increment_nonneg (σ : Bool) (s : ι) : 0 ≤ increment T p H x y σ s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.layer_increment
statement:
lemma layer_increment (_hp : 1 < p.val) (σ : Bool) (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ H) :
    ∑ c ∈ T.children s, increment T p H x y σ c ^ p.val ≤
      p.val * coefficient T p H x y σ s ^ (p.val-1) * increment T p H x y σ s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.outside_field_eq
statement:
lemma outside_field_eq (σ b : Bool) (s : ι) (hs : s ∉ H) :
    T.pField p (x + signed y σ) b s = T.pField p (signed y σ) b s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.prefix_child_increment
statement:
lemma prefix_child_increment (σ : Bool) (s : ι) (_hs : s ∈ H) (c : ι) (hc : c ∈ T.children s) :
    T.pField p (x + signed y σ) (T.tightLabel p x s) c =
      T.pField p x (T.tightLabel p x s) c + increment T p H x y σ c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.recurrenceCeiling_one_le
statement: lemma recurrenceCeiling_one_le : 1 ≤ recurrenceCeiling

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.recurrenceCeiling_pos
statement: lemma recurrenceCeiling_pos : 0 < recurrenceCeiling

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.recurrence_coefficient_le
statement:
lemma recurrence_coefficient_le {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    p * (3 : ℝ) ^ ((p-1)/p) ≤ recurrenceCeiling ^ (p-1)

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.rpow_increment_le
statement:
lemma rpow_increment_le {p a d : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    (a+d)^p - a^p ≤ p * (a+d)^(p-1) * d

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.rpow_sub_one_mul
statement:
lemma rpow_sub_one_mul {p d : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    d ^ (p-1) * d = d ^ p

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.signed_false
statement: @[simp] lemma signed_false (y : ι → ℝ) : signed y false = -y

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.signed_smul
statement:
lemma signed_smul {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (a : ℝ) (y : ι → ℝ) (σ : Bool) :
    signed (a • y) σ = a • signed y σ

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.signed_true
statement: @[simp] lemma signed_true (y : ι → ℝ) : signed y true = y

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.tailFlux_dominates
statement: lemma tailFlux_dominates (b : Bool) (s : ι) : T.pField p y b s ^ p.val ≤ tailFlux T p H y s

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.tailFlux_head_terminal
statement:
lemma tailFlux_head_terminal {h : ℕ} (hheight : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h)
    (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ T.headLevel H h) : tailFlux T p H y s = 0

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.tailFlux_local
statement:
lemma tailFlux_local (s : ι) (hs : s ∈ H) :
    tailFlux T p H y s ≤ ∑ c ∈ T.children s, tailFlux T p H y c

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.tail_le_cutEnergy
statement:
lemma tail_le_cutEnergy (hp : 1 < p.val) {h : ℕ} (hheight : ∀ s, T.depth s ≤ h) :
    T.pRootSum p y ≤ 2 * cutEnergy T p.val H (increment T p H x y) h

name: OAI.RecursivePotentials.VariableExponent.total_coefficient_mass
statement:
lemma total_coefficient_mass {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (T : FiniteRootedTree ι)
    (p : ChildExponent) {H : Finset ι} {x y : ι → ℝ} (hH : T.Initial H) (hx : ∀ s ∉ H, x s = 0)
    (_hy : ∀ s ∈ H, y s = 0) (hstep : ∀ c, c ≠ T.root → T.depth c = T.depth (T.parent c) + 1)
    (hM : ∀ σ, T.pRootSum p (x + signed y σ) ≤ 1) (j : ℕ) :
    ∑ σ, ∑ s ∈ T.exitCut H j, coefficient T p H x y σ s ^ p.val ≤ 3

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.norm_column_le
statement: theorem norm_column_le (F : SegmentFamily V) (v : V) : ‖F.column v‖ ≤ 1

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.norm_test_le
statement:
theorem norm_test_le (F : SegmentFamily V) (u : V →₀ ℝ) :
    ‖F.test u‖ ≤ ∑ v ∈ u.support, |u v|

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.seminorm_sq
statement:
theorem seminorm_sq (F : SegmentFamily V) (u : V →₀ ℝ) :
    F.seminorm u ^ 2 = ∑ S : F.sets, (∑ v ∈ S.val, u v) ^ 2

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.singleton_seminorm
statement:
theorem singleton_seminorm (v : V) (u : V →₀ ℝ) :
    (singleton v).seminorm u = |u v|

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.SegmentFamily.test_apply
statement:
theorem test_apply (F : SegmentFamily V) (u : V →₀ ℝ) (S : F.sets) :
    F.test u S = ∑ v ∈ S.val, u v

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.abs_coord_le
statement:

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.matched_opposite_crossing
statement:
theorem matched_opposite_crossing {ι κ Γ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype Γ]
    {H : Finset V} (hH : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) H)
    (p : V →₀ ℝ) (hp : p.support ⊆ H)
    (a b : ι → V) (a' b' : κ → V)
    (hab : ∀ i, a i ≤ b i) (hab' : ∀ j, a' j ≤ b' j)
    (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (Finset.Icc (a i) (b i)) (Finset.Icc (a j) (b j)))
    (hd' : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (Finset.Icc (a' i) (b' i)) (Finset.Icc (a' j) (b' j)))
    (gate : Γ → V) (left : Γ → ι) (right : Γ → κ)
    (hl : Function.Injective left) (hr : Function.Injective right)
    (hgate : ∀ g, gate g ∉ H)
    (hmem : ∀ g, a (left g) ≤ gate g ∧ gate g ≤ b (left g))
    (hmem' : ∀ g, a' (right g) ≤ gate g ∧ gate g ≤ b' (right g))
    (hop : ∀ g, (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a (left g)) (b (left g)), p v) *
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a' (right g)) (b' (right g)), p v) < 0) :
    2 * ∑ g, |(∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a (left g)) (b (left g)), p v) *
        (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a' (right g)) (b' (right g)), p v)| ≤
      (segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 - ∑ i, (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a i) (b i), p v) ^ 2) +
      (segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 - ∑ j, (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a' j) (b' j), p v) ^ 2)

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.opposite_crossing
statement:
theorem opposite_crossing (F F' : SegmentFamily V) {H : Finset V}
    (hH : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) H) (p : V →₀ ℝ) (hp : p.support ⊆ H)
    (G : Finset V) (hG : ∀ g ∈ G, Gate H g) :
    (∑ g : G, (|F.boundary p g.val * F'.boundary p g.val| -
      F.boundary p g.val * F'.boundary p g.val)) ≤
      (segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 - F.seminorm p ^ 2) +
      (segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 - F'.seminorm p ^ 2)

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.opposite_split_gain
statement:
theorem opposite_split_gain {H : Finset V} (hH : Ancestral (· ≤ ·) H)
    {p : V →₀ ℝ} (hp : p.support ⊆ H) {a c g b b' : V}
    (hac : a ≤ c) (hcg : c ≤ g) (hgb : g ≤ b) (hgb' : g ≤ b')
    (hg : g ∉ H)
    (hop : (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc a b, p v) * (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc c b', p v) < 0) :
    2 * |(∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc a b, p v) * (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc c b', p v)| ≤
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Ico a c, p v) ^ 2 + (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc c b, p v) ^ 2 -
        (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc a b, p v) ^ 2

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.selected_split_budget
statement:
theorem selected_split_budget {ι Γ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype Γ]
    (p : V →₀ ℝ) (a b : ι → V) (hab : ∀ i, a i ≤ b i)
    (hd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (Finset.Icc (a i) (b i)) (Finset.Icc (a j) (b j)))
    (select : Γ → ι) (hinj : Function.Injective select) (cut : Γ → V)
    (hcut : ∀ g, a (select g) ≤ cut g ∧ cut g ≤ b (select g))
    (cost : Γ → ℝ) (hcost : ∀ g, 0 ≤ cost g)
    (hgain : ∀ g, cost g ≤
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Ico (a (select g)) (cut g), p v) ^ 2 +
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (cut g) (b (select g)), p v) ^ 2 -
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a (select g)) (b (select g)), p v) ^ 2) :
    ∑ g, cost g ≤ segmentSeminorm V p ^ 2 -
      ∑ i, (∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc (a i) (b i), p v) ^ 2

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.joint_identity
statement:
theorem joint_identity (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {ι : Ω → Type*}
    [∀ ω, Fintype (ι ω)] (a b : (ω : Ω) → ι ω → ℝ) (r : ℝ)
    (hpair : μ.mean (fun ω => ∑ i, a ω i * b ω i) = r ^ 2) :
    μ.mean (fun ω => ∑ i, (a ω i - b ω i) ^ 2) +
      μ.mean (fun ω => r ^ 2 - ∑ i, b ω i ^ 2) =
      μ.mean (fun ω => ∑ i, a ω i ^ 2) - r ^ 2

theorem absolute_mass_bound (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (b : Ω → Γ → ℝ) (L : Ω → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ ω ω', (∑ g, (|b ω g * b ω' g| - b ω g * b ω' g)) ≤ L ω + L ω') :
    (∑ g, μ.mean (fun ω => |b ω g|) ^ 2) ≤
      (∑ g, μ.mean (fun ω => b ω g) ^ 2) + 2 * μ.mean L

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.absolute_mass_identity
statement:
theorem absolute_mass_identity (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (b : Ω → Γ → ℝ) :
    (∑ g, μ.mean (fun ω => |b ω g|) ^ 2) -
      (∑ g, μ.mean (fun ω => b ω g) ^ 2) =
    (μ.product μ).mean (fun ω => ∑ g, (|b ω.1 g * b ω.2 g| - b ω.1 g * b ω.2 g))

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.joint_mass_bound
statement:
theorem joint_mass_bound (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (b W : Ω → Γ → ℝ) (V L : Ω → ℝ)
    (hzero : ∀ g, μ.mean (fun ω => b ω g + W ω g) = 0)
    (hW : ∀ ω, (∑ g, W ω g ^ 2) ≤ V ω)
    (hc : ∀ ω ω', (∑ g, (|b ω g * b ω' g| - b ω g * b ω' g)) ≤ L ω + L ω') :
    (∑ g, μ.mean (fun ω => |b ω g|) ^ 2) ≤ μ.mean V + 2 * μ.mean L

name: OAI.SegmentLenses.FiniteLaw.pooled_expect

    (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Ω') (f : Ω → E) (g : Ω' → E) :
    (μ.pooled ν).expect (Sum.elim f g) = (1/2 : ℝ) • μ.expect f + (1/2 : ℝ) • ν.expect g

      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * U) < (S + ν) (thinShell x r δ \ Metric.ball z ρ)) :
    1 ≤ shellMajorant ν S ρ δ T U x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.shellMajorant_eq_bracket
statement:
theorem shellMajorant_eq_bracket (ν S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure S]
    (ρ δ T U : ℝ) (x : ℂ) :
    shellMajorant ν S ρ δ T U x = (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ z,
      ((ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ * pairMass ν ρ δ x z +
        rayIndicator S ρ T U (200 * δ / ρ ^ 2) x z) ∂ν

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.shell_concentration
statement:
theorem shell_concentration (ν S : Measure ℂ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure S]
    {ρ δ T U : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ ^ 2 / 1600) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hU : 0 < U) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤
        (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (ENNReal.ofReal (156 * δ / ρ) * ν univ * ν univ) +
        (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ * ((ENNReal.ofReal (6 * Real.pi) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (200 * δ / ρ ^ 2) * (1 + T / U))) * ν univ) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E, ∀ r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
        ENNReal.ofReal U ≤ ν (thinShell x r δ) →
        S (Metric.ball x (r - δ)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal T →
        ∃ z ∈ thinShell x r δ,
          (S + ν) (thinShell x r δ \ Metric.ball z ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * U)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskGeometry.volume_pairCondition

    volume {x : ℂ | pairCondition ρ δ x z y} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (156 * δ / ρ)

    (hR : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → ‖y-x‖ ≤ R) (hH : ‖(star (z-x))⁻¹‖ ≤ H) :

    (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) :
    ‖∫ y, correction x z y*F y*b y‖ ≤
      2*ρ*(∫ y, ‖b y‖)+7*(∫ y in D \ Metric.ball z ρ, ‖b y‖)

lemma corrected_increment_bound {Cs α δ ρ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) (x z : ℂ)
    (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3)
    (hzero : ∑ d, ∫ y, star (y-x)*F y*(b d).density y = 0) :
    ‖∑ d, ∫ y, F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
      2*ρ*coarseMass b δ univ+7*coarseMass b δ (D \ Metric.ball z ρ)+
      ((L : ℝ)+2*(3*(L : ℝ)+1))*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.size_step
statement:
theorem size_step {Cs α δ ρ U : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ^2/1600) (hU : 0 < U) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤
        (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (156*δ/ρ)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b δ univ)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b δ univ)) +
        (ENNReal.ofReal U)⁻¹ *
          ((ENNReal.ofReal (6*Real.pi)*ENNReal.ofReal (2*(200*δ/ρ^2)))*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b δ univ)) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E, ∀ r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2, ∀ (L : ℝ≥0) (F : ℂ → ℂ),
        LipschitzWith L F → (∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) →
        (∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ thinShell x r δ) →
        (U ≤ coarseMass b δ (thinShell x r δ) →
          (∑ d, ∫ y, star (y-x)*F y*(b d).density y) = 0) →
        ‖∑ d, ∫ y, F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
          2*ρ*coarseMass b δ univ+14*U+
            ((L : ℝ)+2*(3*(L : ℝ)+1))*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.size_endpoint_raw
statement:
theorem size_endpoint_raw {Cs d t : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4)
    (hgeom : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ d → δ ≤ (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2/1600)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, (
        (ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (156*width d n/(width d n)^(1/5 : ℝ))*
            ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)) +
        (ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ *
          ((ENNReal.ofReal (6*Real.pi)*ENNReal.ofReal (2*(200*width d n/((width d n)^(1/5 : ℝ))^2)))*
            ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)) +
        ENNReal.ofReal (24*Real.pi*width d n)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)/
          ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ))) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E,
        (∀ᵐ y, y ∈ Metric.ball x 3 → ∑ j, (b j).density y = gradient g y) →
        ∀ r, EndpointRadius g x r →
        ‖∫ y in Metric.ball x r, gradient g y‖ ≤
          (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
          (16+4538*Cs)*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.size_sequence
statement:
theorem size_sequence {Cs d t : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4)
    (hgeom : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ d → δ ≤ (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2/1600)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, (
        (ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (156*width d n/(width d n)^(1/5 : ℝ))*
            ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)*ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ)) +
        (ENNReal.ofReal (t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ *
          ((ENNReal.ofReal (6*Real.pi)*ENNReal.ofReal (2*(200*width d n/((width d n)^(1/5 : ℝ))^2)))*
            ENNReal.ofReal (coarseMass b (width d n) univ))) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E, ∀ r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
        ∀ k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
          ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩,
        (∀ n, t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ) ≤ coarseMass b (width d n) (thinShell x r (width d n)) →
          (∑ j, ∫ y, star (y-x)*((kernel (k (n+1)) x y : ℂ)-kernel (k n) x y)*(b j).density y) = 0) →
        ‖∑ j, ∫ y in Metric.ball x r, (b j).density y‖ ≤
          (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
          (16+4538*Cs)*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

lemma dyadic_ratio {A L : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (n : ℕ) :
    A/(L*A*2^n) ≤ (1/2 : ℝ)^n

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.errorPrice_zero
statement:
lemma errorPrice_zero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {Cs α : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hA : errorPrice b α = 0) : ∀ j, (b j).density =ᵐ[volume] 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.size_majorant
statement:
theorem size_majorant {Cs : ℝ} (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
      (g : ℂ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → ∀ Q : Set ℂ, volume Q ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 1 →
      ∃ F : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F ∧
        (∫⁻ x in Q, F x) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C*errorPrice b (1/100)) ∧
        ∀ x, (∀ᵐ y, y ∈ Metric.ball x 3 → ∑ j, (b j).density y = gradient g y) →
          ∀ r, EndpointRadius g x r →
            ENNReal.ofReal ‖∫ y in Metric.ball x r, gradient g y‖ ≤ F x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.size_tail
statement:
theorem size_tail {Cs : ℝ} (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, 1 ≤ L ∧ ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs),
      0 < errorPrice b (1/100) → ∀ t : ℝ, L*errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t →
      ∀ g : ℂ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g →
      ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
        volume E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (sizeTailConstant*(errorPrice b (1/100)/t)^(34/25 : ℝ)) ∧
        ∀ x ∉ E,
          (∀ᵐ y, y ∈ Metric.ball x 3 → ∑ j, (b j).density y = gradient g y) →
          ∀ r, EndpointRadius g x r → ‖∫ y in Metric.ball x r, gradient g y‖ ≤ t

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.cone_corrected_cap
statement:
lemma cone_corrected_cap {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {K L : ℂ → ℝ} (hK : AEStronglyMeasurable K) (hL : AEStronglyMeasurable L)
    (hK0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ K y) (hK1 : ∀ y, K y ≤ 1)
    (hL0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ L y) (hL1 : ∀ y, L y ≤ 1)
    {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hsupp : ∀ y, L y-K y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D)
    (x z : ℂ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖)
    (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) :
    ‖∫ y, correction x z y*((L y : ℂ)-K y)*a y‖ ≤
      2*ρ*(∫ y, (L y+K y)*‖a y‖)+7*(∫ y in D \ Metric.ball z ρ, ‖a y‖)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.cone_mass_of_nonpositive
statement:
lemma cone_mass_of_nonpositive {e : ℂ} {κ : ℝ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 < κ) {K : ℂ → ℝ} (hK : AEStronglyMeasurable K)
    (hK0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ K y) (hK1 : ∀ y, K y ≤ 1) {p : ℂ}
    (hp : inner ℝ e ((∫ y, (K y : ℂ)*a.density y)+p) ≤ 0) :
    (∫ y, K y*‖a.density y‖) ≤ ‖p‖/κ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.cone_pairing
statement:
lemma cone_pairing {e : ℂ} {κ : ℝ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    {K : ℂ → ℝ} (hK : AEStronglyMeasurable K) (hK0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ K y)
    (hK1 : ∀ y, K y ≤ 1) :
    κ*(∫ y, K y*‖a.density y‖) ≤ inner ℝ e (∫ y, (K y : ℂ)*a.density y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.convex_pairing
statement:
lemma convex_pairing {a : ℂ → ℂ} {K L : ℂ → ℝ}
    (hiK : Integrable (fun y => (K y : ℂ)*a y))
    (hiL : Integrable (fun y => (L y : ℂ)*a y)) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, ((θ*K y+(1-θ)*L y : ℝ) : ℂ)*a y) =
      θ • (∫ y, (K y : ℂ)*a y)+(1-θ) • (∫ y, (L y : ℂ)*a y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_error_bound
statement:
lemma corrected_error_bound {Cs α δ ρ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) (x z : ℂ)
    (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) :
    ‖∑ d, ∫ y, correction x z y*F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
      2*ρ*coarseMass b δ univ+7*coarseMass b δ (D \ Metric.ball z ρ)+
      ((L : ℝ)+2*(3*(L : ℝ)+1))*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_inactive_bound
statement:
lemma corrected_inactive_bound {Cs α δ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) (x z : ℂ)
    (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) :
    ‖∑ d, ∫ y, correction x z y*F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
      7*coarseMass b δ D+((L : ℝ)+2*(3*(L : ℝ)+1))*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.correction_kernel_bound
statement:
lemma correction_kernel_bound {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1)

    ∀ y, ‖correction x z y*F y‖ ≤ 7

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.crossing_interpolation
statement:
lemma crossing_interpolation (e p q : ℂ) (hq : inner ℝ e q < 0) :
    ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 ∧
      inner ℝ e (θ • p+(1-θ) • q) ≤ 0 ∧
      max 0 (-inner ℝ e (θ • p+(1-θ) • q)) = max 0 (-inner ℝ e p)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.increment_bound_general
statement:
lemma increment_bound_general {Cs α δ M : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hα : α ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ M) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D) :
    ‖∑ d, ∫ y, F y*(b d).density y‖ ≤
      M*coarseMass b δ D+(L : ℝ)*Cs*δ^(2*(1-α))*errorPrice b α

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.inner_unit_bound
statement: lemma inner_unit_bound {e p : ℂ} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) : |inner ℝ e p| ≤ ‖p‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.negative_gap_cap
statement:
lemma negative_gap_cap {e : ℂ} {κ B ρ H : ℝ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    {K L : ℂ → ℝ} (hK : AEStronglyMeasurable K) (hL : AEStronglyMeasurable L)
    (hK0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ K y) (hK1 : ∀ y, K y ≤ 1)
    (hL0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ L y) (hL1 : ∀ y, L y ≤ 1)
    {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hsupp : ∀ y, L y-K y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D)
    (x z : ℂ) (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3)
    (hcap : (∫ y in D \ Metric.ball z ρ, ‖a.density y‖) ≤ H)
    {p q R : ℂ} (hp : ‖p‖ ≤ B) (hq : ‖q‖ ≤ B)
    (hneg : inner ℝ e ((∫ y, (L y : ℂ)*a.density y)+q) < 0)
    (hcor : ((∫ y, (L y : ℂ)*a.density y)+q)-((∫ y, (K y : ℂ)*a.density y)+p) =
      (∫ y, correction x z y*((L y : ℂ)-K y)*a.density y)+R) :
    max 0 (-inner ℝ e ((∫ y, (L y : ℂ)*a.density y)+q)) ≤
      max 0 (-inner ℝ e ((∫ y, (K y : ℂ)*a.density y)+p))+
        4*ρ*(B/κ)+7*H+‖R‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.negative_projection_change
statement:
lemma negative_projection_change (e p q : ℂ) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.negative_projection_le_norm
statement:
lemma negative_projection_le_norm {e p : ℂ} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.dist_width_tail
statement:
lemma dist_width_tail {α : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace α] {d p C : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hC : 0 ≤ C) {f : ℕ → α} {j n : ℕ} (hjn : j ≤ n)
    (hincr : ∀ i, j ≤ i → i < n → dist (f i) (f (i+1)) ≤ C*(width d i)^p) :
    dist (f j) (f n) ≤ C*(width d j)^p/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^p)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.geometric_den_pos

statement:
lemma successor_discount {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (δ/2)⁻¹^(1/100 : ℝ) ≤ 2*δ⁻¹^(1/100 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.sum_width_tail

name: OAI.SignedDisk.DiskScales.width_add

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.balanced_kernel_gap_identity
statement:
lemma balanced_kernel_gap_identity {Cs : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) {a : ℂ → ℂ}
    (ha : Integrable a) {r δ ε : ℝ} {M N : ℝ≥0}
    (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) M) (l : RadiusDensity (r-ε) (r+ε) N)
    (x z : ℂ) (hrδ : r+δ ≤ 3) (hrε : r+ε ≤ 3) (hεδ : ε ≤ δ)
    (hMk : (∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y)+
      (∑ j, ∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel k x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y) = 0)
    (hMl : (∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel l x y : ℂ)*a y)+
      (∑ j, ∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel l x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y) = 0) :
    ((∫ y, (kernel l x y : ℂ)*a y)+(∑ j, ∫ y, (kernel l x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y))-
      ((∫ y, (kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y)+(∑ j, ∫ y, (kernel k x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y)) =
    (∫ y, correction x z y*((kernel l x y : ℂ)-kernel k x y)*a y)+
      (∑ j, ∫ y, correction x z y*((kernel l x y : ℂ)-kernel k x y)*(b j).density y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.coarse_bound_scaled
statement:
lemma coarse_bound_scaled {Cs δ : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hδ : 0 < δ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.cone_negative_le_error
statement:
lemma cone_negative_le_error {e : ℂ} {κ : ℝ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) {K : ℂ → ℝ}
    (hK : AEStronglyMeasurable K) (hK0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ K y) (hK1 : ∀ y, K y ≤ 1) (p : ℂ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_kernel_gap
statement:
lemma corrected_kernel_gap {Cs d t r : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4) (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)
    (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    (k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
      ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩) (x z : ℂ) {j n : ℕ} (hjn : j < n)
    (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖)
    (hcap : coarseMass b (width d j) (thinShell x r (width d j) \ Metric.ball z ((width d j)^(1/5 : ℝ))) ≤
      2*(t*(width d j)^(1/10 : ℝ)))
    (hsmall : ∀ i, j < i → i < n → coarseMass b (width d i) (thinShell x r (width d i)) ≤
      t*(width d i)^(1/10 : ℝ)) :
    ‖∑ v, ∫ y, correction x z y*((kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)-kernel (k j) x y)*(b v).density y‖ ≤
      (16+4538*Cs)*t*(width d j)^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_kernel_integrable
statement:
lemma corrected_kernel_integrable {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {r δ : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) M) (x z : ℂ)
    (hr : r+δ ≤ 3) (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) :
    Integrable (fun y => correction x z y*(kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.corrected_kernel_pairing_sub
statement:
lemma corrected_kernel_pairing_sub {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {r δ ε : ℝ} {M N : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) M)
    (l : RadiusDensity (r-ε) (r+ε) N) (x z : ℂ)
    (hrδ : r+δ ≤ 3) (hrε : r+ε ≤ 3) (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖) :
    (∫ y, correction x z y*(kernel l x y : ℂ)*a y)-
      (∫ y, correction x z y*(kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y) =
      ∫ y, correction x z y*((kernel l x y : ℂ)-kernel k x y)*a y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.correcting_pairing
statement:
lemma correcting_pairing {a F : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    (hF : AEStronglyMeasurable F) (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (x z : ℂ)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3) :
    (∫ y, correction x z y*F y*a y) = (∫ y, F y*a y) -
      (star (z-x))⁻¹*(∫ y, star (y-x)*F y*a y)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.general_kernel_pairing_sub
statement:
lemma general_kernel_pairing_sub {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {u v u' v' : ℝ} {M N : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity u v M) (l : RadiusDensity u' v' N) (x : ℂ) :
    (∫ y, (kernel l x y : ℂ)*a y)-(∫ y, (kernel k x y : ℂ)*a y) =
      ∫ y, ((kernel l x y : ℂ)-kernel k x y)*a y

statement:
lemma general_moment_integrable {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.inactive_kernel_distance
statement:
lemma inactive_kernel_distance {Cs d t r : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    (k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
      ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩) (x : ℂ) (n : ℕ)
    (hsmall : coarseMass b (width d n) (thinShell x r (width d n)) ≤ t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)) :
    dist (∑ j, ∫ y, (kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y)
      (∑ j, ∫ y, (kernel (k (n+1)) x y : ℂ)*(b j).density y) ≤
      (16+4538*Cs)*t*(width d n)^(1/10 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.interior_mass_le_kernel
statement:
lemma interior_mass_le_kernel {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {r δ ε : ℝ} {M : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity (r-ε) (r+ε) M) (x : ℂ) (hεδ : ε ≤ δ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.kernel_error_bound
statement:
lemma kernel_error_bound {Cs δ r : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) ⟨216/δ, by positivity⟩) (x : ℂ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.kernel_gap_errors
statement:
lemma kernel_gap_errors {Cs d t r : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    (k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
      ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩) (x : ℂ) {j n : ℕ} (hjn : j < n)
    (hsmall : ∀ i, j < i → i < n → coarseMass b (width d i) (thinShell x r (width d i)) ≤
      t*(width d i)^(1/10 : ℝ)) :
    let B := (2*(1+216*Cs)+(16+4538*Cs)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ)))*t*(width d j)^(-(1/50 : ℝ))
    ‖∑ v, ∫ y, (kernel (k j) x y : ℂ)*(b v).density y‖ ≤ B ∧
    ‖∑ v, ∫ y, (kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*(b v).density y‖ ≤ B

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.moment_kernel_pairing_sub
statement:
lemma moment_kernel_pairing_sub {a : ℂ → ℂ} (ha : Integrable a)
    {r δ ε : ℝ} {M N : ℝ≥0} (k : RadiusDensity (r-δ) (r+δ) M)
    (l : RadiusDensity (r-ε) (r+ε) N) (x : ℂ) (hrδ : r+δ ≤ 3) (hrε : r+ε ≤ 3) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.scaled_corrected_active
statement:
lemma scaled_corrected_active {Cs δ t : ℝ} (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : LipschitzWith L F) {D : Set ℂ} (hD : MeasurableSet D)
    (hFb : ∀ y, ‖F y‖ ≤ 1) (hFD : ∀ y, F y ≠ 0 → y ∈ D)
    (hL : (L : ℝ) ≤ 648/δ) (x z : ℂ) (hz : (1 : ℝ)/2 ≤ ‖z-x‖)
    (hD3 : ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y-x‖ ≤ 3)
    (hcap : coarseMass b δ (D \ Metric.ball z (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))) ≤ 2*(t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ))) :
    ‖∑ j, ∫ y, correction x z y*F y*(b j).density y‖ ≤
      (16+4538*Cs)*t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)

    (ENNReal.ofReal (t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)))⁻¹ *
      ((ENNReal.ofReal (6*Real.pi)*ENNReal.ofReal
        (2*(200*δ/(δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2)*(1+(H*t*δ^(-(1/50 : ℝ)))/(t*δ^(1/10 : ℝ)))))*ENNReal.ofReal M) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal ((1+H)*(156*(A/t)^2*δ^(14/25 : ℝ)+2424*Real.pi*(A/t)*δ^(9/25 : ℝ)))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.direction_raw
statement:
theorem direction_raw {e : ℂ} {κ Cs d t : ℝ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4)
    (hgeom : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ d → δ ≤ (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2/1600)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, directionShellBound b κ t (width d n) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E,
        (∀ᵐ y, y ∈ Metric.ball x 3 → a.density y+∑ j, (b j).density y = gradient g y) →
        ∀ r, NeighborhoodRadius g x r →
        max 0 (-inner ℝ e (∫ y in Metric.ball x r, gradient g y)) ≤
          (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
          directionGapConstant Cs κ*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.direction_sequence
statement:
theorem direction_sequence {e : ℂ} {κ Cs d t : ℝ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4)
    (hgeom : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ d → δ ≤ (δ^(1/5 : ℝ))^2/1600)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t) :
    ∃ E : Set ℂ, MeasurableSet E ∧
      volume E ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, directionShellBound b κ t (width d n) ∧
      ∀ x ∉ E, ∀ r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
        ∀ k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
          ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩,
        (∀ n, (∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*a.density y)+
          (∑ v, ∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*(b v).density y) = 0) →
        max 0 (-inner ℝ e ((∫ y in Metric.ball x r, a.density y)+
          (∑ v, ∫ y in Metric.ball x r, (b v).density y))) ≤
          (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
          directionGapConstant Cs κ*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LocalCancellation.direction_sequence_point
statement:
lemma direction_sequence_point {Cs κ d t r : ℝ} {e : ℂ} (a : ConeDensity e κ)
    (b : ι → ErrorPiece Cs) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs) (hd : 0 < d) (hdq : d ≤ 1/4) (hr : r ∈ Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)
    (hAt : errorPrice b (1/100) ≤ t)
    (k : ∀ n : ℕ, RadiusDensity (r-width d n) (r+width d n)
      ⟨216/width d n, div_nonneg (by norm_num) (width_pos hd n).le⟩) (x : ℂ)
    (hM : ∀ n, (∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*a.density y)+
      (∑ v, ∫ y, star (y-x)*(kernel (k n) x y : ℂ)*(b v).density y) = 0)
    (hcap : ∀ j, t*(width d j)^(1/10 : ℝ) ≤ coarseMass b (width d j) (thinShell x r (width d j)) →
      (∫ y in Metric.ball x (r-width d j), ‖a.density y‖) ≤
        (errorGapConstant Cs/κ)*t*(width d j)^(-(1/50 : ℝ)) →
      ∃ z ∈ thinShell x r (width d j),
        (∫ y in thinShell x r (width d j) \ Metric.ball z ((width d j)^(1/5 : ℝ)), ‖a.density y‖)+
        coarseMass b (width d j) (thinShell x r (width d j) \ Metric.ball z ((width d j)^(1/5 : ℝ))) ≤
          2*(t*(width d j)^(1/10 : ℝ))) :
    max 0 (-inner ℝ e ((∫ y in Metric.ball x r, a.density y)+(∑ v, ∫ y in Metric.ball x r, (b v).density y))) ≤
      (1+216*Cs)/d^(1/100 : ℝ)*errorPrice b (1/100)+
      directionGapConstant Cs κ*t*d^(1/10 : ℝ)/(1-(1/2 : ℝ)^(1/10 : ℝ))

statement:
theorem positive_residual {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    {h : α → ℝ} (hh : Integrable h μ) (hc : 0 ≤ ∫ x, h x ∂μ) :
    ∃ ρ : α → ℝ, Integrable ρ μ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) ∧
      (∀ x, ρ x ≤ max (h x) 0) ∧ (∫ x, ρ x ∂μ) = ∫ x, h x ∂μ ∧
      (∫ x, |h x-ρ x| ∂μ) = (∫ x, |h x| ∂μ) - ∫ x, h x ∂μ ∧
      (∀ x, h x = 0 → ρ x = 0)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ScalarCancellation.refined_integrable
OAI.SignedDisk.ScalarCancellation.refinement_residual
statement:
theorem refinement_residual {α ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    [Fintype ι] (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (ρ : ι → α → ℝ)
    (hρ : ∀ i, Integrable (ρ i) μ) :
    ∃ R β : α → ℝ, Integrable R μ ∧ Integrable β μ ∧
      (∀ x, (∑ i, w i*ρ i x) = R x+β x) ∧
      (∫ x, R x ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i*(∫ x, ρ i x ∂μ) ∧
      (∫ x, β x ∂μ) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x, |R x| ∂μ) = |∑ i, w i*(∫ x, ρ i x ∂μ)| ∧
      (∫ x, |β x| ∂μ) ≤
        (∑ i, w i*(∫ x, |ρ i x| ∂μ))-|∑ i, w i*(∫ x, ρ i x ∂μ)| ∧
      ((0 ≤ ∑ i, w i*(∫ x, ρ i x ∂μ)) → ∀ x, 0 ≤ R x) ∧
      (∀ x, (∀ i, w i*ρ i x = 0) → R x = 0 ∧ β x = 0)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ScalarCancellation.residual_split
statement:
theorem residual_split {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    {h : α → ℝ} (hh : Integrable h μ) :
    ∃ ρ β : α → ℝ, Integrable ρ μ ∧ Integrable β μ ∧
      (∀ x, h x = ρ x+β x) ∧ (∫ x, ρ x ∂μ) = ∫ x, h x ∂μ ∧
      (∫ x, β x ∂μ) = 0 ∧ (∫ x, |ρ x| ∂μ) = |∫ x, h x ∂μ| ∧
      (∫ x, |β x| ∂μ) = (∫ x, |h x| ∂μ)-|∫ x, h x ∂μ| ∧
      ((0 ≤ ∫ x, h x ∂μ) → ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) ∧
      ((∫ x, h x ∂μ) < 0 → ∀ x, ρ x ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ x, h x = 0 → ρ x = 0 ∧ β x = 0)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ScalarCancellation.root_spec
statement:
lemma root_spec {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    Integrable (root μ f) μ ∧
      (∫ x, root μ f x ∂μ) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ ∧
      (∫ x, |root μ f x| ∂μ) = |∫ x, f x ∂μ| ∧
      (∫ x, |f x-root μ f x| ∂μ) = (∫ x, |f x| ∂μ)-|∫ x, f x ∂μ| ∧
      ((0 ≤ ∫ x, f x ∂μ) → ∀ x, 0 ≤ root μ f x) ∧
      ((∫ x, f x ∂μ) < 0 → ∀ x, root μ f x ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ x, f x = 0 → root μ f x = 0)

theorem telescoped_decomposition [DecidableEq ι] (w : ℕ → ι → ι → ℝ) (f : ι → α → ℝ)
    (Λ : ℕ → ℕ → ι → ι → ℝ)
    (hdiag : ∀ k q s, Λ k k q s = if q = s then 1 else 0)
    (hstep : ∀ k j q s, j ≤ k → Λ (k+1) j q s = ∑ a, w k q a*Λ k j a s)
    (k : ℕ) (q : ι) (x : α) :
    refined w f k q x = roots μ w f k q x +
      ∑ j ∈ range (k+1), ∑ s, Λ k j q s*errors μ w f j s x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.VectorRefinement.pair_defect_bound
statement:
theorem pair_defect_bound {ι E : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (w a : ι → ℝ) (θ : ι → E) (n : E) (A : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hθ : ∀ i, ‖θ i‖ = 1)
    (href : A • n = ∑ i, (w i*a i) • θ i)
    {q s : ι} (hwaq : 1/4 ≤ w q) (hwas : 9/64 ≤ w s) (has : a q ≤ a s) :
    a q*‖θ q-θ s‖^2 ≤ 48*((∑ i, w i*a i)-A)

    (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hθ : ∀ i, ‖θ i‖ = 1)
    (href : A • n = ∑ i, (w i*a i) • θ i) :
    (∑ i, w i*a i)-A = (1/2:ℝ)*∑ i, w i*a i*‖θ i-n‖^2

theorem cancelled_potential_lp {ψ : ℂ → ℝ} {β : ℂ → ℂ}

    (hψs : ∀ z, ψ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hψB : ∀ z, |ψ z| ≤ B)
    (hψL : ∀ u v, |ψ u-ψ v| ≤ L*‖u-v‖)
    (hM : 0 < R+X) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (ha : 0 < a)

      (ENNReal.ofReal |∫ y, ⟪cancelledGreen ψ z a x y,β y⟫|)^(3/2:ℝ)) ≤
    (ENNReal.ofReal ((2*B*(R+X)^2)^(3/2:ℝ)*(4*Real.pi*(4*a)^(1/2:ℝ))) +
    ENNReal.ofReal (((8*B*(R+X)^2+(64/3:ℝ)*L*(R+X)^3)*a)^(3/2:ℝ) *
        (2*Real.pi/(2*a)))) * (ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y, ‖β y‖))^(3/2:ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.LabelSwitches.count_energy

theorem count_energy (mark sw : ℕ → Bool) (E : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) {c : ℝ}

    (hsep : ∀ i j, i < j → j < n → sw i = true → sw j = true →
      ∃ k, i ≤ k ∧ k ≤ j ∧ (mark k = true ∨ c < E k)) :

theorem green_finite_decomposition {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {ψ g : ℂ → ℝ} (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) {D R X Y B : ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ D) (hψ1 : ∫ z, ψ z = 1)
    (hψs : ∀ z, ψ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hψB : ∀ z, |ψ z| ≤ B)
    (hRX : R ≤ X) (hM : 0 < R+X) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hXY : 0 < X+Y)
    (β : ι → ℂ → ℂ) (hβ : ∀ i, Integrable (β i))
    (hβs : ∀ i y, β i y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ Y)
    (hdecomp : ∀ᵐ y, ‖y‖ ≤ X → gradient g y = ∑ i, β i y) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict {x : ℂ | ‖x‖ ≤ X},
      g x-∫ z, ψ z*g z = ∑ i, ∫ y, ⟪green ψ x y,β i y⟫

statement:
lemma spatialRow_distance (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) {r B : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hpB : ∀ z, p z ≤ B) (x y : ℂ) :
    l1dist (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x) (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r y) ≤
      (Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*(16*B/r)*‖x-y‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_formula
statement:
lemma spatialRow_formula (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (j : ι) :
    spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x j =
      delta old j+interpolate r (fun z => p z*(delta (target z) j-delta old j)) x

statement:
lemma spatialRow_local_derivative (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)

    {q x : ℂ} (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r)
    (hpB : ∀ z, boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r → p z ≤ B) :
    r*∑ j : ι, ‖gradient (fun y => spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r y j) x‖ ≤
      16*(Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*B

    {q x y : ℂ} (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r) (hy : boxNorm (y-q) < 199*r)
    (hpB : ∀ z, boxNorm (point r z-q) ≤ 200*r → p z ≤ B) :
    l1dist (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x) (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r y) ≤
      (Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*(16*B/r)*‖x-y‖

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_truncate
statement:
lemma spatialRow_truncate (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {q x : ℂ}
    (hx : boxNorm (x-q) < 199*r) (j : ι) :
    spatialRow old target (truncate r q p) (truncate_nonneg r q hp0)
      (truncate_le (by norm_num) (fun z _ => hp1 z)) r x j =
    spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x j

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialSwitchRow_local_derivative

lemma spatialSwitchRow_local_derivative {τ r E : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hr : 0 < r) (hE0 : 0 ≤ E)

    r*∑ j : ι, ‖gradient (fun x => spatialSwitchRow τ r label Θ target old x j) x‖ ≤
      16*(Fintype.card ι:ℝ)*(2*switchRate τ r Θ (label old) y+8*τ⁻¹^2*E)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.AffineDensities.integral_affine
statement:
lemma integral_affine (h : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.AffineDensities.integral_rescale
statement:

name: OAI.SignedDisk.AffineDensities.mass_rescale

name: OAI.SignedDisk.AffineDensities.rescale_support
statement:
lemma rescale_support {h : ℂ → ℂ} {p z : ℂ} {r t : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.coordinate_total_le

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_mixture
statement:
lemma spatialRow_mixture (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)

    spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x j =
      interpolate r (fun z => (1-p z)*delta old j+p z*delta (target z) j) x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PricePieces.errorPiece_mass
statement:
lemma errorPiece_mass {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) (p : ℂ) (q : Grid N)
    {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) {s : ℝ} (hs : s^2 = 1) :
    (errorPiece hh hr k j hj p q n s).mass ≤ (scale r k)⁻¹*

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.law_drift
statement:
lemma law_drift {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℤ × ℤ)
    {x : ℂ} (hx : boxNorm (x-point r q) ≤ 50*r)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.ActualLabels.switchCost_sum
statement:
theorem switchCost_sum (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ) (x : ℂ)
    (anchor : ℕ → ℂ) (exceptional : ℕ → Bool) {b m : ℕ} (hbm : b ≤ m)
    (hr : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, 0 < r (k+1))
    (hx : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, boxNorm (x-point (r (k+1)) (q (k+1))) ≤ 50*r (k+1))
    (hE : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, exceptional (k+1) = false →
      energy h (r (k+1)) (q (k+1)) ≤ (1/1000:ℝ)^2)
    (ha : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, exceptional (k+1) = false →
      anchor (k+1) = anchor k ∧ ‖theta h (r (k+1)) (q (k+1))-anchor k‖ ≤ 1/800) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, switchCost h r x (k+1)) ≤
      1+2*∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico b m, if exceptional (k+1) then (1:ℝ) else 0

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_absorbing
statement:
lemma spatialRow_absorbing (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ)
    (b : ι → ℝ) (hb : b old = 0 ∨ b old = 1)
    (ht : ∀ z, hat r z x ≠ 0 → b (target z) = 0)
    (hz : b old = 0 → ∀ z, hat r z x ≠ 0 → p z = 0) :
    expect (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x) b+interpolate r p x = b old

name: OAI.SignedDisk.FiniteLabels.spatialRow_expect
statement:
lemma spatialRow_expect (old : ι) (target : ℤ × ℤ → ι) (p : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∀ z, p z ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (x : ℂ) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    expect (spatialRow old target p hp0 hp1 r x) f =
      f old+interpolate r (fun z => p z*(f (target z)-f old)) x

name: OAI.SignedDisk.IntrinsicMarks.anchor_step
statement:
lemma anchor_step (e : E) (δ : ℝ) (t : Tree ι E) (n : E) (p : List ι)
    (hp : validPath t p) {s : ℕ} (hs : s < p.length)
    (hm : markIndicator e δ t n (p.take (s+1)) = 0) :
    anchor e δ t n (p.take (s+1)) = anchor e δ t n (p.take s) ∧
      ‖direction e (vector (atPath t (p.take (s+1))))-anchor e δ t n (p.take s)‖ ≤ δ

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.badPiece_mass
statement:
lemma badPiece_mass {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k : ℕ) (p : ℂ) (S : Finset (Grid N))
    {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) :
    (badPiece hr hh k p S n).mass ≤ (scale r k)⁻¹*4*badPrice h r k S n

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.discounted_smallPiece_mass
statement:
lemma discounted_smallPiece_mass {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k : ℕ) (p : ℂ) (S : Finset (Grid N))
    {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (i : ErrorIndex N k) :
    (smallPiece hh hr k p S n i).size^(1/100:ℝ)*(smallPiece hh hr k p S n i).mass ≤
      (scale r k)⁻¹*2*(rho^(k-i.1)*
        (rootWeight S k i.1 i.2.1*densityDefect N r (fun x => coordinate n (sign i.2.2) (h x)) i.1 i.2.1))

    rootSum h r k (goodRoots h r k S n) n y+rootSum h r k (badRoots h r k S n) n y = rootSum h r k S n y

    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (k : ℕ) (p : ℂ) (S : Finset (Grid N))
    {n : ℂ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (i : ErrorIndex N k) :

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.smallPiece_pair_sum
statement:
lemma smallPiece_pair_sum {N : ℕ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.cellPrice_budget
statement:
theorem cellPrice_budget {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ)) {h : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : Integrable h)
    (hsupp : ∀ y, h y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) (m : ℕ) (P : ℕ → Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) :
    (∑ k ∈ range (m+1), ∑ p ∈ P k, cellPrice N r h k (cellRoots N p)) ≤
      1681*((fixedPalette.labels.card:ℝ)*2/(1-rho))*(∫ y, ‖h y‖)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.directional_cell_price
statement:
theorem directional_cell_price : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ))
    {g : ℂ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → Integrable (gradient g) →
    (∀ y, gradient g y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    {n : ℂ}, n ∈ fixedPalette.labels → ∀ {s : ℝ}, (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) →
    ∀ Q : Set ℂ, volume Q ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 1 →
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F ∧
      (∫⁻ X in Q, F X) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C*(scale r k)⁻¹*
        (badPrice (gradient g) r k (cellRoots N p) n+cellPrice N r (gradient g) k (cellRoots N p))) ∧
      ∀ X, ‖X‖ ≤ 2 → ∀ t,
        NeighborhoodRadius (fun Y => g (point (scale r k) p+scale r k • Y)) X t →
        ENNReal.ofReal (max 0 (-inner ℝ (axis n s)
          (∫ Y in Metric.ball X t, gradient (fun Z => g (point (scale r k) p+scale r k • Z)) Y))) ≤ F X

theorem filtered_spatial_cost (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ)

    {b : ℕ} (hb : b ≤ p.length) :
    pathCharge (packingCharge h r m q) p b ≤
      8*spatialConstant*particleSwitches h r m q p b+
      8*spatialConstant*pathCharge (pathEnergy h r m q) p b+(130*spatialConstant+1)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.size_cell_price
statement:
theorem size_cell_price : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ))
    {g : ℂ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → Integrable (gradient g) →
    (∀ y, gradient g y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) → ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    {n : ℂ}, n ∈ fixedPalette.labels → ∀ Q : Set ℂ, volume Q ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 1 →
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F ∧
      (∫⁻ X in Q, F X) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C*(scale r k)⁻¹*
        (rootMass (gradient g) r k (cellRoots N p)+cellPrice N r (gradient g) k (cellRoots N p))) ∧
      ∀ X, ‖X‖ ≤ 2 → ∀ t,
        EndpointRadius (fun Y => g (point (scale r k) p+scale r k • Y)) X t →
        ENNReal.ofReal ‖∫ Y in Metric.ball X t,
          gradient (fun Z => g (point (scale r k) p+scale r k • Z)) Y‖ ≤ F X

lemma green_restrict_density {ψ : ℂ → ℝ} {R X : ℝ}
    (hψs : ∀ z, ψ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hRX : R ≤ X)
    (β : ℂ → ℂ) {x : ℂ} (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ X) (y : ℂ) :
    ⟪green ψ x y, ({y : ℂ | ‖y‖ ≤ X}.indicator β) y⟫ = ⟪green ψ x y,β y⟫

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PlanePotential.green_root_lp_local
statement:
lemma green_root_lp_local {ψ : ℂ → ℝ} {β : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hψm : Measurable ψ) {R X B : ℝ}
    (hψs : ∀ z, ψ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hψB : ∀ z, |ψ z| ≤ B)
    (hRX : R ≤ X) (hM : 0 < R+X) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hX : 0 < X)
    (hβ : Integrable β) :
    (∫⁻ x in {x : ℂ | ‖x‖ ≤ X}, (ENNReal.ofReal |∫ y, ⟪green ψ x y,β y⟫|)^(3/2:ℝ)) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal ((2*B*(R+X)^2)^(3/2:ℝ)*(4*Real.pi*(4*X)^(1/2:ℝ))) *
      (ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y, ‖β y‖))^(3/2:ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.PlanePotential.green_zero_piece_lp_ae
statement:
lemma green_zero_piece_lp_ae {ψ : ℂ → ℝ} {β : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hψm : Measurable ψ) {R X B L a : ℝ}
    (hψs : ∀ z, ψ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hψB : ∀ z, |ψ z| ≤ B)
    (hψL : ∀ u v, |ψ u-ψ v| ≤ L*‖u-v‖)
    (hM : 0 < R+X) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (ha : 0 < a)
    (z : ℂ) (hβ : Integrable β) (hzero : ∫ y, β y = 0)
    (hβs : ∀ᵐ y, β y ≠ 0 → ‖y-z‖ ≤ a) :
    (∫⁻ x in {x : ℂ | ‖x‖ ≤ X},
      (ENNReal.ofReal |∫ y, ⟪green ψ x y,β y⟫|)^(3/2:ℝ)) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal ((8*Real.pi*(2*B*(R+X)^2)^(3/2:ℝ)+
      Real.pi*(8*B*(R+X)^2+(64/3:ℝ)*L*(R+X)^3)^(3/2:ℝ))*a^(1/2:ℝ)) *
      (ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y, ‖β y‖))^(3/2:ℝ)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.physical_directional_price
statement:
theorem physical_directional_price : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ))
    {g : ℂ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → Integrable (gradient g) →
    (∀ y, gradient g y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) →
    (∃ D : ℝ, ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ D) → ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    {n : ℂ}, n ∈ fixedPalette.labels → ∀ {s : ℝ}, (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) →
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F ∧
      (∫⁻ y in cell (point (scale r k) p) (scale r k), F y) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (C*(badPrice (gradient g) r k (cellRoots N p) n+cellPrice N r (gradient g) k (cellRoots N p))) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ cell (point (scale r k) p) (scale r k), ∀ t,
        PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (scale r k) y t →
        ENNReal.ofReal (max 0 (-inner ℝ (axis n s) (gradient (fun z => signedAverage g z t) y))) ≤ F y

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.physical_size_price
statement:
theorem physical_size_price : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ))
    {g : ℂ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → Integrable (gradient g) →
    (∀ y, gradient g y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) →
    (∃ D : ℝ, ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ D) → ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    {n : ℂ}, n ∈ fixedPalette.labels →
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F ∧
      (∫⁻ y in cell (point (scale r k) p) (scale r k), F y) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (C*(rootMass (gradient g) r k (cellRoots N p)+cellPrice N r (gradient g) k (cellRoots N p))) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ cell (point (scale r k) p) (scale r k), ∀ t,
        PhysicalEndpointRadius g (scale r k) y t →
        ENNReal.ofReal ‖gradient (fun z => signedAverage g z t) y‖ ≤ F y

    (hstep : ∀ k, 2*r (k+1) = r k) (old : Label) (m : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, leafSum (fun q => weight h r old x q*divergence (fun y => potential g r y q) x) m []) =
      -∫ x, leafSum (fun q => inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => weight h r old y q) x) (potential g r x q)) m []

statement:
lemma potential_divergence {g : ℂ → ℝ} {r : ℕ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g)
    (hgc : HasCompactSupport g) (hr : ∀ k, 0 < r k) (p : List Label) (x : ℂ)

statement:
lemma run_unfavorable_bound {g : ℂ → ℝ} {r : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hr : ∀ k, 0 < r k) (hstep : ∀ k, 2*r (k+1) = r k)
    (H : ℕ → Label → ℝ) (J : ℕ → ℝ) (hH : ∀ k n, 0 ≤ H k n) (hJ : ∀ k, 0 ≤ J k)
    (x : ℂ) (n : Label) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (runEnvelope g r i j) x)
    (hinterior : ∀ k t, PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (r k) x t →
      unfavorable n (gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x) ≤ H k n)
    (hend : ∀ k t, PhysicalEndpointRadius g (r k) x t →
      ‖gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x‖ ≤ J k) :
    unfavorable n (gradient (runEnvelope g r i j) x) ≤
      (∑ k ∈ Icc i j, H k n)+2*(J i+J j)

name: OAI.SignedDisk.SignedRuns.pointwise_signed_master
statement:
theorem pointwise_signed_master {g : ℂ → ℝ} (h : ℂ → ℂ) {r : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hr : ∀ k, 0 < r k) (hstep : ∀ k, 2*r (k+1) = r k)
    (H : ℕ → Label → ℝ) (J : ℕ → ℝ) (hH : ∀ k n, 0 ≤ H k n) (hJ : ∀ k, 0 ≤ J k)
    (old : Label) (m : ℕ) (x : ℂ)
    (hd : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → DifferentiableAt ℝ (runEnvelope g r i j) x)
    (hinterior : ∀ k n t, PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (r k) x t →
      unfavorable n (gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x) ≤ H k n)
    (hend : ∀ k t, PhysicalEndpointRadius g (r k) x t →
      ‖gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x‖ ≤ J k) :
    ‖gradient (runEnvelope g r 0 m) x‖ ≤ 12*(
      leafSum (fun q => weight h r old x q*divergence (fun y => potential g r y q) x) (m+1) []+
      (∑ k ∈ range (m+1), expect (marginal h r k x) (H k))+
      3*(∑ k ∈ range (m+1), boundaryCost h r x m k*J k))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.SignedRuns.run_cone_bound
statement:
lemma run_cone_bound {g : ℂ → ℝ} {r : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hr : ∀ k, 0 < r k) (hstep : ∀ k, 2*r (k+1) = r k)
    (H : ℕ → Label → ℝ) (J : ℕ → ℝ) (hH : ∀ k n, 0 ≤ H k n) (hJ : ∀ k, 0 ≤ J k)
    (x : ℂ) (n : Label) (p : List Label)
    (hd : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → DifferentiableAt ℝ (runEnvelope g r i j) x)
    (hinterior : ∀ k n t, PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (r k) x t →
      unfavorable n (gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x) ≤ H k n)
    (hend : ∀ k t, PhysicalEndpointRadius g (r k) x t →
      ‖gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x‖ ≤ J k) :
    ((runs (n::p)).map fun a => coneContribution a.dir (gradient (runEnvelope g r a.first a.last) x)).sum ≤
      divergence (fun y => potential g r y (n::p)) x+
      ((runs (n::p)).map fun a => J a.first).sum+
      ((runs (n::p)).map fun a => ∑ k ∈ Icc a.first a.last, H k a.dir).sum+
      2*((runs (n::p)).map fun a => J a.first+J a.last).sum

OAI.SignedDisk.SignedRuns.integrated_signed_master
statement:
theorem integrated_signed_master {g : ℂ → ℝ} (h : ℂ → ℂ) {r : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hr : ∀ k, 0 < r k) (hstep : ∀ k, 2*r (k+1) = r k)
    (H : ℕ → Label → ℂ → ℝ) (J : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ)
    (hH : ∀ k n x, 0 ≤ H k n x) (hJ : ∀ k x, 0 ≤ J k x)
    (old : Label) (m : ℕ)
    (hinterior : ∀ᵐ x, ∀ k n t, PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (r k) x t →
      unfavorable n (gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x) ≤ H k n x)
    (hend : ∀ᵐ x, ∀ k t, PhysicalEndpointRadius g (r k) x t →
      ‖gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x‖ ≤ J k x)
    (hvalue : ∀ᵐ x, ∀ k t t', 0 < t → t ≤ 4*r k → 0 < t' → t' ≤ 4*r k →
      |signedAverage g x t-signedAverage g x t'| ≤ r k*J k x)
    (hHi : ∀ k, k ≤ m → ∀ n, Integrable (H k n))
    (hJi : ∀ k, k ≤ m → Integrable (J k)) :
    (∫ x, ‖gradient (runEnvelope g r 0 m) x‖) ≤
      12*((∑ k ∈ range (m+1), ∫ x, expect (marginal h r k x) (fun n => H k n x))+
        4*(∑ k ∈ range (m+1), ∫ x, pointCost h r x m k*J k x))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.patched_unfavorable
statement:
theorem patched_unfavorable : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {N : ℕ} {base R : ℝ} (hb : 0 < base) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hN : R/base+1 ≤ (N:ℝ))
    {g : ℂ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → Integrable (gradient g) →
    (∀ y, gradient g y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) →
    (∃ D : ℝ, ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ D) →
    ∃ H : ℕ → Label → ℂ → ℝ,
      (∀ j n x, 0 ≤ H j n x) ∧ (∀ j n, Integrable (H j n)) ∧
      (∀ᵐ x, ∀ j n t, PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (scale base j) x t →
        unfavorable n (gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x) ≤ H j n x) ∧
      (∀ m n, (∑ j ∈ range (m+1), ∫ x, marginal (gradient g) (geometricRadii base m) (m-j) x n*H j n x) ≤
        C*(∫ y, ‖gradient g y‖))

name: OAI.SignedDisk.CommonPrices.physical_unfavorable_price

theorem physical_unfavorable_price : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {N : ℕ} {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hN : R/r+1 ≤ (N:ℝ))
    {g : ℂ → ℝ}, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → Integrable (gradient g) →
    (∀ y, gradient g y ≠ 0 → ‖y‖ ≤ R) →
    (∃ D : ℝ, ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ g y‖ ≤ D) → ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (n : Label),
    ∃ F : ℂ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F ∧
      (∫⁻ y in cell (point (scale r k) p) (scale r k), F y) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
        (C*(badPrice (gradient g) r k (cellRoots N p) n+cellPrice N r (gradient g) k (cellRoots N p))) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ cell (point (scale r k) p) (scale r k), ∀ t,
        PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (scale r k) y t →
        ENNReal.ofReal (unfavorable n (gradient (fun z => signedAverage g z t) y)) ≤ F y

statement:
lemma master_from_patches {g : ℂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g)
    {base : ℝ} (hb : 0 < base) (m : ℕ)
    (H : ℕ → Label → ℂ → ℝ) (J : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ)
    (hH : ∀ j n x, 0 ≤ H j n x) (hJ : ∀ j x, 0 ≤ J j x)
    (hHi : ∀ j n, Integrable (H j n)) (hJi : ∀ j, Integrable (J j))
    (hinterior : ∀ᵐ x, ∀ j n t, PhysicalNeighborhoodRadius g (scale base j) x t →
      unfavorable n (gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x) ≤ H j n x)
    (hend : ∀ᵐ x, ∀ j t, PhysicalEndpointRadius g (scale base j) x t →
      ‖gradient (fun y => signedAverage g y t) x‖ ≤ J j x)
    (hvalue : ∀ᵐ x, ∀ j t t', 0 < t → t ≤ 4*scale base j → 0 < t' → t' ≤ 4*scale base j →
      |signedAverage g x t-signedAverage g x t'| ≤ scale base j*J j x) :
    (∫ x, ‖gradient (runEnvelope g (geometricRadii base m) 0 m) x‖) ≤
      12*((∑ j ∈ range (m+1), ∫ x, expect (marginal (gradient g) (geometricRadii base m) (m-j) x) (fun n => H j n x))+
        4*(∑ j ∈ range (m+1), ∫ x, pointCost (gradient g) (geometricRadii base m) x m (m-j)*J j x))

OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.MatrixEnergy.contraction_deficit_identity
statement:
lemma contraction_deficit_identity
    (x : ι → ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ) (m n : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (hy : ∀ j, 0 < y j)
    (hn : ∀ i j, n i j = m i j * y j / x i)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, n i j = 1) (hcol : ∀ j, ∑ i, n i j = 1) :
    (∑ j, potential (y j)) - (∑ i, potential (x i)) =
      (∑ i, ∑ j, n i j * scalarRemainder (y j) (x i)) +
      (∑ i, (1 - ∑ j, m i j) * weight (x i)) / 2 +
      (∑ j, (1 - ∑ i, m i j) * weight (y j)) / 2

name: OAI.EuclideanSteinitz.MatrixEnergy.contraction_spectral_bound
statement:
lemma contraction_spectral_bound
    (x : ι → ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ) (m n : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (hy : ∀ j, 0 < y j)
    (hm : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ m i j)
    (hmrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, m i j ≤ 1) (hmcol : ∀ j, ∑ i, m i j ≤ 1)
    (hn : ∀ i j, n i j = m i j * y j / x i)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, n i j = 1) (hcol : ∀ j, ∑ i, n i j = 1) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, m i j * (1 + y j) * (cutoff (x i) - cutoff (y j)) ^ 2) +
      (∑ i, (1 - ∑ j, m i j) * cutoff (x i) ^ 2) +
      (∑ j, (1 - ∑ i, m i j) * (1 + y j) * cutoff (y j) ^ 2) ≤
        115200 * ((∑ j, potential (y j)) - (∑ i, potential (x i)))

statement:
lemma gain_deficit_identity
    (x : ι → ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ) (m n : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i)
    (hn : ∀ i j, n i j = m i j * y j / x i)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, m i j = 1) (hcol : ∀ j, ∑ i, m i j = 1) :
    (∑ i, potential (x i)) - (∑ j, potential (y j)) =
      (∑ i, ∑ j, m i j * scalarRemainder (x i) (y j)) +
