    (c : Fin n → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) (hm : Monotone c)
    (x : unitary D) {h : D} (hh : 0 ≤ h) {η t : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hclose : traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i, c i • e i) - h) ≤ η ^ 2 * t)
    (hmass : (τ.functional h).re ≤ t)
    (hcentral : traceOneNorm τ (h - (x : D) * h * star (x : D)) ≤ η ^ 2 * t) :
    ∑ j, orderedLayerWeights c j * traceTwoNorm τ
      ((x : D) * upperLayerCut e j - upperLayerCut e j * (x : D)) ^ 2 ≤ 6 * η * t

name: OAI.CurrentMain.raw_spectral_block
statement:
theorem raw_spectral_block (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hw1 : ∑ i, w i = 1) (v : I → D) (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ 1)
    (K : Finset D) (hK : ∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ 1) {η : ℝ}
    (T : BlockControl (Fintype.card I) η)
    {q : D} (hq : IsStarProjection q) (hq0 : q ≠ 0)
    (hcomp : ∀ i j, ∀ x ∈ insert 1 K, ∃ α : ℂ,
      ‖q * (star (v i) * x * v j) * q - α • q‖ < T.tolerance / 2) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, n ≤ Fintype.card I ∧ ∃ U : ProjectionRow (Fin n) q, ∃ c : Fin n → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) ∧ (∀ i, c i ≤ 1) ∧ Monotone c ∧
      (∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
        traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i, c i • U.atom i) - weightedAverage w v q) ≤
          η ^ 2 * (τ.functional q).re) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ e : Fin k ↪ Fin n, ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ H : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ,
        ‖(U.subrow e).sample q * x * (U.subrow e).sample q - (U.subrow e).matrix q H‖ < η)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.spectral_row_block
statement:
theorem spectral_row_block {q : D} (hq : IsStarProjection q)
    (f : D →ₚ[ℂ] ℂ) (hf : f 1 = 1) (a : I → D)
    (haq : ∀ i, a i * q = a i) (ha2 : ∑ i, ‖a i‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1)
    {M σ δ : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hasum : ∑ i, ‖a i‖ ≤ M)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, ‖rowPair a 1 i j - scalarRowGram f a i j • q‖ ≤ δ)
    (K : Finset D)
    (htest : ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ H : Matrix I I ℂ,
      ∀ i j, ‖rowPair a x i j - H i j • q‖ ≤ δ)
    (hKn : ∀ x ∈ K, ‖x‖ ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
      ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ)) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    let c := (scalarRowGram_posSemidef f a).isHermitian.eigenvalues
    let E := 2 * (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 3 * (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 3 * M *
      ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ)
    ∃ U : ProjectionRow {i : I // σ ≤ c i} q,
      (∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
        traceOneNorm τ ((∑ i : {i : I // σ ≤ c i}, c i • U.atom i) -
          ∑ i, a i * star (a i)) ≤
          ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) * ((M + 1) * E + (σ + (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ))) *
            (τ.functional q).re) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, ∃ H : Matrix {i : I // σ ≤ c i} {i : I // σ ≤ c i} ℂ,
        ∀ i j, ‖rowPair U.entry x i j - H i j • q‖ ≤
          E * (1 + (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ * M) + (Real.sqrt σ)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
            ((Fintype.card I : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ))

name: OAI.CurrentMain.weightedAverage_overlap
statement:
lemma weightedAverage_overlap {I : Type uI} [Fintype I]

name: OAI.CurrentMain.weighted_family_of_average
statement:
theorem weighted_family_of_average {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (hRR : RealRankZero D) (w : I → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hw1 : ∑ i, w i = 1) (v : I → D) (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ 1)
    (K : Finset (unitary D)) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1)
    (hcentral : ∀ q : D, IsStarProjection q → ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
      traceOneNorm τ (weightedAverage w v q - (x : D) * weightedAverage w v q * star (x : D)) ≤
        η ^ 2 * (τ.functional q).re)
    {r : D} (hr : IsStarProjection r) :
    ∃ F : WeightedBlockFamily r,
      (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ H : Matrix (Fin (F.columns j)) (Fin (F.columns j)) ℂ,
        ‖F.range j * (x : D) * F.range j - (F.row j).matrix (F.base j) H‖ < η) ∧
      (∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
        traceOneNorm τ (F.weightedSum - weightedAverage w v r) ≤ η ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ τ : Pureness.TracialState D,
        ∑ j, F.weight j * traceTwoNorm τ ((x : D) * F.range j - F.range j * (x : D)) ^ 2 ≤
          6 * η)

lemma exists_packing_step {I : Type uI} [Fintype I] {q z : D} (U : ProjectionRow I q)
    (hRR : RealRankZero D)
    (hsmall : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ g : D, IsStarProjection g ∧ IsFull g ∧
      (⨆ τ : Pureness.TracialState D, (τ.functional g).re) < δ)
    (hz : IsStarProjection z) (K : Finset (unitary D)) {c η ε : ℝ}
    (hc : c ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (hη : η < 1) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (happrox : ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ H : Matrix I I ℂ,
      ‖U.sample q * (x : D) * U.sample q - U.matrix q H‖ < η) :

      PackingStepBounds (U.sample q) z y t c η ε K

name: OAI.CurrentMain.diagonal_separation_certificate
statement:
theorem diagonal_separation_certificate (K : Finset (unitary A))
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hno : IsEmpty (PositiveDiagonal A K μ)) :
    ∃ (f : DiagonalTestSpace A K →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : ℝ),
      (∀ v : A, ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → f (diagonalTestAtom K v) ≤ c) ∧
      c < f (diagonalTestPoint K)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.exists_packing_parameters
statement:

    ∃ η : ℝ, ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧
      Real.sqrt (packingEnergy η n) < ε ∧
      (packingRemainder η n + packingBalance η n) / 2 < ε

name: OAI.CurrentMain.finite_packing_from_diagonals
statement:
theorem finite_packing_from_diagonals (ι : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] D) (hRR : RealRankZero D)
    (hsmall : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ g : D, IsStarProjection g ∧ IsFull g ∧
      (⨆ τ : Pureness.TracialState D, (τ.functional g).re) < δ)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1)
    (diagonals : ∀ K : Finset (unitary A), Nonempty (PositiveDiagonal A K (η ^ 2)))
    (n : ℕ) (K : Finset (unitary A)) :
    ∃ Q : OrthogonalProjectionPair D, PackingBounds ι Q K η n

name: OAI.CurrentMain.finite_set_splitting_from_diagonals
statement:
theorem finite_set_splitting_from_diagonals (ι : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] D)
    (hRR : RealRankZero D) (hT : Nonempty (Pureness.TracialState D))
    (hsmall : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ g : D, IsStarProjection g ∧ IsFull g ∧
      (⨆ τ : Pureness.TracialState D, (τ.functional g).re) < δ)
    (diagonals : ∀ (K : Finset (unitary A)) (μ : ℝ), 0 < μ → Nonempty (PositiveDiagonal A K μ))
    (K : Finset (unitary A)) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ P : D, IsStarProjection P ∧ ∀ x ∈ K,
      uniformTwoNorm (P * ι (x : A) - ι (x : A) * P) < ε ∧
      uniformHalvingError P (ι (x : A)) < ε

name: OAI.CurrentMain.completion_central_splitting_of_finite_stages
statement:
theorem completion_central_splitting_of_finite_stages
    (hfree : (U : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop)
    (hfinite : ∀ (K : Finset (unitary A)) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
      ∃ P : FamilyUltrapower (completionTrace τ) U, IsStarProjection P ∧ ∀ u ∈ K,
        familyTwoNorm (familyLimitTrace (completionTrace τ) U)
          (P * familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U (completionMap τ (u : A)) -
           familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U (completionMap τ (u : A)) * P) < ε ∧
        familyTraceNorm (familyLimitTrace (completionTrace τ) U)
          (P * familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U (completionMap τ (u : A)) -
           (1/2 : ℂ) • familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U (completionMap τ (u : A))) < ε) :
    ∃ p : FamilyUltrapower (completionTrace τ) U, IsStarProjection p ∧
      ∀ x : UniformTracialCompletion τ,
        p * familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U x =
          familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U x * p ∧
        ∀ s : ℕ → I, (familyLimitTrace (completionTrace τ) U s).functional
          (p * familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U x) =
          (1/2 : ℂ) * (familyLimitTrace (completionTrace τ) U s).functional
            (familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace τ) U x)

name: OAI.CurrentMain.diagonalize_finite_splittings
statement:
theorem diagonalize_finite_splittings (hfree : (U : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop)
    (x : ℕ → D)
    (hfinite : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ P : FamilyUltrapower τ U,
      IsStarProjection P ∧ ∀ k ≤ n,
        familyTwoNorm (familyLimitTrace τ U)
          (P * familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k) - familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k) * P) < ε ∧
        familyTraceNorm (familyLimitTrace τ U)
          (P * familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k) -
            (1/2 : ℂ) • familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k)) < ε) :
    ∃ p : FamilyUltrapower τ U, IsStarProjection p ∧ ∀ k : ℕ,
      p * familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k) = familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k) * p ∧
      ∀ s : ℕ → I, (familyLimitTrace τ U s).functional (p * familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k)) =
        (1/2 : ℂ) * (familyLimitTrace τ U s).functional (familyUltrapowerMap τ U (x k))

name: OAI.CurrentMain.exists_coordinate_split
statement:
lemma exists_coordinate_split (K : Finset D) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    {P : FamilyUltrapower τ U} (hP : IsStarProjection P)
    (hc : ∀ x ∈ K, familyTwoNorm (familyLimitTrace τ U)
      (P * familyUltrapowerMap τ U x - familyUltrapowerMap τ U x * P) < ε)
    (hh : ∀ x ∈ K, familyTraceNorm (familyLimitTrace τ U)
      (P * familyUltrapowerMap τ U x - (1/2 : ℂ) • familyUltrapowerMap τ U x) < ε) :
    ∃ b : D, IsSelfAdjoint b ∧ ‖b‖ ≤ 2 ∧ familyTwoNorm τ (b*b-b) < ε ∧
      ∀ x ∈ K, familyTwoNorm τ (b*x-x*b) < ε ∧
        familyTraceNorm τ (b*x-(1/2 : ℂ) • x) < ε

name: OAI.CurrentMain.rr_central_splitting_from_diagonals
statement:
theorem rr_central_splitting_from_diagonals
    (hfree : (U : Filter ℕ) ≤ atTop)
    (hsimple : TopologicallySimple A) (hinf : ¬FiniteDimensional ℂ A)
    (hRR : RealRankZero (FamilyUltrapower (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U))
    (diagonals : ∀ (K : Finset (unitary A)) (μ : ℝ), 0 < μ → Nonempty (PositiveDiagonal A K μ)) :
    ∃ p : FamilyUltrapower (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U,
      IsStarProjection p ∧ ∀ x : UniformTracialCompletion (fun τ : TracialState A => τ),
        p * familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U x =
          familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U x * p ∧
        ∀ s : ℕ → TracialState A,
          (familyLimitTrace (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U s).functional
            (p * familyUltrapowerMap (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U x) =
          (1/2 : ℂ) *
          (familyLimitTrace (completionTrace (fun τ : TracialState A => τ)) U s).functional

statement:
lemma inward_pairing_identity {r : Bool} {D : Set Node} (hD : Initial D) {h g : Node → ℝ}
    (hsupp : ∀ s, s ∉ D → h s = 0) (x y : TreeCoordinate r →₀ ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s, x s ≠ 0 → s.val ∈ D) (hy : ∀ s, s.val ∈ D → y s = 0)
    (a θ t : ℝ) :
    treePairing (a • h + θ • inwardCoeffsOne D h g) (x + t • y) +
      treePairing (a • h + θ • inwardCoeffsTwo D h g) (x - t • y) =
      2 * a * treePairing h x + t * θ * treePairing g y

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.liftCoefficients_coord

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.paired_finite_inequality
statement:
theorem paired_finite_inequality {r : Bool} {k : QuadraticKind} {D : Set Node}
    (hD : Initial D) (hroot : [] ∈ D)
    (x y : TreeCoordinate r →₀ ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s, x s ≠ 0 → s.val ∈ D) (hy : ∀ s, s.val ∈ D → y s = 0)
    {a θ t : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1/2)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hsquare : a^2 + θ^2 ≤ 1) :
    a * testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) x + (t * θ / 2) * testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) y ≤
      (testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) (x + t • y) + testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) (x - t • y)) / 2

name: OAI.BoundedTreePotentials.TreeCalculus.paired_finite_test_bound
statement:
theorem paired_finite_test_bound {r : Bool} {k : QuadraticKind} {D : Set Node}
    (hD : Initial D) (hroot : [] ∈ D)
    (x y : TreeCoordinate r →₀ ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ s, x s ≠ 0 → s.val ∈ D) (hy : ∀ s, s.val ∈ D → y s = 0)
    {a θ t : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1/2)
    (hsquare : a^2 + θ^2 ≤ 1)
    (f g : treeTestFamily r k) :
    a * finitePairing f.val x + (t * θ / 2) * finitePairing g.val y ≤
      (testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) (x + t • y) + testNorm (treeTestFamily r k) (x - t • y)) / 2

theorem operator_norm_le_ten (M : E →L[ℝ] F) (s : Finset E) (t : Finset F)
    (_hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ‖x‖ = 1) (ht : ∀ y ∈ t, ‖y‖ = 1)
    (hsnet : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 → ∃ x₀ ∈ s, ‖x-x₀‖ ≤ (1/4 : ℝ))
    (htnet : ∀ y : F, ‖y‖ = 1 → ∃ y₀ ∈ t, ‖y-y₀‖ ≤ (1/4 : ℝ))
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, |inner ℝ (M x) y| ≤ 5) : ‖M‖ ≤ 10

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.bilinear_test
statement:
theorem bilinear_test (σ : K × I → Bool) (e : J ↪ I) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ K) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ J) :
    inner ℝ (synthesis σ e z) w = FiniteSigns.value (testCoefficients e w z) σ

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.extend_apply

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.sign_sq

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.sum_extend_sq

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.testCoefficients_sq

theorem testCoefficients_sq [Nonempty K] (e : J ↪ I) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ K) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ J)
    (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) :
    ∑ ai, (testCoefficients e w z ai)^2 = 1 / (Fintype.card K : ℝ)

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.vector_apply
statement:

name: OAI.Dixmier.SignMatrix.vector_norm

name: OAI.Dixmier.FrameParameters.exact_failure_bound

name: OAI.Dixmier.InvariantProjection.conjugated_apply

@[simp] theorem conjugated_apply (π : G →* (H →L[ℂ] H)) (S : H ≃L[ℂ] H) (g : G) (x : H) :

name: OAI.Dixmier.InvariantProjection.exists_commuting_projection

theorem exists_commuting_projection (π : G →* (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (hπ : SimilarToUnitary π) (M : ClosedSubmodule ℂ H)
    (hM : ∀ g x, x ∈ M → π g x ∈ M) :
    ∃ P : H →L[ℂ] H, (∀ x, P x ∈ M) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∈ M → P x = x) ∧ ∀ g, Commute P (π g)

    (hM : ∀ g x, x ∈ M → U g x ∈ M) (g : G) :
    Commute M.toSubmodule.starProjection (U g)

      X.faceMap h side (X.faceMap h' side' x)

theorem faceMap_succ (X : GlobularSet.{u}) (m : ℕ) (side : Bool) :

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.faceMap_target

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.weakEquivalence_of_partialPath_data
statement:
theorem weakEquivalence_of_partialPath_data {C : GlobularTheory.{v}}
    (hC : C.IsCoherator) {X Y : C.Model} (hX : X.IsCellular)
    (n : ℕ) (a : disk C n ⟶ X) (i : X ⟶ Y) (b : disk C (n+1) ⟶ Y)
    (sq : IsPushout a (J C n) i b)
    (PX PY : C.Model) (pX₀ pX₁ : PX ⟶ X) (pY₀ pY₁ : PY ⟶ Y)
    (Pi : PX ⟶ PY) (nat₀ : Pi ≫ pY₀ = pX₀ ≫ i) (nat₁ : Pi ≫ pY₁ = pX₁ ≫ i)
    (hpX₀ : GlobularSet.LiftsBoundaries (underlyingMap pX₀))
    (hpX₁ : GlobularSet.LiftsBoundaries (underlyingMap pX₁))
    (hpY₀ : GlobularSet.LiftsBoundaries (underlyingMap pY₀))
    (hpY₁ : GlobularSet.LiftsBoundaries (underlyingMap pY₁))
    (joint : ∀ (t : disk C n ⟶ PY) (u₀ u₁ : disk C (n+1) ⟶ Y),
      t ≫ pY₀ = J C n ≫ u₀ → t ≫ pY₁ = J C n ≫ u₁ →
      ∃ l : disk C (n+1) ⟶ PY,
        J C n ≫ l = t ∧ l ≫ pY₀ = u₀ ∧ l ≫ pY₁ = u₁) :
    WeakEquivalence hC i

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.lift_operation
statement:
theorem lift_operation {X Y : GlobularSet.{v}} (η : X.Hom Y)
    {A B : Type v} (f : A → B) (n : ℕ)
    (s t : A → X.Cell n) (s' t' : B → Y.Cell n)
    (hs : ∀ a, η.app n (s a) = s' (f a))
    (ht : ∀ a, η.app n (t a) = t' (f a))
    (hp : ∀ b, Y.Parallel n (s' b) (t' b))
    (z : A → X.Cell (n+1)) (hzs : ∀ a, X.source n (z a) = s a)
    (hzt : ∀ a, X.target n (z a) = t a)
    (h : Function.Bijective f ∨ Function.Bijective (Y.boundary (n+1))) :
    ∃ z' : B → Y.Cell (n+1),
      (∀ b, Y.source n (z' b) = s' b) ∧
      (∀ b, Y.target n (z' b) = t' b) ∧
      (∀ a, η.app (n+1) (z a) = z' (f a))

statement:
theorem cutoffLow_face (X : GlobularSet.{u}) {q n : ℕ} (h : n+1 ≤ q)
    (side : Bool) (x : (X.cutoff q).Cell (n+1)) :
    X.cutoffLow (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ n) h) (X.cutoffFace q n side x) =
      (if side then X.target n else X.source n) (X.cutoffLow h x)

theorem cutoffLow_parallel (X : GlobularSet.{u}) {q n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ q)

    (X.cutoff q).Parallel n x y ↔ X.Parallel n (X.cutoffLow h x) (X.cutoffLow h y)

theorem cutoffUnitCell_face (X : GlobularSet.{u}) (q n : ℕ) (side : Bool)

      X.cutoffFace q n side (X.cutoffUnitCell q (n+1) x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.cutoffUnitCell_high

@[simp]
theorem cutoffUnitCell_high (X : GlobularSet.{u}) {q n : ℕ} (h : q < n) (x : X.Cell n) :
    X.cutoffHigh h (X.cutoffUnitCell q n x) =
      ⟨(X.faceMap h false x, X.faceMap h true x), X.faceMap_parallel h x⟩

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.cutoffUnitCell_low
statement:

theorem cutoffUnitCell_low (X : GlobularSet.{u}) {q n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ q) (x : X.Cell n) :

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.cutoff_seam_face

theorem cutoff_seam_face (X : GlobularSet.{u}) (q : ℕ) (side : Bool)

    X.cutoffLow (q := q) le_rfl (X.cutoffFace q q side x) =

    (q : ℕ) (X : C.Model) (Y Y' : CutoffModels C q) (g : Y ⟶ Y')
    (h : cutoffObject hC q X ⟶ Y) :
    cutoffEquiv hC q X Y' (h ≫ g) = cutoffEquiv hC q X Y h ≫ g.hom

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffUnit_low_bijective
statement:
theorem cutoffUnit_low_bijective {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) (X : C.Model) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ q) :
    Function.Bijective ((underlyingMap (cutoffUnit hC q X)).app k)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffUnit_universal
statement:
theorem cutoffUnit_universal {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) (X : C.Model) (Y : CutoffModels C q) (f : X ⟶ Y.obj) :
    ∃! l : chosenCutoff hC q X ⟶ Y.obj, cutoffUnit hC q X ≫ l = f

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoff_hasColimits
statement:
theorem cutoff_hasColimits {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) : HasColimitsOfSize.{v,v} (CutoffModels C q)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.elementary_pushout_low_bijective
statement:
theorem elementary_pushout_low_bijective {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    {X Y : C.Model} (n : ℕ) (a : disk C n ⟶ X) (i : X ⟶ Y)
    (b : disk C (n+1) ⟶ Y) (sq : IsPushout a (J C n) i b)
    (k : ℕ) (hkn : k < n) :
    Function.Bijective ((underlyingMap i).app k)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.elementary_pushout_to_coskeletal
statement:
theorem elementary_pushout_to_coskeletal {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    {X Y : C.Model} (n : ℕ) (a : disk C n ⟶ X) (i : X ⟶ Y)
    (b : disk C (n+1) ⟶ Y) (sq : IsPushout a (J C n) i b)
    (hY : Y.IsCoskeletal n) : WeakEquivalence hC i

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.local_sums
statement:
theorem local_sums (C : GlobularTheory.{v})
    (P : C.sumComparisons.isLocal.FullSubcategory) (t : SumIndex) :
    IsPullback
      (P.obj.map (C.toTheoryData.arity.map (t.S.inl t.b t.h t.left t.right)).op)
      (P.obj.map (C.toTheoryData.arity.map (t.S.inr t.b t.h t.left t.right)).op)
      (P.obj.map (C.toTheoryData.arity.map (t.S.seam t.left)).op)
      (P.obj.map (C.toTheoryData.arity.map (Shape.face t.right false)).op)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.low_bijections_eq_local
statement:
theorem low_bijections_eq_local (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) (hC : C.IsCoherator) (q : ℕ) :
    (fun {X Y : C.Model} (f : X ⟶ Y) =>
      ∀ k, k ≤ q → Function.Bijective ((underlyingMap f).app k) : MorphismProperty C.Model) =
    ObjectProperty.isLocal (fun X : C.Model => X.IsCoskeletal q)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.low_bijective_transfinite
statement:
theorem low_bijective_transfinite {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) {X Y : C.Model} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {J : Type v} [LinearOrder J] [OrderBot J] [SuccOrder J] [WellFoundedLT J]
    (H : TransfiniteCompositionOfShape J f)
    (hH : ∀ j, ¬ IsMax j → ∀ k, k ≤ q → Function.Bijective
      ((underlyingMap (H.F.map (homOfLE (Order.le_succ j)))).app k)) :
    ∀ k, k ≤ q → Function.Bijective ((underlyingMap f).app k)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.sums_local
statement:
theorem sums_local {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (M : C.Model) :
    C.sumComparisons.isLocal M.presheaf

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.sumComparison_local_iff
statement:
theorem sumComparison_local_iff (C : GlobularTheory.{v})
    (P : C.Objᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v) (t : SumIndex) :
    (MorphismProperty.single (C.sumComparison t)).isLocal P ↔
      IsPullback
        (P.map (C.toTheoryData.arity.map (t.S.inl t.b t.h t.left t.right)).op)
        (P.map (C.toTheoryData.arity.map (t.S.inr t.b t.h t.left t.right)).op)
        (P.map (C.toTheoryData.arity.map (t.S.seam t.left)).op)
        (P.map (C.toTheoryData.arity.map (Shape.face t.right false)).op)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.sumComparisons_rightAdjoint
statement:
theorem sumComparisons_rightAdjoint (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) :
    C.sumComparisons.isLocal.ι.IsRightAdjoint

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Globe.faceLE_of_lt

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Globe.faceLE_refl

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.disk_hom_ext

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.faceLE_cap_bijective

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.faceLE_low_bijective
statement:

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.faceLE_of_lt
statement:
@[simp] theorem faceLE_of_lt {m n : ℕ} (h : m < n) (side : Bool) :

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.faceLE_refl

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.face_comp_eq_of_app_eq
statement:
theorem face_comp_eq_of_app_eq {m n : ℕ} {X : GlobularPresheaf.{u}}
    (h : m < n) (s : Bool) (a b : disk n ⟶ X)
    (hab : a.app (op (Globe.mk m)) = b.app (op (Globe.mk m))) :
    face h s ≫ a = face h s ≫ b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.face_comp_faceLE
statement:
theorem face_comp_faceLE {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a < b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (s t : Bool) :

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.face_low_bijective
statement:
theorem face_low_bijective {m n k : ℕ} (h : m < n) (hk : k < m) (side : Bool) :

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.face_low_equal
statement:
theorem face_low_equal {m n k : ℕ} (h : m < n) (hk : k < m) (b c : Bool) :
    (face.{u} h b).app (op (Globe.mk k)) = (face h c).app (op (Globe.mk k))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.globeMap_low_equal
statement:
theorem globeMap_low_equal {m n k : ℕ} (f g : Globe.mk m ⟶ Globe.mk n) (hk : k < m) :
    (uliftYoneda.{u}.map f).app (op (Globe.mk k)) =
      (uliftYoneda.{u}.map g).app (op (Globe.mk k))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.pushout_comparison_isIso
OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.existsUnique_factor_low_bijective
statement:
theorem existsUnique_factor_low_bijective {X R Y : GlobularPresheaf.{u}}
    (η : X ⟶ R) (f : X ⟶ Y) (q : ℕ)
    (hη : ∀ k, k ≤ q → Function.Bijective (η.app (op (Globe.mk k))))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.precomp_bijective_low
statement:
theorem precomp_bijective_low {X R Y : GlobularPresheaf.{u}}
    (η : X ⟶ R) (q : ℕ)
    (hη : ∀ k, k ≤ q → Function.Bijective (η.app (op (Globe.mk k))))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.underlyingMap_injective
statement:
theorem underlyingMap_injective {X Y : GlobularPresheaf.{u}} :

name: OAI.Grothendieck.TupleSystem.map_bijective_of_low
statement:
theorem map_bijective_of_low {T : TupleSystem.{v}} {S R : Shape} (f : S ⟶ R)

statement:
theorem Hom.boundaryMap_bijective_of_low {X Y : GlobularSet.{u}} (f : Hom X Y)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.Hom.reflects_parallel_of_low
statement:

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem compCell_source {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator) (n : ℕ)
    (a b : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) (hab : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b) :
    X.underlying.source n (X.compCell hC n a b hab) = X.underlying.source n a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem compCell_target {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator) (n : ℕ)
    (a b : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) (hab : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b) :
    X.underlying.target n (X.compCell hC n a b hab) = X.underlying.target n b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compositionTuple_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem compositionTuple_left {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (n : ℕ)
    (a b : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) (hab : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b) :
    X.eval (C.base (compositionLeft n)) (X.compositionTuple n a b hab) = a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compositionTuple_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem compositionTuple_right {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (n : ℕ)
    (a b : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) (hab : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b) :
    X.eval (C.base (compositionRight n)) (X.compositionTuple n a b hab) = b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoff_freeShape_hasFillers

theorem cutoff_freeShape_hasFillers (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) (hC : C.IsCoherator)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.freeShapeMap_low_bijective
statement:
theorem freeShapeMap_low_bijective {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.freeShape_hasFillers
statement:
theorem freeShape_hasFillers (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) (hC : C.IsCoherator) (S : Shape) :

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.freeShape_joined

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.inverseCell_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverseCell_source {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    X.underlying.source n (X.inverseCell hC n a) = X.underlying.target n a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.inverseCell_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverseCell_target {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    X.underlying.target n (X.inverseCell hC n a) = X.underlying.source n a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.map_eval
statement:
theorem map_eval {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} {X Y : C.Model} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {S T : Shape} (a : C.Hom S T) (t : X.presheaf.obj (op (⟨T⟩ : C.Obj))) :
    f.app (op (⟨S⟩ : C.Obj)) (X.eval a t) =
      Y.eval a (f.app (op (⟨T⟩ : C.Obj)) t)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.map_inverseCell
statement:
theorem map_inverseCell {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} {X Y : C.Model} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hC : C.IsCoherator) (n : ℕ) (a : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    (underlyingMap f).app (n+1) (X.inverseCell hC n a) =
      Y.inverseCell hC n ((underlyingMap f).app (n+1) a)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.sumTuple_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem sumTuple_left {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model)
    (S : Shape) (b h : ℕ) (hl : b < S.1) (hr : b < h)
    (a : X.presheaf.obj (op (⟨S⟩ : C.Obj))) (d : X.underlying.Cell h)
    (w : X.eval (C.base (S.seam hl)) a = X.eval (C.base (Shape.face hr false)) d) :
    X.eval (C.base (S.inl b h hl hr)) (X.sumTuple S b h hl hr a d w) = a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.sumTuple_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem sumTuple_right {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model)
    (S : Shape) (b h : ℕ) (hl : b < S.1) (hr : b < h)
    (a : X.presheaf.obj (op (⟨S⟩ : C.Obj))) (d : X.underlying.Cell h)
    (w : X.eval (C.base (S.seam hl)) a = X.eval (C.base (Shape.face hr false)) d) :
    X.eval (C.base (S.inr b h hl hr)) (X.sumTuple S b h hl hr a d w) = d

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.composition_source
statement:
theorem composition_source (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) (hC : C.IsCoherator) (n : ℕ) :
    C.comp (C.base (Shape.source n)) (C.composition hC n) =
      C.base (Shape.source n ≫ compositionLeft n)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.composition_target
statement:
theorem composition_target (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) (hC : C.IsCoherator) (n : ℕ) :
    C.comp (C.base (Shape.target n)) (C.composition hC n) =
      C.base (Shape.target n ≫ compositionRight n)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.inverse_source
statement:
theorem inverse_source (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) (hC : C.IsCoherator) (n : ℕ) :
    C.comp (C.base (Shape.source n)) (C.inverse hC n) = C.base (Shape.target n)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.inverse_target
statement:
theorem inverse_target (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) (hC : C.IsCoherator) (n : ℕ) :
    C.comp (C.base (Shape.target n)) (C.inverse hC n) = C.base (Shape.source n)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.HasFillers.joined
statement:
theorem HasFillers.joined {X : GlobularSet.{u}} (hX : X.HasFillers)
    {n : ℕ} {a b : X.Cell n} (hp : X.Parallel n a b) : X.Joined n a b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.HasFillers.retract
statement:
theorem HasFillers.retract {X Y : GlobularSet.{u}} (hY : Y.HasFillers)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.Hom.boundaryMap_id
statement:
theorem Hom.boundaryMap_id (X : GlobularSet.{u}) (n : ℕ) (b : X.Boundary n) :
    (Hom.id X).boundaryMap n b = b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.hasFillers_of_endpoint_factorization
statement:
theorem hasFillers_of_endpoint_factorization {X Y P : GlobularSet.{u}}
    (hX : X.HasFillers) (i : Hom X Y) (r : Hom Y X) (h : Hom Y P)
    (p₀ p₁ : Hom P Y) (hh₀ : h.comp p₀ = Hom.id Y)
    (hh₁ : h.comp p₁ = r.comp i) (hp₁ : LiftsBoundaries p₁) : Y.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.liftsBoundary_of_contractible
statement:
theorem liftsBoundary_of_contractible {X Y : GlobularSet.{u}} (f : Hom X Y)
    (hX : X.HasFillers) (hY : Y.HasFillers) (n : ℕ) (hf : LiftsSource f n)
    (b : X.Boundary n) (y : Y.Cell n) (hy : Y.boundary n y = f.boundaryMap n b) :
    ∃ x : X.Cell n, X.boundary n x = b ∧ f.app n x = y

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_assoc
statement:
theorem compCell_assoc {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a b c : X.underlying.Cell (n+1))
    (hab : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b)
    (hbc : X.underlying.target n b = X.underlying.source n c) :
    X.underlying.Joined (n+1)
      (X.compCell hC n (X.compCell hC n a b hab) c (by rw [compCell_target, hbc]))
      (X.compCell hC n a (X.compCell hC n b c hbc) (by rw [compCell_source, hab]))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_inverse_left
statement:
theorem compCell_inverse_left {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    X.underlying.Joined (n+1)
      (X.compCell hC n (X.inverseCell hC n a) a (X.inverseCell_target hC n a))
      (X.unitCell hC n (X.underlying.target n a))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_inverse_right
statement:
theorem compCell_inverse_right {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    X.underlying.Joined (n+1)
      (X.compCell hC n a (X.inverseCell hC n a) (X.inverseCell_source hC n a).symm)
      (X.unitCell hC n (X.underlying.source n a))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_left_unit
statement:
theorem compCell_left_unit {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    X.underlying.Joined (n+1)
      (X.compCell hC n (X.unitCell hC n (X.underlying.source n a)) a
        (X.unitCell_target hC n _)) a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_right_unit
statement:
theorem compCell_right_unit {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a : X.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    X.underlying.Joined (n+1)
      (X.compCell hC n a (X.unitCell hC n (X.underlying.target n a))
        (X.unitCell_source hC n _).symm) a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.joined_of_parallel_expressions
statement:
theorem joined_of_parallel_expressions {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model)
    (hC : C.IsCoherator) (S : Shape) (n : ℕ)
    (a b : (freeShape C S).underlying.Cell n)
    (hp : (freeShape C S).underlying.Parallel n a b)
    (t : X.presheaf.obj (op (⟨S⟩ : C.Obj))) :
    X.underlying.Joined n (X.eval a t) (X.eval b t)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.map_compCell
statement:
theorem map_compCell {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} {X Y : C.Model} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hC : C.IsCoherator) (n : ℕ) (a b : X.underlying.Cell (n+1))
    (hab : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b) :
    (underlyingMap f).app (n+1) (X.compCell hC n a b hab) =
      Y.compCell hC n ((underlyingMap f).app (n+1) a) ((underlyingMap f).app (n+1) b)
        (by rw [← (underlyingMap f).target_app, ← (underlyingMap f).source_app, hab])

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.map_compositionTuple

    (hab : X.underlying.target n a = X.underlying.source n b) :
    f.app (op (⟨compositionShape n⟩ : C.Obj)) (X.compositionTuple n a b hab) =
      Y.compositionTuple n ((underlyingMap f).app (n+1) a) ((underlyingMap f).app (n+1) b)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.hasLiftingProperty_I_iff
statement:
theorem hasLiftingProperty_I_iff {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} {X Y : C.Model}
    (n : ℕ) (p : X ⟶ Y) :
    HasLiftingProperty (I C n) p ↔
      ∀ (b : X.underlying.Boundary n) (y : Y.underlying.Cell n),
        Y.underlying.boundary n y = (underlyingMap p).boundaryMap n b →
        ∃ x : X.underlying.Cell n,
          X.underlying.boundary n x = b ∧ (underlyingMap p).app n x = y

theorem hasLiftingProperty_J_iff {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} {X Y : C.Model}

    HasLiftingProperty (J C n) p ↔
      ∀ (x : X.underlying.Cell n) (y : Y.underlying.Cell (n+1)),
        Y.underlying.source n y = (underlyingMap p).app n x →
        ∃ z : X.underlying.Cell (n+1),
          X.underlying.source n z = x ∧ (underlyingMap p).app (n+1) z = y

statement:
theorem free_hasFillers_of_top_homotopy {C : GlobularTheory.{v}}
    (hC : C.IsCoherator) (q n : ℕ) (H : ExpansionContraction hC q (n+1))
    (S : GlobularPresheaf.{v})
    (hS : ∀ k, n+1 < k → IsEmpty (S.underlying.Cell k))
    (L : CutoffModels C q) (hL : Cofibrant hC q L)
    (hLF : L.obj.underlying.HasFillers)
    (f : (cutoffFreeGlobular hC q).obj S ⟶ L)
    (g : L ⟶ (cutoffFreeGlobular hC q).obj S)
    (hlo : ∀ k, k ≤ n → ∀ x,
      (underlyingMap (f ≫ g).hom).app k
        (GlobularPresheaf.underlyingMap ((cutoffGlobularAdjunction hC q).unit.app S) |>.app k x) =
      (GlobularPresheaf.underlyingMap ((cutoffGlobularAdjunction hC q).unit.app S)).app k x)
    (htop : ∀ x, ((cutoffFreeGlobular hC q).obj S).obj.underlying.Joined (n+1)
      ((underlyingMap (f ≫ g).hom).app (n+1)
        ((GlobularPresheaf.underlyingMap ((cutoffGlobularAdjunction hC q).unit.app S)).app (n+1) x))
      ((GlobularPresheaf.underlyingMap ((cutoffGlobularAdjunction hC q).unit.app S)).app (n+1) x)) :
    ((cutoffFreeGlobular hC q).obj S).obj.underlying.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.RelativeLiftStage.exists_cell
statement:
theorem exists_cell (r k : ℕ)
    (hi : Function.Injective (i.app k))
    (hlo : k < r → Function.Surjective (i.app k))
    (hp : r ≤ k → LiftsBoundary p k)
    (sq : a.comp p = i.comp b)
    (bd : B.Cell k → X.Boundary k)
    (hbd : ∀ x, X.boundary k (a.app k x) = bd (i.app k x))
    (hbp : ∀ y, Y.boundary k (b.app k y) = p.boundaryMap k (bd y)) :
    ∃ z : B.Cell k → X.Cell k,
      (∀ y, X.boundary k (z y) = bd y) ∧
      (∀ y, p.app k (z y) = b.app k y) ∧
      (∀ x, z (i.app k x) = a.app k x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.RelativeLiftStage.succ_old
statement:
theorem succ_old (r : ℕ)

    (hp : ∀ k, r ≤ k → LiftsBoundary p k) (sq : a.comp p = i.comp b)
    {n : ℕ} (s : RelativeLiftStage i a p b n) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) (x : B.Cell k) :
    (s.succ r hi hlo hp sq).app k (by omega) x = s.app k hk x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.relative_lift

    (hlo : ∀ k, k < r → Function.Surjective (i.app k))

    ∃ l : Hom B X, i.comp l = a ∧ l.comp p = b

theorem cutoffFreeGlobular_map_cofibration {C : GlobularTheory.{v}}
    (hC : C.IsCoherator) (q r : ℕ) {S T : GlobularPresheaf.{v}} (i : S ⟶ T)
    (hi : ∀ k, Function.Injective ((GlobularPresheaf.underlyingMap i).app k))
    (hlo : ∀ k, k < r → Function.Surjective ((GlobularPresheaf.underlyingMap i).app k)) :
    (boundaryClass hC q r).rlp.llp ((cutoffFreeGlobular hC q).map i)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoff_hasFillers_iff
statement:
theorem cutoff_hasFillers_iff {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) (X : CutoffModels C q) :
    X.obj.underlying.HasFillers ↔ ∀ n (f : cutoffBoundary hC q n ⟶ X),
      ∃ g : cutoffDisk hC q n ⟶ X, cutoffI hC q n ≫ g = f

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoff_hasLimits
statement:
theorem cutoff_hasLimits {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) : HasLimitsOfSize.{v,v} (CutoffModels C q)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.expansionContraction_of_paths
statement:
theorem expansionContraction_of_paths {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q r : ℕ) (D : ∀ Y, Nonempty (CutoffPathData hC q r Y)) :
    ExpansionContraction hC q r

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.weakEquivalence_of_cutoff_path
statement:
theorem weakEquivalence_of_cutoff_path {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q r : ℕ) {X Y : CutoffModels C q} (i : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : (sourceClass hC q r).rlp.llp i) (hX : Cofibrant hC q X)
    (z : Y ⟶ X) (hz : i ≫ z = 𝟙 X) (P : CutoffPathData hC q r Y) :
    WeakEquivalence hC i.hom

name: OAI.Grothendieck.lifting_terminal_iff
statement:
theorem lifting_terminal_iff {K : Type u} [Category.{v} K] [HasTerminal K]
    {A B : K} (j : A ⟶ B) (X : K) :
    HasLiftingProperty j (terminal.from X) ↔ ∀ a : A ⟶ X, ∃ b : B ⟶ X, j ≫ b = a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.whiskering_hom_ext
statement:
theorem whiskering_hom_ext {X Y : GlobularPresheaf.{u}} (n : ℕ) (ε : Bool)
    (f g : (whiskering n ε).obj X ⟶ Y)
    (hbase : ∀ k x, f.app (op (Globe.mk k)) (.base k x) =
      g.app (op (Globe.mk k)) (.base k x))
    (hedge : ∀ x, f.app (op (Globe.mk (n+1))) (.edge x) =
      g.app (op (Globe.mk (n+1))) (.edge x)) : f = g

OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.WhiskerCell.source_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem source_base {X : GlobularSet.{u}} (n : ℕ) (ε : Bool)
    (k : ℕ) (x : X.Cell (k+1)) :
    source n ε k (.base _ x) = .base _ (X.source k x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.WhiskerCell.source_edge
statement:
@[simp] theorem source_edge {X : GlobularSet.{u}} (n : ℕ) (ε : Bool)
    (x : X.Cell n) : source n ε n (.edge x) = if ε then .tip x else .base _ x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.WhiskerCell.source_tip
statement:
@[simp] theorem source_tip {X : GlobularSet.{u}} (ε : Bool)
    (k : ℕ) (x : X.Cell (k+1)) :
    source (k+1) ε k (.tip x) = .base _ (X.source k x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.WhiskerCell.target_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem target_base {X : GlobularSet.{u}} (n : ℕ) (ε : Bool)
    (k : ℕ) (x : X.Cell (k+1)) :
    target n ε k (.base _ x) = .base _ (X.target k x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.WhiskerCell.target_edge
statement:
@[simp] theorem target_edge {X : GlobularSet.{u}} (n : ℕ) (ε : Bool)
    (x : X.Cell n) : target n ε n (.edge x) = if ε then .base _ x else .tip x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.WhiskerCell.target_tip
statement:
@[simp] theorem target_tip {X : GlobularSet.{u}} (ε : Bool)
    (k : ℕ) (x : X.Cell (k+1)) :
    target (k+1) ε k (.tip x) = .base _ (X.target k x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.whiskerMap_injective
statement:
theorem whiskerMap_injective {X Y : GlobularSet.{u}} (f : Hom X Y)
    (hf : ∀ k, Function.Injective (f.app k)) (n : ℕ) (ε : Bool) (k : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective ((whiskerMap f n ε).app k)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.whisker_bounded
statement:
theorem whisker_bounded (X : GlobularSet.{u}) (n : ℕ) (ε : Bool)
    (hX : ∀ k, n+1 < k → IsEmpty (X.Cell k)) (k : ℕ) (hk : n+1 < k) :
    IsEmpty ((X.whisker n ε).Cell k)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.whisker_hom_ext
statement:
theorem whisker_hom_ext {X Y : GlobularSet.{u}} (n : ℕ) (ε : Bool)
    (f g : Hom (X.whisker n ε) Y)
    (hbase : ∀ k x, f.app k (.base k x) = g.app k (.base k x))
    (hedge : ∀ x, f.app (n+1) (.edge x) = g.app (n+1) (.edge x)) : f = g

OAI.Grothendieck.CoGlobularObject.adjacent_pair
statement:
theorem adjacent_pair (B : CoGlobularObject K) (n : ℕ) (ε δ : Bool) :
    B.adjacent n ε ≫ B.adjacent (n+1) δ = B.adjacent n ε ≫ B.source (n+1)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.CoGlobularObject.face_adjacent
statement:
theorem face_adjacent (B : CoGlobularObject K) {m k : ℕ} (h : m < k) (ε δ : Bool) :
    B.face h ε ≫ B.adjacent k δ = B.face (by omega : m < k+1) ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.CoGlobularObject.face_comp
statement:
theorem face_comp (B : CoGlobularObject K) {m k l : ℕ} (h : m < k) (h' : k < l)
    (ε δ : Bool) : B.face h ε ≫ B.face h' δ = B.face (h.trans h') ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.CoGlobularObject.face_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem face_succ (B : CoGlobularObject K) (n : ℕ) (ε : Bool) :
    B.face (Nat.lt_succ_self n) ε = B.adjacent n ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.CoGlobularObject.globeIso_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem globeIso_naturality (B : CoGlobularObject K)
    [HasColimitsOfSize.{0,max v w} K] {j k : ℕ} (f : Globe.Face j k) :
    B.realization.map (uliftYoneda.map f) ≫ (B.globeIso k).hom =
      (B.globeIso j).hom ≫ B.eval f

name: OAI.Grothendieck.CoGlobularObject.homEquiv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem homEquiv_app (B : CoGlobularObject K) [HasColimitsOfSize.{0,max v w} K]
    (S : GlobularPresheaf.{max v w}) (Y : K) (f : B.realization.obj S ⟶ Y)
    (k : ℕ) (x : S.obj (op (Globe.mk k))) :
    ((B.homEquiv S Y) f).app (op (Globe.mk k)) x = ULift.up (B.cell S k x ≫ f)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.CoGlobularObject.hom_ext
OAI.Grothendieck.FiniteCoGlobularObject.completedObj_eq
statement:
theorem completedObj_eq (B : FiniteCoGlobularObject K q) (k : ℕ) (h : k ≤ q) :
    B.completedObj k = B.obj k h

name: OAI.Grothendieck.FiniteCoGlobularObject.completedObj_terminal
statement:
theorem completedObj_terminal (B : FiniteCoGlobularObject K q) (k : ℕ) (h : ¬ k ≤ q) :
    B.completedObj k = ⊤_ K

name: OAI.Grothendieck.FiniteCoGlobularObject.completed_identity
statement:
theorem completed_identity (B : FiniteCoGlobularObject K q) (k : ℕ) (ε : Bool) :
    B.completedArrow k ε ≫ B.completedArrow (k+1) false =
      B.completedArrow k ε ≫ B.completedArrow (k+1) true

name: OAI.Grothendieck.FiniteCoGlobularObject.face_adjacent
statement:
theorem face_adjacent (B : FiniteCoGlobularObject K q) {j k : ℕ}
    (h : j < k) (hk : k+1 ≤ q) (ε δ : Bool) :
    B.face h (by omega) ε ≫ (if δ then B.target k hk else B.source k hk) =
      B.face (by omega : j < k+1) hk ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.FiniteCoGlobularObject.face_comp
OAI.Grothendieck.FiniteCoGlobularObject.face_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem face_succ (B : FiniteCoGlobularObject K q) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k+1 ≤ q) (ε : Bool) :
    B.face (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hk ε = if ε then B.target k hk else B.source k hk

name: OAI.Grothendieck.FiniteCoGlobularObject.globeIso_face
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem globeIso_face (B : FiniteCoGlobularObject K q)
    [HasColimitsOfSize.{0,max v w} K] {j k : ℕ} (h : j < k) (hk : k ≤ q) (ε : Bool) :
    B.realization.map (GlobularPresheaf.face h ε) ≫ (B.globeIso k hk).hom =
      (B.globeIso j (by omega)).hom ≫ B.face h hk ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.face_comp
statement:
theorem face_comp {a b c : ℕ} (h : a < b) (h' : b < c) (ε δ : Bool) :
    face h ε ≫ face h' δ = face (h.trans h') ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.face_triple_first_last
statement:
theorem face_triple_first_last (n k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) (ε : Bool) :
    face (by omega : k < n+1) ε ≫ tripleFirst n =
      face (by omega : k < n+1) ε ≫ tripleLast n

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linearAdjacent_identity
statement:
theorem linearAdjacent_identity (n k : ℕ) (hk : k+2 ≤ n+1) (ε : Bool) :
    linearAdjacent n k (by omega) ε ≫ linearAdjacent n (k+1) (by omega) false =
      linearAdjacent n k (by omega) ε ≫ linearAdjacent n (k+1) (by omega) true

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linearBlock_center
statement: theorem linearBlock_center (n k : ℕ) (h : k = n) : linearBlock n k = globe (n+1)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linearBlock_high
statement: theorem linearBlock_high (n k : ℕ) (h : n < k) : linearBlock n k = tripleShape n

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linearBlock_low
statement: theorem linearBlock_low (n k : ℕ) (h : k < n) : linearBlock n k = globe k

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.composition_isPushout
statement:
theorem composition_isPushout (n : ℕ) :
    IsPushout (Shape.target n) (Shape.source n) (compositionLeft n) (compositionRight n)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.tripleDesc_first
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem tripleDesc_first {S : Shape} (n : ℕ)
    (a b c : Shape.globe (n+1) ⟶ S) (hab) (hbc) :
    tripleFirst n ≫ tripleDesc n a b c hab hbc = a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.tripleDesc_last
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem tripleDesc_last {S : Shape} (n : ℕ)
    (a b c : Shape.globe (n+1) ⟶ S) (hab) (hbc) :
    tripleLast n ≫ tripleDesc n a b c hab hbc = c

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.tripleDesc_middle
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem tripleDesc_middle {S : Shape} (n : ℕ)
    (a b c : Shape.globe (n+1) ⟶ S) (hab) (hbc) :
    tripleMiddle n ≫ tripleDesc n a b c hab hbc = b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.triple_hom_ext
statement:
theorem triple_hom_ext {S : Shape} (n : ℕ) {f g : tripleShape n ⟶ S}
    (h₀ : tripleFirst n ≫ f = tripleFirst n ≫ g)
    (h₁ : tripleMiddle n ≫ f = tripleMiddle n ≫ g)
    (h₂ : tripleLast n ≫ f = tripleLast n ≫ g) : f = g

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.triple_isPushout
statement:
theorem triple_isPushout (n : ℕ) :
    IsPushout (Shape.target n ≫ compositionRight n) (Shape.source n)
      (triplePrefix n) (tripleLast n)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.appendThree_realization_isPushout
statement:
theorem appendThree_realization_isPushout (S : Shape) (n b : ℕ)
    (hl : b < S.1) (hb : b < n) :
    IsPushout (realization.map (S.seam hl))
      (realization.map (face (by omega : b < n+1) false ≫ tripleFirst n))
      (realization.map (appendThreeOld S n b hl hb))
      (realization.map (appendThreeTail S n b hl hb))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.appendTwoTail_first
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem appendTwoTail_first (n : ℕ) (T : Table (n+1)) :
    tripleFirst n ≫ appendTwoTail n T = lastArrow ⟨n+1,T⟩ ≫ appendTwoOld n T

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.appendTwoTail_last
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem appendTwoTail_last (n : ℕ) (T : Table (n+1)) :
    tripleLast n ≫ appendTwoTail n T = appendTwoLast n T

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.appendTwoTail_middle
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem appendTwoTail_middle (n : ℕ) (T : Table (n+1)) :
    tripleMiddle n ≫ appendTwoTail n T = appendTwoMiddle n T

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.appendTwo_isPushout
statement:
theorem appendTwo_isPushout (n : ℕ) (T : Table (n+1)) :
    IsPushout (lastArrow ⟨n+1,T⟩) (tripleFirst n) (appendTwoOld n T) (appendTwoTail n T)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.appendTwo_realization_isPushout
statement:
theorem appendTwo_realization_isPushout (n : ℕ) (T : Table (n+1)) :
    IsPushout (realization.map (lastArrow ⟨n+1,T⟩)) (realization.map (tripleFirst n))
      (realization.map (appendTwoOld n T)) (realization.map (appendTwoTail n T))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.composition_realization_isPushout
statement:
theorem composition_realization_isPushout (n : ℕ) :
    IsPushout (realization.map (target n)) (realization.map (source n))
      (realization.map (compositionLeft n)) (realization.map (compositionRight n))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.face_lastArrow_transport
statement:
theorem face_lastArrow_transport {b : ℕ} {S T : Shape} (e : S = T)
    (hs : b < S.1) (ht : b < T.1) (ε : Bool) :
    face hs ε ≫ lastArrow S = face ht ε ≫ lastArrow T ≫ eqToHom e.symm

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.isPushout_attach
statement:
theorem isPushout_attach (S : Shape) (b h : ℕ) (hl : b < S.1) (hr : b < h) :
    IsPushout (S.seam hl) (face hr false) (S.inl b h hl hr) (S.inr b h hl hr)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linearBlock_gt
statement:
theorem linearBlock_gt (n b k : ℕ) (hb : b < n) (hk : b < k) :
    b < (linearBlock n k).1

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linearHeight_lt
statement:
theorem linearHeight_lt (n b k : ℕ) (hb : b < n) (hk : b < k) :
    b < linearHeight n k

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linear_adjacent_realization
statement:
theorem linear_adjacent_realization (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) (ε : Bool) :
    (if ε then (linearGlobularDiagram n).target k (by omega)
       else (linearGlobularDiagram n).source k (by omega)) =
      realization.map (linearAdjacent n k hk ε)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linear_face_below
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem linear_face_below (n b k : ℕ) (h : b < k) (hb : b < n)
    (hk : k ≤ n+1) (ε : Bool) :
    realization.map (eqToHom (linearBlock_low n b hb).symm) ≫
      (linearGlobularDiagram n).face h hk ε =
    realization.map (face (linearBlock_gt n b k hb h) ε ≫ lastArrow (linearBlock n k))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linear_face_center
statement:
theorem linear_face_center (n b : ℕ) (h : b < n) (ε : Bool) :
    (linearGlobularDiagram n).face h (by omega) ε =
      realization.map (eqToHom (linearBlock_low n b h) ≫
        face (by omega : b < n+1) ε ≫ eqToHom (linearBlock_center n n rfl).symm)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linear_face_low
statement:
theorem linear_face_low (n b k : ℕ) (h : b < k) (hk : k < n) (ε : Bool) :
    (linearGlobularDiagram n).face h (by omega) ε =
      realization.map (eqToHom (linearBlock_low n b (by omega)) ≫
        face h ε ≫ eqToHom (linearBlock_low n k hk).symm)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linear_face_top
statement:
theorem linear_face_top (n : ℕ) (ε : Bool) :
    (linearGlobularDiagram n).face (Nat.lt_succ_self n) le_rfl ε =
      realization.map (eqToHom (linearBlock_center n n rfl) ≫
        (if ε then GlobularTheory.tripleLast n else GlobularTheory.tripleFirst n) ≫
        eqToHom (linearBlock_high n (n+1) (Nat.lt_succ_self n)).symm)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linear_face_top_low
statement:
theorem linear_face_top_low (n b : ℕ) (h : b < n) (ε : Bool) :
    (linearGlobularDiagram n).face (by omega : b < n+1) le_rfl ε =
      realization.map (eqToHom (linearBlock_low n b h) ≫
        face (by omega : b < n+1) ε ≫ GlobularTheory.tripleLast n ≫
        eqToHom (linearBlock_high n (n+1) (Nat.lt_succ_self n)).symm)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.triple_realization_isPushout
statement:
theorem triple_realization_isPushout (n : ℕ) :
    IsPushout (realization.map (target n ≫ compositionRight n))
      (realization.map (source n)) (realization.map (triplePrefix n))
      (realization.map (tripleLast n))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Table.LinearData.face_top_normalized
statement:
theorem face_top_normalized (n : ℕ) (ε : Bool) :
    realization.map (eqToHom (linearBlock_center n n rfl).symm) ≫
      (linearGlobularDiagram n).face (Nat.lt_succ_self n) le_rfl ε =
    realization.map (if ε then tripleLast n else tripleFirst n) ≫
      realization.map (eqToHom (linearBlock_high n (n+1) (by omega)).symm)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Table.LinearData.seam_below
statement:
theorem seam_below {n k : ℕ} {T : Table k} {hk : k ≤ n+1}
    (d : LinearData n T hk) (b : ℕ) (hl : b < k) (hb : b < n) :
    realization.map (eqToHom (linearBlock_low n b hb).symm) ≫
      (linearGlobularDiagram n).face hl hk true ≫ (linearGlobeIso n k hk).inv ≫
        (linearization n).map T.lastInclusion ≫ d.iso.hom =
    realization.map (Shape.seam ⟨(linearBlock n k).1,d.table⟩ (linearBlock_gt n b k hb hl))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Table.lastArrow_transport
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem lastArrow_transport {S R : Shape} (e : S = R) :
    realization.map (lastArrow S) ≫ realization.map (eqToHom e) =
      realization.map (eqToHom (congrArg Shape.globe (congrArg Sigma.fst e))) ≫
        realization.map (lastArrow R)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Table.last_le_height
statement: theorem last_le_height {k : ℕ} (T : Table k) : k ≤ T.height

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Table.linearBlock_lastArrow_isIso
statement:
theorem linearBlock_lastArrow_isIso (n h : ℕ) (hh : h ≤ n) :
    IsIso (lastArrow (linearBlock n h))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Table.reindexIso_last
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem reindexIso_last {k h : ℕ} (e : k = h) (T : Table k) :
    (T.reindex e).lastInclusion ≫ (T.reindexIso e).hom =
      realization.map (eqToHom (congrArg Shape.globe e.symm)) ≫ T.lastInclusion

OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.density_hom_ext
statement:
theorem density_hom_ext {K : Type u} [Category.{v} K]
    (F : GlobularPresheaf.{0} ⥤ K) [PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0,0} F]
    {S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}} {Y : K} {f g : F.obj S ⟶ Y}
    (h : ∀ (k : Globe) (x : S.obj (op k)),
      F.map (uliftYonedaEquiv.symm x) ≫ f = F.map (uliftYonedaEquiv.symm x) ≫ g) : f = g

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffShapeEquiv_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem cutoffShapeEquiv_naturality {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) (S : Shape) {Y Z : CutoffModels C q}
    (a : (cutoffFunctor hC q).obj (freeShape C S) ⟶ Y) (b : Y ⟶ Z) :
    cutoffShapeEquiv hC q S Z (a ≫ b) =
      cutoffShapeEquiv hC q S Y a ≫ (cutoffForgetGlobular C q).map b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallFreeDesc_gen
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallFreeDesc_gen {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) {S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}} {Y : CutoffModels C q}
    (f : GlobularSet.Hom (GlobularPresheaf.liftSmall.obj S).underlying Y.obj.underlying)
    (k : ℕ) (x : S.underlying.Cell k) :
    (underlyingMap (smallFreeDesc hC q f).hom).app k (smallFreeGen hC q S k x) =
      f.app k (ULift.up x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallFreeGen_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallFreeGen_map {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) {S T : GlobularPresheaf.{0}} (f : S ⟶ T) (k : ℕ) (x : S.underlying.Cell k) :
    (underlyingMap ((smallFree hC q).map f).hom).app k (smallFreeGen hC q S k x) =
      smallFreeGen hC q T k ((GlobularPresheaf.underlyingMap f).app k x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallFreeGen_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallFreeGen_source {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (k : ℕ) (x : S.underlying.Cell (k+1)) :
    ((smallFree hC q).obj S).obj.underlying.source k (smallFreeGen hC q S (k+1) x) =
      smallFreeGen hC q S k (S.underlying.source k x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallFreeGen_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallFreeGen_target {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (k : ℕ) (x : S.underlying.Cell (k+1)) :
    ((smallFree hC q).obj S).obj.underlying.target k (smallFreeGen hC q S (k+1) x) =
      smallFreeGen hC q S k (S.underlying.target k x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallFree_cofibrant
statement:
theorem smallFree_cofibrant {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) : Cofibrant hC q ((smallFree hC q).obj S)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linearFree_hasFillers
statement:
theorem linearFree_hasFillers {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : Shape) (hS : S.2.height ≤ n+1) :
    ((smallFree hC q).obj ((Shape.linearization n).obj S.realize)).obj.underlying.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallDiskDesc_gen
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallDiskDesc_gen {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q k : ℕ) {Y : CutoffModels C q} (x : Y.obj.underlying.Cell k) :
    (underlyingMap (smallDiskDesc hC q k x).hom).app k
      (smallFreeGen hC q (GlobularPresheaf.disk k) k (ULift.up (𝟙 (Globe.mk k)))) = x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallFree_hom_ext
OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallShapeDesc_gen
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallShapeDesc_gen {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) (S : Shape) {Y : CutoffModels C q}
    (t : Y.obj.presheaf.obj (op (⟨S⟩ : C.Obj))) (k : ℕ) (x : S.realize.underlying.Cell k) :
    (underlyingMap (smallShapeDesc hC q S t).hom).app k (smallFreeGen hC q S.realize k x) =
      Y.obj.eval (C.base (S.cellArrow (op (Globe.mk k)) x)) t

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallShapeDesc_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem smallShapeDesc_naturality {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) {S T : Shape} (f : S ⟶ T) {Y : CutoffModels C q}
    (t : Y.obj.presheaf.obj (op (⟨T⟩ : C.Obj))) :
    (smallFree hC q).map (Shape.realization.map f) ≫ smallShapeDesc hC q T t =
      smallShapeDesc hC q S (Y.obj.eval (C.base f) t)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallShape_hasFillers
statement:
theorem smallShape_hasFillers {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) (S : Shape) : ((smallFree hC q).obj S.realize).obj.underlying.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.FiniteCoGlobularObject.cell_face
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem cell_face (B : FiniteCoGlobularObject K q)
    [HasColimitsOfSize.{0,max v w} K] (S : GlobularPresheaf.{max v w})
    {j k : ℕ} (h : j < k) (hk : k ≤ q) (ε : Bool) (x : S.underlying.Cell k) :
    B.face h hk ε ≫ B.cell S k hk x =
      B.cell S j (h.le.trans hk) (S.map (Globe.face h ε).op x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.FiniteCoGlobularObject.face_natural
statement:
theorem face_natural {K : Type u} [Category.{v} K]
    (F : GlobularPresheaf.{0} ⥤ K) {q : ℕ}
    (B : FiniteCoGlobularObject GlobularPresheaf.{0} q)
    (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (Y : K)
    (d : ∀ k (hk : k ≤ q), S.underlying.Cell k → (F.obj (B.obj k hk) ⟶ Y))
    (hd : ∀ k (hk : k+1 ≤ q) (ε : Bool) x,
      F.map (if ε then B.target k hk else B.source k hk) ≫ d (k+1) hk x =
        d k (by omega) (S.map (Globe.face (Nat.lt_succ_self k) ε).op x)) :
    ∀ {j k : ℕ} (h : j < k) (hk : k ≤ q) (ε : Bool) x,
      F.map (B.face h hk ε) ≫ d k hk x =
        d j (h.le.trans hk) (S.map (Globe.face h ε).op x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.finiteRealizationDesc_cell
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem finiteRealizationDesc_cell {K : Type u} [Category.{v} K]
    (F : GlobularPresheaf.{0} ⥤ K) [PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0,0} F]
    {q : ℕ} (B : FiniteCoGlobularObject GlobularPresheaf.{0} q)
    (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (hS : ∀ k, q < k → IsEmpty (S.underlying.Cell k)) (Y : K)
    (d) (hd) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ q) (x : S.underlying.Cell k) :
    F.map (B.cell S k hk x) ≫ finiteRealizationDesc F B S hS Y d hd = d k hk x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallFreeCell_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallFreeCell_map {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) {S T : GlobularPresheaf.{0}} (f : S ⟶ T) (k : ℕ)
    (a : GlobularPresheaf.disk k ⟶ S) :
    (underlyingMap ((smallFree hC q).map f).hom).app k (smallFreeCell hC q k a) =
      smallFreeCell hC q k (a ≫ f)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallFreeCell_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallFreeCell_source {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) {S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}} (k : ℕ) (f : GlobularPresheaf.disk (k+1) ⟶ S) :
    ((smallFree hC q).obj S).obj.underlying.source k (smallFreeCell hC q (k+1) f) =
      smallFreeCell hC q k (GlobularPresheaf.face (Nat.lt_succ_self k) false ≫ f)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallFreeCell_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallFreeCell_target {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) {S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}} (k : ℕ) (f : GlobularPresheaf.disk (k+1) ⟶ S) :
    ((smallFree hC q).obj S).obj.underlying.target k (smallFreeCell hC q (k+1) f) =
      smallFreeCell hC q k (GlobularPresheaf.face (Nat.lt_succ_self k) true ≫ f)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallShapeDesc_cell
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallShapeDesc_cell {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) (S : Shape) {Y : CutoffModels C q}
    (t : Y.obj.presheaf.obj (op (⟨S⟩ : C.Obj))) (k : ℕ) (f : Shape.globe k ⟶ S) :
    (underlyingMap (smallShapeDesc hC q S t).hom).app k
      (smallFreeCell hC q k (Shape.realization.map f)) = Y.obj.eval (C.base f) t

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linearEdge_face
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem linearEdge_face (n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0})
    {j : ℕ} (h : j < n) (ε : Bool) (x : S.underlying.Cell n) :
    GlobularPresheaf.face (by omega : j < n+1) ε ≫ linearEdge n S x =
      linearLow n S j h (S.map (Globe.face h ε).op x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linearLow_face
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem linearLow_face (n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0})
    {j k : ℕ} (h : j < k) (hk : k < n) (ε : Bool) (x : S.underlying.Cell k) :
    GlobularPresheaf.face h ε ≫ linearLow n S k hk x =
      linearLow n S j (by omega) (S.map (Globe.face h ε).op x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.Shape.linearTriple_face
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem linearTriple_face (n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0})
    (ε : Bool) (x : S.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    realization.map (if ε then GlobularTheory.tripleLast n else GlobularTheory.tripleFirst n) ≫
      linearTriple n S x =
      linearEdge n S (S.map (Globe.face (Nat.lt_succ_self n) ε).op x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularPresheaf.disk_bounded
statement: theorem disk_bounded (n k : ℕ) (h : n < k) : IsEmpty ((disk n).underlying.Cell k)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cancelShapeTransport
statement:
theorem cancelShapeTransport {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) {A B : Shape} (e : A = B) {Y : CutoffModels C q}
    (f : (smallFree hC q).obj B.realize ⟶ Y) :
    (smallFree hC q).map (Shape.realization.map (eqToHom e.symm)) ≫
      (smallFree hC q).map (Shape.realization.map (eqToHom e)) ≫ f = f

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.compCell_cancel_left
statement:
theorem compCell_cancel_left {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (X : C.Model) (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (n : ℕ) (a b : X.underlying.Cell (n+1))
    (h : X.underlying.source n a = X.underlying.source n b) :
    X.underlying.Joined (n+1)
      (X.compCell hC n a
        (X.compCell hC n (X.inverseCell hC n a) b (by rw [inverseCell_target, h]))
        (by rw [compCell_source, inverseCell_source])) b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linEdge_face
statement:
@[simp] theorem linEdge_face {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) {j : ℕ} (h : j < n)
    (ε : Bool) (x : S.underlying.Cell n) :
    (linearFree hC q n S).obj.eval (C.base (Shape.face (by omega : j < n+1) ε))
      (linEdge hC q n S x) = linLow hC q n S j h (S.map (Globe.face h ε).op x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linLow_face
statement:
@[simp] theorem linLow_face {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) {j k : ℕ} (h : j < k) (hk : k < n)
    (ε : Bool) (x : S.underlying.Cell k) :
    (linearFree hC q n S).obj.eval (C.base (Shape.face h ε)) (linLow hC q n S k hk x) =
      linLow hC q n S j (h.trans hk) (S.map (Globe.face h ε).op x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linMiddle_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem linMiddle_source {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (x : S.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    (linearFree hC q n S).obj.underlying.source n (linMiddle hC q n S x) =
      (linearFree hC q n S).obj.underlying.target n (linEdge hC q n S (S.underlying.source n x))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linMiddle_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem linMiddle_target {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (x : S.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    (linearFree hC q n S).obj.underlying.target n (linMiddle hC q n S x) =
      (linearFree hC q n S).obj.underlying.source n (linEdge hC q n S (S.underlying.target n x))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linOriginal_center
statement:
@[simp] theorem linOriginal_center {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (hS) (x : S.underlying.Cell n) :
    linOriginal hC q n S hS n x =
      (linearFree hC q n S).obj.underlying.source n (linEdge hC q n S x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linOriginal_high
statement:
@[simp] theorem linOriginal_high {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (hS) (x : S.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    linOriginal hC q n S hS (n+1) x =
      (linearFree hC q n S).obj.compCell hC n
        (linEdge hC q n S (S.underlying.source n x)) (linMiddle hC q n S x)
        (linMiddle_source hC q n S x).symm

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linOriginal_low
statement:
@[simp] theorem linOriginal_low {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (hS) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < n)
    (x : S.underlying.Cell k) : linOriginal hC q n S hS k x = linLow hC q n S k hk x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linOriginal_source
statement:
theorem linOriginal_source {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (hS) (k : ℕ) (x : S.underlying.Cell (k+1)) :
    linOriginal hC q n S hS k (S.underlying.source k x) =
      (linearFree hC q n S).obj.underlying.source k (linOriginal hC q n S hS (k+1) x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linOriginal_target
statement:
theorem linOriginal_target {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (hS) (k : ℕ) (x : S.underlying.Cell (k+1)) :
    linOriginal hC q n S hS k (S.underlying.target k x) =
      (linearFree hC q n S).obj.underlying.target k (linOriginal hC q n S hS (k+1) x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linReverseBlock_adjacent
statement:
theorem linReverseBlock_adjacent {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (k : ℕ) (hk : k+1 ≤ n+1)
    (ε : Bool) (x : S.underlying.Cell (k+1)) :
    (smallFree hC q).map ((Shape.linearGlobularDiagram n).face (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hk ε) ≫
      linReverseBlock hC q n S (k+1) hk x =
      linReverseBlock hC q n S k (by omega) (S.map (Globe.face (Nat.lt_succ_self k) ε).op x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linReverseBlock_center
statement:
@[simp] theorem linReverseBlock_center {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (hk : n ≤ n+1) (x : S.underlying.Cell n) :
    linReverseBlock hC q n S n hk x =
    (smallFree hC q).map (Shape.realization.map (eqToHom (Shape.linearBlock_center n n rfl))) ≫
      smallDiskDesc hC q (n+1) (wEdge hC q n S x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linReverseBlock_high
statement:
@[simp] theorem linReverseBlock_high {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (hk : n+1 ≤ n+1) (x : S.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    linReverseBlock hC q n S (n+1) hk x =
    (smallFree hC q).map (Shape.realization.map (eqToHom (Shape.linearBlock_high n (n+1) (by omega)))) ≫
      smallShapeDesc hC q (tripleShape n) (wTriple hC q n S x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linReverseBlock_low
statement:
@[simp] theorem linReverseBlock_low {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n+1) (h : k < n)
    (x : S.underlying.Cell k) : linReverseBlock hC q n S k hk x =
    (smallFree hC q).map (Shape.realization.map (eqToHom (Shape.linearBlock_low n k h))) ≫
      smallDiskDesc hC q k (wBase hC q n S k x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linearToWhisker_edge
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearToWhisker_edge {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (hS) (x : S.underlying.Cell n) :
    (underlyingMap (linearToWhisker hC q n S hS).hom).app (n+1) (linEdge hC q n S x) =
      wEdge hC q n S x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linearToWhisker_edgeHom
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem linearToWhisker_edgeHom {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (hS) (x : S.underlying.Cell n) :
    (smallFree hC q).map (Shape.linearEdge n S x) ≫ linearToWhisker hC q n S hS =
      smallDiskDesc hC q (n+1) (wEdge hC q n S x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linearToWhisker_low
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearToWhisker_low {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (hS) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) (x : S.underlying.Cell k) :
    (underlyingMap (linearToWhisker hC q n S hS).hom).app k (linLow hC q n S k hk x) =
      wBase hC q n S k x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linearToWhisker_lowHom
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem linearToWhisker_lowHom {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (hS) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < n)
    (x : S.underlying.Cell k) :
    (smallFree hC q).map (Shape.linearLow n S k hk x) ≫ linearToWhisker hC q n S hS =
      smallDiskDesc hC q k (wBase hC q n S k x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linearToWhisker_middle
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearToWhisker_middle {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (hS) (x : S.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    (underlyingMap (linearToWhisker hC q n S hS).hom).app (n+1) (linMiddle hC q n S x) =
      wMiddle hC q n S x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.linearToWhisker_tripleHom
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem linearToWhisker_tripleHom {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (hS) (x : S.underlying.Cell (n+1)) :
    (smallFree hC q).map (Shape.linearTriple n S x) ≫ linearToWhisker hC q n S hS =
      smallShapeDesc hC q (tripleShape n) (wTriple hC q n S x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallFreeCell_face
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallFreeCell_face {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) {S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}} {j k : ℕ} (h : j < k) (ε : Bool)
    (f : GlobularPresheaf.disk k ⟶ S) :
    ((smallFree hC q).obj S).obj.eval (C.base (Shape.face h ε)) (smallFreeCell hC q k f) =
      smallFreeCell hC q j (GlobularPresheaf.face h ε ≫ f)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallFreeCell_image
statement:
theorem smallFreeCell_image {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) {S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}} {Y : CutoffModels C q} (k : ℕ)
    (a : GlobularPresheaf.disk k ⟶ S) (f : (smallFree hC q).obj S ⟶ Y)
    (x : Y.obj.underlying.Cell k) (h : (smallFree hC q).map a ≫ f = smallDiskDesc hC q k x) :
    (underlyingMap f.hom).app k (smallFreeCell hC q k a) = x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallFreeDescCells_gen
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallFreeDescCells_gen {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) {S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}} {Y : CutoffModels C q}
    (f) (hs) (ht) (k : ℕ) (x : S.underlying.Cell k) :
    (underlyingMap (smallFreeDescCells hC q (Y := Y) f hs ht).hom).app k
      (smallFreeGen hC q S k x) = f k x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.transportedShapeDesc
statement:
theorem transportedShapeDesc {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q : ℕ) {A B D E : Shape} (e : A = B) (f : B ⟶ D) (e' : E = D)
    {Y : CutoffModels C q} (t : Y.obj.presheaf.obj (op (⟨D⟩ : C.Obj))) :
    (smallFree hC q).map (Shape.realization.map (eqToHom e ≫ f ≫ eqToHom e'.symm)) ≫
      (smallFree hC q).map (Shape.realization.map (eqToHom e')) ≫ smallShapeDesc hC q D t =
    (smallFree hC q).map (Shape.realization.map (eqToHom e)) ≫
      smallShapeDesc hC q B (Y.obj.eval (C.base f) t)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.wBase_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem wBase_source {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}) (k : ℕ) (x : S.underlying.Cell (k+1)) :
    (whiskerFree hC q n S).obj.underlying.source k (wBase hC q n S (k+1) x) =
      wBase hC q n S k (S.underlying.source k x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.wBase_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem wBase_target {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.exists_upper_resolution
statement:
theorem exists_upper_resolution {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) (hnq : n ≤ q) {X Y : CutoffModels C q} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hY : Cofibrant hC q Y) (hXF : X.obj.underlying.HasFillers)
    (hYF : Y.obj.underlying.HasFillers)
    (hf : ∀ k, k ≤ n → Function.Bijective ((underlyingMap f.hom).app k)) :
    ∃ (M : CutoffModels C q) (i : X ⟶ M) (p : M ⟶ Y) (s : Y ⟶ M),
      i ≫ p = f ∧ s ≫ p = 𝟙 Y ∧ (boundaryClass hC q (n+1)).rlp.llp i ∧
      M.obj.underlying.HasFillers ∧
      ∀ k, k ≤ n → Function.Injective ((underlyingMap p.hom).app k)

    (hf : ∀ k, k ≤ r → Function.Bijective ((GlobularPresheaf.underlyingMap f).app k)) :
    ∀ k, k ≤ r → Function.Bijective ((underlyingMap ((smallFree hC q).map f).hom).app k)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallWhiskerCell_source
statement:
theorem smallWhiskerCell_source {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) {S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}} {Y : CutoffModels C q}
    (f : (smallFree hC q).obj S ⟶ Y) (e : S.underlying.Cell n → Y.obj.underlying.Cell (n+1))
    (he : ∀ x, Y.obj.underlying.source n (e x) =
      (underlyingMap f.hom).app n (smallFreeGen hC q S n x))
    (k : ℕ) (x : (S.underlying.whisker n false).Cell (k+1)) :
    smallWhiskerCell hC q n f e k ((S.underlying.whisker n false).source k x) =
      Y.obj.underlying.source k (smallWhiskerCell hC q n f e (k+1) x)

    (he : ∀ x, Y.obj.underlying.source n (e x) =
      (underlyingMap f.hom).app n (smallFreeGen hC q S n x))
    (k : ℕ) (x : (S.underlying.whisker n false).Cell (k+1)) :
    smallWhiskerCell hC q n f e k ((S.underlying.whisker n false).target k x) =
      Y.obj.underlying.target k (smallWhiskerCell hC q n f e (k+1) x)
