name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallReverseWhiskerCell_source
statement:
theorem smallReverseWhiskerCell_source {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) {S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}} {Y : CutoffModels C q}
    (f : (smallFree hC q).obj S ⟶ Y) (e : S.underlying.Cell n → Y.obj.underlying.Cell (n+1))
    (he : ∀ x, Y.obj.underlying.target n (e x) =
      (underlyingMap f.hom).app n (smallFreeGen hC q S n x))
    (k : ℕ) (x : (S.underlying.whisker n true).Cell (k+1)) :
    smallReverseWhiskerCell hC q n f e k ((S.underlying.whisker n true).source k x) =
      Y.obj.underlying.source k (smallReverseWhiskerCell hC q n f e (k+1) x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallReverseWhiskerCell_target
statement:
theorem smallReverseWhiskerCell_target {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) {S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}} {Y : CutoffModels C q}
    (f : (smallFree hC q).obj S ⟶ Y) (e : S.underlying.Cell n → Y.obj.underlying.Cell (n+1))
    (he : ∀ x, Y.obj.underlying.target n (e x) =
      (underlyingMap f.hom).app n (smallFreeGen hC q S n x))
    (k : ℕ) (x : (S.underlying.whisker n true).Cell (k+1)) :
    smallReverseWhiskerCell hC q n f e k ((S.underlying.whisker n true).target k x) =
      Y.obj.underlying.target k (smallReverseWhiskerCell hC q n f e (k+1) x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallReverseWhiskerDesc_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallReverseWhiskerDesc_base {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) {S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}} {Y : CutoffModels C q}
    (f : (smallFree hC q).obj S ⟶ Y) (e) (he) (k : ℕ) (x : S.underlying.Cell k) :
    (underlyingMap (smallReverseWhiskerDesc hC q n f e he).hom).app k (rwBase hC q n S k x) =
      (underlyingMap f.hom).app k (smallFreeGen hC q S k x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.smallReverseWhiskerDesc_edge
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallReverseWhiskerDesc_edge {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q n : ℕ) {S : GlobularPresheaf.{0}} {Y : CutoffModels C q}
    (f : (smallFree hC q).obj S ⟶ Y) (e) (he) (x : S.underlying.Cell n) :
    (underlyingMap (smallReverseWhiskerDesc hC q n f e he).hom).app (n+1) (rwEdge hC q n S x) = e x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.BoundaryEquiv.nextValue_bijective
statement: theorem nextValue_bijective (Y : K) : Function.Bijective (R.nextValue Y)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Hom.boundary_naturality
statement:
theorem boundary_naturality (e : Hom D B) {Y : K} (j : ℕ) (a : B.bd j ⟶ Y) :
    (D.boundaryEquiv j).equiv Y (e.bd j ≫ a) =
      (e.pre Y).boundaryMap j ((B.boundaryEquiv j).equiv Y a)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Hom.relativeMap_liftsBoundary
statement:
theorem relativeMap_liftsBoundary (j : ℕ) (hp : HasLiftingProperty (oneSidedMap e j) p) :
    GlobularSet.LiftsBoundary (e.relativeMap p) j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Hom.source_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem source_naturality (e : Hom D B) (j : ℕ) :
    D.diagram.source j ≫ e.obj (j+1) = e.obj j ≫ B.diagram.source j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Hom.target_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem target_naturality (e : Hom D B) (j : ℕ) :
    D.diagram.target j ≫ e.obj (j+1) = e.obj j ≫ B.diagram.target j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.fiberProd.lift_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_fst (a : Hom A X) (b : Hom A Y) (h : a.comp f = b.comp g) :
    (lift f g a b h).comp (fst f g) = a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.fiberProd.lift_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_snd (a : Hom A X) (b : Hom A Y) (h : a.comp f = b.comp g) :
    (lift f g a b h).comp (snd f g) = b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.CylinderNode.nextBdEnd_left
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem nextBdEnd_left (Z : CylinderNode D j) (ε : Bool) :
    D.left j ≫ Z.nextBdEnd ε = Z.endpoint ε ≫ pushout.inl _ _

name: OAI.Grothendieck.CylinderNode.nextBdEnd_right
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem nextBdEnd_right (Z : CylinderNode D j) (ε : Bool) :
    D.right j ≫ Z.nextBdEnd ε = Z.endpoint ε ≫ pushout.inr _ _

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffDiskFrame_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem cutoffDiskFrame_source {C : GlobularTheory.{v}} (hC : C.IsCoherator)
    (q j : ℕ) : (cutoffDiskFrame hC q).diagram.source j = cutoffJ hC q j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderNode_critical
statement:
theorem cylinderNode_critical : cylinderNode hC q n n =
    CylinderNode.critical (cutoffDiskFrame hC q) n

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderNode_high
statement:
theorem cylinderNode_high {j : ℕ} (h : n ≤ j) :
    cylinderNode hC q n (j+1) = cylinderNext hC q n (cylinderNode hC q n j)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderNode_low
statement:
theorem cylinderNode_low {j : ℕ} (h : j < n) :
    cylinderNode hC q n j = CylinderNode.stationary (cutoffDiskFrame hC q) j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.diskFrame_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem diskFrame_source (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) (j : ℕ) :
    (diskFrame C).diagram.source j = J C j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.diskFrame_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem diskFrame_target (C : GlobularTheory.{v}) (j : ℕ) :
    (diskFrame C).diagram.target j = targetDisk C j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.TwoEndpoints.base_desc
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem base_desc (b : B ⟶ Y) (d : Bool → (Disk ⟶ Y))
    (h : ∀ ε, e ε ≫ b = i ≫ d ε) : base i e ≫ desc i e b d h = b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.TwoEndpoints.condition
statement: theorem condition (ε : Bool) : e ε ≫ base i e = i ≫ endpoint i e ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.TwoEndpoints.endpoint_desc
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem endpoint_desc (b : B ⟶ Y) (d : Bool → (Disk ⟶ Y))
    (h : ∀ ε, e ε ≫ b = i ≫ d ε) (ε : Bool) : endpoint i e ε ≫ desc i e b d h = d ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.TwoEndpoints.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {f g : obj i e ⟶ Y} (hb : base i e ≫ f = base i e ≫ g)
    (hd : ∀ ε, endpoint i e ε ≫ f = endpoint i e ε ≫ g) : f = g

name: OAI.Grothendieck.TwoEndpoints.oneSide_lifting
statement:
theorem oneSide_lifting {P X Y : K} (f : obj i e ⟶ P) (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : HasLiftingProperty i p) (hf : HasLiftingProperty f p) (ε : Bool) :
    HasLiftingProperty (pushout.desc (base i e ≫ f) (endpoint i e ε ≫ f)
      (by rw [← Category.assoc, condition, Category.assoc])) p

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.cell_desc
OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.cell_face
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem cell_face (S : GlobularPresheaf.{v}) {j k : ℕ} (f : Globe.Face j k)
    (x : S.underlying.Cell k) :
    B.diagram.eval f ≫ B.cell S k x = B.cell S j (S.map (show Globe.mk j ⟶ Globe.mk k from f).op x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.desc_realizeHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem desc_realizeHom {S : GlobularPresheaf.{v}} {Y : K}
    (f : B.realization.obj S ⟶ Y) : B.desc (B.realizeHom f) = f

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.homGlob_eval
statement:
theorem homGlob_eval (Y : K) {j k : ℕ} (f : Globe.Face j k) (a : B.obj k ⟶ Y) :
    (B.homGlob Y).evalFace f a = B.diagram.eval f ≫ a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.homGlob_faceMap
statement:
theorem homGlob_faceMap (Y : K) {j k : ℕ} (h : j < k) (ε : Bool)
    (a : B.obj k ⟶ Y) : (B.homGlob Y).faceMap h ε a = B.diagram.face h ε ≫ a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {S : GlobularPresheaf.{v}} {Y : K} {f g : B.realization.obj S ⟶ Y}
    (h : ∀ k x, B.cell S k x ≫ f = B.cell S k x ≫ g) : f = g

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.realizeHom_desc
statement:
@[simp] theorem realizeHom_desc {S : GlobularPresheaf.{v}} {Y : K}
    (f : GlobularSet.Hom S.underlying (B.homGlob Y)) : B.realizeHom (B.desc f) = f

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffCellEquiv_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem cutoffCellEquiv_comp {Y Z : CutoffModels C q} (j : ℕ)
    (a : cutoffDisk hC q j ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ Z) :
    cutoffCellEquiv hC q Z j (a ≫ f) =
      (underlyingMap f.hom).app j (cutoffCellEquiv hC q Y j a)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffCellEquiv_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem cutoffCellEquiv_source {Y : CutoffModels C q} (j : ℕ)
    (a : cutoffDisk hC q (j+1) ⟶ Y) :
    cutoffCellEquiv hC q Y j ((cutoffDiskFrame hC q).diagram.source j ≫ a) =
      Y.obj.underlying.source j (cutoffCellEquiv hC q Y (j+1) a)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffCellEquiv_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem cutoffCellEquiv_target {Y : CutoffModels C q} (j : ℕ)
    (a : cutoffDisk hC q (j+1) ⟶ Y) :
    cutoffCellEquiv hC q Y j ((cutoffDiskFrame hC q).diagram.target j ≫ a) =
      Y.obj.underlying.target j (cutoffCellEquiv hC q Y (j+1) a)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffDiskFrame_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem cutoffDiskFrame_target (j : ℕ) :
    (cutoffDiskFrame hC q).diagram.target j = (cutoffFunctor hC q).map (targetDisk C j)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffFrameHomEquiv_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem cutoffFrameHomEquiv_naturality (S : GlobularPresheaf.{v})
    {Y Z : CutoffModels C q} (a : (cutoffDiskFrame hC q).realization.obj S ⟶ Y) (b : Y ⟶ Z) :
    cutoffFrameHomEquiv hC q S Z (a ≫ b) =
      cutoffFrameHomEquiv hC q S Y a ≫ (cutoffForgetGlobular C q).map b

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffFrame_cofibrant
statement:
theorem cutoffFrame_cofibrant (S : GlobularPresheaf.{v}) :
    Cofibrant hC q ((cutoffDiskFrame hC q).realization.obj S)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.ulift_evalFace
statement:
theorem ulift_evalFace (X : GlobularSet.{0}) {j k : ℕ} (f : Globe.Face j k)
    (x : (X.ulift.{v}).Cell k) :
    (X.ulift.{v}).evalFace f x = ⟨X.evalFace f x.down⟩

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.ulift_faceMap
statement:
theorem ulift_faceMap (X : GlobularSet.{0}) {j k : ℕ} (h : j < k) (ε : Bool)
    (x : (X.ulift.{v}).Cell k) :
    (X.ulift.{v}).faceMap h ε x = ⟨X.faceMap h ε x.down⟩

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffFrame_whisker_hasFillers
statement:
theorem cutoffFrame_whisker_hasFillers (hnq : n ≤ q) (H : ExpansionContraction hC q (n+1))
    (S : Shape) (ε : Bool) :
    ((cutoffDiskFrame hC q).realization.obj
      ((GlobularPresheaf.whiskering n ε).obj (GlobularPresheaf.liftSmall.obj S.realize))).obj.underlying.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.LiftStage.extendBy_old
statement:
theorem extendBy_old {n : ℕ} (a : LiftStage p f n) (d : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ j, n < j → j ≤ n+d → LiftsBoundary p j)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) (x : A.Cell k) :
    (a.extendBy d h).app k (by omega) x = a.app k hk x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.LiftStage.extendOne_old
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendOne_old {n : ℕ} (a : LiftStage p f n) (hp : LiftsBoundary p (n+1))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) (x : A.Cell k) :
    (a.extendOne hp).app k (by omega) x = a.app k hk x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.completedCylinder_upper
statement:
theorem completedCylinder_upper (j : ℕ) (hj : n < j)
    (B : CutoffModels C q) (e : Bool → (cutoffBoundary hC q j ⟶ B)) (ε : Bool) :
    (boundaryClass hC q (n+1)).rlp.llp
      ((completedCylinder hC q n j B e).oneSideMap ε)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderFrame_upper
statement:
theorem cylinderFrame_upper {j : ℕ} (hj : n < j) (ε : Bool) :
    (boundaryClass hC q (n+1)).rlp.llp
      (GlobularFrame.oneSidedMap (cylinderEndpoint hC q n ε) j)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderNode_upper
statement:
theorem cylinderNode_upper {j : ℕ} (hj : n < j) (ε : Bool) :
    (boundaryClass hC q (n+1)).rlp.llp ((cylinderNode hC q n j).oneSideMap ε)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderNode_upper_fillers
statement:
theorem cylinderNode_upper_fillers {j : ℕ} (hj : n < j) :
    (boundaryClass hC q (n+1)).rlp (terminal.from (cylinderNode hC q n j).obj)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.CriticalData.initialCell_fac
statement:
theorem initialCell_fac (a : GlobularSet.Hom (S.whisker n ε) (D.homGlob Y))
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ n) (x : S.Cell j) :
    e.obj j ≫ c.initialCell a j hj x = a.app j (.base j x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.CriticalData.initialCell_low
statement:
theorem initialCell_low (a : GlobularSet.Hom (S.whisker n ε) (D.homGlob Y))
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j < n) (x : S.Cell j) :
    e.obj j ≫ c.initialCell a j (by omega) x = a.app j (.base j x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.CriticalData.initialCell_top
statement:
theorem initialCell_top (a : GlobularSet.Hom (S.whisker n ε) (D.homGlob Y))
    (x : S.Cell n) : c.initialCell a n le_rfl x = c.iso.hom ≫ a.app (n+1) (.edge x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.RelativeStage.extendBy_old
statement:
theorem extendBy_old (a : RelativeStage e p f b k hk) (d : ℕ) (hd : k+d ≤ m)
    (hp : ∀ j, k < j → j ≤ k+d → HasLiftingProperty (oneSidedMap e j) p)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) (x : S.Cell j) :
    (a.extendBy d hd hp).stage.app j (by omega) x = a.stage.app j hj x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.RelativeStage.succ_old
statement:
theorem succ_old (a : RelativeStage e p f b k hk) (hk' : k+1 ≤ m)
    (hp : HasLiftingProperty (oneSidedMap e (k+1)) p) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k) (x : S.Cell j) :
    (a.succ hk' hp).stage.app j (by omega) x = a.stage.app j hj x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Presentation.comparison_base
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem comparison_base (h : n ≤ m) (j : ℕ) (x : S.Cell j) :
    U.base.app j x ≫ V.comparison U h = V.base.app j x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Presentation.comparison_lifting
statement:
theorem comparison_lifting (h : n ≤ m) {X Y : K} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (hp : ∀ j, n < j → j ≤ m → HasLiftingProperty (oneSidedMap e j) p) :
    HasLiftingProperty (V.comparison U h) p

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Presentation.comparison_stage
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem comparison_stage (h : n ≤ m) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ n) (x : S.Cell j) :
    U.stage.app j hj x ≫ V.comparison U h = V.stage.app j (hj.trans h) x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Hom.boundaryApp_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem boundaryApp_naturality (j k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ j)
    (x : (GlobularPresheaf.disk.{v} (j+1)).underlying.Cell k) :
    D.boundaryApp j k hk x ≫ e.bd (j+1) = e.obj k ≫ B.boundaryApp j k hk x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Hom.boundaryCell_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem boundaryCell_naturality (j k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ j) (ε : Bool) :
    D.boundaryCell j k hk ε ≫ e.bd (j+1) = e.obj k ≫ B.boundaryCell j k hk ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Hom.face_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem face_naturality {j k : ℕ} (h : j < k) (ε : Bool) :
    D.diagram.face h ε ≫ e.obj k = e.obj j ≫ B.diagram.face h ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.boundaryApp_face
statement:
@[simp] theorem boundaryApp_face (j k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ j) (ε : Bool) :
    B.boundaryApp j k hk ⟨Globe.Face.face (by omega : k < j+1) ε⟩ = B.boundaryCell j k hk ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.boundaryApp_inc
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem boundaryApp_inc (j k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ j)
    (x : (GlobularPresheaf.disk.{v} (j+1)).underlying.Cell k) :
    B.boundaryApp j k hk x ≫ B.inc (j+1) = B.diagram.eval x.down

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.boundaryApp_source
statement:
theorem boundaryApp_source (j k : ℕ) (hk : k+1 ≤ j)
    (x : (GlobularPresheaf.disk.{v} (j+1)).underlying.Cell (k+1)) :
    B.boundaryApp j k (by omega) ((GlobularPresheaf.disk (j+1)).underlying.source k x) =
      B.diagram.source k ≫ B.boundaryApp j (k+1) hk x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.boundaryApp_target
statement:
theorem boundaryApp_target (j k : ℕ) (hk : k+1 ≤ j)
    (x : (GlobularPresheaf.disk.{v} (j+1)).underlying.Cell (k+1)) :
    B.boundaryApp j k (by omega) ((GlobularPresheaf.disk (j+1)).underlying.target k x) =
      B.diagram.target k ≫ B.boundaryApp j (k+1) hk x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.boundaryCell_adjacent
statement:
theorem boundaryCell_adjacent (j k : ℕ) (hk : k+1 ≤ j) (ε δ : Bool) :
    B.diagram.adjacent k δ ≫ B.boundaryCell j (k+1) hk ε =
      B.boundaryCell j k (by omega) δ

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.boundaryCell_inc
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem boundaryCell_inc (j k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ j) (ε : Bool) :
    B.boundaryCell j k hk ε ≫ B.inc (j+1) = B.diagram.face (by omega : k < j+1) ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.boundaryCell_low
statement:
theorem boundaryCell_low {j k : ℕ} (h : k < j) (ε : Bool) :
    B.boundaryCell j k (by omega) ε = B.diagram.face h ε ≫ B.left j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.boundaryCell_top
statement:
theorem boundaryCell_top (j : ℕ) (ε : Bool) :
    B.boundaryCell j j le_rfl ε = if ε then B.right j else B.left j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.diskDiagram_cell
statement:
theorem diskDiagram_cell {j : ℕ} {Y : K}
    (f : GlobularSet.Hom (GlobularPresheaf.disk.{v} j).underlying (B.homGlob Y))
    (k : ℕ) (x : (GlobularPresheaf.disk.{v} j).underlying.Cell k) :
    f.app k x = B.diagram.eval x.down ≫ f.app j ⟨𝟙 _⟩

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.LiftStage.evalFace_app
statement:
theorem evalFace_app (s : LiftStage p f m) {k j : ℕ} (a : Globe.Face k j)
    (hj : j ≤ m) (hk : k ≤ m) (x : A.Cell j) :
    s.app k hk (A.evalFace a x) = X.evalFace a (s.app j hj x)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Presentation.boundaryApp_desc
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem boundaryApp_desc (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ j)
    (x : (GlobularPresheaf.disk.{v} (j+1)).underlying.Cell k) :
    B.boundaryApp j k hk x ≫ boundaryDesc f a = a.app k hk x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Presentation.boundaryDesc_comm
statement:
theorem boundaryDesc_comm :
    e.bd (j+1) ≫ boundaryDesc f a = D.inc (j+1) ≫ f.app (j+1) ⟨𝟙 _⟩

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Presentation.boundaryDesc_left
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem boundaryDesc_left :
    B.left j ≫ boundaryDesc f a = a.app j le_rfl ⟨Globe.source j⟩

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Presentation.boundaryDesc_right
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem boundaryDesc_right :
    B.right j ≫ boundaryDesc f a = a.app j le_rfl ⟨Globe.target j⟩

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffFrame_diskWhisker_hasFillers
statement:
theorem cutoffFrame_diskWhisker_hasFillers (hnq : n ≤ q) (H : ExpansionContraction hC q (n+1))
    (j : ℕ) (ε : Bool) :
    ((cutoffDiskFrame hC q).realization.obj
      ((GlobularPresheaf.whiskering n ε).obj (GlobularPresheaf.disk.{v} j))).obj.underlying.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoff_boundary_surjective_iff
statement:
theorem cutoff_boundary_surjective_iff (X : CutoffModels C q) (j : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (X.obj.underlying.boundary j) ↔
      ∀ a : cutoffBoundary hC q j ⟶ X, ∃ b : cutoffDisk hC q j ⟶ X, cutoffI hC q j ≫ b = a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderNode_high_hasFillers
statement:
theorem cylinderNode_high_hasFillers {j : ℕ} (hj : n < j) (hnq : n ≤ q)
    (ε : Bool)
    (hA : (GlobularFrame.oneSided (cylinderEndpoint hC q n ε) j).obj.underlying.HasFillers) :
    (cylinderNode hC q n j).obj.obj.underlying.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinder_oneSided_contractible
statement:
theorem cylinder_oneSided_contractible (hnq : n ≤ q) (H : ExpansionContraction hC q (n+1)) :
    ∀ j, n < j → ∀ ε : Bool,
      Cofibrant hC q (GlobularFrame.oneSided (cylinderEndpoint hC q n ε) j) ∧
      (GlobularFrame.oneSided (cylinderEndpoint hC q n ε) j).obj.underlying.HasFillers ∧
      (sourceClass hC q (n+1)).rlp.llp (GlobularFrame.oneSidedMap (cylinderEndpoint hC q n ε) j)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.hasFillers_of_iso
statement:
theorem hasFillers_of_iso {X Y : CutoffModels C q} (e : X ≅ Y)
    (hX : X.obj.underlying.HasFillers) : Y.obj.underlying.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.Cofibrant.of_iso
statement:
theorem Cofibrant.of_iso {X Y : CutoffModels C q} (hX : Cofibrant hC q X) (e : X ≅ Y) :
    Cofibrant hC q Y

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.boundary_cofibration_split
statement:
theorem boundary_cofibration_split {r : ℕ} {X Y : CutoffModels C q} (i : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : (boundaryClass hC q r).rlp.llp i) (hX : X.obj.underlying.HasFillers) :
    ∃ s : Y ⟶ X, i ≫ s = 𝟙 X

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderNode_contractible
statement:
theorem cylinderNode_contractible (hnq : n ≤ q) (H : ExpansionContraction hC q (n+1)) (j : ℕ) :
    Cofibrant hC q (cylinderNode hC q n j).obj ∧
      (cylinderNode hC q n j).obj.obj.underlying.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderShape_contractible
statement:
theorem cylinderShape_contractible (hnq : n ≤ q) (H : ExpansionContraction hC q (n+1)) (S : Shape) :
    Cofibrant hC q (cylinderShape hC q n S) ∧ (cylinderShape hC q n S).obj.underlying.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinder_oneSided_split_high
statement:
theorem cylinder_oneSided_split_high (hnq : n ≤ q) (H : ExpansionContraction hC q (n+1))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : n < j) (ε : Bool) :
    ∃ s : (cylinderFrame hC q n).obj j ⟶ GlobularFrame.oneSided (cylinderEndpoint hC q n ε) j,
      GlobularFrame.oneSidedMap (cylinderEndpoint hC q n ε) j ≫ s = 𝟙 _

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Hom.cell_realization
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem cell_realization (e : Hom D B) (S : GlobularPresheaf.{v})
    (k : ℕ) (x : S.underlying.Cell k) :
    D.cell S k x ≫ e.realization.app S = e.obj k ≫ B.cell S k x

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.cell_naturality
OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.shapeEndpoint_globe
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem shapeEndpoint_globe {D B : GlobularFrame K} (e : Hom D B) (j : ℕ) :
    (D.shapeGlobeIso j).inv ≫ e.shapeEndpoint.app (Shape.globe j) ≫ (B.shapeGlobeIso j).hom = e.obj j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.shapeGlobeIso_cell
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem shapeGlobeIso_cell (B : GlobularFrame K) (j : ℕ) :
    B.cell (Shape.liftedRealization.obj (Shape.globe j)) j (ULift.up (ULift.up (𝟙 (Globe.mk j)))) ≫
      (B.shapeGlobeIso j).hom = 𝟙 _

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.shapeGlobeIso_face
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem shapeGlobeIso_face (B : GlobularFrame K) {j k : ℕ} (h : j < k) (ε : Bool) :
    B.shapeRealization.map (Shape.face h ε) ≫
      (B.shapeGlobeIso k).hom = (B.shapeGlobeIso j).hom ≫ B.diagram.face h ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.shapeGlobeIso_inv_cell
statement:
theorem shapeGlobeIso_inv_cell (B : GlobularFrame K) (j : ℕ) :
    (B.shapeGlobeIso j).inv = B.cell (Shape.liftedRealization.obj (Shape.globe j)) j
      (ULift.up (ULift.up (𝟙 (Globe.mk j))))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffFrameHomEquiv_left
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem cutoffFrameHomEquiv_left {S T : GlobularPresheaf.{v}} (f : S ⟶ T)
    (Y : CutoffModels C q) (a : (cutoffDiskFrame hC q).realization.obj T ⟶ Y) :
    cutoffFrameHomEquiv hC q S Y ((cutoffDiskFrame hC q).realization.map f ≫ a) =
      f ≫ cutoffFrameHomEquiv hC q T Y a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffShapeEquiv_left
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem cutoffShapeEquiv_left {S T : Shape} (f : S ⟶ T)
    (Y : CutoffModels C q) (a : (cutoffRepresentables hC q).obj ⟨T⟩ ⟶ Y) :
    cutoffShapeEquiv hC q S Y ((cutoffRepresentables hC q).map (C.base f) ≫ a) =
      Shape.liftedRealization.map f ≫ cutoffShapeEquiv hC q T Y a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffShapeEquiv_top
statement:
@[simp] theorem cutoffShapeEquiv_top (Y : CutoffModels C q) (j : ℕ)
    (a : cutoffDisk hC q j ⟶ Y) :
    (cutoffShapeEquiv hC q (Shape.globe j) Y a).app (op (Globe.mk j))
      (ULift.up (ULift.up (𝟙 (Globe.mk j)))) = cutoffCellEquiv hC q Y j a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.shapeGlobularEquiv_left
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem shapeGlobularEquiv_left {S T : Shape} (f : S ⟶ T)
    (X : C.Model) (a : freeShape C T ⟶ X) :
    shapeGlobularEquiv S X (yoneda.map (C.base f) ≫ a) =
      Shape.liftedRealization.map f ≫ shapeGlobularEquiv T X a

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.shapeRealization_sums
statement:
theorem shapeRealization_sums (B : GlobularFrame K) (S : Shape) (b h : ℕ)
    (hl : b < S.1) (hr : b < h) :
    IsPushout (B.shapeRealization.map (S.seam hl))
      (B.shapeRealization.map (Shape.face hr false))
      (B.shapeRealization.map (S.inl b h hl hr))
      (B.shapeRealization.map (S.inr b h hl hr))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffRepresentables_sums
statement:
theorem cutoffRepresentables_sums (S : Shape) (b h : ℕ) (hl : b < S.1) (hr : b < h) :
    IsPushout ((cutoffRepresentables hC q).map (C.base (S.seam hl)))
      ((cutoffRepresentables hC q).map (C.base (Shape.face hr false)))
      ((cutoffRepresentables hC q).map (C.base (S.inl b h hl hr)))
      ((cutoffRepresentables hC q).map (C.base (S.inr b h hl hr)))

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderShapeEndpoint_globe
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem cylinderShapeEndpoint_globe (ε : Bool) (j : ℕ) :
    (cylinderShapeEndpoint hC q n ε).app (Shape.globe j) ≫
      ((cylinderFrame hC q n).shapeGlobeIso j).hom = (cylinderEndpoint hC q n ε).obj j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.completedCylinder_extend
statement:
theorem completedCylinder_extend (j : ℕ) (B : CutoffModels C q)
    (e : Bool → (cutoffBoundary hC q j ⟶ B)) {Y : CutoffModels C q}
    (hY : Y.obj.underlying.HasFillers) (b : B ⟶ Y)
    (d : Bool → (cutoffDisk hC q j ⟶ Y))
    (hd : ∀ ε, e ε ≫ b = cutoffI hC q j ≫ d ε) :
    ∃ l : (completedCylinder hC q n j B e).obj ⟶ Y,
      (completedCylinder hC q n j B e).inc ≫ l = b ∧
      ∀ ε, (completedCylinder hC q n j B e).endpoint ε ≫ l = d ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.criticalCylinder_extend
statement:
theorem criticalCylinder_extend {Y : CutoffModels C q}
    (hY : Y.obj.underlying.HasFillers)
    (b : (cutoffDiskFrame hC q).bd n ⟶ Y)
    (d : Bool → ((cutoffDiskFrame hC q).obj n ⟶ Y))
    (hd : ∀ ε, b = (cutoffDiskFrame hC q).inc n ≫ d ε) :
    ∃ l : (CylinderNode.critical (cutoffDiskFrame hC q) n).obj ⟶ Y,
      (CylinderNode.critical (cutoffDiskFrame hC q) n).inc ≫ l = b ∧
      ∀ ε, (CylinderNode.critical (cutoffDiskFrame hC q) n).endpoint ε ≫ l = d ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderNode_extend
statement:
theorem cylinderNode_extend (j : ℕ) {Y : CutoffModels C q}
    (hY : Y.obj.underlying.HasFillers) (b : (cylinderNode hC q n j).bd ⟶ Y)
    (d : Bool → (cutoffDisk hC q j ⟶ Y))
    (hd : ∀ ε, (cylinderNode hC q n j).bdEnd ε ≫ b = cutoffI hC q j ≫ d ε)
    (hlow : j < n → d false = d true) :
    ∃ l : (cylinderNode hC q n j).obj ⟶ Y,
      (cylinderNode hC q n j).inc ≫ l = b ∧
      ∀ ε, (cylinderNode hC q n j).endpoint ε ≫ l = d ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderShapeEndpoint_low
statement:
theorem cylinderShapeEndpoint_low (S : Shape) (hS : S.height < n) :
    (cylinderShapeEndpoint hC q n false).app S = (cylinderShapeEndpoint hC q n true).app S

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.shapeGlobeIso_source
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem shapeGlobeIso_source (B : GlobularFrame K) (j : ℕ) :
    B.shapeRealization.map (Shape.source j) ≫ (B.shapeGlobeIso (j+1)).hom =
      (B.shapeGlobeIso j).hom ≫ B.diagram.source j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.shapeGlobeIso_source_inv
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem shapeGlobeIso_source_inv (B : GlobularFrame K) (j : ℕ) :
    B.diagram.source j ≫ (B.shapeGlobeIso (j+1)).inv =
      (B.shapeGlobeIso j).inv ≫ B.shapeRealization.map (Shape.source j)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.shapeGlobeIso_target
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem shapeGlobeIso_target (B : GlobularFrame K) (j : ℕ) :
    B.shapeRealization.map (Shape.target j) ≫ (B.shapeGlobeIso (j+1)).hom =
      (B.shapeGlobeIso j).hom ≫ B.diagram.target j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.shapeGlobeIso_target_inv
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem shapeGlobeIso_target_inv (B : GlobularFrame K) (j : ℕ) :
    B.diagram.target j ≫ (B.shapeGlobeIso (j+1)).inv =
      (B.shapeGlobeIso j).inv ≫ B.shapeRealization.map (Shape.target j)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffRepresentables_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem cutoffRepresentables_source (j : ℕ) :
    (cutoffRepresentables hC q).map (C.base (Shape.source j)) =
      (cutoffDiskFrame hC q).diagram.source j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cutoffRepresentables_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem cutoffRepresentables_target (j : ℕ) :
    (cutoffRepresentables hC q).map (C.base (Shape.target j)) =
      (cutoffDiskFrame hC q).diagram.target j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderShapeEndpoint_globe_inv
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem cylinderShapeEndpoint_globe_inv (ε : Bool) (j : ℕ) :
    (cylinderEndpoint hC q n ε).obj j ≫ ((cylinderFrame hC q n).shapeGlobeIso j).inv =
      (cylinderShapeEndpoint hC q n ε).app (Shape.globe j)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderInterpretation_projection
statement:
theorem cylinderInterpretation_projection (hnq : n ≤ q) (H : ExpansionContraction hC q (n+1)) :
    (cylinderInterpretation hC q n hnq H).comp (cylinderProjection hC q n) = Morphism.id C

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderPairBoundary_endpoint
statement:
theorem cylinderPairBoundary_endpoint (a : (cylinderTheory hC q n).AdmissiblePair)
    (z : C.Hom (Shape.globe (a.n+1)) a.arity) (hz : Fills (cylinderProjection hC q n) a z) (ε : Bool) :
    (cylinderEndpoint hC q n ε).bd (a.n+1) ≫ cylinderPairBoundary hC q n a =
      (cutoffDiskFrame hC q).inc (a.n+1) ≫ (cutoffRepresentables hC q).map z ≫
        (cylinderShapeEndpoint hC q n ε).app a.arity

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderPairBoundary_left
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem cylinderPairBoundary_left (a : (cylinderTheory hC q n).AdmissiblePair) :
    (cylinderFrame hC q n).left a.n ≫ cylinderPairBoundary hC q n a =
      ((cylinderFrame hC q n).shapeGlobeIso a.n).inv ≫ a.source.cylinder

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderPairBoundary_right
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem cylinderPairBoundary_right (a : (cylinderTheory hC q n).AdmissiblePair) :
    (cylinderFrame hC q n).right a.n ≫ cylinderPairBoundary hC q n a =
      ((cylinderFrame hC q n).shapeGlobeIso a.n).inv ≫ a.target.cylinder

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderPair_parallel
statement:
theorem cylinderPair_parallel (a : (cylinderTheory hC q n).AdmissiblePair) :
    (cylinderFrame hC q n).inc a.n ≫ ((cylinderFrame hC q n).shapeGlobeIso a.n).inv ≫ a.source.cylinder =
      (cylinderFrame hC q n).inc a.n ≫ ((cylinderFrame hC q n).shapeGlobeIso a.n).inv ≫ a.target.cylinder

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderProjection_liftsFillers
statement:
theorem cylinderProjection_liftsFillers (hnq : n ≤ q)
    (H : ExpansionContraction hC q (n+1)) : LiftsFillers (cylinderProjection hC q n)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderInterpretation_original
statement:
theorem cylinderInterpretation_original {S T : Shape} (f : C.Hom S T) :
    ((cylinderInterpretation hC q n hnq H).map f).original = f

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderRealization_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem cylinderRealization_base {S T : Shape} (f : S ⟶ T) :
    (cylinderRealization hC q n hnq H).map (C.base f) =
      (cylinderFrame hC q n).shapeRealization.map f

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.fullCylinderCoevaluation_evaluation
statement:
@[simp] theorem fullCylinderCoevaluation_evaluation (Y : CutoffModels C q) :
    (fullCylinderCoevaluation hC q n hnq H Y).comp (fullCylinderEvaluation hC q n hnq H Y) =
      GlobularSet.Hom.id _

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.fullCylinderEvaluation_coevaluation
statement:
@[simp] theorem fullCylinderEvaluation_coevaluation (Y : CutoffModels C q) :
    (fullCylinderEvaluation hC q n hnq H Y).comp (fullCylinderCoevaluation hC q n hnq H Y) =
      GlobularSet.Hom.id _

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.inc_source_eq_inc_target
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem inc_source_eq_inc_target (B : GlobularFrame K) (k : ℕ) :
    B.inc k ≫ B.diagram.source k = B.inc k ≫ B.diagram.target k

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.jointSource_lifting
statement:
theorem jointSource_lifting {X Y : K} (p : X ⟶ Y) (k : ℕ)
    (h₀ : HasLiftingProperty (twoEndedMap e k) p)
    (h₁ : HasLiftingProperty (twoEndedMap e (k+1)) p) :
    HasLiftingProperty (jointSourceMap e k) p

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.twoEnded_lift
statement:
theorem twoEnded_lift {X Y : K} (p : X ⟶ Y) (j : ℕ)
    (h : HasLiftingProperty (twoEndedMap e j) p)
    (a : B.bd j ⟶ X) (d : Bool → (D.obj j ⟶ X))
    (hd : ∀ ε, (e ε).bd j ≫ a = D.inc j ≫ d ε)
    (y : B.obj j ⟶ Y) (ha : a ≫ p = B.inc j ≫ y)
    (hy : ∀ ε, d ε ≫ p = (e ε).obj j ≫ y) :
    ∃ l : B.obj j ⟶ X, B.inc j ≫ l = a ∧ (∀ ε, (e ε).obj j ≫ l = d ε) ∧ l ≫ p = y

name: OAI.Grothendieck.CylinderNode.critical_twoSide_lifting
statement:
theorem critical_twoSide_lifting (D : GlobularFrame K) (n : ℕ)
    {X Y : K} (p : X ⟶ Y) (h : HasLiftingProperty (D.inc (n+1)) p) :
    HasLiftingProperty ((critical D n).twoSideMap) p

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.completedCylinder_twoSide_upper
statement:
theorem completedCylinder_twoSide_upper (j : ℕ) (B : CutoffModels C q)
    (e : Bool → (cutoffBoundary hC q j ⟶ B)) :
    (boundaryClass hC q (n+1)).rlp.llp ((completedCylinder hC q n j B e).twoSideMap)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderFrame_jointSource_upper
statement:
theorem cylinderFrame_jointSource_upper (k : ℕ) (hk : n ≤ k) :
    (boundaryClass hC q (n+1)).rlp.llp
      (GlobularFrame.jointSourceMap (cylinderEndpoint hC q n) k)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinderFrame_twoEnded_upper
statement:
theorem cylinderFrame_twoEnded_upper {j : ℕ} (hj : n ≤ j) :
    (boundaryClass hC q (n+1)).rlp.llp
      (GlobularFrame.twoEndedMap (cylinderEndpoint hC q n) j)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.criticalJoint_retract
statement:
theorem criticalJoint_retract (e : Bool → Hom D B) (n : ℕ)
    (i : B.obj n ≅ D.obj (n+1))
    (hs : (e false).obj n ≫ i.hom = D.diagram.source n)
    (ht : (e true).obj n ≫ i.hom = D.diagram.target n)
    (hb : (e false).bd n = (e true).bd n) [Epi ((e false).bd n)] :
    ∃ f : jointSource e n ⟶ oneSided (e false) (n+1),
      ∃ g : oneSided (e false) (n+1) ⟶ jointSource e n, f ≫ g = 𝟙 _

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.oneSided_split_of_endpoint
statement:
theorem oneSided_split_of_endpoint (e : Hom D B) (j : ℕ) [Epi (e.bd j)]
    (r : B.obj j ⟶ D.obj j) (hr : e.obj j ≫ r = 𝟙 _) :
    ∃ s : B.obj j ⟶ oneSided e j, oneSidedMap e j ≫ s = 𝟙 _

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinder_critical_joint_contractible
statement:
theorem cylinder_critical_joint_contractible (hnq : n ≤ q)
    (H : ExpansionContraction hC q (n+1)) :
    (GlobularFrame.jointSource (cylinderEndpoint hC q n) n).obj.underlying.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinder_joint_contractible
statement:
theorem cylinder_joint_contractible (hnq : n ≤ q) (H : ExpansionContraction hC q (n+1))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : n ≤ k) :
    (GlobularFrame.jointSource (cylinderEndpoint hC q n) k).obj.underlying.HasFillers

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinder_joint_split
statement:
theorem cylinder_joint_split (hnq : n ≤ q) (H : ExpansionContraction hC q (n+1))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : n ≤ k) :
    ∃ s : (cylinderFrame hC q n).obj (k+1) ⟶
        GlobularFrame.jointSource (cylinderEndpoint hC q n) k,
      GlobularFrame.jointSourceMap (cylinderEndpoint hC q n) k ≫ s = 𝟙 _

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.cylinder_oneSided_split
statement:
theorem cylinder_oneSided_split (hnq : n ≤ q) (H : ExpansionContraction hC q (n+1))
    (j : ℕ) (ε : Bool) :
    ∃ s : (cylinderFrame hC q n).obj j ⟶ GlobularFrame.oneSided (cylinderEndpoint hC q n ε) j,
      GlobularFrame.oneSidedMap (cylinderEndpoint hC q n ε) j ≫ s = 𝟙 _

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularTheory.Model.target_comp_unitMap
statement: @[simp] theorem target_comp_unitMap (j : ℕ) : targetDisk C j ≫ unitMap C hC j = 𝟙 _

name: OAI.Grothendieck.TwoEndpoints.base_property
statement:
theorem base_property (W : MorphismProperty K) [W.IsStableUnderCobaseChange]
    [W.IsStableUnderComposition] {Bd Disk B : K} (i : Bd ⟶ Disk)
    (e : Bool → (Bd ⟶ B)) (hi : W i) : W (base i e)

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.Hom.pre_liftsBoundary
statement:
theorem Hom.pre_liftsBoundary (e : Hom D B) (Y : K) (j : ℕ)
    (s : B.obj j ⟶ oneSided e j) (hs : oneSidedMap e j ≫ s = 𝟙 _) :
    GlobularSet.LiftsBoundary (e.pre Y) j

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularFrame.jointSource_lift
statement:
theorem jointSource_lift (e : Bool → Hom D B) (Y : K) (k : ℕ)
    (s : B.obj (k+1) ⟶ jointSource e k) (hs : jointSourceMap e k ≫ s = 𝟙 _)
    (t : B.obj k ⟶ Y) (u : Bool → (D.obj (k+1) ⟶ Y))
    (hu : ∀ ε, (e ε).obj k ≫ t = D.diagram.source k ≫ u ε) :
    ∃ l : B.obj (k+1) ⟶ Y, B.diagram.source k ≫ l = t ∧
      ∀ ε, (e ε).obj (k+1) ≫ l = u ε

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.LiftsBoundary.comp
statement:
theorem LiftsBoundary.comp {X Y Z : GlobularSet.{v}} {f : Hom X Y} {g : Hom Y Z}
    {k : ℕ} (hf : LiftsBoundary f k) (hg : LiftsBoundary g k) : LiftsBoundary (f.comp g) k

name: OAI.Grothendieck.GlobularSet.liftsBoundary_of_bijective
statement:
theorem liftsBoundary_of_bijective {X Y : GlobularSet.{v}} (p : Hom X Y) (k : ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ j, j ≤ k → Function.Bijective (p.app j)) : LiftsBoundary p k

theorem reflectedCylinder_joint_cells (Y : CutoffModels C q) (k : ℕ) (hk : n ≤ k)
    (t : (reflectedCylinder hC q n hnq H Y).obj.underlying.Cell k)
    (u : Bool → Y.obj.underlying.Cell (k+1))
    (hu : ∀ ε, (underlyingMap (reflectedCylinderEndpoint hC q n hnq H Y ε).hom).app k t =
      Y.obj.underlying.source k (u ε)) :
    ∃ l : (reflectedCylinder hC q n hnq H Y).obj.underlying.Cell (k+1),
      (reflectedCylinder hC q n hnq H Y).obj.underlying.source k l = t ∧
      ∀ ε, (underlyingMap (reflectedCylinderEndpoint hC q n hnq H Y ε).hom).app (k+1) l = u ε

lemma coloring_extension {P : Type*} (port : P ↪ V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hd : ∀ v, G.degree v ≤ 2)
    (hb : ∀ v, G.degree v = 1 ↔ ∃ p, port p = v) (color : P → Bool) :
    (boundaryPairing G port hd hb).Compatible color ↔
      ∃ c : V → Bool, (∀ p, c (port p) = color p) ∧
        ∀ x y, G.Adj x y → c x = c y

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.diagram_compatible
statement:
lemma diagram_compatible [Fintype Q] (r : Equiv.Perm (Incidence Q))
    (left right : Port Q → Bool) :
    (diagram Q r).Compatible (Sum.elim left right) ↔ ∃ f : Tip Q → Bool,
    (∀ s slot l, (if s then right else left) (slot,l) = f (.inl (s,slot),tipRole s l)) ∧
    (∀ pq role t, f (.inr (pq,role),t) = f (.inr (pq,!role),!t)) ∧
    (∀ i, f (i,false) = f (r i,true))

    (∀ b l, c (b,l) = f (.inl b, tipRole b.1 l)) ∧
    (∀ pq r t, f (.inr (pq,r),t) = f (.inr (pq,!r),!t))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.DMachine.toMachine_accepts

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.positiveCopy_accepts

lemma positiveCopy_accepts (w : List Alpha) :

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.positiveCopy_reach
statement:
lemma positiveCopy_reach (w : List Alpha) (c c' : Config (Q := Q) w) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (M.positiveCopy.Step w) (c.1, some c.2) (c'.1, some c'.2) ↔
      Relation.ReflTransGen (M.Step w) c c'

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.positiveCopy_step
statement:
lemma positiveCopy_step (w : List Alpha) (i : Fin (w.length + 2)) (q : Option Q)
    (c' : Config (Q := Option Q) w) :
    M.positiveCopy.Step w (i, q) c' ↔
      ∃ r, c'.2 = some r ∧ M.Step w (i, q.getD M.initial) (c'.1, r)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.sinkCopy_accepts
statement:
lemma sinkCopy_accepts (w : List Alpha) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (M.sinkCopy.Step w) (⟨0, by omega⟩, some M.initial) (terminal w) ↔
      M.Accepts false w

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.sinkCopy_reach_iff
statement:
lemma sinkCopy_reach_iff (w : List Alpha) (c : Config (Q := Q) w) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (M.sinkCopy.Step w) (c.1, some c.2) (terminal w) ↔
      ∃ a, Relation.ReflTransGen (M.Step w) c a ∧ a.2 ∈ M.accepting

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.sinkCopy_step_old
statement:
lemma sinkCopy_step_old (w : List Alpha) (c : Config (Q := Q) w)
    (c' : Config (Q := Option Q) w) :
    M.sinkCopy.Step w (c.1, some c.2) c' ↔
      (c.2 ∈ M.accepting ∧ c' = (c.1, none)) ∨
      (c.2 ∉ M.accepting ∧ ∃ r, c'.2 = some r ∧ M.Step w c (c'.1, r))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.sinkCopy_sweep
statement:
lemma sinkCopy_sweep (w : List Alpha) (i : Fin (w.length + 2)) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (M.sinkCopy.Step w) (i, none) (terminal w)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.Machine.sinkCopy_terminal
statement:
lemma sinkCopy_terminal (w : List Alpha) :
    M.sinkCopy.transition (terminal (Q := Q) w).2 (scanned w (terminal (Q := Q) w).1) = none

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.scanned_eq_left_iff

lemma scanned_eq_left_iff {Alpha : Type} (w : List Alpha) (i : Fin (w.length + 2)) :

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.scanned_eq_right_iff
statement:
lemma scanned_eq_right_iff {Alpha : Type} (w : List Alpha) (i : Fin (w.length + 2)) :

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.edge_sameCycle
statement:
lemma edge_sameCycle [Finite E] {t : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (e : E)
    (h : G.Reach (G.src e) t) : R.tour.SameCycle (e, false) (e, true)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.flip_sameCycle
statement:
lemma flip_sameCycle [Finite E] {t : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (d : E × Bool)
    (hd : G.Reach (G.vertex d) t) : R.tour.SameCycle d (G.flip d)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.perm_sameCycle
statement:
lemma perm_sameCycle [Finite E] {t : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (d : E × Bool)
    (hd : G.Reach (G.vertex d) t) : R.tour.SameCycle d (R.perm d)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.reach_sameCycle
statement:
lemma reach_sameCycle [Finite E] {t : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (d d' : E × Bool)
    (h : G.Reach (G.vertex d) (G.vertex d')) (ht' : G.Reach (G.vertex d') t) :
    R.tour.SameCycle d d'

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.tour_flip
statement: @[simp] lemma tour_flip (d : E × Bool) : R.tour (G.flip d) = R.perm d

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.tour_vertex
statement: lemma tour_vertex (d : E × Bool) : G.vertex (R.tour d) = G.vertex (G.flip d)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.vertex_pow
statement: lemma vertex_pow (n : ℕ) (d : E × Bool) : G.vertex ((R.perm ^ n) d) = G.vertex d

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.Rotation.vertex_sameCycle
statement:
lemma vertex_sameCycle [Finite E] {t : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (d d' : E × Bool)
    (hd : G.Reach (G.vertex d) t) (he : G.vertex d = G.vertex d') :
    R.tour.SameCycle d d'

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.deterministic
statement: lemma deterministic {v w z : V} (h : G.Step v w) (h' : G.Step v z) : w = z

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.edge_cut
statement:
lemma edge_cut {e f : E} (hne : f ≠ e) :
    G.Reach (G.src f) (G.src e) ↔ G.Reach (G.dst f) (G.src e)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.edge_not_return
statement:
lemma edge_not_return {t : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (e : E)
    (h : G.Reach (G.src e) t) : ¬ G.Reach (G.dst e) (G.src e)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.flip_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma flip_apply (d : E × Bool) : G.flip d = (d.1, !d.2)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.reach_of_terminal
statement: lemma reach_of_terminal {t v : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t) (h : G.Reach t v) : t = v

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.successor_reaches
statement:
lemma successor_reaches {t v w : V} (ht : ∀ e, G.src e ≠ t)
    (hv : G.Reach v t) (hvw : G.Step v w) : G.Reach w t

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.vertex_false
statement: @[simp] lemma vertex_false (e : E) : G.vertex (e, false) = G.src e

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.FunctionalEdges.vertex_true
statement: @[simp] lemma vertex_true (e : E) : G.vertex (e, true) = G.dst e

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.permutation_single_entrance
statement:
lemma permutation_single_entrance {D : Type*} [Finite D] (τ : Equiv.Perm D)
    (U : Set D) (a b : D) (ha : a ∈ U) (ha' : τ a ∉ U)
    (hin : ∀ d, d ∉ U → τ d ∈ U → d = b) : τ.SameCycle a b

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.sameCycle_permCongr
statement:
lemma sameCycle_permCongr {D D' : Type*} (e : D ≃ D') (τ : Equiv.Perm D)
    {d d' : D} (h : τ.SameCycle d d') : (e.permCongrHom τ).SameCycle (e d) (e d')

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.decorate_injective
statement: lemma decorate_injective (w : List Alpha) : Function.Injective (decorate M w)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.edgeInc_incEdge
statement: lemma edgeInc_incEdge (n : ℕ) (d : WholeInc Q n) : edgeInc Q n (incEdge Q n d) = d

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.edgeKey_injective
statement: lemma edgeKey_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (edgeKey Q n)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.graphOrder_apply
statement:
lemma graphOrder_apply [Fintype Q] (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (d : Edge Q w.length × Bool) :
    edgeInc Q w.length ((graphOrder M finish w).perm d) =
      (wholeOrder M finish w).perm (edgeInc Q w.length d)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.graph_reach_state
statement:
lemma graph_reach_state (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (c c' : Machine.Config (Q := Q) w) :
    (graph M finish w).Reach (stateVertex w c) (stateVertex w c') ↔
      Relation.ReflTransGen (M.Step w) c c'

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.graph_step_from_state
statement:
lemma graph_step_from_state (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (c : Machine.Config (Q := Q) w)
    (v : Vertex Q w.length) :
    (graph M finish w).Step (stateVertex w c) v ↔
      ∃ c', v = stateVertex w c' ∧ M.Step w c c'

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.graph_terminal
statement:
lemma graph_terminal (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (t : Machine.Config (Q := Q) w)
    (ht : M.transition t.2 (scanned w t.1) = none) :
    ∀ e, (graph M finish w).src e ≠ stateVertex w t

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.graph_vertex
statement:
lemma graph_vertex (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (d : Edge Q w.length × Bool) :
    (graph M finish w).vertex d = wholeVertex M finish w (edgeInc Q w.length d)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.incEdge_edgeInc
statement: lemma incEdge_edgeInc (n : ℕ) (d : Edge Q n × Bool) : incEdge Q n (edgeInc Q n d) = d

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.outward_internal
statement:
lemma outward_internal (w : List Alpha) (j : Fin (w.length + 1)) :
    outward (scanned w j.castSucc) true = false ∧ outward (scanned w j.succ) false = false

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.scanned_outCell
statement:
lemma scanned_outCell (w : List Alpha) (s : Bool) :
    scanned w (outCell w.length s) = if s then .right else .left

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.sourceAttach_eq_state
statement:
lemma sourceAttach_eq_state (b : Symbol Alpha) (k : Key Q) (p : Q) :
    sourceAttach M b k = .inl p ↔ k.2.1 = p ∧ M.transition p b = some (k.2.2,k.1)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.sourceAttach_injective
statement: lemma sourceAttach_injective (b : Symbol Alpha) : Function.Injective (sourceAttach M b)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.sourceInc_injective
statement: lemma sourceInc_injective : Function.Injective (sourceInc Q)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.stateVertex_injective
statement: lemma stateVertex_injective (w : List Alpha) : Function.Injective (stateVertex (Q := Q) w)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.test_destination
statement:
lemma test_destination (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (s : Bool) :
    (graph M finish w).dst (.inr (.inr (s,testSlot M finish))) =
      stateVertex w (outCell w.length s,if s then finish else M.initial)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.test_step
statement:
lemma test_step (finish : Q) (w : List Alpha) (s : Bool) :
    (graph M finish w).Step (.inr (s,testSlot M finish))
      (stateVertex w (outCell w.length s,if s then finish else M.initial))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.CellNetwork.wholePerm_pow
statement:
lemma wholePerm_pow (w : List Alpha) (r : Symbol Alpha → Equiv.Perm (Incidence Q))
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (w.length + 2)) (j : Incidence Q) :
    (wholePerm w r ^ n) (.inl (i,j)) = .inl (i,(r (scanned w i) ^ n) j)

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.NMachineOn.relabel_accepts
statement:
lemma relabel_accepts {n : ℕ} (e : Q ≃ Fin n) (positive : Bool) (w : List Alpha) :
    (M.relabel e).Accepts positive w ↔ M.Accepts positive w

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.NMachineOn.relabel_noLeft
statement:
lemma relabel_noLeft {n : ℕ} (e : Q ≃ Fin n)
    (hm : ∀ q b q', (q',.left) ∉ M.transition q b) : (M.relabel e).NoLeft

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.PathNFA.accepts_iff
statement:
lemma accepts_iff (positive : Bool) (w : List (BRel H)) :
    machine.Accepts positive w ↔ BRel.live w

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.PathNFA.good_step
statement:
lemma good_step (w : List (BRel H)) (c c' : NMachineOn.Config (Q := State H) w)
    (hg : Good w c) (hs : machine.Step w c c') : Good w c'

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.PathNFA.product_path
statement:
lemma product_path (w : List (BRel H)) (a b : H) :
    w.prod.holds a b ↔ ∃ p : ℕ → H, p 0 = a ∧ p w.length = b ∧
      ∀ i (hi : i < w.length), w[i].holds (p i) (p (i+1))

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.PathNFA.rules_noLeft
statement:
lemma rules_noLeft (q : State H) (b : Symbol (BRel H)) (q' : State H) :
    (q',.left) ∉ rules q b

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.PathNFA.scanned_letter_cell
statement:
lemma scanned_letter_cell (w : List (BRel H)) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < w.length) :
    scanned w ⟨i+1,by omega⟩ = .letter w[i]

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.PathNFA.scanned_letter_data
statement:
lemma scanned_letter_data (w : List (BRel H)) (i : Fin (w.length+2)) (R : BRel H)
    (hs : scanned w i = .letter R) : ∃ hi : i.val-1 < w.length, w[i.val-1] = R

name: OAI.OneWayLiveness.small_nfa
statement:
theorem small_nfa (h : ℕ) :
    ∃ N : NMachine (Alphabet h) (h+3), N.NoLeft ∧
      ∀ positive : Bool, N.Recognizes positive (OWL h)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.average_tv_sq_le_average_divergence
statement:
lemma average_tv_sq_le_average_divergence {a : J → ℝ} (ha : IsProb a)
    {p q : J → I → ℝ} (hp : ∀ j, IsProb (p j)) (hq : ∀ j, IsProb (q j))
    (hs : ∀ j, 0 < a j → ∀ i, 0 < p j i → 0 < q j i) :
    (∑ j, a j * tv (p j) (q j)) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, a j * divergence (p j) (q j)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.divergence_eq_sum
statement:
lemma divergence_eq_sum {p q : I → ℝ} (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < p i → 0 < q i) :
    divergence p q = ∑ i, (p i * Real.log (p i) - p i * Real.log (q i))

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.divergence_nonneg
statement:
lemma divergence_nonneg {p q : I → ℝ} (hp : IsProb p) (hq : IsProb q)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < p i → 0 < q i) : 0 ≤ divergence p q

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_eq_sum
statement:
lemma entropy_eq_sum {w p : I → ℝ} (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) :
    entropy w p = ∑ i, (p i * Real.log (w i) - p i * Real.log (p i))

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_ge_neg_log_of_density
statement:
lemma entropy_ge_neg_log_of_density {w p : I → ℝ} (_hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    (hp : IsProb p) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hden : ∀ i, p i ≤ b * w i) :
    -Real.log b ≤ entropy w p

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_mix_gap
statement:
lemma entropy_mix_gap {w : I → ℝ} (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    {a : J → ℝ} {p : J → I → ℝ} (ha : IsProb a) (hp : ∀ j, IsProb (p j)) :
    entropy w (fun i ↦ ∑ j, a j * p j i) - ∑ j, a j * entropy w (p j) =
      ∑ j, a j * divergence (p j) (fun i ↦ ∑ k, a k * p k i)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_sum_on
statement:
lemma entropy_sum_on {w p : I → ℝ} (D : Finset I)
    (hs : ∀ i, i ∉ D → p i = 0) : entropy w p = ∑ i ∈ D, p i * Real.log (w i / p i)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_supported_concentration
statement:
lemma entropy_supported_concentration (D s : Finset I) (hsD : s ⊆ D) {w p : I → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ D, 0 < w i) (hp : IsProb p) (hs : ∀ i, i ∉ D → p i = 0)
    {m M : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hwsmall : ∑ i ∈ s, w i ≤ m) (hwall : ∑ i ∈ D, w i ≤ M) :
    entropy w p ≤ Real.log 2 + Real.log m + (1 - ∑ i ∈ s, p i) * Real.log M

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_supported_le_log
statement:
lemma entropy_supported_le_log (D : Finset I) {w p : I → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ D, 0 < w i) (hp : IsProb p)
    (hs : ∀ i, i ∉ D → p i = 0) {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hwm : ∑ i ∈ D, w i ≤ m) :
    entropy w p ≤ Real.log m

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_tail
statement:
lemma entropy_tail {p w : I → ℝ} (hp : IsProb p) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    {x a : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hd : ∀ i, p i ≤ x * w i) :
    (a + Real.log x) * (∑ i, if p i < w i * Real.exp (-a) then p i else 0) ≤
      entropy w p + Real.log x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.entropy_tail_term
statement:
lemma entropy_tail_term {p w x a : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hw : 0 < w)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hd : p ≤ x * w) :
    (a + Real.log x) * (if p < w * Real.exp (-a) then p else 0) ≤
      p * (Real.log (w / p) + Real.log x)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.hellinger_le_divergence
statement:
lemma hellinger_le_divergence {p q : I → ℝ} (hp : IsProb p) (hq : IsProb q)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 < p i → 0 < q i) :
    (∑ i, (Real.sqrt (p i) - Real.sqrt (q i)) ^ 2) ≤ divergence p q

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.mix_isProb
statement:
lemma mix_isProb {a : J → ℝ} {p : J → I → ℝ} (ha : IsProb a)
    (hp : ∀ j, IsProb (p j)) : IsProb (fun i ↦ ∑ j, a j * p j i)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.mix_support
statement:
lemma mix_support {a : J → ℝ} {p : J → I → ℝ} (ha : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j)
    (hp : ∀ j i, 0 ≤ p j i) {j : J} (hj : 0 < a j) {i : I} (hi : 0 < p j i) :
    0 < ∑ k, a k * p k i

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.mul_log_div
statement:
lemma mul_log_div {p w : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hw : 0 < w) :
    p * Real.log (w / p) = p * Real.log w - p * Real.log p

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.partial_entropy_le
statement:
lemma partial_entropy_le (s : Finset I) {w p : I → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < w i) (hp : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i)
    {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hwm : ∑ i ∈ s, w i ≤ m) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, p i * Real.log (w i / p i)) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, p i) * Real.log (m / (∑ i ∈ s, p i))

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.prob_sum_on
statement:
lemma prob_sum_on {p : I → ℝ} (hp : IsProb p) (D : Finset I)
    (hs : ∀ i, i ∉ D → p i = 0) : ∑ i ∈ D, p i = 1

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.relTerm_nonneg
statement:
lemma relTerm_nonneg {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hs : 0 < p → 0 < q) : 0 ≤ p * Real.log (p / q) - p + q

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.sqrt_sub_sq_le_relTerm
statement:
lemma sqrt_sub_sq_le_relTerm {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hs : 0 < p → 0 < q) :
    (Real.sqrt p - Real.sqrt q) ^ 2 ≤ p * Real.log (p / q) - p + q

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.tv_comm
statement: lemma tv_comm (p q : I → ℝ) : tv p q = tv q p

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.tv_nonneg
statement: lemma tv_nonneg (p q : I → ℝ) : 0 ≤ tv p q

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.tv_sq_le_hellinger
statement:
lemma tv_sq_le_hellinger {p q : I → ℝ} (hp : IsProb p) (hq : IsProb q) :
    tv p q ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, (Real.sqrt (p i) - Real.sqrt (q i)) ^ 2

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.tv_triangle
statement: lemma tv_triangle (p q r : I → ℝ) : tv p r ≤ tv p q + tv q r

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.FiniteEntropy.weighted_sq_le
statement:
lemma weighted_sq_le {a f : I → ℝ} (ha : IsProb a) :
    (∑ i, a i * f i) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, a i * (f i) ^ 2

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.ceil_bounds
statement:
lemma ceil_bounds {x : ℝ} (hx : 32 ≤ x) :
    0 < ⌈x⌉₊ ∧ x ≤ (⌈x⌉₊ : ℝ) ∧ (⌈x⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ 2 * x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.exists_iteration_threshold
statement:
lemma exists_iteration_threshold (a : ℝ) :
    ∃ X : ℝ, 32 ≤ X ∧ a * lossRatio X ≤ 1/4

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.exp_neg_le_inv_pow_seven
statement:
lemma exp_neg_le_inv_pow_seven {x : ℝ} (hx : 32 ≤ x) :
    Real.exp (-x) ≤ 1 / x ^ 7

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.growth_factor_le
statement:
lemma growth_factor_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 32 ≤ x) :
    1 + Real.exp x / threshold x ≤ Real.exp (4 * x)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.inv_scale
statement:
lemma inv_scale {X : ℝ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) (n : ℕ) :
    1 / scale X n ≤ (1/2 : ℝ)^n * (1/X)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.leakage_factor
statement:
lemma leakage_factor {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    x ^ 2 * threshold x * Real.exp x = 1 / x ^ 4

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.log_bounds
statement: lemma log_bounds {x : ℝ} (hx : 32 ≤ x) : 1 ≤ Real.log x ∧ 7 * Real.log x ≤ x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.lossRatio_nonneg
statement: lemma lossRatio_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) : 0 ≤ lossRatio x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.lossRatio_scale
statement:
lemma lossRatio_scale {X : ℝ} (hX : 16 ≤ X) (n : ℕ) :
    lossRatio (scale X n) ≤ (1/2 : ℝ)^n * lossRatio X

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.lossRatio_square
statement: lemma lossRatio_square {x : ℝ} (hx : 16 ≤ x) : lossRatio (x^2) ≤ (1/2) * lossRatio x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.pow_six_le_exp
statement: lemma pow_six_le_exp {x : ℝ} (hx : 32 ≤ x) : x ^ 6 ≤ Real.exp x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.recurrence_bound
statement:
lemma recurrence_bound {B q ε t m s : ℝ}
    (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (_hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε : ε ≤ q/4) (_ht : 0 ≤ t) (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (hs : s ≤ q/2)
    (hstep : (1-ε)*t - s*m ≤ B*(2-2*q)*m) :
    t ≤ B*(2-q)*m

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.scale_ge
statement: lemma scale_ge {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 ≤ X) (n : ℕ) : X ≤ scale X n

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.scale_ge_add
statement: lemma scale_ge_add {X : ℝ} (hX : 2 ≤ X) (n : ℕ) : X + n ≤ scale X n

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Numerical.threshold_pos
statement: lemma threshold_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : 0 < threshold x

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.commonMass_comm
statement:
lemma commonMass_comm (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (u v : V) :
    commonMass G w u v = commonMass G w v u

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.commonMass_eq_sum
statement:
lemma commonMass_eq_sum (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (u v : V) :
    commonMass G w u v = ∑ z ∈ neighbors G u, if G.Adj v z then w z else 0

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.commonMass_le_neighborMass
statement:
lemma commonMass_le_neighborMass (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v)
    (u v : V) : commonMass G w u v ≤ neighborMass G w u

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.commonMass_nonneg
statement:
lemma commonMass_nonneg (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v) (u v : V) :
    0 ≤ commonMass G w u v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.crossMass_all_left
statement:
lemma crossMass_all_left (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (A : Finset V) :
    crossMass G w univ A = ∑ u ∈ A, w u * neighborMass G w u

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.crossMass_all_right
statement:
lemma crossMass_all_right (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (A : Finset V) :
    crossMass G w A univ = ∑ u ∈ A, w u * neighborMass G w u

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.crossMass_factor
statement:
lemma crossMass_factor (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (A B : Finset V) :
    crossMass G w A B = ∑ u ∈ A, w u * mass w (B ∩ neighbors G u)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.crossMass_le_product
statement:
lemma crossMass_le_product (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v)
    (A B : Finset V) : crossMass G w A B ≤ mass w A * mass w B

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.crossMass_neighbors
statement:
lemma crossMass_neighbors (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ)
    (A : Finset V) (v : V) :

statement:
lemma edgeForm_spike [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (v : V) (t : ℝ) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeForm_symm
statement: lemma edgeForm_symm (G : SimpleGraph V) (a b : V → ℝ) : edgeForm G a b = edgeForm G b a

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeMass_add
statement:
lemma edgeMass_add (G : SimpleGraph V) (a b : V → ℝ) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeMass_mono_weight
statement:
lemma edgeMass_mono_weight (G : SimpleGraph V) {w q : V → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v) (hwq : ∀ v, w v ≤ q v) : edgeMass G w ≤ edgeMass G q

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeMass_spike
statement:
lemma edgeMass_spike [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (v : V) (t : ℝ) :

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.edgeMass_update
statement:
lemma edgeMass_update [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (v : V) (t : ℝ) :
    edgeMass G (Function.update w v t) = edgeMass G w + (t-w v)*neighborMass G w v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.exists_optimizer
statement: lemma exists_optimizer (G : SimpleGraph V) : ∃ w : V → ℝ, IsOptimizer G w

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.optimizer_divergence
statement:
lemma optimizer_divergence {G : SimpleGraph V} {w : V → ℝ} (hw : IsOptimizer G w)
    (q : V → ℝ) (hq : ∀ v, 0 ≤ q v) :
    0 ≤ potential G w - potential G q ∧
      potential G w - potential G q =
        (∑ v, (q v * Real.log (q v / w v) - q v + w v)) + edgeMass G (q-w)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.optimizer_stationary
statement:
lemma optimizer_stationary {G : SimpleGraph V} {w : V → ℝ} (hw : IsOptimizer G w) (v : V) :
    0 < w v ∧ Real.log (1/w v) = neighborMass G w v ∧ w v ≤ 1

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.potential_clamp
statement:
lemma potential_clamp (G : SimpleGraph V) {w : V → ℝ} (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v) :
    potential G w ≤ potential G (fun v ↦ min (w v) 1)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.potential_update
statement:
lemma potential_update [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : V → ℝ) (v : V) (t : ℝ) :
    potential G (Function.update w v t) - potential G w =
      vertexPotential t - vertexPotential (w v) - (t-w v)*neighborMass G w v

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.update_eq_add_spike
statement:
lemma update_eq_add_spike [DecidableEq V] (w : V → ℝ) (v : V) (t : ℝ) :
    Function.update w v t = w + spike v (t-w v)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.WeightedGraph.vertexPotential_le_one
statement: lemma vertexPotential_le_one {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : vertexPotential t ≤ 1

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_add
statement:
lemma expect_add (L : Law α) (f g : α → ℝ) :
    expect L (fun a ↦ f a + g a) = expect L f + expect L g

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_append
statement: lemma expect_append (L K : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) : expect (L++K) f = expect L f + expect K f

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma expect_cons (p : ℝ) (a : α) (L : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) :
    expect ((p,a)::L) f = p*f a + expect L f

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_const
statement: lemma expect_const (L : Law α) (a : ℝ) : expect L (fun _ ↦ a) = a * total L

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_mono
statement:
lemma expect_mono {L : Law α} (hL : Positive L) {f g : α → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ z ∈ L, f z.2 ≤ g z.2) : expect L f ≤ expect L g

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_mul
statement:
lemma expect_mul (L : Law α) (a : ℝ) (f : α → ℝ) :
    expect L (fun z ↦ a*f z) = a * expect L f

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma expect_nil (f : α → ℝ) : expect [] f = 0

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_singleton
statement: @[simp] lemma expect_singleton (p : ℝ) (a : α) (f : α → ℝ) : expect [(p,a)] f = p*f a

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_sum
statement:
lemma expect_sum {I : Type*} (L : Law α) (s : Finset I) (f : I → α → ℝ) :
    expect L (fun a ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, f i a) = ∑ i ∈ s, expect L (f i)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.expect_transform
statement:
lemma expect_transform (p : ℝ) (f : α → β) (L : Law α) (g : β → ℝ) :
    expect (transform p f L) g = p * expect L (g ∘ f)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.positive_append
statement: lemma positive_append {L K : Law α} (hL : Positive L) (hK : Positive K) : Positive (L++K)

name: OAI.CliqueFreeIndependence.Lottery.positive_transform
statement:
lemma positive_transform {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (f : α → β) {L : Law α} (hL : Positive L) :
