name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.mem_cubeSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_cubeSet {x : α → Bool} {a : α} :
    a ∈ cubeSet x ↔ x a = true

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.mem_unionTuple
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_unionTuple {k : ℕ} {f : Fin k → Finset α} {a : α} :
    a ∈ unionTuple f ↔ ∃ j, a ∈ f j

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.small_empty
statement: theorem small_empty (p : ℝ) : Small p (∅ : Family α)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.subset_unionTuple
statement:
theorem subset_unionTuple {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Finset α) (j : Fin k) :
    f j ⊆ unionTuple f

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.unionTuple_subset_iff
statement:
theorem unionTuple_subset_iff {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Finset α) (S : Finset α) :
    unionTuple f ⊆ S ↔ ∀ j, f j ⊆ S

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_add
statement:
theorem expectation_add (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => f ω + g ω) = μ.expectation f + μ.expectation g

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem expectation_const (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (c : ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun _ => c) = c

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_mono
statement:
theorem expectation_mono (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {f g : Ω → ℝ} (hfg : ∀ ω, f ω ≤ g ω) :
    μ.expectation f ≤ μ.expectation g

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_nonneg
statement:
theorem expectation_nonneg (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) :
    0 ≤ μ.expectation f

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_prod
statement:
theorem expectation_prod (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ) (f : Ω × Γ → ℝ) :
    (μ.prod ν).expectation f = μ.expectation (fun ω => ν.expectation (fun γ => f (ω, γ)))

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_smul
statement:
theorem expectation_smul (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => c * f ω) = c * μ.expectation f

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_sub
statement:
theorem expectation_sub (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => f ω - g ω) = μ.expectation f - μ.expectation g

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_sum
statement:
theorem expectation_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => ∑ i, f i ω) = ∑ i, μ.expectation (f i)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.iid_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem iid_weight (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (n : ℕ) (ω : Fin n → Ω) :
    (iid μ n).weight ω = ∏ i, μ.weight (ω i)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.pi_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem pi_weight {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {A : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (A i)]
    (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (A i)) (ω : ∀ i, A i) :
    (pi μ).weight ω = ∏ i, (μ i).weight (ω i)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_compl
statement:
theorem prob_compl (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) :
    μ.prob (fun ω => ¬ P ω) = 1 - μ.prob P

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_eq_expectation
statement:
theorem prob_eq_expectation (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) :
    μ.prob P = μ.expectation (fun ω => if P ω then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_false
statement: @[simp] theorem prob_false (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) : μ.prob (fun _ => False) = 0

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_ge_le_expectation_div
statement:
theorem prob_ge_le_expectation_div (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.prob (fun ω => t ≤ f ω) ≤ μ.expectation f / t

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_le_expectation
statement:
theorem prob_le_expectation (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) (hP : ∀ ω, P ω → 1 ≤ f ω) : μ.prob P ≤ μ.expectation f

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_le_one
statement: theorem prob_le_one (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) : μ.prob P ≤ 1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_mono
statement:
theorem prob_mono (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {P Q : Ω → Prop} (hPQ : ∀ ω, P ω → Q ω) :
    μ.prob P ≤ μ.prob Q

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_nonneg
statement: theorem prob_nonneg (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) : 0 ≤ μ.prob P

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_true
statement: @[simp] theorem prob_true (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) : μ.prob (fun _ => True) = 1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_union_le
statement:
theorem prob_union_le (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P Q : Ω → Prop) :
    μ.prob (fun ω => P ω ∨ Q ω) ≤ μ.prob P + μ.prob Q

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prod_isPositive
statement:
theorem prod_isPositive (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ)
    (hμ : μ.IsPositive) (hν : ν.IsPositive) : (μ.prod ν).IsPositive

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prod_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem prod_weight (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ) (ω : Ω) (γ : Γ) :
    (μ.prod ν).weight (ω, γ) = μ.weight ω * ν.weight γ

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.uniform_isPositive
statement:
theorem uniform_isPositive (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] :
    (uniform Ω).IsPositive

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.uniform_prob
statement:
theorem uniform_prob (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (P : Ω → Prop) :
    (uniform Ω).prob P = ((Finset.univ.filter P).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliExpectation_product
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_product (p : ℝ) (f : α → Bool → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => ∏ x, f x (decide (x ∈ W))) =
      ∏ x, (p * f x true + (1 - p) * f x false)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliLaw_expect_sum_mem
statement:
theorem bernoulliLaw_expect_sum_mem (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (f : α → ℝ) :
    (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).expectation (fun W => ∑ x ∈ W, f x) = p * ∑ x, f x

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliLaw_expectation
statement:
@[simp] theorem bernoulliLaw_expectation (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (f : Finset α → ℝ) :
    (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).expectation f = bernoulliExpectation p f

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliLaw_prob
statement:
@[simp] theorem bernoulliLaw_prob (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (P : Finset α → Prop) : (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).prob P = bernoulliProbability p P

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliLaw_prob_disjoint
statement:
theorem bernoulliLaw_prob_disjoint (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (A : Finset α) :
    (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).prob (fun W => Disjoint W A) = (1 - p) ^ A.card

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliLaw_prob_mem
statement:
theorem bernoulliLaw_prob_mem (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (a : α) :
    (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).prob (fun s => a ∈ s) = p

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliLaw_prob_subset
statement:
theorem bernoulliLaw_prob_subset (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (A : Finset α) :
    (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).prob (fun s => A ⊆ s) = p ^ A.card

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem bernoulliLaw_weight (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (W : Finset α) :
    (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).weight W = bernoulliWeight p W

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliProbability_disjoint
statement:
theorem bernoulliProbability_disjoint (p : ℝ) (A : Finset α) :
    bernoulliProbability p (fun W => Disjoint W A) = (1 - p) ^ A.card

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliProbability_eq_expectation
statement:
theorem bernoulliProbability_eq_expectation (p : ℝ) (P : Finset α → Prop) :
    bernoulliProbability p P = bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => if P W then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliProbability_subset
statement:
theorem bernoulliProbability_subset (p : ℝ) (A : Finset α) :
    bernoulliProbability p (fun W => A ⊆ W) = p ^ A.card

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliWeight_eq_mass
statement:
theorem bernoulliWeight_eq_mass (p : ℝ) (s : Finset α) :
    bernoulliWeight p s = bernoulliMass p s

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem bernoulliWeight_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (W : Finset α) :
    0 ≤ bernoulliWeight p W

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliWeight_pos
statement:
theorem bernoulliWeight_pos {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (W : Finset α) :
    0 < bernoulliWeight p W

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bernoulliWeight_sum
statement: theorem bernoulliWeight_sum (p : ℝ) : ∑ W : Finset α, bernoulliWeight p W = 1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bitLaw_prob_false
statement:
@[simp] theorem bitLaw_prob_false (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    (bitLaw p hp0 hp1).prob (fun b => b = false) = 1 - p

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bitLaw_prob_true
statement:
@[simp] theorem bitLaw_prob_true (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    (bitLaw p hp0 hp1).prob (fun b => b = true) = p

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bitLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem bitLaw_weight (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (b : Bool) :
    (bitLaw p hp0 hp1).weight b = bitWeight p b

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bitWeight_false
statement: @[simp] theorem bitWeight_false (p : ℝ) : bitWeight p false = 1 - p

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bitWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem bitWeight_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (b : Bool) :
    0 ≤ bitWeight p b

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bitWeight_true
statement: @[simp] theorem bitWeight_true (p : ℝ) : bitWeight p true = p

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeExpectation_eq_bernoulliExpectation
statement:
theorem cubeExpectation_eq_bernoulliExpectation (p : ℝ) (f : (α → Bool) → ℝ) :
    cubeExpectation p f = bernoulliExpectation p (fun s => f (finsetBoolEquiv s))

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeExpectation_familyIndicator
statement:
theorem cubeExpectation_familyIndicator (p : ℝ) (D : Family α) :
    cubeExpectation p (familyIndicator D) = familyMeasure p D

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeExpectation_product
statement:
theorem cubeExpectation_product (p : ℝ) (f : α → Bool → ℝ) :
    cubeExpectation p (fun x => ∏ i, f i (x i)) =
      ∏ i, (p * f i true + (1 - p) * f i false)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeSet_finsetBoolEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem cubeSet_finsetBoolEquiv (s : Finset α) :
    cubeSet (finsetBoolEquiv s) = s

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeWeight_finsetBoolEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem cubeWeight_finsetBoolEquiv (p : ℝ) (s : Finset α) :
    cubeWeight p (finsetBoolEquiv s) = bernoulliWeight p s

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem cubeWeight_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (x : α → Bool) :
    0 ≤ cubeWeight p x

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.cubeWeight_sum
statement: theorem cubeWeight_sum (p : ℝ) : ∑ x : α → Bool, cubeWeight p x = 1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.disjoint_indicator_product
statement:
theorem disjoint_indicator_product (A W : Finset α) :
    (if Disjoint W A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      ∏ x, (if x ∈ A then (if x ∈ W then (0 : ℝ) else 1) else 1)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.subset_indicator_product
statement:
theorem subset_indicator_product (A W : Finset α) :
    (if A ⊆ W then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      ∏ x, (if x ∈ A then (if x ∈ W then (1 : ℝ) else 0) else 1)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.sum_finset_product
statement:
theorem sum_finset_product (f : α → Bool → ℝ) :
    (∑ W : Finset α, ∏ x, f x (decide (x ∈ W))) =
      ∏ x, (f x true + f x false)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bin_card_cost_bound
statement:
theorem bin_card_cost_bound {n r h : ℕ} {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hw : (n : ℝ) * q ^ r * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h + 1) ≤ 1) :
    (n : ℝ) * (q / (2 : ℝ) ^ 70) ^ r ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (h + 1)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bin_power_bound
statement:
theorem bin_power_bound {m h : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ 2 ^ (12 * h)) :
    (m : ℝ) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ h) ^ 16 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (4 * h)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.finite_bin_cost_lt_quarter
statement:
theorem finite_bin_cost_lt_quarter (B : Finset (ℕ × ℕ))
    (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, 1 ≤ b.1 ∧ 64 * b.1 ≤ b.2) :
    (∑ b ∈ B, 3 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ b.2) < 1 / 4

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.finite_bin_geometric_bound
statement:
theorem finite_bin_geometric_bound (B : Finset (ℕ × ℕ))
    (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, 1 ≤ b.1 ∧ 64 * b.1 ≤ b.2) {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : a ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (∑ b ∈ B, a ^ b.2) ≤ 4 * a ^ 64

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.finite_bin_power_lt_threshold
statement:
theorem finite_bin_power_lt_threshold (B : Finset (ℕ × ℕ))
    (hB : ∀ b ∈ B, 1 ≤ b.1 ∧ 64 * b.1 ≤ b.2) :
    (∑ b ∈ B, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (4 * b.2)) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 32

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.outright_weight_le
statement:
theorem outright_weight_le {r : ℕ} {q w : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hw : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * r) ≤ w) :
    (q / (2 : ℝ) ^ 70) ^ r ≤ (1 / 64 : ℝ) * q ^ r * w

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.binExponent_eq_of_bounds
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.binExponent_lower
statement:
theorem binExponent_lower {w : ℝ} (hwpos : 0 < w) (hwle : w ≤ 1) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (binExponent w + 1) < w

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.binExponent_spec
statement:
theorem binExponent_spec {w : ℝ} (hwpos : 0 < w) (hwle : w ≤ 1) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (binExponent w + 1) < w ∧
      w ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ binExponent w

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.binExponent_upper
statement:
theorem binExponent_upper {w : ℝ} (hwpos : 0 < w) (hwle : w ≤ 1) :
    w ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ binExponent w

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.exists_dyadic_bin
statement:
theorem exists_dyadic_bin {w : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hwpos : 0 < w)
    (hwn : w < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) :
    ∃ h : ℕ, n ≤ h ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h + 1) < w ∧ w ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ h

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.le_binExponent_of_le_pow
statement:
theorem le_binExponent_of_le_pow {w : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hwpos : 0 < w)
    (hwn : w ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) : n ≤ binExponent w

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.le_binExponent_of_lt_pow
statement:
theorem le_binExponent_of_lt_pow {w : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hwpos : 0 < w)
    (hwn : w < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) : n ≤ binExponent w

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteFibers.fiber_nonempty_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fiber_nonempty_iff (A : Finset α) (key : α → β) (b : β) :
    (fiber A key b).Nonempty ↔ b ∈ keys A key

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteFibers.fiber_subset
statement:
theorem fiber_subset (A : Finset α) (key : α → β) (b : β) :
    fiber A key b ⊆ A

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteFibers.filter_fiber
statement:
theorem filter_fiber (A : Finset α) (key : α → β) (b : β)
    (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    fiber (A.filter P) key b = (fiber A key b).filter P

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteFibers.key_eq_of_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem key_eq_of_mem_fiber {A : Finset α} {key : α → β} {b : β} {a : α}
    (ha : a ∈ fiber A key b) : key a = b

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteFibers.mem_fiber
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_fiber {A : Finset α} {key : α → β} {b : β} {a : α} :
    a ∈ fiber A key b ↔ a ∈ A ∧ key a = b

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteFibers.mem_keys
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_keys {A : Finset α} {key : α → β} {b : β} :
    b ∈ keys A key ↔ ∃ a ∈ A, key a = b

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteFibers.sum_fibers
statement:
theorem sum_fibers (A : Finset α) (key : α → β) (f : α → M) :
    (∑ b ∈ keys A key, ∑ a ∈ fiber A key b, f a) = ∑ a ∈ A, f a

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteFibers.sum_filter_eq_sum_fibers
statement:
theorem sum_filter_eq_sum_fibers (A : Finset α) (key : α → β)
    (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (f : α → M) :
    (∑ a ∈ A.filter P, f a) =
      ∑ b ∈ keys A key, ∑ a ∈ (fiber A key b).filter P, f a

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteFibers.sum_filter_fibers
statement:
theorem sum_filter_fibers (A : Finset α) (key : α → β)
    (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (f : α → M) :
    (∑ b ∈ keys A key, ∑ a ∈ (fiber A key b).filter P, f a) =
      ∑ a ∈ A.filter P, f a

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.largeWeightFamily_cost_le
statement:
theorem largeWeightFamily_cost_le {q : ℝ} {W : Finset α → ℝ}
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hW : ∀ U, 0 ≤ W U)
    (hglobal : (∑ U : Finset α, q ^ U.card * W U) ≤ 1) :
    cost (q / (2 : ℝ) ^ 70) (largeWeightFamily W) ≤ 1 / 64

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.mem_largeWeightFamily
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_largeWeightFamily {W : Finset α → ℝ} {U : Finset α} :
    U ∈ largeWeightFamily W ↔
      U ≠ ∅ ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * U.card) ≤ W U

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.mem_smallWeightFamily
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_smallWeightFamily {W : Finset α → ℝ} {U : Finset α} :
    U ∈ smallWeightFamily W ↔
      U ≠ ∅ ∧ 0 < W U ∧ W U < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * U.card)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.mem_weightBin
statement:
theorem mem_weightBin {W : Finset α → ℝ} {U : Finset α} {b : ℕ × ℕ} :
    U ∈ weightBin W b ↔ U ∈ smallWeightFamily W ∧ weightBinKey W U = b

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.occupiedWeightBins_bounds
statement:
theorem occupiedWeightBins_bounds {W : Finset α → ℝ} {b : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hb : b ∈ occupiedWeightBins W) : 1 ≤ b.1 ∧ 64 * b.1 ≤ b.2

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.subfamily_weight_sum_le
statement:
theorem subfamily_weight_sum_le {q : ℝ} {W : Finset α → ℝ}
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hW : ∀ U, 0 ≤ W U)
    (hglobal : (∑ U : Finset α, q ^ U.card * W U) ≤ 1) (A : Family α) :
    (∑ U ∈ A, q ^ U.card * W U) ≤ 1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.subset_power_sum_le_bins
statement:
theorem subset_power_sum_le_bins {W : Finset α → ℝ} (hW : ∀ U, 0 ≤ W U)
    (S : Finset α) (hlarge : ∀ U ∈ largeWeightFamily W, ¬ U ⊆ S) :
    (∑ U ∈ S.powerset.erase ∅, (W U) ^ 16) ≤
      ∑ b ∈ occupiedWeightBins W,
        ∑ U ∈ (weightBin W b).filter (fun U => U ⊆ S), (W U) ^ 16

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.weightBin_bounds
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.weightBin_card
statement:
theorem weightBin_card {W : Finset α → ℝ} {U : Finset α} {b : ℕ × ℕ}
    (hU : U ∈ weightBin W b) : U.card = b.1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.weightBin_cost_bound
statement:
theorem weightBin_cost_bound {q : ℝ} {W : Finset α → ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hW : ∀ U, 0 ≤ W U)
    (hglobal : (∑ U : Finset α, q ^ U.card * W U) ≤ 1) (b : ℕ × ℕ) :
    ((weightBin W b).card : ℝ) * (q / (2 : ℝ) ^ 70) ^ b.1 ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (b.2 + 1)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.weightBin_power_sum_le
statement:
theorem weightBin_power_sum_le {W : Finset α → ℝ} (hW : ∀ U, 0 ≤ W U)
    (S : Finset α) (b : ℕ × ℕ)
    (hcount : ((weightBin W b).filter (fun U => U ⊆ S)).card ≤ 2 ^ (12 * b.2)) :
    (∑ U ∈ (weightBin W b).filter (fun U => U ⊆ S), (W U) ^ 16) ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (4 * b.2)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.prod_sub_ite_eq_sum_powerset
statement:
theorem prod_sub_ite_eq_sum_powerset (S : Finset V) (P C : V → ℝ) :
    (∏ i, (P i - if i ∈ S then C i else 0)) =
      ∑ U ∈ S.powerset, (-1 : ℝ) ^ U.card * ∏ i, if i ∈ U then C i else P i

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_map
statement:
theorem expectation_map (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → Γ) (g : Γ → ℝ) :
    (map μ f).expectation g = μ.expectation (fun ω => g (f ω))

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_pi_coordinate
statement:
theorem expectation_pi_coordinate (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (A i))
    (i : I) (f : A i → ℝ) :
    (pi μ).expectation (fun ω => f (ω i)) = (μ i).expectation f

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.expectation_pi_product
statement:
theorem expectation_pi_product (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (A i))
    (f : ∀ i, A i → ℝ) :
    (pi μ).expectation (fun ω => ∏ i, f i (ω i)) =
      ∏ i, (μ i).expectation (f i)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.map_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_weight (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → Γ) (γ : Γ) :
    (map μ f).weight γ = ∑ ω, if f ω = γ then μ.weight ω else 0

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.map_weight_eq_prob
statement:
theorem map_weight_eq_prob (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → Γ) (γ : Γ) :
    (map μ f).weight γ = μ.prob (fun ω => f ω = γ)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_map
statement:
theorem prob_map (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → Γ) (P : Γ → Prop) :
    (map μ f).prob P = μ.prob (fun ω => P (f ω))

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_pi
statement:
theorem prob_pi (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (A i)) (P : ∀ i, A i → Prop) :
    (pi μ).prob (fun ω => ∀ i, P i (ω i)) = ∏ i, (μ i).prob (P i)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_pi_coordinate
statement:
theorem prob_pi_coordinate (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (A i))
    (i : I) (P : A i → Prop) :
    (pi μ).prob (fun ω => P (ω i)) = (μ i).prob P

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_prod
statement:
theorem prob_prod (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ)
    (P : Ω → Prop) (Q : Γ → Prop) :
    (μ.prod ν).prob (fun z => P z.1 ∧ Q z.2) = μ.prob P * ν.prob Q

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.prob_pi_cubeSet_eq_mass
statement:
theorem prob_pi_cubeSet_eq_mass (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (Ω i))
    (obs : ∀ i, Ω i → Bool) (p : ℝ)
    (hobs : ∀ i, (μ i).prob (fun w => obs i w = true) = p) (s : Finset α) :
    (FiniteLaw.pi μ).prob (fun ω => cubeSet (fun i => obs i (ω i)) = s) =
      bernoulliMass p s

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.prob_pi_cubeSet_mem_family
statement:
theorem prob_pi_cubeSet_mem_family (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (Ω i))
    (obs : ∀ i, Ω i → Bool) (p : ℝ)
    (hobs : ∀ i, (μ i).prob (fun w => obs i w = true) = p) (D : Family α) :
    (FiniteLaw.pi μ).prob (fun ω => cubeSet (fun i => obs i (ω i)) ∈ D) =
      familyMeasure p D

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.mem_denseFamily
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_denseFamily {H : Family V} {m : ℕ} {S : Finset V} :
    S ∈ denseFamily H m ↔ m ≤ (H.filter (fun e => e ⊆ S)).card

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.mem_initialFamily
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.mem_regularEdges
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_regularEdges {H : Family V} {rho T : ℝ}
    {r : ℕ} {e : Finset V} :
    e ∈ regularEdges H rho r T ↔
      e ∈ H ∧ ∀ I ∈ initialFamily H rho r T, ¬ I ⊆ e

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.mem_regularFamily
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_regularFamily {H C0 : Family V} {e : Finset V} :
    e ∈ regularFamily H C0 ↔ e ∈ H ∧ ∀ I ∈ C0, ¬ I ⊆ e

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.mem_tuplePairs
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.mem_tupleUnion
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.regularEdges_subset
statement:
theorem regularEdges_subset (H : Family V) (rho : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    regularEdges H rho r T ⊆ H

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.regularFamily_subset
statement: theorem regularFamily_subset (H C0 : Family V) : regularFamily H C0 ⊆ H

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.card_subsets_card_le
statement:
theorem card_subsets_card_le {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V] (B : Finset V) (r : ℕ) :
    (B.powerset.filter (fun I => I.card ≤ r)).card =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), Nat.choose B.card i

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.card_subsets_card_le_pow
statement:
theorem card_subsets_card_le_pow {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]
    (B : Finset V) (r : ℕ) :
    (B.powerset.filter (fun I => I.card ≤ r)).card ≤ (1 + B.card) ^ r

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.sum_choose_range_le_pow
statement:
theorem sum_choose_range_le_pow (n r : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), Nat.choose n i) ≤ (1 + n) ^ r

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.T_nonneg
statement: theorem T_nonneg (h : ℕ) : 0 ≤ T h

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.T_pos
statement: theorem T_pos (h : ℕ) : 0 < T h

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.dyadic_residual_bound
statement:
theorem dyadic_residual_bound (a n : ℕ) (prob : ℝ)
    (hprob : prob ≤ 1)
    (hbudget : (a : ℝ) + 1 ≤ prob * (n : ℝ)) :
    ((2 : ℝ) ^ a) ^ n * (1 - prob) ^ (n * n) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.exponent_budget
statement:
theorem exponent_budget (r h : ℕ) (hrh : r ≤ h) (hh : 64 ≤ h) :
    (A r h : ℝ) + 1 ≤ p h * (m h : ℝ)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.exponent_budget_nat
statement:
theorem exponent_budget_nat (r h : ℕ) (hrh : r ≤ h) (hh : 64 ≤ h) :
    A r h + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (4 * h)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.extension_base_le_pow
statement:
theorem extension_base_le_pow (r h : ℕ) (hrh : r ≤ h) :
    1 + r * m h ≤ 2 ^ (13 * h)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.extension_factor_le_pow
statement:
theorem extension_factor_le_pow (r h : ℕ) (hrh : r ≤ h) :
    T h * (1 + (r : ℝ) * (m h : ℝ)) ^ r ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ A r h

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.final_cost_le
statement:
theorem final_cost_le (h : ℕ) (hh : 64 ≤ h) :
    4 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * h))⁻¹ + ((2 : ℝ) ^ m h)⁻¹ ≤
      3 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ h)⁻¹

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.h_le_m
statement: theorem h_le_m (h : ℕ) : h ≤ m h

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.initial_cost_le
statement:
theorem initial_cost_le (r h : ℕ) (hrh : r ≤ h) :
    (T h)⁻¹ * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (2 : ℝ) ^ (h + 1) ≤
      2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * h))⁻¹

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.m_pos
statement: theorem m_pos (h : ℕ) : 0 < m h

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.p_le_one
statement: theorem p_le_one (h : ℕ) : p h ≤ 1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.p_mul_m
statement: theorem p_mul_m (h : ℕ) : p h * (m h : ℝ) = T h

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.p_nonneg
statement: theorem p_nonneg (h : ℕ) : 0 ≤ p h

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.p_pos
statement: theorem p_pos (h : ℕ) : 0 < p h

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.pair_cost_le
statement:
theorem pair_cost_le (r h : ℕ) (hrh : r ≤ h) :
    p h * (2 : ℝ) ^ (h + 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * T h ≤
      2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * h))⁻¹

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.NumericalBounds.residual_cost_le_inv_pow
statement:
theorem residual_cost_le_inv_pow (r h : ℕ) (hrh : r ≤ h) (hh : 64 ≤ h) :
    (T h * (1 + (r : ℝ) * (m h : ℝ)) ^ r) ^ m h *
        (1 - p h) ^ (m h * m h) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m h)⁻¹

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.incidence_count
statement:
theorem incidence_count (H : Family V) (r : ℕ)
    (hH : ∀ e ∈ H, e.card = r) :
    (∑ I ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun I : Finset V => I.card ≤ r),
      (H.filter (fun e => I ⊆ e)).card) = H.card * 2 ^ r

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.initial_cost_le
statement:
theorem initial_cost_le {H : Family V} {rho T : ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    (hρ : 0 ≤ rho) (hT : 0 < T) (hH : ∀ e ∈ H, e.card = r) :
    cost rho (initialFamily H rho r T) ≤
      T⁻¹ * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (H.card : ℝ) * rho ^ r

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.regular_extension_le_card
statement:
theorem regular_extension_le_card {H : Family V} {rho T : ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    (hρ : 0 ≤ rho) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hH : ∀ e ∈ H, e.card = r) (B : Finset V) :
    (∑ e ∈ regularEdges H rho r T, rho ^ (e \ B).card) ≤
      T * ((B.powerset.filter (fun I => I.card ≤ r)).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.regular_extension_le_choose
statement:
theorem regular_extension_le_choose {H : Family V} {rho T : ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    (hρ : 0 ≤ rho) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hH : ∀ e ∈ H, e.card = r) (B : Finset V) :
    (∑ e ∈ regularEdges H rho r T, rho ^ (e \ B).card) ≤
      T * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (Nat.choose B.card i : ℝ))

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.regular_extension_le_pow
statement:
theorem regular_extension_le_pow {H : Family V} {rho T : ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    (hρ : 0 ≤ rho) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hH : ∀ e ∈ H, e.card = r) (B : Finset V) :
    (∑ e ∈ regularEdges H rho r T, rho ^ (e \ B).card) ≤
      T * (1 + (B.card : ℝ)) ^ r

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.regular_extension_le_two_pow
statement:
theorem regular_extension_le_two_pow {H : Family V} {rho T : ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    (hρ : 0 ≤ rho) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hH : ∀ e ∈ H, e.card = r)
    {B : Finset V} (hB : B.card = r) :
    (∑ e ∈ regularEdges H rho r T, rho ^ (e \ B).card) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ r * T

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.regular_weightedDegree_le
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.weightedDegree_nonneg
statement:
theorem weightedDegree_nonneg {H : Family V} {rho : ℝ} {r : ℕ} {I : Finset V}
    (hρ : 0 ≤ rho) : 0 ≤ weightedDegree H rho r I

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.weighted_incidence_count
statement:
theorem weighted_incidence_count (H : Family V) (rho : ℝ) (r : ℕ)
    (hH : ∀ e ∈ H, e.card = r) :
    (∑ I ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun I : Finset V => I.card ≤ r),
      weightedDegree H rho r I * rho ^ I.card) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (H.card : ℝ) * rho ^ r

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.cost_residualFamily_le
statement:
theorem cost_residualFamily_le (H : Family V) (m : ℕ) (sample : Sample H)
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) :
    cost rho (residualFamily H m sample) ≤
      ∑ f : EdgeTuple H m,
        if Disjoint sample (tuplePairs f) then rho ^ (tupleUnion f).card else 0

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.cost_sampledFamily_le
statement:
theorem cost_sampledFamily_le (H : Family V) (sample : Sample H)
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) :
    cost rho (sampledFamily H sample) ≤
      ∑ p ∈ sample, rho ^ (pairUnion p).card

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.covers_sampled_residual
statement:
theorem covers_sampled_residual [Fintype V] (H C0 : Family V) (m : ℕ)
    (sample : Sample (regularFamily H C0)) :
    Covers (C0 ∪ sampledFamily (regularFamily H C0) sample ∪
      residualFamily (regularFamily H C0) m sample) (denseFamily H m)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.exists_regular_tuple
statement:
theorem exists_regular_tuple {H C0 : Family V} {m : ℕ} {S : Finset V}
    (hm : m ≤ (H.filter (fun e => e ⊆ S)).card)
    (h0 : ¬∃ I ∈ C0, I ⊆ S) :
    ∃ f : EdgeTuple (regularFamily H C0) m, ∀ i, (f.val i).val ⊆ S

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.mem_residualFamily
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_residualFamily {H : Family V} {m : ℕ}
    {sample : Sample H} {I : Finset V} :
    I ∈ residualFamily H m sample ↔
      ∃ f : EdgeTuple H m, Disjoint sample (tuplePairs f) ∧ tupleUnion f = I

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.mem_sampledFamily
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_sampledFamily {H : Family V} {sample : Sample H} {I : Finset V} :
    I ∈ sampledFamily H sample ↔ ∃ p ∈ sample, pairUnion p = I

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.expectation_sampledFamily_le
statement:
theorem expectation_sampledFamily_le {H : Family V} {rho T p : ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hH : ∀ e ∈ H, e.card = r)
    (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    (bernoulliLaw (α := PairIndex (regularEdges H rho r T)) p hp0 hp1).expectation
        (fun sample => cost rho (sampledFamily (regularEdges H rho r T) sample)) ≤
      p * ((H.card : ℝ) * rho ^ r * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * T)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.regular_pair_weight_sum_le
statement:
theorem regular_pair_weight_sum_le {H : Family V} {rho T : ℝ} {r : ℕ}
    (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hH : ∀ e ∈ H, e.card = r) :
    (∑ p : PairIndex (regularEdges H rho r T), rho ^ (pairUnion p).card) ≤
      (H.card : ℝ) * rho ^ r * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * T

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.diagonal_mem_tuplePairs
statement:
theorem diagonal_mem_tuplePairs {H : Family X} {m : ℕ}
    (f : EdgeTuple H m) (i : Fin m) : (f.val i, f.val i) ∈ tuplePairs f

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.disjoint_tuplePairs_iff
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.orderedPairMap_injective
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.tuplePairs_card
statement:
theorem tuplePairs_card {H : Family X} {m : ℕ} (f : EdgeTuple H m) :
    (tuplePairs f).card = m * m

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.tuple_survival_probability
statement:
theorem tuple_survival_probability {H : Family X} {m : ℕ}
    (f : EdgeTuple H m) (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    (bernoulliLaw (α := ↥H × ↥H) p hp0 hp1).prob
      (fun sample => Disjoint sample (tuplePairs f)) = (1 - p) ^ (m * m)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.allTupleUnion_card_le
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.allTupleUnion_cons
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.allTupleUnion_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem allTupleUnion_zero {H : Family V} (f : Fin 0 → ↥H) :
    allTupleUnion f = ∅

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.allTupleWeightSum_le
statement:
theorem allTupleWeightSum_le (H : Family V) {rho T : ℝ} {r m : ℕ}
    (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (uniform : ∀ e ∈ H, (e : Finset V).card = r)
    (extension : ∀ B : Finset V,
      (∑ e ∈ H, rho ^ (e \ B).card) ≤ T * (1 + (B.card : ℝ)) ^ r)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ m) :
    allTupleWeightSum H rho t ≤ (T * (1 + ((r * m : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ r) ^ t

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.allTupleWeightSum_succ
statement:
theorem allTupleWeightSum_succ (H : Family V) (rho : ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    allTupleWeightSum H rho (t + 1) =
      ∑ f : Fin t → ↥H, rho ^ (allTupleUnion f).card *
        (∑ e ∈ H, rho ^ (e \ allTupleUnion f).card)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.allTupleWeightSum_succ_le
statement:
theorem allTupleWeightSum_succ_le (H : Family V) {rho T : ℝ} {r m t : ℕ}
    (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (uniform : ∀ e ∈ H, (e : Finset V).card = r)
    (extension : ∀ B : Finset V,
      (∑ e ∈ H, rho ^ (e \ B).card) ≤ T * (1 + (B.card : ℝ)) ^ r)
    (ht : t ≤ m) :
    allTupleWeightSum H rho (t + 1) ≤
      (T * (1 + ((r * m : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ r) * allTupleWeightSum H rho t

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.allTupleWeightSum_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem allTupleWeightSum_zero (H : Family V) (rho : ℝ) :
    allTupleWeightSum H rho 0 = 1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.allTupleWeight_cons
statement:
theorem allTupleWeight_cons {H : Family V} {t : ℕ} (rho : ℝ)
    (e : ↥H) (f : Fin t → ↥H) :
    rho ^ (allTupleUnion (Fin.cons e f)).card =
      rho ^ (allTupleUnion f).card * rho ^ (e.val \ allTupleUnion f).card

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.tupleUnion_card_le
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.tupleWeightSum_le
statement:
theorem tupleWeightSum_le (H : Family V) {rho T : ℝ} {r m : ℕ}
    (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (uniform : ∀ e ∈ H, (e : Finset V).card = r)
    (extension : ∀ B : Finset V,
      (∑ e ∈ H, rho ^ (e \ B).card) ≤ T * (1 + (B.card : ℝ)) ^ r) :
    tupleWeightSum H rho m ≤ (T * (1 + ((r * m : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ r) ^ m

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.tupleWeightSum_le_allTupleWeightSum
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.tupleWeightSum_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem tupleWeightSum_zero (H : Family V) (rho : ℝ) :
    tupleWeightSum H rho 0 = 1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.tupleWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem tupleWeight_nonneg {H : Family V} {t : ℕ} {rho : ℝ}
    (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (f : EdgeTuple H t) : 0 ≤ tupleWeight rho f

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.expectation_residualFamily_le
statement:
theorem expectation_residualFamily_le (H : Family V) (rho : ℝ)
    (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    (bernoulliLaw (α := PairIndex H) p hp0 hp1).expectation
        (fun sample => cost rho (residualFamily H m sample)) ≤
      tupleWeightSum H rho m * (1 - p) ^ (m * m)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.expectation_residualFamily_le_extension
statement:
theorem expectation_residualFamily_le_extension (H : Family V)
    {rho T : ℝ} {r m : ℕ} (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (uniform : ∀ e ∈ H, (e : Finset V).card = r)
    (extension : ∀ B : Finset V,
      (∑ e ∈ H, rho ^ (e \ B).card) ≤ T * (1 + (B.card : ℝ)) ^ r)
    (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    (bernoulliLaw (α := PairIndex H) p hp0 hp1).expectation
        (fun sample => cost rho (residualFamily H m sample)) ≤
      (T * (1 + ((r * m : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ r) ^ m * (1 - p) ^ (m * m)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.expectation_residualFamily_le_inv_pow
statement:
theorem expectation_residualFamily_le_inv_pow (H : Family V)
    {rho : ℝ} {r h : ℕ} (hrho : 0 ≤ rho)
    (uniform : ∀ e ∈ H, (e : Finset V).card = r)
    (extension : ∀ B : Finset V, (∑ e ∈ H, rho ^ (e \ B).card) ≤
      NumericalBounds.T h * (1 + (B.card : ℝ)) ^ r)
    (hrh : r ≤ h) (hh : 64 ≤ h) :
    (bernoulliLaw (α := PairIndex H) (NumericalBounds.p h)
      (NumericalBounds.p_nonneg h) (NumericalBounds.p_le_one h)).expectation
        (fun sample => cost rho (residualFamily H (NumericalBounds.m h) sample)) ≤
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ NumericalBounds.m h)⁻¹

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.density_failure_budget
statement:
theorem density_failure_budget {L a : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.density_rows_gt_one

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.density_rows_pos

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.density_tuple_count_real

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.exists_le_expectation

theorem exists_le_expectation (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.Covering.elementary_covering
statement:
theorem elementary_covering (H : Family V) (rho : ℝ) (r h : ℕ)
    (hrho0 : 0 < rho) (_hrho1 : rho < 1)
    (uniform : ∀ e ∈ H, e.card = r)
    (_hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrh : r ≤ h) (hh : 64 ≤ h)
    (hweight : (H.card : ℝ) * rho ^ r ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (h + 1)) :
    ∃ G : Family V, Covers G (denseFamily H (2 ^ (12 * h))) ∧
      cost rho G ≤ 3 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ h)⁻¹

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.exceptional_lower_bound_of_signed_sum
statement:
theorem exceptional_lower_bound_of_signed_sum {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]
    (S : Finset V) (b : Finset V → ℝ)
    (hsum : ∑ U ∈ S.powerset, (-1 : ℝ) ^ U.card * b U ^ 32 = 0)
    (hb0 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ b ∅) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 32 ≤ ∑ U ∈ S.powerset.erase ∅, (b U ^ 2) ^ 16

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.weighted_kernel_bilinear
statement:
theorem weighted_kernel_bilinear
    (K : I → J → ℝ) (r : I → ℝ) (μ : J → ℝ)
    (hkernel : ∀ x y, (∑ u, r u * K u x * K u y) =
      if x = y then μ x else 0) (f g : J → ℝ) :
    (∑ u, r u * (∑ x, f x * K u x) * (∑ y, g y * K u y)) =
      ∑ x, μ x * f x * g x

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.weighted_kernel_parseval
statement:
theorem weighted_kernel_parseval
    (K : I → J → ℝ) (r : I → ℝ) (μ : J → ℝ)
    (hkernel : ∀ x y, (∑ u, r u * K u x * K u y) =
      if x = y then μ x else 0) (f : J → ℝ) :
    (∑ u, r u * (∑ x, f x * K u x) ^ 2) =
      ∑ x, μ x * (f x) ^ 2

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.weighted_transform_bilinear_expansion
statement:
theorem weighted_transform_bilinear_expansion
    (K : I → J → ℝ) (r : I → ℝ) (f g : J → ℝ) :
    (∑ u, r u * (∑ x, f x * K u x) * (∑ y, g y * K u y)) =
      ∑ x, ∑ y, f x * g y * (∑ u, r u * K u x * K u y)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.b_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem b_empty (q : ℝ) (f : (V → Bool) → ℝ) :
    b q f ∅ = cubeExpectation q f

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.b_eq_alternating_sum
statement:
theorem b_eq_alternating_sum (q : ℝ) (f : (V → Bool) → ℝ) (U : Finset V) :
    b q f U = (1 - q) ^ U.card *
      ∑ x, f x * (∏ i ∈ U, if x i then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) *
        ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ \ U, bitWeight q (x i)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.correction_false
statement: @[simp] theorem correction_false (q : ℝ) : correction q false = 1 - q

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.correction_true
statement: @[simp] theorem correction_true (q : ℝ) : correction q true = -(1 - q)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.rowKernel_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowKernel_empty (q : ℝ) (x : V → Bool) :
    rowKernel q ∅ x = cubeWeight q x

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.rowKernel_eq_alternating_product
statement:
theorem rowKernel_eq_alternating_product (q : ℝ) (U : Finset V) (x : V → Bool) :
    rowKernel q U x = (1 - q) ^ U.card *
      (∏ i ∈ U, if x i then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) *
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ \ U, bitWeight q (x i)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.w_nonneg
statement:
theorem w_nonneg (q : ℝ) (f : (V → Bool) → ℝ) (U : Finset V) :
    0 ≤ w q f U

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.bitWeight_correction_gram
statement:
theorem bitWeight_correction_gram (q : ℝ) (hq1 : q < 1) (x y : Bool) :
    bitWeight q x * bitWeight q y +
        (q / (1 - q)) * correction q x * correction q y =
      if x = y then bitWeight q x else 0

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.rowKernel_gram
statement:
theorem rowKernel_gram (q : ℝ) (_hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (x y : V → Bool) :
    (∑ U : Finset V,
      (q / (1 - q)) ^ U.card * rowKernel q U x * rowKernel q U y) =
      if x = y then cubeWeight q x else 0

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.rowKernel_weighted_product
statement:
theorem rowKernel_weighted_product (q : ℝ) (U : Finset V) (x y : V → Bool) :
    (q / (1 - q)) ^ U.card * rowKernel q U x * rowKernel q U y =
      ∏ i, if i ∈ U then
        (q / (1 - q)) * correction q (x i) * correction q (y i)
      else bitWeight q (x i) * bitWeight q (y i)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.biased_parseval
statement:
theorem biased_parseval (q : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (f : (V → Bool) → ℝ) :
    (∑ U : Finset V, (q / (1 - q)) ^ U.card * w q f U) =
      cubeExpectation q (fun x => (f x) ^ 2)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.global_weight_bound
statement:
theorem global_weight_bound (q : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (f : (V → Bool) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, (f x) ^ 2 ≤ 1) :
    (∑ U : Finset V, q ^ U.card * w q f U) ≤ 1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.indicator_global_weight_bound
statement:
theorem indicator_global_weight_bound (q : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (D : Family V) :
    (∑ U : Finset V, q ^ U.card * w q (familyIndicator D) U) ≤ 1

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.weight_sum_le_second_moment
statement:
theorem weight_sum_le_second_moment (q : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (f : (V → Bool) → ℝ) :
    (∑ U : Finset V, q ^ U.card * w q f U) ≤
      cubeExpectation q (fun x => (f x) ^ 2)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.exists_forall_of_const
statement:
theorem exists_forall_of_const (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : ι → Ω → Prop)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_exists_le
statement:
theorem prob_exists_le (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : ι → Ω → Prop) :
    μ.prob (fun ω => ∃ i, P i ω) ≤ ∑ i, μ.prob (P i)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_forall_ge
statement:
theorem prob_forall_ge (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : ι → Ω → Prop) :
    1 - ∑ i, (1 - μ.prob (P i)) ≤ μ.prob (fun ω => ∀ i, P i ω)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.FiniteLaw.prob_forall_ge_of_const
statement:
theorem prob_forall_ge_of_const (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : ι → Ω → Prop)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.labelLaw_prob_nonzero

@[simp] theorem labelLaw_prob_nonzero (L : ℕ) (p : ℝ)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.labelLaw_prob_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem labelLaw_prob_succ (L : ℕ) (p : ℝ)
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hLp : (L : ℝ) * p ≤ 1) (j : Fin L) :
    (labelLaw L p hp hLp).prob (fun k => k = j.succ) = p

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.labelLaw_prob_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem labelLaw_prob_zero (L : ℕ) (p : ℝ)
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hLp : (L : ℝ) * p ≤ 1) :
    (labelLaw L p hp hLp).prob (fun j => j = 0) = 1 - (L : ℝ) * p

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.labelLaw_weight_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem labelLaw_weight_succ (L : ℕ) (p : ℝ)
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hLp : (L : ℝ) * p ≤ 1) (j : Fin L) :
    (labelLaw L p hp hLp).weight j.succ = p

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.labelLaw_weight_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem labelLaw_weight_zero (L : ℕ) (p : ℝ)
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hLp : (L : ℝ) * p ≤ 1) :
    (labelLaw L p hp hLp).weight 0 = 1 - (L : ℝ) * p

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.labelRow_prob_eq_mass
statement:
theorem labelRow_prob_eq_mass (L : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hLp : (L : ℝ) * p ≤ 1) (j : Fin L) (s : Finset α) :
    (labelSamples L p hp hLp).prob (fun ω => labelRow ω j = s) =

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.labelRow_prob_mem_family
statement:
theorem labelRow_prob_mem_family (L : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hLp : (L : ℝ) * p ≤ 1) (j : Fin L) (D : Family α) :
    (labelSamples L p hp hLp).prob (fun ω => labelRow ω j ∈ D) =

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.labelUnion_eq_cubeSet_nonzero
statement:
theorem labelUnion_eq_cubeSet_nonzero {L : ℕ} (ω : α → Fin (L + 1)) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.labelUnion_prob_eq_mass
statement:
theorem labelUnion_prob_eq_mass (L : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hLp : (L : ℝ) * p ≤ 1) (s : Finset α) :
    (labelSamples L p hp hLp).prob (fun ω => unionTuple (labelRow ω) = s) =

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.labelUnion_prob_mem_family
statement:
theorem labelUnion_prob_mem_family (L : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hLp : (L : ℝ) * p ≤ 1) (D : Family α) :
    (labelSamples L p hp hLp).prob (fun ω => unionTuple (labelRow ω) ∈ D) =
      familyMeasure ((L : ℝ) * p) D

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.mem_labelRow
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_labelRow {L : ℕ} {ω : α → Fin (L + 1)}
    {j : Fin L} {i : α} : i ∈ labelRow ω j ↔ ω i = j.succ

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.exists_mandatory_cover
statement:
theorem exists_mandatory_cover {L : ℕ} (hL : 1 < L) (p : ℝ)
    (hp : p < 1) (hLp : 1 ≤ (L : ℝ) * p) (D : Family α)
    (hbudget : (L : ℝ) * (1 - familyMeasure p D) < 1) :
    ∃ rows : Fin L → Finset α,
      (∀ j, rows j ∈ D) ∧ unionTuple rows = Finset.univ

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.mandatoryBit_mandatory
statement:
@[simp] theorem mandatoryBit_mandatory {L : ℕ} (z : MandatoryColumn L) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.mandatoryColumnLaw_marginal

theorem mandatoryColumnLaw_marginal {L : ℕ} (hL : 1 < L) (p : ℝ)

theorem mandatoryParameter_boundary {L : ℕ} {p : ℝ}

theorem mandatoryParameter_marginal {L : ℕ} (hL : 1 < L) (p : ℝ) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.mandatoryParameter_nonneg
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.mandatoryRows_prob_eq_mass
statement:
theorem mandatoryRows_prob_eq_mass {L : ℕ} (hL : 1 < L) (p : ℝ)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.mandatoryRows_prob_mem_family
statement:
theorem mandatoryRows_prob_mem_family {L : ℕ} (hL : 1 < L) (p : ℝ)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.mandatoryRows_union
statement:
theorem mandatoryRows_union {L : ℕ} (ω : α → MandatoryColumn L) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.columnKernel_eq_rowKernel
statement:
theorem columnKernel_eq_rowKernel (q : ℝ) {k : ℕ} (U : Finset V)
    (X : Fin k → V → Bool) :
    (∏ i, if i ∈ U then ∏ j, correction q (X j i)
      else ∏ j, bitWeight q (X j i)) =
      ∏ j, rowKernel q U (X j)

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.signedArrayMass_eq_zero_of_zero_column
OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.signed_array_identity
statement:
theorem signed_array_identity (q : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (f : (V → Bool) → ℝ) (S : Finset V) :
    (∑ X : Fin k → V → Bool, (∏ j, f (X j)) * signedArrayMass q S X) =
      ∑ U ∈ S.powerset, (-1 : ℝ) ^ U.card * b q f U ^ k

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.exists_unionTuple_mul_eq_univ
statement:
theorem exists_unionTuple_mul_eq_univ {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) {D : Family α}

    (hfull : unionTuple f = Finset.univ) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.exists_unionTuple_thirtytwo_mul_eq_univ

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.unionTuple_flatten
statement:
theorem unionTuple_flatten {a b : ℕ} (f : Fin a → Fin b → Finset α) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.unionTuple_repeat

theorem unionTuple_repeat {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (f : Fin b → Finset α) :

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.unionTuple_rows
statement:
theorem unionTuple_rows {a b : ℕ} (f : Fin (a * b) → Finset α) :
    unionTuple (fun i : Fin a => unionTuple (fun j : Fin b => f (finProdFinEquiv (i, j)))) =

name: OAI.TalagrandDiscreteConvexity.weights_small
statement:
theorem weights_small {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (A : Family α) (W : Finset α → ℝ) (hW : ∀ U, 0 ≤ W U)
    (hglobal : (∑ U : Finset α, q ^ U.card * W U) ≤ 1)
    (hlower : ∀ S ∈ A,
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 32 ≤ ∑ U ∈ S.powerset.erase ∅, (W U) ^ 16) :

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.congruent_linearIsometry

theorem congruent_linearIsometry {s d D : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)

    (hspan : affineSpan ℝ (Set.range a) = ⊤) (h : Congruent a b) :

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.linearIsometry_of_equal_gram
statement:
theorem linearIsometry_of_equal_gram {ι : Type uIndex} {E : Type uDomain} {F : Type uCodomain} [Fintype ι]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F]
    (x : ι → E) (y : ι → F)
    (hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range x) = ⊤)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, ⟪y i, y j⟫ = ⟪x i, x j⟫) :
    ∃ Q : E →ₗᵢ[ℝ] F, ∀ i, Q (x i) = y i

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.ramsey_congruent_iff
statement:
theorem ramsey_congruent_iff {s d D : ℕ} {a : Fin s → Space d}

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.singleton_ramsey
statement: theorem singleton_ramsey {d : ℕ} (a : Fin 1 → Space d) : Ramsey a

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.arrayEvaluation_diagonal
statement:
lemma arrayEvaluation_diagonal {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d) (i : Fin s)
    (v : ℝ) (u : Space d) :
    arrayEvaluation a i (diagonalArray v u) =
      affineEvaluation a i v u ⊗ₜ[ℚ] affineEvaluation a i v u

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.exists_separated_functions
statement:
theorem exists_separated_functions {s d : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)
    (h : ¬ RealCriterion a) :
    ∃ f : Fin s → ℝ → ℝ, ∃ L : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℝ,
      L 1 = 1 ∧
      (∀ v u, (∑ i, f i (affineEvaluation a i v u)) + L (gradientRankOne u) = 0) ∧
      ∀ x, ∑ i, f i x = 0

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.floor_coloring_obstruction
statement:
theorem floor_coloring_obstruction {X : Type uPoint} {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (H : Fin s → X → ℝ) (hcancel : ∀ z, ∑ i, H i z = 0)
    (b : Fin s → X)
    (hmono : ∀ i, (fun j : Fin s =>
      (⌊((2 * s + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 * H j (b i)⌋ : ZMod (2 * s + 1))) =
      (fun j : Fin s =>
      (⌊((2 * s + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 * H j (b ⟨0, hs⟩)⌋ : ZMod (2 * s + 1)))) :
    ∑ i, H i (b i) ≠ -1

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.isometryRows_apply
statement:
lemma isometryRows_apply {d D : ℕ} (Q : Space d →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Space D)
    (x : Space d) (j : Fin D) :
    Q x j = ∑ α, x α * isometryRows Q j α

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.isometryRows_gram
statement:
lemma isometryRows_gram {d D : ℕ} (Q : Space d →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Space D)
    (α β : Fin d) :
    ∑ j, isometryRows Q j α * isometryRows Q j β = if α = β then 1 else 0

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.ramsey_realCriterion
statement:

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.separated_copy_sum
statement:
theorem separated_copy_sum {s d D : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)
    (f : Fin s → ℝ → ℝ) (L : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℝ)
    (hL : L 1 = 1)

    (Q : Space d →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Space D) (t : Space D) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, f i ((t + Q (a i)) j) = -1

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.exists_radial_smoothing
statement:
theorem exists_radial_smoothing (hn : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ b : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b ∧ HasCompactSupport b ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ b x) ∧ 0 < ∫ x, b x ∂μ ∧
      (∫ x, max (-halfLaplacian b x) 0 * ‖x‖^2 ∂μ) < η * ∫ x, b x ∂μ

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.radialBump_halfLaplacian
statement:
lemma radialBump_halfLaplacian {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (p : ℝ) (x : E) :
    halfLaplacian (radialBump a p) x =
      smoothPositivePart' (radialPower a p x-1) * halfLaplacian (radialPower a p) x +
      2 * smoothPositivePart'' (radialPower a p x-1) * p^2 *
        ((a+‖x‖^2)^(p-1))^2 * ‖x‖^2

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.radialBump_integral_lower
statement:
lemma radialBump_integral_lower {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha' : a ≤ 1/4)
    (hn : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E) :
    (∫ x, radialBump (1/4) (smoothingExponent E) x ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ x, radialBump a (smoothingExponent E) x ∂μ

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.radialBump_integral_negative_bound
statement:
lemma radialBump_integral_negative_bound {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hn : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E) :
    (∫ x, max (-halfLaplacian (radialBump (ε^2) (smoothingExponent E)) x) 0 * ‖x‖^2 ∂μ) ≤
      μ.real (Metric.ball (0:E) 1) * (-smoothingExponent E) *
        (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) * (Module.finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ)^(Module.finrank ℝ E+2) *
        Real.sqrt ε

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.radialBump_integral_pos
statement:
lemma radialBump_integral_pos (hn : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E) :

lemma radialBump_negative_le {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (p : ℝ) (x : E) :

statement: lemma radialBump_nonneg (a p : ℝ) (x : E) : 0 ≤ radialBump a p x

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.radialBump_weighted_negative_bound
statement:
lemma radialBump_weighted_negative_bound {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hn : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E) (x : E) :
    max (-halfLaplacian (radialBump (ε^2) (smoothingExponent E)) x) 0 * ‖x‖^2 ≤
      (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) ((Module.finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ)*ε)).indicator
        (fun _ => (-smoothingExponent E)*(Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)*
          (Module.finrank ℝ E + 1 : ℝ)^2*(ε^2)^(smoothingExponent E)) x

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.radialPower_halfLaplacian
statement:
lemma radialPower_halfLaplacian {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (p : ℝ) (x : E) :
    halfLaplacian (radialPower a p) x =
      p * (a+‖x‖^2)^(p-2) *
        ((Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)*a + (Module.finrank ℝ E + 2*p-2)*‖x‖^2)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.radialPower_hasFDerivAt
statement:
lemma radialPower_hasFDerivAt {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (p : ℝ) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (radialPower a p)
      ((2*p*(a+‖x‖^2)^(p-1)) • innerSL ℝ x) x

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.radialPower_hessian
statement:
lemma radialPower_hessian {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (p : ℝ) (x v w : E) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (radialPower a p) x ![v,w] =
      4*p*(p-1)*(a+‖x‖^2)^(p-2) * inner ℝ x v * inner ℝ x w +
      2*p*(a+‖x‖^2)^(p-1) * inner ℝ v w

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.radialPower_laplacian_lower
statement:
lemma radialPower_laplacian_lower {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hn : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E) (x : E) :
    smoothingExponent E * (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ) * a^(smoothingExponent E-1) ≤

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.scalarComposition_hessian
statement:
lemma scalarComposition_hessian {f : E → ℝ} {g g' g'' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f) (hg : ∀ t, HasDerivAt g (g' t) t)
    (hg' : ∀ t, HasDerivAt g' (g'' t) t) (x v w : E) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (g ∘ f) x ![v,w] =
      g'' (f x) * (fderiv ℝ f x v) * (fderiv ℝ f x w) +
      g' (f x) * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x ![v,w]

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.hessianB_mul
statement:
lemma hessianB_mul {f g : E → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f)
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g) (x v w : E) :
    hessianB (fun y => f y*g y) x v w =
      f x*hessianB g x v w + g x*hessianB f x v w +
      fderiv ℝ f x v*fderiv ℝ g x w + fderiv ℝ g x v*fderiv ℝ f x w

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.hessianB_prod_horizontal
statement:
lemma hessianB_prod_horizontal {f : E → ℝ} {g : F → ℝ}

    (x : E × F) (v w : E) :
    hessianB (fun x : E × F => f x.1*g x.2) x (v,0) (w,0) =
      g x.2*hessianB f x.1 v w

    (x : E × F) (v w : F) :

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.exists_split_smoothing
statement:
theorem exists_split_smoothing {k d : ℕ} {H : Type uAction} {V : Type uVertical}
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
    [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [MeasurableSpace V] [BorelSpace V]
    (hn : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ H)
    (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (R : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hsplit : C = R*R.transpose+Z*C*Z.transpose)
    (e : (Fin k → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] H×V) (eh : OrthonormalBasis (Fin d) ℝ H)
    (z : Fin k → V)
    (hR : ∀ j, e (fun l => R l j) = (eh j,0))
    (hZ : ∀ j, e (fun l => Z l j) = (0,z j))
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ b : (Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b ∧ HasCompactSupport b ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ b x) ∧ 0 < ∫ x, b x ∧
      (∫ x, max (-secondOperator C (fun j => Pi.single j 1) b x) 0 * ‖(e x).1‖^2) <
        η * ∫ x, b x

lemma haar_linear_change {E : Type uDomain} {F : Type uCodomain}

    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F]
    (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (ν : Measure F) [ν.IsAddHaarMeasure] :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ f : F → ℝ, Continuous f →
      (∫ x, f (e x) ∂μ) = c * ∫ y, f y ∂ν

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.product_negative_integral_bound
statement:
lemma product_negative_integral_bound {E : Type uDomain} {F : Type uCodomain}
    [MeasurableSpace E] [MeasurableSpace F]
    (μ : Measure E) (ν : Measure F) [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]
    (f a w : E → ℝ) (g b : F → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hg : ∀ y, 0 ≤ g y) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x)
    (haI : Integrable (fun x => max (-a x) 0*w x) μ)
    (hfI : Integrable (fun x => f x*w x) μ)
    (hgI : Integrable g ν) (hbI : Integrable (fun y => |b y|) ν) :
    (∫ z : E×F, max (-(g z.2*a z.1+t^2*f z.1*b z.2)) 0*w z.1 ∂μ.prod ν) ≤
      (∫ x, max (-a x) 0*w x ∂μ)*(∫ y, g y ∂ν) +
      t^2*(∫ x, f x*w x ∂μ)*(∫ y, |b y| ∂ν)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.split_differential
statement:
lemma split_differential
    (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (R : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hsplit : C = R*R.transpose+Z*C*Z.transpose)
    (e : (Fin k → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] H×V) (eh : OrthonormalBasis (Fin d) ℝ H)
    (z : Fin k → V)
    (hR : ∀ j, e (fun l => R l j) = (eh j,0))
    (hZ : ∀ j, e (fun l => Z l j) = (0,z j))
    (f : H → ℝ) (g : V → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f)
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0) (x : Fin k → ℝ) :
    let et := e.trans (scaleVertical H V t ht)
    let b := (fun y : H×V => f y.1*g y.2) ∘ et
    secondOperator C (fun j => Pi.single j 1) b x =
      g (et x).2 * halfLaplacian f (et x).1 +
      t^2*f (et x).1*secondOperator C z g (et x).2

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.covariance_splitting
statement:
lemma covariance_splitting {k d : ℕ} (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin k) ℝ) (hC : C.IsSymm)
    (hU : U * C * U.transpose = 1) :
    let R := C * U.transpose
    let Z := 1 - R * U
    U * R = 1 ∧ U * Z = 0 ∧ C = R * R.transpose + Z * C * Z.transpose

statement:
@[simp] lemma firstMoment_single (γ : Lattice k) (q : ℚ) (a : Fin k) :
    firstMoment (AddMonoidAlgebra.single γ q) a = q * γ a

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.firstMoment_smul
statement:
@[simp] lemma firstMoment_smul (r : ℚ) (x : LatticeRing k) (a : Fin k) :
    firstMoment (r • x) a = r * firstMoment x a

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.firstMoment_sub
statement:
@[simp] lemma firstMoment_sub (x y : LatticeRing k) (a : Fin k) :
    firstMoment (x-y) a = firstMoment x a - firstMoment y a

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.firstMoment_sum
statement:
@[simp] lemma firstMoment_sum {ι : Type uIndex} (t : Finset ι) (x : ι → LatticeRing k) (a : Fin k) :
    firstMoment (∑ i ∈ t, x i) a = ∑ i ∈ t, firstMoment (x i) a

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.firstMoment_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma firstMoment_zero (a : Fin k) : firstMoment (0 : LatticeRing k) a = 0

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.mass_add
statement: @[simp] lemma mass_add (x y : LatticeRing k) : mass (x+y) = mass x + mass y

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.mass_linear
statement: lemma mass_linear : (mass : LatticeRing k → ℚ) = coefficientFunctional (fun _ => 1)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.mass_mul
statement: @[simp] lemma mass_mul (x y : LatticeRing k) : mass (x*y) = mass x * mass y

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.mass_one
statement: @[simp] lemma mass_one : mass (1 : LatticeRing k) = 1

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.mass_single
statement: @[simp] lemma mass_single (γ : Lattice k) (q : ℚ) : mass (AddMonoidAlgebra.single γ q) = q

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.mass_smul
statement: @[simp] lemma mass_smul (r : ℚ) (x : LatticeRing k) : mass (r • x) = r * mass x

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.mass_sub
statement: @[simp] lemma mass_sub (x y : LatticeRing k) : mass (x-y) = mass x - mass y

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.mass_sum
statement:
@[simp] lemma mass_sum {ι : Type uIndex} (t : Finset ι) (x : ι → LatticeRing k) :
    mass (∑ i ∈ t, x i) = ∑ i ∈ t, mass (x i)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.mass_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma mass_zero : mass (0 : LatticeRing k) = 0

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.mem_augmentationIdeal
statement:
lemma mem_augmentationIdeal (x : LatticeRing k) :
    x ∈ augmentationIdeal ↔ mass x = 0

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.moments_eq_of_sub_mem_cube
statement:
lemma moments_eq_of_sub_mem_cube {x y : LatticeRing k}
    (h : x-y ∈ (augmentationIdeal : Ideal (LatticeRing k)) ^ 3) :
    mass x = mass y ∧ (∀ a, firstMoment x a = firstMoment y a) ∧
      ∀ a b, secondMoment x a b = secondMoment y a b

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.monomial_sub_one_mem
statement:
lemma monomial_sub_one_mem (γ : Lattice k) :
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single γ 1 - 1 ∈ (augmentationIdeal : Ideal (LatticeRing k))

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.quadraticStencil_moments
statement:
lemma quadraticStencil_moments (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℚ) (hC : C.IsSymm)
    (l : Fin k → LatticeRing k) (hm : ∀ a, mass (l a) = 0)
    (hf : ∀ a b, firstMoment (l a) b = if a = b then 1 else 0) :
    mass (quadraticStencil C l) = 0 ∧ (∀ a, firstMoment (quadraticStencil C l) a = 0) ∧
      (∀ a b, secondMoment (quadraticStencil C l) a b = C a b)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.secondMoment_add
statement:
@[simp] lemma secondMoment_add (x y : LatticeRing k) (a b : Fin k) :
    secondMoment (x+y) a b = secondMoment x a b + secondMoment y a b

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.secondMoment_linear
statement:
lemma secondMoment_linear (a b : Fin k) :
    (fun x : LatticeRing k => secondMoment x a b) =
      coefficientFunctional (fun γ => (γ a : ℚ) * γ b)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.secondMoment_mul
statement:
lemma secondMoment_mul (x y : LatticeRing k) (a b : Fin k) :
    secondMoment (x*y) a b = mass x * secondMoment y a b + secondMoment x a b * mass y +
      firstMoment x a * firstMoment y b + firstMoment x b * firstMoment y a

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.secondMoment_one
statement: @[simp] lemma secondMoment_one (a b : Fin k) : secondMoment (1 : LatticeRing k) a b = 0

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.secondMoment_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma secondMoment_single (γ : Lattice k) (q : ℚ) (a b : Fin k) :
    secondMoment (AddMonoidAlgebra.single γ q) a b = q * γ a * γ b

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.secondMoment_smul
statement:
@[simp] lemma secondMoment_smul (r : ℚ) (x : LatticeRing k) (a b : Fin k) :
    secondMoment (r • x) a b = r * secondMoment x a b

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.secondMoment_sub
statement:
@[simp] lemma secondMoment_sub (x y : LatticeRing k) (a b : Fin k) :
    secondMoment (x-y) a b = secondMoment x a b - secondMoment y a b

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.secondMoment_sum
statement:
@[simp] lemma secondMoment_sum {ι : Type uIndex} (t : Finset ι) (x : ι → LatticeRing k) (a b : Fin k) :
    secondMoment (∑ i ∈ t, x i) a b = ∑ i ∈ t, secondMoment (x i) a b

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.secondMoment_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma secondMoment_zero (a b : Fin k) : secondMoment (0 : LatticeRing k) a b = 0

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.bilinear_moment_contract
statement:
lemma bilinear_moment_contract {ι : Type uIndex} {k : ℕ}
    (S : Finset ι) (q : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → (Fin k → ℝ))
    (L : (Fin k → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin k → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ∑ γ ∈ S,q γ*L (v γ) (v γ) =
      ∑ j,∑ l,(∑ γ ∈ S,q γ*v γ j*v γ l)*L (Pi.single j 1) (Pi.single l 1)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.compact_taylor_bound
statement:
lemma compact_taylor_bound {E : Type uDomain} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {f : E → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f) (hfc : HasCompactSupport f) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ x h : E,
      |f (x+h)-f x-fderiv ℝ f x h-
        (1/2:ℝ)*iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x ![h,h]| ≤ K*‖h‖^3

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.grid_surjective
statement:
lemma grid_surjective {k n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) {x : Fin k → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ (n:ℝ)⁻¹ • (realLattice k : Set (Fin k → ℝ))) : ∃ γ, latticeSample n γ = x

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.latticeSample_finite_support
statement:
lemma latticeSample_finite_support {k n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    {f : (Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ} (hf : HasCompactSupport f) :

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.latticeSample_injective
statement:
lemma latticeSample_injective {k n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.latticeSample_mem_grid
statement:
lemma latticeSample_mem_grid {k n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (γ : Fin k → ℤ) :
    latticeSample n γ ∈ (n:ℝ)⁻¹ • (realLattice k : Set (Fin k → ℝ))

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.lattice_riemann
statement:
theorem lattice_riemann {k : ℕ} {f : (Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hf : Continuous f) (hfc : HasCompactSupport f) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (∑' γ : Fin k → ℤ, f (latticeSample n γ))/(n:ℝ)^k)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x))

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.lattice_tsum_eq_grid
statement:
lemma lattice_tsum_eq_grid {k n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (s : Set (Fin k → ℝ))
    (f : (Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : Function.support f ⊆ s) :
    (∑' γ : Fin k → ℤ, f (latticeSample n γ)) =
      ∑' x : ↑(s ∩ (n:ℝ)⁻¹ • realLattice k), f x

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.linear_moment_contract
statement:
lemma linear_moment_contract {ι : Type uIndex} {k : ℕ}
    (S : Finset ι) (q : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → (Fin k → ℝ))
    (L : (Fin k → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ∑ γ ∈ S,q γ*L (v γ) = ∑ j,(∑ γ ∈ S,q γ*v γ j)*L (Pi.single j 1)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.bounded_grid_finite
OAI.EuclideanRamsey.convolution_support
statement:
lemma convolution_support {G : Type uGroup} [AddCommGroup G] (S : Finset G) (q : G → ℝ)
    {d : G → ℝ} (hd : Function.HasFiniteSupport d) :
    Function.HasFiniteSupport (fun δ => ∑ γ ∈ S,q γ*d (δ-γ))

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.lattice_riemann_perturb
statement:
theorem lattice_riemann_perturb {k : ℕ} (f : (Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (g : ℕ → (Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (hfc : HasCompactSupport f)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hfs : Function.support f ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 R)
    (hgs : ∀ n, Function.support (g n) ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 R)
    (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hbound : ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → ∀ x, |g n x-f x| ≤ ε n) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (∑' γ : Fin k → ℤ, g n (latticeSample n γ))/(n:ℝ)^k)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x))

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.lattice_sum_perturb_bound
statement:
lemma lattice_sum_perturb_bound {k n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) {s : Set (Fin k → ℝ)}
    (hs : Bornology.IsBounded s) (f g : (Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : Function.support f ⊆ s) (hg : Function.support g ⊆ s)
    (ε : ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, |f x-g x| ≤ ε) :
    |((∑' γ : Fin k → ℤ, f (latticeSample n γ))/(n:ℝ)^k)-
      ((∑' γ : Fin k → ℤ, g (latticeSample n γ))/(n:ℝ)^k)| ≤
      ε * ((Nat.card ↑(s ∩ (n:ℝ)⁻¹ • (realLattice k : Set (Fin k → ℝ))) : ℝ)/(n:ℝ)^k)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.rational_convolution_coeff
statement:
lemma rational_convolution_coeff {G : Type uGroup} [AddCommGroup G] [DecidableEq G]
    (ν d : AddMonoidAlgebra ℚ G) (δ : G) :
    (ν*d).coeff δ = ∑ γ ∈ ν.coeff.support,ν.coeff γ*d.coeff (δ-γ)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.rational_vector_strict
statement:
lemma rational_vector_strict {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι]
    (ζ N : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (hζ : Continuous ζ) (hN : Continuous N)
    (η : ℝ) (d : ι → ℝ) (hp : 0 < ζ d) (hn : N d < η*ζ d) :
    ∃ q : ι → ℚ, 0 < ζ (fun i => q i) ∧ N (fun i => q i) < η*ζ (fun i => q i)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.rationalize_convolution
statement:
lemma rationalize_convolution {G : Type uGroup} [AddCommGroup G] [DecidableEq G]
    (ν : AddMonoidAlgebra ℚ G) (w : G → ℝ) (t η : ℝ)
    {a : G → ℝ} (ha : Function.HasFiniteSupport a)
    (hp : 0 < (∑' γ,a γ)/t)
    (hn : (∑' δ,max (-(∑ γ ∈ ν.coeff.support,(ν.coeff γ:ℝ)*a (δ-γ))) 0*w δ) <
      η*((∑' γ,a γ)/t)) :
    ∃ b : AddMonoidAlgebra ℚ G,
      0 < ((b.coeff.sum fun _ q => q : ℚ):ℝ)/t ∧
      (∑' δ,max (-((ν*b).coeff δ:ℝ)) 0*w δ) <
        η*(((b.coeff.sum fun _ q => q : ℚ):ℝ)/t)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.cosetPushforward_mul
statement:
lemma cosetPushforward_mul {k : ℕ} (Λ : AddSubgroup (Lattice k)) (ν b : LatticeRing k)
    (hν : cosetPushforward Λ ν = 0) : cosetPushforward Λ (ν*b) = 0

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.exists_discrete_smoothing
statement:
theorem exists_discrete_smoothing {k d : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin k → ℤ))
    (q : (Fin k → ℤ) → ℝ) (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hzero : ∑ γ ∈ S,q γ = 0) (hfirst : ∀ j,∑ γ ∈ S,q γ*(γ j:ℝ) = 0)
    (hsecond : ∀ j l,∑ γ ∈ S,q γ*(γ j:ℝ)*(γ l:ℝ) = C j l)
    {b : (Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b)
    (hbc : HasCompactSupport b) (hI : 0 < ∫ x,b x)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : (∫ x,max (-stencilDifferential C b x) 0*gradientWeight U x) < η*∫ x,b x) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : (Fin k → ℤ) → ℝ), 1 ≤ n ∧ Function.HasFiniteSupport a ∧
      0 < (∑' γ,a γ)/(n:ℝ)^2 ∧
      (∑' δ,max (-(∑ γ ∈ S,q γ*a (δ-γ))) 0*gradientWeight U (latticeSample n δ)) <
        η*((∑' γ,a γ)/(n:ℝ)^2)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.rational_smoothing
statement:
theorem rational_smoothing {k d s : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (Λ : Fin s → AddSubgroup (Lattice k)) (ν : LatticeRing k)
    (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℚ) (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hC : C.IsSymm) (hU : U*(C.map (Rat.cast : ℚ → ℝ))*U.transpose = (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))
    (hcos : ∀ i,cosetPushforward (Λ i) ν = 0)
    (hzero : mass ν = 0) (hfirst : ∀ j,firstMoment ν j = 0)
    (hsecond : ∀ j l,secondMoment ν j l = C j l)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (μ : LatticeRing k) (ζ : ℚ), 1 ≤ n ∧ 0 < ζ ∧
      (∀ i,cosetPushforward (Λ i) μ = 0) ∧ mass μ = 0 ∧
      (∀ j,firstMoment μ j = 0) ∧
      (∀ j l,secondMoment μ j l/(n:ℚ)^2 = ζ*C j l) ∧
      (∑' δ : Lattice k,max (-(μ.coeff δ:ℝ)) 0*gradientWeight U (latticeSample n δ)) < η*ζ

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.stencilDifferential_continuous
statement:
lemma stencilDifferential_continuous {k : ℕ} (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    {b : (Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b) :

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.stencilDifferential_support
statement:
lemma stencilDifferential_support {k : ℕ} (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (b : (Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ) : Function.support (stencilDifferential C b) ⊆ tsupport b

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.stencil_taylor_uniform
statement:
lemma stencil_taylor_uniform {ι : Type uIndex} {k : ℕ} (S : Finset ι)
    (q : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → (Fin k → ℝ)) (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hzero : ∑ γ ∈ S,q γ = 0) (hfirst : ∀ j,∑ γ ∈ S,q γ*v γ j = 0)
    (hsecond : ∀ j l,∑ γ ∈ S,q γ*v γ j*v γ l = C j l)
    {b : (Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b)
    (hbc : HasCompactSupport b) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → ∀ x,
      |t^2*(∑ γ ∈ S,q γ*b (x+(-t⁻¹) • v γ))-stencilDifferential C b x| ≤ K/t

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.stencil_weighted_riemann
statement:
lemma stencil_weighted_riemann {ι : Type uIndex} {k d : ℕ} (S : Finset ι)
    (q : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → (Fin k → ℝ)) (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hzero : ∑ γ ∈ S,q γ = 0) (hfirst : ∀ j,∑ γ ∈ S,q γ*v γ j = 0)
    (hsecond : ∀ j l,∑ γ ∈ S,q γ*v γ j*v γ l = C j l)
    {b : (Fin k → ℝ) → ℝ} (hb : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b)
    (hbc : HasCompactSupport b) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (∑' δ : Fin k → ℤ,
      max (-((n:ℝ)^2*∑ γ ∈ S,q γ*b (latticeSample n δ+(-(n:ℝ)⁻¹) • v γ))) 0 *
        gradientWeight U (latticeSample n δ))/(n:ℝ)^k) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ x,max (-stencilDifferential C b x) 0*gradientWeight U x))

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.adic_intersection_lifting
statement:
lemma adic_intersection_lifting (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : R, (∀ i, x ∈ J i ⊔ I ^ n) →
      ∃ y : R, (∀ i, y ∈ J i) ∧ x - y ∈ I ^ q

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.adic_kernel_lifting
statement:
lemma adic_kernel_lifting (I : Ideal R) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : M, f x ∈ I ^ n • (⊤ : Submodule R N) →
      ∃ y : M, f y = 0 ∧ x - y ∈ I ^ q • (⊤ : Submodule R M)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.characterLog_exp
statement:

statement: theorem finite_lattice_identity : FiniteLatticeIdentity

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.finite_order_log_lifts
statement:
lemma finite_order_log_lifts (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (f : Lattice k →+ (LatticeRing k ⧸ augmentationIdeal ^ N))
    (hf : ∀ γ, f γ ∈ Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (augmentationIdeal ^ N)) augmentationIdeal)
    (hfexp : ∀ γ, IsNilpotent.exp (f γ) =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (augmentationIdeal ^ N)) (AddMonoidAlgebra.single γ 1)) :
    ∃ l : Fin k → LatticeRing k,
      (∀ a, (Ideal.Quotient.mk (augmentationIdeal ^ N)) (l a) = f (Pi.single a 1)) ∧
      (∀ a, mass (l a) = 0) ∧
      (∀ a b, firstMoment (l a) b = if a = b then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.finite_order_logs
statement:
lemma finite_order_logs (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ f : Lattice k →+ (LatticeRing k ⧸ augmentationIdeal ^ N),
      (∀ γ, f γ ∈ Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (augmentationIdeal ^ N)) augmentationIdeal) ∧
      (∀ γ, IsNilpotent.exp (f γ) =
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (augmentationIdeal ^ N)) (AddMonoidAlgebra.single γ 1))

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.log_quadratic_mod_coset
statement:
lemma log_quadratic_mod_coset (N : ℕ) (f : Lattice k →+ (LatticeRing k ⧸ augmentationIdeal ^ N))
    (hf : ∀ γ, f γ ∈ Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (augmentationIdeal ^ N)) augmentationIdeal)
    (hfexp : ∀ γ, IsNilpotent.exp (f γ) =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (augmentationIdeal ^ N)) (AddMonoidAlgebra.single γ 1))
    (Λ : AddSubgroup (Lattice k)) (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℚ)
    (hC : quotientTensor Λ (matrixTensor C) = 0)
    (l : Fin k → LatticeRing k)
    (hl : ∀ a, (Ideal.Quotient.mk (augmentationIdeal ^ N)) (l a) = f (Pi.single a 1)) :
    quadraticStencil C l ∈ cosetIdeal Λ ⊔ augmentationIdeal ^ N

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.nil_exp_sub_one_mem
