name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.quotient_nil_augmentation
statement:
lemma quotient_nil_augmentation (N : ℕ) :
    (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (augmentationIdeal ^ N))
      (augmentationIdeal : Ideal (LatticeRing k))) ^ N = ⊥

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.rationalExtension_lattice
statement:
lemma rationalExtension_lattice (f : (Fin k → ℤ) →+ R) (γ : Fin k → ℤ) :
    rationalExtension f (fun j => (γ j : ℚ)) = f γ

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.rationalExtension_mem
statement:
lemma rationalExtension_mem {I : Ideal R} (f : (Fin k → ℤ) →+ R)
    (hf : ∀ γ, f γ ∈ I) (v : Fin k → ℚ) : rationalExtension f v ∈ I

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.rationalExtension_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma rationalExtension_single {R : Type uRing} [CommRing R] [Algebra ℚ R]
    (f : Lattice k →+ R) (a : Fin k) :
    rationalExtension f (Pi.single a 1) = f (Pi.single a 1)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.tensor_quotient_quadratic
statement:
lemma tensor_quotient_quadratic {S : Type uSemigroup} [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ S]
    (V : Submodule ℚ (RationalSpace k)) (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℚ)
    (f : RationalSpace k →ₗ[ℚ] S) (hf : V ≤ LinearMap.ker f)
    (hC : TensorProduct.map V.mkQ V.mkQ (matrixTensor C) = 0) :
    (∑ a, ∑ b, C a b • (f (Pi.single a 1) * f (Pi.single b 1))) = 0

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.affineArray_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma affineArray_tmul {d : ℕ} (w z : AffineVector d) (α β : Option (Fin d)) :
    affineArray (w ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z) α β = w α ⊗ₜ[ℚ] z β

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.exists_symmetric_tensor_presentation
statement:
theorem exists_symmetric_tensor_presentation {W : Type uVector} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℚ W]
    (T : W ⊗[ℚ] W) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (w : Fin k → W) (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℚ), C.IsSymm ∧
      (∑ j,∑ l,C j l • (w j ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w l)) =
        (1/2:ℚ) • (T + TensorProduct.comm ℚ W W T)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.matrixTensor_map_family
statement:
lemma matrixTensor_map_family {k : ℕ} {W : Type uVector} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℚ W]
    (w : Fin k → W) (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℚ) :
    TensorProduct.map (Fintype.linearCombination ℚ w) (Fintype.linearCombination ℚ w) (matrixTensor C) =
      ∑ j,∑ l,C j l • (w j ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w l)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.quotientTensor_zero_of_evaluation
statement:
lemma quotientTensor_zero_of_evaluation {k : ℕ} (f : RationalSpace k →ₗ[ℚ] ℝ)
    (T : RationalSpace k ⊗[ℚ] RationalSpace k) (hT : TensorProduct.map f f T = 0) :
    quotientTensor (AddMonoidHom.ker (f.toAddMonoidHom.comp rationalize)) T = 0

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.rational_lattice_kernel
statement:
lemma rational_lattice_kernel {k : ℕ} (f : RationalSpace k →ₗ[ℚ] ℝ) :
    latticeSpan (AddMonoidHom.ker (f.toAddMonoidHom.comp rationalize)) = f.ker

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.spatialMultiply_family
statement:
lemma spatialMultiply_family {k d : ℕ} (w : Fin k → AffineVector d)
    (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℚ) :
    spatialMultiply (affineArray (∑ j,∑ l,C j l • (w j ⊗ₜ[ℚ] w l))) =
      (show Matrix (Fin d) (Fin k) ℝ from fun α j => w j (some α)) * (C.map (Rat.cast : ℚ → ℝ)) *
        (show Matrix (Fin d) (Fin k) ℝ from fun α j => w j (some α)).transpose

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.count_difference
statement:
lemma count_difference {α : Type uAlpha} (z : α →₀ ℤ) (a : α) :
    (positiveCount z a : ℝ)-(negativeCount z a:ℝ) = z a

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.count_difference_finsupp
statement:
lemma count_difference_finsupp {α : Type uAlpha} (f : α →₀ ℚ) (M : ℕ) (z : α →₀ ℤ)
    (hz : ∀ a,(z a:ℝ) = M*(f a:ℝ)) :
    (positiveCount z).mapRange (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℝ) (by simp) -
      (negativeCount z).mapRange (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℝ) (by simp) =
      (M:ℝ) • f.mapRange (Rat.cast : ℚ → ℝ) (by simp)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.equal_count_pushforward
statement:
lemma equal_count_pushforward {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} (f : α →₀ ℚ) (M : ℕ) (z : α →₀ ℤ)
    (hz : ∀ a,(z a:ℝ) = M*(f a:ℝ)) (g : α → β) (hg : f.mapDomain g = 0) :
    (positiveCount z).mapDomain g = (negativeCount z).mapDomain g

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.equal_evaluated_multisets
statement:
lemma equal_evaluated_multisets {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} (f : α →₀ ℚ) (M : ℕ) (z : α →₀ ℤ)
    (hz : ∀ a,(z a:ℝ) = M*(f a:ℝ)) (g : α → β) (hg : f.mapDomain g = 0) :
    (positiveCount z).toMultiset.map g = (negativeCount z).toMultiset.map g

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.integerize_finsupp
statement:
lemma integerize_finsupp {α : Type uAlpha} (f : α →₀ ℚ) :
    ∃ (M : ℕ) (z : α →₀ ℤ), 0 < M ∧ ∀ a, (z a:ℚ) = M*f a

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.integerize_finsupp_real
statement:
lemma integerize_finsupp_real {α : Type uAlpha} (f : α →₀ ℚ) :
    ∃ (M : ℕ) (z : α →₀ ℤ), 0 < M ∧ ∀ a, (z a:ℝ) = M*(f a:ℝ)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.multiset_map_equiv
statement:
lemma multiset_map_equiv {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (m n : Multiset α) (f : α → β) (h : m.map f = n.map f) :
    ∃ e : m ≃ n, ∀ x : m, f (e x) = f x

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.negativeCount_cast
statement:
lemma negativeCount_cast {α : Type uAlpha} (z : α →₀ ℤ) (a : α) :
    (negativeCount z a : ℝ) = max (-(z a:ℝ)) 0

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.normalized_signed_rows
statement:
theorem normalized_signed_rows {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] {d s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (a : Fin s → Fin d → ℝ) (v : α → ℝ) (g : α → Fin d → ℝ)
    (f : α →₀ ℚ) (ζ η : ℝ) (hζ : 0 < ζ)
    (heval : ∀ i,f.mapDomain (fun x => v x+∑ j,a i j*g x j)=0)
    (hmom : ∀ j l,f.sum (fun x q => (q:ℝ)*g x j*g x l)=ζ*(if j=l then 1 else 0))
    (hneg : f.sum (fun x q => max (-(q:ℝ)) 0*(∑ j,(g x j)^2)) < η*ζ) :
    ∃ (τ : Type) (_ : Fintype τ) (vp vn : τ → ℝ) (U V : Matrix (Fin d) τ ℝ),
      U*U.transpose-V*V.transpose=1 ∧ (V*V.transpose).trace < η ∧
      ∀ i,∃ σ : Equiv.Perm τ,∀ x,
        vn (σ x)+∑ j,a i j*V j (σ x) = vp x+∑ j,a i j*U j x

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.positiveCount_cast
statement:
lemma positiveCount_cast {α : Type uAlpha} (z : α →₀ ℤ) (a : α) :
    (positiveCount z a : ℝ) = max (z a:ℝ) 0

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.sum_count_elements
statement:
lemma sum_count_elements {α : Type uAlpha} [DecidableEq α] (c : α →₀ ℕ) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : c.toMultiset, f x) = c.sum (fun a n => (n:ℝ)*f a)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.sum_counts_difference
statement:
lemma sum_counts_difference {α : Type uAlpha} [DecidableEq α]
    (f : α →₀ ℚ) (M : ℕ) (z : α →₀ ℤ)
    (hz : ∀ a,(z a:ℝ) = M*(f a:ℝ)) (g : α → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : (positiveCount z).toMultiset,g x) -
      (∑ x : (negativeCount z).toMultiset,g x) =
      M*f.sum (fun a q => (q:ℝ)*g a)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.sum_counts_negative
statement:
lemma sum_counts_negative {α : Type uAlpha} [DecidableEq α]
    (f : α →₀ ℚ) (M : ℕ) (z : α →₀ ℤ)
    (hz : ∀ a,(z a:ℝ) = M*(f a:ℝ)) (g : α → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : (negativeCount z).toMultiset,g x) =
      M*f.sum (fun a q => max (-(q:ℝ)) 0*g a)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.sum_multiset_elements
statement:
lemma sum_multiset_elements {α : Type uAlpha} {β : Type uBeta} [DecidableEq α] [AddCommMonoid β]
    (m : Multiset α) (f : α → β) : (∑ x : m, f x) = (m.map f).sum

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.complete_gram_pair
statement:
theorem complete_gram_pair {d : ℕ} {τ : Type uRow} [Fintype τ]
    (U V : Matrix (Fin d) τ ℝ) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hdiff : U*U.transpose-V*V.transpose=1)
    (htrace : (V*V.transpose).trace < η) :
    ∃ R : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ,
      let c := (Real.sqrt (1+η))⁻¹
      (c • (U.fromCols R))*(c • (U.fromCols R)).transpose=1 ∧
      (c • (V.fromCols R))*(c • (V.fromCols R)).transpose=
        (η/(1+η)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.evaluation_coset_pushforward
statement:
lemma evaluation_coset_pushforward {k : ℕ} (φ : Lattice k →+ ℝ)
    (μ : LatticeRing k) (hμ : cosetPushforward φ.ker μ=0) (n : ℝ) :
    μ.coeff.mapDomain (fun x => φ x/n)=0

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.exists_gram_sqrt
statement:
lemma exists_gram_sqrt {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (P : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hP : P.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ R : Matrix ι ι ℝ,R*R.transpose=P

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.gram_fromCols
statement:
lemma gram_fromCols {ι : Type uIndex} {τ : Type uRow} {κ : Type uColor} [Fintype τ] [Fintype κ]
    (U : Matrix ι τ ℝ) (R : Matrix ι κ ℝ) :
    (U.fromCols R)*(U.fromCols R).transpose = U*U.transpose+R*R.transpose

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.lattice_affine_evaluation
statement:
lemma lattice_affine_evaluation {k d s : ℕ} (a : Fin s → Space d)
    (w : Fin k → AffineVector d) (i : Fin s) (γ : Lattice k) (n : ℝ) :
    ((rowEvaluation a i).comp (Fintype.linearCombination ℚ w)) (rationalize γ)/n =
      (∑ j,(γ j:ℝ)/n*w j none)+
        ∑ α,a i α*(∑ j,(γ j:ℝ)/n*w j (some α))

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.row_gram_distance
statement:
lemma row_gram_distance {d : ℕ} {τ : Type uRow} [Fintype τ]
    (v : τ → ℝ) (U : Matrix (Fin d) τ ℝ) (q : ℝ)
    (hU : U*U.transpose=q • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ))
    (a b : Fin d → ℝ) :
    (∑ x,((v x+∑ j,a j*U j x)-(v x+∑ j,b j*U j x))^2) =
      q*(∑ j,(a j-b j)^2)

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.scaled_second_moment
statement:
lemma scaled_second_moment {k d : ℕ} (μ : LatticeRing k) (n : ℕ)
    (C : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℚ) (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (ζ : ℚ) (hsecond : ∀ j l,secondMoment μ j l/(n:ℚ)^2 = ζ*C j l)
    (α β : Fin d) :
    μ.coeff.sum (fun γ q => (q:ℝ)*(∑ j,U α j*latticeSample n γ j)*
      (∑ l,U β l*latticeSample n γ l)) =
      (ζ:ℝ)*(U*(C.map (Rat.cast : ℚ → ℝ))*U.transpose) α β

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.trace_gram_complement
statement:
lemma trace_gram_complement {ι : Type uIndex} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (B : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hB : B.PosSemidef) (η : ℝ) (hη : B.trace ≤ η) :
    (η • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)-B).PosSemidef

name: OAI.EuclideanRamsey.two_scale_of_signed_rows
statement:
theorem two_scale_of_signed_rows {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] {d s : ℕ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (hs : 0 < s) (a : Fin s → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (v : α → ℝ) (g : α → Fin d → ℝ) (f : α →₀ ℚ)
    (ζ η : ℝ) (hζ : 0 < ζ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (heval : ∀ i,f.mapDomain (fun x => v x+∑ j,a i j*g x j)=0)
    (hmom : ∀ j l,f.sum (fun x q => (q:ℝ)*g x j*g x l)=ζ*(if j=l then 1 else 0))
    (hneg : f.sum (fun x q => max (-(q:ℝ)) 0*(∑ j,(g x j)^2)) < η*ζ) :
    ∃ (ℓ : ℕ),1 ≤ ℓ ∧ ∃ (f' g' : Fin s → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin ℓ)),
      (∀ i j,‖f' i-f' j‖^2=‖a i-a j‖^2) ∧
      (∀ i j,‖g' i-g' j‖^2=(η/(1+η))*‖a i-a j‖^2) ∧
      ∀ i,∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin ℓ),∀ x,g' i (σ x)=f' i x

@[simp] theorem mem_fractionalFeasible {F : Family α} {p : ℝ} :

statement:

    cost p (T.biUnion G) ≤ ∑ i ∈ T, cost p (G i)

statement: @[simp] theorem cost_empty (p : ℝ) : cost p (∅ : Family α) = 0

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.cost_gt_of_not_small
statement:
theorem cost_gt_of_not_small {F G : Family α} {p : ℝ}
    (h : ¬ Small p F) (hG : Covers G F) : 1 / 2 < cost p G

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.cost_image_le

theorem cost_mono {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) {G H : Family α} (h : G ⊆ H) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.cost_mono_density
statement:
theorem cost_mono_density {p r : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hpr : p ≤ r) (G : Family α) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.cost_nonneg

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.cost_singleton

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.coverIndicator_nonneg

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.expectation_add
statement:
theorem expectation_add (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => f ω + g ω) = μ.expectation f + μ.expectation g

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.expectation_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem expectation_const (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (c : ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun _ => c) = c

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.expectation_mono
statement:
theorem expectation_mono (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {f g : Ω → ℝ} (hfg : ∀ ω, f ω ≤ g ω) :
    μ.expectation f ≤ μ.expectation g

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.expectation_nonneg
statement:
theorem expectation_nonneg (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) :
    0 ≤ μ.expectation f

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.expectation_prod
statement:
theorem expectation_prod (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ) (f : Ω × Γ → ℝ) :
    (μ.prod ν).expectation f = μ.expectation (fun ω => ν.expectation (fun γ => f (ω, γ)))

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.expectation_smul
statement:
theorem expectation_smul (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => c * f ω) = c * μ.expectation f

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.expectation_sub
statement:
theorem expectation_sub (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => f ω - g ω) = μ.expectation f - μ.expectation g

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.expectation_sum
statement:
theorem expectation_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => ∑ i, f i ω) = ∑ i, μ.expectation (f i)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.iid_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem iid_weight (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (n : ℕ) (ω : Fin n → Ω) :
    (iid μ n).weight ω = ∏ i, μ.weight (ω i)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.pi_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem pi_weight {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {A : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (A i)]
    (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (A i)) (ω : ∀ i, A i) :
    (pi μ).weight ω = ∏ i, (μ i).weight (ω i)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prob_compl
statement:
theorem prob_compl (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) :
    μ.prob (fun ω => ¬ P ω) = 1 - μ.prob P

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prob_eq_expectation
statement:
theorem prob_eq_expectation (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) :
    μ.prob P = μ.expectation (fun ω => if P ω then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prob_false
statement: @[simp] theorem prob_false (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) : μ.prob (fun _ => False) = 0

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prob_ge_le_expectation_div
statement:
theorem prob_ge_le_expectation_div (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.prob (fun ω => t ≤ f ω) ≤ μ.expectation f / t

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prob_le_expectation
statement:
theorem prob_le_expectation (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) (hP : ∀ ω, P ω → 1 ≤ f ω) : μ.prob P ≤ μ.expectation f

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prob_le_one
statement: theorem prob_le_one (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) : μ.prob P ≤ 1

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prob_mono
statement:
theorem prob_mono (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {P Q : Ω → Prop} (hPQ : ∀ ω, P ω → Q ω) :
    μ.prob P ≤ μ.prob Q

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prob_nonneg
statement: theorem prob_nonneg (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) : 0 ≤ μ.prob P

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prob_true
statement: @[simp] theorem prob_true (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) : μ.prob (fun _ => True) = 1

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prob_union_le
statement:
theorem prob_union_le (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P Q : Ω → Prop) :
    μ.prob (fun ω => P ω ∨ Q ω) ≤ μ.prob P + μ.prob Q

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prod_isPositive
statement:
theorem prod_isPositive (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ)
    (hμ : μ.IsPositive) (hν : ν.IsPositive) : (μ.prod ν).IsPositive

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prod_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem prod_weight (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ) (ω : Ω) (γ : Γ) :
    (μ.prod ν).weight (ω, γ) = μ.weight ω * ν.weight γ

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.uniform_isPositive
statement:
theorem uniform_isPositive (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] :
    (uniform Ω).IsPositive

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.uniform_prob
statement:
theorem uniform_prob (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (P : Ω → Prop) :
    (uniform Ω).prob P = ((Finset.univ.filter P).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.expectation_map
statement:
theorem expectation_map (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → Γ) (g : Γ → ℝ) :
    (map μ f).expectation g = μ.expectation (fun ω => g (f ω))

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.expectation_pi_coordinate
statement:
theorem expectation_pi_coordinate (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (A i))
    (i : I) (f : A i → ℝ) :
    (pi μ).expectation (fun ω => f (ω i)) = (μ i).expectation f

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.expectation_pi_product
statement:
theorem expectation_pi_product (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (A i))
    (f : ∀ i, A i → ℝ) :
    (pi μ).expectation (fun ω => ∏ i, f i (ω i)) =
      ∏ i, (μ i).expectation (f i)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.map_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_weight (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → Γ) (γ : Γ) :
    (map μ f).weight γ = ∑ ω, if f ω = γ then μ.weight ω else 0

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.map_weight_eq_prob
statement:
theorem map_weight_eq_prob (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → Γ) (γ : Γ) :
    (map μ f).weight γ = μ.prob (fun ω => f ω = γ)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prob_map
statement:
theorem prob_map (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → Γ) (P : Γ → Prop) :
    (map μ f).prob P = μ.prob (fun ω => P (f ω))

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prob_pi
statement:
theorem prob_pi (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (A i)) (P : ∀ i, A i → Prop) :
    (pi μ).prob (fun ω => ∀ i, P i (ω i)) = ∏ i, (μ i).prob (P i)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prob_pi_coordinate
statement:
theorem prob_pi_coordinate (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (A i))
    (i : I) (P : A i → Prop) :
    (pi μ).prob (fun ω => P (ω i)) = (μ i).prob P

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.prob_prod
statement:
theorem prob_prod (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ)
    (P : Ω → Prop) (Q : Γ → Prop) :
    (μ.prod ν).prob (fun z => P z.1 ∧ Q z.2) = μ.prob P * ν.prob Q

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.colorLaw_isPositive
statement:
theorem colorLaw_isPositive (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hs : p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2) : (colorLaw p s hp hs).IsPositive

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.colorLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem colorLaw_weight (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hs : p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2) (c : Color s) :
    (colorLaw p s hp hs).weight c = colorProb p s c

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.colorMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem colorMass_nonneg (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hs : p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2) (a : Coloring α s) : 0 ≤ colorMass p s a

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.colorMass_pos
statement:
theorem colorMass_pos (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hs : p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2) (a : Coloring α s) : 0 < colorMass p s a

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.colorProb_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] theorem colorProb_castSucc (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (i : Fin s) :
    colorProb p s i.castSucc = (256 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1) * p

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.colorProb_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem colorProb_last (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) :
    colorProb p s (Fin.last s) = 1 - p * scaleSum s

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.colorProb_le_one
statement:
theorem colorProb_le_one (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hs : p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2) (c : Color s) : colorProb p s c ≤ 1

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.colorProb_nonneg
statement:
theorem colorProb_nonneg (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hs : p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2) (c : Color s) : 0 ≤ colorProb p s c

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.colorProb_pos
statement:
theorem colorProb_pos (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hs : p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2) (c : Color s) : 0 < colorProb p s c

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.coloringLaw_expectation_coordinate
statement:
theorem coloringLaw_expectation_coordinate (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hs : p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2) (x : α) (f : Color s → ℝ) :
    (coloringLaw p s hp hs).expectation (fun a => f (a x)) =
      ∑ c : Color s, colorProb p s c * f c

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.coloringLaw_expectation_product
statement:
theorem coloringLaw_expectation_product (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hs : p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2) (f : α → Color s → ℝ) :
    (coloringLaw p s hp hs).expectation (fun a => ∏ x, f x (a x)) =
      ∏ x, ∑ c : Color s, colorProb p s c * f x c

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.coloringLaw_isPositive
statement:
theorem coloringLaw_isPositive (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hs : p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (coloringLaw (α := α) p s hp hs).IsPositive

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.coloringLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem coloringLaw_weight (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hs : p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2) (a : Coloring α s) :
    (coloringLaw p s hp hs).weight a = colorMass p s a

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.scaleSum_nonneg
statement: theorem scaleSum_nonneg (s : ℕ) : 0 ≤ scaleSum s

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.scaleSum_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem scaleSum_zero : scaleSum 0 = 0

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.sum_colorMass
statement:
theorem sum_colorMass (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) :
    ∑ a : Coloring α s, colorMass p s a = 1

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.sum_colorProb
statement: theorem sum_colorProb (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) : ∑ c : Color s, colorProb p s c = 1

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.profile_coefficient_eq
statement:
theorem profile_coefficient_eq {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (s : ℕ) (i : Fin s) :
    ((3 : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1)) * (p / colorProb p s i.castSucc) =
      3 / (64 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.profile_coefficient_pow_eq
statement:
theorem profile_coefficient_pow_eq {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (s : ℕ) (i : Fin s) (t : ℕ) :
    ((3 : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1)) ^ t *
        (p / colorProb p s i.castSucc) ^ t =
      (3 / (64 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1)) ^ t

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.exists_scale
statement:
theorem exists_scale {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ 1 / 2 < p * scaleSum (s + 1)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.half_geometric_sum_le_one
statement:
theorem half_geometric_sum_le_one (s : ℕ) :
    (∑ i : Fin s, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1)) ≤ 1

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.maxScale_admissible
statement:
theorem maxScale_admissible {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    p * scaleSum (maxScale p) ≤ 1 / 2

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.maxScale_largest
statement:
theorem maxScale_largest {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) {t : ℕ}
    (ht : p * scaleSum t ≤ 1 / 2) : t ≤ maxScale p

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.maxScale_next_fail
statement:
theorem maxScale_next_fail {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    1 / 2 < p * scaleSum (maxScale p + 1)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.maxScale_tail_lt
statement:
theorem maxScale_tail_lt {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    1 / (512 : ℝ) ^ (maxScale p + 1) < 4 * p

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.scaleSum_ge_nat
statement: theorem scaleSum_ge_nat (s : ℕ) : (s : ℝ) ≤ scaleSum s

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.scaleSum_le_two_pow
statement: theorem scaleSum_le_two_pow (s : ℕ) : scaleSum s ≤ 2 * (256 : ℝ) ^ s

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.scaleSum_monotone
statement: theorem scaleSum_monotone : Monotone scaleSum

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.scaleSum_succ
statement:
theorem scaleSum_succ (s : ℕ) :
    scaleSum (s + 1) = scaleSum s + (256 : ℝ) ^ (s + 1)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.scale_next_fail_exists
statement:
theorem scale_next_fail_exists {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, 1 / 2 < p * scaleSum (s + 1)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.tail_lt_four_mul_p
statement:
theorem tail_lt_four_mul_p {p : ℝ} {s : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hnext : 1 / 2 < p * scaleSum (s + 1)) :
    1 / (512 : ℝ) ^ (s + 1) < 4 * p

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.color_mean_eq
statement:
theorem color_mean_eq (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) :
    (∑ c : Color s,
      colorProb p s c * ((512 : ℝ) ^ 4 / (512 : ℝ) ^ (c.val + 1))) =
      (512 : ℝ) ^ 4 *
        (p * (∑ i : Fin s, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1)) +
          (1 - p * scaleSum s) * (1 / (512 : ℝ) ^ (s + 1)))

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.color_mean_le
statement:
theorem color_mean_le {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) {s : ℕ}
    (_hs : p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hnext : 1 / 2 < p * scaleSum (s + 1)) :
    (∑ c : Color s,
      colorProb p s c * ((512 : ℝ) ^ 4 / (512 : ℝ) ^ (c.val + 1))) ≤
      5 * (512 : ℝ) ^ 4 * p

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.color_mean_le_r_div_five
statement:
theorem color_mean_le_r_div_five {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) {s : ℕ}
    (hs : (r / ((25 : ℝ) * (512 : ℝ) ^ 4)) * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hnext : 1 / 2 < (r / ((25 : ℝ) * (512 : ℝ) ^ 4)) * scaleSum (s + 1)) :
    (∑ c : Color s,
      colorProb (r / ((25 : ℝ) * (512 : ℝ) ^ 4)) s c *
        ((512 : ℝ) ^ 4 / (512 : ℝ) ^ (c.val + 1))) ≤ r / 5

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.five_Bfour_mul_scaled_density
statement:
theorem five_Bfour_mul_scaled_density (r : ℝ) :
    5 * (512 : ℝ) ^ 4 * (r / ((25 : ℝ) * (512 : ℝ) ^ 4)) = r / 5

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.rounding_constant_pos
statement: theorem rounding_constant_pos : 0 < (25 : ℝ) * (512 : ℝ) ^ 4

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.Admissible.heavy_subset
statement:
theorem Admissible.heavy_subset {w : α → ℝ} {A : Finset α} {m d u : ℝ}
    (hu : Admissible w A m d u) : heavySet w u ⊆ A

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.Admissible.outside_le
statement:
theorem Admissible.outside_le {w : α → ℝ} {A : Finset α} {m d u : ℝ}
    (hu : Admissible w A m d u) {x : α} (hx : x ∉ A) : w x ≤ u

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.mem_heavySet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_heavySet {w : α → ℝ} {u : ℝ} {x : α} :
    x ∈ heavySet w u ↔ u < w x

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.colorMass_profile_likelihood
statement:
theorem colorMass_profile_likelihood (p : ℝ) (s : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hs : p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2) (a z : Coloring α s) (haz : Selector.Earlier a z) :
    p ^ Selector.profileSize (Selector.profile a z) * colorMass p s a =
      colorMass p s z * ∏ i : Fin s,
        ((p / colorProb p s i.castSucc) ^ Selector.rowCount (Selector.profile a z) i *
          ∏ h : Color s, (colorProb p s h) ^ Selector.profile a z i h)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.pow_profileSize_eq_prod_changes
statement:
theorem pow_profileSize_eq_prod_changes (p : ℝ) (a z : Coloring α s) :
    p ^ profileSize (profile a z) = ∏ _x ∈ changes a z, p

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.prod_profile_eq_prod_changes
statement:
theorem prod_profile_eq_prod_changes (a z : Coloring α s)
    (F : Color s → Color s → ℝ) :
    (∏ i : Fin s, ∏ h : Color s, F i.castSucc h ^ profile a z i h) =
      ∏ x ∈ changes a z, F (z x) (a x)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.expectation_pi_subset_product
statement:
theorem expectation_pi_subset_product (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (A i))
    (S : Finset I) (f : ∀ i, A i → ℝ) :
    (pi μ).expectation (fun ω => ∏ i ∈ S, f i (ω i)) =
      ∏ i ∈ S, (μ i).expectation (f i)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.expectation_pi_subset_product_const
statement:
theorem expectation_pi_subset_product_const {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (S : Finset I) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    (pi (fun _ : I => μ)).expectation (fun ω => ∏ i ∈ S, f (ω i)) =
      (μ.expectation f) ^ S.card

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.FiniteLaw.expectation_pi_subset_product_of_mean
statement:
theorem expectation_pi_subset_product_of_mean (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (A i))
    (S : Finset I) (f : ∀ i, A i → ℝ) (a : ℝ)
    (hmean : ∀ i ∈ S, (μ i).expectation (f i) = a) :
    (pi μ).expectation (fun ω => ∏ i ∈ S, f i (ω i)) = a ^ S.card

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.colorProduct_eq_pow_div_pow
statement:
theorem colorProduct_eq_pow_div_pow (S : Finset α) (a : α → ℕ) :
    (∏ x ∈ S, (512 : ℝ) ^ 4 / (512 : ℝ) ^ a x) =
      (512 : ℝ) ^ (4 * S.card) / (512 : ℝ) ^ (∑ x ∈ S, a x)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.one_le_colorProduct_of_sum_le
statement:
theorem one_le_colorProduct_of_sum_le (S : Finset α) (a : α → ℕ)
    (hsum : (∑ x ∈ S, a x) ≤ 4 * S.card) :
    1 ≤ ∏ x ∈ S, (512 : ℝ) ^ 4 / (512 : ℝ) ^ a x

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.expectation_productScore
statement:
theorem expectation_productScore (ν : FiniteLaw Ω) (g : Finset α → ℝ) (Y : Ω → ℝ) :
    (FiniteLaw.pi (fun _ : α => ν)).expectation
        (fun ω => productScore g (fun x => Y (ω x))) =
      ∑ S ∈ (Finset.univ.erase ∅ : Finset (Finset α)),
        g S * (ν.expectation Y) ^ S.card

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.expectation_productScore_le
statement:
theorem expectation_productScore_le (ν : FiniteLaw Ω) (g : Finset α → ℝ)
    (Y : Ω → ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hg : ∀ S, 0 ≤ g S) (hY : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Y ω)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hmean : ν.expectation Y ≤ r / 5) :
    (FiniteLaw.pi (fun _ : α => ν)).expectation
        (fun ω => productScore g (fun x => Y (ω x))) ≤
      (1 / 5) * fracCost r g

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.expectation_productScore_le_tenth
statement:
theorem expectation_productScore_le_tenth (ν : FiniteLaw Ω) (g : Finset α → ℝ)
    (Y : Ω → ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hg : ∀ S, 0 ≤ g S) (hY : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ Y ω)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hmean : ν.expectation Y ≤ r / 5) (hcost : fracCost r g ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (FiniteLaw.pi (fun _ : α => ν)).expectation
        (fun ω => productScore g (fun x => Y (ω x))) ≤ 1 / 10

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.one_fifth_pow_le
statement:
theorem one_fifth_pow_le {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    (r / 5) ^ k ≤ (1 / 5) * r ^ k

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.productScore_nonneg
statement:
theorem productScore_nonneg {g : Finset α → ℝ} {Y : α → ℝ}
    (hg : ∀ S, 0 ≤ g S) (hY : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Y x) : 0 ≤ productScore g Y

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.empty_weight_le_half
OAI.TalagrandThreshold.mem_nonemptySubsets
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_nonemptySubsets {S H : Finset α} :
    S ∈ nonemptySubsets H ↔ S ≠ ∅ ∧ S ⊆ H

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.memberMass_add_empty
statement:
theorem memberMass_add_empty (g : Finset α → ℝ) (H : Finset α) :
    memberMass g H + g ∅ = ∑ S ∈ H.powerset, g S

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.memberMass_ge_half
statement:
theorem memberMass_ge_half {F : Family α} {g : Finset α → ℝ}
    {H : Finset α} {r : ℝ} (hcover : FractionalCover F g) (hH : H ∈ F)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hcost : fracCost r g ≤ 1 / 2) :
    1 / 2 ≤ memberMass g H

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.memberMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem memberMass_nonneg {g : Finset α → ℝ} (hg : ∀ S, 0 ≤ g S)
    (H : Finset α) : 0 ≤ memberMass g H

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.memberMass_pos_of_fractionalCover
statement:
theorem memberMass_pos_of_fractionalCover {F : Family α} {g : Finset α → ℝ}
    {H : Finset α} {r : ℝ} (hcover : FractionalCover F g) (hH : H ∈ F)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hcost : fracCost r g ≤ 1 / 2) :
    0 < memberMass g H

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.roundingMass_eq_zero_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem roundingMass_eq_zero_of_not_mem (g : Finset α → ℝ) (H : Finset α)
    {x : α} (hx : x ∉ H) : roundingMass g H x = 0

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.roundingMass_mean
statement:
theorem roundingMass_mean (g : Finset α → ℝ) (H : Finset α) (a : α → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : α, a x * roundingMass g H x) =
      (∑ S ∈ nonemptySubsets H, g S * subsetAverage a S) / memberMass g H

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.roundingMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem roundingMass_nonneg (g : Finset α → ℝ) (H : Finset α)
    (hg : ∀ S, 0 ≤ g S) (hM : 0 < memberMass g H) (x : α) :
    0 ≤ roundingMass g H x

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.roundingMass_sum
statement:
theorem roundingMass_sum (g : Finset α → ℝ) (H : Finset α)
    (hM : 0 < memberMass g H) : (∑ x : α, roundingMass g H x) = 1

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.subsetAverage_nonneg
statement:
theorem subsetAverage_nonneg {a : α → ℝ} (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x)
    (S : Finset α) : 0 ≤ subsetAverage a S

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.sum_rounding_numerator
statement:
theorem sum_rounding_numerator (g : Finset α → ℝ) (H : Finset α) :
    (∑ x : α, ∑ S ∈ nonemptySubsets H,
      if x ∈ S then g S / (S.card : ℝ) else 0) = memberMass g H

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.sum_uniform_subset_weight
statement:
theorem sum_uniform_subset_weight (g : Finset α → ℝ) (S : Finset α)
    (hS : S ≠ ∅) :
    (∑ x : α, if x ∈ S then g S / (S.card : ℝ) else 0) = g S

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.sum_weighted_uniform_subset_weight
statement:
theorem sum_weighted_uniform_subset_weight (g : Finset α → ℝ)
    (S : Finset α) (a : α → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : α, a x * (if x ∈ S then g S / (S.card : ℝ) else 0)) =
      g S * subsetAverage a S

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.half_mass_of_weighted_average_le
statement:
theorem half_mass_of_weighted_average_le {β : Type*} (T : Finset β)
    (w v : β → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i ∈ T, 0 ≤ w i) (hv : ∀ i ∈ T, 0 ≤ v i)
    (hmean : (∑ i ∈ T, w i * v i) ≤ 2 * (∑ i ∈ T, w i)) :
    (∑ i ∈ T, w i) / 2 ≤ ∑ i ∈ T.filter (fun i => v i ≤ 4), w i

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.productScore_lower_of_mean
statement:
theorem productScore_lower_of_mean (g : Finset α → ℝ) (H : Finset α)
    (a : α → ℕ) (hg : ∀ S, 0 ≤ g S) (hMH : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ memberMass g H)
    (hmean : (∑ x : α, (a x : ℝ) * roundingMass g H x) ≤ 2) :
    (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ productScore g (fun x => (512 : ℝ) ^ 4 / (512 : ℝ) ^ a x)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.subsetAverage_nat_nonneg
statement:

statement:
theorem Captured.exists_meanColor_le_two {F : Family α} {mu : MassFamily F} {s : ℕ}
    {a : Coloring α s} (h : Captured mu a) : ∃ H : ↥F, meanColor mu H a ≤ 2

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.color_level_eq_one_add_tail
statement:
theorem color_level_eq_one_add_tail {s : ℕ} (c : Color s) :
    (c.val + 1 : ℝ) = 1 + ∑ i : Fin s, if i.val < c.val then (1 : ℝ) else 0

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.meanColor_eq_one_add_sum_tail
statement:
theorem meanColor_eq_one_add_sum_tail {F : Family α} (mu : MassFamily F) {s : ℕ}
    (H : ↥F) (a : Coloring α s) :
    meanColor mu H a = 1 +
      ∑ i : Fin s, (1 - ∑ x ∈ prefixSet a i, mu.weight H x)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.meanColor_le_two_of_capture
statement:
theorem meanColor_le_two_of_capture {F : Family α} (mu : MassFamily F) {s : ℕ}
    (H : ↥F) (a : Coloring α s)
    (hcapture : ∀ i : Fin s,
      1 - dscale i ≤ ∑ x ∈ prefixSet a i, mu.weight H x) :
    meanColor mu H a ≤ 2

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.sum_color_tail_indicators
statement:
theorem sum_color_tail_indicators {s : ℕ} (c : Color s) :
    (∑ i : Fin s, if i.val < c.val then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = (c.val : ℝ)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.sum_dscale_le_one
statement: theorem sum_dscale_le_one (s : ℕ) : (∑ i : Fin s, dscale i) ≤ 1

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.sum_tail_eq_one_sub_prefix
statement:
theorem sum_tail_eq_one_sub_prefix {F : Family α} (mu : MassFamily F) {s : ℕ}
    (H : ↥F) (a : Coloring α s) (i : Fin s) :
    (∑ x, if i.val < (a x).val then mu.weight H x else 0) =
      1 - ∑ x ∈ prefixSet a i, mu.weight H x

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.Selected.changes_nonempty

theorem Selected.changes_nonempty {mu : MassFamily F} {a z : Coloring α s}

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.Selected.earlier

theorem Selected.earlier {mu : MassFamily F} {a z : Coloring α s}

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.Selected.feasible
statement:
theorem Selected.feasible {mu : MassFamily F} {a z : Coloring α s}

statement:
theorem captured_of_feasible_self {mu : MassFamily F} {a : Coloring α s}

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.changes_reset_subset
statement:
theorem changes_reset_subset (a : Coloring α s) (H₀ : ↥F) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.eq_of_changes_eq_empty
statement:
theorem eq_of_changes_eq_empty {a z : Coloring α s} (hz : Earlier a z)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.exists_isMinimalMove
statement:
theorem exists_isMinimalMove (mu : MassFamily F) (a : Coloring α s) (H₀ : ↥F) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.half_lt_selectedMoves_cost
statement:
theorem half_lt_selectedMoves_cost (mu : MassFamily F) (a : Coloring α s)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.mem_selectedMoves
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_selectedMoves {mu : MassFamily F} {a z : Coloring α s} :
    z ∈ selectedMoves mu a ↔ Selected mu a z

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.originalExcess_eq_mass_sub
statement:
theorem originalExcess_eq_mass_sub (w : α → ℝ) (A : Finset α) (d : ℝ)
    (htotal : ∑ x, w x = 1) :
    (∑ x, w x * ((if x ∈ A then 1 else 0) - (1 - d))) =
      (∑ x ∈ A, w x) - (1 - d)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.reset_boundedFeasible
statement:
theorem reset_boundedFeasible (mu : MassFamily F) (a : Coloring α s) (H₀ : ↥F) :
    BoundedFeasible mu a H₀ (reset a H₀)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.reset_earlier
statement:
theorem reset_earlier (a : Coloring α s) (H₀ : ↥F) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.reset_feasibleFor
statement:
theorem reset_feasibleFor (mu : MassFamily F) (a : Coloring α s) (H₀ : ↥F) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.selectedChanges_covers
statement:
theorem selectedChanges_covers (mu : MassFamily F) (a : Coloring α s) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.truncatedExcess_le_original
statement:
theorem truncatedExcess_le_original (w : α → ℝ) (A : Finset α) (d u : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hheavy : ∀ x, u < w x → x ∈ A) :
    truncatedExcess w A d u ≤
      ∑ x, w x * ((if x ∈ A then 1 else 0) - (1 - d))

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.mem_wordFiber
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_wordFiber (D : Type*) [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D]
    (n : H → ℕ) (f : D → H) : f ∈ wordFiber D n ↔ wordProfile f = n

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.mem_wordProfiles_iff
statement:
theorem mem_wordProfiles_iff (t : ℕ) (n : H → ℕ) :
    n ∈ wordProfiles H t ↔ ∃ f : Fin t → H, wordProfile f = n

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.prod_weight_wordProfile
statement:
theorem prod_weight_wordProfile {D : Type*} [Fintype D]
    (f : D → H) (π : H → ℝ) :
    (∏ h, π h ^ wordProfile f h) = ∏ i, π (f i)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.sum_wordCount_weight
statement:
theorem sum_wordCount_weight (t : ℕ) (π : H → ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ wordProfiles H t, (wordCount t n : ℝ) * ∏ h, π h ^ n h) =
      (∑ h, π h) ^ t

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.sum_wordCount_weight_finset_le_one
statement:
theorem sum_wordCount_weight_finset_le_one (t : ℕ) (E : Finset (H → ℕ))
    (π : H → ℝ) (hπ : ∀ h, 0 ≤ π h) (hπsum : (∑ h, π h) ≤ 1) :
    (∑ n ∈ E, (wordCount t n : ℝ) * ∏ h, π h ^ n h) ≤ 1

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.sum_wordCount_weight_le_one
statement:
theorem sum_wordCount_weight_le_one (t : ℕ) (π : H → ℝ) (hπ : ∀ h, 0 ≤ π h)
    (hπsum : (∑ h, π h) ≤ 1) :
    (∑ n ∈ wordProfiles H t, (wordCount t n : ℝ) * ∏ h, π h ^ n h) ≤ 1

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.sum_wordProfile
statement:
theorem sum_wordProfile {D : Type*} [Fintype D] (f : D → H) :
    (∑ h, wordProfile f h) = Fintype.card D

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.wordCount_eq_zero_of_not_mem_wordProfiles
statement:
theorem wordCount_eq_zero_of_not_mem_wordProfiles (t : ℕ) (n : H → ℕ)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.wordCount_weight_nonneg

theorem wordCount_weight_nonneg (t : ℕ) (π : H → ℝ) (hπ : ∀ h, 0 ≤ π h)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.one_sub_sum_le_prod_one_sub
statement:
theorem one_sub_sum_le_prod_one_sub {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (c : ι → ℝ) (h0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i) (h1 : ∀ i, c i ≤ 1) :
    1 - ∑ i, c i ≤ ∏ i, (1 - c i)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.prod_one_sub_tupleCoefficient_gt
statement:
theorem prod_one_sub_tupleCoefficient_gt (s : ℕ) :
    (20 / 21 : ℝ) < ∏ i : Fin s, (1 - tupleCoefficient i.val)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.sum_tupleCoefficient_add_remainder
statement:
theorem sum_tupleCoefficient_add_remainder (s : ℕ) :
    (∑ i : Fin s, tupleCoefficient i.val) +
      (1 / 21 : ℝ) * (1 / 64 : ℝ) ^ s = 1 / 21

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.sum_tupleCoefficient_le
statement:
theorem sum_tupleCoefficient_le (s : ℕ) :
    (∑ i : Fin s, tupleCoefficient i.val) ≤ 1 / 21

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.sum_tupleCoefficient_lt
statement:
theorem sum_tupleCoefficient_lt (s : ℕ) :
    (∑ i : Fin s, tupleCoefficient i.val) < 1 / 21

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.tupleCoefficient_eq
statement:
theorem tupleCoefficient_eq (i : ℕ) :
    tupleCoefficient i = (3 / 64 : ℝ) * (1 / 64 : ℝ) ^ i

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.tupleCoefficient_le_first
statement: theorem tupleCoefficient_le_first (i : ℕ) : tupleCoefficient i ≤ 3 / 64

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.tupleCoefficient_lt_one
statement: theorem tupleCoefficient_lt_one (i : ℕ) : tupleCoefficient i < 1

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.tupleCoefficient_nonneg
statement: theorem tupleCoefficient_nonneg (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ tupleCoefficient i

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.tupleCoefficient_pos
statement: theorem tupleCoefficient_pos (i : ℕ) : 0 < tupleCoefficient i

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.changes_filter_castSucc
statement:
theorem changes_filter_castSucc (a z : Coloring α s) (i : Fin s) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.changes_filter_last

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.crossings_eq_of_profile_eq

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.crossings_eq_profileCrossings

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.crossings_le_card_changes

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.mem_groupOriginals
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_groupOriginals {F : Family α} (mu : MassFamily F)
    (a z : Coloring α s) (n : Profile s) :
    a ∈ groupOriginals mu z n ↔ Bad mu a ∧ Selected mu a z ∧ profile a z = n

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.movedRow_card_eq_rowCount

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.movedRow_subset_changes

theorem movedRow_subset_changes (a z : Coloring α s) (i : Fin s) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.profileCrossings_le_profileSize

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.profileSize_profile
statement:
theorem profileSize_profile (a z : Coloring α s) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.profileSize_profile_eq_card_changes
statement:
theorem profileSize_profile_eq_card_changes (a z : Coloring α s) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.profile_eq_zero_of_le

theorem profile_eq_zero_of_le (a z : Coloring α s) (i : Fin s)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.rowCount_le_profileSize

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.rowCount_profile

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.changes_delayColor_subset

theorem changes_delayColor_subset (a z : Coloring α s) (x : α) (i : Fin s)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.crossings_delayColor_of_ne

theorem crossings_delayColor_of_ne (a z : Coloring α s) (x : α) (i j : Fin s)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.crossings_delayColor_self
statement:
theorem crossings_delayColor_self (a z : Coloring α s) (x : α) (i : Fin s)
    (hx : (z x).val = i.val) (hmove : (z x).val < (a x).val) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.delayColor_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem delayColor_apply_of_ne (z : Coloring α s) (x : α) (i : Fin s)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.delayColor_apply_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem delayColor_apply_self (z : Coloring α s) (x : α) (i : Fin s) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.earlier_delayColor
statement:
theorem earlier_delayColor (a z : Coloring α s) (x : α) (i : Fin s)
    (hx : (z x).val = i.val) (hmove : (z x).val < (a x).val)
    (hearlier : Earlier a z) : Earlier a (delayColor z x i)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.movement_delayColor_add_one
statement:
theorem movement_delayColor_add_one (a z : Coloring α s) (x : α) (i : Fin s)
    (hx : (z x).val = i.val) (hmove : (z x).val < (a x).val) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.prefix_delayColor_of_ne
statement:
theorem prefix_delayColor_of_ne (z : Coloring α s) (x : α) (i j : Fin s)
    (hx : (z x).val = i.val) (hji : j ≠ i) :
    prefixSet (delayColor z x i) j = prefixSet z j

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.prefix_delayColor_self
statement:
theorem prefix_delayColor_self (z : Coloring α s) (x : α) (i : Fin s)
    (_hx : (z x).val = i.val) :
    prefixSet (delayColor z x i) i = (prefixSet z i).erase x

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.Admissible.erase_one
statement:
theorem Admissible.erase_one {mu : α → ℝ} {A : Finset α} {m m' d u : ℝ}
    (hu : Admissible mu A m d u) {x : α} (hx : x ∈ A)
    (hxu : mu x ≤ u) (hm : m' + 1 = m) :
    Admissible mu (A.erase x) m' d u

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.feasibleFor_delayColor
statement:
theorem feasibleFor_delayColor {F : Family α} (mu : MassFamily F) {s : ℕ}
    (a z : Coloring α s) (H : ↥F) (hfeasible : FeasibleFor mu a z H)
    (x : α) (i : Fin s) (hx : (z x).val = i.val)
    (hmove : (z x).val < (a x).val) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : Admissible (mu.weight H) (prefixSet z i)
      (crossings a z i : ℝ) (dscale i) ε)
    (hweight : mu.weight H x ≤ ε) :
    FeasibleFor mu a (delayColor z x i) H

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.truncatedExcess_erase
statement:
theorem truncatedExcess_erase (mu : α → ℝ) (A : Finset α) (d u : ℝ)
    (x : α) (hx : x ∈ A) :
    truncatedExcess mu (A.erase x) d u =
      truncatedExcess mu A d u - min (mu x) u

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.selected_movedRow_subset_filter
statement:
theorem selected_movedRow_subset_filter {F : Family α} (mu : MassFamily F)
    {s : ℕ} (a z : Coloring α s) (hselected : Selected mu a z)
    (H : ↥F) (hfeasible : FeasibleFor mu a z H) (i : Fin s) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : Admissible (mu.weight H) (prefixSet z i)
      (crossings a z i : ℝ) (dscale i) ε) :
    movedRow a z i ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun x => ε < mu.weight H x)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.selected_movedRow_subset_heavySet
statement:
theorem selected_movedRow_subset_heavySet {F : Family α} (mu : MassFamily F)
    {s : ℕ} (a z : Coloring α s) (hselected : Selected mu a z)
    (H : ↥F) (hfeasible : FeasibleFor mu a z H) (i : Fin s) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : Admissible (mu.weight H) (prefixSet z i)
      (crossings a z i : ℝ) (dscale i) ε) :
    movedRow a z i ⊆ heavySet (mu.weight H) ε

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.continuous_truncatedExcess
statement:
theorem continuous_truncatedExcess (w : α → ℝ) (A : Finset α) (d : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun u => truncatedExcess w A d u)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.exists_greatest_admissible
statement:
theorem exists_greatest_admissible (w : α → ℝ) (A : Finset α) (m d : ℝ)
    (hne : ∃ u, Admissible w A m d u) :
    ∃ ε, Admissible w A m d ε ∧ ∀ u, Admissible w A m d u → u ≤ ε

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.isClosed_admissible
statement:
theorem isClosed_admissible (w : α → ℝ) (A : Finset α) (m d : ℝ) :
    IsClosed {u : ℝ | Admissible w A m d u}

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.isCompact_admissible
statement:
theorem isCompact_admissible (w : α → ℝ) (A : Finset α) (m d : ℝ) :
    IsCompact {u : ℝ | Admissible w A m d u}

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.exists_short_right_cutoff
statement:
theorem exists_short_right_cutoff (w : α → ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : ε < 1) :
    ∃ u : ℝ, ε < u ∧ u ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ x, ε < w x → u ≤ w x

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.maximal_admissible_card_bound
statement:
theorem maximal_admissible_card_bound (w : α → ℝ) (A : Finset α) (m d ε : ℝ)
    (hwnonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (hwsum : ∑ x, w x = 1)
    (hm0 : 0 ≤ m) (_hd0 : 0 < d) (_hd1 : d < 1)
    (hε : Admissible w A m d ε)
    (hmax : ∀ u : ℝ, Admissible w A m d u → u ≤ ε) :
    d * ((heavySet w ε).card : ℝ) ≤ m

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.truncatedExcess_sub_eq_heavy_increment
statement:
theorem truncatedExcess_sub_eq_heavy_increment (w : α → ℝ) (A : Finset α)
    (d ε u : ℝ) (hεu : ε ≤ u)
    (hupper : ∀ x, ε < w x → u ≤ w x)
    (hheavy : ∀ x, ε < w x → x ∈ A) :
    truncatedExcess w A d u - truncatedExcess w A d ε =
      (u - ε) * d * ((heavySet w ε).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.exists_maximal_truncation
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_truncation (w : α → ℝ) (A : Finset α) (m d : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (hsum : ∑ x, w x = 1)
    (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hd0 : 0 < d) (hd1 : d < 1)
    (hne : ∃ u, Admissible w A m d u) :
    ∃ ε, Admissible w A m d ε ∧
      (∀ u, Admissible w A m d u → u ≤ ε) ∧
      d * ((heavySet w ε).card : ℝ) ≤ m

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.exists_maximal_truncation_div
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_truncation_div (w : α → ℝ) (A : Finset α) (m d : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (hsum : ∑ x, w x = 1)
    (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hd0 : 0 < d) (hd1 : d < 1)
    (hne : ∃ u, Admissible w A m d u) :
    ∃ ε, Admissible w A m d ε ∧
      (∀ u, Admissible w A m d u → u ≤ ε) ∧
      ((heavySet w ε).card : ℝ) ≤ m / d

    (G : Finset (Coloring α s)) (z : Coloring α s) (n : Profile s)

    (hEarlier : ∀ a ∈ G, Earlier a z)
    (hprofile : ∀ a ∈ G, profile a z = n)
    (hrows : ∀ a ∈ G, ∀ i, movedRow a z i ⊆ R i) :

name: OAI.TalagrandThreshold.Selector.half_bad_probability_le_selected_cost
statement:

    (hs : p * scaleSum s ≤ 1 / 2) (hF : ¬ Small p F) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (coloringLaw (α := α) p s hp hs).prob (Bad mu) ≤
      ∑ a : Coloring α s, if Bad mu a then
        colorMass p s a * ∑ z ∈ selectedMoves mu a, p ^ (changes a z).card

theorem hsNormSq_anticommutator (hP : OrthogonalProjectionFamily P)
    (weight : κ → ℝ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    hsNormSq (matrixGrading P weight * B + B * matrixGrading P weight) =

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.hsNormSq_centeredGrading
statement:
theorem hsNormSq_centeredGrading {n : ℕ} {P : Fin (n + 1) → Matrix ι ι ℂ}
    (hP : OrthogonalProjectionFamily P) :
    hsNormSq (centeredGrading P) =
      ∑ k, ((k.val : ℝ) - (n : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 * hsNormSq (P k)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.hsNormSq_centeredGrading_trace

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.hsNormSq_centered_anticommutator

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.binomial_block_coupling_bound
statement:
theorem binomial_block_coupling_bound
    (n d : ℕ) (B : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ r s, 0 ≤ B r s)
    (hrow : ∀ r, (∑ s : Fin (n + 1), B r s) = (n.choose r.val : ℝ))
    (hcol : ∀ s, (∑ r : Fin (n + 1), B r s) = (n.choose s.val : ℝ))
    (hvanish : ∀ r s, r.val + s.val < n - d → B r s = 0) :
    (∑ r : Fin (n + 1), ∑ s : Fin (n + 1),
      ((s.val : ℝ) + (r.val : ℝ) - (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 * B r s) ≤
        4 * (d : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.blockCouplingWeight_fst_marginal
statement:
theorem blockCouplingWeight_fst_marginal {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {P : Fin (n + 1) → Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hP : OrthogonalProjectionFamily P)
    (H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : H.conjTranspose * H = 1)
    (hmult : ∀ k, hsNormSq (P k) = (n.choose k.val : ℝ))
    (r : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (∑ s : Fin (n + 1), blockCouplingWeight P H (r, s)) = binomialWeight n r

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.blockCouplingWeight_nonneg
statement:

    (t : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1)) : 0 ≤ blockCouplingWeight P H t

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.blockCouplingWeight_snd_marginal
statement:
theorem blockCouplingWeight_snd_marginal {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {P : Fin (n + 1) → Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hP : OrthogonalProjectionFamily P)
    (H : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : H * H.conjTranspose = 1)
    (hmult : ∀ k, hsNormSq (P k) = (n.choose k.val : ℝ))
    (s : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (∑ r : Fin (n + 1), blockCouplingWeight P H (r, s)) = binomialWeight n s

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.blockCouplingWeight_support
statement:
theorem blockCouplingWeight_support {n d : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (P : Fin (n + 1) → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (H : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hvanish : ∀ r s, r.val + s.val < n - d → P s * H * P r = 0)
    (r s : Fin (n + 1)) (ht : blockCouplingWeight P H (r, s) ≠ 0) :
    n - d ≤ r.val + s.val

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.hsNormSq_centeredGrading_anticommutator_le
statement:
theorem hsNormSq_centeredGrading_anticommutator_le {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (n d : ℕ) (P : Fin (n + 1) → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hP : OrthogonalProjectionFamily P) (H : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hleft : H.conjTranspose * H = 1) (hright : H * H.conjTranspose = 1)
    (hmult : ∀ k, hsNormSq (P k) = (n.choose k.val : ℝ))
    (hvanish : ∀ r s, r.val + s.val < n - d → P s * H * P r = 0) :
    hsNormSq (centeredGrading P * H + H * centeredGrading P) ≤
      4 * (d : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.hsNormSq_centeredGrading_anticommutator_le_of_trace
statement:
theorem hsNormSq_centeredGrading_anticommutator_le_of_trace {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (n d : ℕ) (P : Fin (n + 1) → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hP : OrthogonalProjectionFamily P) (H : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hleft : H.conjTranspose * H = 1) (hright : H * H.conjTranspose = 1)
    (htrace : ∀ k, (Matrix.trace (P k)).re = (n.choose k.val : ℝ))
    (hvanish : ∀ r s, r.val + s.val < n - d → P s * H * P r = 0) :
    hsNormSq (centeredGrading P * H + H * centeredGrading P) ≤
      4 * (d : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.normalizedPairWeight_column

statement:

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.card_finset_card_le

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.fourierFlag_finrank

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.fourierSpace_finrank

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.abs_mul_thresholdSign
statement: theorem abs_mul_thresholdSign (t : ℝ) : |t| * thresholdSign t = t

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.polynomial_projectionBlock_eq_zero
statement:
theorem polynomial_projectionBlock_eq_zero
    {n d r s : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hp : IsMultilinear p) (hd : p.totalDegree ≤ d)
    (hnz : ∀ x, polynomialValue p x ≠ 0)
    (U V : Submodule ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ (Cube n)))
    (hU : U ≤ weightedFourierSpace (fun x => |polynomialValue p x|)
      (fun x => abs_pos.mpr (hnz x)) r)
    (hV : V ≤ weightedFourierSpace (fun x => |polynomialValue p x|)
      (fun x => abs_pos.mpr (hnz x)) s)
    (hrs : r + s < n - d) :
    V.starProjection *
      signMultiplier (fun x => fullParity x * thresholdSign (polynomialValue p x)) *
        U.starProjection = 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.polynomial_signedWeight
statement:
theorem polynomial_signedWeight {n : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) (x : Cube n) :
    ((|polynomialValue p x| : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ((fullParity x * thresholdSign (polynomialValue p x) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      walshChar Finset.univ x * (polynomialValue p x : ℂ)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.polynomial_sqrtWeight_pairing_eq_zero
statement:
theorem polynomial_sqrtWeight_pairing_eq_zero
    {n d r s : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hp : IsMultilinear p) (hd : p.totalDegree ≤ d)
    (hnz : ∀ x, polynomialValue p x ≠ 0)
    (a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Cube n))
    (ha : WithLp.ofLp a ∈ fourierSpace n r)
    (hb : WithLp.ofLp b ∈ fourierSpace n s) (hrs : r + s < n - d) :
    let D := sqrtWeightEquiv (fun x => |polynomialValue p x|)
      (fun x => abs_pos.mpr (hnz x))
    inner ℂ (D b)
      (signMultiplier (fun x => fullParity x * thresholdSign (polynomialValue p x)) (D a))
        = 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.projectionBlock_eq_zero_of_map_pairing
statement:
theorem projectionBlock_eq_zero_of_map_pairing
    {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
    (A B U V : Submodule 𝕜 E) [U.HasOrthogonalProjection] [V.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (D : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) (H : E →L[𝕜] E)
    (hU : U ≤ A.map D) (hV : V ≤ B.map D)
    (hpair : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, inner 𝕜 (D b) (H (D a)) = 0) :
    V.starProjection * H * U.starProjection = 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.projectionBlock_eq_zero_of_pairing
statement:
theorem projectionBlock_eq_zero_of_pairing
    {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
    (U V : Submodule 𝕜 E) [U.HasOrthogonalProjection] [V.HasOrthogonalProjection]
    (H : E →L[𝕜] E)
    (hpair : ∀ u ∈ U, ∀ v ∈ V, inner 𝕜 v (H u) = 0) :
    V.starProjection * H * U.starProjection = 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.sqrtWeight_inner_eq_sum
statement:
theorem sqrtWeight_inner_eq_sum
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (w h : Ω → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x)
    (D : EuclideanSpace ℂ Ω →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ Ω)
    (hD : ∀ a x, D a x = (Real.sqrt (w x) : ℂ) * a x)
    (H : EuclideanSpace ℂ Ω →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ Ω)
    (hH : ∀ a x, H a x = (h x : ℂ) * a x)
    (a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ Ω) :
    inner ℂ (D b) (H (D a)) =
      ∑ x, star (b x) * a x * ((w x : ℂ) * (h x : ℂ))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.sqrtWeight_inner_eq_sum_signedWeight
statement:
theorem sqrtWeight_inner_eq_sum_signedWeight
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (w h : Ω → ℝ) (q : Ω → ℂ) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x)
    (hwq : ∀ x, (w x : ℂ) * (h x : ℂ) = q x)
    (D : EuclideanSpace ℂ Ω →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ Ω)
    (hD : ∀ a x, D a x = (Real.sqrt (w x) : ℂ) * a x)
    (H : EuclideanSpace ℂ Ω →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ Ω)
    (hH : ∀ a x, H a x = (h x : ℂ) * a x)
    (a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ Ω) :
    inner ℂ (D b) (H (D a)) = ∑ x, star (b x) * a x * q x

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.sqrtWeight_pairing_eq_zero_of_fourier_separation
statement:
theorem sqrtWeight_pairing_eq_zero_of_fourier_separation
    {n r s k : ℕ} (w h : Cube n → ℝ) (q : Cube n → ℂ)
    (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (hwq : ∀ x, (w x : ℂ) * (h x : ℂ) = q x)
    (D : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Cube n) →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Cube n))
    (hD : ∀ a x, D a x = (Real.sqrt (w x) : ℂ) * a x)
    (H : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Cube n) →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Cube n))
    (hH : ∀ a x, H a x = (h x : ℂ) * a x)
    (a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Cube n))
    (ha : WithLp.ofLp a ∈ fourierSpace n r)
    (hb : WithLp.ofLp b ∈ fourierSpace n s)
    (hq : q ∈ fourierSpaceFrom n k) (hrs : r + s < k) :
    inner ℂ (D b) (H (D a)) = 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.weightedFlag_block_eq_zero_of_polynomial_degree
statement:
theorem weightedFlag_block_eq_zero_of_polynomial_degree
    {n d r s : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hp : IsMultilinear p) (hd : p.totalDegree ≤ d)
    (hnz : ∀ x, polynomialValue p x ≠ 0) (hrs : r + s < n - d) :
    let K := weightedFourierFlag (fun x => |polynomialValue p x|)
      (fun x => abs_pos.mpr (hnz x))
    flagProjection K s *
      signMultiplier (fun x => fullParity x * thresholdSign (polynomialValue p x)) *
        flagProjection K r = 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.weightedFlag_matrixBlock_eq_zero_of_polynomial_degree
statement:
theorem weightedFlag_matrixBlock_eq_zero_of_polynomial_degree
    {n d r s : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hp : IsMultilinear p) (hd : p.totalDegree ≤ d)
    (hnz : ∀ x, polynomialValue p x ≠ 0) (hrs : r + s < n - d)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ (Cube n))) :
    let K := weightedFourierFlag (fun x => |polynomialValue p x|)
      (fun x => abs_pos.mpr (hnz x))
    operatorMatrix b (flagProjection K s) *
      operatorMatrix b
        (signMultiplier (fun x => fullParity x * thresholdSign (polynomialValue p x))) *
      operatorMatrix b (flagProjection K r) = 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.weightedProjectionMatrix_block_eq_zero_of_polynomial_degree
statement:
theorem weightedProjectionMatrix_block_eq_zero_of_polynomial_degree
    {n d : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hp : IsMultilinear p) (hd : p.totalDegree ≤ d)
    (hnz : ∀ x, polynomialValue p x ≠ 0)
    (r s : Fin (n + 1)) (hrs : r.val + s.val < n - d) :
    let w := fun x => |polynomialValue p x|
    let hw : ∀ x, 0 < w x := fun x => abs_pos.mpr (hnz x)
    weightedProjectionMatrix w hw s *
      signMatrix (fun x => fullParity x * polynomialThreshold p x) *
        weightedProjectionMatrix w hw r = 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.anticommutator_energy_ge_selected
statement:
theorem anticommutator_energy_ge_selected [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : ι → ι → ℕ) (hzero : ∀ i j, ρ i j = 0 → i = j)
    (M : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (h : ι → ℝ) (hh : ∀ i, h i = 1 ∨ h i = -1)
    (s : Finset (ι × ι))
    (hs : s ⊆ distanceShell (fun p : ι × ι => ρ p.1 p.2) 1)
    (hsign : ∀ p ∈ s, h p.1 = h p.2) :
    4 * ((∑ p ∈ distanceShell (fun p : ι × ι => ρ p.1 p.2) 0,
        ‖M p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) + ∑ p ∈ s, ‖M p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2) ≤
      hsNormSq (M * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) +
        Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) * M)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.anticommutator_entry_sq_of_same_sign

    (i j : ι) (hij : h i = h j) :
    ‖(M * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) +
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) * M) i j‖ ^ 2 =
      4 * ‖M i j‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.edge_recovery
statement:
theorem edge_recovery {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Cube n) (Cube n) ℂ)
    (h : Cube n → ℝ) (hh : ∀ x, h x = 1 ∨ h x = -1)
    (htotal : hsNormSq M = (n : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n / 4)
    (hdistance : (∑ x, ∑ y, (hammingDist x y : ℝ) * ‖M x y‖ ^ 2) ≤ hsNormSq M)
    (hcap : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → ‖M x y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) :
    ((orderedConstantEdges h).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * hsNormSq (M * Matrix.diagonal (fun x => (h x : ℂ)) +
        Matrix.diagonal (fun x => (h x : ℂ)) * M)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.edge_recovery_for_subset
statement:
theorem edge_recovery_for_subset [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : ι → ι → ℕ) (hzero : ∀ i j, ρ i j = 0 → i = j)
    (M : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (h : ι → ℝ) (hh : ∀ i, h i = 1 ∨ h i = -1)
    (s : Finset (ι × ι))
    (hs : s ⊆ distanceShell (fun p : ι × ι => ρ p.1 p.2) 1)
    (hsign : ∀ p ∈ s, h p.1 = h p.2)
    (hcap : ∀ i j, ρ i j = 1 → ‖M i j‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ))
    (htotal : hsNormSq M =
      ((distanceShell (fun p : ι × ι => ρ p.1 p.2) 1).card : ℝ) / 4)
    (henergy : (∑ i, ∑ j, (ρ i j : ℝ) * ‖M i j‖ ^ 2) ≤ hsNormSq M) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * hsNormSq
      (M * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) +
        Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (h i : ℂ)) * M)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.neighbor_deficit_le_twice_zero_mass
statement:
theorem neighbor_deficit_le_twice_zero_mass (d : α → ℕ) (w : α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ a, 0 ≤ w a)
    (htotal : (∑ a, w a) = ((distanceShell d 1).card : ℝ) / 4)
    (henergy : (∑ a, (d a : ℝ) * w a) ≤ ∑ a, w a) :
    (∑ a ∈ distanceShell d 1, ((1 / 4 : ℝ) - w a)) ≤
      2 * (∑ a ∈ distanceShell d 0, w a)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.selected_neighbor_card_le_eight_mass
statement:

    (hw : ∀ a, 0 ≤ w a)
    (hcap : ∀ a ∈ distanceShell d 1, w a ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ))
    (htotal : (∑ a, w a) = ((distanceShell d 1).card : ℝ) / 4)
    (henergy : (∑ a, (d a : ℝ) * w a) ≤ ∑ a, w a) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤ 8 * ((∑ a ∈ distanceShell d 0, w a) + ∑ a ∈ s, w a)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.twice_mass_sub_neighbor_le_distance

name: OAI.LeanBlast.GotsmanLinial.weightedFlag_operatorMatrix_tridiagonal
