name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.expectation_add
statement:
theorem expectation_add (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => f ω + g ω) = μ.expectation f + μ.expectation g

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.expectation_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem expectation_const (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (c : ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun _ => c) = c

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.expectation_mono
statement:
theorem expectation_mono (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {f g : Ω → ℝ} (hfg : ∀ ω, f ω ≤ g ω) :
    μ.expectation f ≤ μ.expectation g

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.expectation_nonneg
statement:
theorem expectation_nonneg (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) :
    0 ≤ μ.expectation f

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.expectation_prod
statement:
theorem expectation_prod (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ) (f : Ω × Γ → ℝ) :
    (μ.prod ν).expectation f = μ.expectation (fun ω => ν.expectation (fun γ => f (ω, γ)))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.expectation_smul
statement:
theorem expectation_smul (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => c * f ω) = c * μ.expectation f

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.expectation_sub
statement:
theorem expectation_sub (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => f ω - g ω) = μ.expectation f - μ.expectation g

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.expectation_sum
statement:
theorem expectation_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun ω => ∑ i, f i ω) = ∑ i, μ.expectation (f i)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.iid_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem iid_weight (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (n : ℕ) (ω : Fin n → Ω) :
    (iid μ n).weight ω = ∏ i, μ.weight (ω i)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.pi_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem pi_weight {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {A : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (A i)]
    (μ : ∀ i, FiniteLaw (A i)) (ω : ∀ i, A i) :
    (pi μ).weight ω = ∏ i, (μ i).weight (ω i)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.prob_compl
statement:
theorem prob_compl (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) :
    μ.prob (fun ω => ¬ P ω) = 1 - μ.prob P

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.prob_eq_expectation
statement:
theorem prob_eq_expectation (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) :
    μ.prob P = μ.expectation (fun ω => if P ω then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.prob_false
statement: @[simp] theorem prob_false (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) : μ.prob (fun _ => False) = 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.prob_ge_le_expectation_div
statement:
theorem prob_ge_le_expectation_div (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    μ.prob (fun ω => t ≤ f ω) ≤ μ.expectation f / t

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.prob_le_expectation
statement:
theorem prob_le_expectation (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) (f : Ω → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ f ω) (hP : ∀ ω, P ω → 1 ≤ f ω) : μ.prob P ≤ μ.expectation f

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.prob_le_one
statement: theorem prob_le_one (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) : μ.prob P ≤ 1

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.prob_mono
statement:
theorem prob_mono (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) {P Q : Ω → Prop} (hPQ : ∀ ω, P ω → Q ω) :
    μ.prob P ≤ μ.prob Q

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.prob_nonneg
statement: theorem prob_nonneg (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P : Ω → Prop) : 0 ≤ μ.prob P

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.prob_true
statement: @[simp] theorem prob_true (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) : μ.prob (fun _ => True) = 1

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.prob_union_le
statement:
theorem prob_union_le (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (P Q : Ω → Prop) :
    μ.prob (fun ω => P ω ∨ Q ω) ≤ μ.prob P + μ.prob Q

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.prod_isPositive
statement:
theorem prod_isPositive (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ)
    (hμ : μ.IsPositive) (hν : ν.IsPositive) : (μ.prod ν).IsPositive

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.prod_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem prod_weight (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ) (ω : Ω) (γ : Γ) :
    (μ.prod ν).weight (ω, γ) = μ.weight ω * ν.weight γ

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.uniform_isPositive
statement:
theorem uniform_isPositive (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] :
    (uniform Ω).IsPositive

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.uniform_prob
statement:
theorem uniform_prob (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (P : Ω → Prop) :
    (uniform Ω).prob P = ((Finset.univ.filter P).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_product
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_product (p : ℝ) (f : X → Bool → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => ∏ x, f x (decide (x ∈ W))) =
      ∏ x, (p * f x true + (1 - p) * f x false)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliLaw_expectation
statement:
@[simp] theorem bernoulliLaw_expectation (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (f : Finset X → ℝ) :
    (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).expectation f = bernoulliExpectation p f

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliLaw_prob
statement:
@[simp] theorem bernoulliLaw_prob (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (P : Finset X → Prop) : (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).prob P = bernoulliProbability p P

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem bernoulliLaw_weight (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (W : Finset X) :
    (bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).weight W = bernoulliWeight p W

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliProbability_eq_expectation
statement:
theorem bernoulliProbability_eq_expectation (p : ℝ) (P : Finset X → Prop) :
    bernoulliProbability p P = bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => if P W then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliProbability_subset
statement:
theorem bernoulliProbability_subset (p : ℝ) (A : Finset X) :
    bernoulliProbability p (fun W => A ⊆ W) = p ^ A.card

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem bernoulliWeight_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (W : Finset X) :
    0 ≤ bernoulliWeight p W

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliWeight_pos
statement:
theorem bernoulliWeight_pos {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (W : Finset X) :
    0 < bernoulliWeight p W

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliWeight_sum
statement: theorem bernoulliWeight_sum (p : ℝ) : ∑ W : Finset X, bernoulliWeight p W = 1

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.subset_indicator_product
statement:
theorem subset_indicator_product (A W : Finset X) :
    (if A ⊆ W then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      ∏ x, (if x ∈ A then (if x ∈ W then (1 : ℝ) else 0) else 1)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.sum_finset_product
statement:
theorem sum_finset_product (f : X → Bool → ℝ) :
    (∑ W : Finset X, ∏ x, f x (decide (x ∈ W))) =
      ∏ x, (f x true + f x false)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.iid_expectation_succ
statement:
theorem iid_expectation_succ (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (n : ℕ)
    (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Ω) → ℝ) :
    (μ.iid (n + 1)).expectation f =
      μ.expectation (fun head => (μ.iid n).expectation (fun tail => f (Fin.cases head tail)))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.FiniteLaw.iid_weight_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem iid_weight_cons (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (n : ℕ) (head : Ω) (tail : Fin n → Ω) :
    (μ.iid (n + 1)).weight (Fin.cases head tail) = μ.weight head * (μ.iid n).weight tail

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.adaptiveFailureCount_expectation_le
statement:
theorem adaptiveFailureCount_expectation_le [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (step : State → Ω → State) (bad : State → Ω → Bool)
    (q : ℝ) (hbad : ∀ state, μ.prob (fun draw => bad state draw = true) ≤ q)
    (n : ℕ) (initial : State) :
    (μ.iid n).expectation (fun draws => (adaptiveFailureCount step bad n initial draws : ℝ)) ≤
      (n : ℝ) * q

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.adaptiveRun_rank_failure_bound
statement:
theorem adaptiveRun_rank_failure_bound (rank : State → ℕ) (step : State → Ω → State)
    (hstep : ∀ state draw, rank (step state draw) ≤ rank state)
    (n : ℕ) (initial : State) (draws : Fin n → Ω)
    (hincomplete : rank (adaptiveRun step n initial draws) ≠ 0) :
    n + rank (adaptiveRun step n initial draws) ≤
      rank initial + adaptiveFailureCount step (rankFailure rank step) n initial draws

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.adaptiveRun_rank_le
statement:
theorem adaptiveRun_rank_le (rank : State → ℕ) (step : State → Ω → State)
    (hstep : ∀ state draw, rank (step state draw) ≤ rank state)
    (n : ℕ) (initial : State) (draws : Fin n → Ω) :
    rank (adaptiveRun step n initial draws) ≤ rank initial

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.adaptive_counter_completion
statement:
theorem adaptive_counter_completion [Fintype Ω] (μ : FiniteLaw Ω)
    (counter : State → ℕ) (step : State → Ω → State)
    (hstep : ∀ state draw, counter state ≤ counter (step state draw))
    (s : ℕ)
    (hprogress : ∀ state, counter state < s →
      (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ μ.prob (fun draw => counter state < counter (step state draw)))
    (initial : State) :
    (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ (μ.iid (4 * s)).prob
      (fun draws => s ≤ counter (adaptiveRun step (4 * s) initial draws))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.adaptive_incomplete_many_failures
statement:
theorem adaptive_incomplete_many_failures (rank : State → ℕ) (step : State → Ω → State)
    (hstep : ∀ state draw, rank (step state draw) ≤ rank state)
    (s : ℕ) (initial : State) (hinitial : rank initial ≤ s)
    (draws : Fin (4 * s) → Ω)
    (hincomplete : rank (adaptiveRun step (4 * s) initial draws) ≠ 0) :
    3 * s + 1 ≤ adaptiveFailureCount step (rankFailure rank step) (4 * s) initial draws

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.adaptive_rank_completion
statement:
theorem adaptive_rank_completion [Fintype Ω] (μ : FiniteLaw Ω)
    (rank : State → ℕ) (step : State → Ω → State)
    (hstep : ∀ state draw, rank (step state draw) ≤ rank state)
    (hprogress : ∀ state, rank state ≠ 0 →
      (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ μ.prob (fun draw => rank (step state draw) < rank state))
    (s : ℕ) (initial : State) (hinitial : rank initial ≤ s) :
    (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ (μ.iid (4 * s)).prob
      (fun draws => rank (adaptiveRun step (4 * s) initial draws) = 0)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.rankFailure_probability_le
statement:
theorem rankFailure_probability_le [Fintype Ω] (μ : FiniteLaw Ω)
    (rank : State → ℕ) (step : State → Ω → State)
    (hprogress : ∀ state, rank state ≠ 0 →
      (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ μ.prob (fun draw => rank (step state draw) < rank state))
    (state : State) :
    μ.prob (fun draw => rankFailure rank step state draw = true) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_add
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_add (p : ℝ) (f g : Finset X → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => f W + g W) =
      bernoulliExpectation p f + bernoulliExpectation p g

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_congr
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_congr (p : ℝ) {f g : Finset X → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ W, f W = g W) : bernoulliExpectation p f = bernoulliExpectation p g

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem bernoulliExpectation_const (p c : ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun _ : Finset X => c) = c

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_mono
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_mono {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    {f g : Finset X → ℝ} (hfg : ∀ W, f W ≤ g W) :
    bernoulliExpectation p f ≤ bernoulliExpectation p g

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_nonneg
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    {f : Finset X → ℝ} (hf : ∀ W, 0 ≤ f W) : 0 ≤ bernoulliExpectation p f

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_pushforward
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_pushforward (p : ℝ) (T : Finset X → Finset X)
    (F : Finset X → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => F (T W)) =
      ∑ Y : Finset X, bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => if T W = Y then 1 else 0) * F Y

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_smul
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_smul (p c : ℝ) (f : Finset X → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => c * f W) = c * bernoulliExpectation p f

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_sum
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p : ℝ)
    (f : ι → Finset X → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => ∑ i, f i W) = ∑ i, bernoulliExpectation p (f i)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_union_fixed
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_union_fixed (p : ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (A : Finset X) (F : Finset X → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => F (W ∪ A)) =
      bernoulliExpectation p (fun Y => if A ⊆ Y then F Y / p ^ A.card else 0)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulli_union_fixed_mass
statement:
theorem bernoulli_union_fixed_mass (p : ℝ) (A Y : Finset X) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => if W ∪ A = Y then 1 else 0) =
      ∏ x, if x ∈ A then (if x ∈ Y then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
        else (if x ∈ Y then p else 1 - p)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulli_union_fixed_mass_div
statement:
theorem bernoulli_union_fixed_mass_div (p : ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (A Y : Finset X) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => if W ∪ A = Y then 1 else 0) =
      (if A ⊆ Y then bernoulliWeight p Y else 0) / p ^ A.card

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulli_union_fixed_mass_mul
statement:
theorem bernoulli_union_fixed_mass_mul (p : ℝ) (A Y : Finset X) :
    p ^ A.card * bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => if W ∪ A = Y then 1 else 0) =
      if A ⊆ Y then bernoulliWeight p Y else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.finset_eq_indicator_product
statement:
theorem finset_eq_indicator_product (U V : Finset X) :
    (if U = V then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      ∏ x, if (x ∈ U ↔ x ∈ V) then (1 : ℝ) else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.card_graphEdges
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_graphEdges (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) :
    (graphEdges G).card = edgeCount G

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.edgeCount_eq_card_edgeFinset
statement:
theorem edgeCount_eq_card_edgeFinset {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [Fintype G.edgeSet] :
    edgeCount G = G.edgeFinset.card

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.edgeCount_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem edgeCount_eq_zero_iff {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    edgeCount G = 0 ↔ G = ⊥

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.edgeCount_graphOfEdges
statement:
@[simp]
theorem edgeCount_graphOfEdges (W : Finset (Edge n)) :
    edgeCount (graphOfEdges W) = W.card

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.edgeSet_graphOfEdges
statement:
theorem edgeSet_graphOfEdges (W : Finset (Edge n)) :
    (graphOfEdges W).edgeSet = Subtype.val '' (W : Set (Edge n))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.edge_smul_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem edge_smul_val (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (e : Edge n) :
    (σ • e).val = Sym2.map σ e.val

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.graphEdges_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem graphEdges_bot : graphEdges (⊥ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) = ∅

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.graphEdges_graphOfEdges
statement:
@[simp]
theorem graphEdges_graphOfEdges (W : Finset (Edge n)) :
    graphEdges (graphOfEdges W) = W

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.graphEdges_map
statement:
theorem graphEdges_map (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) :
    graphEdges (G.map σ.toEmbedding) = σ • graphEdges G

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.graphEdges_mono
statement:
theorem graphEdges_mono {G H : SimpleGraph (Fin n)} (h : G ≤ H) :
    graphEdges G ⊆ graphEdges H

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.graphEdges_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem graphEdges_top : graphEdges (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) = Finset.univ

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.graphOfEdges_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem graphOfEdges_empty : graphOfEdges (∅ : Finset (Edge n)) = ⊥

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.graphOfEdges_graphEdges
statement:
@[simp]
theorem graphOfEdges_graphEdges (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) :
    graphOfEdges (graphEdges G) = G

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.graphOfEdges_le_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem graphOfEdges_le_iff {S T : Finset (Edge n)} :
    graphOfEdges S ≤ graphOfEdges T ↔ S ⊆ T

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.graphOfEdges_mono
statement:
theorem graphOfEdges_mono {S T : Finset (Edge n)} (h : S ⊆ T) :
    graphOfEdges S ≤ graphOfEdges T

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.graphOfEdges_smul
statement:
theorem graphOfEdges_smul (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (W : Finset (Edge n)) :
    graphOfEdges (σ • W) = (graphOfEdges W).map σ.toEmbedding

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.graphOfEdges_univ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem graphOfEdges_univ : graphOfEdges (Finset.univ : Finset (Edge n)) = ⊤

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.mem_edgeSet_graphOfEdges
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_edgeSet_graphOfEdges (W : Finset (Edge n)) (e : Edge n) :
    e.val ∈ (graphOfEdges W).edgeSet ↔ e ∈ W

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.mem_graphEdges
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_graphEdges (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (e : Edge n) :
    e ∈ graphEdges G ↔ e.val ∈ G.edgeSet

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bernoulliExpectation_one (f : Finset X → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation 1 f = f Finset.univ

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bernoulliExpectation_zero (f : Finset X → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation 0 f = f ∅

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliProbability_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bernoulliProbability_one (P : Finset X → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    bernoulliProbability 1 P = if P Finset.univ then 1 else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliProbability_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bernoulliProbability_zero (P : Finset X → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    bernoulliProbability 0 P = if P ∅ then 1 else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliWeight_one
statement:
theorem bernoulliWeight_one (W : Finset X) :
    bernoulliWeight 1 W = if W = Finset.univ then 1 else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliWeight_zero
statement:
theorem bernoulliWeight_zero (W : Finset X) :
    bernoulliWeight 0 W = if W = ∅ then 1 else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.containmentProbability_iso
statement:
theorem containmentProbability_iso {V W : Type*} (n : ℕ) (p : ℝ)
    {H : SimpleGraph V} {F : SimpleGraph W} (e : H ≃g F) :
    containmentProbability n p H = containmentProbability n p F

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.containmentProbability_one
statement:
theorem containmentProbability_one {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (n : ℕ)
    (H : SimpleGraph V) (hcard : Fintype.card V ≤ n) :
    containmentProbability n 1 H = 1

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.containmentProbability_zero
statement:
theorem containmentProbability_zero {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (n : ℕ)
    (H : SimpleGraph V) (he : 1 ≤ edgeCount H) :
    containmentProbability n 0 H = 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.copyCount_bot_of_edge
statement:
theorem copyCount_bot_of_edge {V W : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    (H : SimpleGraph V) (he : 1 ≤ edgeCount H) :
    (⊥ : SimpleGraph W).copyCount H = 0

statement:

      bernoulliExpectation (p + q - p * q) F

      (fun V => if U ∪ V = Y then 1 else 0)) = bernoulliWeight (p + q - p * q) Y

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulli_union_parameter_mem
statement:
theorem bernoulli_union_parameter_mem {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ 1 - (1 - p) ^ n ∧ 1 - (1 - p) ^ n ≤ 1

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulli_union_product
statement:
theorem bernoulli_union_product (p q : ℝ) (f : X → Bool → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun U => bernoulliExpectation q
      (fun V => ∏ x, f x (decide (x ∈ U ∪ V)))) =
      ∏ x, ((p + q - p * q) * f x true + (1 - (p + q - p * q)) * f x false)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.biUnion_fin_cons

statement:
theorem iid_bernoulli_union_expectation (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (n : ℕ) (F : Finset X → ℝ) :
    ((bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).iid n).expectation (fun draws => F (Finset.univ.biUnion draws)) =
      bernoulliExpectation (1 - (1 - p) ^ n) F

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.iid_bernoulli_union_probability

    (n : ℕ) (P : Finset X → Prop) :
    ((bernoulliLaw p hp0 hp1).iid n).prob (fun draws => P (Finset.univ.biUnion draws)) =
      bernoulliProbability (1 - (1 - p) ^ n) P

        if Nonempty (F ≃g K.coe) then (if K.spanningCoe ≤ G then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.exists_graphRepresentationWithConstraints
statement:
theorem exists_graphRepresentationWithConstraints {V : Type*} [Fintype V]

    (hq : ∀ F : H.Subgraph, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ expectedCopies n q F.coe) :
    ∃ E : Finset (Edge n), E.card = edgeCount H ∧
      (∀ W : Finset (Edge n),
        (0 < (graphOfEdges W).copyCount H ↔
          ∃ T ∈ copyOrbit (Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) E, T ⊆ W)) ∧
      (∀ S : Finset (Edge n), S ⊆ E →

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.exists_spread_orbit_tree
statement:
theorem exists_spread_orbit_tree (H : Finset X) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hH : H.Nonempty)
    (hE : ∀ U : Finset X, U ⊆ H → U.Nonempty →
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (orbitCount G U : ℝ) * q ^ U.card) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ → ℕ, ∃ T : ProbabilityTree X k,
      0 < k ∧ T.IsDisjoint ∧ T.HasCapacities m ∧
      T.HasSpread (fun _ => 128 * q) ∧
      (∀ i, i < k → 0 < m i) ∧
      (∀ i, i + 1 < k → 16 * m i ≤ m (i + 1)) ∧
      m (k - 1) ≤ H.card ∧
      ∀ p : T.Path, T.pathUnion p ∈ copyOrbit G H

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.exists_spread_orbit_tree_of_predecessors
statement:
theorem exists_spread_orbit_tree_of_predecessors
    (H : Finset X) (hH : H.Nonempty) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (R : Finset X → Finset X → Prop)
    (hpred : ∀ I, I ⊆ H → I.Nonempty →
      ∃ S, S ⊆ I ∧ 17 * S.card < I.card ∧ R S I)
    (hratio : ∀ I, I ⊆ H → ∀ S, R S I →
      ∀ S0 ∈ copyOrbit G S, ∀ J : Finset X, J.Nonempty → Disjoint S0 J →
        containmentProb G I (S0 ∪ J) / containmentProb G I S0 ≤ σ ^ J.card) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ → ℕ, ∃ T : ProbabilityTree X k,
      0 < k ∧ T.IsDisjoint ∧ T.HasCapacities m ∧ T.HasSpread (fun _ => σ) ∧
      (∀ i, i < k → 0 < m i) ∧
      (∀ i, i + 1 < k → 16 * m i ≤ m (i + 1)) ∧
      m (k - 1) ≤ H.card ∧
      ∀ p : T.Path, T.pathUnion p ∈ copyOrbit G H

theorem extensionLaw_isSpread_of_ratio (I S : Finset X)

    (hratio : ∀ J : Finset X, J.Nonempty → Disjoint S J →

    (hnested : ∀ i, i < d → A i ⊆ A (i + 1))
    (S0 : Finset X) (hS0 : S0 ∈ copyOrbit G (A 0)) :
    (orbitExtensionTree G d A hnested S0 hS0).HasCapacities
      (fun i => (A (i + 1)).card - (A i).card)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.orbitExtensionTree_hasSpread
statement:
theorem orbitExtensionTree_hasSpread (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (d : ℕ) (A : ℕ → Finset X)
    (hnested : ∀ i, i < d → A i ⊆ A (i + 1))
    (hratio : ∀ i, i < d → ∀ S0 ∈ copyOrbit G (A i),
      ∀ J : Finset X, J.Nonempty → Disjoint S0 J →
        containmentProb G (A (i + 1)) (S0 ∪ J) /
          containmentProb G (A (i + 1)) S0 ≤ σ ^ J.card)
    (S0 : Finset X) (hS0 : S0 ∈ copyOrbit G (A 0)) :
    (orbitExtensionTree G d A hnested S0 hS0).HasSpread (fun _ => σ)

theorem resamplingTargetWeight_total (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (W : Finset X) (c : B) :
    (∑ b, resamplingTargetWeight ν A ρ W c b) = 1

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resamplingWeight_congr_fragments
statement:
theorem resamplingWeight_congr_fragments (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    (ρ : ℝ) {W W' : Finset X}
    (hW : ∀ b, resamplingFragment A W b = resamplingFragment A W' b) (cb : B × B) :
    resamplingWeight ν A ρ W cb = resamplingWeight ν A ρ W' cb

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resamplingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_subset
statement:
theorem resamplingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_subset (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    (ρ : ℝ) (W : Finset X) (c b : B) (hb : ¬A b ⊆ resamplingY A W c) :
    resamplingWeight ν A ρ W (c, b) = 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resamplingWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem resamplingWeight_nonneg (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (W : Finset X) (cb : B × B) :
    0 ≤ resamplingWeight ν A ρ W cb

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resamplingWeight_total
statement:
theorem resamplingWeight_total (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (W : Finset X) :
    (∑ cb : B × B, resamplingWeight ν A ρ W cb) = 1

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resamplingZ_nonneg
statement:
theorem resamplingZ_nonneg (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (Y : Finset X) : 0 ≤ resamplingZ ν A ρ Y

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resamplingZ_pos
statement:
theorem resamplingZ_pos (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (W : Finset X) (c : B) :
    0 < resamplingZ ν A ρ (resamplingY A W c)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resampling_expectation_source
statement:
theorem resampling_expectation_source (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (W : Finset X) (f : B → ℝ) :
    (resamplingLaw ν A ρ W hν hρ).expectation (fun cb => f cb.1) = ν.expectation f

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resampling_prob_source
statement:
theorem resampling_prob_source (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (W : Finset X) (P : B → Prop) :
    (resamplingLaw ν A ρ W hν hρ).prob (fun cb => P cb.1) = ν.prob P

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resampling_source_marginal
statement:
theorem resampling_source_marginal (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (W : Finset X) (c : B) :
    (∑ b, resamplingWeight ν A ρ W (c, b)) = ν.weight c

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resampling_target_subset_iff_fragment
statement:
theorem resampling_target_subset_iff_fragment (A : B → Finset X)
    (W : Finset X) (c b : B) :
    A b ⊆ resamplingY A W c ↔ resamplingFragment A W b ⊆ A c

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resampling_target_subset_of_pos
statement:
theorem resampling_target_subset_of_pos (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    (ρ : ℝ) (W : Finset X) (c b : B)
    (hcb : 0 < resamplingWeight ν A ρ W (c, b)) : A b ⊆ resamplingY A W c

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_resamplingZ
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_resamplingZ (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    (ρ : ℝ) (F : Finset X → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun Y => resamplingZ ν A ρ Y * F Y) =
      ∑ c, ν.weight c * bernoulliExpectation ρ
        (fun Y => if A c ⊆ Y then F Y / ρ ^ (A c).card else 0)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_resampling_source
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_resampling_source (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    (ρ : ℝ) (F : Finset X → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun W => ν.expectation (fun c => F (resamplingY A W c))) =
      ∑ c, ν.weight c * bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun W => F (W ∪ A c))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resamplingExperiment_density
statement:
theorem resamplingExperiment_density (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1)
    (F : Finset X → ℝ) :
    (resamplingExperimentLaw ν A ρ hν hρ hρ1).expectation
      (fun ω => F (resamplingY A ω.1 ω.2.1)) =
      bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun Y => resamplingZ ν A ρ Y * F Y)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resamplingExperiment_density_prob
statement:
theorem resamplingExperiment_density_prob (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1)
    (P : Finset X → Prop) :
    (resamplingExperimentLaw ν A ρ hν hρ hρ1).prob
      (fun ω => P (resamplingY A ω.1 ω.2.1)) =
      bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun Y => if P Y then resamplingZ ν A ρ Y else 0)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resamplingExperiment_expectation
statement:
theorem resamplingExperiment_expectation (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1)
    (F : Finset X → B × B → ℝ) :
    (resamplingExperimentLaw ν A ρ hν hρ hρ1).expectation (fun ω => F ω.1 ω.2) =
      bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun W => (resamplingLaw ν A ρ W hν hρ).expectation (F W))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resamplingExperiment_observed_mass
statement:
theorem resamplingExperiment_observed_mass (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) (Y : Finset X) :
    (resamplingExperimentLaw ν A ρ hν hρ hρ1).prob
      (fun ω => resamplingY A ω.1 ω.2.1 = Y) =
      bernoulliWeight ρ Y * resamplingZ ν A ρ Y

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resampling_density
statement:
theorem resampling_density (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (F : Finset X → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun W => (resamplingLaw ν A ρ W hν hρ).expectation
      (fun cb => F (resamplingY A W cb.1))) =
      bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun Y => resamplingZ ν A ρ Y * F Y)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resampling_density_prob
statement:
theorem resampling_density_prob (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (P : Finset X → Prop) :
    bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun W => (resamplingLaw ν A ρ W hν hρ).prob
      (fun cb => P (resamplingY A W cb.1))) =
      bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun Y => if P Y then resamplingZ ν A ρ Y else 0)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resampling_source_density
statement:
theorem resampling_source_density (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) (F : Finset X → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun W => ν.expectation (fun c => F (resamplingY A W c))) =
      bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun Y => resamplingZ ν A ρ Y * F Y)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.localFailure_iff
statement:
theorem localFailure_iff (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X) (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (W : Finset X) (c b : B) :
    LocalFailure ν A ρ m W c b ↔
      resamplingZ ν A ρ (W ∪ A c) < Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ)) ∨
        m / 2 < (A b \ W).card

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.localFailure_iff_twice
statement:
theorem localFailure_iff_twice (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X) (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (W : Finset X) (c b : B) :
    LocalFailure ν A ρ m W c b ↔
      resamplingZ ν A ρ (W ∪ A c) < Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ)) ∨
        m < 2 * (A b \ W).card

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.IsSpread.containment_le
OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.expectation_intersection_eq_sum
statement:
theorem expectation_intersection_eq_sum (μ : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {m : ℕ} {T : Finset X} (hT : T.card ≤ m) (g : ℕ → ℝ) :
    μ.expectation (fun c => g (A c ∩ T).card) =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        μ.prob (fun c => (A c ∩ T).card = r) * g r

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.expectation_intersection_le_binomial
OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.intersection_card_eq_le
OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.intersection_card_ge_le
OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.intersection_card_ge_le_subsets
statement:
theorem intersection_card_ge_le_subsets (μ : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    (T : Finset X) (r : ℕ) :
    μ.prob (fun c => r ≤ (A c ∩ T).card) ≤
      ∑ J ∈ T.powersetCard r, μ.prob (fun c => J ⊆ A c)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.intersection_card_ge_le_target
statement:
theorem intersection_card_ge_le_target {μ : FiniteLaw B} {A : B → Finset X}
    {a : ℝ} (hs : IsSpread μ A a) (T : Finset X) (r : ℕ) :
    μ.prob (fun c => r ≤ (A c ∩ T).card) ≤
      (T.card.choose r : ℝ) * a ^ r

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.intersection_inverse_moment_le
OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.intersection_inverse_sum_le
OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.intersection_inverse_truncated_sum_le
statement:
theorem intersection_inverse_truncated_sum_le
    {μ : FiniteLaw B} {A : B → Finset X} {a : ℝ}
    (hs : IsSpread μ A a) (ha : 0 ≤ a) {m : ℕ}
    {T : Finset X} (hT : T.card ≤ m) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (Q : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred Q] :
    (∑ c, if Q (A c ∩ T).card then μ.weight c * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A c ∩ T).card else 0) ≤
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        if Q r then (m.choose r : ℝ) * (a / ρ) ^ r else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.intersection_moment_le
OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.intersection_truncated_moment_le
statement:
theorem intersection_truncated_moment_le {μ : FiniteLaw B} {A : B → Finset X}
    {a : ℝ} (hs : IsSpread μ A a) (ha : 0 ≤ a) {m : ℕ}
    {T : Finset X} (hT : T.card ≤ m) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (Q : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred Q] :
    μ.expectation (fun c => if Q (A c ∩ T).card then t ^ (A c ∩ T).card else 0) ≤
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        if Q r then (m.choose r : ℝ) * (a * t) ^ r else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.intersection_truncated_sum_le
statement:
theorem intersection_truncated_sum_le {μ : FiniteLaw B} {A : B → Finset X}
    {a : ℝ} (hs : IsSpread μ A a) (ha : 0 ≤ a) {m : ℕ}
    {T : Finset X} (hT : T.card ≤ m) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (Q : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred Q] :
    (∑ c, if Q (A c ∩ T).card then μ.weight c * t ^ (A c ∩ T).card else 0) ≤
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        if Q r then (m.choose r : ℝ) * (a * t) ^ r else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.localFailure_iff_real
statement:
theorem localFailure_iff_real (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (W : Finset X) (c b : B) :
    LocalFailure ν A ρ m W c b ↔
      resamplingZ ν A ρ (resamplingY A W c) < Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ)) ∨
        (m : ℝ) / 2 < ((A b \ W).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.local_failure_bound
statement:
theorem local_failure_bound (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ a : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hsize : ∀ b, (A b).card ≤ m)
    (hspread : IsSpread ν A a) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hratio : a / ρ ≤ Real.exp (-50)) :
    bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun W => (resamplingLaw ν A ρ W hν hρ).prob
      (fun cb => LocalFailure ν A ρ m W cb.1 cb.2)) ≤ Real.exp (-9 * (m : ℝ))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.local_failure_probability_bound
statement:
theorem local_failure_probability_bound (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ a : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hsize : ∀ b, (A b).card ≤ m)
    (hspread : IsSpread ν A a) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hratio : a / ρ ≤ Real.exp (-50)) :
    (resamplingExperimentLaw ν A ρ hν hρ hρ1.le).prob
      (fun ω => LocalFailure ν A ρ m ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2) ≤ Real.exp (-9 * (m : ℝ))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.local_failure_source_form
statement:
theorem local_failure_source_form (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ a : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hsize : ∀ b, (A b).card ≤ m)
    (hspread : IsSpread ν A a) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hratio : a / ρ ≤ Real.exp (-50)) :
    (resamplingExperimentLaw ν A ρ hν hρ hρ1.le).prob
      (fun ω => resamplingZ ν A ρ (resamplingY A ω.1 ω.2.1) <
          Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ)) ∨
        (m : ℝ) / 2 < ((A ω.2.2 \ ω.1).card : ℝ)) ≤ Real.exp (-9 * (m : ℝ))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resampling_large_fragment_bound
statement:
theorem resampling_large_fragment_bound (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ a : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1)
    (m : ℕ) (hsize : ∀ b, (A b).card ≤ m) (hspread : IsSpread ν A a)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hratio : a / ρ ≤ Real.exp (-50)) :
    bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun W => (resamplingLaw ν A ρ W hν hρ).prob
      (fun cb => Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ)) ≤
          resamplingZ ν A ρ (resamplingY A W cb.1) ∧
        m / 2 < (A cb.2 \ W).card)) ≤
      Real.exp (10 * (m : ℝ)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m * Real.exp (-25 * (m : ℝ))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resampling_large_fragment_pair_bound
statement:
theorem resampling_large_fragment_pair_bound (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (m : ℕ) (c b : B) :
    bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun W =>
      if Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ)) ≤ resamplingZ ν A ρ (resamplingY A W c) ∧
          m / 2 < (A b \ W).card then resamplingWeight ν A ρ W (c, b) else 0) ≤
      if m < 2 * (A c ∩ A b).card then
        Real.exp (10 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.weight c * ν.weight b * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A c ∩ A b).card
      else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resampling_large_fragment_term_le
statement:
theorem resampling_large_fragment_term_le (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (m : ℕ) (W : Finset X) (c b : B) :
    (if Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ)) ≤ resamplingZ ν A ρ (resamplingY A W c) ∧
          m / 2 < (A b \ W).card then resamplingWeight ν A ρ W (c, b) else 0) ≤
      if m < 2 * (A c ∩ A b).card ∧ A b \ A c ⊆ W then
        Real.exp (10 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.weight c * ν.weight b * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A b).card
      else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.resampling_small_density_bound
statement:
theorem resampling_small_density_bound (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ τ : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun W => (resamplingLaw ν A ρ W hν hρ).prob
      (fun cb => resamplingZ ν A ρ (resamplingY A W cb.1) < τ)) ≤ τ

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulli_subset_expectation_of_dependsOutside
statement:
theorem bernoulli_subset_expectation_of_dependsOutside
    {p : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (A S : Finset X) (f : Finset X → ℝ)
    (hf : DependsOutside A f) (hSA : S ⊆ A) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => if S ⊆ W then f W else 0) =
      p ^ S.card * bernoulliExpectation p f

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.cutoffTargetMass_mul_eq_expectation
statement:
theorem cutoffTargetMass_mul_eq_expectation (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {p : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hp : 0 < p) (δ : ℝ)
    (W : Finset X) (b : B) (f : Finset X → ℝ) :
    cutoffTargetMass ν A p δ W b * f W =
      (resamplingLaw ν A p W hν hp).expectation
        (fun cb => if cb.2 = b ∧ δ ≤ resamplingZ ν A p (resamplingY A W cb.1)
          then f W else 0)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.cutoffTargetMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem cutoffTargetMass_nonneg (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (δ : ℝ) (W : Finset X) (b : B) :
    0 ≤ cutoffTargetMass ν A p δ W b

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.cutoff_source_weight_le
statement:
theorem cutoff_source_weight_le (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {p δ : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hδ : 0 < δ) (W : Finset X) (c b : B) :
    (if δ ≤ resamplingZ ν A p (resamplingY A W c)
      then resamplingWeight ν A p W (c, b) else 0) ≤
      if A b \ A c ⊆ W then δ⁻¹ * ν.weight c * ν.weight b * (p⁻¹) ^ (A b).card
      else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.dependsOutside_union
statement:
theorem dependsOutside_union {β : Type*} (A S : Finset X) (f : Finset X → β)
    (hf : DependsOutside A f) (hSA : S ⊆ A) (W : Finset X) :
    f (W ∪ S) = f W

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.inv_pow_card_mul_pow_sdiff
statement:
theorem inv_pow_card_mul_pow_sdiff (p : ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (S T : Finset X) :
    (p⁻¹) ^ S.card * p ^ (S \ T).card = (p⁻¹) ^ (T ∩ S).card

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.outside_change_of_measure
statement:
theorem outside_change_of_measure (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {p a : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hs : IsSpread ν A a) (m : ℕ) (b : B) (hAb : (A b).card ≤ m)
    (hsmall : a / p ≤ Real.exp (-50))
    (f : Finset X → ℝ) (hf : ∀ W, 0 ≤ f W) (hloc : DependsOutside (A b) f) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W =>
      cutoffTargetMass ν A p (Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ))) W b * f W) ≤
      Real.exp (11 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.weight b * bernoulliExpectation p f

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.outside_change_of_measure_law
statement:
theorem outside_change_of_measure_law (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    (hν : ν.IsPositive) {p a : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hs : IsSpread ν A a) (m : ℕ) (b : B) (hAb : (A b).card ≤ m)
    (hsmall : a / p ≤ Real.exp (-50))
    (f : Finset X → ℝ) (hf : ∀ W, 0 ≤ f W) (hloc : DependsOutside (A b) f) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W =>
      (resamplingLaw ν A p W hν hp).expectation
        (fun cb => if cb.2 = b ∧ Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ)) ≤
            resamplingZ ν A p (resamplingY A W cb.1) then f W else 0)) ≤
      Real.exp (11 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.weight b * bernoulliExpectation p f

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.outside_change_of_measure_moment
statement:
theorem outside_change_of_measure_moment (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {p δ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (b : B) (f : Finset X → ℝ) (hf : ∀ W, 0 ≤ f W)
    (hloc : DependsOutside (A b) f) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => cutoffTargetMass ν A p δ W b * f W) ≤
      δ⁻¹ * ν.weight b * bernoulliExpectation p f *
        ν.expectation (fun c => (p⁻¹) ^ (A c ∩ A b).card)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.outside_change_of_measure_of_le
statement:
theorem outside_change_of_measure_of_le (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {p a : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hs : IsSpread ν A a) (m : ℕ) (b : B) (hAb : (A b).card ≤ m)
    (hsmall : a / p ≤ Real.exp (-50))
    (f : Finset X → ℝ) (hf : ∀ W, 0 ≤ f W) (hloc : DependsOutside (A b) f)
    (t : Finset X → ℝ)
    (ht : ∀ W, t W ≤ cutoffTargetMass ν A p (Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ))) W b) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => t W * f W) ≤
      Real.exp (11 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.weight b * bernoulliExpectation p f

    (hb : 0 < successfulTargetMass μ A ρ m W b) : (A b \ W).card ≤ m / 2

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bad_probability_le_expected_treePotential
statement:
theorem bad_probability_le_expected_treePotential {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (m : ℕ → ℕ) {d : ℕ} (T : ProbabilityTree X d) :
    bernoulliProbability p (fun W => ¬Good p m W T) ≤
      bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => treePotential p m W T)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_nodePotential
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_nodePotential {X B : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    [Fintype B] (p : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (failure : Finset X → ℝ)
    (target childPotential : B → Finset X → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => nodePotential m (failure W)
      (fun b => target b W) (fun b => childPotential b W)) =
      (bernoulliExpectation p failure +
        ∑ b, bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => target b W * childPotential b W)) /
        Real.exp (-(m : ℝ))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.bernoulliExpectation_nodePotential_le
statement:
theorem bernoulliExpectation_nodePotential_le {X B : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    [Fintype B] (p : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (ν : FiniteLaw B) (failure : Finset X → ℝ)
    (target childPotential : B → Finset X → ℝ)
    (hfailure : bernoulliExpectation p failure ≤ Real.exp (-9 * (m : ℝ)))
    (hchild : ∀ b,
      bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => target b W * childPotential b W) ≤
        Real.exp (11 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.weight b * bernoulliExpectation p (childPotential b)) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => nodePotential m (failure W)
      (fun b => target b W) (fun b => childPotential b W)) ≤
      Real.exp (-8 * (m : ℝ)) + Real.exp (12 * (m : ℝ)) *
        ν.expectation (fun b => bernoulliExpectation p (childPotential b))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.child_treePotential_dependsOutside
statement:
theorem child_treePotential_dependsOutside {d : ℕ} {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (ν : FiniteLaw B) (hν : ν.IsPositive) (A : B → Finset X)
    (child : B → ProbabilityTree X d)
    (hdis : (ProbabilityTree.node B ν hν A child).IsDisjoint)
    (p : ℝ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (b : B) :
    DependsOutside (A b) (fun W => treePotential p m W (child b))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.nodePotential_nonneg
statement:
theorem nodePotential_nonneg {B : Type*} [Fintype B] (m : ℕ) (failure : ℝ)
    (target childPotential : B → ℝ) (hf : 0 ≤ failure)
    (ht : ∀ b, 0 ≤ target b) (hc : ∀ b, 0 ≤ childPotential b) :
    0 ≤ nodePotential m failure target childPotential

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.one_lt_nodePotential_of_bad
statement:
theorem one_lt_nodePotential_of_bad {B : Type*} [Fintype B]
    (m : ℕ) (failure : ℝ) (target childPotential : B → ℝ) (good : B → Prop)
    (ht : ∀ b, 0 ≤ target b) (hc : ∀ b, 0 ≤ childPotential b)
    (hmass : failure + ∑ b, target b = 1)
    (hchild : ∀ b, ¬good b → 1 < childPotential b)
    (hbad : (∑ b, if good b then target b else 0) < 1 - Real.exp (-(m : ℝ))) :
    1 < nodePotential m failure target childPotential

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.one_lt_treePotential_of_not_good
statement:
theorem one_lt_treePotential_of_not_good {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (m : ℕ → ℕ)
    (W : Finset X) {d : ℕ} (T : ProbabilityTree X d) (hbad : ¬Good p m W T) :
    1 < treePotential p m W T

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.potentialEnvelope_eq_sum
statement:
theorem potentialEnvelope_eq_sum (d : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) :
    potentialEnvelope d m =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range d,
        Real.exp (12 * (∑ h ∈ Finset.range j, (m h : ℝ)) - 8 * (m j : ℝ))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.reduction_good_probability_ge
statement:
theorem reduction_good_probability_ge {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (m : ℕ → ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) {d : ℕ} (T : ProbabilityTree X d)
    (hdis : T.IsDisjoint) (hcap : T.HasCapacities m) (hspread : T.HasSpread a)
    (hm : ∀ j, j < d → 1 ≤ m j) (ha : ∀ j, j < d → 0 ≤ a j)
    (hsmall : ∀ j, j < d → a j / p ≤ Real.exp (-50))
    (hgrowth : ∀ j, j + 1 < d → 16 * m j ≤ m (j + 1)) :
    3 / 4 ≤ bernoulliProbability p (fun W => Good p m W T)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.root_bad_probability_lt_one_quarter
statement:
theorem root_bad_probability_lt_one_quarter {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (m : ℕ → ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) {d : ℕ} (T : ProbabilityTree X d)
    (hdis : T.IsDisjoint) (hcap : T.HasCapacities m) (hspread : T.HasSpread a)
    (hm : ∀ j, j < d → 1 ≤ m j) (ha : ∀ j, j < d → 0 ≤ a j)
    (hsmall : ∀ j, j < d → a j / p ≤ Real.exp (-50))
    (hgrowth : ∀ j, j + 1 < d → 16 * m j ≤ m (j + 1)) :
    bernoulliProbability p (fun W => ¬Good p m W T) < 1 / 4

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.successfulTargetMass_le_cutoff
statement:
theorem successfulTargetMass_le_cutoff {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (m : ℕ) (W : Finset X) (b : B) :
    successfulTargetMass ν A p m W b ≤
      cutoffTargetMass ν A p (Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ))) W b

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.treePotential_dependsOnlyOn
statement:
theorem treePotential_dependsOnlyOn (p : ℝ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) {d : ℕ}
    (T : ProbabilityTree X d) : DependsOnlyOn T.support (fun W => treePotential p m W T)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.treePotential_expectation_le
statement:
theorem treePotential_expectation_le {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (m : ℕ → ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) {d : ℕ} (T : ProbabilityTree X d)
    (hdis : T.IsDisjoint) (hcap : T.HasCapacities m) (hspread : T.HasSpread a)
    (hm : ∀ j, j < d → 1 ≤ m j) (ha : ∀ j, j < d → 0 ≤ a j)
    (hsmall : ∀ j, j < d → a j / p ≤ Real.exp (-50)) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => treePotential p m W T) ≤ potentialEnvelope d m

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.treePotential_expectation_node_le
statement:
theorem treePotential_expectation_node_le {d : ℕ} {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (ν : FiniteLaw B) (hν : ν.IsPositive) (A : B → Finset X)
    (child : B → ProbabilityTree X d) (m : ℕ → ℕ)
    {p a : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hspread : IsSpread ν A a) (hm : 1 ≤ m 0)
    (hsize : ∀ b, (A b).card ≤ m 0) (hsmall : a / p ≤ Real.exp (-50))
    (hdis : (ProbabilityTree.node B ν hν A child).IsDisjoint) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => treePotential p m W (ProbabilityTree.node B ν hν A child)) ≤
      Real.exp (-8 * (m 0 : ℝ)) + Real.exp (12 * (m 0 : ℝ)) *
        ν.expectation (fun b => bernoulliExpectation p
          (fun W => treePotential p (fun j => m (j + 1)) W (child b)))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.treePotential_nonneg
statement:
theorem treePotential_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (W : Finset X)
    {d : ℕ} (T : ProbabilityTree X d) : 0 ≤ treePotential p m W T

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.good_retainedMass_pos
statement:
theorem good_retainedMass_pos {d : ℕ} {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (μ : FiniteLaw B) (hμ : μ.IsPositive) (A : B → Finset X)
    (child : B → ProbabilityTree X d) (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (W : Finset X)
    (hm : 0 < m 0) (hg : Good ρ m W (.node B μ hμ A child)) :
    0 < retainedMass (successfulTargetMass μ A ρ (m 0) W)
      (fun b => Good ρ (fun j => m (j + 1)) W (child b))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.one_sub_exp_neg_nat_pos
statement:
theorem one_sub_exp_neg_nat_pos {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    0 < 1 - Real.exp (-(m : ℝ))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.reduceTree_hasCapacities
statement:
theorem reduceTree_hasCapacities (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (W : Finset X) {d : ℕ}
    (T : ProbabilityTree X d) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hm : ∀ j < d, 0 < m j)
    (hg : Good ρ m W T) :
    (reduceTree ρ m W T hρ hm hg).HasCapacities (fun j => m j / 2)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.reduceTree_isDisjoint
statement:
theorem reduceTree_isDisjoint (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (W : Finset X) {d : ℕ}
    (T : ProbabilityTree X d) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hm : ∀ j < d, 0 < m j)
    (hg : Good ρ m W T) (hT : T.IsDisjoint) :
    (reduceTree ρ m W T hρ hm hg).IsDisjoint

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.reduceTree_path_recovery
statement:
theorem reduceTree_path_recovery (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (W : Finset X) {d : ℕ}
    (T : ProbabilityTree X d) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hm : ∀ j < d, 0 < m j)
    (hg : Good ρ m W T) :
    ∀ q : (reduceTree ρ m W T hρ hm hg).Path,
      ∃ p : T.Path, T.pathUnion p ⊆ W ∪ (reduceTree ρ m W T hρ hm hg).pathUnion q

OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.retainedLaw_positive
statement:
theorem retainedLaw_positive (w : B → ℝ) (G : B → Prop) (hw : ∀ b, 0 ≤ w b)
    (hpos : 0 < retainedMass w G) : (retainedLaw w G hw hpos).IsPositive

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.retainedLaw_prob
statement:
theorem retainedLaw_prob (w : B → ℝ) (G Q : B → Prop) (hw : ∀ b, 0 ≤ w b)
    (hpos : 0 < retainedMass w G) :
    (retainedLaw w G hw hpos).prob (fun b => Q b) =
      (∑ b, if G b ∧ Q b then w b else 0) / retainedMass w G

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.sum_retained
statement:
theorem sum_retained (w : B → ℝ) (G : B → Prop) (hw : ∀ b, 0 ≤ w b) (f : B → ℝ) :
    (∑ b : RetainedIndex w G, w b * f b) = ∑ b, if G b then w b * f b else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.sum_retained_indicator
statement:
theorem sum_retained_indicator (w : B → ℝ) (G Q : B → Prop) (hw : ∀ b, 0 ≤ w b) :
    (∑ b : RetainedIndex w G, if Q b then w b else 0) =
      ∑ b, if G b ∧ Q b then w b else 0

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.sum_retained_weights
statement:
theorem sum_retained_weights (w : B → ℝ) (G : B → Prop) (hw : ∀ b, 0 ≤ w b) :
    (∑ b : RetainedIndex w G, w b) = retainedMass w G

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.target_fragment_mass_le_source
statement:
theorem target_fragment_mass_le_source
    (μ : FiniteLaw B) (A F : B → Finset X) (joint : B × B → ℝ)
    (event : B → B → Prop) (G : B → Prop)
    (hjoint : ∀ c b, 0 ≤ joint (c, b))
    (hsource : ∀ c, ∑ b, joint (c, b) = μ.weight c)
    (hfragment : ∀ c b, 0 < joint (c, b) → F b ⊆ A c) (J : Finset X) :
    (∑ b, if G b ∧ J ⊆ F b then ∑ c, if event c b then joint (c, b) else 0 else 0) ≤
      μ.prob (fun c => J ⊆ A c)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.ProbabilityTree.CoverState.accumulate_rank
statement:
@[simp] theorem accumulate_rank (state : CoverState original σ) (W : Finset X) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.ProbabilityTree.CoverState.biUnion_fin_succ
statement:
theorem biUnion_fin_succ {n : ℕ} (draws : Fin (n + 1) → Finset X) :
    Finset.univ.biUnion draws = draws 0 ∪ Finset.univ.biUnion (fun i : Fin n => draws i.succ)

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.ProbabilityTree.CoverState.coveredBy_of_rank_zero
statement:
theorem coveredBy_of_rank_zero (state : CoverState original σ) (h : state.rank = 0) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.ProbabilityTree.CoverState.exists_advance_of_halved
statement:
theorem exists_advance_of_halved (state : CoverState original σ) (W : Finset X)
    (hdepth : state.depth ≠ 0) (U : ProbabilityTree X state.depth)
    (hdisjoint : U.IsDisjoint)
    (hcapacity : U.HasCapacities (fun i => state.capacity i / 2))
    (hspread : U.HasSpread (fun i => capacityReserve σ (state.capacity i / 2)))
    (hrecovery : Recovers state.tree U W) :
    ∃ next, state.Advances W next

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.ProbabilityTree.CoverState.prob_covered_of_advance_probability
statement:
theorem prob_covered_of_advance_probability [Fintype X] (μ : FiniteLaw (Finset X))
    (hprogress : ∀ state : CoverState original σ, state.rank ≠ 0 →
      (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ μ.prob (fun W => ∃ next, state.Advances W next))
    (s : ℕ) (state : CoverState original σ) (hrank : state.rank ≤ s) :
    (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ (μ.iid (4 * s)).prob
      (fun draws => original.CoveredBy (state.seen ∪ Finset.univ.biUnion draws))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.ProbabilityTree.CoverState.rank_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem rank_eq_zero_iff (state : CoverState original σ) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.ProbabilityTree.CoverState.run_seen
statement:
theorem run_seen (n : ℕ) (state : CoverState original σ) (draws : Fin n → Finset X) :
    (adaptiveRun step n state draws).seen = state.seen ∪ Finset.univ.biUnion draws

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.ProbabilityTree.CoverState.step_rank_le
statement:
theorem step_rank_le (state : CoverState original σ) (W : Finset X) :

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.ProbabilityTree.CoverState.step_rank_lt_of_exists
statement:
theorem step_rank_lt_of_exists (state : CoverState original σ) (W : Finset X)
    (h : ∃ next, state.Advances W next) : (state.step W).rank < state.rank

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.ProbabilityTree.CoverState.step_seen
statement:
theorem step_seen (state : CoverState original σ) (W : Finset X) :
    (state.step W).seen = state.seen ∪ W

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.exists_zero_prefix_positive_suffix
statement:
theorem exists_zero_prefix_positive_suffix (m : ℕ → ℕ) (d : ℕ)
    (hmono : MonotoneOn m (Set.Iio d)) :
    ∃ k, k ≤ d ∧ (∀ i, i < k → m i = 0) ∧
      (∀ i, i < d - k → 0 < m (i + k))

name: OAI.LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai.sampling_budget_le
statement:
theorem sampling_budget_le {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (L : ℕ) :
    ((4 * successesNeeded L : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Real.exp 50 * (4 * σ)) ≤
      16 * Real.exp 50 * σ * (1 + Real.logb 2 (L : ℝ))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.card_smallSets_le
statement:
theorem card_smallSets_le {L : Type*} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (r : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card {S : Finset L // S.card ≤ r} ≤ (Fintype.card L+1)^r

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.card_witness_le
statement:
theorem card_witness_le (j : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Witness I H j) ≤
      2^Fintype.card I * (Fintype.card I + Fintype.card H)^j

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.encodeSmallSet_injective
statement:
theorem encodeSmallSet_injective {L : Type*} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (r : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (encodeSmallSet (L := L) r)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.exists_crossing_cut
statement:
theorem exists_crossing_cut (R : I → I → Prop)
    (hsym : ∀ ⦃left right⦄, R left right → R right left) (hirr : ∀ vertex, ¬ R vertex vertex) :
    ∃ c : I → Bool, ∀ i, (∃ j, R i j) → ∃ j, R i j ∧ c i ≠ c j

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.exists_star_forest
statement:
theorem exists_star_forest (R : I → I → Prop) (T : I → H → Prop)
    (hsym : ∀ ⦃left right⦄, R left right → R right left) (hirr : ∀ vertex, ¬ R vertex vertex) :
    ∃ A : Finset I, A ⊆ covered R T ∧ (covered R T).card ≤ 2*A.card ∧
      ∀ i ∈ A, (∃ j, j ∉ A ∧ R i j) ∨ (∃ l, T i l)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.exists_star_system
statement:
theorem exists_star_system (R : I → I → Prop) (T : I → H → Prop)
    (hsym : ∀ ⦃left right⦄, R left right → R right left) (hirr : ∀ vertex, ¬ R vertex vertex) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ ((covered R T).card + 1)/2) :
    ∃ A : Finset I, A.card = j ∧ ∃ p : A → I ⊕ H, starSystem R T A p

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.glue_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem glue_mem (A : Finset I) (x : A → X) (y : {i : I // i ∉ A} → X)
    (i : A) : glue A x y i = x i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.glue_not_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem glue_not_mem (A : Finset I) (x : A → X) (y : {i : I // i ∉ A} → X)
    (i : {i : I // i ∉ A}) : glue A x y i = y i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.heavySet_card_le_floor
statement:
theorem heavySet_card_le_floor (t : L → ℕ) {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) :
    (heavySet t v).card ≤ ⌊(∑ l, (t l : ℝ))/v⌋₊

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.heavySet_card_mul_le
statement:
theorem heavySet_card_mul_le (t : L → ℕ) (v : ℝ) :
    ((heavySet t v).card : ℝ)*v ≤ ∑ l, (t l : ℝ)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.heavy_occupancy_card_le

theorem heavy_occupancy_card_le (line : X → L) (x : I → X) {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) :
    (heavySet (occupancy line x) v).card ≤ ⌊(Fintype.card I : ℝ)/v⌋₊

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.mem_covered
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_covered (R : I → I → Prop) (T : I → H → Prop) (i : I) :
    i ∈ covered R T ↔ (∃ j, R i j) ∨ (∃ l, T i l)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.mem_cutEdges
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_cutEdges (R : I → I → Prop) (c : I → Bool) (i j : I) :
    (i,j) ∈ cutEdges R c ↔ R i j ∧ c i ≠ c j

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.mem_iff_encodeSmallSet
statement:
theorem mem_iff_encodeSmallSet {L : Type*} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (r : ℕ)
    (S : {S : Finset L // S.card ≤ r}) (a : L) :
    a ∈ S.val ↔ ∃ i, encodeSmallSet r S i = some a

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.probability_exists_le
statement:
theorem probability_exists_le {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
    (w : X → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (P : J → (I → X) → Prop) :
    probability w (fun x => ∃ j, P j x) ≤ ∑ j, probability w (P j)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.probability_lineSet_le
statement:
theorem probability_lineSet_le (w : X → ℝ) (line : X → L) (S : Finset L)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : ∀ l, (∑ x, if line x = l then w x else 0) ≤ δ) :
    (∑ x, if line x ∈ S then w x else 0) ≤ (S.card : ℝ)*δ

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.probability_mono
statement:
theorem probability_mono (w : X → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x)
    {P Q : (I → X) → Prop} (hPQ : ∀ x, P x → Q x) :
    probability w P ≤ probability w Q

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.probability_or_le
statement:
theorem probability_or_le (w : X → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (P Q : (I → X) → Prop) :
    probability w (fun x => P x ∨ Q x) ≤ probability w P + probability w Q

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.probability_star_factorization
statement:
theorem probability_star_factorization (A : Finset I) (w : X → ℝ)
    (P : ({i : I // i ∉ A} → X) → A → X → Prop) :
    probability w (fun x : I → X => ∀ i : A, P (fun j => x j) i (x i)) =
      ∑ y : {i : I // i ∉ A} → X,
        (∏ j, w (y j)) * ∏ i : A, ∑ t : X, if P y i t then w t else 0

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.productMass_glue

theorem productMass_glue (A : Finset I) (w : X → ℝ)
    (x : A → X) (y : {i : I // i ∉ A} → X) :
    productMass w (glue A x y) = (∏ i, w (x i)) * ∏ j, w (y j)

theorem sharingCoverage_witness (S : X → X → Prop)
    (hSsym : ∀ ⦃left right⦄, S left right → S right left)
    (holes : H → X) (x : I → X) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : n ≤ (sharingCoverage S holes x).card) :
    ∃ W : Witness I H ((n+1)/2), starEvent S holes W.1.val W.2 x

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Coverage.starEvent_iff_root
statement:
theorem starEvent_iff_root (S : X → X → Prop) (holes : H → X)
    (A : Finset I) (p : A → I ⊕ H) (x : I → X) :
    starEvent S holes A p x ↔
      ∀ i : A, rootPredicate S holes A p (fun j => x j) i (x i)

      ∑ l ∈ S, ∑ x, if line x = l then w x else 0

    (hone : ∀ n A B, I ⊆ A → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ Y →
      (∃ e, B ⊆ insert e A) → f n B ≤ f n A + 1)
    (hlow : ∀ Z, I ⊆ Z → Z ⊆ Y → (Z \ I).Finite →
      ∀ j, ∃ n ≥ j, f n Z < 0)
    (hIX : I ⊆ X) (hXY : X ⊆ Y) (j : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ Z, I ⊆ Z ∧ Z ⊆ X ∧ (X \ Z).Finite ∧

    (hmono : ∀ n A B, I ⊆ A → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ Y → f n A ≤ f n B)
    (hone : ∀ n A B, I ⊆ A → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ Y →

    (hlow : ∀ Z, I ⊆ Z → Z ⊆ Y → (Z \ I).Finite →

    {I : Type uI} {J : Type uJ} {T : Type uT} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (B : I → J → Bool) (rowMode : I → Option T) (colMode : J → Option T)
    (dummyCol : J → Prop) (core : Finset I)
    (hcore : 6 ≤ core.card)
    (core_anchor : ∀ i ∈ core, ∃ t, rowMode i = some t)
    (core_zeros : ∀ j, (core.filter fun i => B i j = false).card ≤ 1)
    (variable_sparse : ∀ j, colMode j = none → ¬ dummyCol j →
      (core.filter fun i => B i j = true).card ≤ 4)
    (dummy_unique : ∀ j k, dummyCol j → dummyCol k → j = k)
    (cross_mode : ∀ i j t u, rowMode i = some t → colMode j = some u →
      B i j = true → t = u)
    (nonanchor_row_unit : ∀ i, rowMode i = none → ∀ j k t,
      colMode j = some t → colMode k = some t →
      B i j = true → B i k = true → j = k)
    (nonanchor_col_unit : ∀ j, colMode j = none → ∀ i k t,
      rowMode i = some t → rowMode k = some t →
      B i j = true → B k j = true → i = k)
    (row_dense : ∀ i, 2 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun j => B i j = true).card) :
    ∃ t, (∀ i, rowMode i = some t) ∧ (∀ j, colMode j = some t)

    {I : Type uI} {J : Type uJ} {T : Type uT} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]

    (dummyRow : I → Prop) (dummyCol : J → Prop)
    (hcore : DenseAnchorCore B rowMode colMode dummyCol ∨
      DenseAnchorCore (fun j i => B i j) colMode rowMode dummyRow)
    (dummy_row_unique : ∀ i k, dummyRow i → dummyRow k → i = k)
    (dummy_col_unique : ∀ j k, dummyCol j → dummyCol k → j = k)
    (cross_mode : ∀ i j t u, rowMode i = some t → colMode j = some u →
      B i j = true → t = u)
    (nonanchor_row_unit : ∀ i, rowMode i = none → ∀ j k t,
      colMode j = some t → colMode k = some t →
      B i j = true → B i k = true → j = k)
    (nonanchor_col_unit : ∀ j, colMode j = none → ∀ i k t,
      rowMode i = some t → rowMode k = some t →
      B i j = true → B k j = true → i = k)
    (row_dense : ∀ i, 2 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun j => B i j = true).card)
    (col_dense : ∀ j, 2 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun i => B i j = true).card) :
    ∃ t, (∀ i, rowMode i = some t) ∧ (∀ j, colMode j = some t)

      (∀ i ∈ firstCore, ∃ t, rowMode i = some t) →
      (firstCore.filter fun i => anchor64 i j = true).card ≤ 4)
    (variable_row_sparse : ∀ i, rowMode i = none → ¬ dummyRow i →
      (∀ j ∈ firstCore, ∃ t, colMode j = some t) →
      (firstCore.filter fun j => anchor64 i j = true).card ≤ 4)
    (dummy_row_unique : ∀ i k, dummyRow i → dummyRow k → i = k)
    (dummy_col_unique : ∀ j k, dummyCol j → dummyCol k → j = k)
    (cross_mode : ∀ i j t u, rowMode i = some t → colMode j = some u →
      anchor64 i j = true → t = u)
    (nonanchor_row_unit : ∀ i, rowMode i = none → ∀ j k t,
      colMode j = some t → colMode k = some t →
      anchor64 i j = true → anchor64 i k = true → j = k)
    (nonanchor_col_unit : ∀ j, colMode j = none → ∀ i k t,
      rowMode i = some t → rowMode k = some t →
      anchor64 i j = true → anchor64 k j = true → i = k) :
    ∃ t, (∀ i, rowMode i = some t) ∧ (∀ j, colMode j = some t)

name: OAI.Problem348.DirectNonshattering.class_injective_of_surjective
statement:

    {R : Type uR} {C : Type uC} {K : Type uK} [DecidableEq C] [LinearOrder K]
    {L : Type uL} (classOf : C → L) (key : C → K) (A : R → C → Bool)
    (hmono : ∀ r i j, classOf i = classOf j → key i ≤ key j →
      A r i = true → A r j = true)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective A) : Function.Injective classOf

name: OAI.Problem348.DirectNonshattering.exists_missing_word
statement:
theorem exists_missing_word
    {R : Type uR} {L : Type uL} {K : Type uK} [DecidableEq L] [LinearOrder K]
    (classOf : Fin 5 → L) (key : Fin 5 → K) (A : R → Fin 5 → Bool)
    (hmono : ∀ r i j, classOf i = classOf j → key i ≤ key j →
      A r i = true → A r j = true)
    (hsupport : ∀ r,
      ((univ.filter (fun i => A r i = true)).image classOf).card ≤ 3 ∨
      (∀ i, A r i = true)) :
    ∃ w : Fin 5 → Bool, ∀ r, A r ≠ w

name: OAI.Problem348.DirectNonshattering.exists_missing_word_pointwise
statement:
theorem exists_missing_word_pointwise {ρ : Type uRho} {β : Type uBeta} [DecidableEq β] (k : ℕ)
    (cls : Fin (k + 2) → β) (key : Fin (k + 2) → ℕ)
    (trace : ρ → Fin (k + 2) → Bool)
    (hup : ∀ r a b, cls a = cls b → key a ≤ key b →
      trace r a = true → trace r b = true)
    (hsupport : ∀ r, (∀ j, trace r j = true) ∨
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => trace r j = true)).image cls).card ≤ k) :
    ∃ word : Fin (k + 2) → Bool, ∀ r, ∃ j, trace r j ≠ word j

name: OAI.Problem348.DirectNonshattering.exists_missing_word_with_zero
statement:
theorem exists_missing_word_with_zero {ρ : Type uRho} {β : Type uBeta} [DecidableEq β] (k : ℕ)
    (cls : Fin (k + 2) → β) (key : Fin (k + 2) → ℕ)
    (trace : ρ → Fin (k + 2) → Bool)
    (hup : ∀ r a b, cls a = cls b → key a ≤ key b →
      trace r a = true → trace r b = true)
    (hsupport : ∀ r, (∀ j, trace r j = true) ∨
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => trace r j = true)).image cls).card ≤ k) :
    ∃ word : Fin (k + 2) → Bool,
      (∃ j, word j = false) ∧ ∀ r, trace r ≠ word

name: OAI.Problem348.DirectNonshattering.matrix_missing_word
statement:
theorem matrix_missing_word {R : Type uR} {C : Type uC} {β : Type uBeta} [DecidableEq β] (k : ℕ)
    (A : R → C → Bool) (cols : Fin (k + 2) → C)
    (cls : C → β) (key : C → ℕ) (dummyRow : R → Prop) (dummyCol : C → Prop)
    (hdummyRow : ∀ r, dummyRow r → ∀ c, A r c = true)
    (hdummyCol : ∀ c, dummyCol c → ∀ r, A r c = true)
    (hup : ∀ r, ¬ dummyRow r → ∀ a b,
      ¬ dummyCol a → ¬ dummyCol b → cls a = cls b → key a ≤ key b →
      A r a = true → A r b = true)
    (hsupport : ∀ r, ¬ dummyRow r →
      (∀ j, ¬ dummyCol (cols j)) →
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => A r (cols j) = true)).image
        (cls ∘ cols)).card ≤ k) :
    ∃ word : Fin (k + 2) → Bool, ∀ r, ∃ j, A r (cols j) ≠ word j

name: OAI.Problem348.DirectNonshattering.matrix_missing_word_of_class_cover
statement:
theorem matrix_missing_word_of_class_cover {R : Type uR} {C : Type uC} {β : Type uBeta} [DecidableEq β] (k : ℕ)
    (A : R → C → Bool) (cols : Fin (k + 2) → C)
    (cls : C → β) (key : C → ℕ) (dummyRow : R → Prop) (dummyCol : C → Prop)
    (hdummyRow : ∀ r, dummyRow r → ∀ c, A r c = true)
    (hdummyCol : ∀ c, dummyCol c → ∀ r, A r c = true)
    (hup : ∀ r, ¬ dummyRow r → ∀ a b,
      ¬ dummyCol a → ¬ dummyCol b → cls a = cls b → key a ≤ key b →
      A r a = true → A r b = true)
    (hcover : ∀ r, ¬ dummyRow r → ∃ S : Finset β, S.card ≤ k ∧
      ∀ c, ¬ dummyCol c → A r c = true → cls c ∈ S) :
    ∃ word : Fin (k + 2) → Bool, ∀ r, ∃ j, A r (cols j) ≠ word j

name: OAI.Problem348.DirectNonshattering.not_surjective_five

      A r i = true → A r j = true)

    {R : Type uR} {C : Type uC} {L : Type uL} {K : Type uK} [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C] [DecidableEq L]
    [LinearOrder K]
    (A : R → C → Bool) (dummyRow : R → Prop) (dummyColumn : C → Prop)
    [DecidablePred dummyColumn]
    (classOf : C → L) (key : C → K)
    (hrow : ∀ r, dummyRow r → ∀ c, A r c = true)
    (hcolumn : ∀ c, dummyColumn c → ∀ r, A r c = true)
    (hmono : ∀ r, ¬ dummyRow r → ∀ c d,
      ¬ dummyColumn c → ¬ dummyColumn d → classOf c = classOf d →
      key c ≤ key d → A r c = true → A r d = true)
    (hsupport : ∀ r, ¬ dummyRow r →
      ((univ.filter (fun c => ¬ dummyColumn c ∧ A r c = true)).image classOf).card ≤ 3)

    (col_initial : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → modeLabel (c j) ≠ none → modeLabel (c i) ≠ none)
