    (hcs : ColumnSparse r c) (hrs : RowSparse r c)
    (hrow : GroupsMonotone r) (hcol : GroupsMonotone c) :
    ∃ (t : Mode h) (a b : Fin 64 → Fin (2 ^ h)),
      (∀ i, r i = Sum.inl (t, i, a i)) ∧
      (∀ j, c j = Sum.inl (t, j, b j))

name: OAI.Problem348.HostAnchorRigidity.selected_columns_injective
statement:
theorem selected_columns_injective {h : ℕ} (r c : Fin 64 → Position h)
    (hcopy : ∀ i j, host (r i) (c j) = anchor64 i j) : Function.Injective c

name: OAI.Problem348.HostAnchorRigidity.selected_rows_injective
statement:
theorem selected_rows_injective {h : ℕ} (r c : Fin 64 → Position h)
    (hcopy : ∀ i j, host (r i) (c j) = anchor64 i j) : Function.Injective r

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.AnchorGroups.column_representatives
statement:
theorem column_representatives {h : ℕ} {K : Type uK} [LinearOrder K]
    (key : Position h → K) (r c : Fin 64 → Position h) (t : Mode h)
    (hc : StrictMono (fun j => key (c j)))
    (hcopy : ∀ i j, host (r i) (c j) = anchor64 i j)
    (hmode : ∀ j, ∃ v y, c j = Sum.inl (t, v, y))
    (horder : ∀ u v : Fin 64, ∀ x y : Fin (2 ^ h),
      key (Sum.inl (t,u,x)) < key (Sum.inl (t,v,y)) → u ≤ v) :
    ∃ y : Fin 64 → Fin (2 ^ h), ∀ j, c j = Sum.inl (t,j,y j)

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.AnchorGroups.representatives
statement:
theorem representatives {h : ℕ} {KR : Type uKR} {KC : Type uKC}
    [LinearOrder KR] [LinearOrder KC]
    (rowKey : Position h → KR) (colKey : Position h → KC)
    (r c : Fin 64 → Position h) (t : Mode h)
    (hr : StrictMono (fun i => rowKey (r i)))
    (hc : StrictMono (fun j => colKey (c j)))
    (hcopy : ∀ i j, host (r i) (c j) = anchor64 i j)
    (hrowmode : ∀ i, ∃ u x, r i = Sum.inl (t,u,x))
    (hcolmode : ∀ j, ∃ v y, c j = Sum.inl (t,v,y))
    (hroworder : ∀ u v : Fin 64, ∀ x y : Fin (2 ^ h),
      rowKey (Sum.inl (t,u,x)) < rowKey (Sum.inl (t,v,y)) → u ≤ v)
    (hcolorder : ∀ u v : Fin 64, ∀ x y : Fin (2 ^ h),
      colKey (Sum.inl (t,u,x)) < colKey (Sum.inl (t,v,y)) → u ≤ v) :
    ∃ x y : Fin 64 → Fin (2 ^ h),
      (∀ i, r i = Sum.inl (t,i,x i)) ∧ (∀ j, c j = Sum.inl (t,j,y j))

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.AnchorGroups.row_representatives
statement:
theorem row_representatives {h : ℕ} {K : Type uK} [LinearOrder K]
    (key : Position h → K) (r c : Fin 64 → Position h) (t : Mode h)
    (hr : StrictMono (fun i => key (r i)))
    (hcopy : ∀ i j, host (r i) (c j) = anchor64 i j)
    (hmode : ∀ i, ∃ u x, r i = Sum.inl (t, u, x))
    (horder : ∀ u v : Fin 64, ∀ x y : Fin (2 ^ h),
      key (Sum.inl (t,u,x)) < key (Sum.inl (t,v,y)) → u ≤ v) :
    ∃ x : Fin 64 → Fin (2 ^ h), ∀ i, r i = Sum.inl (t,i,x i)

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.card_variablePosition
statement:
@[simp] theorem card_variablePosition (h : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (VariablePosition h) = (2 * h + 1) * 2 ^ h

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.columnKey_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem columnKey_leaf (h : ℕ) (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    columnKey h (plusPos h le_rfl x) = leafKey h x.val

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.columnKey_minus_internal
statement:
theorem columnKey_minus_internal {h i : ℕ} (hi : i < h) (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    columnKey h (minusPos i (Nat.le_of_lt hi) x) =
      lateKey (h - i) (2 ^ (h - i)) (node i x) (2 * i + 1) x.val

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.columnKey_plus_internal
statement:
theorem columnKey_plus_internal {h i : ℕ} (hi : i < h) (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    columnKey h (plusPos i (Nat.le_of_lt hi) x) =
      earlyKey i (2 ^ (h - i)) (node i x) (2 * i) x.val

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.column_minus_child_lt_parent
statement:
theorem column_minus_child_lt_parent {h i : ℕ} (hi : i < h)
    (x y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    columnKey h (minusPos (i + 1) (by omega) x) <
        columnKey h (minusPos i (Nat.le_of_lt hi) y) ↔
      node (i + 1) x / 2 ≤ node i y

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.column_plus_parent_lt_child
statement:
theorem column_plus_parent_lt_child {h i : ℕ} (hi : i < h)
    (x y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    columnKey h (plusPos i (Nat.le_of_lt hi) y) <
        columnKey h (plusPos (i + 1) (by omega) x) ↔
      node i y ≤ node (i + 1) x / 2

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.earlyKey_parent_lt_child
statement:
theorem earlyKey_parent_lt_child (b i p a cls₁ cls₂ x y : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    earlyKey i (2 * b) a cls₁ x < earlyKey (i + 1) b p cls₂ y ↔ a ≤ p / 2

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.earlyKey_parent_lt_leafKey
statement:
theorem earlyKey_parent_lt_leafKey (h i p a cls x : ℕ) :
    earlyKey i 2 a cls x < leafKey h p ↔ a ≤ p / 2

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.keyClass_key
statement: @[simp] theorem keyClass_key (a b c d e : ℕ) : keyClass (key a b c d e) = d

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.keyClass_orderKey
statement:
@[simp] theorem keyClass_orderKey (column : Bool) (h : ℕ) (p : VariablePosition h) :
    keyClass (orderKey column h p) = p.1.val

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.keyCoordinate_key
statement:
@[simp] theorem keyCoordinate_key (a b c d e : ℕ) :
    keyCoordinate (key a b c d e) = e

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.keyCoordinate_orderKey
statement:
@[simp] theorem keyCoordinate_orderKey (column : Bool) (h : ℕ)
    (p : VariablePosition h) : keyCoordinate (orderKey column h p) = p.2.val

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.key_lt_iff_endpoint_le_of_tie_lt
statement:
theorem key_lt_iff_endpoint_le_of_tie_lt
    (a b phase t u cls₁ cls₂ x y : ℕ) (htu : t < u) :
    key a phase t cls₁ x < key b phase u cls₂ y ↔ a ≤ b

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.lateKey_child_lt_parent
statement:
theorem lateKey_child_lt_parent (b r p a cls₁ cls₂ x y : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    lateKey r b p cls₁ x < lateKey (r + 1) (2 * b) a cls₂ y ↔ p / 2 ≤ a

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.leafKey_lt_lateKey_parent
statement:
theorem leafKey_lt_lateKey_parent (h r p a cls y : ℕ) :
    leafKey h p < lateKey r 2 a cls y ↔ p / 2 ≤ a

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.minusPos_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem minusPos_leaf (h : ℕ) (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    minusPos h le_rfl x = plusPos h le_rfl x

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.orderKey_injective
statement:
theorem orderKey_injective (column : Bool) (h : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (orderKey column h)

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.orderKey_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem orderKey_leaf (column : Bool) (h : ℕ) (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    orderKey column h (plusPos h le_rfl x) = leafKey h x.val

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.rowKey_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowKey_leaf (h : ℕ) (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    rowKey h (plusPos h le_rfl x) = leafKey h x.val

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.rowKey_minus_internal
statement:
theorem rowKey_minus_internal {h i : ℕ} (hi : i < h) (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    rowKey h (minusPos i (Nat.le_of_lt hi) x) =
      earlyKey i (2 ^ (h - i)) (node i x) (2 * i + 1) x.val

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.rowKey_plus_internal
statement:
theorem rowKey_plus_internal {h i : ℕ} (hi : i < h) (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    rowKey h (plusPos i (Nat.le_of_lt hi) x) =
      lateKey (h - i) (2 ^ (h - i)) (node i x) (2 * i) x.val

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.row_minus_parent_lt_child
statement:
theorem row_minus_parent_lt_child {h i : ℕ} (hi : i < h)
    (x y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    rowKey h (minusPos i (Nat.le_of_lt hi) y) <
        rowKey h (minusPos (i + 1) (by omega) x) ↔
      node i y ≤ node (i + 1) x / 2

name: OAI.Problem348.TreePositions.row_plus_child_lt_parent
statement:
theorem row_plus_child_lt_parent {h i : ℕ} (hi : i < h)
    (x y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    rowKey h (plusPos (i + 1) (by omega) x) <
        rowKey h (plusPos i (Nat.le_of_lt hi) y) ↔
      node (i + 1) x / 2 ≤ node i y

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.columnIndex_lt_iff
statement:
theorem columnIndex_lt_iff (h : ℕ) (r s : Position h) :
    columnIndex h r < columnIndex h s ↔ @LT.lt _ (columnOrder h).toLT r s

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.columnIndex_variable_lt_iff
statement:
theorem columnIndex_variable_lt_iff {h : ℕ} (v w : VariablePosition h) :
    columnIndex h (Sum.inr (Sum.inl v)) < columnIndex h (Sum.inr (Sum.inl w)) ↔
      TreePositions.columnKey h v < TreePositions.columnKey h w

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.column_anchor_initial
OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.column_anchor_lt_nonanchor
statement:
theorem column_anchor_lt_nonanchor {h : ℕ} (t : Mode h) (u : Fin 64)
    (a : Fin (2 ^ h)) (x : VariablePosition h ⊕ Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    columnIndex h (Sum.inl (t, u, a)) < columnIndex h (Sum.inr x)

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.column_anchor_strictMono
statement:
theorem column_anchor_strictMono {h : ℕ} (t : Mode h)
    (a : Fin 64 → Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    StrictMono (fun u => columnIndex h (Sum.inl (t, u, a u)))

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.column_dummy_lt_variable
statement:
theorem column_dummy_lt_variable {h : ℕ} (v : VariablePosition h) (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    columnIndex h (Sum.inr (Sum.inr x)) < columnIndex h (Sum.inr (Sum.inl v))

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.column_minus_child_lt_parent
statement:
theorem column_minus_child_lt_parent {h i : ℕ} (hi : i < h) (x y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    columnIndex h (.inr (.inl (TreePositions.minusPos (i + 1) (by omega) x))) <
      columnIndex h (.inr (.inl (TreePositions.minusPos i (by omega) y))) ↔
      TreePositions.node (i + 1) x / 2 ≤ TreePositions.node i y

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.column_plus_parent_lt_child
statement:
theorem column_plus_parent_lt_child {h i : ℕ} (hi : i < h) (x y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    columnIndex h (.inr (.inl (TreePositions.plusPos i (by omega) y))) <
      columnIndex h (.inr (.inl (TreePositions.plusPos (i + 1) (by omega) x))) ↔
      TreePositions.node i y ≤ TreePositions.node (i + 1) x / 2

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.rowIndex_lt_iff
statement:
theorem rowIndex_lt_iff (h : ℕ) (r s : Position h) :
    rowIndex h r < rowIndex h s ↔ @LT.lt _ (rowOrder h).toLT r s

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.rowIndex_variable_lt_iff
statement:
theorem rowIndex_variable_lt_iff {h : ℕ} (v w : VariablePosition h) :
    rowIndex h (Sum.inr (Sum.inl v)) < rowIndex h (Sum.inr (Sum.inl w)) ↔
      TreePositions.rowKey h v < TreePositions.rowKey h w

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.row_anchor_initial
OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.row_anchor_lt_nonanchor
statement:
theorem row_anchor_lt_nonanchor {h : ℕ} (t : Mode h) (u : Fin 64)
    (a : Fin (2 ^ h)) (x : VariablePosition h ⊕ Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    rowIndex h (Sum.inl (t, u, a)) < rowIndex h (Sum.inr x)

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.row_anchor_strictMono
statement:
theorem row_anchor_strictMono {h : ℕ} (t : Mode h)
    (a : Fin 64 → Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    StrictMono (fun u => rowIndex h (Sum.inl (t, u, a u)))

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.row_minus_parent_lt_child
statement:
theorem row_minus_parent_lt_child {h i : ℕ} (hi : i < h) (x y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    rowIndex h (.inr (.inl (TreePositions.minusPos i (by omega) y))) <
      rowIndex h (.inr (.inl (TreePositions.minusPos (i + 1) (by omega) x))) ↔
      TreePositions.node i y ≤ TreePositions.node (i + 1) x / 2

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.row_plus_child_lt_parent
statement:
theorem row_plus_child_lt_parent {h i : ℕ} (hi : i < h) (x y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    rowIndex h (.inr (.inl (TreePositions.plusPos (i + 1) (by omega) x))) <
      rowIndex h (.inr (.inl (TreePositions.plusPos i (by omega) y))) ↔
      TreePositions.node (i + 1) x / 2 ≤ TreePositions.node i y

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.row_variable_lt_dummy
statement:
theorem row_variable_lt_dummy {h : ℕ} (v : VariablePosition h) (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    rowIndex h (Sum.inr (Sum.inl v)) < rowIndex h (Sum.inr (Sum.inr x))

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.anchor_representatives_of_one_mode
statement:
theorem anchor_representatives_of_one_mode {h : ℕ}
    (r c : Fin 64 → Position h) (t : Mode h)
    (hr : StrictMono (fun i => rowIndex h (r i)))
    (hc : StrictMono (fun j => columnIndex h (c j)))
    (hcopy : ∀ i j, host (r i) (c j) = anchor64 i j)
    (hrowmode : ∀ i, ∃ u x, r i = Sum.inl (t,u,x))
    (hcolmode : ∀ j, ∃ v y, c j = Sum.inl (t,v,y)) :
    ∃ x y : Fin 64 → Fin (2 ^ h),
      (∀ i, r i = Sum.inl (t,i,x i)) ∧ (∀ j, c j = Sum.inl (t,j,y j))

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.column_anchor_group_le
statement:
theorem column_anchor_group_le {h : ℕ} (t : Mode h) (u v : Fin 64)
    (x y : Fin (2 ^ h))
    (hxy : columnIndex h (Sum.inl (t,u,x)) < columnIndex h (Sum.inl (t,v,y))) :
    u ≤ v

name: OAI.Problem348.OrderedHost.row_anchor_group_le
statement:
theorem row_anchor_group_le {h : ℕ} (t : Mode h) (u v : Fin 64)
    (x y : Fin (2 ^ h))
    (hxy : rowIndex h (Sum.inl (t,u,x)) < rowIndex h (Sum.inl (t,v,y))) :
    u ≤ v

name: OAI.Problem348.ModeIncidence.card_col_incident_le_four
statement:
theorem card_col_incident_le_four {h depth : ℕ} {sign parity : Bool}
    (hd : depth ≤ h) (modes : Finset Mode)
    (hmodes : ∀ t ∈ modes, colIncident h depth sign parity t) :
    modes.card ≤ 4

name: OAI.Problem348.ModeIncidence.card_col_ones_le_four
statement:
theorem card_col_ones_le_four {α : Type uAlpha} [DecidableEq α]
    {h depth : ℕ} {sign parity : Bool} (hd : depth ≤ h)
    (positions : Finset α) (mode : α → Mode) (entry : α → Bool)
    (hincident : ∀ x ∈ positions, entry x = true →
      colIncident h depth sign parity (mode x))
    (hunique : ∀ x ∈ positions, ∀ y ∈ positions,
      entry x = true → entry y = true → mode x = mode y → x = y) :
    (positions.filter (fun x => entry x = true)).card ≤ 4

name: OAI.Problem348.ModeIncidence.card_internalColModes_le
statement:
theorem card_internalColModes_le (depth : ℕ) (sign parity : Bool) :
    (internalColModes depth sign parity).card ≤ 4

name: OAI.Problem348.ModeIncidence.card_internalRowModes_le
statement:
theorem card_internalRowModes_le (depth : ℕ) (sign parity : Bool) :
    (internalRowModes depth sign parity).card ≤ 3

name: OAI.Problem348.ModeIncidence.card_leafColModes_le
statement:
theorem card_leafColModes_le (h : ℕ) (parity : Bool) :
    (leafColModes h parity).card ≤ 2

name: OAI.Problem348.ModeIncidence.card_leafRowModes_le
statement:
theorem card_leafRowModes_le (h : ℕ) (parity : Bool) :
    (leafRowModes h parity).card ≤ 4

name: OAI.Problem348.ModeIncidence.card_ones_le_of_mode_bound
statement:
theorem card_ones_le_of_mode_bound {α : Type uAlpha} [DecidableEq α]
    (positions : Finset α) (mode : α → Mode) (entry : α → Bool)
    (incident : Mode → Prop) (bound : ℕ)
    (hbound : ∀ modes : Finset Mode,
      (∀ t ∈ modes, incident t) → modes.card ≤ bound)
    (hincident : ∀ x ∈ positions, entry x = true → incident (mode x))
    (hunique : ∀ x ∈ positions, ∀ y ∈ positions,
      entry x = true → entry y = true → mode x = mode y → x = y) :
    (positions.filter (fun x => entry x = true)).card ≤ bound

name: OAI.Problem348.ModeIncidence.card_row_incident_le_four
statement:
theorem card_row_incident_le_four {h depth : ℕ} {sign parity : Bool}
    (hd : depth ≤ h) (modes : Finset Mode)
    (hmodes : ∀ t ∈ modes, rowIncident h depth sign parity t) :
    modes.card ≤ 4

name: OAI.Problem348.ModeIncidence.card_row_ones_le_four
statement:
theorem card_row_ones_le_four {α : Type uAlpha} [DecidableEq α]
    {h depth : ℕ} {sign parity : Bool} (hd : depth ≤ h)
    (positions : Finset α) (mode : α → Mode) (entry : α → Bool)
    (hincident : ∀ x ∈ positions, entry x = true →
      rowIncident h depth sign parity (mode x))
    (hunique : ∀ x ∈ positions, ∀ y ∈ positions,
      entry x = true → entry y = true → mode x = mode y → x = y) :
    (positions.filter (fun x => entry x = true)).card ≤ 4

name: OAI.Problem348.ModeIncidence.colIncident_internal
OAI.Problem348.ModeIncidence.colIncident_leaf
statement:
theorem colIncident_leaf {h : ℕ} {sign parity : Bool} {t : Mode}
    (ht : colIncident h h sign parity t) : t ∈ leafColModes h parity

name: OAI.Problem348.ModeIncidence.rowIncident_internal
OAI.Problem348.ModeIncidence.rowIncident_leaf
statement:
theorem rowIncident_leaf {h : ℕ} {sign parity : Bool} {t : Mode}
    (ht : rowIncident h h sign parity t) : t ∈ leafRowModes h parity

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.card_colRole_modes_le_four
statement:
theorem card_colRole_modes_le_four {h : ℕ} (v : VariablePosition h)
    (s : Finset (Mode h))
    (hs : ∀ t ∈ s, ∃ j, colRole t j (.inr (.inl v))) : s.card ≤ 4

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.card_rowRole_modes_le_four
statement:
theorem card_rowRole_modes_le_four {h : ℕ} (v : VariablePosition h)
    (s : Finset (Mode h))
    (hs : ∀ t ∈ s, ∃ j, rowRole t j (.inr (.inl v))) : s.card ≤ 4

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.card_variable_col_anchor_ones_le_four
statement:
theorem card_variable_col_anchor_ones_le_four {h : ℕ} {α : Type uAlpha}
    [DecidableEq α] (v : VariablePosition h) (s : Finset α)
    (a : α → AnchorPosition h)
    (hgroups : Set.InjOn (fun x => ((a x).1, (a x).2.1)) (s : Set α)) :
    (s.filter (fun x => host (.inl (a x)) (.inr (.inl v)) = true)).card ≤ 4

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.card_variable_row_anchor_ones_le_four
statement:
theorem card_variable_row_anchor_ones_le_four {h : ℕ} {α : Type uAlpha}
    [DecidableEq α] (v : VariablePosition h) (s : Finset α)
    (a : α → AnchorPosition h)
    (hgroups : Set.InjOn (fun x => ((a x).1, (a x).2.1)) (s : Set α)) :
    (s.filter (fun x => host (.inr (.inl v)) (.inl (a x)) = true)).card ≤ 4

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.colRole_incident
statement:
theorem colRole_incident {h : ℕ} (t : Mode h) (j : Fin 2)
    (v : VariablePosition h) (hv : colRole t j (.inr (.inl v))) :
    ModeIncidence.colIncident h (depth v) (plus v) (nodeParity v)
      (incidenceMode t)

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.col_anchor_ones_unique_group
statement:
theorem col_anchor_ones_unique_group {h : ℕ}
    (x : VariablePosition h ⊕ Fin (2 ^ h))
    (a b : AnchorPosition h)
    (ha : host (.inl a) (.inr x) = true)
    (hb : host (.inl b) (.inr x) = true)
    (hm : a.1 = b.1) : a.2.1 = b.2.1

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.incidenceMode_injective
statement:
theorem incidenceMode_injective (h : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (@incidenceMode h)

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.rowRole_incident
statement:
theorem rowRole_incident {h : ℕ} (t : Mode h) (j : Fin 2)
    (v : VariablePosition h) (hv : rowRole t j (.inr (.inl v))) :
    ModeIncidence.rowIncident h (depth v) (plus v) (nodeParity v)
      (incidenceMode t)

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.row_anchor_ones_unique_group
statement:
theorem row_anchor_ones_unique_group {h : ℕ}
    (x : VariablePosition h ⊕ Fin (2 ^ h))
    (a b : AnchorPosition h)
    (ha : host (.inr x) (.inl a) = true)
    (hb : host (.inr x) (.inl b) = true)
    (hm : a.1 = b.1) : a.2.1 = b.2.1

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.SelectedAnchors.GroupInjective.injOn
statement:
theorem GroupInjective.injOn {I : Type uI} {h : ℕ} {f : I → Position h}
    (hf : GroupInjective f) (S : Set I)
    (hanchor : ∀ i ∈ S, ∃ a, f i = .inl a) :
    Set.InjOn (fun i => label (f i)) S

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.SelectedAnchors.cross_mode
statement:
theorem cross_mode {h : ℕ} (r c : Position h) (t u : Mode h)
    (hr : mode r = some t) (hc : mode c = some u)
    (hentry : host r c = true) : t = u

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.SelectedAnchors.nonanchor_col_unit
statement:
theorem nonanchor_col_unit {I : Type uI} {h : ℕ}
    (f : I → Position h) (hf : GroupInjective f)
    (c : VariablePosition h ⊕ Fin (2 ^ h)) (i j : I) (t : Mode h)
    (hi : mode (f i) = some t) (hj : mode (f j) = some t)
    (hci : host (f i) (.inr c) = true)
    (hcj : host (f j) (.inr c) = true) : i = j

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.SelectedAnchors.nonanchor_col_unit_of_mode_none
statement:

name: OAI.Problem348.CopyBound.card_le_card_mul_pow
statement:
theorem card_le_card_mul_pow {k n : ℕ}
    (S : Finset
      ({f : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n // StrictMono f} ×
       {f : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n // StrictMono f}))
    (i j : Fin (k + 1)) (L : Finset (Fin n × Fin n))
    (hL : ∀ rc ∈ S, (rc.1.val i, rc.2.val j) ∈ L) :
    S.card ≤ L.card * n ^ (2 * k)

name: OAI.Problem348.CopyBound.normalized_count_le
statement:
theorem normalized_count_le {count d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hcount : count ≤ m * (d * m) ^ 130) :
    (count : ℝ) / (((d * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 132) ≤
      (1 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2)) * (1 / (m : ℝ))

name: OAI.Problem348.copyCount_le_of_cell_mem

theorem copyCount_le_of_cell_mem {k n : ℕ}
    (H : BinaryMatrix (k + 1)) (A : BinaryMatrix n)
    (i j : Fin (k + 1)) (L : Finset (Fin n × Fin n))
    (hL : ∀ rc ∈ orderedCopies H A, (rc.1.val i, rc.2.val j) ∈ L) :
    copyCount H A ≤ L.card * n ^ (2 * k)

name: OAI.Problem348.fixedCopyCount_le_of_body_cell_mem
statement:

name: OAI.Problem348.no_polynomial_removal_bound_of_sequence
statement:
theorem no_polynomial_removal_bound_of_sequence
    (hseq : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h →
      let d : ℕ := 386 * h + 2
      let n : ℕ := d * 2 ^ h
      ∃ A : BinaryMatrix n,
        fixedDistance A ≥ 1 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2) ∧
        (copyCount fixedH A : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) ^ 132) ≤
          (1 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2)) * (1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ h))) :
    ∀ c C : ℝ, 0 < c → 0 < C →
      ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧
        ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧
          ∃ A : BinaryMatrix n,
            fixedDistance A ≥ ε ∧
            (copyCount fixedH A : ℝ) <
              c * Real.rpow ε C * ((n : ℝ) ^ 132)

name: OAI.Problem348.PathPropagation.exists_modeBody
statement:
theorem exists_modeBody {B : R → C → Bool}
    {xp xm : ℕ → R} {yp ym : ℕ → C} {xd : R} {yd : C} {h : ℕ}
    (hrootp : B (xp 0) (yp 0) = true)
    (hrootm : B (xm 0) (ym 0) = false)
    (hdcol : ∀ i, i ≤ h → B (xp i) yd = true ∧ B (xm i) yd = true)
    (hdrow : ∀ i, i ≤ h → B xd (yp i) = true ∧ B xd (ym i) = true)
    (hleafr : xp h = xm h) (hleafc : yp h = ym h) :
    ∃ i, i < h ∧ ModeBody B xp xm yp ym xd yd i

    (hrootp : B (xp 0) (yp 0) = true)
    (hrootm : B (xm 0) (ym 0) = false)
    (hdcol : ∀ i, i ≤ h → B (xp i) yd = true ∧ B (xm i) yd = true)
    (hdrow : ∀ i, i ≤ h → B xd (yp i) = true ∧ B xd (ym i) = true)
    (havoid : ∀ i, i < h → ¬ ModeBody B xp xm yp ym xd yd i) :
    ∀ i, i ≤ h → B (xp i) (yp i) = true ∧ B (xm i) (ym i) = false

name: OAI.Problem348.TreeSampling.atLevel_leaf

name: OAI.Problem348.TreeSampling.atLevel_node

name: OAI.Problem348.TreeSampling.atLevel_val

      u.val % (2 ^ (h-i)) + (2 ^ (h-i)) * (z.val / (2 ^ (h-i)))

name: OAI.Problem348.TreeSampling.mix_val

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.guard_frequency

    (guards : Seeds (2 ^ h) → Finset (Position h × Position h))
    (hguards : ∀ s rc, rc ∈ guards s →
      Protected rc.1 rc.2 ∧ Selected s rc.1 rc.2)
    (rc : Position h × Position h) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun s => rc ∈ guards s).card * (2 ^ h) ^ 2 ≤
      Fintype.card (Seeds (2 ^ h))

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.protected_anchor_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem protected_anchor_left {h : ℕ} (a : AnchorPosition h)
    (c : Position h) : Protected (Sum.inl a) c

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.protected_anchor_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem protected_anchor_right {h : ℕ} (r : Position h)
    (a : AnchorPosition h) : Protected r (Sum.inl a)

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.protected_dummy_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem protected_dummy_left {h : ℕ} (x : Fin (2 ^ h))
    (c : Position h) : Protected (Sum.inr (Sum.inr x)) c

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.protected_dummy_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem protected_dummy_right {h : ℕ} (r : Position h)
    (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) : Protected r (Sum.inr (Sum.inr x))

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.protected_event_card_le
statement:
theorem protected_event_card_le {h : ℕ} (r c : Position h)
    (event : Finset (Seeds (2 ^ h)))
    (hevent : ∀ s ∈ event, Protected r c ∧ Selected s r c) :
    event.card ≤ 2 ^ h

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.protected_roots
statement:
theorem protected_roots {h : ℕ} (v w : VariablePosition h)
    (hv : depth v = 0) (hw : depth w = 0) :
    Protected (Sum.inr (Sum.inl v)) (Sum.inr (Sum.inl w))

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.selected_fiber_card
statement:
theorem selected_fiber_card {h : ℕ} (r c : Position h) (hp : Protected r c) :
    Fintype.card {s : Seeds (2 ^ h) // Selected s r c} = 2 ^ h

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.selected_fiber_card_mul
statement:
theorem selected_fiber_card_mul {h : ℕ} (r c : Position h) (hp : Protected r c) :
    Fintype.card {s : Seeds (2 ^ h) // Selected s r c} * (2 ^ h) ^ 2 =
      Fintype.card (Seeds (2 ^ h))

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.selected_filter_card
statement:
theorem selected_filter_card {h : ℕ} (r c : Position h) (hp : Protected r c) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun s : Seeds (2 ^ h) => Selected s r c).card = 2 ^ h

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.transported_guard_frequency
statement:
theorem transported_guard_frequency {h n : ℕ}
    (row col : Position h ≃ Fin n)
    (guards : Seeds (2 ^ h) → Finset (Fin n × Fin n))
    (hguards : ∀ s rc, rc ∈ guards s →
      Protected (row.symm rc.1) (col.symm rc.2) ∧
      Selected s (row.symm rc.1) (col.symm rc.2))
    (rc : Fin n × Fin n) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun s => rc ∈ guards s).card * (2 ^ h) ^ 2 ≤
      Fintype.card (Seeds (2 ^ h))

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.FrameChosen.cell_good
statement:
theorem FrameChosen.cell_good {row col : Position h ≃ Fin n} {s : Seeds (2 ^ h)}
    {F : AnchorFrame n} (hF : FrameChosen row col s F)
    {r₀ r₁ c₀ c₁ : Fin n}
    (hr₀ : RowChosen row s r₀) (hr₁ : RowChosen row s r₁)
    (hc₀ : ColChosen col s c₀) (hc₁ : ColChosen col s c₁)
    {rc : Fin n × Fin n} (hcell : F.Cell r₀ r₁ c₀ c₁ rc) :
    GoodCell row col s rc

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.PathChosen.core_good
OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.PathChosen.edge_good
OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.PathChosen.guard_good

statement:
theorem goodCell_of_chosen {row col : Position h ≃ Fin n} {s : Seeds (2 ^ h)}

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.HostSampling.path_guard_frequency
statement:
theorem path_guard_frequency (row col : Position h ≃ Fin n)
    (P : Seeds (2 ^ h) → Selection n)
    (hP : ∀ s, PathChosen row col s (P s)) (rc : Fin n × Fin n) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun s => rc ∈ (P s).guards h).card * (2 ^ h) ^ 2 ≤
      Fintype.card (Seeds (2 ^ h))

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.SelectedAnchor.frame_valid
statement:
theorem frame_valid {h n : ℕ} (er ec : Position h ≃ Fin n) (t : Mode h)
    (a b : Fin 64 → Fin (2 ^ h))
    (hr : StrictMono (fun u => er (.inl (t,u,a u))))
    (hc : StrictMono (fun v => ec (.inl (t,v,b v))))
    (r₀ r₁ c₀ c₁ : Position h)
    (hr₀ : rowRole t 0 r₀) (hr₁ : rowRole t 1 r₁)
    (hc₀ : colRole t 0 c₀) (hc₁ : colRole t 1 c₁)
    (hbeforeR : ∀ u, er (.inl (t,u,a u)) < er r₀)
    (hrows : er r₀ < er r₁)
    (hbeforeC : ∀ v, ec (.inl (t,v,b v)) < ec c₀)
    (hcols : ec c₀ < ec c₁) :
    (frame er ec t a b hr hc).Valid (matrix er ec)
      (er r₀) (er r₁) (ec c₀) (ec c₁)

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.SelectedAnchor.matrix_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrix_apply {h n : ℕ} (er ec : Position h ≃ Fin n)
    (r c : Position h) : matrix er ec (er r) (ec c) = host r c

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.host_col_role_one
statement:
theorem host_col_role_one {h : ℕ} (t : Mode h) (c : Position h)
    (hc : colRole t 1 c) (u : Fin 64) (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    host (.inl (t,u,x)) c = decide (u.val = 1)

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.host_col_role_zero
statement:
theorem host_col_role_zero {h : ℕ} (t : Mode h) (c : Position h)
    (hc : colRole t 0 c) (u : Fin 64) (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    host (.inl (t,u,x)) c = decide (u.val = 0)

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.host_row_role_one
statement:
theorem host_row_role_one {h : ℕ} (t : Mode h) (r : Position h)
    (hr : rowRole t 1 r) (v : Fin 64) (y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    host r (.inl (t,v,y)) = decide (v.val = 1)

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.host_row_role_zero
statement:
theorem host_row_role_zero {h : ℕ} (t : Mode h) (r : Position h)
    (hr : rowRole t 0 r) (v : Fin 64) (y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    host r (.inl (t,v,y)) = decide (v.val = 0)

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.depth_root_minus
statement:
@[simp] theorem depth_root_minus {h : ℕ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    depth ((⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (2 * h + 1)), x) = 0

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.depth_root_plus
statement:
@[simp] theorem depth_root_plus {h : ℕ} (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    depth ((0 : Fin (2 * h + 1)), x) = 0

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.depth_shared_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem depth_shared_leaf {h : ℕ} (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    depth (Fin.last (2 * h), x) = h

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.host_root_minus
statement:
theorem host_root_minus {h : ℕ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) (x y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    host (Sum.inr (Sum.inl ((⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (2 * h + 1)), x)))
      (Sum.inr (Sum.inl ((⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (2 * h + 1)), y))) = false

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.host_root_plus
statement:
theorem host_root_plus {h : ℕ} (x y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    host (Sum.inr (Sum.inl ((0 : Fin (2 * h + 1)), x)))
      (Sum.inr (Sum.inl ((0 : Fin (2 * h + 1)), y))) = true

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.host_shared_leaf_diagonal
statement:
theorem host_shared_leaf_diagonal {h : ℕ} (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    host (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (Fin.last (2 * h), x)))
      (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (Fin.last (2 * h), x))) = true

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.node_eq_coordinate_of_leaf
statement:
theorem node_eq_coordinate_of_leaf {h : ℕ} (r : VariablePosition h)
    (hr : depth r = h) : node r = r.2.val

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.node_eq_zero_of_depth_zero
statement:
theorem node_eq_zero_of_depth_zero {h : ℕ} (v : VariablePosition h)
    (hv : depth v = 0) : node v = 0

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.node_shared_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem node_shared_leaf {h : ℕ} (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    node (Fin.last (2 * h), x) = x.val

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.plus_root_minus
statement:
@[simp] theorem plus_root_minus {h : ℕ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    plus ((⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (2 * h + 1)), x) = false

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.plus_root_plus
statement:
@[simp] theorem plus_root_plus {h : ℕ} (x : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    plus ((0 : Fin (2 * h + 1)), x) = true

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.variableEntry_leaf_of_depth
statement:
theorem variableEntry_leaf_of_depth {h : ℕ} (r c : VariablePosition h)
    (hr : depth r = h) (hc : depth c = h) :
    variableEntry r c = decide (r.2.val ≤ c.2.val)

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.variableEntry_root_minus
statement:
theorem variableEntry_root_minus {h : ℕ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) (x y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    variableEntry ((⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (2 * h + 1)), x)
      ((⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (2 * h + 1)), y) = false

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.variableEntry_root_minus_of_atLevel
statement:
theorem variableEntry_root_minus_of_atLevel {h : ℕ} (hh : 1 ≤ h)
    (r c : VariablePosition h) (hr : AtLevel 0 false r) (hc : AtLevel 0 false c) :
    variableEntry r c = false

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.variableEntry_root_plus
statement:
theorem variableEntry_root_plus {h : ℕ} (x y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    variableEntry ((0 : Fin (2 * h + 1)), x)
      ((0 : Fin (2 * h + 1)), y) = true

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.variableEntry_root_plus_of_atLevel
statement:
theorem variableEntry_root_plus_of_atLevel {h : ℕ} (hh : 1 ≤ h)
    (r c : VariablePosition h) (hr : AtLevel 0 true r) (hc : AtLevel 0 true c) :
    variableEntry r c = true

name: OAI.Problem348.Construction.variableEntry_shared_leaf
statement:
theorem variableEntry_shared_leaf {h : ℕ} (x y : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    variableEntry (Fin.last (2 * h), x) (Fin.last (2 * h), y) =
      decide (x.val ≤ y.val)

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.ancestor_parent
statement:
theorem ancestor_parent (h i z : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 ≤ h) :
    z / blockSize h (i + 1) / 2 = z / blockSize h i

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.blockSize_mul_nodes
statement:
theorem blockSize_mul_nodes {h i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ h) :
    blockSize h i * 2 ^ i = 2 ^ h

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.blockSize_pos
statement: theorem blockSize_pos (h i : ℕ) : 0 < blockSize h i

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.classAt_depth
statement:
@[simp] theorem classAt_depth (h i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ h) (plus : Bool) :
    (classAt h i hi plus).val / 2 = i

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.classAt_internal
statement:
theorem classAt_internal (h i : ℕ) (hi : i < h) (plus : Bool) :
    (classAt h i hi.le plus).val = 2 * i + (!plus).toNat

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.classAt_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem classAt_leaf (h : ℕ) (plus : Bool) :
    (classAt h h le_rfl plus).val = 2 * h

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.classAt_leaf_iff
statement:
theorem classAt_leaf_iff (h i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ h) (plus : Bool) :
    (classAt h i hi plus).val = 2 * h ↔ i = h

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.classAt_signs_eq_iff
statement:
theorem classAt_signs_eq_iff (h i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ h) :
    classAt h i hi true = classAt h i hi false ↔ i = h

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.mixFin_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem mixFin_leaf (h : ℕ) (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    mixFin h h le_rfl z u = z

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.mixFin_node
statement:
@[simp] theorem mixFin_node (h i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ h) (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    (mixFin h i hi z u).val / blockSize h i = z.val / blockSize h i

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.mixFin_root
statement:
@[simp] theorem mixFin_root (h : ℕ) (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    mixFin h 0 (Nat.zero_le h) z u = u

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.mix_div
statement:
theorem mix_div {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (z u : ℕ) :
    mix b z u / b = z / b

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.mix_lt
statement:
theorem mix_lt {b n z u : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hz : z < n * b) :
    mix b z u < n * b

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.mix_mod
statement:
theorem mix_mod {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (z u : ℕ) :
    mix b z u % b = u % b

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.sample_depth
statement:
@[simp] theorem sample_depth (h i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ h) (plus : Bool)
    (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) : depth (sample h i hi plus z u) = i

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.sample_leaf_offset
statement:
@[simp] theorem sample_leaf_offset (h : ℕ) (s : Bool) (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    (sample h h le_rfl s z u).2 = z

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.sample_node
statement:
@[simp] theorem sample_node (h i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ h) (plus : Bool)
    (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    node (sample h i hi plus z u) = z.val / blockSize h i

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.sample_node_lt
statement:
theorem sample_node_lt (h i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ h) (plus : Bool)
    (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) : node (sample h i hi plus z u) < 2 ^ i

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.sample_nodes_eq
statement:
theorem sample_nodes_eq (h i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ h) (s t : Bool)
    (z u v : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    node (sample h i hi s z u) = node (sample h i hi t z v)

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.sample_parent
statement:
theorem sample_parent (h i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 ≤ h) (s t : Bool)
    (z u v : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    node (sample h (i + 1) hi s z u) / 2 =
      node (sample h i (by omega) t z v)

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.sample_root_node
statement:
@[simp] theorem sample_root_node (h : ℕ) (s : Bool) (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    node (sample h 0 (Nat.zero_le h) s z u) = 0

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.sample_root_offset
statement:
@[simp] theorem sample_root_offset (h : ℕ) (s : Bool) (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    (sample h 0 (Nat.zero_le h) s z u).2 = u

name: OAI.Problem348.SampledPath.sample_shared_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem sample_shared_leaf (h : ℕ) (s t : Bool)
    (z u v : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    sample h h le_rfl s z u = sample h h le_rfl t z v

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.horizontal_minus_col_first
statement:
theorem horizontal_minus_col_first {h : ℕ} (i : Fin h) (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    Construction.colRole (horizontal i false (parity (z.val / blockSize h (i.val + 1)))) 0
      (position h (i.val + 1) (by omega) false z u)

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.horizontal_minus_col_second
statement:
theorem horizontal_minus_col_second {h : ℕ} (i : Fin h) (d : Bool)

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.horizontal_plus_col_first
statement:
theorem horizontal_plus_col_first {h : ℕ} (i : Fin h) (d : Bool)
    (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    Construction.colRole (horizontal i true d) 0 (position h i.val (by omega) true z u)

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.horizontal_plus_col_second
statement:
theorem horizontal_plus_col_second {h : ℕ} (i : Fin h) (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    Construction.colRole (horizontal i true (parity (z.val / blockSize h (i.val + 1)))) 1
      (position h (i.val + 1) (by omega) true z u)

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.horizontal_row_first
statement:
theorem horizontal_row_first {h : ℕ} (i : Fin h) (s : Bool)
    (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    Construction.rowRole (horizontal i s (parity (z.val / blockSize h (i.val + 1)))) 0
      (position h (i.val + 1) (by omega) s z u)

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.horizontal_row_second
statement:
theorem horizontal_row_second {h : ℕ} (i : Fin h) (s d : Bool)
    (u : Fin (2 ^ h)) : Construction.rowRole (horizontal i s d) 1 (dummy h u)

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.mode_kind
statement:
@[simp] theorem mode_kind {h : ℕ} (i : Fin h) (k : Fin 6) :
    Construction.kind (mode i k) = k.val

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.mode_level
statement:
@[simp] theorem mode_level {h : ℕ} (i : Fin h) (k : Fin 6) :
    Construction.level (mode i k) = i.val + 1

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.parity_eq_false
statement: @[simp] theorem parity_eq_false (n : ℕ) : parity n = false ↔ n % 2 = 0

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.parity_eq_true
statement: @[simp] theorem parity_eq_true (n : ℕ) : parity n = true ↔ n % 2 = 1

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.position_shared_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem position_shared_leaf (h : ℕ) (s t : Bool)
    (z u v : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    position h h le_rfl s z u = position h h le_rfl t z v

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.sample_atLevel
statement:
@[simp] theorem sample_atLevel (h i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ h) (s : Bool)
    (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) : Construction.AtLevel i s (sample h i hi s z u)

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.sample_hostNode
statement:
@[simp] theorem sample_hostNode (h i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ h) (s : Bool)
    (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    Construction.node (sample h i hi s z u) = z.val / blockSize h i

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.vertical_col_first
statement:
theorem vertical_col_first {h : ℕ} (i : Fin h) (s : Bool) (u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    Construction.colRole (vertical i s) 0 (dummy h u)

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.vertical_col_second
statement:
theorem vertical_col_second {h : ℕ} (i : Fin h) (s : Bool) (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    Construction.colRole (vertical i s) 1 (position h i.val (by omega) s z u)

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.vertical_minus_row_first
statement:
theorem vertical_minus_row_first {h : ℕ} (i : Fin h) (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    Construction.rowRole (vertical i false) 0
      (position h i.val (by omega) false z u)

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.vertical_minus_row_second
statement:
theorem vertical_minus_row_second {h : ℕ} (i : Fin h) (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    Construction.rowRole (vertical i false) 1
      (position h (i.val + 1) (by omega) false z u)

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.vertical_plus_row_first
statement:
theorem vertical_plus_row_first {h : ℕ} (i : Fin h) (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    Construction.rowRole (vertical i true) 0
      (position h (i.val + 1) (by omega) true z u)

name: OAI.Problem348.HostSampledPath.vertical_plus_row_second
statement:
theorem vertical_plus_row_second {h : ℕ} (i : Fin h) (z u : Fin (2 ^ h)) :
    Construction.rowRole (vertical i true) 1
      (position h i.val (by omega) true z u)

name: OAI.Problem348.Sampling.exists_agreement_of_changed_card_lt
statement:
theorem exists_agreement_of_changed_card_lt
    {Ω : Type uOmega} {Cell : Type uCell} {Value : Type uValue} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Cell] [DecidableEq Value]
    (A B : Cell → Value) (selected : Ω → Cell → Prop)
    (relevant : Cell → Prop) [DecidableRel selected] [DecidablePred relevant]
    (m : ℕ) (hΩ : 0 < Fintype.card Ω)
    (hbound : ∀ e, relevant e →
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => selected ω e)).card * m ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card Ω)
    (hsmall : (Finset.univ.filter (fun e => A e ≠ B e)).card < m ^ 2) :
    ∃ ω, ∀ e, relevant e → selected ω e → A e = B e

name: OAI.Problem348.Sampling.exists_agreement_three_seed
statement:
theorem exists_agreement_three_seed
    {Cell : Type uCell} {Value : Type uValue} [Fintype Cell] [DecidableEq Value]
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (A B : Cell → Value)
    (selected : (Fin m × Fin m × Fin m) → Cell → Prop)
    (relevant : Cell → Prop) [DecidableRel selected] [DecidablePred relevant]
    (hbound : ∀ e, relevant e →
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => selected ω e)).card ≤ m)
    (hsmall : (Finset.univ.filter (fun e => A e ≠ B e)).card < m ^ 2) :
    ∃ ω, ∀ e, relevant e → selected ω e → A e = B e

name: OAI.Problem348.Sampling.exists_avoiding_of_card_mul_le
statement:
theorem exists_avoiding_of_card_mul_le {Ω : Type uOmega} {I : Type uI} [Fintype Ω]
    (events : Finset I) (bad : I → Finset Ω) (q : ℕ)
    (hΩ : 0 < Fintype.card Ω)
    (hbound : ∀ i ∈ events, (bad i).card * q ≤ Fintype.card Ω)
    (hsmall : events.card < q) :
    ∃ ω, ∀ i ∈ events, ω ∉ bad i

name: OAI.Problem348.Sampling.exists_avoiding_of_sum_card_lt
statement:
theorem exists_avoiding_of_sum_card_lt {Ω : Type uOmega} {I : Type uI} [Fintype Ω]
    (events : Finset I) (bad : I → Finset Ω)
    (hsmall : (∑ i ∈ events, (bad i).card) < Fintype.card Ω) :
    ∃ ω, ∀ i ∈ events, ω ∉ bad i

name: OAI.Problem348.Sampling.exists_avoiding_of_uniform_ratio_lt
statement:
theorem exists_avoiding_of_uniform_ratio_lt {Ω : Type uOmega} {I : Type uI} [Fintype Ω]
    (events : Finset I) (bad : I → Finset Ω) (r : ℚ)
    (hΩ : 0 < Fintype.card Ω)
    (hbound : ∀ i ∈ events, ((bad i).card : ℚ) / (Fintype.card Ω : ℚ) ≤ r)
    (hsmall : (events.card : ℚ) * r < 1) :
    ∃ ω, ∀ i ∈ events, ω ∉ bad i

name: OAI.Problem348.Sampling.exists_selection_avoiding
statement:
theorem exists_selection_avoiding {Ω : Type uOmega} {Cell : Type uCell} [Fintype Ω]
    (changed : Finset Cell) (selected : Ω → Cell → Prop) (m : ℕ)
    [DecidableRel selected]
    (hΩ : 0 < Fintype.card Ω)
    (hbound : ∀ e ∈ changed,
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => selected ω e)).card * m ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card Ω)
    (hsmall : changed.card < m ^ 2) :
    ∃ ω, ∀ e ∈ changed, ¬ selected ω e

name: OAI.Problem348.Sampling.sq_le_changed_card_of_forcing
statement:
theorem sq_le_changed_card_of_forcing
    {Ω : Type uOmega} {Cell : Type uCell} {Value : Type uValue} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Cell] [DecidableEq Value]
    (A B : Cell → Value) (selected : Ω → Cell → Prop)
    (relevant : Cell → Prop) [DecidableRel selected] [DecidablePred relevant]
    (m : ℕ) (hΩ : 0 < Fintype.card Ω)
    (hbound : ∀ e, relevant e →
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => selected ω e)).card * m ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card Ω)
    (hforcing : ∀ ω, ∃ e, relevant e ∧ selected ω e ∧ A e ≠ B e) :
    m ^ 2 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun e => A e ≠ B e)).card

name: OAI.Problem348.Sampling.guard_frequency_le
statement:
theorem guard_frequency_le {Ω : Type uOmega} {Cell : Type uCell} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Cell]
    (guard : Ω → Finset Cell) (selected : Ω → Cell → Prop)
    [DecidableRel selected]
    (hsub : ∀ ω e, e ∈ guard ω → selected ω e) (e : Cell) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => e ∈ guard ω)).card ≤
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => selected ω e)).card

name: OAI.Problem348.Sampling.hammingDistance_ge_of_guard_sampling
statement:
theorem hammingDistance_ge_of_guard_sampling
    {k n : ℕ} {Ω : Type uOmega} [Fintype Ω]
    (H : BinaryMatrix k) (A B : BinaryMatrix n)
    (guard : Ω → Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (m : ℕ)
    (hΩ : 0 < Fintype.card Ω)
    (hbound : ∀ e,
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => e ∈ guard ω)).card * m ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card Ω)
    (hforce : ∀ ω,
      (∀ e ∈ guard ω, A e.1 e.2 = B e.1 e.2) → ¬ HFree H B)
    (hfree : HFree H B) : m ^ 2 ≤ hammingDistance A B

name: OAI.Problem348.Sampling.hammingDistance_ge_of_three_seed_guards
statement:
theorem hammingDistance_ge_of_three_seed_guards
    {k n : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (H : BinaryMatrix k) (A B : BinaryMatrix n)
    (guard : (Fin m × Fin m × Fin m) → Finset (Fin n × Fin n))
    (hbound : ∀ e, (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => e ∈ guard ω)).card ≤ m)
    (hforce : ∀ ω,
      (∀ e ∈ guard ω, A e.1 e.2 = B e.1 e.2) → ¬ HFree H B)
    (hfree : HFree H B) : m ^ 2 ≤ hammingDistance A B

      (SelectedAnchor.matrix er ec)

name: OAI.Problem348.SequenceAssembly.copyDensity_le_of_integer_bound
statement:
theorem copyDensity_le_of_integer_bound {d m : ℕ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (A : BinaryMatrix (d * m))
    (hcount : copyCount fixedH A ≤ m * (d * m) ^ 130) :
    (copyCount fixedH A : ℝ) / (((d * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 132) ≤
      (1 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2)) * (1 / (m : ℝ))

name: OAI.Problem348.SequenceAssembly.counterexample_sequence_of_integer_bounds
statement:
theorem counterexample_sequence_of_integer_bounds
    (hcert : ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h →
      let d : ℕ := 386 * h + 2
      let n : ℕ := d * 2 ^ h
      ∃ A : BinaryMatrix n, HostBounds A (2 ^ h)) :
    ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h →
      let d : ℕ := 386 * h + 2
      let n : ℕ := d * 2 ^ h
      ∃ A : BinaryMatrix n,
        fixedDistance A ≥ 1 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2) ∧
        (copyCount fixedH A : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) ^ 132) ≤
          (1 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2)) * (1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ h))

name: OAI.Problem348.SequenceAssembly.fixedDistance_ge_of_integer_bound
statement:
theorem fixedDistance_ge_of_integer_bound {d m : ℕ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m) (A : BinaryMatrix (d * m))
    (hrep : ∀ B : BinaryMatrix (d * m), HFree fixedH B →
      m ^ 2 ≤ hammingDistance A B) :
    1 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ fixedDistance A

name: OAI.Problem348.SequenceAssembly.fixedMinEdits_ge_of_repairs

    (hq : q ≤ n * n)
    (hrep : ∀ B : BinaryMatrix n, HFree fixedH B → q ≤ hammingDistance A B) :
    q ≤ fixedMinEdits A

name: OAI.Problem348.counterexample_sequence
statement:
theorem counterexample_sequence :
    ∀ h : ℕ, 1 ≤ h →
  let d : ℕ := 386 * h + 2
  let n : ℕ := d * 2 ^ h
  ∃ A : BinaryMatrix n,
    fixedDistance A ≥ 1 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2) ∧
    (copyCount fixedH A : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) ^ 132) ≤
      (1 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2)) * (1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ h))

name: OAI.Problem348.no_polynomial_removal_bound
statement:
theorem no_polynomial_removal_bound :
    ∀ c C : ℝ, 0 < c → 0 < C →
  ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧
      ∃ A : BinaryMatrix n,
        fixedDistance A ≥ ε ∧
        (copyCount fixedH A : ℝ) <
          c * Real.rpow ε C * ((n : ℝ) ^ 132)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.continuous_entropy
statement:
theorem continuous_entropy {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] :
    Continuous (entropy : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropy_eq
statement:
theorem entropy_eq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → ℝ) :
    entropy p = -(∑ i, p i * Real.log (p i))

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropy_le_log_card
statement:
theorem entropy_le_log_card {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p : ι → ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ probabilitySimplex ι) : entropy p ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card ι)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropy_nonneg
statement:
theorem entropy_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p : ι → ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ probabilitySimplex ι) : 0 ≤ entropy p

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropy_le_crossEntropy
statement:
theorem entropy_le_crossEntropy {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p q : ι → ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ probabilitySimplex ι) (hq : q ∈ probabilitySimplex ι)
    (hsupp : ∀ i, p i = 0 → q i = 0) :
    entropy q ≤ -∑ i, q i * Real.log (p i)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropy_maximizer_support
statement:
theorem entropy_maximizer_support {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p q : ι → ℝ}
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i)
    (hmax : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      entropy (fun i => (1-t)*p i+t*q i) ≤ entropy p) {j : ι} (hjq : 0 < q j) :
    0 < p j

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropy_mix_ge
statement:
theorem entropy_mix_ge {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p q : ι → ℝ}
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (1-t) * entropy p + t * entropy q ≤
      entropy (fun i => (1-t)*p i + t*q i)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropy_mix_zero_bonus
statement:
theorem entropy_mix_zero_bonus {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p q : ι → ℝ}
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) {j : ι} (hj : p j = 0)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (1-t) * entropy p + t * entropy q + q j * Real.negMulLog t ≤
      entropy (fun i => (1-t)*p i + t*q i)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.exists_pos_nonneg_perturb
statement:
theorem exists_pos_nonneg_perturb {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p v : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hz : ∀ i, p i = 0 → 0 ≤ v i) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i+t*v i

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.negMulLog_tangent
statement:
theorem negMulLog_tangent {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    Real.negMulLog x ≤ -x * Real.log y + y-x

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropy_partition_bound
statement:
theorem entropy_partition_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p q : ι → ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ probabilitySimplex ι) (hq : q ∈ probabilitySimplex ι)
    (hsupp : ∀ i, p i = 0 → q i = 0) (a : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    entropy q ≤ Real.log (partition p a t) - ∑ i, q i*Real.log (p i) -
      t * ∑ i, q i*a i

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.linearScore_expectation
statement:
theorem linearScore_expectation (G : LooplessGraph V E) (p : G.Matching → ℝ)
    (u : E → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    (∑ M, p M * linearScore G u c M) =
      (∑ e, u e * G.mean p e) - c * ∑ M, p M

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.partition_pos
statement:
theorem partition_pos {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p : ι → ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ probabilitySimplex ι) (a : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : 0 < partition p a t

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.partition_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem partition_zero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p : ι → ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ probabilitySimplex ι) (a : ι → ℝ) : partition p a 0 = 1

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.sum_mean_assoc
statement:
theorem sum_mean_assoc (G : LooplessGraph V E) (p : G.Matching → ℝ) (u : E → ℝ) :
    (∑ M, p M * (∑ e, u e * G.indicator M e)) = ∑ e, u e * G.mean p e

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.tiltedLaw_mem_simplex
OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropy_line_deriv_eventually
statement:
theorem entropy_line_deriv_eventually {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (x v : ι → ℝ)
    (hsupp : ∀ i, x i = 0 → v i = 0) :
    deriv (fun t : ℝ => entropy (fun i => x i+t*v i)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0] entropyLineD x v

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.entropy_second_variation
statement:
theorem entropy_second_variation {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (x v : ι → ℝ) (hsupp : ∀ i, x i = 0 → v i = 0)
    {p : κ → ℝ} (hp : p ∈ probabilitySimplex κ) (a : κ → ℝ)
    (hcenter : ∑ i, p i*a i = 0) {m : ℝ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (c₀ c₁ : ℝ)
    (hlocal : IsLocalMax (fun t => entropyBarrier m (entropy (fun i => x i+t*v i)) +
      c₀+t*c₁+t^2*(∑ i, p i*(a i)^2)-Real.log (partition p a t)) 0) :
    (8*Real.exp (-entropy x/m)-1)*(∑ i, (v i)^2/x i) +
      (8*Real.exp (-entropy x/m)/m)*(entropyLineD x v 0)^2 +
      (∑ i, p i*(a i)^2) ≤ 0

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.second_deriv_nonpos_of_local_max
statement:
theorem second_deriv_nonpos_of_local_max {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℝ}
    (hm : IsLocalMax f x) (hc : ContinuousAt f x) : deriv (deriv f) x ≤ 0

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.compatible_jointLaw_expect_first
statement:
theorem compatible_jointLaw_expect_first {A B C : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq C]
    {p : A → ℝ} {q : B → ℝ} (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (f : A → C) (g : B → C) (hcompat : ∀ c, fiberMass p f c = fiberMass q g c)
    (h : A → ℝ) :
    ∑ z : {z : A × B // f z.1=g z.2}, jointLaw p q f g z.val * h z.val.1 = ∑ a, p a*h a

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.compatible_jointLaw_expect_second
statement:
theorem compatible_jointLaw_expect_second {A B C : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq C]
    {p : A → ℝ} {q : B → ℝ} (hq : ∀ b, 0 ≤ q b)
    (f : A → C) (g : B → C) (hcompat : ∀ c, fiberMass p f c = fiberMass q g c)
    (h : B → ℝ) :
    ∑ z : {z : A × B // f z.1=g z.2}, jointLaw p q f g z.val * h z.val.2 = ∑ b, q b*h b

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.compatible_jointLaw_mem_simplex
statement:
theorem compatible_jointLaw_mem_simplex {A B C : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq C]
    {p : A → ℝ} {q : B → ℝ} (hp : p ∈ probabilitySimplex A) (hq : q ∈ probabilitySimplex B)
    (f : A → C) (g : B → C) (hcompat : ∀ c, fiberMass p f c = fiberMass q g c) :
    (fun z : {z : A × B // f z.1=g z.2} => jointLaw p q f g z.val) ∈
      probabilitySimplex {z : A × B // f z.1=g z.2}

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.fiberMass_expect
statement:
theorem fiberMass_expect {A C : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C]
    (p : A → ℝ) (f : A → C) (h : C → ℝ) :
    ∑ c, fiberMass p f c * h c = ∑ a, p a*h (f a)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.fiberMass_mem_simplex
statement:
theorem fiberMass_mem_simplex {A C : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C]
    {p : A → ℝ} (hp : p ∈ probabilitySimplex A) (f : A → C) :

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.fiberMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem fiberMass_nonneg {A C : Type*} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq C]
    {p : A → ℝ} (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (f : A → C) (c : C) :

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.fiberMass_sum
statement:
theorem fiberMass_sum {A C : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C]
    (p : A → ℝ) (f : A → C) : ∑ c, fiberMass p f c = ∑ a, p a

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.jointLaw_expect_first
statement:
theorem jointLaw_expect_first {A B C : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq C]
    {p : A → ℝ} {q : B → ℝ} (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (f : A → C) (g : B → C) (hcompat : ∀ c, fiberMass p f c = fiberMass q g c)
    (h : A → ℝ) : ∑ z : A × B, jointLaw p q f g z * h z.1 = ∑ a, p a*h a

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.jointLaw_expect_second
statement:
theorem jointLaw_expect_second {A B C : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq C]
    {p : A → ℝ} {q : B → ℝ} (hq : ∀ b, 0 ≤ q b)
    (f : A → C) (g : B → C) (hcompat : ∀ c, fiberMass p f c = fiberMass q g c)
    (h : B → ℝ) : ∑ z : A × B, jointLaw p q f g z * h z.2 = ∑ b, q b*h b

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.jointLaw_first
statement:
theorem jointLaw_first {A B C : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq C]
    {p : A → ℝ} {q : B → ℝ} (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (f : A → C) (g : B → C) (hcompat : ∀ c, fiberMass p f c = fiberMass q g c)
    (a : A) : (∑ b, jointLaw p q f g (a,b)) = p a

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.jointLaw_mem_simplex
statement:
theorem jointLaw_mem_simplex {A B C : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq C]
    {p : A → ℝ} {q : B → ℝ} (hp : p ∈ probabilitySimplex A) (hq : q ∈ probabilitySimplex B)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.jointLaw_nonneg
statement:
theorem jointLaw_nonneg {A B C : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq C]

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.jointLaw_second
statement:
theorem jointLaw_second {A B C : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq C]
    {p : A → ℝ} {q : B → ℝ} (hq : ∀ b, 0 ≤ q b)
    (f : A → C) (g : B → C) (hcompat : ∀ c, fiberMass p f c = fiberMass q g c)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.le_fiberMass_self
statement:
theorem le_fiberMass_self {A C : Type*} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq C]

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.sum_subtype_supported

theorem sum_subtype_supported {A : Type*} [Fintype A] (P : A → Prop) [DecidablePred P]

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.cutMass_linear
statement:
theorem cutMass_linear (G : LooplessGraph V E) (x y : E → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (S : Finset V) :

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.cut_compl
statement:
@[simp] theorem cut_compl (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V) :

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.degree_indicator
statement:
theorem degree_indicator (G : LooplessGraph V E) (M : G.Matching) (v : V) :

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.degree_linear
statement:
theorem degree_linear (G : LooplessGraph V E) (x y : E → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (v : V) :

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.degree_mean
statement:
theorem degree_mean (G : LooplessGraph V E) (p : G.Matching → ℝ) (v : V) :

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.incidence_sum
statement:
theorem incidence_sum (G : LooplessGraph V E) (e : E) (S : Finset V) :
    (∑ v ∈ S, if G.Incident v e then (1:ℕ) else 0) =
      (if G.left e ∈ S then 1 else 0) + (if G.right e ∈ S then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.indicator_mem_constraintPolytope
statement:
theorem indicator_mem_constraintPolytope (G : LooplessGraph V E) (M : G.Matching) :

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.mem_cut

@[simp] theorem mem_cut (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V) (e : E) :

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.polytope_subset_constraintPolytope

theorem polytope_subset_constraintPolytope (G : LooplessGraph V E) :

theorem boundaryEdge_crosses (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.boundaryEdge_mem
statement:
theorem boundaryEdge_mem (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.boundary_eq_iff_mem
statement:
theorem boundary_eq_iff_mem (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V)
    (M : (G.onSide S).Matching) (e : {e // G.left e ∈ S ∨ G.right e ∈ S})

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.boundary_fiber
statement:
theorem boundary_fiber (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.boundary_fiber_zero
statement:

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.boundary_mem_lifted

theorem boundary_mem_lifted (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.couple_laws
statement:
theorem couple_laws (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V) (x : E → ℝ)
    {p : (G.onSide S).Matching → ℝ} {q : (G.onSide Sᶜ).Matching → ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ probabilitySimplex (G.onSide S).Matching)
    (hq : q ∈ probabilitySimplex (G.onSide Sᶜ).Matching)
    (hpx : ∀ e, (G.onSide S).mean p e = x e.val)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.indicator_glue_right

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.lifted_cross_eq_boundary

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.lifted_other_subset
statement:
theorem lifted_other_subset (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V)
    (M₁ : (G.onSide S).Matching) (M₂ : (G.onSide Sᶜ).Matching)
    (heq : (G.boundaryEdge S M₁).val = (G.boundaryEdge Sᶜ M₂).val)
    {e : E} (he : e ∈ G.liftedEdges Sᶜ M₂)
    (hkeep : G.left e ∈ S ∨ G.right e ∈ S) : e ∈ G.liftedEdges S M₁

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.mem_glued_left
statement:
theorem mem_glued_left (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V)
    (M₁ : (G.onSide S).Matching) (M₂ : (G.onSide Sᶜ).Matching)
    (heq : (G.boundaryEdge S M₁).val = (G.boundaryEdge Sᶜ M₂).val)
    (e : {e // G.left e ∈ S ∨ G.right e ∈ S}) :
    e.val ∈ G.liftedEdges S M₁ ∪ G.liftedEdges Sᶜ M₂ ↔ e ∈ M₁.val

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.mem_glued_right
statement:
theorem mem_glued_right (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V)
    (M₁ : (G.onSide S).Matching) (M₂ : (G.onSide Sᶜ).Matching)
    (heq : (G.boundaryEdge S M₁).val = (G.boundaryEdge Sᶜ M₂).val)
    (e : {e // G.left e ∈ Sᶜ ∨ G.right e ∈ Sᶜ}) :
    e.val ∈ G.liftedEdges S M₁ ∪ G.liftedEdges Sᶜ M₂ ↔ e ∈ M₂.val

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.mem_liftVertices
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_liftVertices (S : Finset V)
    (T : Finset (Option {v // v ∈ S})) (v : V) :
    v ∈ liftVertices S T ↔ sideMap S v ∈ T

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.mem_liftedEdges
statement:
theorem mem_liftedEdges (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V)
    (M : (G.onSide S).Matching) (e : {e // G.left e ∈ S ∨ G.right e ∈ S}) :
    e.val ∈ G.liftedEdges S M ↔ e ∈ M.val

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.odd_compl_of_even

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.onSide_cutMass
statement:
theorem onSide_cutMass (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V)
    (x : E → ℝ) (T : Finset (Option {v // v ∈ S})) :
    (G.onSide S).cutMass (fun e => x e.val) T = G.cutMass x (liftVertices S T)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.onSide_cut_crosses
statement:
theorem onSide_cut_crosses (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V)
    (T : Finset (Option {v // v ∈ S})) (e : {e // G.left e ∈ S ∨ G.right e ∈ S}) :
    (G.onSide S).Crosses T e ↔ G.Crosses (liftVertices S T) e.val

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.onSide_degree_none
statement:
theorem onSide_degree_none (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V) (x : E → ℝ) :

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.onSide_degree_some
statement:
theorem onSide_degree_some (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V)
    (x : E → ℝ) (v : {v // v ∈ S}) :
    (G.onSide S).degree (fun e => x e.val) (some v) = G.degree x v.val

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.onSide_incident_none
statement:
theorem onSide_incident_none (G : LooplessGraph V E) (S : Finset V)
    (e : {e // G.left e ∈ S ∨ G.right e ∈ S}) :

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.onSide_incident_some

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.covariance_contradiction
statement:
theorem covariance_contradiction {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {C : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hC : C.PosSemidef) {a m s : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hs : 8*m < s) (hrank : s-4*m ≤ C.rank)
    (htrace : C.trace = s-m) (ha : 8*m/s ≤ a)
    (hsecond : ∀ u : ι → ℝ,
      (a-1) * ((C *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ (C *ᵥ u)) + u ⬝ᵥ (C *ᵥ u) ≤ 0) : False

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.covariance_entry
statement:
theorem covariance_entry {p : A → ℝ} (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (b : A → I → ℝ) (i j : I) :
    covariance p b i j = ∑ a, p a*b a i*b a j

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.covariance_mulVec
statement:
theorem covariance_mulVec {p : A → ℝ} (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (b : A → I → ℝ)
    (u : I → ℝ) (i : I) :
    (covariance p b *ᵥ u) i = ∑ a, p a*b a i*(b a ⬝ᵥ u)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.covariance_posSemidef
statement:
theorem covariance_posSemidef (p : A → ℝ) (b : A → I → ℝ) :
    (covariance p b).PosSemidef

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.covariance_quadratic
statement:
theorem covariance_quadratic {p : A → ℝ} (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (b : A → I → ℝ)
    (u : I → ℝ) : u ⬝ᵥ (covariance p b *ᵥ u) = ∑ a, p a*(b a ⬝ᵥ u)^2

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.covariance_rank
statement:
theorem covariance_rank {p : A → ℝ} (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (b : A → I → ℝ) :
    (covariance p b).rank = Module.finrank ℝ (weightedDirectionSpace p b)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.covariance_rank_bound
statement:
theorem covariance_rank_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {C : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hC : C.PosSemidef) {a : ℝ}
    (hsecond : ∀ u : ι → ℝ,
      (a - 1) * ((C *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ (C *ᵥ u)) + u ⬝ᵥ (C *ᵥ u) ≤ 0) :
    (C.rank : ℝ) ≤ (1-a) * C.trace

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.normalizedCentered_mean
statement:
theorem normalizedCentered_mean {p : A → ℝ} (hp : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (v : A → I → ℝ) (x : I → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, ∑ a, p a*v a i = x i) (i : I) :
    ∑ a, p a*normalizedCentered v x a i = 0

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.normalizedCentered_variance
statement:
theorem normalizedCentered_variance {p : A → ℝ} (hp : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (v : A → I → ℝ) (hv : ∀ a i, (v a i)^2=v a i) (x : I → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, ∑ a, p a*v a i = x i) (hxp : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (i : I) :
    ∑ a, p a*(normalizedCentered v x a i)^2 = 1-x i

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.normalized_covariance_trace
statement:
theorem normalized_covariance_trace {p : A → ℝ} (hp : p ∈ probabilitySimplex A)
    (v : A → I → ℝ) (hv : ∀ a i, (v a i)^2=v a i) (x : I → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, ∑ a, p a*v a i = x i) (hxp : ∀ i, 0 < x i) :
    (covariance p (normalizedCentered v x)).trace = Fintype.card I - ∑ i, x i

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.weightedColumns_span

theorem finitePolyhedron_eventually_expand (L : I → (J → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (b : I → ℝ)

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.quotient_finrank_le_pair
statement:
theorem quotient_finrank_le_pair (U : Submodule ℝ A) (W : Submodule ℝ B) (Z : Submodule ℝ C)

    (h : ∀ u, f u ∈ W → g u ∈ Z → u ∈ U) :

name: OAI.MatchingEntropy.LooplessGraph.odd_family_bound

    (U : Finset V) (T : C → Finset V)
    (hodd : ∀ c, Odd (T c).card)
    (hdisj : ∀ c v, v ∈ T c → v ∉ U)
    (huniq : ∀ a b v, v ∈ T a → v ∈ T b → a=b)
    (hclosed : ∀ e, 0 < x e → G.left e ∉ U → G.right e ∉ U →
      ∀ c, G.left e ∈ T c ↔ G.right e ∈ T c) :
    Fintype.card C ≤ U.card
