theorem exists_rightCovers_iff {r : V → V → Prop} {C : Finset (V × V)}
    {z : V × V} : (∃ b ∈ C, RightCovers r b z) ↔ z ∈ rightImage r C

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.leftImage_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem leftImage_empty (r : V → V → Prop) : leftImage r ∅ = ∅

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.leftImage_mono
statement:
theorem leftImage_mono (r : V → V → Prop) {R R' : Finset (V × V)}
    (h : R ⊆ R') : leftImage r R ⊆ leftImage r R'

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.mem_H
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_H {r : V → V → Prop} {R C : Finset (V × V)} {h : V × V} :
    h ∈ H r R C ↔
      ∃ i j, (h.1, j) ∈ R ∧ (i, h.2) ∈ C ∧ r h.1 i ∧ r h.2 j

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.mem_Z
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_Z {r : V → V → Prop} {R C : Finset (V × V)} {z : V × V} :
    z ∈ Z r R C ↔
      ∃ p s, (p, z.2) ∈ R ∧ (z.1, s) ∈ C ∧ r p z.1 ∧ r s z.2

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.mem_leftImage
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_leftImage {r : V → V → Prop} {R : Finset (V × V)}
    {z : V × V} : z ∈ leftImage r R ↔ ∃ p, (p, z.2) ∈ R ∧ r p z.1

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.mem_rightImage
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_rightImage {r : V → V → Prop} {C : Finset (V × V)}
    {z : V × V} : z ∈ rightImage r C ↔ ∃ s, (z.1, s) ∈ C ∧ r s z.2

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.mem_uncoveredZ
OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.pruningResult_self
statement:
theorem pruningResult_self {r : V → V → Prop} {R C : Finset (V × V)}
    (h : ConflictFree r R C) : PruningResult r R C R C

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.rightImage_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem rightImage_empty (r : V → V → Prop) : rightImage r ∅ = ∅

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.rightImage_mono
statement:
theorem rightImage_mono (r : V → V → Prop) {C C' : Finset (V × V)}
    (h : C ⊆ C') : rightImage r C ⊆ rightImage r C'

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.uncoveredZ_eq_sdiff
statement:
theorem uncoveredZ_eq_sdiff (r : V → V → Prop) (R C R' C' : Finset (V × V)) :
    uncoveredZ r R C R' C' = Z r R C \ (leftImage r R' ∪ rightImage r C')

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.alphaEdges_image
statement:
theorem alphaEdges_image
    {M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C)}
    (hM : IsMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M) :
    (alphaEdges M).image alphaLift = M.filter (fun e => e.2.isRight)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.alphaEdges_isMatching
statement:
theorem alphaEdges_isMatching
    {M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C)}
    (hM : IsMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M) :
    IsMatching (AlphaRelation r R C) (alphaEdges M)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.alphaLift_injective
statement:
theorem alphaLift_injective :
    Function.Injective (alphaLift (r := r) (R := R) (C := C))

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.augmented_matching_card
statement:
theorem augmented_matching_card
    {M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C)}
    (hM : IsMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M) :
    M.card = (originalEdges M).card + (alphaEdges M).card + (betaEdges M).card

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.augmented_matching_eq_three_images
statement:
theorem augmented_matching_eq_three_images
    {M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C)}
    (hM : IsMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M) :
    M = (originalEdges M).image originalLift ∪
      (alphaEdges M).image alphaLift ∪ (betaEdges M).image betaLift

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.betaEdges_image
statement:
theorem betaEdges_image
    {M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C)}
    (hM : IsMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M) :
    (betaEdges M).image betaLift = M.filter (fun e => e.1.isRight)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.betaEdges_isMatching
statement:
theorem betaEdges_isMatching
    {M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C)}
    (hM : IsMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M) :
    IsMatching (BetaRelation r R C) (betaEdges M)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.betaLift_injective
statement:
theorem betaLift_injective :
    Function.Injective (betaLift (r := r) (R := R) (C := C))

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.mem_alphaEdges
OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.mem_betaEdges
OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.mem_originalEdges
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_originalEdges
    {M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C)} {e : ↥R × ↥C} :
    e ∈ originalEdges M ↔ originalLift e ∈ M

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.originalEdges_isMatching
statement:
theorem originalEdges_isMatching
    {M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C)}
    (hM : IsMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M) :
    IsMatching (OriginalRelation r R C) (originalEdges M)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.originalLift_injective
statement:
theorem originalLift_injective :
    Function.Injective (originalLift (r := r) (R := R) (C := C))

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.original_alpha_left_ne
statement:
theorem original_alpha_left_ne
    {M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C)}
    (hM : IsMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M)
    {e : ↥R × ↥C} (he : e ∈ originalEdges M)
    {a : ↥(Z r R C) × ↥R} (ha : a ∈ alphaEdges M) : e.1 ≠ a.2

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.original_beta_right_ne
statement:
theorem original_beta_right_ne
    {M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C)}
    (hM : IsMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M)
    {e : ↥R × ↥C} (he : e ∈ originalEdges M)
    {b : ↥(Z r R C) × ↥C} (hb : b ∈ betaEdges M) : e.2 ≠ b.2

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Bipartite.exists_matching_one_larger_saturating_left
statement:
theorem exists_matching_one_larger_saturating_left [Fintype L] [Fintype R]
    [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R]
    {M N : Finset (L × R)} (hM : IsMatching E M) (hN : IsMatching E N)
    (hcard : M.card < N.card) :
    ∃ Q : Finset (L × R), IsMatching E Q ∧ Q.card = M.card + 1 ∧
      M.image Prod.fst ⊆ Q.image Prod.fst

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Bipartite.exists_matching_saturating_left_of_card_lt
statement:
theorem exists_matching_saturating_left_of_card_lt [Fintype L] [Fintype R]
    [DecidableEq L] [DecidableEq R]
    {M N : Finset (L × R)} (hM : IsMatching E M) (hN : IsMatching E N)
    (hcard : M.card < N.card) :
    ∃ Q : Finset (L × R), IsMatching E Q ∧ Q.card = N.card ∧
      M.image Prod.fst ⊆ Q.image Prod.fst

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Bipartite.IsMatching.swap
statement:
theorem IsMatching.swap {M : Finset (L × R)} (hM : IsMatching E M) :
    IsMatching (fun b a => E a b) (swapMatching M)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Bipartite.IsMaximumMatching.swap
OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Bipartite.card_filter_swapMatching
statement:
@[simp] theorem card_filter_swapMatching (M : Finset (L × R))
    (p : R × L → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    ((swapMatching M).filter p).card = (M.filter (fun e => p e.swap)).card

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Bipartite.card_swapMatching
statement:
@[simp] theorem card_swapMatching (M : Finset (L × R)) :
    (swapMatching M).card = M.card

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Bipartite.exists_maximum_matching_with_maximum_blocks
statement:
theorem exists_maximum_matching_with_maximum_blocks
    (P : L → Prop) (Q : R → Prop) [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q]
    (hblock : ∀ a b, E a b → Q b → P a) :
    ∃ M : Finset (L × R), IsMaximumMatching E M ∧
      IsMaximumMatching (fun a b => E a b ∧ Q b)
        (M.filter (fun e => Q e.2)) ∧
      IsMaximumMatching (fun a b => E a b ∧ ¬P a)
        (M.filter (fun e => ¬P e.1))

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Bipartite.filter_swapMatching
statement:
theorem filter_swapMatching (M : Finset (L × R))
    (p : R × L → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    (swapMatching M).filter p = swapMatching (M.filter (fun e => p e.swap))

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Bipartite.isMaximumMatching_leftBlock_of_minimum_crossing
statement:
theorem isMaximumMatching_leftBlock_of_minimum_crossing
    (P : L → Prop) (Q : R → Prop) [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q]
    (hblock : ∀ a b, E a b → Q b → P a)
    {M : Finset (L × R)} (hM : IsMaximumMatching E M)
    (hmin : ∀ N : Finset (L × R), IsMaximumMatching E N →
      (M.filter (fun e => P e.1 ∧ ¬Q e.2)).card ≤
        (N.filter (fun e => P e.1 ∧ ¬Q e.2)).card) :
    IsMaximumMatching (fun a b => E a b ∧ ¬P a)
      (M.filter (fun e => ¬P e.1))

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Bipartite.isMaximumMatching_rightBlock_of_minimum_crossing
statement:
theorem isMaximumMatching_rightBlock_of_minimum_crossing
    (P : L → Prop) (Q : R → Prop) [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q]
    (hblock : ∀ a b, E a b → Q b → P a)
    {M : Finset (L × R)} (hM : IsMaximumMatching E M)
    (hmin : ∀ N : Finset (L × R), IsMaximumMatching E N →
      (M.filter (fun e => P e.1 ∧ ¬Q e.2)).card ≤
        (N.filter (fun e => P e.1 ∧ ¬Q e.2)).card) :
    IsMaximumMatching (fun a b => E a b ∧ Q b)
      (M.filter (fun e => Q e.2))

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Bipartite.mem_swapMatching
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_swapMatching {M : Finset (L × R)} {e : R × L} :
    e ∈ swapMatching M ↔ e.swap ∈ M

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Bipartite.swapMatching_swapMatching
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapMatching_swapMatching (M : Finset (L × R)) :
    swapMatching (swapMatching M) = M

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.alphaEdges_isMaximumMatching
statement:
theorem alphaEdges_isMaximumMatching
    {M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C)}
    (hM : IsMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M)
    (hα : IsMaximumMatching
      (fun a b => AugmentedEdge r R C a b ∧ b.isRight)
      (M.filter (fun e => e.2.isRight))) :
    IsMaximumMatching (AlphaRelation r R C) (alphaEdges M)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.betaEdges_isMaximumMatching
statement:
theorem betaEdges_isMaximumMatching
    {M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C)}
    (hM : IsMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M)
    (hβ : IsMaximumMatching
      (fun a b => AugmentedEdge r R C a b ∧ ¬a.isLeft)
      (M.filter (fun e => ¬e.1.isLeft))) :
    IsMaximumMatching (BetaRelation r R C) (betaEdges M)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.exists_augmented_maximum_matching
statement:
theorem exists_augmented_maximum_matching (r : V → V → Prop)
    (R C : Finset (V × V)) :
    ∃ M : Finset (LeftVertex r R C × RightVertex r R C),
      IsMaximumMatching (AugmentedEdge r R C) M ∧
      IsMaximumMatching (AlphaRelation r R C) (alphaEdges M) ∧
      IsMaximumMatching (BetaRelation r R C) (betaEdges M)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.SupportedCoefficients.of_ne_zero
OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixA_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixA_apply (r : V → V → Prop) (R C : Finset (V × V))
    (a : V → V → ℝ) (right : ↥C) (h : ↥(H r R C)) :
    matrixA r R C a right h =
      if right.val.2 = h.val.2 then a h.val.1 right.val.1 else 0

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixB_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixB_apply (r : V → V → Prop) (R C : Finset (V × V))
    (b : V → V → ℝ) (h : ↥(H r R C)) (left : ↥R) :
    matrixB r R C b h left =
      if h.val.1 = left.val.1 then b h.val.2 left.val.2 else 0

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixL_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixL_apply (r : V → V → Prop) (R C : Finset (V × V))
    (a : V → V → ℝ) (z : ↥(Z r R C)) (left : ↥R) :
    matrixL r R C a z left =
      if z.val.2 = left.val.2 then a left.val.1 z.val.1 else 0

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixN_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixN_apply (r : V → V → Prop) (R C : Finset (V × V))
    (b : V → V → ℝ) (right : ↥C) (z : ↥(Z r R C)) :
    matrixN r R C b right z =
      if right.val.1 = z.val.1 then b right.val.2 z.val.2 else 0

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.fiberIndex_injective
statement:
theorem fiberIndex_injective (P : Finset (X × X)) (p : X) :
    Function.Injective (fiberIndex P p)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixB_mulVec_fiber
statement:
theorem matrixB_mulVec_fiber (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X))
    (b : X → X → ℝ) (u : ↥R → ℝ) (p s : X)
    (hps : (p, s) ∈ H r R C) :
    (matrixB r R C b *ᵥ u) ⟨(p, s), hps⟩ =
      ∑ j : PairFiber R p, b s j.1 * u (fiberIndex R p j)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixN_transpose_mulVec_fiber
statement:
theorem matrixN_transpose_mulVec_fiber (r : X → X → Prop)
    (R C : Finset (X × X)) (b : X → X → ℝ) (v : ↥C → ℝ) (i j : X)
    (hij : (i, j) ∈ Z r R C) :
    ((matrixN r R C b)ᵀ *ᵥ v) ⟨(i, j), hij⟩ =
      ∑ s : PairFiber C i, b s.1 j * v (fiberIndex C i s)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.mem_range_fiberIndex
statement:
theorem mem_range_fiberIndex (P : Finset (X × X)) (p : X) (q : ↥P) :
    q ∈ Set.range (fiberIndex P p) ↔ q.1.1 = p

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.restrictFiber_mem_kernelD
statement:
theorem restrictFiber_mem_kernelD (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X))
    (b : X → X → ℝ) (hb : SupportedCoefficients r b) (p i : X)
    (hpi : r p i) (u : ↥R → ℝ) (hu : matrixB r R C b *ᵥ u = 0) :
    matrixD R C b p i *ᵥ restrictFiber R p u = 0

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.restrictFiber_mem_kernelD_transpose
statement:
theorem restrictFiber_mem_kernelD_transpose (r : X → X → Prop)
    (R C : Finset (X × X)) (b : X → X → ℝ) (hb : SupportedCoefficients r b)
    (p i : X) (hpi : r p i) (v : ↥C → ℝ)
    (hv : (matrixN r R C b)ᵀ *ᵥ v = 0) :
    (matrixD R C b p i)ᵀ *ᵥ restrictFiber C i v = 0

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.LinearAlgebra.MaxSupportKernel.kernel_support
statement:
theorem kernel_support {T : Set (I × J)} {D : Matrix I J ℝ}
    (hD : SupportedOn T D)
    (hmax : ∀ A : Matrix I J ℝ, SupportedOn T A → A.rank ≤ D.rank)
    {x : J → ℝ} {y : I → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.ker D.mulVecLin)
    (hy : y ∈ LinearMap.ker Dᵀ.mulVecLin)
    {s : I} {j : J} (hsj : (s, j) ∈ T) :
    x j * y s = 0

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.LinearAlgebra.MaxSupportKernel.kernel_support_of_max_rank
statement:
theorem kernel_support_of_max_rank {T : Set (I × J)} {D : Matrix I J ℝ}
    (hD : SupportedOn T D)
    (hmax : ∀ A : Matrix I J ℝ, SupportedOn T A → A.rank ≤ D.rank)
    {x : J → ℝ} {y : I → ℝ}
    (hx : D *ᵥ x = 0) (hy : Dᵀ *ᵥ y = 0)
    {s : I} {j : J} (hsj : (s, j) ∈ T) :
    x j * y s = 0

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.LinearAlgebra.MaxSupportKernel.range_lt_range_add_single
statement:
theorem range_lt_range_add_single [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (D : Matrix I J ℝ) {x : J → ℝ} {y : I → ℝ}
    (hx : D *ᵥ x = 0) (hy : Dᵀ *ᵥ y = 0)
    (s : I) (j : J) (hxj : x j ≠ 0) (hys : y s ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin <
      LinearMap.range (D + Matrix.single s j (1 : ℝ)).mulVecLin

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.conflict_kernel_product_eq_zero
statement:
theorem conflict_kernel_product_eq_zero (r : X → X → Prop)
    (R C : Finset (X × X)) (b : X → X → ℝ) (hb : SupportedCoefficients r b)
    (hmax : LocalMaximalRanks r R C b)
    (u : ↥R → ℝ) (hu : matrixB r R C b *ᵥ u = 0)
    (v : ↥C → ℝ) (hv : (matrixN r R C b)ᵀ *ᵥ v = 0)
    (left : ↥R) (right : ↥C) (hc : Conflict r left.1 right.1) :
    u left * v right = 0

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixD_supported
statement:
theorem matrixD_supported (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X))
    (b : X → X → ℝ) (hb : SupportedCoefficients r b) (p i : X) :
    SupportedOn (localSupport r R C p i) (matrixD R C b p i)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixA_mul_matrixB_apply
statement:
theorem matrixA_mul_matrixB_apply
    (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X)) (a b : X → X → ℝ)
    (ha : SupportedCoefficients r a) (hb : SupportedCoefficients r b)
    (right : {right : X × X // right ∈ C})
    (left : {left : X × X // left ∈ R}) :
    (matrixA r R C a * matrixB r R C b) right left =
      a left.val.1 right.val.1 * b right.val.2 left.val.2

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixN_mul_matrixL_apply
statement:
theorem matrixN_mul_matrixL_apply
    (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X)) (a b : X → X → ℝ)
    (ha : SupportedCoefficients r a) (hb : SupportedCoefficients r b)
    (right : {right : X × X // right ∈ C})
    (left : {left : X × X // left ∈ R}) :
    (matrixN r R C b * matrixL r R C a) right left =
      a left.val.1 right.val.1 * b right.val.2 left.val.2

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixN_mul_matrixL_eq_matrixA_mul_matrixB
statement:
theorem matrixN_mul_matrixL_eq_matrixA_mul_matrixB
    (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X)) (a b : X → X → ℝ)
    (ha : SupportedCoefficients r a) (hb : SupportedCoefficients r b) :
    matrixN r R C b * matrixL r R C a = matrixA r R C a * matrixB r R C b

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.card_add_rank_matrixN_mul_matrixL_le_card_H_of_lifts
statement:
theorem card_add_rank_matrixN_mul_matrixL_le_card_H_of_lifts
    {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X)) (a b : X → X → ℝ)
    (ha : SupportedCoefficients r a) (hb : SupportedCoefficients r b)
    (hmax : LocalMaximalRanks r R C b)
    (left : E → ↥R) (right : E → ↥C)
    (U : E → (↥R → ℝ)) (W : E → (↥C → ℝ))
    (hU : ∀ e, matrixL r R C a *ᵥ U e = 0)
    (hW : ∀ e, (matrixN r R C b)ᵀ *ᵥ W e = 0)
    (hWcoordinate : ∀ e, W e (right e) = 1)
    (hUcoordinate : ∀ e f, U e (left f) = if e = f then 1 else 0)
    (hconflict : ∀ e, Conflict r (left e).val (right e).val) :
    Fintype.card E + (matrixN r R C b * matrixL r R C a).rank ≤ (H r R C).card

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.card_le_finrank_ker_matrixA_of_lifts
statement:
theorem card_le_finrank_ker_matrixA_of_lifts
    {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X)) (a b : X → X → ℝ)
    (ha : SupportedCoefficients r a) (hb : SupportedCoefficients r b)
    (hmax : LocalMaximalRanks r R C b)
    (left : E → ↥R) (right : E → ↥C)
    (U : E → (↥R → ℝ)) (W : E → (↥C → ℝ))
    (hU : ∀ e, matrixL r R C a *ᵥ U e = 0)
    (hW : ∀ e, (matrixN r R C b)ᵀ *ᵥ W e = 0)
    (hWcoordinate : ∀ e, W e (right e) = 1)
    (hUcoordinate : ∀ e f, U e (left f) = if e = f then 1 else 0)
    (hconflict : ∀ e, Conflict r (left e).val (right e).val) :
    Fintype.card E ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (matrixA r R C a).mulVecLin)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.kernelB_vanishes_at_matched_left
statement:
theorem kernelB_vanishes_at_matched_left
    (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X)) (b : X → X → ℝ)
    (hb : SupportedCoefficients r b) (hmax : LocalMaximalRanks r R C b)
    (left : ↥R) (right : ↥C) (hc : Conflict r left.val right.val)
    (v : ↥C → ℝ) (hv : (matrixN r R C b)ᵀ *ᵥ v = 0)
    (hcoordinate : v right = 1)
    (u : ↥R → ℝ) (hu : matrixB r R C b *ᵥ u = 0) : u left = 0

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixB_lift_mem_ker_matrixA
statement:
theorem matrixB_lift_mem_ker_matrixA
    (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X)) (a b : X → X → ℝ)
    (ha : SupportedCoefficients r a) (hb : SupportedCoefficients r b)
    (u : ↥R → ℝ) (hu : matrixL r R C a *ᵥ u = 0) :
    matrixB r R C b *ᵥ u ∈ LinearMap.ker (matrixA r R C a).mulVecLin

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixB_lifts_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem matrixB_lifts_linearIndependent
    {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X)) (b : X → X → ℝ)
    (hb : SupportedCoefficients r b) (hmax : LocalMaximalRanks r R C b)
    (left : E → ↥R) (right : E → ↥C)
    (U : E → (↥R → ℝ)) (W : E → (↥C → ℝ))
    (hW : ∀ e, (matrixN r R C b)ᵀ *ᵥ W e = 0)
    (hWcoordinate : ∀ e, W e (right e) = 1)
    (hUcoordinate : ∀ e f, U e (left f) = if e = f then 1 else 0)
    (hconflict : ∀ e, Conflict r (left e).val (right e).val) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (fun e => matrixB r R C b *ᵥ U e)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.card_add_rank_matrixL_add_rank_matrixN_le_card_Z_add_card_H_of_lifts
statement:
theorem card_add_rank_matrixL_add_rank_matrixN_le_card_Z_add_card_H_of_lifts
    {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X)) (a b : X → X → ℝ)
    (ha : SupportedCoefficients r a) (hb : SupportedCoefficients r b)
    (hmax : LocalMaximalRanks r R C b)
    (left : E → ↥R) (right : E → ↥C)
    (U : E → (↥R → ℝ)) (W : E → (↥C → ℝ))
    (hU : ∀ e, matrixL r R C a *ᵥ U e = 0)
    (hW : ∀ e, (matrixN r R C b)ᵀ *ᵥ W e = 0)
    (hWcoordinate : ∀ e, W e (right e) = 1)
    (hUcoordinate : ∀ e f, U e (left f) = if e = f then 1 else 0)
    (hconflict : ∀ e, Conflict r (left e).val (right e).val) :
    Fintype.card E + (matrixL r R C a).rank + (matrixN r R C b).rank ≤
      (Z r R C).card + (H r R C).card

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixL_rank_add_matrixN_rank_le_rank_composite_add_card_Z
statement:
theorem matrixL_rank_add_matrixN_rank_le_rank_composite_add_card_Z
    (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X)) (a b : X → X → ℝ) :
    (matrixL r R C a).rank + (matrixN r R C b).rank ≤
      (matrixN r R C b * matrixL r R C a).rank + (Z r R C).card

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrix_rank_add_rank_le_rank_mul_add_card
statement:
theorem matrix_rank_add_rank_le_rank_mul_add_card

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.det_blockSupportedVariables_ne_zero

theorem det_blockSupportedVariables_ne_zero

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.det_matchingMinor_ne_zero

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Bipartite.exists_vertexCover_card_eq_of_isMaximumMatching
statement:
theorem exists_vertexCover_card_eq_of_isMaximumMatching {M : Finset (L × R)}

    ∃ A : Finset L, ∃ B : Finset R,
      IsVertexCover E A B ∧ A.card + B.card = M.card ∧

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.exists_eval_maximal_support_rank
statement:
theorem exists_eval_maximal_support_rank

      label k i j = label k i' j' → i = i' ∧ j = j')
    (extra : τ → MvPolynomial σ K) (hextra : ∀ t, extra t ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a : σ → K, (∀ t, MvPolynomial.eval a (extra t) ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ k (D : Matrix (I k) (J k) K),
        (∀ i j, ¬ support k i j → D i j = 0) →
        D.rank ≤ (evalPolynomialMatrix a
          (supportedVariableMatrix (R := K) (support k) (label k))).rank

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.rank_eq_card_of_maximum_matching_minor
statement:
theorem rank_eq_card_of_maximum_matching_minor

    {support : I → J → Prop} {matching : Finset (I × J)}
    [DecidableEq ↥matching]
    (hmatching : IsMaximumMatching support matching) (D : Matrix I J K)
    (hD : ∀ i j, ¬ support i j → D i j = 0)
    (hdet : (D.submatrix (fun e : ↥matching => e.1.1)
      (fun e : ↥matching => e.1.2)).det ≠ 0) : D.rank = matching.card

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.exists_coefficients_localMaximalRanks
statement:
theorem exists_coefficients_localMaximalRanks
    (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X))
    (extra : τ → MvPolynomial (CoefficientVariables X) ℝ)
    (hextra : ∀ t, extra t ≠ 0) :
    ∃ v : CoefficientVariables X → ℝ,
      (∀ t, MvPolynomial.eval v (extra t) ≠ 0) ∧
      SupportedCoefficients r (selectedA r v) ∧
      SupportedCoefficients r (selectedB r v) ∧
      LocalMaximalRanks r R C (selectedB r v)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixD_eq_eval_supported
statement:
theorem matrixD_eq_eval_supported (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X))
    (v : CoefficientVariables X → ℝ) (p i : X) :
    matrixD R C (selectedB r v) p i = evalPolynomialMatrix v
      (supportedVariableMatrix (R := ℝ)
        (fun s : PairFiber C i => fun j : PairFiber R p => r s.1 j.1)
        (fun s j => Sum.inr (s.1, j.1)))

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.selectedB_supported

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.eval_matrixNPolynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_matrixNPolynomial (r : X → X → Prop)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.eval_matrixNPolynomial_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_matrixNPolynomial_transpose (r : X → X → Prop)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixLPolynomial_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixLPolynomial_apply (r : X → X → Prop)
    (R C : Finset (X × X)) (z : ↥(Z r R C)) (left : ↥R) :
    matrixLPolynomial r R C z left =
      if z.1.2 = left.1.2 ∧ r left.1.1 z.1.1
      then MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl (left.1.1, z.1.1)) else 0

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixNPolynomial_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixNPolynomial_apply (r : X → X → Prop)
    (R C : Finset (X × X)) (right : ↥C) (z : ↥(Z r R C)) :
    matrixNPolynomial r R C right z =
      if right.1.1 = z.1.1 ∧ r right.1.2 z.1.2
      then MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr (right.1.2, z.1.2)) else 0

statement:

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixLSupport_iff_leftCovers
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixLSupport_iff_leftCovers (r : X → X → Prop)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixNTransposeSupport_iff_rightCovers
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixNTransposeSupport_iff_rightCovers (r : X → X → Prop)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.exists_pruning_rank_coefficients
statement:
theorem exists_pruning_rank_coefficients
    (r : X → X → Prop) (R C : Finset (X × X))
    (α : Finset (↥(Z r R C) × ↥R)) (β : Finset (↥(Z r R C) × ↥C))
    (hα : IsMaximumMatching (matrixLSupport r R C) α)
    (hβ : IsMaximumMatching (matrixNTransposeSupport r R C) β) :
    ∃ v : CoefficientVariables X → ℝ,
      SupportedCoefficients r (selectedA r v) ∧
      SupportedCoefficients r (selectedB r v) ∧
      LocalMaximalRanks r R C (selectedB r v) ∧
      ((matrixL r R C (selectedA r v)).submatrix
        (fun e : ↥α => e.1.1) (fun e : ↥α => e.1.2)).det ≠ 0 ∧
      (((matrixN r R C (selectedB r v))ᵀ).submatrix
        (fun e : ↥β => e.1.1) (fun e : ↥β => e.1.2)).det ≠ 0 ∧
      (matrixL r R C (selectedA r v)).rank = α.card ∧
      ((matrixN r R C (selectedB r v))ᵀ).rank = β.card

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.matrixL_supported_on_matchingSupport
statement:
theorem matrixL_supported_on_matchingSupport (r : X → X → Prop)

      (matrixN r R C (selectedB r v))ᵀ z right = 0

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.exists_normalized_kernelLifts
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_kernelLifts [DecidableEq E]
    (M : Matrix I J F) (col : κ → J)
    (cover : ∀ x : J → F, ∃ y : κ → F,
      M *ᵥ x = (M.submatrix id col) *ᵥ y)
    (left : E → J) (hleft : Function.Injective left)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ e k, left e ≠ col k) :
    ∃ U : E → J → F, (∀ e, M *ᵥ U e = 0) ∧
      (∀ e f, U e (left f) = if e = f then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.exists_normalized_kernelLifts_of_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_kernelLifts_of_det_ne_zero
    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq κ] [DecidableEq E]
    (M : Matrix I J F) (row : κ → I) (col : κ → J)
    (hdet : (M.submatrix row col).det ≠ 0) (hrank : M.rank ≤ Fintype.card κ)
    (left : E → J) (hleft : Function.Injective left)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ e k, left e ≠ col k) :
    ∃ U : E → J → F, (∀ e, M *ᵥ U e = 0) ∧
      (∀ e f, U e (left f) = if e = f then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.extendSelected_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem extendSelected_apply_of_ne (col : κ → J) (y : κ → F) (j : J)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.kernelLift_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem kernelLift_apply_of_ne (M : Matrix I J F) (col : κ → J)
    (cover : ∀ x : J → F, ∃ y : κ → F,
      M *ᵥ x = (M.submatrix id col) *ᵥ y) (j j' : J)
    (hj' : ∀ k, j' ≠ col k) :
    kernelLift M col cover j j' = (Pi.single j 1 : J → F) j'

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.kernelLift_eq
statement:
theorem kernelLift_eq (M : Matrix I J F) (col : κ → J)
    (cover : ∀ x : J → F, ∃ y : κ → F,
      M *ᵥ x = (M.submatrix id col) *ᵥ y) (j : J) :
    kernelLift M col cover j =
      Pi.single j 1 - ∑ k, Pi.single (col k) (liftCoefficients M col cover j k)

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.kernelLift_normalized
statement:
theorem kernelLift_normalized [DecidableEq E]
    (M : Matrix I J F) (col : κ → J)
    (cover : ∀ x : J → F, ∃ y : κ → F,
      M *ᵥ x = (M.submatrix id col) *ᵥ y)
    (left : E → J) (hleft : Function.Injective left)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ e k, left e ≠ col k) (e f : E) :
    kernelLift M col cover (left e) (left f) = if e = f then 1 else 0

name: OAI.SeymourSecondNeighborhood.Pruning.liftCoefficients_spec
statement:
theorem liftCoefficients_spec (M : Matrix I J F) (col : κ → J)
    (cover : ∀ x : J → F, ∃ y : κ → F,
      M *ᵥ x = (M.submatrix id col) *ᵥ y) (j : J) :
    M *ᵥ Pi.single j 1 = (M.submatrix id col) *ᵥ liftCoefficients M col cover j

name: OAI.Paper320.flip_differences
statement:
theorem flip_differences (x y : I → Bool) :
    flip x (Finset.univ.filter fun i => x i ≠ y i) = y

name: OAI.Paper320.flip_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem flip_empty (x : I → Bool) : flip x ∅ = x

name: OAI.Paper320.flip_false
statement:
@[simp] theorem flip_false (B : Finset I) (i : I) :
    flip (fun _ => false) B i = decide (i ∈ B)

name: OAI.Paper320.flip_flip
statement: @[simp] theorem flip_flip (x : I → Bool) (B : Finset I) : flip (flip x B) B = x

name: OAI.Paper320.flip_insert
statement:
theorem flip_insert (x : I → Bool) (i : I) (B : Finset I) (hi : i ∉ B) :
    flip x (insert i B) = flip (flip x B) {i}

name: OAI.Paper320.flip_prod_other
statement:
theorem flip_prod_other (x : J × I → Bool) {j k : J} (i : I) (hk : k ≠ j) :
    (fun a => flip x {(j, i)} (k, a)) = fun a => x (k, a)

name: OAI.Paper320.flip_prod_same
statement:
theorem flip_prod_same (x : J × I → Bool) (j : J) (i : I) :
    (fun a => flip x {(j, i)} (j, a)) = flip (fun a => x (j, a)) {i}

name: OAI.Paper320.flip_singleton_other
statement:
theorem flip_singleton_other (x : I → Bool) {i j : I} (h : j ≠ i) :
    flip x {i} j = x j

name: OAI.Paper320.flip_singleton_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem flip_singleton_self (x : I → Bool) (i : I) :
    flip x {i} i = !(x i)

name: OAI.Paper320.le_blockSensitivityAt
statement:
theorem le_blockSensitivityAt (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (x : I → Bool)
    (blocks : Finset (Finset I))
    (hd : ∀ A ∈ blocks, ∀ B ∈ blocks, A ≠ B → Disjoint A B)
    (hb : ∀ B ∈ blocks, B.Nonempty ∧ f (flip x B) ≠ f x) :
    blocks.card ≤ blockSensitivityAt f x

name: OAI.Paper320.le_blockSensitivityAt_of_family
statement:
theorem le_blockSensitivityAt_of_family [Fintype K]
    (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (x : I → Bool) (blocks : K → Finset I)
    (hne : ∀ k, (blocks k).Nonempty)
    (hd : Pairwise fun k l => Disjoint (blocks k) (blocks l))
    (hb : ∀ k, f (flip x (blocks k)) ≠ f x) :
    Fintype.card K ≤ blockSensitivityAt f x

name: OAI.Paper320.sensitivityAt_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem sensitivityAt_eq_zero_iff (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (x : I → Bool) :
    sensitivityAt f x = 0 ↔ ∀ i, f (flip x {i}) = f x

name: OAI.Paper320.sensitivityAt_le_card
statement:
theorem sensitivityAt_le_card (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (x : I → Bool) :
    sensitivityAt f x ≤ Fintype.card I

name: OAI.Paper320.sensitivityAt_le_sensitivity
statement:
theorem sensitivityAt_le_sensitivity (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (x : I → Bool) :
    sensitivityAt f x ≤ sensitivity f

name: OAI.Paper320.sensitivityAt_pos
statement:
theorem sensitivityAt_pos (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (x : I → Bool) (i : I)
    (hi : f (flip x {i}) ≠ f x) : 0 < sensitivityAt f x

name: OAI.Paper320.sensitivity_le
statement:
theorem sensitivity_le (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) {n : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ x, sensitivityAt f x ≤ n) : sensitivity f ≤ n

name: OAI.Paper320.sensitivity_pos_of_nonconstant
statement:
theorem sensitivity_pos_of_nonconstant (f : (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (h : ∃ x y, f x ≠ f y) : 0 < sensitivity f

name: OAI.Paper320.blockSensitivityAt_compose_zero_le
statement:
theorem blockSensitivityAt_compose_zero_le (f : (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (g : (J → Bool) → Bool) (hg : g (fun _ => false) = false) :
    blockSensitivityAt f (fun _ => false) * blockSensitivityAt g (fun _ => false) ≤
      blockSensitivityAt (compose f g) (fun _ => false)

name: OAI.Paper320.compose_flip_product_zero
statement:
theorem compose_flip_product_zero (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (g : (J → Bool) → Bool)
    (C : Finset I) (D : Finset J) (hg : g (fun _ => false) = false)
    (hD : g (flip (fun _ => false) D) ≠ g (fun _ => false)) :
    compose f g (flip (fun _ => false) (C ×ˢ D)) = f (flip (fun _ => false) C)

name: OAI.Paper320.compose_flip_sensitive_iff
statement:
theorem compose_flip_sensitive_iff (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (g : (J → Bool) → Bool)
    (x : I × J → Bool) (i : I) (j : J) :
    compose f g (flip x {(i, j)}) ≠ compose f g x ↔
      g (flip (fun a => x (i, a)) {j}) ≠ g (fun a => x (i, a)) ∧
      f (flip (fun k => g (fun a => x (k, a))) {i}) ≠
        f (fun k => g (fun a => x (k, a)))

name: OAI.Paper320.compose_zero
statement:
theorem compose_zero (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (g : (J → Bool) → Bool)
    (hg : g (fun _ => false) = false) :
    compose f g (fun _ => false) = f (fun _ => false)

name: OAI.Paper320.sensitivityAt_compose
statement:
theorem sensitivityAt_compose (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (g : (J → Bool) → Bool)
    (x : I × J → Bool) :
    sensitivityAt (compose f g) x =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i =>
        f (flip (fun k => g (fun a => x (k, a))) {i}) ≠
          f (fun k => g (fun a => x (k, a)))),
        sensitivityAt g (fun a => x (i, a))

name: OAI.Paper320.sensitivity_compose_le
statement:
theorem sensitivity_compose_le (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (g : (J → Bool) → Bool) :
    sensitivity (compose f g) ≤ sensitivity f * sensitivity g

name: OAI.Paper320.ballPredicate_eq_nearestDistance

name: OAI.Paper320.ballPredicate_eq_true

name: OAI.Paper320.ballPredicate_nested

name: OAI.Paper320.ballPredicate_no_joint_one

name: OAI.Paper320.ballPredicate_no_joint_zero

name: OAI.Paper320.ballPredicate_sensitivityAt_zero_le
statement:
theorem ballPredicate_sensitivityAt_zero_le [Fintype C]
    (centers : C → I → Bool) (R : ℕ)
    (hsep : ∀ a b, a ≠ b → 2 * (R + 1) < hammingDist (centers a) (centers b))

name: OAI.Paper320.ballPredicate_zero_flip
statement:
theorem ballPredicate_zero_flip [Fintype C] (centers : C → I → Bool) (R : ℕ)
    (x : I → Bool) (i : I) (hx : ballPredicate centers R x = false)

name: OAI.Paper320.hammingDist_flip_eq_add_one
statement:
theorem hammingDist_flip_eq_add_one (x z : I → Bool) (i : I) (hi : x i = z i) :

name: OAI.Paper320.hammingDist_flip_le_add_one
statement:
theorem hammingDist_flip_le_add_one (x z : I → Bool) (i : I) :

name: OAI.Paper320.hammingDist_flip_self
statement:
theorem hammingDist_flip_self (x : I → Bool) (i : I) :

name: OAI.Paper320.hammingDist_le_flip_add_one
statement:

name: OAI.Paper320.near_center_unique

name: OAI.Paper320.jointSensitivityAt_le_jointSensitivity

theorem jointSensitivityAt_le_jointSensitivity {h : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]

name: OAI.Paper320.jointSensitivityAt_le_left

theorem jointSensitivityAt_le_left {I : Type} [Fintype I]

name: OAI.Paper320.normalizedMax_le

theorem normalizedMax_le {M s₀ s₁ u : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M)
    (h₀ : s₀ ≤ u * M ^ n) (h₁ : s₁ ≤ u * M ^ (n + 1)) :

name: OAI.Paper320.normalizedMax_nonneg
statement:
theorem normalizedMax_nonneg {M s₀ s₁ : ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hM : 0 < M) (hs₀ : 0 ≤ s₀) : 0 ≤ normalizedMax M n s₀ s₁

name: OAI.Paper320.normalized_profiles_step
statement:
theorem normalized_profiles_step {M r ε : ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hM : 0 < M) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hεr : r / M ≤ ε) (hεt : 16 / M ≤ ε)
    {s₀ s₁ j₀ j₁ s₀' s₁' j₀' j₁' : ℝ} (hs₀ : 0 ≤ s₀) (hj₀ : 0 ≤ j₀)
    (hS₀ : s₀' ≤ 16 * s₀ + s₁ + 3 * j₁)
    (hS₁ : s₁' ≤ M ^ 2 * s₀ + r * s₁)
    (hJ₀ : j₀' ≤ 16 * s₀ + 3 * j₁)
    (hJ₁ : j₁' ≤ M ^ 2 * j₀ + r * s₁) :
    normalizedMax M (n + 1) s₀' s₁' ≤
      (1 + ε) * normalizedMax M n s₀ s₁ + 3 * normalizedMax M n j₀ j₁ ∧
    normalizedMax M (n + 1) j₀' j₁' ≤
      ε * normalizedMax M n s₀ s₁ + 3 * normalizedMax M n j₀ j₁

name: OAI.Paper320.raw_profiles_step
statement:
theorem raw_profiles_step {M r ε u v p : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 < M) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hεr : r ≤ ε * M) (hεt : 16 ≤ ε * M)
    {s₀ s₁ j₀ j₁ s₀' s₁' j₀' j₁' : ℝ}
    (hs₀ : s₀ ≤ u * p) (hs₁ : s₁ ≤ u * (p * M))
    (hj₀ : j₀ ≤ v * p) (hj₁ : j₁ ≤ v * (p * M))
    (hS₀ : s₀' ≤ 16 * s₀ + s₁ + 3 * j₁)
    (hS₁ : s₁' ≤ M ^ 2 * s₀ + r * s₁)
    (hJ₀ : j₀' ≤ 16 * s₀ + 3 * j₁)
    (hJ₁ : j₁' ≤ M ^ 2 * j₀ + r * s₁) :
    s₀' ≤ ((1 + ε) * u + 3 * v) * (p * M) ∧
    s₁' ≤ ((1 + ε) * u + 3 * v) * (p * M * M) ∧
    j₀' ≤ (ε * u + 3 * v) * (p * M) ∧
    j₁' ≤ (ε * u + 3 * v) * (p * M * M)

name: OAI.Paper320.coupled_profiles_bound
statement:
theorem coupled_profiles_bound (d : ℕ) (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (ε L : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hbudget : ε * 3 ^ (d + 1) ≤ 2)
    (hu0 : u 0 ≤ L) (hv0 : v 0 ≤ 0)
    (hu : ∀ n < d, u (n + 1) ≤ (1 + ε) * u n + 3 * v n)
    (hv : ∀ n < d, v (n + 1) ≤ ε * u n + 3 * v n) :
    ∀ n ≤ d, u n ≤ 2 * L ∧ v n ≤ ε * L * (3 ^ n - 1)

name: OAI.Paper320.geometric_error_le
OAI.Paper320.quantitative_profile_bounds
statement:
theorem quantitative_profile_bounds (d L M r : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hbudget : ((max r 16 : ℕ) : ℝ) / M * 3 ^ (d + 1) ≤ 2)
    (S J : ℕ → Bool → ℕ)
    (hS₀ : S 0 false ≤ L) (hS₁ : S 0 true ≤ L * M)
    (hJ₀ : J 0 false = 0) (hJ₁ : J 0 true = 0)
    (hstepS₀ : ∀ n < d, S (n + 1) false ≤ 16 * S n false + S n true + 3 * J n true)
    (hstepS₁ : ∀ n < d, S (n + 1) true ≤ M ^ 2 * S n false + r * S n true)
    (hstepJ₀ : ∀ n < d, J (n + 1) false ≤ 16 * S n false + 3 * J n true)
    (hstepJ₁ : ∀ n < d, J (n + 1) true ≤ M ^ 2 * J n false + r * S n true) :
    ∀ n ≤ d, S n false ≤ 2 * L * M ^ n ∧ S n true ≤ 2 * L * M ^ (n + 1)

name: OAI.Paper320.GoodLabeling.good_implies_card_lt_sixteen
statement:
theorem good_implies_card_lt_sixteen (I : Finset (Fin k)) (m : Fin k → Fin r)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ j ∈ I, T.Adj i j → A.label i j = m j) : I.card < 16

OAI.Paper320.Tournament.ne_of_adj

name: OAI.Paper320.gateIndex_antitone

name: OAI.Paper320.gateIndex_strictAnti

name: OAI.Paper320.recursiveFamily_eq_false_iff
statement:
theorem recursiveFamily_eq_false_iff {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) :
    recursiveFamily T label F q x = false ↔ ∀ i, rowClause T label F q x i = false

name: OAI.Paper320.recursiveFamily_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem recursiveFamily_eq_true_iff {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) :
    recursiveFamily T label F q x = true ↔ ∃ i, rowClause T label F q x i = true

name: OAI.Paper320.recursiveFamily_nested
statement:
theorem recursiveFamily_nested {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (hF : NestedFamily F) : NestedFamily (recursiveFamily T label F)

name: OAI.Paper320.recursiveFamily_zero
statement:
theorem recursiveFamily_zero {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hzero : ∀ q, F q (fun _ => false) = false) (q : Fin h) :
    recursiveFamily T label F q (fun _ => false) = false

name: OAI.Paper320.recursive_coordinates_card
statement:
theorem recursive_coordinates_card {k r : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I] :
    Fintype.card ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) = k * r * Fintype.card I

name: OAI.Paper320.rowClause_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem rowClause_eq_true_iff {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (i : Fin k) :
    rowClause T label F q x i = true ↔
      (∀ c, F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x i c) = true) ∧
      ∀ j, T.Adj i j → F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x j (label i j)) = false

name: OAI.Paper320.rowClause_nested
statement:
theorem rowClause_nested {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (hF : NestedFamily F) {q q' : Fin h} (hqq : q ≤ q')
    (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (i : Fin k)
    (hi : rowClause T label F q' x i = true) : rowClause T label F q x i = true

name: OAI.Paper320.regular_rowChildren_card
statement:
theorem regular_rowChildren_card {M r : ℕ} (T : RegularTournament M)
    (label : Fin (2 * M ^ 2 + 1) → Fin (2 * M ^ 2 + 1) → Fin r)
    (i : Fin (2 * M ^ 2 + 1)) :
    (rowChildren T.toTournament label i).card = r + M ^ 2

name: OAI.Paper320.rowChildren_card
statement:
theorem rowChildren_card {k r : ℕ} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (i : Fin k) :
    (rowChildren T label i).card = r + (Finset.univ.filter (T.Adj i)).card

name: OAI.Paper320.rowChildren_disjoint
statement:
theorem rowChildren_disjoint {k r : ℕ} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (i : Fin k) :
    Disjoint (Finset.univ.image fun c => (i, c))
      ((Finset.univ.filter (T.Adj i)).image fun j => (j, label i j))

name: OAI.Paper320.mem_rowLift
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_rowLift {k r : ℕ} {I : Type} (i : Fin k) (B : Finset I)
    (p : (Fin k × Fin r) × I) : p ∈ rowLift (r := r) i B ↔ p.1.1 = i ∧ p.2 ∈ B

name: OAI.Paper320.recursiveChild_rowLift_other
statement:
theorem recursiveChild_rowLift_other {k r : ℕ} {I : Type}
    (i j : Fin k) (B : Finset I) (c : Fin r) (hji : j ≠ i) :
    recursiveChild (flip (fun _ => false) (rowLift (r := r) i B)) j c =
      fun _ => false

name: OAI.Paper320.recursiveChild_rowLift_same
statement:
theorem recursiveChild_rowLift_same {k r : ℕ} {I : Type}
    (i : Fin k) (B : Finset I) (c : Fin r) :
    recursiveChild (flip (fun _ => false) (rowLift (r := r) i B)) i c =
      flip (fun _ => false) B

name: OAI.Paper320.recursiveFamily_rowLift
statement:
theorem recursiveFamily_rowLift {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (hzero : ∀ q, F q (fun _ => false) = false) (B : Finset I)
    (hB : ∀ q, F q (flip (fun _ => false) B) = true) (i : Fin k) (q : Fin h) :
    recursiveFamily T label F q (flip (fun _ => false) (rowLift i B)) = true

name: OAI.Paper320.rowLift_card
statement:
theorem rowLift_card {k r : ℕ} {I : Type} (i : Fin k) (B : Finset I) :
    (rowLift (r := r) i B).card = r * B.card

name: OAI.Paper320.rowLift_disjoint
statement:
theorem rowLift_disjoint {k r : ℕ} {I : Type} (i j : Fin k) (B C : Finset I)
    (hBC : Disjoint B C) : Disjoint (rowLift (r := r) i B) (rowLift j C)

name: OAI.Paper320.rowLift_disjoint_of_ne
statement:
theorem rowLift_disjoint_of_ne {k r : ℕ} {I : Type} (i j : Fin k)
    (B C : Finset I) (hij : i ≠ j) : Disjoint (rowLift (r := r) i B) (rowLift j C)

name: OAI.Paper320.rowLift_family_disjoint
statement:
theorem rowLift_family_disjoint {k r : ℕ} {I K : Type} (blocks : K → Finset I)
    (hB : Pairwise fun a b => Disjoint (blocks a) (blocks b)) :
    Pairwise fun a b : Fin k × K =>
      Disjoint (rowLift (r := r) a.1 (blocks a.2)) (rowLift b.1 (blocks b.2))

name: OAI.Paper320.rowLift_nonempty
statement:
theorem rowLift_nonempty {k r : ℕ} {I : Type} (i : Fin k) (B : Finset I)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hB : B.Nonempty) : (rowLift (r := r) i B).Nonempty

name: OAI.Paper320.recursiveChild_flip_other
statement:
theorem recursiveChild_flip_other {k r : ℕ} {I : Type}
    (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (j j' : Fin k) (c c' : Fin r) (a : I)
    (h : (j', c') ≠ (j, c)) :
    recursiveChild (flip x {((j, c), a)}) j' c' = recursiveChild x j' c'

name: OAI.Paper320.recursiveChild_flip_same
OAI.Paper320.rowClause_eq_of_conditions
statement:
theorem rowClause_eq_of_conditions {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x y : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (i : Fin k)
    (ht : ∀ c, F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x i c) =
      F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild y i c))
    (hg : ∀ j, T.Adj i j → F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x j (label i j)) =
      F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild y j (label i j))) :
    rowClause T label F q x i = rowClause T label F q y i

name: OAI.Paper320.rowClause_flip_change
statement:
theorem rowClause_flip_change {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (i j : Fin k) (c : Fin r) (a : I)
    (hc : rowClause T label F q (flip x {((j, c), a)}) i ≠ rowClause T label F q x i) :
    (j = i ∧ F (Fin.last h) (flip (recursiveChild x j c) {a}) ≠
      F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x j c)) ∨
    (T.Adj i j ∧ c = label i j ∧
      F (gateIndex q) (flip (recursiveChild x j c) {a}) ≠
        F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x j c))

name: OAI.Paper320.rowClause_flip_eq
statement:
theorem rowClause_flip_eq {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (i j : Fin k) (c : Fin r) (a : I)
    (ht : j = i → F (Fin.last h) (flip (recursiveChild x j c) {a}) =
      F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x j c))
    (hg : T.Adj i j → c = label i j →
      F (gateIndex q) (flip (recursiveChild x j c) {a}) =
        F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x j c)) :
    rowClause T label F q (flip x {((j, c), a)}) i = rowClause T label F q x i

name: OAI.Paper320.card_biUnion_le_mul
statement:
theorem card_biUnion_le_mul {J I : Type} [DecidableEq I] (A : Finset J) (B : J → Finset I) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : ∀ j ∈ A, (B j).card ≤ n) : (A.biUnion B).card ≤ A.card * n

name: OAI.Paper320.childChanges_card
statement:
@[simp] theorem childChanges_card {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (F : Fin h → (I → Bool) → Bool) (q : Fin h)
    (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (j : Fin k) (c : Fin r) :
    (childChanges F q x j c).card = sensitivityAt (F q) (recursiveChild x j c)

name: OAI.Paper320.childJointChanges_card
statement:
@[simp] theorem childJointChanges_card {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (F : Fin h → (I → Bool) → Bool) (q q' : Fin h)
    (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (j : Fin k) (c : Fin r) :
    (childJointChanges F q q' x j c).card =
      jointSensitivityAt (F q) (F q') (recursiveChild x j c)

name: OAI.Paper320.childLift_card
statement:
@[simp] theorem childLift_card {J I : Type} (j : J) (A : Finset I) :
    (childLift j A).card = A.card

name: OAI.Paper320.mem_childLift
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_childLift {J I : Type} (j : J) (A : Finset I) (p : J × I) :
    p ∈ childLift j A ↔ p.1 = j ∧ p.2 ∈ A

name: OAI.Paper320.rowClause_joint_flip_change
statement:
theorem rowClause_joint_flip_change {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q q' : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool)
    (i j : Fin k) (c : Fin r) (a : I)
    (hc : rowClause T label F q (flip x {((j, c), a)}) i ≠ rowClause T label F q x i)
    (hc' : rowClause T label F q' (flip x {((j, c), a)}) i ≠ rowClause T label F q' x i) :
    (j = i ∧ F (Fin.last h) (flip (recursiveChild x j c) {a}) ≠
      F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x j c)) ∨
    (T.Adj i j ∧ c = label i j ∧
      F (gateIndex q) (flip (recursiveChild x j c) {a}) ≠
        F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x j c) ∧
      F (gateIndex q') (flip (recursiveChild x j c) {a}) ≠
        F (gateIndex q') (recursiveChild x j c))

name: OAI.Paper320.Tournament.card_internalEdges
statement:
theorem card_internalEdges (I : Finset (Fin k)) :
    (T.internalEdges I).card = I.card.choose 2

name: OAI.Paper320.Tournament.card_le_three_of_outdegree_le_one
statement:
theorem card_le_three_of_outdegree_le_one (I : Finset (Fin k))
    (h : ∀ i ∈ I, (I.filter (T.Adj i)).card ≤ 1) : I.card ≤ 3

name: OAI.Paper320.Tournament.sum_outdegree_eq
statement:
theorem sum_outdegree_eq (I : Finset (Fin k)) :
    ∑ i ∈ I, (I.filter (T.Adj i)).card = (T.internalEdges I).card

name: OAI.Paper320.gateCandidates_card
statement:
theorem gateCandidates_card {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (hF : NestedFamily F) (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) :
    (gateCandidates T label F q x).card ≤ 3

name: OAI.Paper320.gateCandidates_neighbor
statement:
theorem gateCandidates_neighbor {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (hF : NestedFamily F) (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool)
    (i j : Fin k) (hi : i ∈ gateCandidates T label F q x)
    (hj : j ∈ gateCandidates T label F q x) (hij : T.Adj i j) :
    j = gateWitness T label F q x i

name: OAI.Paper320.gateFailures_empty_iff
statement:
theorem gateFailures_empty_iff {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (i : Fin k) :
    gateFailures T label F q x i = ∅ ↔
      ∀ j, T.Adj i j → F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x j (label i j)) = false

name: OAI.Paper320.gateFailures_singleton
statement:
theorem gateFailures_singleton {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (i : Fin k)
    (hi : i ∈ gateCandidates T label F q x) :
    gateFailures T label F q x i = {gateWitness T label F q x i}

name: OAI.Paper320.targetCandidates_card
statement:
theorem targetCandidates_card {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (A : GoodLabeling T r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool) (hF : NestedFamily F)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (targetCandidates T A.label F q x).card < 16

name: OAI.Paper320.targetFailures_empty_iff
statement:
theorem targetFailures_empty_iff {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type}
    (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (i : Fin k) :
    targetFailures F x i = ∅ ↔ ∀ c, F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x i c) = true

name: OAI.Paper320.targetFailures_singleton
statement:
theorem targetFailures_singleton {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (hr : 0 < r) (i : Fin k)
    (hi : i ∈ targetCandidates T label F q x) :
    targetFailures F x i = {targetWitness F x hr i}

name: OAI.Paper320.repaired_gate_location
statement:
theorem repaired_gate_location {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool)
    (i j j' : Fin k) (c : Fin r) (a : I)
    (hf : rowClause T label F q (flip x {((j, c), a)}) i = true)
    (hij' : T.Adj i j') (hon : F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x j' (label i j')) = true) :
    (j', label i j') = (j, c)

name: OAI.Paper320.repaired_target_location
statement:
theorem repaired_target_location {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool)
    (i j : Fin k) (c c' : Fin r) (a : I)
    (hf : rowClause T label F q (flip x {((j, c), a)}) i = true)
    (hz : F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x i c') = false) : (i, c') = (j, c)

name: OAI.Paper320.rowClause_repair_cases
statement:
theorem rowClause_repair_cases {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool)
    (i j : Fin k) (c : Fin r) (a : I)
    (hi : rowClause T label F q x i = false)
    (hf : rowClause T label F q (flip x {((j, c), a)}) i = true) :
    (i ∈ targetCandidates T label F q x ∧ j = i ∧
      F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x j c) = false ∧
      F (Fin.last h) (flip (recursiveChild x j c) {a}) = true) ∨
    (i ∈ gateCandidates T label F q x ∧ T.Adj i j ∧ c = label i j ∧
      F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x j c) = true ∧
      F (gateIndex q) (flip (recursiveChild x j c) {a}) = false)

name: OAI.Paper320.gateSinks_card
statement:
theorem gateSinks_card {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) :
    (gateSinks T label F q x).card ≤ 1

name: OAI.Paper320.gateWitness_spec
statement:
theorem gateWitness_spec {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (i : Fin k)
    (hi : i ∈ gateCandidates T label F q x) :
    T.Adj i (gateWitness T label F q x i) ∧
      F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x (gateWitness T label F q x i)
        (label i (gateWitness T label F q x i))) = true

name: OAI.Paper320.gateWitness_unique
statement:
theorem gateWitness_unique {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (i : Fin k)
    (hi : i ∈ gateCandidates T label F q x) (j : Fin k) (hij : T.Adj i j)
    (hj : F (gateIndex q) (recursiveChild x j (label i j)) = true) :
    j = gateWitness T label F q x i

name: OAI.Paper320.nonsink_gateWitness_mem
statement:
theorem nonsink_gateWitness_mem {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (hF : NestedFamily F) (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool)
    (i : Fin k) (hi : i ∈ gateCandidates T label F q x)
    (hs : i ∉ gateSinks T label F q x) :
    gateWitness T label F q x i ∈ gateCandidates T label F q x

name: OAI.Paper320.targetWitness_false
statement:
theorem targetWitness_false {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (hr : 0 < r) (i : Fin k)
    (hi : i ∈ targetCandidates T label F q x) :
    F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x i (targetWitness F x hr i)) = false

name: OAI.Paper320.targetWitness_unique
statement:
theorem targetWitness_unique {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} (T : Tournament k)
    (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r) (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool) (hr : 0 < r) (i : Fin k)
    (hi : i ∈ targetCandidates T label F q x) (c : Fin r)
    (hc : F (Fin.last h) (recursiveChild x i c) = false) : c = targetWitness F x hr i

name: OAI.Paper320.recursive_joint_zero
statement:
theorem recursive_joint_zero {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (T : Tournament k) (A : GoodLabeling T r)
    (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool) (hF : NestedFamily F) (hr : 0 < r) :
    jointSensitivity (recursiveFamily T A.label F) false ≤
      16 * sideSensitivity F false + 3 * jointSensitivity F true

name: OAI.Paper320.recursive_joint_zero_at
statement:
theorem recursive_joint_zero_at {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (T : Tournament k) (A : GoodLabeling T r)
    (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool) (hF : NestedFamily F) (hr : 0 < r)
    (q q' : Fin h) (hqq : q < q') (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool)
    (hx : recursiveFamily T A.label F q x = false)
    (hx' : recursiveFamily T A.label F q' x = false) :
    jointSensitivityAt (recursiveFamily T A.label F q) (recursiveFamily T A.label F q') x ≤
      16 * sideSensitivity F false + 3 * jointSensitivity F true

name: OAI.Paper320.recursive_joint_one
statement:
theorem recursive_joint_one {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (T : Tournament k) (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r)
    (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool) (hF : NestedFamily F) (o : ℕ)
    (ho : ∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (T.Adj i)).card = o) :
    jointSensitivity (recursiveFamily T label F) true ≤
      o * jointSensitivity F false + r * sideSensitivity F true

name: OAI.Paper320.recursive_joint_one_at
statement:
theorem recursive_joint_one_at {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (T : Tournament k) (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r)
    (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool) (hF : NestedFamily F) (o : ℕ)
    (ho : ∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (T.Adj i)).card = o)
    (q q' : Fin h) (hqq : q < q') (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool)
    (hx : recursiveFamily T label F q x = true)
    (hx' : recursiveFamily T label F q' x = true) :
    jointSensitivityAt (recursiveFamily T label F q) (recursiveFamily T label F q') x ≤
      o * jointSensitivity F false + r * sideSensitivity F true

name: OAI.Paper320.recursive_sensitivity_one_at
statement:
theorem recursive_sensitivity_one_at {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (T : Tournament k) (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r)
    (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool) (o : ℕ)
    (ho : ∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (T.Adj i)).card = o)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool)
    (hx : recursiveFamily T label F q x = true) :
    sensitivityAt (recursiveFamily T label F q) x ≤
      o * sideSensitivity F false + r * sideSensitivity F true

name: OAI.Paper320.recursive_side_one
statement:
theorem recursive_side_one {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (T : Tournament k) (label : Fin k → Fin k → Fin r)
    (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool) (o : ℕ)
    (ho : ∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (T.Adj i)).card = o) :
    sideSensitivity (recursiveFamily T label F) true ≤
      o * sideSensitivity F false + r * sideSensitivity F true

name: OAI.Paper320.recursive_sensitivity_zero_at
statement:
theorem recursive_sensitivity_zero_at {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (T : Tournament k) (A : GoodLabeling T r)
    (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool) (hF : NestedFamily F) (hr : 0 < r)
    (q : Fin h) (x : ((Fin k × Fin r) × I) → Bool)
    (hx : recursiveFamily T A.label F q x = false) :
    sensitivityAt (recursiveFamily T A.label F q) x ≤
      16 * sideSensitivity F false + sideSensitivity F true + 3 * jointSensitivity F true

name: OAI.Paper320.recursive_side_zero
statement:
theorem recursive_side_zero {k r h : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]

name: OAI.Paper320.recursive_four_recurrences
statement:
theorem recursive_four_recurrences {M r h : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (T : RegularTournament M) (A : GoodLabeling T.toTournament r)
    (F : Fin (h + 1) → (I → Bool) → Bool) (hF : NestedFamily F) (hr : 0 < r) :
    let P := recursiveFamily T.toTournament A.label F
    (sideSensitivity P true ≤ M ^ 2 * sideSensitivity F false + r * sideSensitivity F true) ∧
    (jointSensitivity P true ≤ M ^ 2 * jointSensitivity F false + r * sideSensitivity F true) ∧
    (sideSensitivity P false ≤ 16 * sideSensitivity F false + sideSensitivity F true +
      3 * jointSensitivity F true) ∧
    (jointSensitivity P false ≤ 16 * sideSensitivity F false + 3 * jointSensitivity F true)

name: OAI.Paper320.tower_four_recurrences
statement:
theorem tower_four_recurrences {M r : ℕ} {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (T : RegularTournament M) (A : GoodLabeling T.toTournament r)
    (base : (h : ℕ) → Fin h → (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (D n : ℕ) (hn : n < D) (hr : 0 < r) (hbase : NestedFamily (base D)) :
    (towerSide T.toTournament A.label base D (n + 1) true ≤
      M ^ 2 * towerSide T.toTournament A.label base D n false +
      r * towerSide T.toTournament A.label base D n true) ∧
    (towerJoint T.toTournament A.label base D (n + 1) true ≤
      M ^ 2 * towerJoint T.toTournament A.label base D n false +
      r * towerSide T.toTournament A.label base D n true) ∧
    (towerSide T.toTournament A.label base D (n + 1) false ≤
      16 * towerSide T.toTournament A.label base D n false +
      towerSide T.toTournament A.label base D n true +
      3 * towerJoint T.toTournament A.label base D n true) ∧
    (towerJoint T.toTournament A.label base D (n + 1) false ≤
      16 * towerSide T.toTournament A.label base D n false +
      3 * towerJoint T.toTournament A.label base D n true)

name: OAI.Paper320.Tournament.labelingConstraint_iff

    (∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, T.Adj (v i) (v j) → A (v i,v j) = m j) ↔
      ∀ p ∈ T.internalEdges (s.image v), A p = m (Function.invFun v p.2)

name: OAI.Paper320.exists_constructed_seed
statement:
theorem exists_constructed_seed (d M : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hM : 9 ^ (d + 1) ≤ M) :
    ∃ f : (Fin (constructionDimension d M (Nat.ceil (Real.sqrt (M : ℝ)))) → Bool) → Bool,
      0 < constructionDimension d M (Nat.ceil (Real.sqrt (M : ℝ))) ∧
      f (fun _ => false) = false ∧ (∃ x y, f x ≠ f y) ∧
      sensitivity f ≤ 2 * (d + 2) * M ^ (d + 1) ∧
      M ^ 2 * (2 * M ^ 2 + 1) ^ d ≤ blockSensitivityAt f (fun _ => false)

name: OAI.Paper320.power_amplification
statement:
theorem power_amplification {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (hf : f (fun _ => false) = false)
    (A B : ℕ) (hs : sensitivity f ≤ A)
    (hb : B ≤ blockSensitivityAt f (fun _ => false))
    (hA : 1 < A) (hB : A ^ 2 < B) :
    let α := Real.log (B : ℝ) / Real.log (A : ℝ)
    2 < α ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ,
        0 < Fintype.card I ^ m ∧
        iterateFin f m (fun _ => false) = false ∧
        (∃ x y, iterateFin f m x ≠ iterateFin f m y) ∧
        (sensitivity (iterateFin f m) : ℝ) ^ α ≤
          (blockSensitivityAt (iterateFin f m) (fun _ => false) : ℝ) ∧
        ((B : ℝ) / (A : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ m ≤
          (blockSensitivity (iterateFin f m) : ℝ) /
            (sensitivity (iterateFin f m) : ℝ) ^ 2) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun m : ℕ => (blockSensitivityAt (iterateFin f m) (fun _ => false) : ℝ))
        Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

name: OAI.Paper320.rpow_log_exponent
statement:

    A ^ (Real.log B / Real.log A) = B

name: OAI.Paper320.quantitative_ratio_of_bounds
statement:
theorem quantitative_ratio_of_bounds {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (f : (I → Bool) → Bool) (d M : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hnc : ∃ x y, f x ≠ f y)
    (hs : sensitivity f ≤ 2 * (d + 2) * M ^ (d + 1))
    (hb : M ^ 2 * (2 * M ^ 2 + 1) ^ d ≤ blockSensitivityAt f (fun _ => false)) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ d / (4 * ((d : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2) ≤
      (blockSensitivity f : ℝ) / (sensitivity f : ℝ) ^ 2

name: OAI.Paper320.quantitative_ratio_tendsto
statement:
theorem quantitative_ratio_tendsto :
    Tendsto (fun d : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) ^ d / (4 * ((d : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)) atTop atTop

name: OAI.Paper320.ratio_of_bounds
statement:
theorem ratio_of_bounds {I : Type} [Fintype I] (f : (I → Bool) → Bool)
    (s b : ℝ) (hpos : 0 < (sensitivity f : ℝ))
    (hs : (sensitivity f : ℝ) ≤ s) (hb : b ≤ (blockSensitivityAt f (fun _ => false) : ℝ))
    (hb0 : 0 ≤ b) :
    b / s ^ 2 ≤ (blockSensitivity f : ℝ) / (sensitivity f : ℝ) ^ 2

name: OAI.Paper320.seed_ratio_identity
statement:
theorem seed_ratio_identity (d : ℕ) {L M k : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) (hM : M ≠ 0) :
    (M ^ 2 * k ^ d) / (2 * L * M ^ (d + 1)) ^ 2 =
      (k / M ^ 2) ^ d / (4 * L ^ 2)

name: OAI.Paper320.constructed_power_family
statement:
theorem constructed_power_family :
    ∃ α : ℝ, 2 < α ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ → ℕ) (F : ∀ m : ℕ, (Fin (n m) → Bool) → Bool),
        (∀ m : ℕ,
          0 < n m ∧ F m (fun _ => false) = false ∧
          (∃ x y, F m x ≠ F m y) ∧
          (sensitivity (F m) : ℝ) ^ α ≤ (blockSensitivityAt (F m) (fun _ => false) : ℝ) ∧
          ((128 : ℝ) / 121) ^ m ≤
            (blockSensitivity (F m) : ℝ) / (sensitivity (F m) : ℝ) ^ 2) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto
          (fun m : ℕ => (blockSensitivityAt (F m) (fun _ => false) : ℝ))
          Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

name: OAI.Paper320.fixed_power_separation
statement:
theorem fixed_power_separation :
    ∃ α : ℝ, 2 < α ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ → ℕ) (F : ∀ m : ℕ, (Fin (n m) → Bool) → Bool),
        (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m →
          0 < n m ∧ F m (fun _ => false) = false ∧
          (∃ x y : Fin (n m) → Bool, F m x ≠ F m y) ∧
          (sensitivity (F m) : ℝ) ^ α ≤
            (blockSensitivityAt (F m) (fun _ => false) : ℝ)) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto
          (fun m : ℕ => (blockSensitivityAt (F m) (fun _ => false) : ℝ))
          Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

name: OAI.Paper320.quantitative_separation
statement:
theorem quantitative_separation (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → Bool),
      0 < n ∧ f (fun _ => false) = false ∧
      (∃ x y : Fin n → Bool, f x ≠ f y) ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ^ d / (4 * ((d : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2) ≤
        (blockSensitivity f : ℝ) / (sensitivity f : ℝ) ^ 2

name: OAI.Paper320.unbounded_quadratic_separation
statement:
theorem unbounded_quadratic_separation (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → Bool),
      0 < n ∧ f (fun _ => false) = false ∧
      (∃ x y : Fin n → Bool, f x ≠ f y) ∧
      C * (sensitivity f : ℝ) ^ 2 < (blockSensitivity f : ℝ)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.GaussianTools.bounded_concentration
statement:
theorem bounded_concentration {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B) (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ sample ∂μ, |X i sample| ≤ B)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    μ.real {sample | u < |(∑ i, (X i sample - ∫ z, X i z ∂μ)) / (n : ℝ)|} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * u^2 / (2 * B^2))

statement: lemma gaussian_coordinate_ne (i : Fin m) : ∀ᵐ x : E ∂μ, x i ≠ 0

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.GaussianNonparallel.gaussian_cross_zero_measure
statement:
lemma gaussian_cross_zero_measure (i j : Fin m) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ((μ).prod μ) {z : E × E | cross i j z.1 z.2 = 0} = 0

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.GaussianNonparallel.gaussian_inner_zero_measure
statement:
lemma gaussian_inner_zero_measure (v : E) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    (stdGaussian E) {x | inner ℝ v x = 0} = 0

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.GaussianNonparallel.iid_cross_ne
statement:
lemma iid_cross_ne {N : ℕ} (i j : Fin m) (hij : i ≠ j) (a b : Fin N) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    ∀ᵐ g : Fin N → E ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => μ), cross i j (g a) (g b) ≠ 0

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.GaussianNonparallel.iid_pairwise_nonparallel
statement:
lemma iid_pairwise_nonparallel {N : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    ∀ᵐ g : Fin N → E ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => μ),

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionInterpolation.covariance_lipschitz
OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionInterpolation.covariance_net_bound
statement:
lemma covariance_net_bound (hN : 0 < N) (g : Fin N → E) {B b ρ : ℝ}
    (hg : ∀ i, ‖g i‖^2 ≤ B) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (V : Finset E)
    (hV : ∀ v ∈ V, ‖v‖ = 1)
    (hnet : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 → ∃ v ∈ V, ‖x-v‖ ≤ ρ)
    (hdev : ∀ v ∈ V, |empiricalCov g v - 1| ≤ b)
    (x : E) (hx : ‖x‖ = 1) : |empiricalCov g x - 1| ≤ b + 2*B*ρ

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionInterpolation.empiricalSin_lipschitz
OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionInterpolation.fourier_net_bound
statement:
lemma fourier_net_bound (hN : 0 < N) (g : Fin N → E) {B b ρ δ R : ℝ}
    (hg : ∀ i, ‖g i‖^2 ≤ B) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hρ : ρ < 1)
    (V W : Finset E)
    (hV : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ = 1 → ∃ v ∈ V, ‖x-v‖ ≤ ρ)
    (hW : ∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ R → ∃ w' ∈ W, ‖w-w'‖ ≤ δ)
    (hdev : ∀ v ∈ V, ∀ w ∈ W,
      |inner ℝ (empiricalSin g w - Real.exp (-‖w‖^2/2) • w) v| ≤ b)
    (w : E) (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖empiricalSin g w - Real.exp (-‖w‖^2/2) • w‖ ≤ b/(1-ρ) + (B+(m : ℝ))*δ

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionInterpolation.gaussianTransform_lipschitz
statement:
lemma gaussianTransform_lipschitz (w w' : E) :
    ‖Real.exp (-‖w‖^2/2) • w - Real.exp (-‖w'‖^2/2) • w'‖ ≤ (m : ℝ)*‖w-w'‖

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionInterpolation.gaussian_norm_sq_mean
statement: lemma gaussian_norm_sq_mean : (∫ g : E, ‖g‖^2 ∂stdGaussian E) = m

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionInterpolation.projection_interpolate
OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionInterpolation.sin_vector_lipschitz
statement:
lemma sin_vector_lipschitz (g w w' : E) :
    ‖Real.sin (inner ℝ g w) • g - Real.sin (inner ℝ g w') • g‖ ≤
      ‖g‖^2 * ‖w-w'‖

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionAsymptotics.covariance_net_error
statement:
lemma covariance_net_error {m : ℕ} (hm : 1000 ≤ m)
    (hb : 16*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)/12) ≤ 1/(8*(m : ℝ))) :
    1/8 + 16*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)/12) + 8*(m : ℝ)*(1/(m : ℝ)^3) ≤ 1/2

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionAsymptotics.eventual_bias_bound
statement:
lemma eventual_bias_bound : ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop,
    0 < m ∧ 16*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)/12) ≤ 1/(8*(m : ℝ))

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionAsymptotics.eventual_selection_majorant
statement:
lemma eventual_selection_majorant : ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop,
    2*(m : ℝ)^9*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)/8) +
      6*(m : ℝ)^3*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)) < 1

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionAsymptotics.grid_card_bound
statement:
lemma grid_card_bound (m k : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    (((2*m^k+1)^m : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (((k : ℝ)+2)*(m : ℝ)^2)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionAsymptotics.large_chart_exponent
statement:
lemma large_chart_exponent (x : ℝ) (hx : 1000000 ≤ x) :
    6*x^2 - x^3/32 ≤ -x

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionAsymptotics.large_fourier_exponent
statement:
lemma large_fourier_exponent (x : ℝ) (hx : 1000000 ≤ x) :
    54*x^2 - x^4/2048 ≤ -x

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionAsymptotics.normalized_covariance_exponent
statement:
lemma normalized_covariance_exponent (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    -(m : ℝ)^6*(1/8)^2/(2*(4*(m : ℝ))^2) = -(m : ℝ)^4/2048

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionAsymptotics.normalized_fourier_exponent
statement:
lemma normalized_fourier_exponent {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    -(m : ℝ)^6*(1/(2*Real.sqrt m))^2/(2*(2*Real.sqrt m)^2) = -(m : ℝ)^4/32

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionAsymptotics.polynomial_exp_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma polynomial_exp_tendsto_zero (k : ℕ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (m : ℝ)^k * Real.exp (-c*(m : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionAsymptotics.probability_majorization
statement:
lemma probability_majorization {m : ℕ} (hm : 1000000 ≤ m) {A B : ℝ}
    (_hA0 : 0 ≤ A) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B)
    (hA : A ≤ Real.exp (6*(m : ℝ)^2)) (hB : B ≤ Real.exp (48*(m : ℝ)^2)) :
    (m : ℝ)^3*((m : ℝ)^6*(2*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)/8)) +
      A*B*(2*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)^4/32)) + A*(2*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)^4/2048))) +
      A*(2*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)^3/32)) ≤
      2*(m : ℝ)^9*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)/8) + 6*(m : ℝ)^3*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ))

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionAsymptotics.projection_failure_bound
statement:
lemma projection_failure_bound {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log m) :
    (m : ℝ)^6*(2*Real.exp (-(10*Real.sqrt (Real.log m))^2/2)) ≤ 1/4

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionAsymptotics.projection_net_error
statement:
lemma projection_net_error {m : ℕ} (hm : 1000 ≤ m) (hl : 1 ≤ Real.log m) :
    10*Real.sqrt (Real.log m) + 2*Real.sqrt m*(1/(m : ℝ)^3) ≤
      11*Real.sqrt (Real.log m)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionAsymptotics.scalar_net_error
statement:
lemma scalar_net_error {m : ℕ} (hm : 1000 ≤ m)
    (hb : 16*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)/12) ≤ 1/(8*(m : ℝ))) :
    (1/(2*Real.sqrt m) + 16*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)/12))/(1-1/(m : ℝ)^3) +
      (5*(m : ℝ))*(1/(m : ℝ)^3) ≤ 2/Real.sqrt m

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionAsymptotics.selection_majorant_tendsto
statement:
lemma selection_majorant_tendsto :
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => 2*(m : ℝ)^9*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)/8) +
      6*(m : ℝ)^3*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionFamily.badCount_le_of_imp
statement:
lemma badCount_le_of_imp {A B : Set (Fin N → E)} (g : Fin S → Fin N → E)
    (h : ∀ s, g s ∈ A → g s ∈ B) : badCount A g ≤ badCount B g

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionFamily.good_chart_interpolation
statement:
lemma good_chart_interpolation {N S : ℕ} (g : Fin S → Fin N → E)
    (hg : ∀ s, g s ∉ normBad) {v v' : E} {ρ q q' : ℝ}
    (hd : ‖v-v'‖ ≤ ρ) (hq : q+2*Real.sqrt m*ρ ≤ q') :
    badCount (projectionBad q' v) g ≤ badCount (projectionBad q v') g

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionFamily.inner_empiricalSin
statement:
lemma inner_empiricalSin (g : Fin N → E) (v w : E) :
    inner ℝ (empiricalSin g w - Real.exp (-‖w‖^2/2) • w) v =
      (∑ i, inner ℝ (g i) v * Real.sin (inner ℝ (g i) w))/(N : ℝ) -
      inner ℝ w v * Real.exp (-‖w‖^2/2)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionFamily.net_covariance_scalar
statement:
lemma net_covariance_scalar {g : Fin N → E} (hg : g ∉ normBad)
    (v : E) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (hf : g ∉ covarianceBad v) :
    |empiricalCov g v - 1| ≤ 1/8 + 16*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)/12)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionFamily.net_fourier_scalar
statement:
lemma net_fourier_scalar (hm : 0 < m) {g : Fin N → E} (hg : g ∉ normBad)
    {u : ℝ} (v w : E) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) (hf : g ∉ fourierBad u v w) :
    |inner ℝ (empiricalSin g w - Real.exp (-‖w‖^2/2) • w) v| ≤
      u + 16*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)/12)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionFamily.normBounds_of_not_bad
statement:
lemma normBounds_of_not_bad {g : Fin N → E} (hg : g ∉ normBad) (i : Fin N) :
    (m : ℝ)/4 ≤ ‖g i‖^2 ∧ ‖g i‖^2 ≤ 4*(m : ℝ)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.DirectionFamily.source_nets
statement:
lemma source_nets (hm : 2 ≤ m) : ∃ V W : Finset E,
    (∀ v ∈ V, ‖v‖ = 1) ∧
    (V.card : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (6*(m : ℝ)^2) ∧
    (W.card : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (48*(m : ℝ)^2) ∧
    (∀ v : E, ‖v‖ = 1 → ∃ v' ∈ V, ‖v-v'‖ ≤ 1/(m : ℝ)^3) ∧
    (∀ w : E, ‖w‖ ≤ (m : ℝ)^42 → ∃ w' ∈ W, ‖w-w'‖ ≤ 1/(m : ℝ)^3)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.PivotFamily.all_coordinate_small_ball
statement:
lemma all_coordinate_small_ball {m N S : ℕ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin S => Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin N => stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))))).real
      {g | ∃ s i j, |g s i j| ≤ a} ≤ (S:ℝ)*((N:ℝ)*((m:ℝ)*(2*a)))

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.PivotFamily.coordinate_small_ball
statement:
lemma coordinate_small_ball {m : ℕ} (j : Fin m) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))).real {x | |x j| ≤ a} ≤ 2*a

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.PivotFamily.pivot_majorant_tendsto
statement:
lemma pivot_majorant_tendsto :
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => 2*(m : ℝ)^9*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)/8) +
      6*(m : ℝ)^3*Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)) + 2/(m:ℝ)^20) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.PivotFamily.standard_density_le_one
statement: lemma standard_density_le_one (x : ℝ) : gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x ≤ 1

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.PivotFamily.standard_small_ball
statement:
lemma standard_small_ball {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (gaussianReal 0 1).real {x | |x| ≤ a} ≤ 2*a

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartLinear.gramInverse_norm
statement:
lemma gramInverse_norm (J : E →L[ℝ] F) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hl : ∀ x, a * ‖x‖^2 ≤ ‖J x‖^2) (y : E) :
    ‖(gramEquiv J ha hl).symm y‖ ≤ ‖y‖/a

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartLinear.gram_injective
statement:
lemma gram_injective (J : E →L[ℝ] F) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hl : ∀ x, a * ‖x‖^2 ≤ ‖J x‖^2) : Function.Injective (J.adjoint.comp J)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartLinear.pseudoInverse_column
statement:
lemma pseudoInverse_column (J : E →L[ℝ] F) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hl : ∀ x, a * ‖x‖^2 ≤ ‖J x‖^2) (y : F) :
    ‖pseudoInverse J ha hl y‖ ≤ ‖J.adjoint y‖/a

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartLinear.pseudoInverse_comp
statement:
lemma pseudoInverse_comp (J : E →L[ℝ] F) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hl : ∀ x, a * ‖x‖^2 ≤ ‖J x‖^2) : (pseudoInverse J ha hl).comp J = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartLinear.pseudoInverse_equation
statement:
lemma pseudoInverse_equation (J : E →L[ℝ] F) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hl : ∀ x, a * ‖x‖^2 ≤ ‖J x‖^2) (y : F) :
    J.adjoint (J (pseudoInverse J ha hl y)) = J.adjoint y

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartLinear.pseudoInverse_norm
statement:
lemma pseudoInverse_norm (J : E →L[ℝ] F) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hl : ∀ x, a * ‖x‖^2 ≤ ‖J x‖^2) (y : F) :
    ‖pseudoInverse J ha hl y‖ ≤ ‖y‖ / Real.sqrt a

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartLinear.residual_norm
statement:
lemma residual_norm (J : E →L[ℝ] F) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hl : ∀ x, a * ‖x‖^2 ≤ ‖J x‖^2) (y : F) :
    ‖y-J (pseudoInverse J ha hl y)‖ ≤ ‖y‖

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartLinear.residual_orthogonal
statement:
lemma residual_orthogonal (J : E →L[ℝ] F) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hl : ∀ x, a * ‖x‖^2 ≤ ‖J x‖^2) (y : F) (x : E) :
    inner ℝ (J x) (y - J (pseudoInverse J ha hl y)) = 0

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartLinear.residual_pythagoras
statement:
lemma residual_pythagoras (J : E →L[ℝ] F) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hl : ∀ x, a * ‖x‖^2 ≤ ‖J x‖^2) (y : F) :
    ‖J (pseudoInverse J ha hl y)‖^2 + ‖y-J (pseudoInverse J ha hl y)‖^2 = ‖y‖^2

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.FrameCharts.chart_adjoint_single
statement:
lemma chart_adjoint_single (u : Fin N → E) (i : Fin N) :

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.FrameCharts.chart_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma chart_apply (u : Fin N → E) (x : E) (i : Fin N) :
    chart u x i = inner ℝ (u i) x

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.FrameCharts.chart_energy
statement:
lemma chart_energy (u : Fin N → E) (x : E) :
    ‖chart u x‖^2 = ∑ i, (inner ℝ (u i) x)^2

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.FrameCharts.extend_covariance
statement:
lemma extend_covariance (g : Fin N → E) (hN : 0 < N) (a b : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ = 1 → a ≤ (∑ i, (inner ℝ v (g i))^2)/(N : ℝ) ∧
      (∑ i, (inner ℝ v (g i))^2)/(N : ℝ) ≤ b) (x : E) :
    a*(N : ℝ)*‖x‖^2 ≤ ∑ i, (inner ℝ (g i) x)^2 ∧
      (∑ i, (inner ℝ (g i) x)^2) ≤ b*(N : ℝ)*‖x‖^2

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.FrameCharts.normalized_bounds
statement:
lemma normalized_bounds (g : Fin N → E) (hm : 0 < m) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hc : ∀ v : E, ‖v‖ = 1 → 1/2 ≤ (∑ i, (inner ℝ v (g i))^2)/(N : ℝ) ∧
      (∑ i, (inner ℝ v (g i))^2)/(N : ℝ) ≤ 2) (x : E) :
    ((N : ℝ)/(2*m))*‖x‖^2 ≤ ‖chart (fun i => (Real.sqrt m)⁻¹ • g i) x‖^2 ∧
    ‖chart (fun i => (Real.sqrt m)⁻¹ • g i) x‖^2 ≤ ((2*N : ℝ)/m)*‖x‖^2

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.FrameCharts.normalized_energy
statement:
lemma normalized_energy (g : Fin N → E) (_hm : 0 < m) (x : E) :
    ‖chart (fun i => (Real.sqrt m)⁻¹ • g i) x‖^2 =
      (∑ i, (inner ℝ (g i) x)^2)/(m : ℝ)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.FrameCharts.normalized_norms
statement:
lemma normalized_norms (g : Fin N → E) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hg : ∀ i, Real.sqrt m/2 ≤ ‖g i‖ ∧ ‖g i‖ ≤ 2*Real.sqrt m) (i : Fin N) :
    1/2 ≤ ‖(Real.sqrt m)⁻¹ • g i‖ ∧ ‖(Real.sqrt m)⁻¹ • g i‖ ≤ 2

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.HyperplaneCount.shattered_independent
statement:
lemma shattered_independent (f : ι → E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (A : Finset (Finset ι))

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.HyperplaneCount.sign_patterns_bound

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.HyperplaneCount.vcDim_le
statement:

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.RoundedCharts.ae_regular
statement:
lemma ae_regular (u : Fin N → E) (τ : ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, u i ≠ 0) :

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.RoundedCharts.cube_norm
statement:
lemma cube_norm {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {θ : E} (hθ : θ ∈ cube R) :

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.RoundedCharts.hyperplane_null
statement:
lemma hyperplane_null (u : E) (hu : u ≠ 0) (t : ℝ) :

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.RoundedCharts.integerLabel_bound
statement:
lemma integerLabel_bound (u : Fin N → E) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hu : ∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ 2)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.RoundedCharts.representative

lemma representative (u : Fin S → Fin N → E) (τ : ℝ) (v : Vertex u τ) :

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.RoundedCharts.rounded_error

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.RoundedCharts.rounded_error_coordinate

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.RoundedCharts.vertex_finite

lemma vertex_finite (u : Fin S → Fin N → E) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.SourceCharts.rounded_B_error
