name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.Profile.active_bound
statement:
lemma active_bound (g : S → N → E) (s : S) {q ε σ k γ G : ℝ}
    (θ η v : E) (h : N → ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hε : 0 < ε) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hk : k = q^2/(Fintype.card N : ℝ)) (hg : ∀ s i, ‖g s i‖ ≤ G)
    (hf : ‖Real.exp (-‖(σ⁻¹:ℝ) • (η-θ)‖^2/2) • ((σ⁻¹:ℝ) • (η-θ)) -
       ((Fintype.card N : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, Real.sin (inner ℝ (g s i) (η-θ)/σ) • g s i‖ ≤ γ) :
    |differential (fun j : S × N => g j.1 j.2) q ε σ θ η v 0 0
      (fun j => if j.1 = s then k/ε*(h j.2-inner ℝ (g j.1 j.2) v/q) else 0)| ≤
      k/σ*(∑ i, |h i|) + q*γ/σ*‖v‖ +
        ε/σ^2*((Fintype.card S : ℝ)*(Fintype.card N : ℝ)*G)*‖v‖

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.Profile.active_cancellation
statement:
lemma active_cancellation (g : S → N → E) (s : S) (q ε σ k : ℝ)
    (θ η v : E) (h : N → ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (hk : k = q^2/(Fintype.card N : ℝ)) (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    differential (fun j : S × N => g j.1 j.2) q ε σ θ η v 0 0
      (fun j => if j.1 = s then k/ε*(h j.2-inner ℝ (g j.1 j.2) v/q) else 0) =
    k/σ*(∑ i, h i*Real.sin (inner ℝ (g s i) (η-θ)/σ)) +
    q/σ*inner ℝ
      (Real.exp (-‖(σ⁻¹:ℝ) • (η-θ)‖^2/2) • ((σ⁻¹:ℝ) • (η-θ)) -
       ((Fintype.card N : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, Real.sin (inner ℝ (g s i) (η-θ)/σ) • g s i) v +
    ε/σ^2*(∑ j : S × N, inner ℝ (g j.1 j.2) v*Real.sin (inner ℝ (g j.1 j.2) (η-θ)/σ))

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.Profile.cancellation
statement:
lemma cancellation (g : ι → E) (q ε σ k : ℝ) (θ η v : E) (h : ι → ℝ)
    (hq : q ≠ 0) (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (hk : k = q^2/(Fintype.card ι : ℝ))
    (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    differential g q ε σ θ η v 0 0
      (fun i => k/ε*(h i-inner ℝ (g i) v/q)) =
    k/σ*(∑ i, h i*Real.sin (inner ℝ (g i) (η-θ)/σ)) +
    q/σ*inner ℝ
      (Real.exp (-‖(σ⁻¹:ℝ) • (η-θ)‖^2/2) • ((σ⁻¹:ℝ) • (η-θ)) -
       ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, Real.sin (inner ℝ (g i) (η-θ)/σ) • g i) v +
    ε/σ^2*(∑ i, inner ℝ (g i) v*Real.sin (inner ℝ (g i) (η-θ)/σ))

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.Profile.differential_correction
statement:
lemma differential_correction (g : ι → E) {q ε σ : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (θ η v : E) (α β δ : ι → ℝ) :
    |differential g q ε σ θ η v α β δ - differential g q ε σ θ η v 0 0 δ| ≤
      ε/σ*(∑ i, (|δ i| * |β i| + |inner ℝ (g i) v|/σ*(|α i| * |β i| + |α i| + |β i|)))

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.Profile.integral_inv_sq
statement:
lemma integral_inv_sq {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ σ in a..b, (σ^2)⁻¹) = a⁻¹-b⁻¹

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.Profile.kernel_correction
statement:
lemma kernel_correction (g : ι → E) {q ε a b A : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (θ η : E) (α β : ι → ℝ) (hα : ∀ i, |α i| ≤ A) (hβ : ∀ i, |β i| ≤ A) :
    |kernel g q ε a b θ η α β - kernel g q ε a b θ η 0 0| ≤
      ε*(Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*(A^2+2*A)*Real.log (b/a)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.Profile.kernel_segment_bound
statement:
lemma kernel_segment_bound (g : ι → E) {q ε a b C D : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D) (θ η v : E) (α β δ : ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ σ ∈ Icc a b,
      |differential g q ε σ (θ+t • v) η v (fun i => α i+t*δ i) β δ| ≤ C/σ+D/σ^2) :
    |kernel g q ε a b (θ+v) η (fun i => α i+δ i) β-kernel g q ε a b θ η α β| ≤
      C*Real.log (b/a)+D/a

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.Profile.pairing_continuousOn
statement:
lemma pairing_continuousOn (g : ι → E) (q ε : ℝ) (θ η : E) (α β : ι → ℝ)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) : ContinuousOn (fun σ => pairing g q ε σ θ η α β) (Icc a b)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.Profile.pairing_correction
statement:
lemma pairing_correction (g : ι → E) {q ε σ : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (θ η : E) (α β : ι → ℝ) :
    |pairing g q ε σ θ η α β - pairing g q ε σ θ η 0 0| ≤
      ε/σ*∑ i, (|α i| * |β i|+|α i|+|β i|)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.Profile.pairing_integrable
statement:
lemma pairing_integrable (g : ι → E) (q ε : ℝ) (θ η : E) (α β : ι → ℝ)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun σ => pairing g q ε σ θ η α β) volume a b

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.MetricKernel.base_distance_error
statement:
lemma base_distance_error (g : κ → E) {q ε a b : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (θ η : E) :
    |Profile.kernel g q ε a b θ θ 0 0 + Profile.kernel g q ε a b η η 0 0 -
      2*Profile.kernel g q ε a b θ η 0 0 - KernelApprox.cstar*q*‖η-θ‖| ≤
      q*(2*a+‖η-θ‖^2/b)+4*ε*(Fintype.card κ : ℝ)*Real.log (b/a)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.MetricKernel.base_pairing
statement:
lemma base_pairing (g : κ → E) (q ε σ : ℝ) (θ η : E) :
    Profile.pairing g q ε σ θ θ 0 0 + Profile.pairing g q ε σ η η 0 0 -
      2*Profile.pairing g q ε σ θ η 0 0 =
      2*q*KernelApprox.scaled ‖η-θ‖ σ +
        2*ε/σ*∑ i, (1-Real.cos (inner ℝ (g i) (η-θ)/σ))

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.MetricKernel.cos_integrable
statement:
lemma cos_integrable (g : κ → E) (θ η : E) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (i : κ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun σ => (1-Real.cos (inner ℝ (g i) (η-θ)/σ))/σ) volume a b

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.MetricKernel.cos_integral_bound
statement:
lemma cos_integral_bound (g : κ → E) (θ η : E) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (i : κ) :
    |∫ σ in a..b, (1-Real.cos (inner ℝ (g i) (η-θ)/σ))/σ| ≤ 2*Real.log (b/a)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.MetricKernel.full_differential_bound
statement:
lemma full_differential_bound (g : S → N → E) (s : S)
    {q ε σ k γ G A V H D₀ : ℝ} (θ η v : E) (h : N → ℝ) (α β : S × N → ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hε : 0 < ε) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hk : k = q^2/(Fintype.card N : ℝ))
    (hG : 0 ≤ G) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hD : 0 ≤ D₀) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hg : ∀ s i, ‖g s i‖ ≤ G) (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ V*H) (hh : ∑ i, |h i| ≤ H)
    (hα : ∀ i, |α i| ≤ A) (hβ : ∀ i, |β i| ≤ A)
    (hδ : ∀ i : S × N, |(if i.1 = s then k/ε*(h i.2-inner ℝ (g i.1 i.2) v/q) else 0)| ≤ D₀*H)
    (hf : ‖Real.exp (-‖(σ⁻¹:ℝ) • (η-θ)‖^2/2) • ((σ⁻¹:ℝ) • (η-θ)) -
       ((Fintype.card N : ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, Real.sin (inner ℝ (g s i) (η-θ)/σ) • g s i‖ ≤ γ) :
    |Profile.differential (fun j : S × N => g j.1 j.2) q ε σ θ η v α β
      (fun j => if j.1 = s then k/ε*(h j.2-inner ℝ (g j.1 j.2) v/q) else 0)| ≤
      ((k+q*γ*V+ε*((Fintype.card S : ℝ)*(Fintype.card N : ℝ))*D₀*A)*H)/σ +
      (ε*((Fintype.card S : ℝ)*(Fintype.card N : ℝ))*G*V*(1+A^2+2*A)*H)/σ^2

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.MetricKernel.gaussian_scaled_integrable
statement:
lemma gaussian_scaled_integrable (θ η : E) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.MetricKernel.gram_eq_kernel
statement:
lemma gram_eq_kernel (g : κ → E) (θ : ι → E) (α : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (q ε : ℝ) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (v w : ι) :

      Profile.kernel g q ε a b (θ v) (θ w) (α v) (α w)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartKernel.alpha_derivative_bound
statement:
lemma alpha_derivative_bound (g : Fin S → Fin N → E) (B : Fin S → F →L[ℝ] E)
    {q k ε H : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hk1 : k ≤ 1) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (s : Fin S) (h : F) (hH : ∑ i, |h i| ≤ H)
    (hg : ∀ i, ‖g s i‖ ≤ 2*q) (hB : ∀ i, ‖B s (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)‖ ≤ 4*k)
    (j : Fin S × Fin N) : |alpha g B q k ε s h j| ≤ (9*k/ε)*H

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartKernel.alpha_linear
statement:
lemma alpha_linear (g : Fin S → Fin N → E) (B : Fin S → F →L[ℝ] E)
    (q k ε : ℝ) (s : Fin S) (x h : F) (t : ℝ) :
    alpha g B q k ε s (x+t • h) = fun j => alpha g B q k ε s x j+t*alpha g B q k ε s h j

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartKernel.alpha_norm_bound
statement:
lemma alpha_norm_bound (g : Fin S → Fin N → E) (B : Fin S → F →L[ℝ] E)
    {q k ε R : ℝ} (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hε : 0 < ε) (s : Fin S) (x : F)
    (hx : ‖residual (FrameCharts.chart (fun i => q⁻¹ • g s i)) (B s) x‖ ≤ R)
    (j : Fin S × Fin N) : |alpha g B q k ε s x j| ≤ k/ε*R

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartKernel.norm_linear_le_l1
statement:
lemma norm_linear_le_l1 (B : F →L[ℝ] E) {V : ℝ} (_hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hB : ∀ i, ‖B (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)‖ ≤ V) (x : F) :

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartAngles.correction
statement:
lemma correction (g : κ → E) {q ε a b A : ℝ} (hε : 0≤ε) (ha : 0<a) (hab : a≤b)
    (hA : 0≤A) (θ η : E) (α β : κ → ℝ)
    (hα : ∀ i, |α i|≤A) (hβ : ∀ i, |β i|≤A) :
    |distance g q ε a b θ η α β-distance g q ε a b θ η 0 0| ≤
      4*(ε*(Fintype.card κ:ℝ)*(A^2+2*A)*Real.log (b/a))

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartAngles.global_angle
statement:
lemma global_angle {H : Type u4} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    (P : ι → H) (θ : ι → E) {c e : ℝ} (hc : 0≤c) (_he : 0≤e)
    (hd : ∀ v w, |‖P v-P w‖^2-c*‖θ v-θ w‖|≤e) (v z y : ι) :
    -(3*e/2) ≤ inner ℝ (P v-P z) (P y-P z)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ChartAngles.local_profile
statement:
lemma local_profile (g : Fin S → Fin N → E) (B : Fin S → F →L[ℝ] E)
    {q k ε a b T R γ : ℝ} (hq : 0<q) (hk : 0≤k) (hk1 : k≤1)
    (hε : 0<ε) (ha : 0<a) (hab : a≤b) (hT : 0≤T) (hR : 0≤R) (hγ : 0≤γ)
    (hkq : k=q^2/(N:ℝ)) (hg : ∀ s i, ‖g s i‖≤2*q)
    (hB : ∀ s i, ‖B s (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)‖≤4*k)
    (hf : ∀ (s : Fin S) (w : E), ‖w‖≤2*T/a →
      ‖Real.exp (-‖w‖^2/2) • w-((N:ℝ)⁻¹) • ∑ i, Real.sin (inner ℝ (g s i) w) • g s i‖≤γ)
    (s t : Fin S) (x x' y : F)

      ∀ i ∈ s, s.filter (fun j => t j z ≤ t i z) = s.filter (fun j => t j y ≤ t i y) ∧

lemma moving_threshold_integral_hasFDerivAt (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → X → ℝ)
    (F : Finset ι → ℝ) {y : X} (t' : ι → X →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, HasFDerivAt (t i) (t' i) y) (hi : Set.InjOn (fun i => t i y) s)
    {φ : ℝ → ℝ} (hφ : Integrable φ) (hc : Continuous φ) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun z => ∫ x, φ x * F (s.filter (fun i => t i z < x)))
      (∑ i ∈ s, (-(φ (t i y) *

    (∑ i ∈ s, (F (s.filter (fun j => t j ≤ t i))-F (s.filter (fun j => t j < t i)))) =

    F (s.filter (fun i => t i < x)) = F ∅+
      ∑ i ∈ s, if t i < x then
        F (s.filter (fun j => t j ≤ t i))-F (s.filter (fun j => t j < t i)) else 0

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.InterfaceStep.threshold_integral
statement:
lemma threshold_integral (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → ℝ) (ht : Set.InjOn t s)
    (F : Finset ι → ℝ) {φ : ℝ → ℝ} (hφ : Integrable φ) :
    (∫ x, φ x * F (s.filter (fun i => t i < x))) =
      (∫ x, φ x)*F ∅ + ∑ i ∈ s, (∫ x in Ioi (t i), φ x) *
        (F (s.filter (fun j => t j ≤ t i))-F (s.filter (fun j => t j < t i)))

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.InterfaceStep.threshold_integral_deriv
statement:
lemma threshold_integral_deriv (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → ℝ) (ht : Set.InjOn t s)
    (F : Finset ι → W) {φ : ℝ → ℝ} (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport φ) :
    (∫ x, deriv φ x • F (s.filter (fun i => t i < x))) =
      -∑ i ∈ s, φ (t i) •
        (F (s.filter (fun j => t j ≤ t i))-F (s.filter (fun j => t j < t i)))

    {φ : ℝ → ℝ} {ψ : Z → ℝ} (hmφ : Measurable φ) (hmψ : Measurable ψ)

statement:
lemma common_coefficient_budget (B : I → Z →L[ℝ] ℝ) (s : Finset ℤ)
    (pivot : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, pivot i≠0) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0<τ)
    (F : Finset (I × s) → A → ℝ) {M C J : ℝ}
    (_hM0 : 0≤M) (hC : 0≤C) (hJ : 0≤J) (hM : ∀ a α, |F a α|≤M)
    {φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ} (hd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt φ (φ' t) t) (hn : ∀ t, 0≤φ t)
    (hi : Integrable φ) (hi' : Integrable φ') (h1 : ∫ t, φ t=1) (hφC : ∀ t, |φ t|≤C)
    {ψ : Z → ℝ} (hmψ : Measurable ψ) (hnψ : ∀ z, 0≤ψ z) (hiψ : Integrable ψ) (hψ1 : ∫ z, ψ z=1)
    (θ : ℝ × Z) (i : I)
    (hj : ∀ᵐ z ∂law ψ volume, ∀ k : s,
      φ (form (B i) θ+B i z-(k:ℤ)*τ/pivot i)≠0 →
        (∑ α, |jump B (fun i (k : s) => -((k:ℤ)*τ/pivot i)) F θ i k z α|)≤J)
    (hsmall : τ/|pivot i| *(∫ t, |φ' t|)≤1) :
    (∑ α, |(pivot i)⁻¹ * ∑ k : s, ∫ z,
      -(φ (form (B i) θ+B i z-(k:ℤ)*τ/pivot i)*
        jump B (fun i (k : s) => -((k:ℤ)*τ/pivot i)) F θ i k z α) ∂law ψ volume|) ≤ 2*J/τ

lemma boundary_pattern (ell : I → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (pivot : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, pivot i≠0)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CellInterface.interface_extension_traces
statement:
lemma interface_extension_traces (ell : I → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (pivot : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, pivot i≠0)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0<τ) (s : Finset ℤ) {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hb : ∀ x∈U, regular ell τ x → ∀ i, label ell τ x i∈s)
    (F : LabelVertex ell τ U → A → ℝ) {x : E} (hx : x∈U) (i : I) (k : ℤ)
    (heq : ell i x=(k:ℝ)*τ) (hother : ∀ j, j≠i → ∀ l : ℤ, ell j x≠(l:ℝ)*τ)
    (v : E) (hv : ell i v>0) :
    ∃ vp vm : LabelVertex ell τ U,
      vp.val i=k ∧ vm.val i=k-1 ∧ (∀ j, j≠i → vp.val j=vm.val j) ∧
      (if 0<pivot i then
        extension ell pivot τ s U F (pattern ell pivot τ s x)=F vp ∧
        extension ell pivot τ s U F (weakPattern ell pivot τ s x)=F vm
      else
        extension ell pivot τ s U F (pattern ell pivot τ s x)=F vm ∧
        extension ell pivot τ s U F (weakPattern ell pivot τ s x)=F vp)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CellInterface.interface_jump_bound
statement:
lemma interface_jump_bound [Fintype A]
    (ell : I → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (pivot : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, pivot i≠0)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0<τ) (s : Finset ℤ) {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hb : ∀ x∈U, regular ell τ x → ∀ i, label ell τ x i∈s)
    (F : LabelVertex ell τ U → A → ℝ) {J : ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ (vp vm : LabelVertex ell τ U) (i : I), vp.val i=vm.val i+1 →
      (∀ j, j≠i → vp.val j=vm.val j) → ∑ a, |F vp a-F vm a|≤J)
    {x : E} (hx : x∈U) (i : I) (k : ℤ)
    (heq : ell i x=(k:ℝ)*τ) (hother : ∀ j, j≠i → ∀ l : ℤ, ell j x≠(l:ℝ)*τ)
    (v : E) (hv : ell i v>0) :
    ∑ a, |extension ell pivot τ s U F (weakPattern ell pivot τ s x) a-
      extension ell pivot τ s U F (pattern ell pivot τ s x) a|≤J

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CellInterface.mem_pattern
statement:
lemma mem_pattern (ell : I → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (pivot : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, pivot i≠0)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0<τ) (s : Finset ℤ) {x : E} (hr : regular ell τ x) (i : I) (k : s) :
    (i,k)∈pattern ell pivot τ s x ↔ if 0<pivot i then label ell τ x i<k.val else k.val≤label ell τ x i

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CellInterface.mem_pattern_at
statement:
lemma mem_pattern_at (ell : I → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (pivot : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, pivot i≠0)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0<τ) (s : Finset ℤ) {x : E} (i : I)
    (hr : ∀ k : ℤ, ell i x≠(k:ℝ)*τ) (k : s) :
    (i,k)∈pattern ell pivot τ s x ↔ if 0<pivot i then label ell τ x i<k.val else k.val≤label ell τ x i

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CellInterface.mem_weakPattern_at
statement:
lemma mem_weakPattern_at (ell : I → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (pivot : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, pivot i≠0)
    (τ : ℝ) (s : Finset ℤ) (x : E) (i : I) (k : s) (hr : ell i x≠(k.val:ℝ)*τ) :
    (i,k)∈weakPattern ell pivot τ s x ↔ (i,k)∈pattern ell pivot τ s x

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CellInterface.neighboring_labels
statement:
lemma neighboring_labels (ell : I → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0<τ)
    {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) {x : E} (hx : x∈U) (i : I) (k : ℤ)
    (heq : ell i x=(k:ℝ)*τ)
    (hother : ∀ j, j≠i → ∀ l : ℤ, ell j x≠(l:ℝ)*τ)
    (v : E) (hv : ell i v>0) :
    ∃ xp xm : E, xp∈U ∧ xm∈U ∧
      (∀ j (l : ℤ), ell j xp≠(l:ℝ)*τ) ∧
      (∀ j (l : ℤ), ell j xm≠(l:ℝ)*τ) ∧
      (∀ j, j≠i → ⌊ell j xp/τ⌋=⌊ell j x/τ⌋ ∧ ⌊ell j xm/τ⌋=⌊ell j x/τ⌋) ∧
      ⌊ell i xp/τ⌋=k ∧ ⌊ell i xm/τ⌋=k-1

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CellInterface.pattern_labels
statement:
lemma pattern_labels (ell : I → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (pivot : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, pivot i≠0)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0<τ) (s : Finset ℤ) {x y : E}
    (hx : regular ell τ x) (hy : regular ell τ y)
    (hbx : ∀ i, label ell τ x i∈s) (hby : ∀ i, label ell τ y i∈s)
    (he : pattern ell pivot τ s x=pattern ell pivot τ s y) : label ell τ x=label ell τ y

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CellInterface.regular_floor_le
statement:
lemma regular_floor_le (ell : I → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0<τ)
    {x : E} (hr : regular ell τ x) (i : I) (k : ℤ) :
    k≤label ell τ x i ↔ (k:ℝ)*τ<ell i x

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ProductSlice.actual_jump_budget
statement:
lemma actual_jump_budget (B : I → Z →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hB : Function.Injective B)
    (pivot : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, pivot i≠0) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0<τ) (s : Finset ℤ)
    {U : Set (ℝ × Z)} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hb : ∀ x∈U, regular (ell B pivot) τ x → ∀ i, label (ell B pivot) τ x i∈s)
    (F : LabelVertex (ell B pivot) τ U → A → ℝ) {J : ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ (vp vm : LabelVertex (ell B pivot) τ U) (i : I), vp.val i=vm.val i+1 →
      (∀ j, j≠i → vp.val j=vm.val j) → ∑ a, |F vp a-F vm a|≤J)
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (ψ : Z → ℝ) (θ : ℝ × Z) (i : I)
    (hsupp : ∀ᵐ z ∂law ψ volume, ∀ k : s,
      φ (form (B i) θ+B i z-(k:ℤ)*τ/pivot i)≠0 → eventPoint B pivot τ θ i k.val z∈U) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂law ψ volume, ∀ k : s,
      φ (form (B i) θ+B i z-(k:ℤ)*τ/pivot i)≠0 →
        ∑ a, |jump B (fun i (k : s) => -((k:ℤ)*τ/pivot i))
          (extension (ell B pivot) pivot τ s U F) θ i k z a|≤J

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ProductSlice.cell_eq_extension
statement:
lemma cell_eq_extension (B : I → Z →L[ℝ] ℝ) (pivot : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, pivot i≠0)
    (τ : ℝ) (s : Finset ℤ) (U : Set (ℝ × Z)) (F : LabelVertex (ell B pivot) τ U → A → ℝ)
    (x : ℝ × Z) (α : A) :
    cell B (fun i (k : s) => -((k:ℤ)*τ/pivot i))
      (fun P => extension (ell B pivot) pivot τ s U F P α) x =
    extension (ell B pivot) pivot τ s U F (pattern (ell B pivot) pivot τ s x) α

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ProductSlice.ell_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma ell_apply (B : I → Z →L[ℝ] ℝ) (pivot : I → ℝ) (i : I) (x : ℝ × Z) :
    ell B pivot i x=pivot i*(x.1-B i x.2)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ProductSlice.event_form
statement:
lemma event_form (B : I → Z →L[ℝ] ℝ) (pivot : I → ℝ) (τ : ℝ)
    (θ : ℝ × Z) (i : I) (k : ℤ) (z : Z) (j : I) :
    form (B j) (eventPoint B pivot τ θ i k z) =
      form (B j) θ+B j z-(form (B i) θ+B i z-(k:ℝ)*τ/pivot i)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ProductSlice.event_on_plane
statement:
lemma event_on_plane (B : I → Z →L[ℝ] ℝ) (pivot : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, pivot i≠0)
    (τ : ℝ) (θ : ℝ × Z) (i : I) (k : ℤ) (z : Z) :
    ell B pivot i (eventPoint B pivot τ θ i k z)=(k:ℝ)*τ

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ProductSlice.event_other_regular
statement:
lemma event_other_regular (B : I → Z →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hB : Function.Injective B)
    (pivot : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, pivot i≠0) (τ : ℝ) (θ : ℝ × Z) (i : I) (k : ℤ)
    (μ : Measure Z) (hμ : μ ≪ volume) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, ∀ j, j≠i → ∀ l : ℤ, ell B pivot j (eventPoint B pivot τ θ i k z)≠(l:ℝ)*τ

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ProductSlice.jump_eq_traces
statement:
lemma jump_eq_traces (B : I → Z →L[ℝ] ℝ) (pivot : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, pivot i≠0)
    (τ : ℝ) (s : Finset ℤ) (U : Set (ℝ × Z)) (F : LabelVertex (ell B pivot) τ U → A → ℝ)
    (θ : ℝ × Z) (i : I) (k : s) (z : Z) (α : A) :
    jump B (fun i (k : s) => -((k:ℤ)*τ/pivot i))
      (extension (ell B pivot) pivot τ s U F) θ i k z α =
    extension (ell B pivot) pivot τ s U F
      (weakPattern (ell B pivot) pivot τ s (eventPoint B pivot τ θ i k.val z)) α-
    extension (ell B pivot) pivot τ s U F
      (pattern (ell B pivot) pivot τ s (eventPoint B pivot τ θ i k.val z)) α

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ProductSlice.normalized_ell
statement:
lemma normalized_ell (B : I → Z →L[ℝ] ℝ) (pivot : I → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, pivot i≠0)
    (τ : ℝ) (i : I) (k : ℤ) (x : ℝ × Z) :
    (ell B pivot i x-(k:ℝ)*τ)/pivot i=form (B i) x-(k:ℝ)*τ/pivot i

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CoordinateSplit.convolution_split
statement:
lemma convolution_split (φ : E → ℝ) (f : (ℝ × Z) → ℝ)
    (θ : E) :
    convolution φ (f ∘ split) (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) volume θ =
    convolution (φ ∘ split.symm) f (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) volume (split θ)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CoordinateSplit.derivative_transport
statement:
lemma derivative_transport (h : (ℝ × Z) → ℝ) (D : (ℝ × Z) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (θ : E) (hd : HasFDerivAt h D (split θ)) :
    HasFDerivAt (h ∘ split) (D.comp split.toContinuousLinearMap) θ

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CoordinateSplit.inner_formula
statement: lemma inner_formula (u x : E) : inner ℝ u x=u 0*(split x).1+rest u (split x).2

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CoordinateSplit.integral_split
statement: lemma integral_split (f : ℝ × Z → ℝ) : (∫ x : E, f (split x))=∫ p, f p

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CoordinateSplit.normalized_form
statement:
lemma normalized_form (u : E) (hu : u 0≠0) (x : E) :
    inner ℝ u x/(u 0)=(split x).1-slope u (split x).2

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CoordinateSplit.preserving
statement: lemma preserving : MeasurePreserving (split (m := m)) volume volume

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CoordinateSplit.rest_apply
statement: lemma rest_apply (u : E) (z : Z) : rest u z=∑ j, u j.succ*z j

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CoordinateSplit.slope_injective
statement:
lemma slope_injective {I : Type u1} (u : I → E) (hu : ∀ i, u i 0≠0)
    (hn : ∀ i j, i≠j → ∀ t : ℝ, u i≠t • u j) : Function.Injective (fun i => slope (u i))

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CoordinateSplit.split_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma split_apply (x : E) : split x=(x 0,WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => x j.succ))

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.CoordinateSplit.split_symm_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma split_symm_apply (p : ℝ × Z) : split.symm p=WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons p.1 (fun j => p.2 j))

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.EuclideanCells.chartFunction_eq
statement:
lemma chartFunction_eq (u : I → E) (hu : ∀ i, u i 0≠0)
    {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0<τ) (s : Finset ℤ) (U : Set (ℝ × Z))
    (hb : ∀ x∈U, regular (ell (B u) (pivot u)) τ x → ∀ i, label (ell (B u) (pivot u)) τ x i∈s)
    (F : LabelVertex (ell (B u) (pivot u)) τ U → A → ℝ)
    (x : E) (hx : split x∈U) (hr : regular (ell (B u) (pivot u)) τ (split x)) (a : A) :
    chartFunction u τ s U F a x=F (vertex (ell (B u) (pivot u)) τ (split x) hx hr) a

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.EuclideanCells.chartFunction_integrable
statement:
lemma chartFunction_integrable (u : I → E) (τ : ℝ) (s : Finset ℤ) (U : Set (ℝ × Z))
    (F : LabelVertex (ell (B u) (pivot u)) τ U → A → ℝ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0≤M)
    (hF : ∀ v a, |F v a|≤M) (a : A) : LocallyIntegrable (chartFunction u τ s U F a)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.EuclideanCells.chartFunction_measurable
statement:
lemma chartFunction_measurable (u : I → E) (τ : ℝ) (s : Finset ℤ) (U : Set (ℝ × Z))
    (F : LabelVertex (ell (B u) (pivot u)) τ U → A → ℝ) (a : A) :
    Measurable (chartFunction u τ s U F a)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.EuclideanCells.form_comp
statement:
lemma form_comp (u : E) (hu : u 0≠0) :
    (form (slope u)).comp split.toContinuousLinearMap=(u 0)⁻¹ • InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E u

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.EuclideanCells.kernel_split
statement:
lemma kernel_split (φ : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (ProductMollifier.kernel (m := m+1) φ) ∘ split.symm =
      (fun p : ℝ × Z => φ p.1*ProductMollifier.kernel φ p.2)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConcreteCells.domain_open
statement: lemma domain_open : IsOpen (domain (m := m))

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConcreteCells.ell_eq
statement:
lemma ell_eq (u : Fin N → E) (hu : ∀ i, u i 0≠0) (x : ℝ × Z) (i : Fin N) :
    ProductSlice.ell (B u) (pivot u) i x=inner ℝ (u i) (split.symm x)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConcreteCells.function_bounded
statement:
lemma function_bounded (u : Fin S → Fin N → E) (hu : ∀ s i, u s i 0≠0) (τ : ℝ)
    (F : RoundedCharts.Vertex u τ → A → ℝ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0≤M) (hF : ∀ v a, |F v a|≤M)
    (s : Fin S) (a : A) (x : E) : |function u hu τ F s a x|≤M

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConcreteCells.function_eq
statement:
lemma function_eq (u : Fin S → Fin N → E) (hu : ∀ s i, u s i 0≠0) {τ : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0<τ) (hn : ∀ s i, ‖u s i‖≤2) (F : RoundedCharts.Vertex u τ → A → ℝ)
    (s : Fin S) (x : E) (hx : x∈RoundedCharts.cube 2) (hr : RoundedCharts.regular (u s) τ x) (a : A) :
    function u hu τ F s a x=F ⟨(s,RoundedCharts.integerLabel (u s) τ x),x,hx,hr,rfl⟩ a

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConcreteCells.function_integrable
statement:
lemma function_integrable (u : Fin S → Fin N → E) (hu : ∀ s i, u s i 0≠0) (τ : ℝ)
    (F : RoundedCharts.Vertex u τ → A → ℝ) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0≤M) (hF : ∀ v a, |F v a|≤M)
    (s : Fin S) (a : A) : LocallyIntegrable (function u hu τ F s a)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConcreteCells.function_measurable
statement:
lemma function_measurable (u : Fin S → Fin N → E) (hu : ∀ s i, u s i 0≠0) (τ : ℝ)
    (F : RoundedCharts.Vertex u τ → A → ℝ) (s : Fin S) (a : A) : Measurable (function u hu τ F s a)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConcreteCells.label_eq
statement:
lemma label_eq (u : Fin N → E) (hu : ∀ i, u i 0≠0) (τ : ℝ) (x : ℝ × Z) :
    CellInterface.label (ProductSlice.ell (B u) (pivot u)) τ x =
      RoundedCharts.integerLabel u τ (split.symm x)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConcreteCells.regular_eq
statement:
lemma regular_eq (u : Fin N → E) (hu : ∀ i, u i 0≠0) (τ : ℝ) (x : ℝ × Z) :
    CellInterface.regular (ProductSlice.ell (B u) (pivot u)) τ x ↔
      RoundedCharts.regular u τ (split.symm x)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConcreteCells.regular_sub
statement:
lemma regular_sub (u : Fin N → E) (hu : ∀ i, u i 0≠0) (τ : ℝ) (θ : E) :
    ∀ᵐ z : E, RoundedCharts.regular u τ (θ-z)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConcreteCells.support_domain
statement:
lemma support_domain {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0<lam) (hlam1 : lam<1) (θ : E)
    (hθ : ∀ j, |θ j|≤1) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂ProductSlice.law (ProductMollifier.kernel (m := m) (ProductMollifier.density lam)) volume,
      ∀ t : ℝ, |t|<lam → split θ-(t,z)∈domain

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConvolutionBounds.error
statement:
lemma error {κ : G → ℝ} (hk : HasCompactSupport κ) (hc : Continuous κ)
    (hki : Integrable κ μ) (hkn : ∀ z, 0 ≤ κ z) (hk1 : ∫ z, κ z ∂μ=1)
    (f : A → G → ℝ) (hf : ∀ a, LocallyIntegrable (f a) μ) (x : G) {B : ℝ}
    (hb : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, κ z ≠ 0 → ∑ a, |f a (x-z)-f a x| ≤ B) :
    (∑ a, |smooth κ (f a) μ x-f a x|) ≤ B

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConvolutionBounds.integral_l1_bound
statement:
lemma integral_l1_bound (f : A → G → ℝ) (hf : ∀ a, Integrable (f a) μ)
    {B : G → ℝ} (hB : Integrable B μ) (hb : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, ∑ a, |f a z| ≤ B z) :
    (∑ a, |∫ z, f a z ∂μ|) ≤ ∫ z, B z ∂μ

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConvolutionBounds.mismatch
statement:
lemma mismatch {κ : G → ℝ} (hk : HasCompactSupport κ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ 1 κ)
    (f g : A → G → ℝ) (hf : ∀ a, LocallyIntegrable (f a) μ)
    (hg : ∀ a, LocallyIntegrable (g a) μ) (x h : G) {B : ℝ}
    (hki : Integrable (fun z => |fderiv ℝ κ z h|) μ)
    (hb : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, fderiv ℝ κ z h ≠ 0 → ∑ a, |f a (x-z)-g a (x-z)| ≤ B) :
    (∑ a, |fderiv ℝ (smooth κ (f a) μ) x h-fderiv ℝ (smooth κ (g a) μ) x h|) ≤
      B*(∫ z, |fderiv ℝ κ z h| ∂μ)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConvolutionBounds.smooth_deriv
statement:
lemma smooth_deriv {κ f : G → ℝ} (hk : HasCompactSupport κ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ 1 κ) (hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ) (x h : G) :
    fderiv ℝ (smooth κ f μ) x h = ∫ z, (fderiv ℝ κ z h)*f (x-z) ∂μ

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConvolutionBounds.smooth_deriv_integrable
statement:
lemma smooth_deriv_integrable {κ f : G → ℝ} (hk : HasCompactSupport κ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ 1 κ) (hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ) (x h : G) :
    Integrable (fun z => (fderiv ℝ κ z h)*f (x-z)) μ

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.ConvolutionBounds.smooth_eq
statement:
lemma smooth_eq (κ f : G → ℝ) (x : G) :
    smooth κ f μ x = ∫ z, κ z*f (x-z) ∂μ

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.GradientBudget.directional_control
statement:
lemma directional_control (u : I → E) (β : I → ℝ) (a e : E) {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (ha : a+e=∑ i, β i • u i)
    (hu : ∀ i, |inner ℝ (u i) a| ≤ δ*‖a‖) :
    ‖a‖ ≤ δ*∑ i, |β i|+‖e‖

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.GradientBudget.good_chart_average
statement:
lemma good_chart_average (u : S → I → E) (β : S → I → ℝ) (a : E) (e : S → E)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (ha : ∀ s, a+e s=∑ i, β s i • u s i)
    (good : Finset S) (hgood : (Fintype.card S : ℝ)/2 ≤ good.card)
    (hu : ∀ s ∈ good, ∀ i, |inner ℝ (u s i) a| ≤ δ*‖a‖) :
    (Fintype.card S : ℝ)*‖a‖ ≤ 2*∑ s, (δ*∑ i, |β s i|+‖e s‖)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.GradientBudget.total_gradient
statement:
lemma total_gradient (u : S → I → E) (β : S → I → A → ℝ) (a : A → E) (e : S → A → E)
    {δ B R : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (ha : ∀ s α, a α+e s α=∑ i, β s i α • u s i)
    (hg : ∀ α, ∃ good : Finset S, (Fintype.card S : ℝ)/2 ≤ good.card ∧
      ∀ s ∈ good, ∀ i, |inner ℝ (u s i) (a α)| ≤ δ*‖a α‖)
    (hβ : ∀ s, ∑ i, ∑ α, |β s i α| ≤ B)
    (he : ∀ s, ∑ α, ‖e s α‖ ≤ R) (hS : 0 < Fintype.card S) :
    ∑ α, ‖a α‖ ≤ 2*(δ*B+R)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.GradientCalculus.gradient_budget
statement:
lemma gradient_budget (u : S → I → E) (β : S → I → A → ℝ)
    (D : S → A → StrongDual ℝ E) (base : A → StrongDual ℝ E)
    {δ B R : ℝ} (hδ : 0≤δ)
    (hd : ∀ s a, D s a=∑ i, β s i a • InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E (u s i))
    (hgood : ∀ a, ∃ good : Finset S, (Fintype.card S:ℝ)/2≤good.card ∧
      ∀ s∈good, ∀ i, |base a (u s i)|≤δ*‖base a‖)
    (hβ : ∀ s, ∑ i, ∑ a, |β s i a|≤B)
    (he : ∀ s, ∑ a, ‖D s a-base a‖≤R) (hS : 0<Fintype.card S) :
    ∑ a, ‖base a‖≤2*(δ*B+R)

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.GradientCalculus.gradient_mismatch
statement:
lemma gradient_mismatch {κ : E → ℝ} (hk : HasCompactSupport κ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ 1 κ)
    (f g : A → E → ℝ) (hf : ∀ a, LocallyIntegrable (f a))
    (hg : ∀ a, LocallyIntegrable (g a)) (x : E) {B L : ℝ}
    (hki : ∀ j : Fin m, Integrable (fun z => |fderiv ℝ κ z (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)|))
    (hL : ∀ j : Fin m, ∫ z, |fderiv ℝ κ z (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)| = L)
    (hb : ∀ᵐ z, (∃ j : Fin m, fderiv ℝ κ z (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)≠0) →
      ∑ a, |f a (x-z)-g a (x-z)|≤B) :
    (∑ a, ‖fderiv ℝ (ConvolutionBounds.smooth κ (f a) volume) x-
      fderiv ℝ (ConvolutionBounds.smooth κ (g a) volume) x‖)≤(m:ℝ)*B*L

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.GradientCalculus.norm_le_partials
statement: lemma norm_le_partials (D : StrongDual ℝ E) : ‖D‖≤∑ j, |D (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)|

name: OAI.UniformSparsestCut.GradientCalculus.vector_coordinate
statement:
lemma vector_coordinate (D : StrongDual ℝ E) (j : Fin m) :

statement:
lemma estimates (M : ℕ) (hM : 0<M) (w : V → ℝ) (hw : ∀ v, 0≤w v) (hws : (∑ v,w v)=1)
    (Z : V → H) (htri : ∀ v w z, ‖Z v-Z z‖^2 ≤ ‖Z v-Z w‖^2+‖Z w-Z z‖^2)
    {D a b : ℝ} (hD : 0≤D) (hdiam : ∀ v z, ‖Z v-Z z‖^2≤D)
    (havg : a≤∑ v, ∑ z, w v*w z*‖Z v-Z z‖^2)
    (hcon : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] (F : V → A → ℝ),
      (∀ v z, (∑ k, |F v k-F z k|)≤‖Z v-Z z‖^2) →
      (∑ v, ∑ z, w v*w z*(∑ k, |F v k-F z k|))≤b) :
    let n := Replication.n M w
    let d := fun i j : Fin n => ‖Z (Replication.rep M w i)-Z (Replication.rep M w j)‖^2
    let ε := 4*D*(Fintype.card V:ℝ)/M
    NegativeType d ∧ (n:ℝ)^2*(a-ε)≤∑ i, ∑ j,d i j ∧
      ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] (F : Fin n → A → ℝ),
        (∀ i j, (∑ k, |F i k-F j k|)≤d i j) →
        (∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, |F i k-F j k|)≤(n:ℝ)^2*(b+ε)

statement:
lemma affine_frame_of_anchor_gram {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ}
    (y : ι → Point n) (a b : ι → ℝ) (p : Point n) (d e : Point n)
    (hdd : (inner ℝ (d) (d)) = 4) (hee : (inner ℝ (e) (e)) = 2) (hde : (inner ℝ (d) (e)) = 2)
    (hzz : ∀ i, (inner ℝ (y i-p) (y i-p)) = (a i-1)^2+(b i)^2)
    (hzd : ∀ i, (inner ℝ (y i-p) (d)) = 2*(1-a i))
    (hze : ∀ i, (inner ℝ (y i-p) (e)) = 1-a i+b i) :
    ∃ c A B : Point n, (inner ℝ (A) (A)) = 1 ∧ (inner ℝ (B) (B)) = 1 ∧
      (inner ℝ (A) (B)) = 0 ∧ ∀ i, y i = c + a i • A + b i • B

    (∀ u, shortestPathDistance G ℓ u u = 0) ∧
    (∀ u v, shortestPathDistance G ℓ u v = shortestPathDistance G ℓ v u) ∧
    (∀ u v w, shortestPathDistance G ℓ u w ≤
      shortestPathDistance G ℓ u v + shortestPathDistance G ℓ v w) ∧
    (∀ u v, shortestPathDistance G ℓ u v = 0 → u = v) ∧
    (∀ u v, ∃ p : G.Walk u v,

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.blockRelation_star_cross
statement:
theorem blockRelation_star_cross {α β : Type*} (E : SetRel α α) (F : SetRel α β)
    (G : SetRel β α) (H : SetRel β β) (x : α) (y : β) :
    ((Sum.inl x), (Sum.inr y)) ∈ relStar (blockRelation E F G H) ↔
      (x, y) ∈ relStar E ○ F ○ relStar (H ∪ (G ○ relStar E ○ F))

      (x, y) ∈ relStar (H ∪ (G ○ relStar E ○ F))

    ∃ a b, (x, a) ∈ relStar (E ○ B) ∧ (a, b) ∈ E ∧

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relStar_block_exit
statement:
theorem relStar_block_exit {α : Type*} (L R B E D : SetRel α α) :
    relStar ((L ○ R) ∪ (B ○ relStar D ○ E ○ R)) ○ (L ∪ (B ○ relStar D ○ E)) =
      (relStar (L ○ R) ○ L) ∪
        (relStar (L ○ R) ○ B ○ relStar (D ∪ (E ○ R ○ relStar (L ○ R) ○ B)) ○
          E ○ relStar (R ○ L))

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relStar_block_forward
statement:
theorem relStar_block_forward {α : Type*} (A B C D : SetRel α α) :
    relStar (A ∪ (B ○ relStar D ○ C)) ○ B ○ relStar D =
      relStar A ○ B ○ relStar (D ∪ (C ○ relStar A ○ B))

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relStar_block_return
statement:
theorem relStar_block_return {α : Type*} (A B C D : SetRel α α) :
    relStar (A ∪ (B ○ relStar D ○ C)) =
      relStar A ∪ (relStar A ○ B ○ relStar (D ∪ (C ○ relStar A ○ B)) ○
        C ○ relStar A)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relStar_comp_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relStar_comp_self {α : Type*} (R : SetRel α α) :
    relStar R ○ relStar R = relStar R

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relStar_comp_unfold
statement:
theorem relStar_comp_unfold {α β : Type*} (R : SetRel α β) (L : SetRel β α) :
    relStar (R ○ L) = SetRel.id ∪ (R ○ relStar (L ○ R) ○ L)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relStar_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relStar_empty {α : Type*} : relStar (∅ : SetRel α α) = SetRel.id

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relStar_lost_edge
OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relStar_mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem relStar_mono {α : Type*} {R S : SetRel α α} (h : R ⊆ S) :
    relStar R ⊆ relStar S

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relStar_unfold
statement:
theorem relStar_unfold {α : Type*} (R : SetRel α α) :
    relStar R = SetRel.id ∪ (relStar R ○ R)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relStar_union
statement:
theorem relStar_union {α : Type*} (A B : SetRel α α) :
    relStar (A ∪ B) = relStar A ○ relStar (B ○ relStar A)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.union_relComp
statement:
theorem union_relComp {α β γ : Type*} (A B : SetRel α β) (C : SetRel β γ) :
    (A ∪ B) ○ C = (A ○ C) ∪ (B ○ C)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.weighted_class_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_class_bound {α β : Type*} (X M : Finset α) (Y : Finset β)
    (R : β → α → Prop) (hM : M ⊆ X)
    (hunique : ∀ y ∈ Y, ∀ z ∈ Y, ∀ x ∈ X, R y x → R z x → y = z)
    (hcover : ∀ y ∈ Y,
      (∃ x ∈ X, x ∉ M ∧ R y x) ∨
        ∃ x ∈ X, ∃ z ∈ X, x ≠ z ∧ R y x ∧ R y z) :
    2 * Y.card + M.card ≤ 2 * X.card

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.comp_assoc
statement:
theorem comp_assoc {m : ℕ} (a b c : Diagram m) :
    comp (comp a b) c = comp a (comp b c)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.comp_assoc_forward
statement:
theorem comp_assoc_forward {m : ℕ} (a b c : Diagram m) :
    (comp (comp a b) c).forward = (comp a (comp b c)).forward

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.comp_assoc_left
statement:
theorem comp_assoc_left {m : ℕ} (a b c : Diagram m) :
    (comp (comp a b) c).left = (comp a (comp b c)).left

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.comp_identity
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_identity {m : ℕ} (a : Diagram m) : comp a (identity m) = a

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.context_forward_iff
statement:
theorem context_forward_iff {m : ℕ} (u e v : Diagram m) {p q : Fin m} :
    (p, q) ∈ (comp (comp u e) v).forward ↔
      ∃ a b, (p, a) ∈ u.forward ∧
        ((false, a), (true, b)) ∈ e.feedback u.right v.left ∧ (b, q) ∈ v.forward

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.context_surviving
statement:
theorem context_surviving {m : ℕ} (d u e v : Diagram m) (positive : Bool) :
    d.surviving (comp (comp u e) v) positive =
      contextEntry d u v positive ○ e.feedback u.right v.left ○ contextExit d u v positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.context_through_iff
statement:
theorem context_through_iff {m : ℕ} (u e v : Diagram m) (positive : Bool) {p q : Fin m} :
    (p, q) ∈ (comp (comp u e) v).through positive ↔
      ∃ a b, (p, a) ∈ (if positive then u.forward else v.backward) ∧
        ((!positive, a), (positive, b)) ∈ e.feedback u.right v.left ∧
        (b, q) ∈ (if positive then v.forward else u.backward)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.feedback_forward
statement:
theorem feedback_forward {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (R L : SetRel (Fin m) (Fin m))
    {p q : Fin m} :
    ((false, p), (true, q)) ∈ e.feedback R L ↔
      (p, q) ∈ relStar (e.left ○ R) ○ e.forward ○
        relStar (L ○ (e.right ∪ (e.backward ○ R ○ relStar (e.left ○ R) ○ e.forward)))

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.feedback_reflect_map
statement:
theorem feedback_reflect_map {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (R L : SetRel (Fin m) (Fin m))
    {s t : Bool} {p q : Fin m} (h : ((s, p), (t, q)) ∈ e.feedback R L) :
    ((!s, p), (!t, q)) ∈ (reflect e).feedback L R

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.finite_diagram
statement:
@[instance]
theorem finite_diagram {m : ℕ} : Finite (Diagram m)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.identity_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem identity_comp {m : ℕ} (a : Diagram m) : comp (identity m) a = a

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.inclusion_refl
statement: theorem inclusion_refl {m : ℕ} (a : Diagram m) : (a, a) ∈ inclusion m

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.mem_feedback_reflect
statement:
theorem mem_feedback_reflect {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (R L : SetRel (Fin m) (Fin m))
    {s t : Bool} {p q : Fin m} :
    ((s, p), (t, q)) ∈ (reflect e).feedback L R ↔
      ((!s, p), (!t, q)) ∈ e.feedback R L

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.mem_port_through
statement:
theorem mem_port_through {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (positive : Bool) (p q : Fin m) :
    ((!positive, p), (positive, q)) ∈ e.portRelation ↔ (p, q) ∈ e.through positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.reflect_comp
statement:
theorem reflect_comp {m : ℕ} (a b : Diagram m) :
    reflect (comp a b) = comp (reflect b) (reflect a)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.class_count
statement: theorem class_count {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) : e.classes.ncard ≤ 2 * m

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.class_eq_of_common
statement:
theorem class_eq_of_common {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    {c d : Bool × Set (Fin m)} (hc : c ∈ e.classes) (hd : d ∈ e.classes)
    (hsign : c.1 = d.1) {x : Fin m} (hx : x ∈ c.2) (hxd : x ∈ d.2) : c = d

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.class_eq_of_mem
OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.class_nonempty
statement:
theorem class_nonempty {m : ℕ} {e : Diagram m} {c : Bool × Set (Fin m)}
    (hc : c ∈ e.classes) : c.2.Nonempty

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.class_related
statement:
theorem class_related {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    {c : Bool × Set (Fin m)} (hc : c ∈ e.classes) {x y : Fin m}
    (hx : x ∈ c.2) (hy : y ∈ c.2) :
    (x, y) ∈ e.recurrence c.1 ∧ (y, x) ∈ e.recurrence c.1

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.comp_mono
OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.corner_comp
statement:
theorem corner_comp {m : ℕ} {e z w : Diagram m} (hz : z ∈ e.corner)
    (hw : w ∈ e.corner) : comp z w ∈ e.corner

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.corner_forward_absorption
statement:
theorem corner_forward_absorption {m : ℕ} (e z : Diagram m) (hz : z ∈ e.corner) :
    e.forward ○ e.loopClosure true ○ z.forward ⊆ z.forward ∧
    z.forward ○ e.loopClosure true ○ e.forward ⊆ z.forward

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.corner_returns
statement:
theorem corner_returns {m : ℕ} (e z : Diagram m) (hz : z ∈ e.corner) :
    e.left ⊆ z.left ∧ e.right ⊆ z.right

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.corner_through_absorption
statement:
theorem corner_through_absorption {m : ℕ} (e z : Diagram m) (hz : z ∈ e.corner)
    (positive : Bool) :
    e.through positive ○ e.loopClosure positive ○ z.through positive ⊆ z.through positive ∧
    z.through positive ○ e.loopClosure positive ○ e.through positive ⊆ z.through positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.loopClosure_comp
statement:
theorem loopClosure_comp {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (positive : Bool)
    (R : SetRel (Fin m) (Fin m)) :
    e.loopClosure positive ○ (e.loopClosure positive ○ R) = e.loopClosure positive ○ R

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.loopClosure_comp_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem loopClosure_comp_self {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (positive : Bool) :
    e.loopClosure positive ○ e.loopClosure positive = e.loopClosure positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.missing_comp
statement:
theorem missing_comp {m : ℕ} (e z w : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (hz : z ∈ e.corner) (hw : w ∈ e.corner) :
    e.missing (comp z w) ⊆ e.missing z ∪ e.missing w

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.missing_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem missing_self {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) : e.missing e = ∅

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.nesting_refl
statement:
theorem nesting_refl {m : ℕ} {e : Diagram m} (he : comp e e = e) :
    (e, e) ∈ nesting m

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.nesting_trans
OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.not_mem_missing_iff
statement:
theorem not_mem_missing_iff {m : ℕ} (e z : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (hz : z ∈ e.corner) {c : Bool × Set (Fin m)} (hc : c ∈ e.classes)
    {x : Fin m} (hx : x ∈ c.2) :
    c ∉ e.missing z ↔ (x, x) ∈ e.surviving z c.1

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.rectangle_cover
statement:
theorem rectangle_cover {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    {positive : Bool} {u v : Fin m} (huv : (u, v) ∈ e.through positive) :
    ∃ p, (p, p) ∈ e.recurrence positive ∧ (u, v) ∈ e.rectangle positive p

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.rectangle_eq_of_related
statement:
theorem rectangle_eq_of_related {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    {positive : Bool} {p q : Fin m} (hpq : (p, q) ∈ e.recurrence positive)
    (hqp : (q, p) ∈ e.recurrence positive) :
    e.rectangle positive p = e.rectangle positive q

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.rectangle_subset
statement:
theorem rectangle_subset {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (positive : Bool) (p : Fin m) : e.rectangle positive p ⊆ e.through positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.rectangle_survives
statement:
theorem rectangle_survives {m : ℕ} (e z : Diagram m) (hz : z ∈ e.corner)
    {positive : Bool} {p : Fin m} (hp : (p, p) ∈ e.surviving z positive) :
    e.rectangle positive p ⊆ z.through positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.recurrence_comp_through
statement:
theorem recurrence_comp_through {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (positive : Bool) :
    e.recurrence positive ○ e.through positive = e.loopClosure positive ○ e.through positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.recurrence_idempotent
statement:
theorem recurrence_idempotent {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (positive : Bool) :
    e.recurrence positive ○ e.recurrence positive = e.recurrence positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.recurrence_trans
statement:
theorem recurrence_trans {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    {positive : Bool} {x y z : Fin m}
    (hxy : (x, y) ∈ e.recurrence positive) (hyz : (y, z) ∈ e.recurrence positive) :
    (x, z) ∈ e.recurrence positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.surviving_absorption
statement:
theorem surviving_absorption {m : ℕ} (e z : Diagram m) (hz : z ∈ e.corner)
    (positive : Bool) :
    e.recurrence positive ○ e.surviving z positive ⊆ e.surviving z positive ∧
    e.surviving z positive ○ e.recurrence positive ⊆ e.surviving z positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.surviving_comp
statement:
theorem surviving_comp {m : ℕ} (e z w : Diagram m)
    (hz : z ∈ e.corner) (hw : w ∈ e.corner) (positive : Bool) :
    (if positive then e.surviving z positive ○ e.surviving w positive
      else e.surviving w positive ○ e.surviving z positive) ⊆
      e.surviving (comp z w) positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.surviving_loop_iff
statement:
theorem surviving_loop_iff {m : ℕ} (e z : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (hz : z ∈ e.corner) {c : Bool × Set (Fin m)} (hc : c ∈ e.classes)
    {x y : Fin m} (hx : x ∈ c.2) (hy : y ∈ c.2) :
    (x, x) ∈ e.surviving z c.1 ↔ (y, y) ∈ e.surviving z c.1

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.through_comp_recurrence
statement:
theorem through_comp_recurrence {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (positive : Bool) :
    e.through positive ○ e.recurrence positive = e.through positive ○ e.loopClosure positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.through_loop_through
statement:
theorem through_loop_through {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (positive : Bool) :
    e.through positive ○ e.loopClosure positive ○ e.through positive = e.through positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.classInfluence_cross
statement:
theorem classInfluence_cross {m : ℕ} (e d u v : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (positive : Bool) {C : Bool × Set (Fin m)} (hC : C ∈ e.classes) {a b c f : Fin m}
    (hab : (a, b) ∈ e.classInfluence d u v positive C)
    (hcf : (c, f) ∈ e.classInfluence d u v positive C) :
    (a, f) ∈ e.classInfluence d u v positive C

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.classInfluence_subset
statement:
theorem classInfluence_subset {m : ℕ} (e d u v : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (hcontext : comp (comp u e) v = d) (positive : Bool) (C : Bool × Set (Fin m)) :
    e.classInfluence d u v positive C ⊆ d.recurrence positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.classRectangle_cross
statement:
theorem classRectangle_cross {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    {C : Bool × Set (Fin m)} (hC : C ∈ e.classes) {a b c d : Bool × Fin m}
    (hab : (a, b) ∈ e.classRectangle C) (hcd : (c, d) ∈ e.classRectangle C) :
    (a, d) ∈ e.classRectangle C

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.classRectangle_subset
statement:
theorem classRectangle_subset {m : ℕ} (e : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (C : Bool × Set (Fin m)) : e.classRectangle C ⊆ e.portRelation

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.classRectangle_survives
statement:
theorem classRectangle_survives {m : ℕ} (e z : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (hz : z ∈ e.corner) {C : Bool × Set (Fin m)} (hC : C ∈ e.classes)
    (hmissing : C ∉ e.missing z) : e.classRectangle C ⊆ z.portRelation

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.inclusion_of_missing_empty
statement:
theorem inclusion_of_missing_empty {m : ℕ} (e z : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (hz : z ∈ e.corner) (hmissing : e.missing z = ∅) : (e, z) ∈ inclusion m

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.missing_context_subset_marked
statement:
theorem missing_context_subset_marked {m : ℕ} (e d u v z : Diagram m)
    (he : comp e e = e) (hd : comp d d = d) (hcontext : comp (comp u e) v = d)
    (hz : z ∈ e.corner) (J : Set (Bool × Set (Fin m))) (hJz : e.missing z ⊆ J) :
    d.missing (comp (comp u z) v) ⊆ e.transportMarked d u v J

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.portRelation_covered
statement:
theorem portRelation_covered {m : ℕ} (e z : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (hz : z ∈ e.corner) {a b : Bool × Fin m} (hab : (a, b) ∈ e.portRelation) :
    (a, b) ∈ z.portRelation ∨ ∃ C ∈ e.missing z, (a, b) ∈ e.classRectangle C

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.transport
statement:
theorem transport {m : ℕ} (e d u v : Diagram m)
    (he : comp e e = e) (hd : comp d d = d) (hcontext : comp (comp u e) v = d)
    (J : Set (Bool × Set (Fin m))) (hJ : J ⊆ e.classes) :
    ∃ J' ⊆ d.classes, J'.ncard ≤ 2 * J.ncard ∧
      ∀ z ∈ e.corner, e.missing z ⊆ J → comp (comp u z) v ∈ d.corner →
        d.missing (comp (comp u z) v) ⊆ J'

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.transportMarked_card
statement:
theorem transportMarked_card {m : ℕ} (e d u v : Diagram m)
    (he : comp e e = e) (hd : comp d d = d) (hcontext : comp (comp u e) v = d)
    (J : Set (Bool × Set (Fin m))) (hJ : J ⊆ e.classes) :
    (e.transportMarked d u v J).ncard ≤ 2 * J.ncard

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.corner_forward_factor
statement:
theorem corner_forward_factor {m : ℕ} (e d : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (hd : d ∈ e.corner) {u v : Fin m} (huv : (u, v) ∈ d.forward) :
    ∃ p q, (p, p) ∈ e.recurrence true ∧ (q, q) ∈ e.recurrence true ∧
      (u, p) ∈ e.forward ○ e.loopClosure true ∧ (p, q) ∈ e.surviving d true ∧
      (q, v) ∈ e.loopClosure true ○ e.forward

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.corner_through_factor
statement:
theorem corner_through_factor {m : ℕ} (e d : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (hd : d ∈ e.corner) {positive : Bool} {u v : Fin m}
    (huv : (u, v) ∈ d.through positive) :
    ∃ p q, (p, p) ∈ e.recurrence positive ∧ (q, q) ∈ e.recurrence positive ∧
      (u, p) ∈ e.through positive ○ e.loopClosure positive ∧
      (p, q) ∈ e.surviving d positive ∧
      (q, v) ∈ e.loopClosure positive ○ e.through positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.loopClosure_subset_of_corner
statement:
theorem loopClosure_subset_of_corner {m : ℕ} (e d : Diagram m) (hd : d ∈ e.corner)
    (positive : Bool) : e.loopClosure positive ⊆ d.loopClosure positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.nested_chain_bound
statement:
theorem nested_chain_bound {m k : ℕ} (b : ℕ → Diagram m)
    (hidemp : ∀ j ≤ k, comp (b j) (b j) = b j)
    (hnest : ∀ j < k, (b (j + 1), b j) ∈ nesting m)
    (J : Set (Bool × Set (Fin m)))
    (hJ : ∀ j ≤ k, (b 0).missing (b j) ⊆ J) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, ((b j).missing (b (j + 1))).ncard ≤ 2 * J.ncard

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.nested_class_containment
statement:
theorem nested_class_containment {m : ℕ} (e d : Diagram m)
    (he : comp e e = e) (hd : comp d d = d) (hde : d ∈ e.corner)
    {c : Bool × Set (Fin m)} (hc : c ∈ d.classes) :
    (∃ C ∈ e.classes, C.1 = c.1 ∧ C.2 ⊆ c.2 ∧ C ∉ e.missing d) ∨
      ∃ C ∈ e.classes, ∃ D ∈ e.classes,
        C ≠ D ∧ C.1 = c.1 ∧ D.1 = c.1 ∧ C.2 ⊆ c.2 ∧ D.2 ⊆ c.2

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.nested_forward_loop_absorption
statement:
theorem nested_forward_loop_absorption {m : ℕ} (e d : Diagram m) (hd : d ∈ e.corner) :
    e.forward ○ d.loopClosure true ○ d.forward ⊆ d.loopClosure true ○ d.forward ∧
    d.forward ○ d.loopClosure true ○ e.forward ⊆ d.forward ○ d.loopClosure true

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.nested_recurrence_absorption
statement:
theorem nested_recurrence_absorption {m : ℕ} (e d : Diagram m) (hd : d ∈ e.corner)
    (positive : Bool) :
    e.recurrence positive ○ d.recurrence positive ⊆ d.recurrence positive ∧
    d.recurrence positive ○ e.recurrence positive ⊆ d.recurrence positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.nested_recurrent_witness
statement:
theorem nested_recurrent_witness {m : ℕ} (e d : Diagram m) (he : comp e e = e)
    (hd : d ∈ e.corner) {positive : Bool} {x : Fin m}
    (hxx : (x, x) ∈ d.recurrence positive) :
    ∃ p q, (p, p) ∈ e.recurrence positive ∧ (q, q) ∈ e.recurrence positive ∧
      (x, p) ∈ d.recurrence positive ∧ (p, x) ∈ d.recurrence positive ∧
      (x, q) ∈ d.recurrence positive ∧ (q, x) ∈ d.recurrence positive ∧
      (p, q) ∈ e.surviving d positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.nested_through_absorption
statement:
theorem nested_through_absorption {m : ℕ} (e d : Diagram m) (hd : d ∈ e.corner)
    (positive : Bool) :
    e.through positive ○ d.recurrence positive ⊆ d.recurrence positive ∧
    d.recurrence positive ○ e.through positive ⊆ d.recurrence positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.nested_through_loop_absorption
statement:
theorem nested_through_loop_absorption {m : ℕ} (e d : Diagram m) (hd : d ∈ e.corner)
    (positive : Bool) :
    e.through positive ○ d.loopClosure positive ○ d.through positive ⊆
      d.loopClosure positive ○ d.through positive ∧
    d.through positive ○ d.loopClosure positive ○ e.through positive ⊆
      d.through positive ○ d.loopClosure positive

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Diagram.nested_unprotected_loss
statement:
theorem nested_unprotected_loss {m : ℕ} (e d : Diagram m)
    (he : comp e e = e) (hd : comp d d = d) (hde : d ∈ e.corner)
    (P : Set (Bool × Fin m)) (hmissing : e.missing d ⊆ e.unprotected P) :
    2 * (d.unprotected P).ncard + (e.missing d).ncard ≤ 2 * (e.unprotected P).ncard

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.finite_corner
OAI.TwoWayComplementation.finite_idempotent_pow
statement:
theorem finite_idempotent_pow {A : Type*} [Monoid A] [Finite A] (a : A) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ IsIdempotentElem (a ^ k)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.finite_subsemigroup_idempotent
statement:
theorem finite_subsemigroup_idempotent {A : Type*} [Semigroup A] [Finite A]
    (S : Set A) (hne : S.Nonempty) (hmul : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x * y ∈ S) :
    ∃ e ∈ S, IsIdempotentElem e

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.map_positive_pow
statement:
theorem map_positive_pow {A B : Type*} [Monoid A] [Monoid B]
    (f : A →ₙ* B) (a : A) (k : ℕ) : f (a ^ (k + 1)) = f a ^ (k + 1)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.minimal_idempotent_lift
statement:
theorem minimal_idempotent_lift {A M : Type*} [Semigroup A] [Finite A] [Semigroup M]
    (θ : A →ₙ* M) (hθ : Function.Surjective θ) (q : M) (hq : IsIdempotentElem q) :
    ∃ d, IsIdempotentElem d ∧ θ d = q ∧
      ∀ e, IsIdempotentElem e → θ e = q → e * d = e → d * e = e → e = d

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.RelationMonoid.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {H : Type*} {R S : RelationMonoid H} (h : R.toRel = S.toRel) : R = S

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.RelationMonoid.toRel_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toRel_mul {H : Type*} (R S : RelationMonoid H) :
    (R * S).toRel = R.toRel ○ S.toRel

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.RelationMonoid.toRel_ofRel
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toRel_ofRel {H : Type*} (R : SetRel H H) : (ofRel R).toRel = R

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.RelationMonoid.toRel_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toRel_one {H : Type*} : (1 : RelationMonoid H).toRel = SetRel.id

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relation_corner_comp
statement:
theorem relation_corner_comp {α : Type*} (P i A B : SetRel α α)
    (hP : P ○ P = P) (hi : i ○ i = i) (hiPi : i ○ P ○ i = i)
    (hA : i ○ A ○ i = A) (hB : i ○ B ○ i = B) :
    (P ○ A ○ P) ○ (P ○ B ○ P) = P ○ (A ○ B) ○ P

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relation_corner_identities
statement:
theorem relation_corner_identities {α : Type*} (P i : SetRel α α)
    (hP : P ○ P = P) (hiPi : i ○ P ○ i = i) :
    let Q := P ○ i ○ P
    Q ○ Q = Q ∧ P ○ Q = Q ∧ Q ○ P = Q ∧
    Q ○ i = P ○ i ∧ i ○ Q = i ○ P ∧ i ○ Q ○ i = i

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relation_corner_inverse
statement:
theorem relation_corner_inverse {α : Type*} (P i : SetRel α α)
    (hP : P ○ P = P) (hiPi : i ○ P ○ i = i) :
    (∀ Z, (P ○ i ○ P) ○ Z ○ (P ○ i ○ P) = Z → P ○ (i ○ Z ○ i) ○ P = Z) ∧
    (∀ A, i ○ A ○ i = A →
      (P ○ i ○ P) ○ (P ○ A ○ P) ○ (P ○ i ○ P) = P ○ A ○ P ∧
      i ○ (P ○ A ○ P) ○ i = A)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relation_extend_comp
statement:
theorem relation_extend_comp {H : Type*} (F : Set H) (A B : SetRel F F) :
    (Prod.map Subtype.val Subtype.val) '' (A ○ B) =
      ((Prod.map Subtype.val Subtype.val) '' A) ○
        ((Prod.map Subtype.val Subtype.val) '' B)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relation_extend_restrict
statement:
theorem relation_extend_restrict {H : Type*} (F : Set H) (R : SetRel F F) :
    {xy : F × F | (xy.1.val, xy.2.val) ∈ (Prod.map Subtype.val Subtype.val) '' R} = R

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relation_restrict_extend
statement:
theorem relation_restrict_extend {H : Type*} (F : Set H) (R : SetRel H H) :
    (Prod.map Subtype.val Subtype.val) '' {xy : F × F | (xy.1.val, xy.2.val) ∈ R} =
      restrictedIdentity F ○ R ○ restrictedIdentity F

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.restrictedIdentity_comp_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrictedIdentity_comp_self {α : Type*} (F : Set α) :
    restrictedIdentity F ○ restrictedIdentity F = restrictedIdentity F

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.singleton_context
OAI.TwoWayComplementation.bipartite_relation_comp
statement:
theorem bipartite_relation_comp {H : Type*} (F U V : Set H)
    (hU : U ⊆ F) (hV : V ⊆ F) (hUV : Disjoint U V)
    (E E' : SetRel H H) (hE : E ⊆ U ×ˢ V) (hE' : E' ⊆ U ×ˢ V) :
    (restrictedIdentity F ∪ E) ○ (restrictedIdentity F ∪ E') =
      restrictedIdentity F ∪ (E ∪ E')

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.hub_pair_relation
statement:
theorem hub_pair_relation {H : Type*} (u v z : H) (huz : u ≠ z) (hvz : v ≠ z) :
    restrictedIdentity {x | x ≠ z} ○ (SetRel.id ∪ {(u, z)}) ○
      (SetRel.id ∪ {(z, v)}) ○ restrictedIdentity {x | x ≠ z} =
        restrictedIdentity {x | x ≠ z} ∪ {(u, v)}

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.missing_context_card
statement:
theorem missing_context_card {m : ℕ} (e d u v z : Diagram m)
    (he : Diagram.comp e e = e) (hd : Diagram.comp d d = d)
    (hcontext : Diagram.comp (Diagram.comp u e) v = d) (hz : z ∈ e.corner)
    (hnew : Diagram.comp (Diagram.comp u z) v ∈ d.corner) :
    (d.missing (Diagram.comp (Diagram.comp u z) v)).ncard ≤ 2 * (e.missing z).ncard

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.permutation_conjugate_relation
statement:
theorem permutation_conjugate_relation {H : Type*} (σ : Equiv.Perm H) (R : SetRel H H) :
    Function.graph σ ○ R ○ Function.graph σ.symm = {xy | (σ xy.1, σ xy.2) ∈ R}

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.Network.summary_join
statement:
theorem summary_join {m : ℕ} {V W : Type*} (N : Network m V) (M : Network m W) :
    (N.join M).summary = Diagram.comp N.summary M.summary

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.blockRelation_star_back
statement:
theorem blockRelation_star_back {α β : Type*} (E : SetRel α α) (F : SetRel α β)
    (G : SetRel β α) (H : SetRel β β) (x : β) (y : α) :
    (Sum.inr x, Sum.inl y) ∈ relStar (blockRelation E F G H) ↔
      (x, y) ∈ relStar H ○ G ○ relStar (E ∪ (F ○ relStar H ○ G))

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.blockRelation_star_left
statement:
theorem blockRelation_star_left {α β : Type*} (E : SetRel α α) (F : SetRel α β)
    (G : SetRel β α) (H : SetRel β β) (x y : α) :
    (Sum.inl x, Sum.inl y) ∈ relStar (blockRelation E F G H) ↔
      (x, y) ∈ relStar (E ∪ (F ○ relStar H ○ G))

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.blockRelation_star_swap
statement:
theorem blockRelation_star_swap {α β : Type*} (E : SetRel α α) (F : SetRel α β)
    (G : SetRel β α) (H : SetRel β β) (x y : α ⊕ β) :
    (x.swap, y.swap) ∈ relStar (blockRelation H G F E) ↔
      (x, y) ∈ relStar (blockRelation E F G H)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relStar_entry_feedback
statement:
theorem relStar_entry_feedback {Q V : Type*} (I : SetRel Q V) (E : SetRel V V)
    (O R : SetRel V Q) (X : SetRel Q Q) :
    I ○ relStar (E ∪ (R ○ X ○ I)) ○ O =
      relStar (I ○ relStar E ○ R ○ X) ○ (I ○ relStar E ○ O)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relStar_general_feedback
statement:
theorem relStar_general_feedback {Q V : Type*} (I J : SetRel Q V) (E : SetRel V V)
    (O R : SetRel V Q) (X : SetRel Q Q) :
    I ○ relStar (E ∪ (R ○ X ○ J)) ○ O =
      (I ○ relStar E ○ O) ∪
        (I ○ relStar E ○ R ○ relStar (X ○ J ○ relStar E ○ R) ○ X ○ J ○ relStar E ○ O)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.wordDiagram_append
statement:
theorem wordDiagram_append {Sigma : Type*} {m : ℕ} (d : Sigma → Diagram m)
    (u v : List Sigma) :
    wordDiagram d (u ++ v) = Diagram.comp (wordDiagram d u) (wordDiagram d v)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.wordDiagram_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordDiagram_nil {Sigma : Type*} {m : ℕ} (d : Sigma → Diagram m) :
    wordDiagram d [] = Diagram.identity m

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.ChainNode.coordinates_injective
statement:
theorem coordinates_injective {m n : ℕ} (c d : ChainNode m n)
    (hp : c.position = d.position) (hq : c.label = d.label) : c = d

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.ChainNode.coordinates_surjective
statement:
theorem coordinates_surjective {m n : ℕ} (q : Fin m) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ n) :
    ∃ c : ChainNode m n, c.label = q ∧ c.position = p

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.ChainNode.position_le
statement: theorem position_le {m n : ℕ} (c : ChainNode m n) : c.position ≤ n

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.chainNetwork_edges
statement:
theorem chainNetwork_edges {Sigma : Type*} {m : ℕ}
    (moves : Sigma → Fin 3 → SetRel (Fin m) (Fin m)) (w : List Sigma) (last : Sigma)
    (c d : ChainNode m w.length) :
    (c, d) ∈ (chainNetwork moves w last).edge ↔
      ∃ move : Fin 3, (c.label, d.label) ∈ moves (chainSymbol w last c) move ∧
        (d.position : ℤ) = (c.position : ℤ) + (move.val : ℤ) - 1

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.chainNetwork_entrances
statement:
theorem chainNetwork_entrances {Sigma : Type*} {m : ℕ}
    (moves : Sigma → Fin 3 → SetRel (Fin m) (Fin m)) (w : List Sigma) (last : Sigma)
    (q : Fin m) (c : ChainNode m w.length) :
    ((q, c) ∈ (chainNetwork moves w last).leftIn ↔ c.position = 0 ∧ q = c.label) ∧
    ((q, c) ∈ (chainNetwork moves w last).rightIn ↔ c.position = w.length ∧ q = c.label)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.chainNetwork_exits
statement:
theorem chainNetwork_exits {Sigma : Type*} {m : ℕ}
    (moves : Sigma → Fin 3 → SetRel (Fin m) (Fin m)) (w : List Sigma) (last : Sigma)
    (c : ChainNode m w.length) (q : Fin m) :
    ((c, q) ∈ (chainNetwork moves w last).leftOut ↔
      c.position = 0 ∧ (c.label, q) ∈ moves (chainSymbol w last c) 0) ∧
    ((c, q) ∈ (chainNetwork moves w last).rightOut ↔
      c.position = w.length ∧ (c.label, q) ∈ moves (chainSymbol w last c) 2)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.chainNetwork_summary
statement:
theorem chainNetwork_summary {Sigma : Type*} {m : ℕ}
    (moves : Sigma → Fin 3 → SetRel (Fin m) (Fin m)) (w : List Sigma) (last : Sigma) :
    (chainNetwork moves w last).summary =
      wordDiagram (fun a => cellDiagram m (moves a 1) (moves a 2) (moves a 0)) (w ++ [last])

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.amplification_arithmetic
statement:
theorem amplification_arithmetic {h c : ℕ} (hh : 129 ≤ h) (δ : Fin 4096 → ℕ)
    (htotal : ∑ j, δ j ≤ 1024 * c)
    (hstep : ∀ j, lossBound (h - 127) ≤ 2 * δ j) : lossBound h ≤ c

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.exists_hub_families
statement:
theorem exists_hub_families {H : Type*} [Finite H] (hh : 129 ≤ Nat.card H) :
    ∃ u v : Fin 64 ↪ H, ∃ z : H,
      (∀ i j, u i ≠ v j) ∧ (∀ i, u i ≠ z) ∧ (∀ j, v j ≠ z)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.lossBound_step
statement: theorem lossBound_step {h : ℕ} (hh : 129 ≤ h) : lossBound h = 2 * lossBound (h - 127)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.mem_restricted_sandwich
statement:
theorem mem_restricted_sandwich {H : Type*} (F : Set H) (R : SetRel H H) (a b : H) :
    (a, b) ∈ restrictedIdentity F ○ R ○ restrictedIdentity F ↔
      a ∈ F ∧ b ∈ F ∧ (a, b) ∈ R

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.retained_pair_set
statement:
theorem retained_pair_set {H : Type*} [Finite H] (U V : Set H)
    (hU : U.ncard = 64) (hV : V.ncard = 64) (hUV : Disjoint U V)
    (z x y : H) (hzU : z ∉ U) (hzV : z ∉ V) (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ V) :
    ∃ F : Set H, Nat.card F = Nat.card H - 127 ∧ x ∈ F ∧ y ∈ F ∧ z ∉ F ∧
      (∀ a ∈ U, a ∈ F → a = x) ∧ (∀ b ∈ V, b ∈ F → b = y)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.retained_relation_identity
statement:
theorem retained_relation_identity {H : Type*} (U V F : Set H) (z x y : H)
    (hz : z ∉ F) (hx : ∀ a ∈ U, a ∈ F → a = x) (hy : ∀ b ∈ V, b ∈ F → b = y)
    (E : SetRel H H) (hE : E ⊆ U ×ˢ V) (hnew : (x, y) ∉ E) :
    restrictedIdentity F ○ (restrictedIdentity {a | a ≠ z} ∪ E) ○ restrictedIdentity F =
      restrictedIdentity F

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.retained_relation_pair
statement:
theorem retained_relation_pair {H : Type*} (P : SetRel H H) (F : Set H)
    (hP : restrictedIdentity F ○ P ○ restrictedIdentity F = restrictedIdentity F)
    (x y : H) (hx : x ∈ F) (hy : y ∈ F) :
    restrictedIdentity F ○ (P ∪ {(x, y)}) ○ restrictedIdentity F =
      restrictedIdentity F ∪ {(x, y)}

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.sandwich_power_absorption
statement:
theorem sandwich_power_absorption {A : Type*} [Monoid A] (b a : A)
    (hb : IsIdempotentElem b) (k : ℕ) :
    b * (b * a * b) ^ (k + 1) = (b * a * b) ^ (k + 1) ∧
      (b * a * b) ^ (k + 1) * b = (b * a * b) ^ (k + 1)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.identity_pair_idempotent
statement:
theorem identity_pair_idempotent {H : Type*} (x y : H) :
    IsIdempotentElem (RelationMonoid.ofRel (SetRel.id ∪ {(x, y)}))

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.order_reversing_image_bound
statement:
theorem order_reversing_image_bound
    (m h : ℕ) (_hm : 1 ≤ m) (hh : 2 ≤ h)
    (S : Set (Diagram m)) (hidentity : Diagram.identity m ∈ S)
    (hclosed : ∀ ⦃a b⦄, a ∈ S → b ∈ S → Diagram.comp a b ∈ S)
    (φ : S → SetRel (Fin h) (Fin h)) (hsurj : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hmul : ∀ a b : S,
      φ ⟨Diagram.comp a.val b.val, hclosed a.property b.property⟩ = φ a ○ φ b)
    (hreverse : ∀ a b : S, (a.val, b.val) ∈ Diagram.inclusion m → φ b ⊆ φ a) :
    lossBound h ≤ 2 * m

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.order_reversing_image_bound_finite
statement:
theorem order_reversing_image_bound_finite {H : Type*} [Finite H]
    (m : ℕ) (_hm : 1 ≤ m) (hh : 2 ≤ Nat.card H)
    (S : Set (Diagram m)) (hidentity : Diagram.identity m ∈ S)
    (hclosed : ∀ ⦃a b⦄, a ∈ S → b ∈ S → Diagram.comp a b ∈ S)
    (φ : S → SetRel H H) (hsurj : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hmul : ∀ a b : S,
      φ ⟨Diagram.comp a.val b.val, hclosed a.property b.property⟩ = φ a ○ φ b)
    (hreverse : ∀ a b : S, (a.val, b.val) ∈ Diagram.inclusion m → φ b ⊆ φ a) :
    lossBound (Nat.card H) ≤ 2 * m

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.TwoNFA.augmentConfig_injective
statement:
theorem augmentConfig_injective {Q : Type*} {n : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (augmentConfig : Q × Fin n → Option Q × Fin (n + 1))

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.TwoNFA.augmentedStep_local_iff
statement:
theorem augmentedStep_local_iff {Sigma Q : Type*} (A : TwoNFA Sigma Q) (w : List Sigma)
    (c d : Option Q × Fin (w.length + 3)) :
    (c, d) ∈ A.augmentedStep w ↔
      ∃ p : Fin (w.length + 2), c.2 = p.castSucc ∧ ∃ move : Fin 3,
        (c.1, d.1) ∈ A.augmentedMove (tapeSymbol w p) move ∧
        (d.2.val : ℤ) = (p.val : ℤ) + (move.val : ℤ) - 1

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.TwoNFA.augmented_acceptance
statement:
theorem augmented_acceptance {Sigma Q : Type*} (A : TwoNFA Sigma Q) (w : List Sigma) :
    w ∈ A.language ↔
      (augmentConfig (A.initial, ⟨0, by omega⟩), (none, ⟨w.length + 2, by omega⟩)) ∈
        relStar (A.augmentedStep w)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.TwoNFA.augmented_run_cases
statement:
theorem augmented_run_cases {Sigma Q : Type*} (A : TwoNFA Sigma Q) (w : List Sigma)
    {c : Option Q × Fin (w.length + 3)}
    (hrun : (augmentConfig (A.initial, ⟨0, by omega⟩), c) ∈ relStar (A.augmentedStep w)) :
    w ∈ A.language ∨ ∃ x : Q × Fin (w.length + 2),
      c = augmentConfig x ∧ ((A.initial, ⟨0, by omega⟩), x) ∈ relStar (A.step w)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.TwoNFA.augmented_sink_exit
statement:
theorem augmented_sink_exit {Sigma Q : Type*} (A : TwoNFA Sigma Q) (w : List Sigma)
    (p : Fin (w.length + 3)) :
    ((none, p), (none, ⟨w.length + 2, by omega⟩)) ∈ relStar (A.augmentedStep w)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.TwoNFA.reindex_language
statement:
theorem reindex_language {Sigma Q Q' : Type*} (A : TwoNFA Sigma Q) (e : Q ≃ Q') :
    (A.reindex e).language = A.language

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.tapeSymbol_left_iff
statement:
theorem tapeSymbol_left_iff {Sigma : Type*} (w : List Sigma) (p : Fin (w.length + 2)) :
    tapeSymbol w p = Sum.inl 0 ↔ p.val = 0

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.tapeSymbol_right_iff
statement:
theorem tapeSymbol_right_iff {Sigma : Type*} (w : List Sigma) (p : Fin (w.length + 2)) :
    tapeSymbol w p = Sum.inl 1 ↔ p.val = w.length + 1

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relationProduct_append
statement:
theorem relationProduct_append {H : Type*} (u v : List (SetRel H H)) :
    relationProduct (u ++ v) = relationProduct u ○ relationProduct v

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.singleton_word_context
statement:
theorem singleton_word_context {H : Type*} (w : List (SetRel H H)) (p q : H) :
    (relationProduct ([restrictedIdentity {p}] ++ w ++ [restrictedIdentity {q}])).Nonempty ↔
      (p, q) ∈ relationProduct w

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.sourceAutomaton_language
statement:
theorem sourceAutomaton_language (H : Type*) :
    (sourceAutomaton H).language = sourceLanguage H

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.sourceAutomaton_sound
statement:
theorem sourceAutomaton_sound {H : Type*} (w : List (SetRel H H))
    (hw : w ∈ (sourceAutomaton H).language) : (relationProduct w).Nonempty

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.sourceLanguage_state_bound
statement:
theorem sourceLanguage_state_bound (H : Type*) [Fintype H] :
    ∃ A : TwoNFA (SetRel H H) (Fin (Fintype.card H + 2)), A.language = sourceLanguage H

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.sourceProductive_of_step
statement:
theorem sourceProductive_of_step {H : Type*} (w : List (SetRel H H))
    {c d : Option (Option H) × Fin (w.length + 2)}
    (hstep : (c, d) ∈ (sourceAutomaton H).step w) (hd : d ∈ sourceProductive w) :
    c ∈ sourceProductive w

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.diagram_recognition_lower_bound
statement:
theorem diagram_recognition_lower_bound (h m : ℕ) (hh : 2 ≤ h) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (τ : List (SetRel (Fin h) (Fin h)) → Diagram m)
    (hzero : τ [] = Diagram.identity m)
    (hmul : ∀ u v, τ (u ++ v) = Diagram.comp (τ u) (τ v))
    (l r : Diagram m) (a b : Fin m)
    (hlanguage : ∀ w, (a, b) ∈ (Diagram.comp (Diagram.comp l (τ w)) r).forward ↔
      ¬ (relationProduct w).Nonempty) : lossBound h ≤ 2 * m

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.word_diagram_order_reversal
statement:
theorem word_diagram_order_reversal {H : Type*} {m : ℕ}
    (τ : List (SetRel H H) → Diagram m)
    (hmul : ∀ u v, τ (u ++ v) = Diagram.comp (τ u) (τ v))
    (l r : Diagram m) (a b : Fin m)
    (hlanguage : ∀ w, (a, b) ∈ (Diagram.comp (Diagram.comp l (τ w)) r).forward ↔
      ¬ (relationProduct w).Nonempty)
    {u v : List (SetRel H H)} (huv : (τ u, τ v) ∈ Diagram.inclusion m) :
    relationProduct v ⊆ relationProduct u

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.blockRelation_terminal
statement:
theorem blockRelation_terminal {V Q : Type*} (E : SetRel V V) (O : SetRel V Q)
    (c : V) (q : Q) :
    (Sum.inl c, Sum.inr q) ∈ relStar (blockRelation E O ∅ ∅) ↔
      (c, q) ∈ relStar E ○ O

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.chainStep_exitEquiv
statement:
theorem chainStep_exitEquiv {Sigma : Type*} {m : ℕ}
    (moves : Sigma → Fin 3 → SetRel (Fin m) (Fin m)) (w : List Sigma) (last : Sigma)
    (x y : ChainNode m w.length ⊕ Fin m) :
    (ChainNode.exitEquiv m w.length x, ChainNode.exitEquiv m w.length y) ∈
        chainStep moves w last ↔
      (x, y) ∈ blockRelation (chainNetwork moves w last).edge
        (chainNetwork moves w last).rightOut ∅ ∅

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.chainStep_recognition
statement:
theorem chainStep_recognition {Sigma : Type*} {m : ℕ}
    (moves : Sigma → Fin 3 → SetRel (Fin m) (Fin m)) (w : List Sigma) (last : Sigma)
    (q r : Fin m) :
    ((q, ⟨0, by omega⟩), (r, ⟨w.length + 1, by omega⟩)) ∈ relStar (chainStep moves w last) ↔
      (q, r) ∈ (chainNetwork moves w last).summary.forward

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.chainSymbol_getElem
statement:
theorem chainSymbol_getElem {Sigma : Type*} {m : ℕ} (w : List Sigma) (last : Sigma)
    (c : ChainNode m w.length) :
    chainSymbol w last c = (w ++ [last])[c.position]'(by
      have := c.position_le
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton]
      omega)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.chainSymbol_position
statement:
theorem chainSymbol_position {Sigma : Type*} {m : ℕ} (w : List Sigma) (last : Sigma)
    (c d : ChainNode m w.length) (hp : c.position = d.position) :
    chainSymbol w last c = chainSymbol w last d

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.marked_getElem
statement:
theorem marked_getElem {Sigma : Type*} (w : List Sigma) (p : Fin (w.length + 2)) :
    ((Sum.inl 0 : Fin 2 ⊕ Sigma) :: (w.map Sum.inr ++ [Sum.inl 1]))[p.val]'(by simp; omega) =
      tapeSymbol w p

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.relStar_equiv_iff
statement:
theorem relStar_equiv_iff {V W : Type*} (e : V ≃ W) (R : SetRel V V) (S : SetRel W W)
    (h : ∀ x y, (e x, e y) ∈ S ↔ (x, y) ∈ R) (x y : V) :
    (e x, e y) ∈ relStar S ↔ (x, y) ∈ relStar R

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.TwoNFA.diagram_representation
statement:
theorem TwoNFA.diagram_representation {Sigma : Type*} {s : ℕ} (A : TwoNFA Sigma (Fin s)) :
    ∃ τ : List Sigma → Diagram (s + 1), ∃ l r : Diagram (s + 1), ∃ a b : Fin (s + 1),
      τ [] = Diagram.identity (s + 1) ∧
      (∀ u v, τ (u ++ v) = Diagram.comp (τ u) (τ v)) ∧
      (∀ w, w ∈ A.language ↔ (a, b) ∈ (Diagram.comp (Diagram.comp l (τ w)) r).forward)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.TwoNFA.pullAlphabet_language
statement:
theorem TwoNFA.pullAlphabet_language {Sigma Gamma Q : Type*} (A : TwoNFA Gamma Q)
    (f : Sigma → Gamma) (w : List Sigma) :
    w ∈ (A.pullAlphabet f).language ↔ w.map f ∈ A.language

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.complementation_lower_bound
statement:
theorem complementation_lower_bound (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    ∃ A : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) (Fin n),
      ∀ s : ℕ, ∀ B : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) (Fin s),
        B.language = A.languageᶜ → 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 127) ≤ 2 * (s + 1)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.complementation_lower_bound_finite
statement:
theorem complementation_lower_bound_finite (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    ∃ A : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) (Fin n),
      ∀ (Q : Type*) [Fintype Q], ∀ B : TwoNFA (SetRel (Fin (n - 2)) (Fin (n - 2))) Q,
        B.language = A.languageᶜ →
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ ((n - 4) / 127) - 1 ≤ (Fintype.card Q : ℝ)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.no_polynomial_complementation
statement:
theorem no_polynomial_complementation :
    ¬ ∃ p : Polynomial ℝ, ∀ n k : ℕ, ∀ A : TwoNFA (Fin k) (Fin n),
      ∃ s : ℕ, ∃ B : TwoNFA (Fin k) (Fin s),
        B.language = A.languageᶜ ∧ (s : ℝ) ≤ p.eval (n : ℝ)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.polynomial_not_bound_two_pow
statement:
theorem polynomial_not_bound_two_pow (p : Polynomial ℝ) :
    ¬ ∀ n : ℕ, (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ p.eval (n : ℝ)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.tapeSymbol_map
statement:
theorem tapeSymbol_map {Sigma Gamma : Type*} (f : Sigma → Gamma) (w : List Sigma)
    (p : Fin (w.length + 2)) :
    tapeSymbol (w.map f) ⟨p.val, by simp⟩ =
      Sum.map id f (tapeSymbol w p)

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.TwoNFA.Deterministic.pullAlphabet
statement:
theorem TwoNFA.Deterministic.pullAlphabet {Sigma Gamma Q : Type*} {A : TwoNFA Gamma Q}
    (hA : A.Deterministic) (f : Sigma → Gamma) : (A.pullAlphabet f).Deterministic

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.TwoNFA.Deterministic.reindex
statement:
theorem TwoNFA.Deterministic.reindex {Sigma Q Q' : Type*} {A : TwoNFA Sigma Q}
    (hA : A.Deterministic) (e : Q ≃ Q') : (A.reindex e).Deterministic

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.CompanionBridge.relationProduct_map
statement:
theorem relationProduct_map {H : Type*} (w : List (BRel H)) :
    relationProduct (w.map (relationEquiv H)) = relationEquiv H w.prod

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.CompanionBridge.sourceLanguage_map_iff
statement:
theorem sourceLanguage_map_iff {H : Type*} (w : List (BRel H)) :
    w.map (relationEquiv H) ∈ sourceLanguage H ↔ BRel.live w

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.CompanionBridge.convertedTransitions_subsingleton
OAI.TwoWayComplementation.CompanionBridge.encodeMove_injective

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.CompanionBridge.encode_decode
statement: @[simp] theorem encode_decode (m : Fin 3) : encodeMove (decodeMove m) = m

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.CompanionBridge.encode_scanned
statement:
theorem encode_scanned {Alpha : Type*} (w : List Alpha) (p : Fin (w.length + 2)) :
    encodeSymbol (scanned w p) = tapeSymbol w p

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.CompanionBridge.guard_of_legal_move
statement:
theorem guard_of_legal_move {Alpha : Type*} (w : List Alpha)
    (p r : Fin (w.length + 2)) (m : Move) (h : m.Rel p.val r.val) :
