name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.CompanionBridge.move_rel_iff
statement:
theorem move_rel_iff (m : Move) (i j : ℕ) :
    m.Rel i j ↔ (j : ℤ) = (i : ℤ) + ((encodeMove m).val : ℤ) - 1

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.CompanionBridge.select_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem select_eq_some_iff {X : Type*} (S : Set X) (hS : S.Subsingleton) (x : X) :
    select S = some x ↔ x ∈ S

name: OAI.TwoWayComplementation.CompanionBridge.toDMachine_accepts
OAI.TwoWayComplementation.CompanionBridge.toDMachine_step
statement:
theorem toDMachine_step {Alpha : Type*} {s : ℕ}
    (A : TwoNFA Alpha (Fin s)) (hA : A.Deterministic) (w : List Alpha)
    (c d : Fin s × Fin (w.length + 2)) :
    (toDMachine A hA).Step w (c.2, c.1) (d.2, d.1) ↔ (c, d) ∈ A.step w

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Gate.eval_add
statement:
theorem Gate.eval_add {w : ℕ} (g : Gate w) (v v' : Fin w → ℂ) :
    g.eval (v + v') = g.eval v + g.eval v'

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Program.dirtyEval_available
statement:
theorem Program.dirtyEval_available {n k : ℕ} (p : Program n k)
    (x : Fin n → ℂ) (z : Fin k → ℂ) :
    p.dirtyEval x z = available x (p.dirtyScratch x z)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Program.dirtyEval_clean
statement:
theorem Program.dirtyEval_clean {n k : ℕ} (p : Program n k) (x : Fin n → ℂ) :
    p.dirtyEval x 0 = p.eval x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Program.dirtyEval_input
statement:
theorem Program.dirtyEval_input {n k : ℕ} (p : Program n k)
    (x : Fin n → ℂ) (z : Fin k → ℂ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    p.dirtyEval x z (Fin.castAdd k i) = (Fin.snoc x 0 : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) i

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Program.dirtyScratch_step_cast
statement:
@[simp] theorem Program.dirtyScratch_step_cast {n k : ℕ} (p : Program n k)
    (g : Gate (n + 1 + k)) (x : Fin n → ℂ) (z : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    (p.step g).dirtyScratch x z i.castSucc = p.dirtyScratch x (Fin.init z) i

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Program.dirtyScratch_step_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem Program.dirtyScratch_step_last {n k : ℕ} (p : Program n k)
    (g : Gate (n + 1 + k)) (x : Fin n → ℂ) (z : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) :
    (p.step g).dirtyScratch x z (Fin.last k) =
      z (Fin.last k) + g.eval (p.dirtyEval x (Fin.init z))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Program.dirtySweep_exists
statement:
theorem Program.dirtySweep_exists {ι : Type*} {n k : ℕ} (p : Program n k)
    (enabled : Bool) (xs : Fin n → ι) (zs : Fin k → ι)
    (hz : Function.Injective zs) (hxz : ∀ i j, xs i ≠ zs j) :
    ∃ W : List (Shear ι), W.length ≤ 2 * k ∧ ∀ v : ι → ℂ,
      (∀ j, runShears W v (zs j) =
        p.dirtyScratch (replayInputs enabled xs v) (v ∘ zs) j) ∧
      (∀ r, (∀ j, r ≠ zs j) → runShears W v r = v r)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Shear.act_other
statement:
theorem Shear.act_other {ι : Type*} (s : Shear ι) (v : ι → ℂ) {a : ι}
    (h : a ≠ s.i) : s.act v a = v a

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Shear.act_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem Shear.act_self {ι : Type*} (s : Shear ι) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    s.act v s.i = v s.i + s.c * v s.j

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Shear.act_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem Shear.act_source {ι : Type*} (s : Shear ι) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    s.act v s.j = v s.j

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Shear.inv_act_act
statement:
@[simp] theorem Shear.inv_act_act {ι : Type*} (s : Shear ι) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    Shear.act s.inv (s.act v) = v

name: OAI.ExactFourier.add_gate
statement:
theorem add_gate {ι : Type*} {w : ℕ} (d : ι) (refs : Fin w → Option ι)
    (h : ∀ a j, refs a = some j → d ≠ j) (g : Gate w) :
    ∃ W : List (Shear ι), W.length ≤ 2 ∧ ∀ v : ι → ℂ,
      runShears W v d = v d + g.eval (fun a => readCoord (refs a) v) ∧
      ∀ i, i ≠ d → runShears W v i = v i

name: OAI.ExactFourier.add_reference
statement:
theorem add_reference {ι : Type*} (d : ι) (r : Option ι) (c : ℂ)
    (h : ∀ i, r = some i → d ≠ i) :
    ∃ W : List (Shear ι), W.length ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ v : ι → ℂ,
      runShears W v d = v d + c * readCoord r v ∧
      ∀ i, i ≠ d → runShears W v i = v i

name: OAI.ExactFourier.readCoord_congr_except
statement:
theorem readCoord_congr_except {ι : Type*} (d : ι) (r : Option ι)
    (h : ∀ i, r = some i → d ≠ i) (v v' : ι → ℂ)
    (hv : ∀ i, i ≠ d → v' i = v i) : readCoord r v' = readCoord r v

name: OAI.ExactFourier.read_referenceMap
statement:
theorem read_referenceMap {ι : Type*} {n k : ℕ} (enabled : Bool)
    (xs : Fin n → ι) (zs : Fin k → ι) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    (fun a => readCoord (referenceMap enabled xs zs a) v) =
      available (replayInputs enabled xs v) (v ∘ zs)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.referenceMap_avoids
statement:
theorem referenceMap_avoids {ι : Type*} {n k : ℕ} (enabled : Bool)
    (xs : Fin n → ι) (zs : Fin k → ι) (d : ι)
    (hx : ∀ i, d ≠ xs i) (hz : ∀ j, d ≠ zs j) :
    ∀ a j, referenceMap enabled xs zs a = some j → d ≠ j

name: OAI.ExactFourier.reverseShears_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem reverseShears_length {ι : Type*} (W : List (Shear ι)) :
    (reverseShears W).length = W.length

name: OAI.ExactFourier.runShears_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem runShears_append {ι : Type*} (W V : List (Shear ι)) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    runShears (W ++ V) v = runShears V (runShears W v)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.runShears_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem runShears_cons {ι : Type*} (s : Shear ι) (W : List (Shear ι))
    (v : ι → ℂ) : runShears (s :: W) v = runShears W (s.act v)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.runShears_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem runShears_nil {ι : Type*} (v : ι → ℂ) : runShears [] v = v

name: OAI.ExactFourier.runShears_reverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem runShears_reverse {ι : Type*} (W : List (Shear ι)) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    runShears (reverseShears W) (runShears W v) = v

name: OAI.ExactFourier.snoc_add
statement:
theorem snoc_add {n : ℕ} (v v' : Fin n → ℂ) (a a' : ℂ) :
    (Fin.snoc (v + v') (a + a') : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) =
      (Fin.snoc v a : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) + (Fin.snoc v' a' : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.difference_le
statement:
theorem difference_le (p : MatrixPrice) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) (hB : IsUnit B) :
    |p.value B - p.value A| ≤ p.value (A⁻¹ * B)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.identity_pad
statement:
theorem identity_pad (p : MatrixPrice) {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) :
    p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 (1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ)) = p.value A

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.one
statement:
@[simp] theorem one (p : MatrixPrice) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :
    p.value (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) = 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.pairComplement_left₀
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairComplement_left₀ {ι : Type*} (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    pairComplement i j hij (Sum.inl 0) = j

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.pairComplement_left₁
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairComplement_left₁ {ι : Type*} (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    pairComplement i j hij (Sum.inl 1) = i

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.pairComplement_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairComplement_right {ι : Type*} (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (t : {t : ι // t ≠ i ∧ t ≠ j}) : pairComplement i j hij (Sum.inr t) = t

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.shear_two
statement:
theorem shear_two (p : MatrixPrice) (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    p.value (Matrix.transvection (1 : Fin 2) 0 c) = 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.transvection_isUnit
statement:
theorem transvection_isUnit {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) (c : ℂ) : IsUnit (Matrix.transvection i j c)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.transvection_le_one
statement:
theorem transvection_le_one (p : MatrixPrice) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) (c : ℂ) : p.value (Matrix.transvection i j c) ≤ 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.transvection_list_isUnit
statement:
theorem transvection_list_isUnit {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (L : List (Matrix.TransvectionStruct ι ℂ)) :
    IsUnit (L.map Matrix.TransvectionStruct.toMatrix).prod

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.transvection_list_le
statement:
theorem transvection_list_le (p : MatrixPrice) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (L : List (Matrix.TransvectionStruct ι ℂ)) :
    p.value (L.map Matrix.TransvectionStruct.toMatrix).prod ≤ L.length

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MonomialMatrix.diagonal
statement:
theorem diagonal {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (d : ι → ℂ) (hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0) :
    MonomialMatrix (Matrix.diagonal d)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MonomialMatrix.one
statement: theorem one {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] : MonomialMatrix (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Program.memorySweep_exists
statement:
theorem Program.memorySweep_exists {n k : ℕ} (p : Program n k) (enabled : Bool) :
    ∃ W : List (Shear (Fin n ⊕ Fin k)), W.length ≤ 2 * k ∧
      ∀ (x : Fin n → ℂ) (z : Fin k → ℂ),
        runShears W (Sum.elim x z) =
          Sum.elim x (p.dirtyScratch (if enabled then x else 0) z)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Shear.act_eq_mulVec
statement:
theorem Shear.act_eq_mulVec {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Shear ι) (v : ι → ℂ) : s.act v = s.toMatrix.mulVec v

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Shear.act_sumInl
statement:
theorem Shear.act_sumInl {ι κ : Type*} (s : Shear ι) (v : ι → ℂ) (y : κ → ℂ) :
    Shear.act (s.sumInl κ) (Sum.elim v y) = Sum.elim (s.act v) y

name: OAI.ExactFourier.broadcast_exists
statement:
theorem broadcast_exists {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (refs : κ → Option ι) :
    ∃ W : List (Shear (ι ⊕ κ)), W.length ≤ Fintype.card κ ∧
      ∀ (v : ι → ℂ) (y : κ → ℂ),
        runShears W (Sum.elim v y) = Sum.elim v (fun j => y j + readCoord (refs j) v)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.broadcast_reverse
statement:
theorem broadcast_reverse {ι κ : Type*} (W : List (Shear (ι ⊕ κ)))
    (R : (ι → ℂ) → κ → ℂ)
    (hW : ∀ v y, runShears W (Sum.elim v y) = Sum.elim v (fun j => y j + R v j))
    (v : ι → ℂ) (y : κ → ℂ) :
    runShears (reverseShears W) (Sum.elim v y) =
      Sum.elim v (fun j => y j - R v j)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.broadcast_subset_exists
statement:
theorem broadcast_subset_exists {ι κ : Type*} (S : Finset κ) (refs : κ → Option ι) :
    ∃ W : List (Shear (ι ⊕ κ)), W.length ≤ S.card ∧
      ∀ (v : ι → ℂ) (y : κ → ℂ),
        runShears W (Sum.elim v y) =
          Sum.elim v (fun j => y j + if j ∈ S then readCoord (refs j) v else 0)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.replayMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem replayMatrix_mulVec {n a k : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (x : Fin n → ℂ) (z : Fin k → ℂ) (y : Fin a → ℂ) :
    (replayMatrix G).mulVec (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x z) y) =
      Sum.elim (Sum.elim x z) (fun j => y j + G.mulVec x j)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.replay_readout
statement:
theorem replay_readout {ι κ : Type*} (W : List (Shear ι))
    (B : List (Shear (ι ⊕ κ))) (R : (ι → ℂ) → κ → ℂ)
    (hB : ∀ v y, runShears B (Sum.elim v y) = Sum.elim v (fun j => y j + R v j))
    (v : ι → ℂ) (y : κ → ℂ) :
    runShears ((W.map (fun s => s.sumInl κ)) ++ B ++
        reverseShears (W.map (fun s => s.sumInl κ))) (Sum.elim v y) =
      Sum.elim v (fun j => y j + R (runShears W v) j)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.runShears_eq_mulVec
statement:
theorem runShears_eq_mulVec {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (W : List (Shear ι)) (v : ι → ℂ) : runShears W v = (shearMatrix W).mulVec v

name: OAI.ExactFourier.runShears_sumInl
statement:
theorem runShears_sumInl {ι κ : Type*} (W : List (Shear ι)) (v : ι → ℂ) (y : κ → ℂ) :
    runShears (W.map (fun s => s.sumInl κ)) (Sum.elim v y) =
      Sum.elim (runShears W v) y

name: OAI.ExactFourier.shearMatrix_isUnit
statement:
theorem shearMatrix_isUnit {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (W : List (Shear ι)) : IsUnit (shearMatrix W)

OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.rectangularShear_neg
OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.twoWay_bound
OAI.ExactFourier.OnePort.first_factorization
statement:
theorem first_factorization (A : Matrix (α ⊕ PUnit) (α ⊕ PUnit) ℂ) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.OnePort.plane_first
statement:
theorem plane_first
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (A : Matrix (α ⊕ PUnit) (α ⊕ PUnit) ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex plane plane (firstSelected (β := β) A) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (unionFirst A) 0 0 (1 : Matrix (α × β) (α × β) ℂ)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.OnePort.plane_second
statement:
theorem plane_second
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (B : Matrix (PUnit ⊕ β) (PUnit ⊕ β) ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex plane plane (secondSelected (α := α) B) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (unionSecond B) 0 0 (1 : Matrix (α × β) (α × β) ℂ)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.OnePort.price
statement:
theorem price (p : MatrixPrice) (A : Matrix (α ⊕ PUnit) (α ⊕ PUnit) ℂ)
    (B : Matrix (PUnit ⊕ β) (PUnit ⊕ β) ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) (hB : IsUnit B) :
    p.value (product A B) = p.value A + p.value B

name: OAI.ExactFourier.OnePort.product_isUnit
statement:
theorem product_isUnit (A : Matrix (α ⊕ PUnit) (α ⊕ PUnit) ℂ)
    (B : Matrix (PUnit ⊕ β) (PUnit ⊕ β) ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) (hB : IsUnit B) :
    IsUnit (product A B)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.OnePort.reindex_first_all
statement:
theorem reindex_first_all
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (A : Matrix (α ⊕ PUnit) (α ⊕ PUnit) ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex (splitRight (α ⊕ PUnit) β) (splitRight (α ⊕ PUnit) β)
      (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (PUnit ⊕ β) (PUnit ⊕ β) ℂ)) =
        Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix β β ℂ))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.OnePort.reindex_second_all
statement:
theorem reindex_second_all
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (B : Matrix (PUnit ⊕ β) (PUnit ⊕ β) ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex (splitLeft α (PUnit ⊕ β)) (splitLeft α (PUnit ⊕ β))
      ((1 : Matrix (α ⊕ PUnit) (α ⊕ PUnit) ℂ) ⊗ₖ B) =
        Matrix.fromBlocks ((1 : Matrix α α ℂ) ⊗ₖ B) 0 0 B

name: OAI.ExactFourier.OnePort.rest_prices
statement:
theorem rest_prices (p : MatrixPrice) (A : Matrix (α ⊕ PUnit) (α ⊕ PUnit) ℂ)
    (B : Matrix (PUnit ⊕ β) (PUnit ⊕ β) ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) (hB : IsUnit B) :
    p.value (firstRest (β := β) A) = Fintype.card β * p.value A ∧
      p.value (secondRest (α := α) B) = Fintype.card α * p.value B

name: OAI.ExactFourier.OnePort.rest_unit
statement:
theorem rest_unit (A : Matrix (α ⊕ PUnit) (α ⊕ PUnit) ℂ)
    (B : Matrix (PUnit ⊕ β) (PUnit ⊕ β) ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) (hB : IsUnit B) :
    IsUnit (firstRest (β := β) A) ∧ IsUnit (secondRest (α := α) B)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.OnePort.second_factorization
statement:
theorem second_factorization (B : Matrix (PUnit ⊕ β) (PUnit ⊕ β) ℂ) :
    secondRest (α := α) B * secondSelected B =
      (1 : Matrix (α ⊕ PUnit) (α ⊕ PUnit) ℂ) ⊗ₖ B

name: OAI.ExactFourier.OnePort.selected_product_price
statement:
theorem selected_product_price (p : MatrixPrice) (A : Matrix (α ⊕ PUnit) (α ⊕ PUnit) ℂ)
    (B : Matrix (PUnit ⊕ β) (PUnit ⊕ β) ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) (hB : IsUnit B) :
    p.value (secondSelected B * firstSelected A) = p.value (product A B)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.OnePort.selected_unit
statement:
theorem selected_unit (A : Matrix (α ⊕ PUnit) (α ⊕ PUnit) ℂ)
    (B : Matrix (PUnit ⊕ β) (PUnit ⊕ β) ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) (hB : IsUnit B) :
    IsUnit (firstSelected (β := β) A) ∧ IsUnit (secondSelected (α := α) B)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.OnePort.union_prices
statement:
theorem union_prices (p : MatrixPrice) (A : Matrix (α ⊕ PUnit) (α ⊕ PUnit) ℂ)
    (B : Matrix (PUnit ⊕ β) (PUnit ⊕ β) ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) (hB : IsUnit B) :
    p.value (unionFirst (β := β) A) = p.value A ∧
      p.value (unionSecond (α := α) B) = p.value B

name: OAI.ExactFourier.OnePort.union_unit
statement:
theorem union_unit (A : Matrix (α ⊕ PUnit) (α ⊕ PUnit) ℂ)
    (B : Matrix (PUnit ⊕ β) (PUnit ⊕ β) ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) (hB : IsUnit B) :
    IsUnit (unionFirst (β := β) A) ∧ IsUnit (unionSecond (α := α) B)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Reindexed.apply_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem apply_symm_apply
    {ι : Type fourierU1} {κ : Type fourierU2} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (e : ι ≃ κ) (A : Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex e e (Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm A) = A

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Reindexed.mul
statement:
theorem mul (e : ι ≃ κ) (A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex e e (A * B) = Matrix.reindex e e A * Matrix.reindex e e B

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Reindexed.symm_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem symm_apply_apply
    {ι : Type fourierU1} {κ : Type fourierU2} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (e : ι ≃ κ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm (Matrix.reindex e e A) = A

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Reindexed.unit
statement:
theorem unit (e : ι ≃ κ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) :
    IsUnit (Matrix.reindex e e A)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.lowerShear_reindex
statement:
theorem lowerShear_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (G : Matrix κ ι ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex (Equiv.sumComm κ ι) (Equiv.sumComm κ ι) (rectangularShear G) =
      lowerShear G

name: OAI.ExactFourier.lowerShear_unit
statement:
theorem lowerShear_unit {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (G : Matrix κ ι ℂ) : IsUnit (lowerShear G)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.rectangularShear_inv
statement:
theorem rectangularShear_inv {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (G : Matrix ι κ ℂ) :
    (rectangularShear G)⁻¹ = rectangularShear (-G)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.rectangularShear_mul
statement:
theorem rectangularShear_mul {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (G H : Matrix ι κ ℂ) :
    rectangularShear G * rectangularShear H = rectangularShear (G + H)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.rectangularShear_unit
statement:
theorem rectangularShear_unit {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (G : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : IsUnit (rectangularShear G)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.replayMatrix_reindex
statement:
theorem replayMatrix_reindex {n a k : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex replayOrder replayOrder
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (rectangularShear G) 0 0 (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ)) =
      replayMatrix G

name: OAI.ExactFourier.signedSwap_monomial
statement:
theorem signedSwap_monomial {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] :
    MonomialMatrix (Matrix.fromBlocks 0 (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (-1) 0)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.twoWay_identity
statement:
theorem twoWay_identity {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (G : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hG : IsUnit G) :
    rectangularShear G * lowerShear (-G⁻¹) * rectangularShear G =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (0 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) G (-G⁻¹) 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Gate.eval_map
statement:
theorem Gate.eval_map {w w' : ℕ} (f : Fin w → Fin w') (g : Gate w)
    (v : Fin w' → ℂ) : (g.map f).eval v = g.eval (v ∘ f)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.LinearDAG.eval_addColumn
statement:
theorem LinearDAG.eval_addColumn {n a : ℕ} (C : LinearDAG n a) (j : Fin n)
    (c : Fin a → ℂ) (x : Fin n → ℂ) :
    (C.addColumn j c).eval x = fun i => C.eval x i + c i * x j

name: OAI.ExactFourier.LinearDAG.eval_comp
statement:
theorem LinearDAG.eval_comp {n a b : ℕ} (D : LinearDAG a b) (C : LinearDAG n a)
    (x : Fin n → ℂ) : (D.comp C).eval x = D.eval (C.eval x)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.LinearDAG.eval_layer
statement:
theorem LinearDAG.eval_layer {n a : ℕ} (g : Fin a → Gate (n + 1))
    (x : Fin n → ℂ) : (LinearDAG.layer g).eval x = fun i => (g i).eval (Fin.snoc x 0)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.LinearDAG.eval_matrix
statement:
theorem LinearDAG.eval_matrix {n a : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (x : Fin n → ℂ) : (LinearDAG.matrix n a G).eval x = G.mulVec x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.LinearDAG.eval_wires
statement:
@[simp] theorem LinearDAG.eval_wires {n a : ℕ} (f : Fin a → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Fin n → ℂ) : (LinearDAG.wires f).eval x = fun i => (Fin.snoc x 0 : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) (f i)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.LinearDAG.size_layer
statement:
@[simp] theorem LinearDAG.size_layer {n a : ℕ} (g : Fin a → Gate (n + 1)) :
    (LinearDAG.layer g).size = a

name: OAI.ExactFourier.LinearDAG.size_matrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem LinearDAG.size_matrix {n a : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin n) ℂ) :
    (LinearDAG.matrix n a G).size = 2 * a * n

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Program.eval_append
statement:
theorem Program.eval_append {n m k l : ℕ} (p : Program n k) (q : Program m l)
    (f : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1 + k)) (x : Fin n → ℂ) (y : Fin m → ℂ)
    (hf : ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)), p.eval x (f i) = (Fin.snoc y 0 : Fin (m + 1) → ℂ) i) :
    (∀ j, (p.append f q).eval x (keepIndex j) = p.eval x j) ∧
    (∀ i, (p.append f q).eval x (appendIndex f i) = q.eval y i)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Program.eval_emit
statement:
theorem Program.eval_emit {n k a : ℕ} (p : Program n k)
    (g : Fin a → Gate (n + 1 + k)) (x : Fin n → ℂ) :
    (∀ j, (p.emit g).eval x (keepIndex j) = p.eval x j) ∧
    (∀ i, (p.emit g).eval x (gateIndex i) = (g i).eval (p.eval x))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Program.eval_input
statement:
theorem Program.eval_input {n k : ℕ} (p : Program n k) (x : Fin n → ℂ) (j : Fin n) :
    p.eval x ⟨j.val, by have := j.isLt; omega⟩ = x j

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Program.eval_zero
statement:
theorem Program.eval_zero {n k : ℕ} (p : Program n k) (x : Fin n → ℂ) :
    p.eval x ⟨n, by omega⟩ = 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.appendIndex_castSucc
OAI.ExactFourier.appendIndex_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem appendIndex_last {n m k l : ℕ} (f : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1 + k)) :
    appendIndex (l := l + 1) f (Fin.last (m + 1 + l)) = Fin.last (n + 1 + (k + l))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.appendIndex_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem appendIndex_zero {n m k : ℕ} (f : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (n + 1 + k))
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) : appendIndex (l := 0) f i = f i

name: OAI.ExactFourier.gateIndex_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] theorem gateIndex_castSucc {n k a : ℕ} (i : Fin a) :
    gateIndex (n := n) (k := k) i.castSucc = (gateIndex (n := n) (k := k) i).castSucc

name: OAI.ExactFourier.gateIndex_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem gateIndex_last {n k a : ℕ} :
    gateIndex (n := n) (k := k) (Fin.last a) = Fin.last (n + 1 + (k + a))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.keepIndex_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem keepIndex_succ {n k l : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1 + k)) :
    keepIndex (l := l + 1) i = (keepIndex (l := l) i).castSucc

name: OAI.ExactFourier.keepIndex_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem keepIndex_zero {n k : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1 + k)) :
    keepIndex (l := 0) i = i

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellJoin.join_eq
statement:
theorem join_eq
    {α : Type} {β : Type} {γ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] (X : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ℂ) (Y : Matrix (γ ⊕ β) (γ ⊕ β) ℂ) :
    join X Y =
    Matrix.reindex (Equiv.sumAssoc α γ β).symm (Equiv.sumAssoc α γ β).symm
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α ℂ) 0 0 Y) *
      Matrix.reindex (middleEquiv (ι := α) (κ := β) (τ := γ)) middleEquiv
        (Matrix.fromBlocks X 0 0 (1 : Matrix γ γ ℂ))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellJoin.price
statement:
theorem price (p : MatrixPrice) (X : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ℂ)
    (Y : Matrix (γ ⊕ β) (γ ⊕ β) ℂ) (hX : IsUnit X) (hY : IsUnit Y) :
    p.value (join X Y) ≤ p.value X + p.value Y

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellJoin.unit
statement:
theorem unit (X : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ℂ) (Y : Matrix (γ ⊕ β) (γ ⊕ β) ℂ)
    (hX : IsUnit X) (hY : IsUnit Y) : IsUnit (join X Y)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RowCompression.matrix_row_equiv
statement:
theorem matrix_row_equiv (R S : Matrix α β K)
    (hRS : Submodule.span K (Set.range R) = Submodule.span K (Set.range S)) :
    ∃ V : Matrix α α K, IsUnit V ∧ V * R = S

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RowCompression.range_equiv
statement:
theorem range_equiv [FiniteDimensional K E] (f g : E →ₗ[K] F)
    (hfg : LinearMap.range f = LinearMap.range g) :
    ∃ e : E ≃ₗ[K] E, ∀ x, f (e x) = g x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RowCompression.sparse_row_compression
statement:
theorem sparse_row_compression {γ : Type*} [Fintype β] (R : Matrix α β K)
    (Q : γ → β → K)
    (hspan : Submodule.span K (Set.range R) = Submodule.span K (Set.range Q)) :
    ∃ V : Matrix α α K, IsUnit V ∧ ∃ I : Finset α,
      I.card ≤ Fintype.card β ∧
      (∀ i, i ∉ I → (V*R) i = 0) ∧
      (∀ i ∈ I, ∃ g, (V*R) i = Q g)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RowCompression.splitEquiv_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem splitEquiv_fst (f : E →ₗ[K] F) (s : F →ₗ[K] E)
    (hs : f.comp s = LinearMap.id) (x : E) : (splitEquiv f s hs x).1 = f x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RowCompression.surjective_equiv
statement:
theorem surjective_equiv [FiniteDimensional K E] (f g : E →ₗ[K] F)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    ∃ e : E ≃ₗ[K] E, ∀ x, f (e x) = g x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TensorTools.join_mul
statement:
theorem join_mul
    {ι : Type} {κ : Type} {τ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] [DecidableEq τ] (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Matrix τ τ ℂ)
    (E : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (F : Matrix τ κ ℂ) (Y Z : Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) 0 0 B)
        (Matrix.fromRows 0 F) 0 Z *
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 (1 : Matrix τ τ ℂ))
        (Matrix.fromRows E 0) 0 Y =
    Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B)
      (Matrix.fromRows E (F * Y)) 0 (Z * Y)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TensorTools.pad_front
statement:
theorem pad_front
    {ι : Type} {κ : Type} {τ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] [DecidableEq τ] (B : Matrix τ τ ℂ) (F : Matrix τ κ ℂ) (Z : Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex (Equiv.sumAssoc ι τ κ).symm (Equiv.sumAssoc ι τ κ).symm
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) 0 0 (Matrix.fromBlocks B F 0 Z)) =
    Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) 0 0 B)
      (Matrix.fromRows 0 F) 0 Z

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TensorTools.pad_middle
statement:
theorem pad_middle
    {ι : Type} {κ : Type} {τ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] [DecidableEq τ] (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (E : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (Y : Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex (middleEquiv (τ := τ)) middleEquiv
      (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.fromBlocks A E 0 Y) 0 0 (1 : Matrix τ τ ℂ)) =
    Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 (1 : Matrix τ τ ℂ))
      (Matrix.fromRows E 0) 0 Y

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TensorTools.price_join
statement:
theorem price_join (p : MatrixPrice) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Matrix τ τ ℂ)
    (E : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (F : Matrix τ κ ℂ) (Y Z : Matrix κ κ ℂ)
    (hA : IsUnit A) (hB : IsUnit B) (hY : IsUnit Y) (hZ : IsUnit Z) :
    p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B)
      (Matrix.fromRows E (F * Y)) 0 (Z * Y)) ≤
      p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks A E 0 Y) + p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks B F 0 Z)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TensorTools.unit_reindex
statement:
theorem unit_reindex (e : ι ≃ κ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) :
    IsUnit (Matrix.reindex e e A)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TensorTools.unit_tensor
statement:
theorem unit_tensor (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Matrix κ κ ℂ)
    (hA : IsUnit A) (hB : IsUnit B) : IsUnit (A ⊗ₖ B)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.lift_identity
statement:
theorem lift_identity
    {α : Type} {β : Type} {σ : Type} {κ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype σ] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq κ] (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (E : Matrix (σ × α) κ ℂ)
    (Y : Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex liftEquiv liftEquiv
      (Matrix.fromBlocks ((1 : Matrix σ σ ℂ) ⊗ₖ M) E 0 Y ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix β β ℂ)) =
    Matrix.fromBlocks ((1 : Matrix (σ × β) (σ × β) ℂ) ⊗ₖ M) (oldE E) 0
      (Y ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix β β ℂ))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.merge_identity
statement:
theorem merge_identity
    {α : Type} {β : Type} {σ : Type} {κ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype σ] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq κ] (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ)
    (E : Matrix (σ × α) κ ℂ) (Y : Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex mergeEquiv mergeEquiv
      (Matrix.fromBlocks
        (Matrix.fromBlocks ((1 : Matrix (σ × β) (σ × β) ℂ) ⊗ₖ M) 0 0
          ((1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ) ⊗ₖ M))
        (Matrix.fromRows (oldE E) (((1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ) ⊗ₖ C) *
          (Y ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix β β ℂ)))) 0
        (((1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ) ⊗ₖ D) * (Y ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix β β ℂ)))) =
    Matrix.fromBlocks ((1 : Matrix ((σ × β) ⊕ κ) ((σ × β) ⊕ κ) ℂ) ⊗ₖ M)
      (nextE E Y C) 0 (Y ⊗ₖ D)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.new_identity
statement:
theorem new_identity
    {α : Type} {β : Type} {κ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq κ] (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex (Equiv.prodSumDistrib κ α β) (Equiv.prodSumDistrib κ α β)
      ((1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ) ⊗ₖ Matrix.fromBlocks M C 0 D) =
    Matrix.fromBlocks ((1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ) ⊗ₖ M) ((1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ) ⊗ₖ C) 0
      ((1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ) ⊗ₖ D)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.next_price
statement:
theorem next_price (p : MatrixPrice) (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (E : Matrix (σ × α) κ ℂ) (Y : Matrix κ κ ℂ)
    (hM : IsUnit M) (hD : IsUnit D) (hY : IsUnit Y) :
    p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks ((1 : Matrix ((σ × β) ⊕ κ) ((σ × β) ⊕ κ) ℂ) ⊗ₖ M)
       (nextE E Y C) 0 (Y ⊗ₖ D)) ≤
      Fintype.card β * p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks ((1 : Matrix σ σ ℂ) ⊗ₖ M) E 0 Y) +
      Fintype.card κ * p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks M C 0 D)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.rectangularShear_add_le
statement:
theorem rectangularShear_add_le (G H : Matrix ι κ ℂ) :
    p.value (rectangularShear (G+H)) ≤
      p.value (rectangularShear G) + p.value (rectangularShear H)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.rectangularShear_single
statement:
theorem rectangularShear_single
    {ι : Type} {κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (i : ι) (j : κ) (c : ℂ) :
    rectangularShear (Matrix.single i j c) =
      Matrix.transvection (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j) c

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.rectangularShear_sparse
statement:
theorem rectangularShear_sparse (G : Matrix ι κ ℂ) :
    p.value (rectangularShear G) ≤
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun ij : ι × κ => G ij.1 ij.2 ≠ 0).card : ℝ)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.rectangularShear_sum_le
statement:
theorem rectangularShear_sum_le {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (G : α → Matrix ι κ ℂ) :
    p.value (rectangularShear (∑ i ∈ s, G i)) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ s, p.value (rectangularShear (G i))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.bottom_card_pos
statement: theorem bottom_card_pos (hβ : 0 < Fintype.card β) (k : ℕ) : 0 < Fintype.card (Bottom β k)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.bottom_card_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem bottom_card_succ
    {β : Type} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] (k : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Bottom β (k+1)) = Fintype.card (Bottom β k) * Fintype.card β

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.bottom_card_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem bottom_card_zero
    {β : Type} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] : Fintype.card (Bottom β 0) = 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.calls_card_relation
statement:
theorem calls_card_relation (k : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Calls β k) * Fintype.card β = k * Fintype.card (Bottom β k)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.calls_card_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem calls_card_succ
    {β : Type} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] (k : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Calls β (k+1)) = Fintype.card (Calls β k) * Fintype.card β + Fintype.card (Bottom β k)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.calls_card_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem calls_card_zero
    {β : Type} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] : Fintype.card (Calls β 0) = 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.cancellation_identity
statement:
theorem cancellation_identity (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (E : Matrix (σ × α) κ ℂ)
    (Y : Matrix κ κ ℂ) (V : Matrix σ σ ℂ) (hY : IsUnit Y) :
    rectangularShear (-((V ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix α α ℂ)) * (E * Y⁻¹))) *
      Matrix.fromBlocks (V ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix α α ℂ)) 0 0 (1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ) *
      Matrix.fromBlocks ((1 : Matrix σ σ ℂ) ⊗ₖ M) E 0 Y =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (V ⊗ₖ M) 0 0 Y

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.compressed_price
statement:
theorem compressed_price (p : MatrixPrice) (M : Matrix α α ℂ)
    (E : Matrix (σ × α) κ ℂ) (Y : Matrix κ κ ℂ)
    (hM : IsUnit M) (hY : IsUnit Y) {γ : Type} (Q : γ → α × κ → ℂ)
    (hspan : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (flat (E * Y⁻¹))) = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range Q))
    (B : ℕ) (hQ : ∀ g, nnz (Q g) ≤ B) :
    Fintype.card σ * p.value M + p.value Y ≤
      p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks ((1 : Matrix σ σ ℂ) ⊗ₖ M) E 0 Y) +
      (Fintype.card α * Fintype.card κ : ℝ) * B

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.experiment_price
statement:
theorem experiment_price (p : MatrixPrice) (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (hM : IsUnit M) (hD : IsUnit D) (k : ℕ) :
    p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks ((1 : Matrix (Calls β k) (Calls β k) ℂ) ⊗ₖ M)
      (contamination C D k) 0 (tensorPower D k)) ≤
      Fintype.card (Calls β k) * p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks M C 0 D)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.flat_left
statement:
theorem flat_left
    {α : Type} {σ : Type} {κ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype σ] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq κ] (V : Matrix σ σ ℂ) (E : Matrix (σ × α) κ ℂ) :
    flat ((V ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix α α ℂ)) * E) = V * flat E

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.flat_next_normalized
statement:
theorem flat_next_normalized
    {α : Type} {β : Type} {σ : Type} {κ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype σ] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq κ] (E : Matrix (σ × α) κ ℂ) (Y : Matrix κ κ ℂ)
    (C : Matrix α β ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (hY : IsUnit Y) :
    flat (nextE E Y C * (Y ⊗ₖ D)⁻¹) =
      nextRows (flat (E * Y⁻¹)) (C * D⁻¹) D⁻¹

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.generators_sparse
statement:
theorem generators_sparse (C : Matrix α β ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ i, nnz (generators C D k i) ≤ Fintype.card α * Fintype.card β

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.liftRows_mul
statement:
theorem liftRows_mul
    {α : Type} {β : Type} {σ : Type} {κ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype σ] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq κ] (V : Matrix σ σ ℂ) (B : Matrix β β ℂ)
    (R : Matrix σ (α × κ) ℂ) (H : Matrix β β ℂ) :
    (V ⊗ₖ B) * liftRows R H = liftRows (V * R) (B * H)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.nextRows_change
statement:
theorem nextRows_change (V : Matrix σ σ ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ)
    (R : Matrix σ (α × κ) ℂ) (T : Matrix α β ℂ) (hD : IsUnit D) :
    Matrix.fromBlocks (V ⊗ₖ D) 0 0 (1 : Matrix κ κ ℂ) * nextRows R T D⁻¹ =
      nextRows (V * R) T 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.nnz_flat
statement:
theorem nnz_flat
    {α : Type} {σ : Type} {κ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype σ] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq κ] (E : Matrix (σ × α) κ ℂ) :
    nnz (fun ij : (σ × α) × κ => E ij.1 ij.2) = ∑ s, nnz (flat E s)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.nnz_fresh
statement:
theorem nnz_fresh
    {α : Type} {β : Type} {κ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq κ] (T : Matrix α β ℂ) (i : κ) :
    nnz (freshRows T i) ≤ Fintype.card α * Fintype.card β

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.nnz_lift_one
statement:
theorem nnz_lift_one
    {α : Type} {β : Type} {σ : Type} {κ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype σ] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq κ] (Q : Matrix σ (α × κ) ℂ) (s : σ) (b : β) :
    nnz (liftRows Q (1 : Matrix β β ℂ) (s,b)) ≤ nnz (Q s)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.nnz_nextRows
statement:
theorem nnz_nextRows (Q : Matrix σ (α × κ) ℂ) (T : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (hQ : ∀ s, nnz (Q s) ≤ Fintype.card α * Fintype.card β) :
    ∀ s, nnz (nextRows Q T (1 : Matrix β β ℂ) s) ≤ Fintype.card α * Fintype.card β

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.nnz_selected_le
statement:
theorem nnz_selected_le
    {σ : Type} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {δ : Type} [Fintype δ] (R : Matrix σ δ ℂ)
    (I : Finset σ) (B : ℕ) (hzero : ∀ i, i ∉ I → R i = 0)
    (hB : ∀ i ∈ I, nnz (R i) ≤ B) :
    ∑ i, nnz (R i) ≤ I.card * B

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.rowBasis_normalizes
statement:
theorem rowBasis_normalizes (C : Matrix α β ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ)
    (hD : IsUnit D) (k : ℕ) :
    rowBasis D k * flat (contamination C D k * (tensorPower D k)⁻¹) = generators C D k

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.rowBasis_unit
statement:
theorem rowBasis_unit (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (hD : IsUnit D) (k : ℕ) :
    IsUnit (rowBasis D k)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.span_rows_unit_mul
statement:
theorem span_rows_unit_mul {δ : Type} (V : Matrix σ σ ℂ) (R : Matrix σ δ ℂ)
    (hV : IsUnit V) :
    Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (V * R)) = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range R)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.tensorPower_price
statement:
theorem tensorPower_price (p : MatrixPrice) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (hD : IsUnit D) (k : ℕ) :
    p.value (tensorPower D k) = Fintype.card (Calls β k) * p.value D

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Triangular.tensorPower_unit
statement:
theorem tensorPower_unit (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (hD : IsUnit D) (k : ℕ) :
    IsUnit (tensorPower D k)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.blockTruncHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockTruncHom_apply {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (t : ℕ)
    (F : Matrix ι ι (PowerSeries ℂ)) (a b : Fin t × ι) :
    blockTruncHom t F a b =
      if b.1.val ≤ a.1.val then PowerSeries.coeff (a.1.val-b.1.val) (F a.2 b.2) else 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.blockTrunc_isUnit
statement:
theorem blockTrunc_isUnit {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (t : ℕ)
    (F : Matrix ι ι (PowerSeries ℂ))
    (hF : IsUnit (F.map PowerSeries.constantCoeff)) :
    IsUnit (blockTruncHom t F)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.blocks_mul_columns
statement:
theorem blocks_mul_columns {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (t : ℕ)
    (F : Matrix ι ι (PowerSeries ℂ)) (V : Matrix ι κ (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    blockTruncHom t F * coefficientColumns t V = coefficientColumns t (F*V)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.coeff_mul_truncated
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_truncated {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {t : ℕ}
    (F G : PowerSeries R) (a : Fin t) :
    PowerSeries.coeff a.val (F*G) = ∑ k : Fin t,
      (if k.val ≤ a.val then PowerSeries.coeff (a.val-k.val) F else 0) *
        PowerSeries.coeff k.val G

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.prefixScalar_isUnit
statement:
theorem prefixScalar_isUnit (t T : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries ℂ)
    (hf : IsUnit (PowerSeries.constantCoeff f)) : IsUnit (prefixScalar t T f)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.prefixScalar_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem prefixScalar_mul (t T : ℕ) (f g : PowerSeries ℂ) :
    prefixScalar t T (f*g) = prefixScalar t T f * prefixScalar t T g

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.prefixScalar_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem prefixScalar_one (t T : ℕ) :
    prefixScalar t T 1 = 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.prefix_mul_columns
OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.truncMatrix_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem truncMatrix_add {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (t : ℕ)
    (F G : PowerSeries R) : truncMatrix t (F+G) = truncMatrix t F + truncMatrix t G

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.truncMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem truncMatrix_mul {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (t : ℕ)
    (F G : PowerSeries R) : truncMatrix t (F*G) = truncMatrix t F * truncMatrix t G

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.truncMatrix_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem truncMatrix_one {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (t : ℕ) :
    truncMatrix t (1 : PowerSeries R) = 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.truncMatrix_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem truncMatrix_zero {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (t : ℕ) :
    truncMatrix t (0 : PowerSeries R) = 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.trunc_isUnit
statement:
theorem trunc_isUnit {R : Type*} [Ring R] (t : ℕ) (F : PowerSeries R)
    (hF : IsUnit (PowerSeries.constantCoeff F)) : IsUnit (truncMatrix t F)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.zero_prefix_columns_mul
statement:
theorem zero_prefix_columns_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (t T : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (S : Matrix (Fin t × ι) (Fin t × ι) ℂ)
    (hS : ∀ a b, b.1.val < T → S a b = 0) :
    S * (prefixScalar t T f ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ)) = S

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.blocks_lower
statement:
theorem blocks_lower (t : ℕ) (F : Matrix (Fin t × α) (Fin t × α) ℂ)
    (A : Fin t → Matrix α α ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, IsUnit (A i))
    (hdiag : ∀ i a b, F (i,a) (i,b) = A i a b)
    (hbelow : ∀ i j a b, i < j → F (i,a) (j,b) = 0) :
    IsUnit F ∧ (∑ i, p.value (A i)) ≤ p.value F

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.lower_triangular
statement:
theorem lower_triangular (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix β α ℂ)
    (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (hM : IsUnit M) (hD : IsUnit D) :
    p.value M + p.value D ≤ p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks M 0 C D)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.triangular_experiment_bound
statement:
theorem triangular_experiment_bound (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (hM : IsUnit M) (hD : IsUnit D) (k : ℕ) :
    (Fintype.card (Calls β k) : ℝ) *
        (p.value M + p.value D - p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks M C 0 D)) ≤
      (Fintype.card α : ℝ)^2 * Fintype.card β * Fintype.card (Bottom β k)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.trunc_lower_bound
statement:
theorem trunc_lower_bound (t : ℕ) (F : Matrix α α (PowerSeries ℂ))
    (hF : IsUnit (F.map PowerSeries.constantCoeff)) :
    (t : ℝ) * p.value (F.map PowerSeries.constantCoeff) ≤
      p.value (CoefficientTime.blockTruncHom t F)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.upper_triangular
statement:
theorem upper_triangular (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (hM : IsUnit M) (hD : IsUnit D) :
    p.value M + p.value D ≤ p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks M C 0 D)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.AxisJoin.join_eq
statement:
theorem join_eq
    {α : Type} {β : Type} {γ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] (X : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ℂ) (Y : Matrix (α ⊕ γ) (α ⊕ γ) ℂ) :
    join X Y =
      Matrix.reindex rightOrder rightOrder (Matrix.fromBlocks Y 0 0 (1 : Matrix β β ℂ)) *
      Matrix.reindex (Equiv.sumAssoc α β γ) (Equiv.sumAssoc α β γ)
        (Matrix.fromBlocks X 0 0 (1 : Matrix γ γ ℂ))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.AxisJoin.price
statement:
theorem price (p : MatrixPrice) (X : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ℂ)
    (Y : Matrix (α ⊕ γ) (α ⊕ γ) ℂ) (hX : IsUnit X) (hY : IsUnit Y) :
    p.value (join X Y) ≤ p.value X + p.value Y

name: OAI.ExactFourier.AxisJoin.unit
statement:
theorem unit (X : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ℂ) (Y : Matrix (α ⊕ γ) (α ⊕ γ) ℂ)
    (hX : IsUnit X) (hY : IsUnit Y) : IsUnit (join X Y)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellSeries.coeff_resolvent
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_resolvent (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (n : ℕ) (i j : β) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (resolvent D i j) = (D^n) i j

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellSeries.coeff_state
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_state
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (C : Matrix α β ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (n : ℕ) (i : α) (j : β) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (state C D i j) = (C*D^n) i j

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellSeries.coeff_transfer_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_transfer_succ (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (n : ℕ) (i j : α) :
    PowerSeries.coeff (n+1) (transfer M C B D i j) = (C*D^n*B) i j

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellSeries.coeff_transfer_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_transfer_zero
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (i j : α) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 0 (transfer M C B D i j) = M i j

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellSeries.constant_transfer
statement:
theorem constant_transfer
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) :
    (transfer M C B D).map PowerSeries.constantCoeff = M

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellSeries.resolvent_left_inverse
statement:
theorem resolvent_left_inverse (D : Matrix β β ℂ) :
    resolvent D * (1 - (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries ℂ) • D.map PowerSeries.C) = 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellSeries.resolvent_right_inverse
statement:
theorem resolvent_right_inverse (D : Matrix β β ℂ) :
    (1 - (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries ℂ) • D.map PowerSeries.C) * resolvent D = 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellStream.data_block
statement:
theorem data_block (t : ℕ) :
    (run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) t).toBlocks₁₁ =
      blockTruncHom t (CellSeries.transfer M C B D)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellStream.data_entry
statement:
theorem data_entry (t : ℕ) (i j : Fin t) (a b : α) :
    run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) t (Sum.inl (i,a)) (Sum.inl (j,b)) =
      if j.val ≤ i.val then PowerSeries.coeff (i.val-j.val) (CellSeries.transfer M C B D a b) else 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellStream.fst_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem fst_fst
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ) (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (t : ℕ) (a b : α) :
    run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) (t+1) (Sum.inl (0,a)) (Sum.inl (0,b)) = M a b

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellStream.fst_state
statement:
@[simp] theorem fst_state
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ) (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (t : ℕ) (a : α) (b : β) :
    run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) (t+1) (Sum.inl (0,a)) (Sum.inr b) = C a b

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellStream.fst_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem fst_succ
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ) (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (t : ℕ) (a b : α) (j : Fin t) :
    run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) (t+1) (Sum.inl (0,a)) (Sum.inl (j.succ,b)) = 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellStream.price
statement:
theorem price (p : MatrixPrice) (K : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ℂ)
    (hK : IsUnit K) (t : ℕ) : p.value (run K t) ≤ (t : ℝ) * p.value K

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellStream.state_block
statement:
theorem state_block (t : ℕ) :
    (run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) t).toBlocks₁₂ =
      coefficientColumns t (CellSeries.state C D)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellStream.state_entry
statement:
theorem state_entry (t : ℕ) (i : Fin t) (a : α) (b : β) :
    run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) t (Sum.inl (i,a)) (Sum.inr b) = (C*D^i.val) a b

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellStream.succ_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem succ_fst
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ) (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (t : ℕ) (a b : α) (i : Fin t) :
    run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) (t+1) (Sum.inl (i.succ,a)) (Sum.inl (0,b)) =
      ∑ w, run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) t (Sum.inl (i,a)) (Sum.inr w) * B w b

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellStream.succ_state
statement:
@[simp] theorem succ_state
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ) (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (t : ℕ) (a : α) (b : β) (i : Fin t) :
    run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) (t+1) (Sum.inl (i.succ,a)) (Sum.inr b) =
      ∑ w, run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) t (Sum.inl (i,a)) (Sum.inr w) * D w b

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellStream.succ_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem succ_succ
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ) (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (t : ℕ) (a b : α) (i j : Fin t) :
    run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) (t+1) (Sum.inl (i.succ,a)) (Sum.inl (j.succ,b)) =
      run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) t (Sum.inl (i,a)) (Sum.inl (j,b))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellStream.unit
statement:
theorem unit (K : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ℂ) (hK : IsUnit K) (t : ℕ) :
    IsUnit (run K t)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TensorAxis.card_space
statement: @[simp] theorem card_space (k : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Space α k) = Fintype.card α ^ k

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TensorAxis.map_power
statement:
theorem map_power
    {α : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type} {S : Type} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] (f : R →+* S) (A : Matrix α α R) (k : ℕ) :
    (power A k).map f = power (A.map f) k

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TensorAxis.mul_power
statement:
theorem mul_power
    {α : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type} [CommSemiring R] (A B : Matrix α α R) (k : ℕ) :
    power A k * power B k = power (A*B) k

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TensorAxis.power_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem power_one
    {α : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type} [CommSemiring R] (k : ℕ) : power (1 : Matrix α α R) k = 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TensorAxis.price_power
statement:
theorem price_power (p : MatrixPrice) (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) (k : ℕ) :
    p.value (power A k) = (Fintype.card (Fibers α k) : ℝ) * p.value A

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TensorAxis.unit_power
statement: theorem unit_power (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) (k : ℕ) : IsUnit (power A k)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TimeLifts.left_data
statement:
theorem left_data
    {σ : Type} {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype σ] [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (t : ℕ) (X : Matrix ((Fin t × α) ⊕ β) ((Fin t × α) ⊕ β) ℂ)
    (H : Matrix α α (PowerSeries ℂ)) (hX : X.toBlocks₁₁ = blockTruncHom t H) :
    (left (σ := σ) t X).toBlocks₁₁ =
      blockTruncHom t ((1 : Matrix σ σ (PowerSeries ℂ)) ⊗ₖ H)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TimeLifts.left_price
statement:
theorem left_price (p : MatrixPrice) (t : ℕ)
    (X : Matrix ((Fin t × α) ⊕ β) ((Fin t × α) ⊕ β) ℂ) (hX : IsUnit X) :
    p.value (left (σ := σ) t X) = (Fintype.card σ : ℝ) * p.value X

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TimeLifts.left_state
statement:
theorem left_state
    {σ : Type} {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype σ] [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (t : ℕ) (X : Matrix ((Fin t × α) ⊕ β) ((Fin t × α) ⊕ β) ℂ)
    (E : Matrix α β (PowerSeries ℂ)) (hX : X.toBlocks₁₂ = coefficientColumns t E) :
    (left (σ := σ) t X).toBlocks₁₂ =
      coefficientColumns t ((1 : Matrix σ σ (PowerSeries ℂ)) ⊗ₖ E)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TimeLifts.left_unit
statement:
theorem left_unit (t : ℕ) (X : Matrix ((Fin t × α) ⊕ β) ((Fin t × α) ⊕ β) ℂ)
    (hX : IsUnit X) : IsUnit (left (σ := σ) t X)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TimeLifts.right_data
statement:
theorem right_data
    {σ : Type} {ρ : Type} {α : Type} [Fintype σ] [Fintype ρ] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq ρ] [DecidableEq α] (t : ℕ) (X : Matrix ((Fin t × σ) ⊕ ρ) ((Fin t × σ) ⊕ ρ) ℂ)
    (H : Matrix σ σ (PowerSeries ℂ)) (hX : X.toBlocks₁₁ = blockTruncHom t H) :
    (right (α := α) t X).toBlocks₁₁ =
      blockTruncHom t (H ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix α α (PowerSeries ℂ)))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TimeLifts.right_price
statement:
theorem right_price (p : MatrixPrice) (t : ℕ)
    (X : Matrix ((Fin t × σ) ⊕ ρ) ((Fin t × σ) ⊕ ρ) ℂ) (hX : IsUnit X) :
    p.value (right (α := α) t X) = (Fintype.card α : ℝ) * p.value X

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TimeLifts.right_state
statement:
theorem right_state
    {σ : Type} {ρ : Type} {α : Type} [Fintype σ] [Fintype ρ] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq ρ] [DecidableEq α] (t : ℕ) (X : Matrix ((Fin t × σ) ⊕ ρ) ((Fin t × σ) ⊕ ρ) ℂ)
    (E : Matrix σ ρ (PowerSeries ℂ)) (hX : X.toBlocks₁₂ = coefficientColumns t E) :
    (right (α := α) t X).toBlocks₁₂ =
      coefficientColumns t (E ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix α α (PowerSeries ℂ)))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TimeLifts.right_unit
statement:
theorem right_unit (t : ℕ) (X : Matrix ((Fin t × σ) ⊕ ρ) ((Fin t × σ) ⊕ ρ) ℂ)
    (hX : IsUnit X) : IsUnit (right (α := α) t X)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Cascade.bounded_cleared
statement:
theorem bounded_cleared
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (b : Polynomial ℂ) (L : Matrix α α (Polynomial ℂ))
    (T : Matrix α β (Polynomial ℂ)) {d : ℕ}
    (hb : b.natDegree≤d) (hL : Bounded L d) (hT : Bounded T d) (k : ℕ) :
    Bounded (cleared b L T k) (k*d)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Cascade.cell_clearing
statement:
theorem cell_clearing (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    power (CellSeries.transfer M C B D) k *
      (cleared (CellPoly.b M C B D) (CellPoly.L M C B D) (CellPoly.T M C B D) k).map CellPoly.ps =
    CellPoly.ps ((CellPoly.b M C B D)^k) •
      response (CellSeries.transfer M C B D) (CellSeries.state C D) k

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Cascade.clearing_identity
statement:
theorem clearing_identity
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (c : PowerSeries ℂ) (H L : Matrix α α (PowerSeries ℂ))
    (S T : Matrix α β (PowerSeries ℂ)) (hL : H*L=c•1) (hT : H*T=c•S) (k : ℕ) :
    power H k * cleared c L T k = c^k • response H S k

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Cascade.columns_fromCols
statement:
theorem columns_fromCols {σ ρ τ : Type} (t : ℕ)
    (E : Matrix σ ρ (PowerSeries ℂ)) (F : Matrix σ τ (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    coefficientColumns t (Matrix.fromCols E F) =
      Matrix.fromCols (coefficientColumns t E) (coefficientColumns t F)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Cascade.data_block
statement:
theorem data_block (t k : ℕ) :
    (run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) t k).toBlocks₁₁ =
      blockTruncHom t (power (CellSeries.transfer M C B D) k)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Cascade.exists_cleared_degree
statement:
theorem exists_cleared_degree (b : Polynomial ℂ) (L : Matrix α α (Polynomial ℂ))
    (T : Matrix α β (Polynomial ℂ)) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, ∀ k, Bounded (cleared b L T k) (k*d)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Cascade.map_cleared
statement:
theorem map_cleared
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] {R : Type} [CommSemiring R] {S : Type} [CommSemiring S] (f : R →+* S)
    (b : R) (L : Matrix α α R) (T : Matrix α β R) (k : ℕ) :
    (cleared b L T k).map f = cleared (f b) (L.map f) (T.map f) k

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Cascade.power_smul
statement:
theorem power_smul
    {α : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type} [CommSemiring R] (c : R) (A : Matrix α α R) (k : ℕ) :
    power (c • A) k = c^k • power A k

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Cascade.price
statement:
theorem price (p : MatrixPrice) (K : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ℂ)
    (hK : IsUnit K) (t k : ℕ) :
    p.value (run K t k) ≤ (t : ℝ) * Fintype.card (Fibers α k) * p.value K

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Cascade.state_block
statement:
theorem state_block (t k : ℕ) :
    (run (Matrix.fromBlocks M C B D) t k).toBlocks₁₂ =
      coefficientColumns t (response (CellSeries.transfer M C B D) (CellSeries.state C D) k)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Cascade.unit
statement:
theorem unit (K : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ℂ) (hK : IsUnit K) (t k : ℕ) :
    IsUnit (run K t k)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.cleared_resolvent
statement:
theorem cleared_resolvent (D : Matrix β β ℂ) :
    ps (a D) • CellSeries.resolvent D = (R D).map ps

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.cleared_state
statement:
theorem cleared_state
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (C : Matrix α β ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) :
    ps (a D) • CellSeries.state C D = (C.map Polynomial.C * R D).map ps

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.cleared_transfer
statement:
theorem cleared_transfer (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) :
    ps (a D) • CellSeries.transfer M C B D = (F M C B D).map ps

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.eval_F_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_F_zero
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.eval_Z_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_Z_zero
    {β : Type} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] (D : Matrix β β ℂ) : (Z D).map (evalRingHom 0) = 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.eval_a_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_a_zero (D : Matrix β β ℂ) : (a D).eval 0 = 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.eval_b_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_b_zero (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) : (b M C B D).eval 0 = M.det

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.map_Z
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_Z
    {β : Type} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] (D : Matrix β β ℂ) :
    (Z D).map ps = 1 - (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries ℂ) • D.map PowerSeries.C

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.map_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_const {ι κ : Type} (A : Matrix ι κ ℂ) :
    (A.map Polynomial.C).map ps = A.map PowerSeries.C

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.map_smul
OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.right_clearing
statement:
theorem right_clearing (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) :
    CellSeries.transfer M C B D * (L M C B D).map ps = ps (b M C B D) • 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.state_clearing
statement:
theorem state_clearing (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) :
    CellSeries.transfer M C B D * (T M C B D).map ps =
      ps (b M C B D) • CellSeries.state C D

name: OAI.ExactFourier.PolynomialMatrix.bounded_one
statement:
theorem bounded_one
    {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] : Bounded (1 : Matrix ι ι (Polynomial ℂ)) 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.PolynomialMatrix.bounded_power
statement:
theorem bounded_power {α : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (A : Matrix α α (Polynomial ℂ)) {d : ℕ} (hA : Bounded A d) (k : ℕ) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.PolynomialMatrix.bounded_smul
statement:
theorem bounded_smul
    {ι : Type} {κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (b : Polynomial ℂ) (A : Matrix ι κ (Polynomial ℂ))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.PolynomialMatrix.le_bound
statement:
theorem le_bound (A : Matrix ι κ (Polynomial ℂ)) (i : ι) (j : κ) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.LinearDAG.eval_butterflies
statement:
theorem LinearDAG.eval_butterflies {n m : ℕ} (C : LinearDAG n (m+m))
    (c : Fin m → ℂ) (x : Fin n → ℂ) :
    (C.butterflies c).eval x = Fin.addCases
      (fun i => C.eval x (Fin.castAdd m i) + c i * C.eval x (Fin.natAdd m i))
      (fun i => C.eval x (Fin.castAdd m i) - c i * C.eval x (Fin.natAdd m i))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.LinearDAG.eval_fanout
OAI.ExactFourier.LinearDAG.eval_withInputs
statement:
theorem LinearDAG.eval_withInputs {m n a : ℕ} (C : LinearDAG n a)
    (f : Fin n → Fin m) (x : Fin m → ℂ) : (C.withInputs f).eval x = C.eval (x ∘ f)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.LinearDAG.eval_withOutputs
statement:
@[simp] theorem LinearDAG.eval_withOutputs {n a b : ℕ} (C : LinearDAG n a)

@[simp] theorem LinearDAG.size_fanout {n a b : ℕ}

name: OAI.ExactFourier.LinearDAG.size_withInputs

statement:
theorem size_reconstruct (m : ℕ) (C : Fin m → TypedDAG ι κ) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Program.eval_original
statement:
theorem Program.eval_original {n k : ℕ} (p : Program n k) (x : Fin n → ℂ)
    (i : Fin (n+1)) : p.eval x (Fin.castAdd k i) = (Fin.snoc x 0 : Fin (n+1) → ℂ) i

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_addPair
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_addPair (x : κ ⊕ κ → ℂ) :
    (addPair (κ := κ)).eval x = fun i => x (Sum.inl i) + x (Sum.inr i)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_blockCols
statement:
theorem eval_blockCols (C : TypedDAG ι κ) (D : TypedDAG τ κ)
    (A : Matrix κ ι ℂ) (B : Matrix κ τ ℂ)
    (hC : ∀ x, C.eval x=A.mulVec x) (hD : ∀ x, D.eval x=B.mulVec x) (x : ι ⊕ τ → ℂ) :
    (blockCols C D).eval x = (Matrix.fromCols A B).mulVec x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_comp (D : TypedDAG κ τ) (C : TypedDAG ι κ) (x : ι → ℂ) :
    (D.comp C).eval x = D.eval (C.eval x)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_fanout
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_fanout (C : TypedDAG ι κ) (D : TypedDAG ι τ) (x : ι → ℂ) :
    (C.fanout D).eval x = Sum.elim (C.eval x) (D.eval x)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_identity
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_identity (x : ι → ℂ) : (identity (ι := ι)).eval x = x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_inputs
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_inputs (C : TypedDAG ι κ) (f : ι → τ) (x : τ → ℂ) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_matrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_matrix (A : Matrix κ ι ℂ) (x : ι → ℂ) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_outputs
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_outputs (C : TypedDAG ι κ) (f : τ → κ) (x : ι → ℂ) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_parallel
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_parallel (C : TypedDAG ι κ) (x : τ × ι → ℂ) :
    (C.parallel τ).eval x = fun j => C.eval (fun i => x (j.1,i)) j.2

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_scalar
statement:
theorem eval_scalar (c : ℂ) (C : TypedDAG ι κ) (A : Matrix κ ι ℂ)
    (hC : ∀ x, C.eval x=A.mulVec x) (x : ι → ℂ) :
    (scalar c C).eval x = (c • A).mulVec x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_scale
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_scale (c : κ → ℂ) (x : κ → ℂ) :
    (scale c).eval x = fun i => c i * x i

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_stack
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_stack (C : τ → TypedDAG ι κ) (x : ι → ℂ) :
    (stack C).eval x = fun j => (C j.1).eval x j.2

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_stackFin
statement:
theorem eval_stackFin (n : ℕ) (C : Fin n → TypedDAG ι κ) (x : ι → ℂ) :
    (stackFin n C).eval x = fun j => (C j.1).eval x j.2

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_tensor
statement:
theorem eval_tensor (C : TypedDAG ι κ) (D : TypedDAG τ υ)
    (A : Matrix κ ι ℂ) (B : Matrix υ τ ℂ)
    (hC : ∀ x, C.eval x = A.mulVec x) (hD : ∀ x, D.eval x = B.mulVec x)
    (x : ι × τ → ℂ) : (C.tensor D).eval x = (A ⊗ₖ B).mulVec x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_tensorPower
statement:
theorem eval_tensorPower
    {α : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (k : ℕ) (x : TensorAxis.Space α k → ℂ) :
    (tensorPower A k).eval x = (TensorAxis.power A k).mulVec x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_wires
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_wires (f : κ → Option ι) (x : ι → ℂ) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.size_addPair

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.size_fanout

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.size_outputs

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.size_scalar
statement:

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.size_scale

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Cascade.eval_clearedDAG
statement:
theorem eval_clearedDAG
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (b : ℂ) (L : Matrix α α ℂ) (T : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (k : ℕ) (x : States α β k → ℂ) :
    (clearedDAG b L T k).eval x = (cleared b L T k).mulVec x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Cascade.size_clearedDAG
statement:
theorem size_clearedDAG
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (b : ℂ) (L : Matrix α α ℂ) (T : Matrix α β ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    (clearedDAG b L T k).size ≤
      2*(Fintype.card β+Fintype.card α+1)*k^2*Fintype.card α^k

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.eliminate_top_right
statement:
theorem eliminate_top_right (A P : Matrix α α ℂ) (E Q : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ)
    (hK : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks A E B D)) (hA : IsUnit A) (hP : IsUnit P)
    (hQ : A * P * Q = E) :
    p.value A ≤ p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks A E B D) +
      2 * p.value P + p.value (rectangularShear Q)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RadixTwo.evalAt_periodic
statement:
theorem evalAt_periodic (n : ℕ) (ω : ℂ) (hω : ω^n=1) (x : Fin n → ℂ) (r : ℕ) :
    evalAt n ω x (r+n) = evalAt n ω x r

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RadixTwo.evalAt_split
statement:
theorem evalAt_split (n : ℕ) (ω : ℂ) (x : Fin (n+n) → ℂ) (r : ℕ) :
    evalAt (n+n) ω x r = evalAt n (ω^2) (x ∘ evenIndex n) r +
      ω^r * evalAt n (ω^2) (x ∘ oddIndex n) r

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RadixTwo.eval_inverse
statement:
theorem eval_inverse {n : ℕ} (hn : 0<n) (ω : ℂ) (hω : IsPrimitiveRoot ω n)
    (x : Fin n → ℂ) :
    eval n ω⁻¹ (eval n ω x) = fun i => (n : ℂ) * x i

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RadixTwo.eval_ofFn
statement:
theorem eval_ofFn (n : ℕ) (ω : ℂ) (x : Fin n → ℂ) (i : Fin n) :
    (Polynomial.ofFn n x).eval (ω^i.val) = eval n ω x i

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RadixTwo.eval_split
statement:
theorem eval_split (n : ℕ) (ω : ℂ) (hω : ω^n = -1) (x : Fin (n+n) → ℂ) :
    eval (n+n) ω x = Fin.addCases
      (fun i => eval n (ω^2) (x ∘ evenIndex n) i + ω^i.val * eval n (ω^2) (x ∘ oddIndex n) i)
      (fun i => eval n (ω^2) (x ∘ evenIndex n) i - ω^i.val * eval n (ω^2) (x ∘ oddIndex n) i)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RadixTwo.orthogonality
statement:
theorem orthogonality {n : ℕ} (hn : 0<n) (ω : ℂ) (hω : IsPrimitiveRoot ω n)
    (i k : Fin n) :
    (∑ j : Fin n, (ω⁻¹)^(i.val*j.val) * ω^(k.val*j.val)) =
      if i=k then (n : ℂ) else 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RadixTwo.power_even
statement: theorem power_even (ω : ℂ) (r j : ℕ) : ω^(r*(2*j)) = (ω^2)^(r*j)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RadixTwo.power_odd
statement: theorem power_odd (ω : ℂ) (r j : ℕ) : ω^(r*(2*j+1)) = ω^r * (ω^2)^(r*j)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RadixTwo.square_period
statement: theorem square_period {n : ℕ} (ω : ℂ) (hω : ω^n = -1) : (ω^2)^n = 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RadixTwo.sum_even_odd
statement:
theorem sum_even_odd {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] (n : ℕ) (f : Fin (n+n) → R) :
    ∑ i, f i = (∑ i : Fin n, f (evenIndex n i)) + ∑ i : Fin n, f (oddIndex n i)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.circuit_eval_of_matrix
statement:
theorem circuit_eval_of_matrix (C : TypedDAG ι κ) (A : Matrix κ ι ℂ)
    (hC : ∀ x, C.eval x = A.mulVec x) (x : Fin (Fintype.card ι) → ℂ) :
    C.circuit.eval x =
      (Matrix.reindex (Fintype.equivFin κ) (Fintype.equivFin ι) A).mulVec x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Cascade.q_constant
statement:
theorem q_constant (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (hM : IsUnit M) (k : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (CellPoly.ps ((CellPoly.b M C B D)^k)) ≠ 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.blockTrunc_smul_one
statement:
theorem blockTrunc_smul_one (t : ℕ) (q : PowerSeries ℂ) :
    blockTruncHom t (q • (1 : Matrix α α (PowerSeries ℂ))) =
      truncMatrix t q ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix α α ℂ)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CoefficientTime.scalar_correction
statement:
theorem scalar_correction
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (H : Matrix α α (PowerSeries ℂ))
    (E Q : Matrix α β (PowerSeries ℂ)) (q : PowerSeries ℂ)
    (hq : PowerSeries.constantCoeff q ≠ 0) (hQ : H*Q=q•E) (t : ℕ) :
    blockTruncHom t H * (truncMatrix t q⁻¹ ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix α α ℂ)) *
      coefficientColumns t Q = coefficientColumns t E

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.eliminate_series
statement:
theorem eliminate_series (H : Matrix α α (PowerSeries ℂ))
    (E Q : Matrix α β (PowerSeries ℂ)) (q : PowerSeries ℂ) (t : ℕ)
    (K : Matrix ((Fin t × α) ⊕ β) ((Fin t × α) ⊕ β) ℂ)
    (hK : IsUnit K) (hH : IsUnit (H.map PowerSeries.constantCoeff))
    (hdata : K.toBlocks₁₁=blockTruncHom t H)
    (hstate : K.toBlocks₁₂=coefficientColumns t E)
    (hq : PowerSeries.constantCoeff q ≠ 0) (hQ : H*Q=q•E) :
    p.value (blockTruncHom t H) ≤ p.value K +
      2*(Fintype.card α : ℝ)*p.value (truncMatrix t q⁻¹) +
      p.value (rectangularShear (coefficientColumns t Q))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.RadixTwo.exists_fft_dag
statement:
theorem exists_fft_dag (k : ℕ) (ω : ℂ) (hω : IsPrimitiveRoot ω (2^k)) :
    ∃ C : LinearDAG (2^k) (2^k), C.size ≤ 3*k*2^k ∧
      ∀ x, C.eval x = eval (2^k) ω x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.ScalarConvolution.diagonalDAG_eval
statement:
theorem diagonalDAG_eval {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m → ℂ) (x : Fin m → ℂ) :
    (diagonalDAG c).eval x = fun i => c i * x i

name: OAI.ExactFourier.ScalarConvolution.eval_padding
statement:
theorem eval_padding (t m : ℕ) (x : Fin t → ℂ) :
    (LinearDAG.wires (padIndex t m)).eval x = (padded x : Fin m → ℂ)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.ScalarConvolution.exists_truncation_dag
statement:
theorem exists_truncation_dag (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) (f : PowerSeries ℂ) :
    ∃ C : LinearDAG t t, C.size ≤ 52 * t * (Nat.log 2 t + 1) ∧
      ∀ x, C.eval x = (truncMatrix t f).mulVec x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.ScalarConvolution.ofFn_padded
statement:
theorem ofFn_padded {t m : ℕ} (htm : t ≤ m) (x : Fin t → ℂ) :
    Polynomial.ofFn m (padded x) = Polynomial.ofFn t x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.ScalarConvolution.truncMatrix_inv
statement:
theorem truncMatrix_inv (t : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries ℂ)
    (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f ≠ 0) :
    (truncMatrix t f)⁻¹ = truncMatrix t f⁻¹

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Boundary.boundary_difference
statement:
theorem boundary_difference (ℓ f : ℂ[X]) (b : ℕ) :
    (f * X ^ b) %ₘ ℓ - f * X ^ b = -ℓ * ((f * X ^ b) /ₘ ℓ)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Boundary.coeff_trunc_mul_series
statement:
theorem coeff_trunc_mul_series (t : ℕ) (η V : PowerSeries ℂ) (a : Fin t) :
    PowerSeries.coeff a.val (((PowerSeries.trunc t η : ℂ[X]) : PowerSeries ℂ) * V) =
      PowerSeries.coeff a.val (η*V)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Boundary.prefix_quotient_zero
statement:
theorem prefix_quotient_zero (ℓ f : ℂ[X]) (hℓ : ℓ.Monic)
    {d t b : ℕ} (ht : ℓ.natDegree = t) (hf : f.natDegree ≤ d) (hb : b + d < t) :
    (f * X ^ b) /ₘ ℓ = 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Boundary.prefix_scalar_cancels
statement:
theorem prefix_scalar_cancels {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (t T : ℕ) (f η : PowerSeries ℂ) (hfη : f*η=1)
    (V : Matrix ι κ (PowerSeries ℂ)) (a : Fin t × ι) (b : κ) :
    ((prefixScalar t T f ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ)) *
      coefficientColumns t (η • V)) a b =
        if a.1.val < T then PowerSeries.coeff a.1.val (V a.2 b)
        else PowerSeries.coeff a.1.val (η * V a.2 b)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Boundary.quotientColumns_prefix_zero
statement:
theorem quotientColumns_prefix_zero {ι : Type} (t d : ℕ) (ℓ : ℂ[X])
    (hℓ : ℓ.Monic) (ht : ℓ.natDegree=t) (G : Matrix ι ι ℂ[X])
    (hG : ∀ i j, (G i j).natDegree ≤ d) (i : ι) (b : Fin t × ι)
    (hb : b.1.val < t-d) : quotientColumns t ℓ G i b = 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Boundary.quotientLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientLinear_apply (ℓ : ℂ[X]) (hℓ : ℓ.Monic) (f : ℂ[X]) :
    quotientLinear ℓ hℓ f = f /ₘ ℓ

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Boundary.quotient_degree_lt
statement:
theorem quotient_degree_lt (ℓ f : ℂ[X]) (hℓ : ℓ.Monic)
    {d t b : ℕ} (ht : ℓ.natDegree = t) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hf : f.natDegree ≤ d) (hb : b < t) :
    ((f * X ^ b) /ₘ ℓ).natDegree < d

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Boundary.seriesMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem seriesMatrix_apply {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (G : Matrix ι ι ℂ[X]) (i j : ι) : seriesMatrix G i j = (G i j : PowerSeries ℂ)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Boundary.supported_identity_decomposition
statement:
theorem supported_identity_decomposition {κ : Type} [DecidableEq κ]
    (S : κ → Prop) [DecidablePred S] (L : Matrix κ κ ℂ)
    (hrow : ∀ i j, ¬S i → L i j = 0)
    (hcol : ∀ i j, ¬S j → L i j = 0) :
    (1 + L).submatrix (Equiv.sumCompl S) (Equiv.sumCompl S) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (1 + L.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val)
        (0 : Matrix {i // S i} {i // ¬S i} ℂ) 0 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Boundary.weightedCorrection_prefix_zero
statement:
theorem weightedCorrection_prefix_zero {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (η ℓ : ℂ[X]) (hℓ : ℓ.Monic) (J G : Matrix ι ι ℂ[X]) {d t b : ℕ}
    (ht : ℓ.natDegree = t) (hG : ∀ u v, (G u v).natDegree ≤ d)
    (hb : b+d < t) : weightedCorrection η ℓ J G b = 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Boundary.weightedCorrection_series
statement:
theorem weightedCorrection_series {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (t : ℕ) (η ℓ : ℂ[X]) (J G : Matrix ι ι ℂ[X])
    (i : ι) (b : Fin t × ι) :
    (((weightedCorrection η ℓ J G b.1.val) i b.2 : ℂ[X]) : PowerSeries ℂ) =
      (η : PowerSeries ℂ) * (seriesMatrix J * quotientColumns t ℓ G) i b

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Boundary.card_times
statement: theorem card_times (t d e : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Times t d e) ≤ e+2*d

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.submatrix_equiv
statement:
theorem submatrix_equiv (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) (e f : κ ≃ ι) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_addIdentity
statement:
theorem eval_addIdentity [DecidableEq ι] (C : TypedDAG ι ι) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hC : ∀ x, C.eval x=A.mulVec x) (x : ι → ℂ) :
    C.addIdentity.eval x=(1+A).mulVec x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.eval_weightedBlocks
statement:
theorem eval_weightedBlocks (W : Matrix α (β × γ) ℂ) (C : γ → TypedDAG ι ι)
    (G : γ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hC : ∀ g x, (C g).eval x = (G g).mulVec x) (x : β × ι → ℂ) :
    (weightedBlocks W C).eval x = (blockMatrix W G).mulVec x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.size_addIdentity
statement:
@[simp] theorem size_addIdentity (C : TypedDAG ι ι) :
    C.addIdentity.size=C.size+Fintype.card ι

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TypedDAG.size_weightedBlocks
statement:
theorem size_weightedBlocks (W : Matrix α (β × γ) ℂ) (C : γ → TypedDAG ι ι) :
    (weightedBlocks W C).size = Fintype.card β * (∑ g, (C g).size) +
      2*Fintype.card ι*Fintype.card α*Fintype.card β*Fintype.card γ

name: OAI.ExactFourier.extendInjection_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendInjection_inl {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (f : κ → ι) (hf : Function.Injective f) (j : κ) :
    extendInjection f hf (Sum.inl j) = f j

name: OAI.ExactFourier.fixed_price_of_cascade

theorem fixed_price_of_cascade (x y C : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ k t : ℕ, 0 < k → 0 < t →
      (t:ℝ)*k*(x-y) ≤ C*((t:ℝ)*Real.log (2*t)+(k+1:ℝ)^3)) : x ≤ y

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Boundary.exists_uniform_active_dag
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_active_dag (G J : Matrix α α (Polynomial ℂ))
    (dg dj : ℕ) (hG : Bounded G dg) (hJ : Bounded J dj) :
    ∃ A : ℕ, ∀ k t : ℕ, ∀ η ℓ : Polynomial ℂ, ℓ.Monic →
      ∃ C : TypedDAG (Times t (k*dg) (k*dj) × Space α k) (Times t (k*dg) (k*dj) × Space α k),
        C.size ≤ A*(k+1)^6*Fintype.card α^k ∧
        ∀ x, C.eval x=(activeMatrix t (k*dg) (k*dj) η ℓ (power J k) (power G k)).mulVec x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.conjugate_le
statement:
theorem conjugate_le (p : MatrixPrice) (P A : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hP : IsUnit P) (hA : IsUnit A) :
    p.value (P*A*P⁻¹) ≤ 2*p.value P+p.value A

name: OAI.ExactFourier.MatrixPrice.le_conjugate
statement:
theorem le_conjugate (p : MatrixPrice) (P A : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hP : IsUnit P) (hA : IsUnit A) :
    p.value A ≤ 2*p.value P+p.value (P*A*P⁻¹)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.ScalarConvolution.exists_prefix_dag
statement:
theorem exists_prefix_dag (t T : ℕ) (ht : 0<t) (f : PowerSeries ℂ) :
    ∃ C : LinearDAG t t, C.size ≤ 52*t*(Nat.log 2 t+1) ∧
      ∀ x, C.eval x=(prefixScalar t T f).mulVec x

name: OAI.ExactFourier.ScalarConvolution.prefix_inv
statement:
theorem prefix_inv (t T : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries ℂ)
    (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f ≠ 0) :
    (prefixScalar t T f)⁻¹=prefixScalar t T f⁻¹

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.adjugate_eq_det_smul_inv
statement:
theorem adjugate_eq_det_smul_inv (A : Matrix β β ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) :
    A.adjugate=A.det•A⁻¹

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.eval_F
statement:
theorem eval_F
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (s : ℂ)
    (hD : IsUnit (1-s•D)) :
    (F M C B D).map (evalRingHom s)=(a D).eval s • feedback M C B D s

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.eval_R
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_R (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (s : ℂ) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CellPoly.eval_Z

    {β : Type} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (s : ℂ) :

theorem pair_layer (p : MatrixPrice) (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hA : IsUnit A) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.cell_eq
statement:
theorem cell_eq (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (b : ℂ) :
    cell A C B D b=side (Q b)*middle A C B D*side (P b)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.cell_feedback
statement:
theorem cell_feedback
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (b : ℂ) (hb : b≠0) (hD : IsUnit D) :
    CellPoly.feedback (data A C B D b) (co C D b) (bo B D b) (state D b) 1=
      matrix A C B D

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.cell_price
statement:
theorem cell_price (p : MatrixPrice) (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (b : ℂ) (hb : b≠1)
    (hK : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks A C B D)) :
    p.value (cell A C B D b)≤p.value (Matrix.fromBlocks A C B D)+4*Fintype.card β

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.cell_unit
statement:
theorem cell_unit (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (b : ℂ) (hb : b≠1)
    (hK : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks A C B D)) : IsUnit (cell A C B D b)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.choose_data
statement:
theorem choose_data (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)

    (hK : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks A C B D)) :
    ∃ b : ℂ,b≠0 ∧ b≠1 ∧ IsUnit (data A C B D b)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.denominator
statement:
theorem denominator
    {β : Type} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (b : ℂ) : 1-(1 : ℂ)•state D b=b•D

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.factor
statement:
theorem factor (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) :
    matrix A C B D=Matrix.fromBlocks A C 0 (1 : Matrix β β ℂ)*
      Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α ℂ) 0 (-D⁻¹*B) D⁻¹

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.involutive
statement:
theorem involutive
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (hD : IsUnit D) :
    matrix (A-C*D⁻¹*B) (C*D⁻¹) (-D⁻¹*B) D⁻¹=Matrix.fromBlocks A C B D

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.middle_eq
statement:
theorem middle_eq
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) :
    middle A C B D=Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 (1 : Matrix β β ℂ))
      (Matrix.fromRows C 0) (Matrix.fromCols B 0) D

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.schur_unit
statement:
theorem schur_unit (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (hD : IsUnit D)
    (hK : IsUnit (Matrix.fromBlocks A C B D)) : IsUnit (A-C*D⁻¹*B)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.side_eq
statement:
theorem side_eq
    {α : Type} {β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (L : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    side (α := α) (β := β) L=
      Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α ℂ) 0 0 (L 0 0•1))
        (Matrix.fromRows 0 (L 0 1•1)) (Matrix.fromCols 0 (L 1 0•1)) (L 1 1•1)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.side_price

theorem side_price (p : MatrixPrice) (L : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hL : IsUnit L) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.side_unit
statement:
theorem side_unit (L : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hL : IsUnit L) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.solve
statement:
theorem solve (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)
    (B : Matrix β α ℂ) (D : Matrix β β ℂ) (hD : IsUnit D) :
    matrix A C B D*Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α ℂ) 0 B D=
      Matrix.fromBlocks A C 0 (1 : Matrix β β ℂ)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Pivot.unit
statement:
theorem unit (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (C : Matrix α β ℂ)

statement:
theorem reindex_sum
    {α : Type} {β : Type} {γ : Type} {δ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] [Fintype δ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] [DecidableEq δ] (e : α≃β) (f : γ≃δ) (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (N : Matrix γ γ ℂ) :
 Matrix.reindex (e.sumCongr f) (e.sumCongr f) (Matrix.fromBlocks M 0 0 N)=
 Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.reindex e e M) 0 0 (Matrix.reindex f f N)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.reindex_tensor
statement:
theorem reindex_tensor
    {α : Type} {β : Type} {γ : Type} {δ : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] [Fintype δ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ] [DecidableEq δ] (e : α≃β) (f : γ≃δ) (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (N : Matrix γ γ ℂ) :
 Matrix.reindex (e.prodCongr f) (e.prodCongr f) (Matrix.kronecker M N)=
 Matrix.kronecker (Matrix.reindex e e M) (Matrix.reindex f f N)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.Step.decompose

    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {A : (t : τ) → Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} {α : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (s : Step D A α) :
