statement:
theorem coloredBlock_on
    {τ : Type} {π : Type} {ρ : Type} [Fintype π] [Fintype ρ] [DecidableEq π] [DecidableEq ρ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {A : (t : τ) → Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} (u : π→τ) (v : ρ→τ) (e : π≃ρ) (he : ∀ p,u p=v (e p))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.assemble_slot
statement:
theorem assemble_slot (k : τ→ℕ) (S : ∀ p,Step D A (β p))
    (hc : ∀ t,Fintype.card {p // (S p).kind=some t}=k t)
    (hw : Fintype.card (ActiveSpace D k ⊕ ν)≤Fintype.card (Σ p,β p)) :
    ∃ (M : Matrix (Σ p,β p) (Σ p,β p) ℂ) (e : ActiveSpace D k ⊕ ν ↪ (Σ p,β p)),
      MonomialMatrix M ∧ Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun p=>(S p).matrix)=
        M*Embedded.matrix e (inventoryWithIdentity (A := A) (ν := ν) k)

statement:

 (∑ t,p t*((c.delta t : ℤ) : ℝ))≤0 ↔ pairPrice (D := D) p c.pair≤c.word.weight p

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.gather_active
statement:
theorem gather_active (k : τ→ℕ) (S : ∀ p,Step D A (β p))
    (hc : ∀ t,Fintype.card {p // (S p).kind=some t}=k t) :
    ∃ e : ActiveSpace D k ↪ (Σ p,β p),
      Embedded.matrix e (inventoryMatrix (A := A) k)=
        Embedded.matrix (Embedded.sigmaEmbed (fun p=>(S p).activeTuple))
          (Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun p=>optionalMatrix A (S p).kind))

theorem layer_decompose (S : ∀ p,Step D A (β p)) :
    Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun p=>(S p).matrix)=
      Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun p=>(S p).monoPart)*
      Embedded.matrix (Embedded.sigmaEmbed (fun p=>(S p).activeTuple))
        (Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun p=>optionalMatrix A (S p).kind))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.PairComparison.rename_ineq
statement:
@[simp] theorem PairComparison.rename_ineq (f : τ→σ) (e : ∀ t,D t≃E (f t))
 (he : ∀ t,Matrix.reindex (e t) (e t) (A t)=B (f t)) (c : PairComparison (A := A)) (v : σ→ℝ) :
 (pairPrice (D := E) v (c.rename f e he).pair≤(c.rename f e he).word.weight v) ↔

statement:
theorem Word.continuous_weight {τ : Type} {D : τ→Type}
 [∀ t,Fintype (D t)] [∀ t,DecidableEq (D t)]
 {A : ∀ t,Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} {α : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.familyMultiplicity_key
statement:
theorem familyMultiplicity_key
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {A : (t : τ) → Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} {ρ : Type} [Fintype ρ] [DecidableEq ρ] (c : ρ→PairComparison (A := A)) (n : LivePair τ→ℕ) (a : ρ→ℕ)
 (h : ∀ p,(∑ r,if (c r).pair=p then a r else 0)≤n p) (s : LivePair τ) :
 (∑ p,if familyKey c p=s then familyMultiplicity c n a p else 0)=n s

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.familyMultiplicity_scale
statement:
theorem familyMultiplicity_scale
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {A : (t : τ) → Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} {ρ : Type} [Fintype ρ] [DecidableEq ρ] (c : ρ→PairComparison (A := A))
 (n : LivePair τ→ℕ) (a : ρ→ℕ) (u : ℕ) (p : LivePair τ⊕ρ) :
 familyMultiplicity c (fun p=>n p*u) (fun r=>a r*u) p=familyMultiplicity c n a p*u

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.familyProgram_matrix
statement:
theorem familyProgram_matrix
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {A : (t : τ) → Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} {ρ : Type} [Fintype ρ] [DecidableEq ρ] (c : ρ→PairComparison (A := A)) (p : LivePair τ⊕ρ) :
 (familyProgram c p).matrix (A := A)=pairMatrix (A := A) (familyKey c p)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.family_cast_matrix
statement:
theorem family_cast_matrix
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] (f : τ → ExactFourier.Packing.GMatrix) {t u : τ} (h : t=u) :
 Matrix.reindex (Equiv.cast (congrArg (fun t=>(f t).domain) h))
  (Equiv.cast (congrArg (fun t=>(f t).domain) h)) (f t).mat=(f u).mat

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.family_saving
statement:
theorem family_saving
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {A : (t : τ) → Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} {ρ : Type} [Fintype ρ] [DecidableEq ρ] (c : ρ→PairComparison (A := A)) (n : LivePair τ→ℕ) (a : ρ→ℕ)
 (h : ∀ p,(∑ r,if (c r).pair=p then a r else 0)≤n p) (t : τ) :
 (∑ p,(n p : ℤ)*pairBaseline (D := D) p t)-
 (∑ p,(familyMultiplicity c n a p : ℤ)*(familyProgram c p).types.count t)=
 ∑ r,(a r : ℤ)*(c r).delta t

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.family_total_scale
statement:
theorem family_total_scale (c : ρ→PairComparison (A := A))
 (n : LivePair τ→ℕ) (a : ρ→ℕ) (u : ℕ) (t : τ) :
 (∑ p,familyMultiplicity c (fun p=>n p*u) (fun r=>a r*u) p*(familyProgram c p).types.count t)=
 (∑ p,familyMultiplicity c n a p*(familyProgram c p).types.count t)*u

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.framedLayer_product

 ∃ (M : Matrix (Σ p,β p) (Σ p,β p) ℂ) (e : ActiveSpace D k ⊕ ν ↪ (Σ p,β p)),
 MonomialMatrix M ∧ Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun p=>slotMatrix (A := A) (S p))=
   M*Embedded.matrix e (inventoryWithIdentity (A := A) (ν := ν) k)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.pairEquiv_matrix
statement:
theorem pairEquiv_matrix (f : τ→σ) (e : ∀ t,D t≃E (f t))
 (he : ∀ t,Matrix.reindex (e t) (e t) (A t)=B (f t)) (p : LivePair τ) :
 Matrix.reindex (pairEquiv f e p) (pairEquiv f e p) (pairMatrix (A := A) p)=
 pairMatrix (A := B) (mapPair f p)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.pairPrice_map
statement:
theorem pairPrice_map
    {τ : Type} {σ : Type} {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {E : σ → Type} [(t : σ) → Fintype (E t)] [(t : σ) → DecidableEq (E t)] (f : τ→σ) (e : ∀ t,D t≃E (f t)) (v : σ→ℝ) (p : LivePair τ) :
 pairPrice (D := E) v (mapPair f p)=pairPrice (D := D) (v∘f) p

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.pair_baseline_sum
statement:
theorem pair_baseline_sum
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] (k : τ→ℕ) (I : ℕ) (t : τ) :
 (∑ p : LivePair τ,speciesCopies k I p.1.1*speciesCopies k I p.1.2*
    pairBaseline (D := D) p t)=2*k t*((∑ i,k i*Fintype.card (D i))+I)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.slotMatrix_extend
statement:
theorem slotMatrix_extend
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {A : (t : τ) → Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} {α : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (W : FramedWord D α) {T : ℕ} (time : Fin W.frames.length→Fin T)
 (ht : Function.Injective time) (t : Fin T) :
 slotMatrix (A := A) (framedSlot W time t)=
   Function.extend time (fun i=>(W.frames.get i).matrix (A := A)) (fun _=>1) t

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.slotMatrix_product
statement:
theorem slotMatrix_product (W : FramedWord D α) {T : ℕ} (time : Fin W.frames.length→Fin T)
 (ht : StrictMono time) :
 (List.ofFn (fun t=>slotMatrix (A := A) (framedSlot W time t))).prod * W.tail=W.matrix (A := A)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.slotMono_monomial
statement:
theorem slotMono_monomial
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {α : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (f : Option (Frame D α)) : MonomialMatrix (slotMono f)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.speciesEquiv_matrix
statement:
theorem speciesEquiv_matrix
    {τ : Type} {σ : Type} {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {A : (t : τ) → Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} {E : σ → Type} [(t : σ) → Fintype (E t)] [(t : σ) → DecidableEq (E t)] {B : (t : σ) → Matrix (E t) (E t) ℂ} (f : τ→σ) (e : ∀ t,D t≃E (f t))
 (he : ∀ t,Matrix.reindex (e t) (e t) (A t)=B (f t)) (s : Option τ) :
 Matrix.reindex (speciesEquiv f e s) (speciesEquiv f e s) (speciesMatrix (A := A) s)=
 speciesMatrix (A := B) (s.map f)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.card_subtype_sigma
OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.exists_dummy_framed
statement:
theorem exists_dummy_framed (W : ∀ t,FramedWord D (D t))
 (hW : ∀ t (o : Fin (W t).frames.length),((W t).frames.get o).type=t)
 {T : ℕ} (c : τ→Fin T→ℕ) (k d : τ→ℕ)
 (hc : ∀ t s,c t s≤k t) (hkd : ∀ t,k t<d t)
 (hsum : ∀ t,∑ s,c t s=d t*(W t).frames.length) :
 ∃ time : ∀ v : Σ t,Fin (d t),Fin (W v.1).frames.length→Fin T,
 (∀ v,StrictMono (time v)) ∧ ∀ s t,
 Fintype.card {v : Σ t,Fin (d t) //
   (slotCall (A := A) (framedSlot (W v.1) (time v) s)).kind=some t}=c t s

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.exists_dummy_schedule
statement:
theorem exists_dummy_schedule {T d h k : ℕ} (c : Fin T→ℕ)
 (hc : ∀ t,c t≤k) (hkd : k<d) (hsum : ∑ t,c t=d*h) :
 ∃ time : Fin d→Fin h→Fin T,(∀ j,StrictMono (time j)) ∧
   ∀ t,Fintype.card {v : Fin d×Fin h // time v.1 v.2=t}=c t

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.framedSlot_type
statement:
theorem framedSlot_type
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {A : (t : τ) → Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} {α : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (W : FramedWord D α) {T : ℕ}
 (time : Fin W.frames.length→Fin T) (ht : Function.Injective time) (s : Fin T) (t : τ) :
 (slotCall (A := A) (framedSlot W time s)).kind=some t ↔
   ∃ i,time i=s ∧ (W.frames.get i).type=t

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.monotone_fiber_gap
OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.occurrence_card
statement:
theorem occurrence_card {m F o t : ℕ} :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin m => cyclicStart F j + o = t)).card ≤ m / F + 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.occurrence_card_real
statement:
theorem occurrence_card_real {m F o t : ℕ} (hF : 0 < F) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin m => cyclicStart F j + o = t)).card : ℝ) ≤
      (m : ℝ) / F + 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.pack_list
statement:
theorem pack_list (J : Matrix γ γ ℂ) (L : List (Matrix α α ℂ))
 (hL : ∀ B∈L,∃ (M : Matrix α α ℂ) (e : γ↪α),MonomialMatrix M ∧ B=M*Embedded.matrix e J) :
 ∃ W : Word (fun _ : Unit=>γ) (fun _=>J) α,W.matrix=L.prod ∧ W.calls.length=L.length

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.packed_schedule
statement:
theorem packed_schedule (k : τ→ℕ) (W : ∀ p,FramedWord D (β p)) {T : ℕ}
 (time : ∀ p,Fin (W p).frames.length→Fin T) (ht : ∀ p,StrictMono (time p))
 (hc : ∀ s t,Fintype.card {p // (slotCall (A := A) (framedSlot (W p) (time p) s)).kind=some t}=k t)
 (hw : Fintype.card (ActiveSpace D k ⊕ ν)≤Fintype.card (Σ p,β p)) :
 ∃ V : Word (fun _ : Unit=>ActiveSpace D k ⊕ ν)
   (fun _=>inventoryWithIdentity (A := A) (ν := ν) k) (Σ p,β p),
 V.matrix=Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun p=>(W p).matrix (A := A)) ∧ V.calls.length=T

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.same_remainder_card
statement:
theorem same_remainder_card {m F : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin m))
    (hS : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, i.val % F = j.val % F) : S.card ≤ m / F + 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.schedule_in_range
statement:
theorem schedule_in_range {F L m : ℕ} (hF : 0 < F) (j : Fin m) (o : Fin L) :
    cyclicStart F j + o.val < F + L - 1

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.schedule_strict
statement:
theorem schedule_strict {F m : ℕ} (j : Fin m) :
    StrictMono (fun o : ℕ => cyclicStart F j + o)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.scheduledLoad_bound
statement:
theorem scheduledLoad_bound (P : π → List τ) (m : π → ℕ) (F : ℕ) (hF : 0 < F)
    (i : τ) (t : ℕ) :
    (scheduledLoad P m F i t : ℝ) ≤ (totalCalls P m i : ℝ) / F + ∑ p, ((P p).length : ℝ)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.scheduledLoad_capacity
statement:
theorem scheduledLoad_capacity (P : π → List τ) (m : π → ℕ) (F : ℕ) (hF : 0 < F)
    (capacity : τ → ℕ) (hmargin : ∀ i : τ,
      (totalCalls P m i : ℝ) / F + ∑ p, ((P p).length : ℝ) ≤ capacity i) :
    ∀ (i : τ) (t : ℕ), scheduledLoad P m F i t ≤ capacity i

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.slot_card
statement:
theorem slot_card
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {A : (t : τ) → Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} {π : Type} [Fintype π] [DecidableEq π] {β : π → Type} [(p : π) → Fintype (β p)] [(p : π) → DecidableEq (β p)] (W : ∀ p,FramedWord D (β p)) {T : ℕ}
 (time : ∀ p,Fin (W p).frames.length→Fin T) (ht : ∀ p,Function.Injective (time p))
 (s : Fin T) (t : τ) :
 Fintype.card {p // (slotCall (A := A) (framedSlot (W p) (time p) s)).kind=some t}=
 Fintype.card {v : Σ p,Fin (W p).frames.length //
   time v.1 v.2=s ∧ ((W v.1).frames.get v.2).type=t}

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.vacancy_listing
statement:
theorem vacancy_listing {T n : ℕ} (c : Fin T→ℕ) (hn : ∑ t,c t=n) :
 ∃ f : Fin n→Fin T,Monotone f ∧ (∀ t,Fintype.card {i // f i=t}=c t)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.complete_and_pack
statement:
theorem complete_and_pack (k : τ→ℕ) (W : ∀ p,FramedWord D (β p))
 (dummy : ∀ t,FramedWord D (D t))
 (hdummy : ∀ t,(dummy t).matrix (A := A)=1)
 (hdtype : ∀ t (o : Fin (dummy t).frames.length),((dummy t).frames.get o).type=t)
 {T : ℕ} (time : ∀ p,Fin (W p).frames.length→Fin T)
 (htime : ∀ p,StrictMono (time p))
 (hload : ∀ s t,Fintype.card {p //
   (slotCall (A := A) (framedSlot (W p) (time p) s)).kind=some t}≤k t)
 (d : τ→ℕ) (hkd : ∀ t,k t<d t)
 (hdef : ∀ t,k t*T-(∑ p,(W p).types.count t)=d t*(dummy t).frames.length)
 (R : ℕ) (hR : ∑ t,d t*Fintype.card (D t)≤R)
 (hw : Fintype.card (ActiveSpace D k ⊕ ν)≤Fintype.card (Σ p,β p)+R) :
 ∃ V : Word (fun _ : Unit=>ActiveSpace D k ⊕ ν)
   (fun _=>inventoryWithIdentity (A := A) (ν := ν) k) ((Σ p,β p)⊕Fin R),
 V.matrix=Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun p=>(W p).matrix (A := A))) 0 0 1 ∧
 V.calls.length=T

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.cyclicTime_strict
statement:
theorem cyclicTime_strict
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {π : Type} [Fintype π] [DecidableEq π] {β : π → Type} [(p : π) → Fintype (β p)] [(p : π) → DecidableEq (β p)] (W : ∀ p,FramedWord D (β p)) (m : π→ℕ) (F L : ℕ)
 (hF : 0<F) (hL : ∀ p,(W p).frames.length≤L) (v : Σ p,Fin (m p)) :
 StrictMono (cyclicTime W m F L hF hL v)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.cyclic_slot_bound
statement:
theorem cyclic_slot_bound (W : ∀ p,FramedWord D (β p)) (m : π→ℕ) (F L : ℕ)
 (hF : 0<F) (hL : ∀ p,(W p).frames.length≤L) (s : Fin (F+L-1)) (t : τ) :
 (Fintype.card {v : Σ p,Fin (m p) //
   (slotCall (A := A) (framedSlot (W v.1) (cyclicTime W m F L hF hL v) s)).kind=some t} : ℝ)≤
 (∑ p,m p*(W p).types.count t : ℕ)/ (F : ℝ)+∑ p,((W p).frames.length : ℝ)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.cyclic_slot_card
statement:
theorem cyclic_slot_card (W : ∀ p,FramedWord D (β p)) (m : π→ℕ) (F L : ℕ)
 (hF : 0<F) (hL : ∀ p,(W p).frames.length≤L) (s : Fin (F+L-1)) (t : τ) :
 Fintype.card {v : Σ p,Fin (m p) //
   (slotCall (A := A) (framedSlot (W v.1) (cyclicTime W m F L hF hL v) s)).kind=some t}=
 scheduledLoad (fun p=>(W p).types) m F t s.val

    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] (D : τ → Type) [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {A : (t : τ) → Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] : (emptyFramed D α).matrix (A := A)=1

theorem emptyTime_strict
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] (D : τ → Type) [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (T : ℕ) : StrictMono (emptyTime D α T)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.empty_slot_card
statement:
@[simp] theorem empty_slot_card
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] (D : τ → Type) [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {A : (t : τ) → Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (T : ℕ) (s : Fin T) (t : τ) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.list_card_get

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.list_count_get
statement:
theorem list_count_get {τ : Type} [DecidableEq τ] (L : List τ) (t : τ) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.matrix_sumFramed
statement:
theorem matrix_sumFramed
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {A : (t : τ) → Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} {π : Type} {ρ : Type} [Fintype π] [Fintype ρ] [DecidableEq π] [DecidableEq ρ] {β : π → Type} {γ : ρ → Type} [(p : π) → Fintype (β p)] [(p : π) → DecidableEq (β p)] [(r : ρ) → Fintype (γ r)] [(r : ρ) → DecidableEq (γ r)] (W : ∀ p,FramedWord D (β p)) (V : ∀ r,FramedWord D (γ r)) :
 Matrix.reindex (Equiv.sumSigmaDistrib (SumDomain β γ)) (Equiv.sumSigmaDistrib (SumDomain β γ))
   (Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun v=>(sumFramed W V v).matrix (A := A)))=
 Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun p=>(W p).matrix (A := A))) 0 0
   (Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun r=>(V r).matrix (A := A)))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.slot_card_sum
statement:
theorem slot_card_sum (W : ∀ p,FramedWord D (β p)) {T : ℕ}
 (time : ∀ p,Fin (W p).frames.length→Fin T) (ht : ∀ p,Function.Injective (time p))
 (s : Fin T) (t : τ) :
 Fintype.card {p // (slotCall (A := A) (framedSlot (W p) (time p) s)).kind=some t}=
 ∑ p,∑ o : Fin (W p).frames.length,
   if time p o=s ∧ ((W p).frames.get o).type=t then 1 else 0

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.slot_card_total
statement:
theorem slot_card_total (W : ∀ p,FramedWord D (β p)) {T : ℕ}
 (time : ∀ p,Fin (W p).frames.length→Fin T) (ht : ∀ p,Function.Injective (time p)) (t : τ) :
 (∑ s : Fin T,Fintype.card {p // (slotCall (A := A) (framedSlot (W p) (time p) s)).kind=some t})=
 ∑ p,(W p).types.count t

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.sumTime_strict
statement:
theorem sumTime_strict
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {π : Type} {ρ : Type} [Fintype π] [Fintype ρ] [DecidableEq π] [DecidableEq ρ] {β : π → Type} {γ : ρ → Type} [(p : π) → Fintype (β p)] [(p : π) → DecidableEq (β p)] [(r : ρ) → Fintype (γ r)] [(r : ρ) → DecidableEq (γ r)] (W : ∀ p,FramedWord D (β p)) (V : ∀ r,FramedWord D (γ r)) {T : ℕ}
 (timeW : ∀ p,Fin (W p).frames.length→Fin T)
 (timeV : ∀ r,Fin (V r).frames.length→Fin T)
 (hW : ∀ p,StrictMono (timeW p)) (hV : ∀ r,StrictMono (timeV r)) :
 ∀ v,StrictMono (sumTime W V timeW timeV v)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.sum_slot_card
statement:
theorem sum_slot_card
    {τ : Type} [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq τ] {D : τ → Type} [(t : τ) → Fintype (D t)] [(t : τ) → DecidableEq (D t)] {A : (t : τ) → Matrix (D t) (D t) ℂ} {π : Type} {ρ : Type} [Fintype π] [Fintype ρ] [DecidableEq π] [DecidableEq ρ] {β : π → Type} {γ : ρ → Type} [(p : π) → Fintype (β p)] [(p : π) → DecidableEq (β p)] [(r : ρ) → Fintype (γ r)] [(r : ρ) → DecidableEq (γ r)] (W : ∀ p,FramedWord D (β p)) (V : ∀ r,FramedWord D (γ r)) {T : ℕ}
 (timeW : ∀ p,Fin (W p).frames.length→Fin T)
 (timeV : ∀ r,Fin (V r).frames.length→Fin T) (s : Fin T) (t : τ) :
 Fintype.card {v //
   (slotCall (A := A) (framedSlot (sumFramed W V v) (sumTime W V timeW timeV v) s)).kind=some t}=
 Fintype.card {p // (slotCall (A := A) (framedSlot (W p) (timeW p) s)).kind=some t}+
 Fintype.card {r // (slotCall (A := A) (framedSlot (V r) (timeV r) s)).kind=some t}

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.copies_equiv
statement:
theorem copies_equiv {κ : σ→Type} [∀ s,Fintype (κ s)] [∀ s,DecidableEq (κ s)]
 (key : π→σ) (m : π→ℕ)
 (h : ∀ s,(∑ p,if key p=s then m p else 0)=Fintype.card (κ s)) :
 ∃ e : (Σ v : Σ p,Fin (m p),E (key v.1))≃(Σ v : Σ s,κ s,E v.1),
 Matrix.reindex e e (Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun v : Σ p,Fin (m p)=>B (key v.1)))=
   Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun v : Σ s,κ s=>B v.1)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.copyCoordinates_matrix
statement:
theorem copyCoordinates_matrix
    {σ : Type} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {E : σ → Type} [(s : σ) → Fintype (E s)] [(s : σ) → DecidableEq (E s)] {B : (s : σ) → Matrix (E s) (E s) ℂ} (κ : σ→Type) [∀ s,Fintype (κ s)] [∀ s,DecidableEq (κ s)] :
 Matrix.reindex (copyCoordinates (E := E) κ) (copyCoordinates κ)
   (Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun v : Σ s,κ s=>B v.1))=
 Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun s=>Matrix.kronecker (1 : Matrix (κ s) _ ℂ) (B s))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.copy_fiber_card

theorem copy_fiber_card
    {σ : Type} {π : Type} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [Fintype π] [DecidableEq π] (key : π→σ) (m : π→ℕ) (s : σ) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.embeddedCall_eq

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.family_square_win
statement:
theorem family_square_win (k : τ→ℕ) (I : ℕ)
 (key : π→LivePair τ) (W : ∀ p,FramedWord D (PairDomain D (key p))) (m : π→ℕ)
 (hW : ∀ p,(W p).matrix (A := A)=pairMatrix (A := A) (key p))
 (hnum : ∀ s,(∑ p,if key p=s then m p else 0)=
   speciesCopies k I s.1.1*speciesCopies k I s.1.2)
 (dummy : ∀ t,FramedWord D (D t))
 (hdummy : ∀ t,(dummy t).matrix (A := A)=1)
 (hdtype : ∀ t (o : Fin (dummy t).frames.length),((dummy t).frames.get o).type=t)

   (slotCall (A := A) (framedSlot (W v.1) (time v) s)).kind=some t}≤k t)
 (d : τ→ℕ) (hkd : ∀ t,k t<d t)
 (hdef : ∀ t,k t*T-(∑ p,m p*(W p).types.count t)=d t*(dummy t).frames.length)

 (hJ : IsUnit (inventoryWithIdentity (A := A) (ν := Fin I) k))

 (hT : T<2*Fintype.card (ActiveSpace D k⊕Fin I)) : FiniteWinStatement

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.live_matrix_on
statement:
theorem live_matrix_on (k : τ→ℕ) (I : ℕ)
 (x y : LiveSpace D k I⊕(Fin I×Fin I)) :
 Matrix.kronecker (speciesInventory (speciesCopies k I) (speciesMatrix (A := A)))
   (speciesInventory (speciesCopies k I) (speciesMatrix (A := A)))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.live_matrix_reindex
statement:
theorem live_matrix_reindex (k : τ→ℕ) (I : ℕ) :

   (Matrix.fromBlocks (liveMatrix (A := A) k I) 0 0 (1 : Matrix (Fin I×Fin I) _ ℂ))=

   (speciesInventory (speciesCopies k I) (speciesMatrix (A := A)))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.singleStepFin_matrix
statement:
theorem singleStepFin_matrix (e : α≃Fin (Fintype.card α))
 (f : (α×α)≃Fin (Fintype.card α^2)) (A : Matrix α α ℂ)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.square_inventory_parameters
statement:
theorem square_inventory_parameters {K W G S h u L C : ℕ}
 (hK : 0<K) (hW : 0<W) (hh : 0<h)
 (hS : 2*K≤S) (hGS : G+S=2*K*W)
 (hdK : h∣K) (hdS : h∣S)
 (hu : L+2*C*W≤u) (huh : h<u) :
 let T := (2*W-1)*u
 let F := T+1-L
 0<F ∧ F+L-1=T ∧ T<2*(W*u) ∧
 (G*u^2 : ℝ)/(F : ℝ)+(C : ℝ)≤(K*u : ℕ) ∧
 ∃ d : ℕ,K*u<d ∧ K*u*T-G*u^2=d*h ∧ d≤K*u*T

 (hu0 : 0≤u) (hC : 0≤C) (hW : 0≤W)
 (hGF : G+S=2*K*W) (hF : F=(2*W-1)*u+1-L) (hFu : F≤2*W*u) :
 G*u^2+C*F≤K*u*F

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Packing.scalable_square_win
statement:
theorem scalable_square_win (hA : ∀ t,IsUnit (A t)) (k : τ→ℕ) (I : ℕ)
 (hk : ∀ t,0<k t) (anchor : τ) (hn : ¬MonomialMatrix (A anchor))
 (key : π→LivePair τ) (P : ∀ p,FramedWord D (PairDomain D (key p))) (m : π→ℕ)
 (hP : ∀ p,(P p).matrix (A := A)=pairMatrix (A := A) (key p))
 (hnum : ∀ s,(∑ p,if key p=s then m p else 0)=
   speciesCopies k I s.1.1*speciesCopies k I s.1.2)
 (dummy : ∀ t,FramedWord D (D t)) (hdpos : ∀ t,0<(dummy t).frames.length)
 (hdummy : ∀ t,(dummy t).matrix (A := A)=1)
 (hdtype : ∀ t (o : Fin (dummy t).frames.length),((dummy t).frames.get o).type=t)
 (S : τ→ℕ) (hS : ∀ t,2*k t≤S t)
 (hGS : ∀ t,(∑ p,m p*(P p).types.count t)+S t=
    2*k t*((∑ i,k i*Fintype.card (D i))+I))
 (hdK : ∀ t,(dummy t).frames.length∣k t) (hdS : ∀ t,(dummy t).frames.length∣S t)
 (hreservoir : 2*(∑ t,k t*Fintype.card (D t))*((∑ t,k t*Fintype.card (D t))+I)≤I^2) :
 FiniteWinStatement

    CellPoly.feedback ((e-t)•1) (1+e•A) ((2*e)•1) (1+e•A) (t/(e+t))=
      (e+t)•cayley A t

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CayleyLimit.denominator_factor
statement:
theorem denominator_factor (a : α → ℂ) (i : α) (hi : a i≠0) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CayleyLimit.denominator_zero

theorem difference_factor (U : Matrix α α ℂ) (hU : IsUnit U) (a : α → ℂ) :

      Similarity.conj U (Matrix.diagonal a)*Similarity.conj U (Matrix.diagonal (reciprocal a))

theorem eval_as_cayley (U : Matrix α α ℂ) (hU : IsUnit U) (a : α → ℂ)

    (hm : IsUnit (1-s⁻¹•Similarity.conj U (Matrix.diagonal a))) :
    (polynomial U a).map (evalRingHom s)=(denominator a).eval s•
      MatrixPrice.cayley (Similarity.conj U (Matrix.diagonal a)) s⁻¹

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CayleyLimit.eval_zero
statement:
theorem eval_zero (U : Matrix α α ℂ) (a : α → ℂ) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CayleyLimit.generic_units

theorem generic_units (U : Matrix α α ℂ) (hU : IsUnit U) (a : α → ℂ)

    IsUnit (1+s⁻¹•Similarity.conj U (Matrix.diagonal a)) ∧
    IsUnit (1-s⁻¹•Similarity.conj U (Matrix.diagonal a))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.CayleyLimit.numerator_zero

theorem numerator_zero (a : α → ℂ) (i : α) :

theorem relations (G J R T : Matrix α α ℂ) (M A : Matrix α α ℂ)

    (hs : A.IsSymm) (hk : A*(1+M)=0) (hp : A*(1+R)=0) (hm : 1-R=A*T) :
    M*(1+R)=1+R ∧ M.transpose*(1-R)=-(1-R)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.GraphReflection.block_relations
statement:
theorem block_relations (B E F G H : Matrix α α ℂ) (hB : IsUnit B)
    (hp : graph B*(1+Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H)=1+Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H)
    (hm : (graph B).transpose*(1-Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H)=-(1-Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H)) :
    B*G=1+E ∧ B*(1+H)=F ∧ B.transpose*F=1-H ∧ B.transpose*(1-E)=G

name: OAI.ExactFourier.GraphReflection.diagonalization
statement:
theorem diagonalization (B E F G H : Matrix α α ℂ) (hB : IsUnit B) (hG : IsUnit G)
    (h1 : B*G=1+E) (h2 : B*(1+H)=F) (h3 : B.transpose*F=1-H) (h4 : B.transpose*(1-E)=G) :
    hadamard*(swap*Pivot.matrix F E H G)*hadamard⁻¹=
      Matrix.fromBlocks B 0 0 (-B.transpose⁻¹)

    (hp : graph B*(1+Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H)=1+Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H)
    (hm : (graph B).transpose*(1-Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H)=-(1-Matrix.fromBlocks E F G H)) :
    IsUnit F ∧ IsUnit G

theorem power_group (A : Matrix α α ℂ) (b j : ℕ) :
 ∃ e : Space α (b*j)≃Space (Space α b) j,
 Matrix.reindex e e (power A (b*j))=power (power A b) j

name: OAI.ExactFourier.TensorAxis.power_reindex

 ∃ f : Space α k≃Space β k,Matrix.reindex f f (power M k)=power (Matrix.reindex e e M) k

 Matrix.reindex ((funCoordinates (α := Fin q) b).trans (tensorCoordinates q b).symm)
  ((funCoordinates (α := Fin q) b).trans (tensorCoordinates q b).symm) (power A b)=tensorPower A b

statement:
theorem recurrence_bound (f : ℕ→ℝ) {b : ℕ} {p g C₀ : ℝ}
 (hb : 2≤b) (hp : 0<p) (hp1 : p≤1) (hg : 0≤g) (hC₀ : 0≤C₀)
 (hs : g*(p/b)<1)
 (hf : ∀ k,f k≤C₀+g*avg p f (k/b) 0) :
 ∃ a C : ℝ,0<a ∧ a<1 ∧ 0<C ∧ ∀ k,f k≤C*(k+1 : ℝ)^a

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Amplification.tensor_amplification

 (hb : 2≤b) (W : List (WordStep A (q^b))) (hW : wordMatrix W=tensorPower A b)
 (hw : wordCalls W<b*q^(b-1)) :
 ∃ a C : ℝ,0<a ∧ a<1 ∧ 0<C ∧ ∀ k,
 (cost (power A k) : ℝ)≤C*(q : ℝ)^k*(k+1 : ℝ)^a

name: OAI.ExactFourier.PairFamily.split_blocks
statement:
theorem split_blocks (S : Set σ) [DecidablePred (·∈S)]
 (H : σ→Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
 Matrix.blockDiagonal' H=
 Embedded.matrix (subEmbedding S) (Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i : S=>H i)) *
 Embedded.matrix (subEmbedding Sᶜ) (Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i : (Sᶜ : Set σ)=>H i))

 Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i=>if i∈S then H i else 1)

theorem commutator_identity (G : Matrix α β ℂ) (H : Matrix β γ ℂ) :

 Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α ℂ) 0 0 (rectangularShear H) *
 rectangularShear (Matrix.fromCols (-G) (0 : Matrix α γ ℂ)) *
 Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α ℂ) 0 0 (rectangularShear (-H)) =
 rectangularShear (Matrix.fromCols (0 : Matrix α β ℂ) (G*H))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.compress_product
statement:
theorem compress_product {a b e n : ℕ} (ha : a≤n) (hb : b≤n) (he : e≤n)
 (M N : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :
 (M * Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin n=>if i.val<e then (1 : ℂ) else 0) * N).submatrix
  (initialEmbedding ha) (initialEmbedding hb)=
 (M.submatrix (initialEmbedding ha) (initialEmbedding he)) *
 (N.submatrix (initialEmbedding he) (initialEmbedding hb))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.initialEmbedding_val

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Displacement.all_chunks
statement:
theorem all_chunks (q p a e s c k : ℕ) (ha : a≤p*c) (he : e≤q*c)
 (hfft : 4*c≤2^k) (hspace : 2^k+2*c≤a+e+s)
 (M : ℕ→ℕ→ℂ) (v w : ℕ→ℂ)
 (hrec : ∀ i j,i+1<a → j+1<e → M (i+1) (j+1)=M i j+v (i+1)*w (j+1)) :
 Layered (Matrix.fromBlocks (rectangularShear (fun i : Fin a=>fun j : Fin e=>M i.val j.val))
  0 0 (1 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) ℂ)) (q*p*(768*k+384))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Displacement.convolution_submatrix
statement:
theorem convolution_submatrix (a e k : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (h : a+e ≤ 2^k) (haL : a ≤ 2^k) (heL : e ≤ 2^k)
 (v : Fin a→ℂ) :
 (convolutionMatrix k (Polynomial.ofFn a v)).submatrix (initialEmbedding haL) (initialEmbedding heL)=lower (extendVector v) a e

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Displacement.exact_width
statement:

 (hrec : ∀ i j,i+1<a → j+1<e → M (i+1) (j+1)=M i j+v (i+1)*w (j+1)) :

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Displacement.fullKernel_sumLayered

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Displacement.kernel_congr
statement:

 (hv : ∀ l, l ≤ i → v l=v' l) (hw : ∀ l, l ≤ j → w l=w' l) : kernel v w i j=kernel v' w' i j

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Displacement.kernel_eq_mul

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Displacement.kernel_restrict
statement:
theorem kernel_restrict (v w : ℕ→ℂ) (a e : ℕ) (i : Fin a) (j : Fin e) :

statement:

 (v : Fin a→ℂ) (w : Fin e→ℂ) :
 Layered (Matrix.fromBlocks (rectangularShear (fun i : Fin a=>fun j : Fin e=>kernel (extendVector v) (extendVector w) i.val j.val))
  0 0 (1 : Matrix (Fin (2^k)) (Fin (2^k)) ℂ)) (256*k+128)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Displacement.kernel_submatrix
statement:
theorem kernel_submatrix (a e k : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (he : 0 < e) (h : 2*(a+e) ≤ 2^k)
 (v : Fin a→ℂ) (w : Fin e→ℂ) :
 (fullKernel k a e v w).submatrix (initialEmbedding (by omega : a ≤ 2^k)) (initialEmbedding (by omega : e ≤ 2^k))=

name: OAI.ExactFourier.Displacement.reconstruct
statement:
theorem reconstruct (a e : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (he : 0 < e) (M : ℕ→ℕ→ℂ) (v w : ℕ→ℂ)
 (hrec : ∀ i j, i+1 < a → j+1 < e → M (i+1) (j+1)=M i j+v (i+1)*w (j+1)) :
 let row := fun j=>M 0 j-v 0*w j
 let col := fun i=>if i=0 then 0 else M i 0-v i*w 0
 ∀ i j, i < a → j < e → M i j=kernel v w i j+kernel delta row i j+kernel col delta i j

name: OAI.ExactFourier.ToeplitzLayers.cross_interior
statement:
theorem cross_interior (s a e i₀ j₀ : ℕ) (h g : ℕ→ℂ) (hi : s ≤ i₀) (hj : j₀+e ≤ s) :
 ∀ i j, i+1 < a → j+1 < e →
 cross s h g (i₀+(i+1)) (j₀+(j+1))=
 cross s h g (i₀+i) (j₀+j)+(-h (i₀+(i+1)-s))*g (s-(j₀+(j+1)))

statement:
theorem cross_layer (s a : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f≠0) :
 Layered (Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) ℂ) 0
  (lowerCross s a (PowerSeries.coeff · f) * (truncMatrix s f)⁻¹)
  (1 : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin a) ℂ)) (2097152*(Nat.log 2 (a+s)+1))

name: OAI.ExactFourier.ToeplitzLayers.cross_mul
statement:
theorem cross_mul (s a : ℕ) (h g : PowerSeries ℂ) :
 lowerCross s a (PowerSeries.coeff · h) * truncMatrix s g =
 (fun i : Fin a=>fun j : Fin s=>cross s (PowerSeries.coeff · h) (PowerSeries.coeff · g) (s+i.val) j.val)

name: OAI.ExactFourier.ToeplitzLayers.cross_succ
statement:
theorem cross_succ (s : ℕ) (h g : ℕ→ℂ) (i j : ℕ) (hi : s ≤ i) (hj : j+1 < s) :

statement:
lemma Eval.lift (f : R →+* S) (hf : ∀ x, IsUnit (f x) → IsUnit x)
    {c : ℚ →+* R} {X : Fin n → R} {h : Formula n} {a : S}
    (ha : Eval (f.comp c) (fun i => f (X i)) h a) :
    ∃ b : R, Eval c X h b ∧ f b = a

OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.Eval.unique
statement:
lemma Eval.unique {c : ℚ →+* R} {X : Fin n → R} {h : Formula n} {a b : R}

OAI.RationalHitting.NoncommBlocks.diag_unit_iff
statement:
lemma diag_unit_iff (A : Matrix ι ι R) (D : Matrix κ κ R) :
    IsUnit (fromBlocks A 0 0 D) ↔ IsUnit A ∧ IsUnit D

name: OAI.RationalHitting.NoncommBlocks.lower_unit
statement: lemma lower_unit (C : Matrix κ ι R) : IsUnit (fromBlocks (1 : Matrix ι ι R) 0 C (1 : Matrix κ κ R))

name: OAI.RationalHitting.NoncommBlocks.schur_factor
statement:
lemma schur_factor (A A' : Matrix ι ι R) (B : Matrix ι κ R) (C : Matrix κ ι R)
    (hAA' : A * A' = 1) (hA'A : A' * A = 1) :
    fromBlocks A B C 0 =
      fromBlocks 1 0 (C * A') 1 * fromBlocks A 0 0 (-C * A' * B) *
      fromBlocks 1 (A' * B) 0 1

name: OAI.RationalHitting.NoncommBlocks.schur_inverse
statement:
lemma schur_inverse (A A' : Matrix ι ι R) (B : Matrix ι κ R) (C : Matrix κ ι R)
    (a b : Matrix κ κ R) (hAA' : A * A' = 1) (hA'A : A' * A = 1)
    (ha : C * A' * B = a) (hab : a*b=1) (hba : b*a=1) :
    ∃ M : Matrix (ι ⊕ κ) (ι ⊕ κ) R,
      fromBlocks A B C 0 * M = 1 ∧ M * fromBlocks A B C 0 = 1 ∧
      matMul (matMul (fromCols (0 : Matrix κ ι R) (-1)) M)
        (fromRows (0 : Matrix ι κ R) (1 : Matrix κ κ R)) = b

name: OAI.RationalHitting.NoncommBlocks.schur_unit_iff
statement:
lemma schur_unit_iff (A A' : Matrix ι ι R) (B : Matrix ι κ R) (C : Matrix κ ι R)
    (hAA' : A * A' = 1) (hA'A : A' * A = 1) :
    IsUnit (fromBlocks A B C 0) ↔ IsUnit (C * A' * B)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.NoncommBlocks.upper_unit
statement: lemma upper_unit (B : Matrix ι κ R) : IsUnit (fromBlocks (1 : Matrix ι ι R) B 0 (1 : Matrix κ κ R))

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Affine.eval_constMatrix
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_constMatrix {ι κ : Type*} (c : ℚ →+* R) (X : Fin n → R)
    (A : Matrix ι κ ℚ) : (constMatrix A).map (eval c X) = A.map c

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Affine.eval_constant
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_constant (c : ℚ →+* R) (X : Fin n → R) (a : ℚ) :
    eval c X (constant a) = c a

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Affine.eval_variable
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_variable (c : ℚ →+* R) (X : Fin n → R) (i : Fin n) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Affine.homogeneous_one
statement:
lemma homogeneous_one (c : ℚ →+* R) (X : Fin n → R) (a : Form n) :
    homogeneous c (Fin.cases 1 X) a = eval c X a

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Affine.normalized
statement:
lemma normalized [Algebra ℚ R] (Z : Fin (n+1) → R) (u : R) (hu : Z 0*u=1)
    (a : Form n) :
    homogeneous (algebraMap ℚ R) Z a =
      Z 0 * eval (algebraMap ℚ R) (fun i => u * Z i.succ) a

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Affine.normalized_pencil
statement:
lemma normalized_pencil {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Algebra ℚ R]
    (L : Matrix ι ι (Form n)) (Z : Fin (n+1) → R) (u : R) (hu : Z 0*u=1) :
    L.map (homogeneous (algebraMap ℚ R) Z) =
      Matrix.scalar ι (Z 0) * L.map (eval (algebraMap ℚ R) (fun i => u*Z i.succ))

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Affine.normalized_pencil_unit
statement:
lemma normalized_pencil_unit {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Algebra ℚ R]
    (L : Matrix ι ι (Form n)) (Z : Fin (n+1) → R) (z : Rˣ) (hz : (z : R)=Z 0)
    (hL : IsUnit (L.map (homogeneous (algebraMap ℚ R) Z))) :
    IsUnit (L.map (eval (algebraMap ℚ R) (fun i => (↑z⁻¹ : R)*Z i.succ)))

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.Eval.augmented_isUnit_iff
statement:
lemma Eval.augmented_isUnit_iff {f : Formula n} {a : R} (ha : Eval c X f a) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.Eval.inverseNodes_units
statement:

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.Eval.realization
statement:
theorem Eval.realization {f : Formula n} {a : R} (ha : Eval c X f a) :
    ∃ M : Matrix f.Index f.Index R,
      realized c X f * M = 1 ∧ M * realized c X f = 1 ∧
      rowR c f * M * colR c f = scalar a

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.card_index
statement: lemma card_index (f : Formula n) : Fintype.card f.Index = f.size + 1

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.certificate_bounds
statement:
lemma certificate_bounds (f : Formula n) (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (hf : f.size ≤ s) :
    (certificates f).length ≤ s+1 ∧
      ∀ h ∈ certificates f, 0 < Fintype.card h.Index ∧ Fintype.card h.Index ≤ 2*s+1

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.certificates_iff
statement:
theorem certificates_iff (f : Formula n) :
    (∀ h ∈ certificates f, IsUnit (realized c X h)) ↔
      ∃ a, Eval c X f a ∧ IsUnit a

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.colR_add

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.colR_inv
statement: @[simp] lemma colR_inv (f : Formula n) : colR c (.inv f) = fromRows 0 1

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.colR_mul
statement: @[simp] lemma colR_mul (f g : Formula n) : colR c (.mul f g) = fromRows 0 (colR c g)

statement:
lemma eval_of_inverseNodes_units (f : Formula n)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.leaf_realization
statement:
lemma leaf_realization (a : R) :
    ∃ M : Matrix (Unit ⊕ Unit) (Unit ⊕ Unit) R,
      fromBlocks 1 (-scalar a) 0 1 * M = 1 ∧
      M * fromBlocks 1 (-scalar a) 0 1 = 1 ∧
      NoncommBlocks.matMul (NoncommBlocks.matMul (fromCols (1 : Matrix Unit Unit R) 0) M)
        (fromRows (0 : Matrix Unit Unit R) (1 : Matrix Unit Unit R)) = scalar a

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.realized_add
statement:
@[simp] lemma realized_add (f g : Formula n) : realized c X (.add f g) =

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.realized_inv
statement:

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.realized_mul
statement:

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.rowR_add

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.rowR_inv
statement: @[simp] lemma rowR_inv (f : Formula n) : rowR c (.inv f) = fromCols 0 (-1)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.rowR_mul
statement: @[simp] lemma rowR_mul (f g : Formula n) : rowR c (.mul f g) = fromCols (rowR c f) 0

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Formula.size_le_of_mem_inverseNodes

lemma size_le_of_mem_inverseNodes {f h : Formula n} (hh : h ∈ inverseNodes f) :

lemma basis_toMatrix_det_ne_zero {K M : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup M]

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.derivative_taylor
statement:
lemma derivative_taylor {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (a : K) (f : K[X]) :
    derivative (taylor a f) = taylor a (derivative f)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.exists_degree_echelon_family
statement:
lemma exists_degree_echelon_family {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (d : ℕ) (V : Submodule K K[X])
    (hV : ∀ f ∈ V, f ≠ 0 → f.natDegree < d) :
    ∃ (h : ℕ) (f : Fin h → K[X]), LinearIndependent K f ∧
      Submodule.span K (Set.range f) = V ∧
      Function.Injective (fun i => (f i).natDegree)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.exists_echelon_basis_at
statement:
lemma exists_echelon_basis_at {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (d : ℕ) (V : Submodule K K[X]) {h : ℕ} (b : Basis (Fin h) K V)
    (hV : ∀ f ∈ V, f ≠ 0 → f.natDegree < d) (a : K) :
    ∃ b' : Basis (Fin h) K V,
      Function.Injective (fun j => (b' j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity a)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.exists_order_echelon_basis
statement:
lemma exists_order_echelon_basis {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (d : ℕ) (V : Submodule K K[X]) {h : ℕ} (b : Basis (Fin h) K V)
    (hV : ∀ f ∈ V, f ≠ 0 → f.natDegree < d) :
    ∃ b' : Basis (Fin h) K V,
      Function.Injective (fun j => (b' j : K[X]).natTrailingDegree)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.exists_order_echelon_family
statement:
lemma exists_order_echelon_family {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (d : ℕ) (V : Submodule K K[X])
    (hV : ∀ f ∈ V, f ≠ 0 → f.natDegree < d) :
    ∃ (h : ℕ) (f : Fin h → K[X]), LinearIndependent K f ∧
      Submodule.span K (Set.range f) = V ∧
      Function.Injective (fun i => (f i).natTrailingDegree)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.iterate_derivative_taylor
statement:
lemma iterate_derivative_taylor {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (a : K)
    (f : K[X]) (r : ℕ) :
    derivative^[r] (taylor a f) = taylor a (derivative^[r] f)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.natDegree_scaled_derivative_le
statement:
lemma natDegree_scaled_derivative_le {K : Type*} [CommRing K]
    (f : K[X]) (r : ℕ) :
    (X ^ r * derivative^[r] f).natDegree ≤ f.natDegree

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.natDegree_wronskian_le
OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.order_reflect
statement:
lemma order_reflect {K : Type*} [Field K] (N : ℕ) (f : K[X])
    (hf : f ≠ 0) (hd : f.natDegree ≤ N) :
    (reflect N f).natTrailingDegree = N - f.natDegree

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.scaled_derivative_order
statement:
lemma scaled_derivative_order {K : Type*} [CommRing K]
    (f : K[X]) (r : ℕ) : X ^ f.natTrailingDegree ∣ X ^ r * derivative^[r] f

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.sum_rootMultiplicity_le_natDegree
statement:
lemma sum_rootMultiplicity_le_natDegree {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (f : K[X]) (s : Finset K) :
    ∑ a ∈ s, f.rootMultiplicity a ≤ f.natDegree

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.wronskian_basis_change
statement:
lemma wronskian_basis_change {K : Type*} [Field K] {h : ℕ}
    {V : Submodule K K[X]} (b b' : Basis (Fin h) K V) :
    wronskian (fun j => (b' j : K[X])) =
      wronskian (fun j => (b j : K[X])) * C (b.toMatrix b').det

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.wronskian_basis_ne_zero
statement:
lemma wronskian_basis_ne_zero {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (d : ℕ) {V : Submodule K K[X]} {h : ℕ} (b : Basis (Fin h) K V)
    (hV : ∀ f ∈ V, f ≠ 0 → f.natDegree < d) :
    wronskian (fun j => (b j : K[X])) ≠ 0

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.wronskian_basis_rootMultiplicity
statement:
lemma wronskian_basis_rootMultiplicity {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (d : ℕ) {V : Submodule K K[X]} {h : ℕ}
    (b b' : Basis (Fin h) K V) (a : K)
    (hV : ∀ f ∈ V, f ≠ 0 → f.natDegree < d) :
    (wronskian (fun j => (b' j : K[X]))).rootMultiplicity a =
      (wronskian (fun j => (b j : K[X]))).rootMultiplicity a

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.wronskian_linearCombination
OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.wronskian_ne_zero_of_distinct_degrees
statement:
lemma wronskian_ne_zero_of_distinct_degrees {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    {h : ℕ} (f : Fin h → K[X]) (hf : ∀ j, f j ≠ 0)
    (hd : Function.Injective (fun j => (f j).natDegree)) :
    wronskian f ≠ 0

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.wronskian_order_at
statement:
lemma wronskian_order_at {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] {h : ℕ}
    (a : K) (f : Fin h → K[X]) (hf : ∀ j, f j ≠ 0)
    (hd : Function.Injective (fun j => (f j).rootMultiplicity a)) :
    (wronskian f).rootMultiplicity a + (∑ i : Fin h, i.val) =
      ∑ j, (f j).rootMultiplicity a

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.wronskian_order_bound
statement:
theorem wronskian_order_bound {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (d : ℕ) {V : Submodule K K[X]} {h w : ℕ}
    (b : Basis (Fin h) K V) (a : Fin w → K) (ha : Function.Injective a)
    (e : Fin w → Basis (Fin h) K V)
    (hV : ∀ f ∈ V, f ≠ 0 → f.natDegree < d)
    (he : ∀ i, Function.Injective (fun j => (e i j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity (a i))) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, (e i j : K[X]).rootMultiplicity (a i) ≤
      h * (d - 1) + w * (∑ j : Fin h, j.val)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.wronskian_order_of_distinct_orders
statement:
lemma wronskian_order_of_distinct_orders {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    {h : ℕ} (f : Fin h → K[X]) (hf : ∀ j, f j ≠ 0)
    (hd : Function.Injective (fun j => (f j).natTrailingDegree)) :
    wronskian f ≠ 0 ∧
      (wronskian f).natTrailingDegree + (∑ i : Fin h, i.val) =
        ∑ j, (f j).natTrailingDegree

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Expansion.wronskian_taylor
OAI.RationalHitting.LaurentReduction.exists_independent_subfamily
statement:
lemma exists_independent_subfamily {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    {h : ℕ} (v : Fin h → V) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (a : Fin k → Fin h), Function.Injective a ∧
      Submodule.span K (Set.range (v ∘ a)) = Submodule.span K (Set.range v) ∧
      LinearIndependent K (v ∘ a)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.LaurentReduction.finrank_map_add_finrank_inf_ker
statement:
lemma finrank_map_add_finrank_inf_ker {L : Type*} [Field L] {V W : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module L V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module L W]
    (f : V →ₗ[L] W) (U : Submodule L V) [FiniteDimensional L U] :
    finrank L (U.map f) + finrank L ↥(U ⊓ f.ker) = finrank L U

name: OAI.RationalHitting.LaurentReduction.finrank_map_injective
statement:
lemma finrank_map_injective {L : Type*} [Field L] {V W : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module L V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module L W]
    (f : V →ₗ[L] W) (hf : Function.Injective f) (U : Submodule L V) :
    finrank L (U.map f) = finrank L U

name: OAI.RationalHitting.SmallExpansion.expansion_numeric
statement:
lemma expansion_numeric (w B M N k l : ℕ) (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hMN : M = N + 2*w^3*B) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkB : k ≤ B)
    (hh : w * (k*(M-1)) ≤ k*(N-1) + w*(∑ j : Fin k, j.val) +
      (l*(M-1) + w*(∑ j : Fin l, j.val))) :
    (w-1)*k < l

name: OAI.RationalHitting.SmallExpansion.sum_reversed_counts

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Rectangular.blockEval_injective_of_isUnit

lemma blockEval_injective_of_isUnit {w q e : ℕ}
    (A : Fin w → Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) F)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Rectangular.blockEval_injective_of_leftInverse
statement:
lemma blockEval_injective_of_leftInverse {w q e : ℕ}
    (A : Fin w → Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) F)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Rectangular.blockMatrix_mulVec

lemma blockMatrix_mulVec {w q e : ℕ} (A : Fin w → Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) F)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Rectangular.coefficientMatrix_expansion
statement:
lemma coefficientMatrix_expansion {q k : ℕ} (f : Fin q → P)
    (b : Basis (Fin k) F (componentSpace (F := F) f)) (α : Fin q) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Rectangular.coefficient_image_le_concat
statement:
lemma coefficient_image_le_concat {w q k : ℕ}
    (A : Fin w → Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) F) (P : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin k) F) (i : Fin w) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Rectangular.component_image_le_range

lemma component_image_le_range {w q k : ℕ} (T : Fin w → P →ₗ[F] Q)

      (imageCombination T (fun j => (b j : P))).range

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Rectangular.concat_row_relation
statement:
lemma concat_row_relation {w q k : ℕ}
    (A : Fin w → Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) F) (T : Fin w → P →ₗ[F] Q)
    (f : Fin q → P) (b : Basis (Fin k) F (componentSpace (F := F) f))
    (hker : ∀ α, ∑ i, ∑ γ, A i α γ • T i (f γ) = 0) (α : Fin q) :
    (concatMatrix A (coefficientMatrix f b)).row α ∈
      (imageCombination T (fun j => (b j : P))).ker

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Rectangular.kernel_impossible
statement:
theorem kernel_impossible {w q k e : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) (he : 0 < e)
    (A : Fin w → Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) F) (T : Fin w → P →ₗ[F] Q)
    (X : Fin w → Matrix (Fin e) (Fin e) F)
    (hX : Function.Injective (blockEval A X))
    (f : Fin q → P) (b : Basis (Fin k) F (componentSpace (F := F) f))
    (hker : ∀ α, ∑ i, ∑ γ, A i α γ • T i (f γ) = 0)
    (hex : (w-1)*k < finrank F (imageCombination T (fun j => (b j : P))).range) :
    False

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Rectangular.no_shrunk_subspace
statement:
lemma no_shrunk_subspace {w q e : ℕ} (he : 0 < e)
    (A : Fin w → Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) F)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.HahnGeometric.geometricPowers_of_not_orderTop_pos

name: OAI.RationalHitting.HahnGeometric.normalized_pos

name: OAI.RationalHitting.CyclotomicRing.rho_character
statement:
lemma rho_character (e : ℕ) (a : ZMod (dimension e)) (i j : Fin (degree e)) :
    rho e (character e a) i j =
      if (a.val+j.val) % degree e = i.val then (-1 : ℚ)^((a.val+j.val)/degree e) else 0

statement:
lemma rho_character_integral (e : ℕ) (a : ZMod (dimension e)) (i j : Fin (degree e)) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.CyclotomicRing.rho_root_pow
statement:
lemma rho_root_pow (e k : ℕ) (i j : Fin (degree e)) :
    rho e (AdjoinRoot.root (modulus e)^k) i j =
      if (k+j.val) % degree e = i.val then (-1 : ℚ)^((k+j.val)/degree e) else 0

name: OAI.RationalHitting.CyclotomicRing.root_degree
statement: lemma root_degree (e : ℕ) : AdjoinRoot.root (modulus e)^degree e = -1

statement:
lemma root_pow_reduce (e k : ℕ) :

      (basis e ⟨k % degree e,Nat.mod_lt _ (degree_pos e)⟩)

    |U n N e x a i j| ≤ (CyclotomicRing.dimension e : ℤ)^4 *

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Generator.regular_apply

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Generator.scaled_normalization

statement:
lemma entry_bound (e : ℕ) (T : Matrix (ZMod (dimension e)) (ZMod (dimension e)) ℤ)
    (p r : ℤ) (A H : ℕ) (hT : ∀ i j, |T i j| ≤ A) (hH : 1 ≤ H)
    (hp : |p| ≤ H) (hr : |r| ≤ H) (u v : ZMod (dimension e)) (i j : Fin (degree e)) :
    |entry e T p r u v i j| ≤ (dimension e : ℤ)^3*A*(H : ℤ)^(2*dimension e)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.IntegralLift.entry_spec
statement:
lemma entry_spec (e : ℕ)
    (P : Matrix (ZMod (dimension e)) (ZMod (dimension e)) (R e)[X])
    (T : Matrix (ZMod (dimension e)) (ZMod (dimension e)) ℤ) (t p r : ℤ)
    (hT : ∀ u v, Polynomial.eval (t : R e) (P u v) = (T u v : R e))
    (u v : ZMod (dimension e)) (i j : Fin (degree e)) :
    (entry e T p r u v i j : ℚ) = (dimension e : ℚ) *
      rho e (MvPolynomial.eval ![(t : R e),(p : R e),(r : R e)]
        (ThreeLift.lift (character e) P u v)) i j

name: OAI.RationalHitting.IntegralLift.rho_div_nat
statement:
lemma rho_div_nat (e : ℕ) (z : R e) (i j : Fin (degree e)) :
    (dimension e : ℚ) * rho e ((dimension e : R e)⁻¹*z) i j = rho e z i j

name: OAI.RationalHitting.IntegralLift.rho_rat_mul
statement:
lemma rho_rat_mul (e : ℕ) (q : ℚ) (z : R e) (i j : Fin (degree e)) :
    rho e (algebraMap ℚ (R e) q * z) i j = q * rho e z i j

name: OAI.RationalHitting.IntegralTest.full_bound
statement:
lemma full_bound (M : ℕ) (a t : ℤ) (w H : ℕ) (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hH : 1 ≤ H)
    (ha : |a| ≤ w) (ht : |t| ≤ H) (i j : Fin M) :
    |full M a t i j| ≤ (M : ℤ)*(2*w : ℤ)^(2*M)*(H : ℤ)^M

name: OAI.RationalHitting.IntegralTest.padded_bound
statement:
lemma padded_bound (M N : ℕ) (a t : ℤ) (w H : ℕ) (hw : 1 ≤ w) (hH : 1 ≤ H)
    (ha : |a| ≤ w) (ht : |t| ≤ H) (i j : Fin M) :
    |padded M N a t i j| ≤ (M : ℤ)*(2*w : ℤ)^(2*M)*(H : ℤ)^M

name: OAI.RationalHitting.ThreeLift.eval_lift
statement:
lemma eval_lift (χ : AddChar (ZMod d) K) (R : Matrix (ZMod d) (ZMod d) K[X])
    (x : Fin 3 → K) (i j : ZMod d) :
    MvPolynomial.eval x (lift χ R i j) =
      (d : K)⁻¹ * ∑ a : ZMod d, ∑ b : ZMod d, ∑ k : ZMod d,
        χ (-a*k)*Polynomial.eval (x 0) (R k (k-b)) * QuantumMatrices.weyl χ a b i j *
          (x 1)^a.val*(x 2)^b.val

name: OAI.RationalHitting.ThreeLift.eval_uni
statement: lemma eval_uni (x : Fin 3 → K) (p : K[X]) : MvPolynomial.eval x (uni p) = Polynomial.eval (x 0) p

name: OAI.RationalHitting.EncodingBounds.encodeNat_le

name: OAI.RationalHitting.EncodingBounds.encodeNat_length

name: OAI.RationalHitting.EncodingBounds.nat_le_two_pow

name: OAI.RationalHitting.EncodingBounds.normalized_entry_ratio

lemma normalized_entry_ratio {d : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℤ) (hA : A.det ≠ 0)

    ((A.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ))⁻¹ * B.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) i j =

name: OAI.RationalHitting.EncodingBounds.output_length_le

      H.tuples.length*n*H.dimension*H.dimension*B

name: OAI.RationalHitting.EncodingBounds.ratio_den_le

name: OAI.RationalHitting.EncodingBounds.ratio_num_le

name: OAI.RationalHitting.Generator.U_power_bound

lemma U_power_bound (n N e H : ℕ) (x : Fin 3 → ℕ) (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hx : ∀ l, x l ≤ H)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.PolynomialBounds.mul_monomials

name: OAI.RationalHitting.PolynomialBounds.normalized_bits_bound

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OneToZero.execution_time
statement:
theorem execution_time (M : Λ → TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ) (S : Finset Λ)
    (hs : TM1.Supports M S) (C : ℕ) (hC : ∀ l ∈ S, weight (M l) ≤ C)
    (t : ℕ) (a b : TM1.Cfg Γ Λ σ) (ha : a.l ∈ Finset.insertNone S)
    (hr : exec (TM1.step M) t a = some b) :
    ∃ u ≤ C*t, exec (TM0.step (TM1to0.tr M)) u (TM1to0.trCfg M a) =

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.FiniteStates.finite_machine
statement:
theorem finite_machine (M : TM0.Machine Γ Λ) (S : Finset Λ)
    (hs : TM0.Supports M (S : Set Λ)) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (G : TM0.Machine Γ (Fin (m+1))), ∀ (l : List Γ) (t : ℕ) (a : TM0.Cfg Γ Λ),
      exec (TM0.step M) t (TM0.init l)=some a → TM0.step M a=none →
      ∃ b : TM0.Cfg Γ (Fin (m+1)), exec (TM0.step G) t (TM0.init l)=some b ∧
        TM0.step G b=none ∧ b.Tape=a.Tape

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.StackToOne.continuation_time
statement:
theorem continuation_time (q : TM2.Stmt Γ Λ σ) (v : σ)
    (S : ∀ k, List (Γ k)) (T : ListBlank (∀ k, Option (Γ k))) (L : ℕ)
    (hT : ∀ k, T.map (proj k) = ListBlank.mk ((S k).map some).reverse)
    (hS : ∀ k, (S k).length ≤ L) :
    ∃ u b, u ≤ stackWeight q*(2*(L+stackWeight q)+3) ∧
      TrCfg (TM2.stepAux q v S) b ∧
      exec (TM1.step (tr M)) u (TM1.stepAux (trNormal q) v (Tape.mk' ∅ (addBottom T))) = some b

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.StackToOne.execution_time
statement:
theorem execution_time [Inhabited Λ] (F : Finset Λ) (hF : TM2.Supports M F)
    (C : ℕ) (hC : ∀ l ∈ F, stackWeight (M l)+1 ≤ C)
    (t : ℕ) (a b : TM2.Cfg Γ Λ σ)
    (a' : TM1.Cfg (Γ' K Γ) (Λ' K Γ Λ σ) σ) (L : ℕ)
    (ha : a.l ∈ Finset.insertNone F) (hS : ∀ k, (a.stk k).length ≤ L)
    (htr : TrCfg a a') (hr : exec (TM2.step M) t a = some b) :
    ∃ u b', u ≤ C*t*(2*(L+C*t)+4) ∧ TrCfg b b' ∧
      exec (TM1.step (tr M)) u a' = some b'

lemma go_time {k} (o q v) {S : List (Γ k)} {L : ListBlank (∀ k, Option (Γ k))}
    (hL : L.map (proj k) = ListBlank.mk (S.map some).reverse) (n) (H : n ≤ S.length) :
    exec (TM1.step (tr M)) n ⟨some (go k o q), v, Tape.mk' ∅ (addBottom L)⟩ =
      some ⟨some (go k o q),v,(Tape.move Dir.right)^[n] (Tape.mk' ∅ (addBottom L))⟩

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.StackToOne.statement_length
statement:
lemma statement_length (q : TM2.Stmt Γ Λ σ) (v : σ) (S : ∀ k, List (Γ k))

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.StackToOne.step_time
statement:
theorem step_time (l : Λ) (v : σ) (S : ∀ k, List (Γ k))
    (a : TM1.Cfg (Γ' K Γ) (Λ' K Γ Λ σ) σ) (L C : ℕ)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Compiler.binary_compilation
statement:
theorem binary_compilation (p : Program K) :
    ∃ (b : ℕ) (enc : TapeAlphabet K → List.Vector Bool b)
      (dec : List.Vector Bool b → TapeAlphabet K)
      (h0 : enc default=List.Vector.replicate b false),
      (∀ a,dec (enc a)=a) ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (G : TM0.Machine Bool (Fin (m+1))) (C : ℕ), 0<C ∧
      ∀ (k : K) (w : List Bool) (v : Store K) (t : ℕ),
        Eval p (Function.update (fun _ => []) k w) v t →
        ∃ u ≤ C*(w.length+t+3)^2, ∃ a,
          exec (TM0.step G) u (TM0.init ((TM2to1.trInit k w).flatMap (fun z => (enc z).toList)))=some a ∧
          TM0.step G a=none ∧
          ∃ c : TM1.Cfg (TapeAlphabet K) (TapeLabels K) (Option Bool),
            TM2to1.TrCfg (⟨none,none,v⟩ : TM2.Cfg (fun _ : K => Bool) (Labels K) (Option Bool)) c ∧
            a.Tape=TM1to1.trTape h0 c.Tape

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Compiler.finite_compilation
statement:
theorem finite_compilation (p : Program K) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (G : TM0.Machine (TapeAlphabet K) (Fin (m+1))) (C : ℕ), 0<C ∧
      ∀ (k : K) (w : List Bool) (v : Store K) (t : ℕ),
        Eval p (Function.update (fun _ => []) k w) v t →
        ∃ u ≤ C*(w.length+t+3)^2, ∃ a,
          exec (TM0.step G) u (TM0.init (TM2to1.trInit k w))=some a ∧
          TM0.step G a=none ∧
          ∃ b : TM1.Cfg (TapeAlphabet K) (TapeLabels K) (Option Bool),
            TM2to1.TrCfg (⟨none,none,v⟩ : TM2.Cfg (fun _ : K => Bool) (Labels K) (Option Bool)) b ∧
            a.Tape=b.Tape

lemma stackConstant_bound (p : Program K) (l : Labels K) (hl : l∈support p) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Compiler.tapeConstant_bound
statement:
lemma tapeConstant_bound (p : Program K) (l : TapeLabels K) (hl : l∈tapeSupport p) :
    OneToZero.weight (TM2to1.tr (machine p) l) ≤ tapeConstant p

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Compiler.tapeSupported
statement:
lemma tapeSupported (p : Program K) :
    TM1.Supports (TM2to1.tr (machine p)) (tapeSupport p)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.Alphabet.compiled_init
statement:
lemma compiled_init {Γ Λ σ : Type*} [Inhabited Γ] [Inhabited Λ] [Inhabited σ]
    {b : ℕ} (enc : Γ → List.Vector Bool b) (h0 : enc default=List.Vector.replicate b false)
    (w : List Γ) :
    TM1to1.trCfg enc h0 (TM1.init w : TM1.Cfg Γ Λ σ)=
      TM1.init (w.flatMap (fun a => (enc a).toList))

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.Alphabet.continuation_time
statement:
theorem continuation_time (M : Λ → TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ) (q : TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ)
    (v : σ) (L R : ListBlank Γ) :
    ∃ t ≤ writesWeight q,
      exec (TM1.step (TM1to1.tr enc dec M)) t
        (TM1.stepAux (TM1to1.trNormal dec q) v (TM1to1.trTape' enc0 L R)) =
        some (TM1to1.trCfg enc enc0 (TM1.stepAux q v (Tape.mk' L R)))

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.Alphabet.execution_time
statement:
theorem execution_time [Inhabited Λ] (M : Λ → TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ) (S : Finset Λ)
    (hs : TM1.Supports M S) (C : ℕ) (hC : ∀ l ∈ S, writesWeight (M l)+1 ≤ C)
    (t : ℕ) (a b : TM1.Cfg Γ Λ σ) (ha : a.l ∈ Finset.insertNone S)
    (hr : exec (TM1.step M) t a = some b) :
    ∃ u ≤ C*t, exec (TM1.step (TM1to1.tr enc dec M)) u
      (TM1to1.trCfg enc enc0 a) = some (TM1to1.trCfg enc enc0 b)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OneToZero.finite_compiler
statement:
theorem finite_compiler {Γ Λ σ : Type*} [Inhabited Γ] [Inhabited Λ] [Inhabited σ]
    [Fintype Λ] [Fintype σ] (M : Λ → TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (G : TM0.Machine Γ (Fin (m+1))) (C : ℕ), 0<C ∧
      ∀ (w : List Γ) (t : ℕ) (a : TM1.Cfg Γ Λ σ),
        exec (TM1.step M) t (TM1.init w)=some a → TM1.step M a=none →
        ∃ u≤C*t, ∃ b : TM0.Cfg Γ (Fin (m+1)),
          exec (TM0.step G) u (TM0.init w)=some b ∧ TM0.step G b=none ∧ b.Tape=a.Tape

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OneToZero.supports_univ
statement:
lemma supports_univ {Γ Λ σ : Type*} [Fintype Λ] (q : TM1.Stmt Γ Λ σ) :
    TM1.SupportsStmt Finset.univ q

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.all_process
statement:
lemma all_process (code : Bool → Bool → List Bool) (xs out : List Bool) (k : ℕ) (f b : Bool) :
    ∃ f' b', exec (TM1.step (M code)) (cost code f xs k out.length)
      (invariant xs k out f b)=
      some (invariant [] (k+xs.length) (out++emit code f xs) f' b')

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.bit_ne_three
statement: @[simp] lemma bit_ne_three (b : Bool) : bit b ≠ 3

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.clear_blanks
statement:
lemma clear_blanks (O : List A) (k : ℕ) :
    Tape.mk₂ (List.replicate k (0:A)) (O++[0])=Tape.mk₁ O

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.cost_bound
statement:
lemma cost_bound (code : Bool → Bool → List Bool) (B : ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ f x, (code f x).length≤B) (f : Bool) (xs : List Bool) (k L : ℕ) :
    cost code f xs k L ≤ xs.length*(2*(k+xs.length)+2*(L+B*xs.length)+B+7)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.emit_false
statement:
lemma emit_false (code : Bool → Bool → List Bool) (xs : List Bool) :
    emit code false xs=xs.flatMap (code false)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.emit_length
statement:
lemma emit_length (code : Bool → Bool → List Bool) (B : ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ f x, (code f x).length≤B) (f : Bool) (xs : List Bool) :
    (emit code f xs).length≤B*xs.length

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.enter_finish
statement:
lemma enter_finish (code : Bool → Bool → List Bool) (out : List Bool) (k : ℕ) (f b : Bool) :
    exec (TM1.step (M code)) 1 (invariant [] k out f b)=
      some (state 6 f b [] (List.replicate (k+2) 0++3::out.map bit++[3]))

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.finish
statement:
lemma finish (code : Bool → Bool → List Bool) (out : List Bool) (k : ℕ) (f b : Bool) :
    exec (TM1.step (M code)) (k+2*out.length+7) (invariant [] k out f b)=
      some ⟨none,(f,b),Tape.mk₁ (out.map bit)⟩

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.head₂
statement: @[simp] lemma head₂ (L R : List A) : (Tape.mk₂ L R).head=R.headI

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.left_empty
statement:
@[simp] lemma left_empty (R : List A) :
    (Tape.mk₂ [] R).move .left = Tape.mk₂ [] (0::R)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.left₂
statement:
@[simp] lemma left₂ (a : A) (L R : List A) :
    (Tape.mk₂ (a::L) R).move .left=Tape.mk₂ L (a::R)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.prepare
statement:
theorem prepare (code : Bool → Bool → List Bool) (B : ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ f x, (code f x).length≤B) (w : List Bool) (v : V) :
    ∃ t ≤ (4*B+12)*(w.length+1)^2, ∃ v',
      exec (TM1.step (M code)) t (⟨some 0,v,Tape.mk₁ (w.map raw)⟩ : Cfg)=
        some ⟨none,v',Tape.mk₁ ((emit code true w.reverse).map bit)⟩

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.process
statement:
lemma process (code : Bool → Bool → List Bool) (x f b : Bool) (xs out : List Bool) (k : ℕ) :
    exec (TM1.step (M code)) (2*k+2*out.length+(code f x).length+7)
      (invariant (x::xs) k out f b)=
      some (invariant xs (k+1) (out++code f x) false x)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.raw_ne_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma raw_ne_zero (b : Bool) : raw b ≠ 0

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.raw_stack_input
statement:
theorem raw_stack_input {K : Type} [DecidableEq K] (k : K) (b : ℕ)
    (enc : TM2to1.Γ' K (fun _ => Bool) → List.Vector Bool b) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (G : TM0.Machine A (Fin (m+1))) (C : ℕ), 0<C ∧
      ∀ w : List Bool, w≠[] → ∃ t≤C*(w.length+1)^2, ∃ a : TM0.Cfg A (Fin (m+1)),
        exec (TM0.step G) t (TM0.init (w.map raw))=some a ∧ TM0.step G a=none ∧
        a.Tape=Tape.mk₁ (((TM2to1.trInit k w).flatMap (fun z => (enc z).toList)).map bit)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.right₂
statement:
@[simp] lemma right₂ (L : List A) (a : A) (R : List A) :
    (Tape.mk₂ L (a::R)).move .right=Tape.mk₂ (a::L) R

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.scan_left
statement:
lemma scan_left (F : Q → Stmt) (q r : Q) (v : V) (l L R : List A)
    (hF : F q=leftTo q r) (hl : ∀ a∈l, a≠3) :
    exec (TM1.step F) (l.length+1) (⟨some q,v,Tape.mk₂ (l++3::L) R⟩ : Cfg)=
      some ⟨some r,v,Tape.mk₂ L (3::l.reverse++R)⟩

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.scan_right
statement:
lemma scan_right (F : Q → Stmt) (q : Q) (v : V) (l L R : List A)
    (h : ∀ a∈l, ∀ L R, TM1.step F (⟨some q,v,Tape.mk₂ L (a::R)⟩ : Cfg)=
      some ⟨some q,v,Tape.mk₂ (a::L) R⟩) :
    exec (TM1.step F) l.length (⟨some q,v,Tape.mk₂ L (l++R)⟩ : Cfg)=
      some ⟨some q,v,Tape.mk₂ (l.reverse++L) R⟩

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.scan_six_zero
statement:
lemma scan_six_zero (code : Bool → Bool → List Bool) (f b : Bool) (L R : List A) :
    TM1.step (M code) (state 6 f b L (0::R))=some (state 6 f b (0::L) R)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.scan_zero_raw
statement:
lemma scan_zero_raw (code : Bool → Bool → List Bool) (x : Bool) (v : V) (L R : List A) :
    TM1.step (M code) (⟨some 0,v,Tape.mk₂ L (raw x::R)⟩ : Cfg)=
      some ⟨some 0,v,Tape.mk₂ (raw x::L) R⟩

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.stack_encoding
statement:
lemma stack_encoding {K : Type} [DecidableEq K] (k : K) (b : ℕ)
    (enc : TM2to1.Γ' K (fun _ => Bool) → List.Vector Bool b)
    (w : List Bool) (hw : w≠[]) :
    emit (fun f x => (enc (f,Function.update (fun _ => none) k (some x))).toList) true w.reverse=
      (TM2to1.trInit k w).flatMap (fun a => (enc a).toList)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.start
statement:
lemma start (code : Bool → Bool → List Bool) (w : List Bool) (v : V) :
    exec (TM1.step (M code)) (w.length+1) (⟨some 0,v,Tape.mk₁ (w.map raw)⟩ : Cfg)=
      some (invariant w.reverse 0 [] true false)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.start_markers
statement:
lemma start_markers (code : Bool → Bool → List Bool) (w : List Bool) (v : V) :
    exec (TM1.step (M code)) 1 (⟨some 0,v,Tape.mk₂ (w.map raw) []⟩ : Cfg)=
      some (invariant w 0 [] true false)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.stepAux_writeBits
statement:
lemma stepAux_writeBits (bs : List Bool) (q : Stmt) (v : V) (L R : List A) :
    TM1.stepAux (writeBits bs q) v (Tape.mk₂ L R)=
      TM1.stepAux q v (Tape.mk₂ ((bs.map bit).reverse++L) (R.drop bs.length))

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.InputAdapter.write₂
statement:
@[simp] lemma write₂ (L R : List A) (a : A) :
    (Tape.mk₂ L R).write a=Tape.mk₂ L (a::R.tail)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.bit_beq_one
statement: @[simp] lemma bit_beq_one (x : Bool) : (bit x==1)=x

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.bit_ne_three
statement: @[simp] lemma bit_ne_three (x : Bool) : bit x≠3

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.blockVector
statement:
lemma blockVector {b} (v : List.Vector Bool b) :
    block v.get=v.toList.map bit

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.clear_blanks
statement:
lemma clear_blanks (l r : ℕ) (w : List A) :
    Tape.mk₂ (List.replicate l (0:A)) (w++List.replicate r 0)=Tape.mk₁ w

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.consume_none
statement:
lemma consume_none {b} (get : Word b → Option Bool) (w : Word b)
    (hx : get w=none) (gap : ℕ) (out : List Bool) (v : V b) :
    exec (TM1.step (M get)) 1 (invariant gap out (block w) v)=
      some (state 5 (w,none) (List.replicate (gap+b+1) 0++3::out.reverse.map raw++[3]) [])

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.consume_some
statement:
lemma consume_some {b} (get : Word b → Option Bool) (w : Word b) (x : Bool)
    (hx : get w=some x) (gap : ℕ) (out : List Bool) (R : List A) (v : V b) :
    exec (TM1.step (M get)) 1 (invariant gap out (block w++R) v)=
      some (state 2 (w,some x) (List.replicate (gap+b) 0++3::out.reverse.map raw++[3]) (3::R))

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.cost_bound
statement:
lemma cost_bound (b gap len n : ℕ) :
    cost b gap len n≤(n+1)*(3*(gap+b*(n+1)+len+n+10))

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.decode_stream
statement:
lemma decode_stream {b} (hb : 1≤b) (get : Word b → Option Bool)
    (code : Bool → Bool → Word b) (stop : Bool → Word b)
    (hc : ∀ f x,get (code f x)=some x) (hs : ∀ f,get (stop f)=none)
    (xs : List Bool) (f : Bool) (gap : ℕ) (out : List Bool) (v : V b) :
    ∃ u : V b, exec (TM1.step (M get)) (cost b gap out.length xs.length)
      (invariant gap out (stream code stop f xs) v)=
      some ⟨none,u,Tape.mk₁ ((out++xs).map raw)⟩

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.emit_one
statement:
lemma emit_one {b} (hb : 1≤b) (get : Word b → Option Bool) (w : Word b) (x : Bool)
    (hx : get w=some x) (gap : ℕ) (out : List Bool) (R : List A) (v : V b) :
    exec (TM1.step (M get)) (2*(gap+b)+3) (invariant gap out (block w++R) v)=
      some (invariant (gap+b-1) (out++[x]) R (w,some x))

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.fill_all
statement: @[simp] lemma fill_all {b} (w v : Word b) : fill (List.finRange b) w v=w

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.fill_apply
statement:
lemma fill_apply {b} (is : List (Fin b)) (w v : Word b) (j : Fin b) :
    fill is w v j=if j∈is then w j else v j

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.finish
statement:
lemma finish {b} (get : Word b → Option Bool) (w : Word b)
    (hx : get w=none) (gap : ℕ) (out : List Bool) (v : V b) :
    exec (TM1.step (M get)) (gap+b+out.length+6) (invariant gap out (block w) v)=
      some ⟨none,(w,none),Tape.mk₁ (out.map raw)⟩

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.finite_output
statement:
theorem finite_output {b} (hb : 1≤b) (get : Word b → Option Bool)
    (code : Bool → Bool → Word b) (stop : Bool → Word b)
    (hc : ∀ f x,get (code f x)=some x) (hs : ∀ f,get (stop f)=none) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (G : TM0.Machine A (Fin (m+1))) (C : ℕ), 0<C ∧
      ∀ xs : List Bool, ∃ t≤C*(xs.length+1)^2, ∃ a,
        exec (TM0.step G) t (TM0.init (stream code stop true xs))=some a ∧
        TM0.step G a=none ∧ a.Tape=Tape.mk₁ (xs.map raw)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.getter_code
statement:
lemma getter_code {b} (k : K) (enc : StackAlphabet K → List.Vector Bool b)
    (dec : List.Vector Bool b → StackAlphabet K) (hd : ∀ a,dec (enc a)=a) (f x : Bool) :
    getter k dec (code k enc f x)=some x

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.getter_stop
statement:
lemma getter_stop {K : Type} [DecidableEq K] {b : ℕ} (k : K)
  (enc : RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.StackAlphabet K → List.Vector Bool b)
  (dec : List.Vector Bool b → RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.StackAlphabet K)
  (hd : ∀ (a : RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.StackAlphabet K), dec (enc a) = a)
  (f : Bool) :
  RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.getter k dec
      (RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.stop enc f) =
    none

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.prepare
statement:
theorem prepare {b} (hb : 1≤b) (get : Word b → Option Bool)
    (code : Bool → Bool → Word b) (stop : Bool → Word b)
    (hc : ∀ f x,get (code f x)=some x) (hs : ∀ f,get (stop f)=none)
    (xs : List Bool) :
    ∃ t≤(3*b+34)*(xs.length+1)^2, ∃ u : V b,
      exec (TM1.step (M get)) t (TM1.init (stream code stop true xs))=
        some ⟨none,u,Tape.mk₁ (xs.map raw)⟩

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.raw_ne_three
statement: @[simp] lemma raw_ne_three (x : Bool) : raw x≠3

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.raw_stack_output
statement:
theorem raw_stack_output {b} (k : K) (enc : StackAlphabet K → List.Vector Bool b)
    (dec : List.Vector Bool b → StackAlphabet K) (h0 : enc default=List.Vector.replicate b false)
    (hd : ∀ a,dec (enc a)=a) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (G : TM0.Machine A (Fin (m+1))) (C : ℕ), 0<C ∧
      ∀ xs : List Bool, ∃ t≤C*(xs.length+1)^2, ∃ a,
        exec (TM0.step G) t (TM0.init
          (((TM2to1.trInit k xs.reverse).flatMap (fun z => (enc z).toList)).map bit))=some a ∧
        TM0.step G a=none ∧ a.Tape=Tape.mk₁ (xs.map raw)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.readBlock_spec
statement:
lemma readBlock_spec {b} (is : List (Fin b)) (w v : Word b) (x : Option Bool)
    (q : Stmt b) (L R : List A) :
    TM1.stepAux (readBlock is q) (v,x) (Tape.mk₂ L (is.map (fun i => bit (w i))++R))=
      TM1.stepAux q (fill is w v,x) (Tape.mk₂ (List.replicate is.length 0++L) R)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.right₂
statement:
@[simp] lemma right₂ (L : List A) (a : A) (R : List A) :
    (Tape.mk₂ L (a::R)).move .right=Tape.mk₂ (a::L) R

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.scan_left
statement:
lemma scan_left {b} (F : Q → Stmt b) (q r : Q) (v : V b) (l L R : List A)
    (hF : F q=leftTo q r) (hl : ∀ a∈l, a≠3) :
    exec (TM1.step F) (l.length+1) (state q v (l++3::L) R)=
      some (state r v L (3::l.reverse++R))

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.scan_right
statement:
lemma scan_right {b} (F : Q → Stmt b) (q : Q) (v : V b) (l L R : List A)
    (h : ∀ a∈l, ∀ L R, TM1.step F (state q v L (a::R))=some (state q v (a::L) R)) :
    exec (TM1.step F) l.length (state q v L (l++R))=
      some (state q v (l.reverse++L) R)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.start
statement:
lemma start {b} (get : Word b → Option Bool) (R : List A) (v : V b) :
    exec (TM1.step (M get)) 1 ⟨some 0,v,Tape.mk₁ R⟩=
      some (invariant 0 [] R v)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.stream_encoding
statement:
lemma stream_encoding {b} (k : K) (enc : StackAlphabet K → List.Vector Bool b)
    (h0 : enc default=List.Vector.replicate b false) (xs : List Bool) :
    Tape.mk₁ (stream (code k enc) (stop enc) true xs)=
      Tape.mk₁ (((TM2to1.trInit k xs.reverse).flatMap (fun z => (enc z).toList)).map bit)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.stream_false
statement:
lemma stream_false {b} (k : K) (enc : StackAlphabet K → List.Vector Bool b) (xs : List Bool) :
    stream (code k enc) (stop enc) false xs=
      (xs.flatMap (fun x => (enc (false,Function.update (fun _ => none) k (some x))).toList)).map bit ++
      block (stop enc false)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.width_pos

lemma width_pos {K : Type} [DecidableEq K] {b : ℕ}
  (enc : RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.StackAlphabet K → List.Vector Bool b)
  (dec : List.Vector Bool b → RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.StackAlphabet K)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.write₂

@[simp] lemma write₂ (L R : List A) (a : A) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.OutputAdapter.zeros_cons
statement:
lemma zeros_cons (k : ℕ) (L : List A) :
    List.replicate k (0:A)++0::L=0::(List.replicate k 0++L)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.StackTape.clean
statement:
lemma clean {K Λ σ : Type*} [DecidableEq K] [Inhabited Λ] [Inhabited σ]
    (k : K) (w : List Bool)
    {c : TM1.Cfg (TM2to1.Γ' K (fun _ => Bool)) (TM2to1.Λ' K (fun _ => Bool) Λ σ) σ}
    (h : TM2to1.TrCfg
      (⟨none,default,Function.update (fun _ => []) k w⟩ : TM2.Cfg (fun _ : K => Bool) Λ σ) c) :
    c.Tape=Tape.mk₁ (TM2to1.trInit k w)

statement:
lemma compilation_square_bound (D C A x E : ℕ) :
    D*((C+A+4)*x^E)^2 = D*(C+A+4)^2*x^(2*E)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.ExecutableGenerator.compilation_sum_bound
statement:
lemma compilation_sum_bound (x t y R C A : ℕ) (hx : x≤R)
    (ht : t≤C*R) (hy : y≤A*R) (hR : 1≤R) : x+t+y+3≤(C+A+4)*R

name: OAI.RationalHitting.ExecutableGenerator.encoded_raw
statement:
lemma encoded_raw (n s : ℕ) : (encoded n s).map TMTime.OutputAdapter.raw =
    (encodeOutput (list n s)).map tapeBit

name: OAI.RationalHitting.ExecutableGenerator.run_eq_exec
statement:
lemma run_eq_exec {m : ℕ} (G : Machine m) (t : ℕ) (a : Config m) :
    run G t a = exec (TM0.step G) t a

name: OAI.RationalHitting.ExecutableGenerator.unaryWord_raw

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Compiler.raw_compilation
statement:
theorem raw_compilation (p : Program K) (ki ko : K) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (G : TM0.Machine (Fin 4) (Fin (m+1))) (C : ℕ), 0<C ∧
      ∀ (w xs : List Bool) (t : ℕ), w≠[] →
        Eval p (Function.update (fun _ => []) ki w)
          (Function.update (fun _ => []) ko xs.reverse) t →
        ∃ u≤C*(w.length+t+xs.length+3)^2, ∃ a,
          exec (TM0.step G) u (TM0.init (w.map InputAdapter.raw))=some a ∧
          TM0.step G a=none ∧ a.Tape=Tape.mk₁ (xs.map OutputAdapter.raw)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.BinaryLift.run

lemma run (F : TM0.Machine Bool Λ) (t : ℕ) (a : TM0.Cfg Bool Λ) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.BinaryLift.run_init
statement:
lemma run_init (F : TM0.Machine Bool Λ) (w : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (a : TM0.Cfg Bool Λ)
    (hr : exec (TM0.step F) t (TM0.init w)=some a) (hh : TM0.step F a=none) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.BinaryLift.step
statement:
lemma step (F : TM0.Machine Bool Λ) (a : TM0.Cfg Bool Λ) :
    TM0.step (machine F) (cfg a)=(TM0.step F a).map cfg

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.Link.finite_sequence
statement:
theorem finite_sequence [Fintype Λ] [Fintype Δ]
    (F : TM0.Machine Γ Λ) (G : TM0.Machine Γ Δ) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (H : TM0.Machine Γ (Fin (m+1))),
      ∀ (w v : List Γ) (t u : ℕ) (a : TM0.Cfg Γ Λ) (b : TM0.Cfg Γ Δ),
        exec (TM0.step F) t (TM0.init w)=some a → TM0.step F a=none →
        a.Tape=Tape.mk₁ v → exec (TM0.step G) u (TM0.init v)=some b → TM0.step G b=none →
        ∃ c, exec (TM0.step H) (t+1+u) (TM0.init w)=some c ∧ TM0.step H c=none ∧ c.Tape=b.Tape

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.Link.run_left
statement:
lemma run_left (F : TM0.Machine Γ Λ) (G : TM0.Machine Γ Δ)
    (t : ℕ) {a b : TM0.Cfg Γ Λ} (h : exec (TM0.step F) t a=some b) :
    exec (TM0.step (machine F G)) t (left a)=some (left b)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.Link.run_right

lemma run_right (F : TM0.Machine Γ Λ) (G : TM0.Machine Γ Δ)

    exec (TM0.step (machine F G)) t (right a)=(exec (TM0.step G) t a).map right

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.Link.step_left
statement:
lemma step_left (F : TM0.Machine Γ Λ) (G : TM0.Machine Γ Δ)
    {a b : TM0.Cfg Γ Λ} (h : TM0.step F a=some b) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.Link.step_right
statement:
lemma step_right (F : TM0.Machine Γ Λ) (G : TM0.Machine Γ Δ) (a : TM0.Cfg Γ Δ) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.TMTime.Link.switch
statement:

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.carrySplit_length

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_clear
statement:
lemma eval_clear (a : K) (s : Store K) :
    Eval (clear a) s (update s a []) (2*(s a).length+1)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_copy
statement:
lemma eval_copy {a b tmp : K} (hab : a ≠ b) (hat : a ≠ tmp) (hbt : b ≠ tmp)
    (s : Store K) :
    Eval (copy a b tmp) s (update (update s b (s a)) tmp [])
      (7*(s a).length+2*(s b).length+2*(s tmp).length+7)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_copyHead
statement:
lemma eval_copyHead {a b : K} (s : Store K) (x : Bool) (l : List Bool) (hs : s a = x::l) :
    Eval (copyHead a b) s (update s b (x::s b)) 2

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_duplicateReverse
statement:
lemma eval_duplicateReverse {a b c : K} (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (s : Store K) :
    Eval (duplicateReverse a b c) s
      (update (update (update s a []) b ((s a).reverse++s b)) c ((s a).reverse++s c))
      (5*(s a).length+1)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_increment
statement:
lemma eval_increment {a tmp flag : K} (hat : a ≠ tmp) (haf : a ≠ flag) (htf : tmp ≠ flag)
    (s : Store K) :
    ∃ t ≤ 7*(s a).length+2*(s tmp).length+2*(s flag).length+18,
      Eval (increment a tmp flag) s
        (update (update (update s a (incrementWord (s a))) tmp []) flag []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_incrementLoop
statement:
lemma eval_incrementLoop {a tmp flag : K} (hat : a ≠ tmp) (haf : a ≠ flag) (htf : tmp ≠ flag)
    (s : Store K) (hf : s flag = [true]) :
    ∃ t ≤ 5*(s a).length+10, Eval (incrementLoop a tmp flag) s
      (update (update (update s a (carrySplit (s a)).2) tmp
        (List.replicate (carrySplit (s a)).1 false ++ s tmp)) flag []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_reverse
statement:
lemma eval_reverse {a b : K} (hab : a ≠ b) (s : Store K) :
    Eval (reverse a b) s (update (update s a []) b ((s a).reverse ++ s b))
      (2*(s a).length+1)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.incrementWord_length
statement: theorem incrementWord_length (l : List Bool) : (incrementWord l).length ≤ l.length+1

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.incrementWord_value
statement: @[simp] theorem incrementWord_value (l : List Bool) : wordValue (incrementWord l) = wordValue l+1

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.transfer_cons
statement:
lemma transfer_cons {a b : K} (hab : a ≠ b) (s : Store K) (x : Bool) (l : List Bool)

statement: lemma addSplit_first_length (a b : List Bool) : (addSplit a b).1.length = b.length

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.addSplit_spec

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.addWord_length

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.addWord_value
statement:
@[simp] theorem addWord_value (a b : List Bool) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_add
statement:
lemma eval_add {a b out tmp flag : K}
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hao : a ≠ out) (hat : a ≠ tmp) (haf : a ≠ flag)
    (hbo : b ≠ out) (hbt : b ≠ tmp) (hbf : b ≠ flag)
    (hot : out ≠ tmp) (hof : out ≠ flag) (htf : tmp ≠ flag)
    (s : Store K) :
    ∃ t ≤ (s b).length*(7*(s a).length+27)+
        2*(s out).length+2*(s tmp).length+2*(s flag).length+9,
      Eval (add a b out tmp flag) s
        (update (update (update (update (update s a (addWord (s a) (s b))) b []) out []) tmp []) flag []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_addLoop
statement:
lemma eval_addLoop {a b out tmp flag : K}
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hao : a ≠ out) (hat : a ≠ tmp) (haf : a ≠ flag)
    (hbo : b ≠ out) (hbt : b ≠ tmp) (hbf : b ≠ flag)
    (hot : out ≠ tmp) (hof : out ≠ flag) (htf : tmp ≠ flag)
    (s : Store K) (ht : s tmp = []) (hf : s flag = []) :
    ∃ t ≤ (s b).length*(7*(s a).length+25)+1,
      Eval (addLoop a b out tmp flag) s
        (update (update (update s a (addSplit (s a) (s b)).2) b []) out
          ((addSplit (s a) (s b)).1.reverse++s out)) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_emitLow
statement:
lemma eval_emitLow {a out : K} (hao : a ≠ out) (s : Store K) :

      (update (update s a (s a).tail) out ((s a).headD false::s out)) 2

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.wordValue_head_tail

lemma wordValue_head_tail (l : List Bool) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.bits_wordValue
statement: lemma bits_wordValue (l : List Bool) (h : Canonical l) : (wordValue l).bits = l

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.canonical_single
statement: lemma canonical_single {b : Bool} (h : Canonical [b]) : b = true

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.canonical_tail

statement:
lemma eval_normalize {a tmp flag : K} (hat : a ≠ tmp) (haf : a ≠ flag) (htf : tmp ≠ flag)
    (s : Store K) :
    ∃ t ≤ 7*(s a).length+2*(s tmp).length+2*(s flag).length+16,
      Eval (normalize a tmp flag) s
        (update (update (update s a (normalizeWord (s a))) tmp []) flag []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_trimLoop
statement:
lemma eval_trimLoop {a flag : K} (haf : a ≠ flag) (s : Store K) (hf : s flag = [true]) :
    ∃ t ≤ 3*(s a).length+6,
      Eval (trimLoop a flag) s (update (update s a (trimMSD (s a))) flag []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.normalizeWord_eq_bits
statement: @[simp] theorem normalizeWord_eq_bits (l : List Bool) : normalizeWord l = (wordValue l).bits

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.normalizeWord_length
statement: lemma normalizeWord_length (l : List Bool) : (normalizeWord l).length = (wordValue l).size

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.normalizeWord_value
statement: @[simp] theorem normalizeWord_value (l : List Bool) : wordValue (normalizeWord l) = wordValue l

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.trimMSD_length
statement: lemma trimMSD_length (l : List Bool) : (trimMSD l).length ≤ l.length

lemma trimMSD_reverse_value (l : List Bool) :
