name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.wordValue_append
statement:
lemma wordValue_append (a b : List Bool) :
    wordValue (a++b) = wordValue a + 2^a.length * wordValue b

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.bitNat_false
statement: @[simp] lemma bitNat_false : bitNat false = 0

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.digit_subtract
statement:
lemma digit_subtract (x y c : Bool) :
    bitNat x + 2*bitNat (borrowBit x y c) =
      bitNat (differenceBit x y c)+bitNat y+bitNat c

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_mulLoop
statement:
lemma eval_mulLoop (s : Store (Fin 8))
    (hf : ∀ k : Fin 8, 3 ≤ k.val → s k = []) (A C : ℕ)
    (hA : (s 0).length+(s 1).length ≤ A)
    (hC : (s 2).length+(s 1).length*((s 0).length+(s 1).length) ≤ C) :
    ∃ t ≤ (s 1).length*(A*(7*C+34)+23)+1,
      Eval mulLoop s
        (update (update (update s 0 (List.replicate (s 1).length false++s 0)) 1 [])
          2 (mulAccWord (s 0) (s 1) (s 2))) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_multiply
statement:
lemma eval_multiply (s : Store (Fin 8)) (hzero : s 2 = [])
    (hf : ∀ k : Fin 8, 3 ≤ k.val → s k = []) :
    let A := (s 0).length+(s 1).length
    let C := (s 1).length*A
    ∃ t ≤ (s 1).length*(A*(7*C+34)+23)+7*C+18,
      Eval multiply s
        (update (update (update s 0 (List.replicate (s 1).length false++s 0)) 1 [])
          2 (wordValue (s 0)*wordValue (s 1)).bits) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_readBit
statement:
lemma eval_readBit (k : K) (f : Bool → Program K) (s v : Store K) (t : ℕ)
    (h : Eval (f ((s k).headD false)) s v t) : Eval (readBit k f) s v (1+t)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_subtractDigit
statement:
lemma eval_subtractDigit (s : Store (Fin 5)) (c : Bool) (hc : s 3 = [c]) :
    Eval subtractDigit s
      (update (update (update (update s 0 (s 0).tail) 1 (s 1).tail)
        3 [borrowBit ((s 0).headD false) ((s 1).headD false) c])
        2 (differenceBit ((s 0).headD false) ((s 1).headD false) c :: s 2)) 12

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.mulAccWord_length
statement:
lemma mulAccWord_length (a b c : List Bool) :
    (mulAccWord a b c).length ≤ c.length+b.length*(a.length+b.length)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.mulAccWord_value
statement:
@[simp] theorem mulAccWord_value (a b c : List Bool) :
    wordValue (mulAccWord a b c) = wordValue c + wordValue a*wordValue b

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.product_bits_length
statement:
lemma product_bits_length (a b : List Bool) :
    (wordValue a * wordValue b).bits.length ≤ a.length+b.length

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.subtractWord_borrow
statement:
lemma subtractWord_borrow (a b : List Bool) :
    (subtractWord a b false).2 = true ↔ wordValue a < wordValue b

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.subtractWord_length
statement:
lemma subtractWord_length (a b : List Bool) (c : Bool) :
    (subtractWord a b c).1.length = max a.length b.length

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.subtractWord_nonnegative
statement:
lemma subtractWord_nonnegative {a b : List Bool} (h : wordValue b ≤ wordValue a) :
    (subtractWord a b false).2 = false ∧
      wordValue (subtractWord a b false).1 = wordValue a-wordValue b

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.subtractWord_value
statement:
lemma subtractWord_value (a b : List Bool) (c : Bool) :
    wordValue a + 2^(max a.length b.length)*bitNat (subtractWord a b c).2 =
      wordValue (subtractWord a b c).1 + wordValue b + bitNat c

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.wordValue_bit
statement: lemma wordValue_bit (x : Bool) (a : List Bool) : wordValue (x::a) = bitNat x+2*wordValue a

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.wordValue_lt
statement: lemma wordValue_lt (l : List Bool) : wordValue l < 2^l.length

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.wordValue_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma wordValue_nil : wordValue [] = 0

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Eval.rename
statement:
theorem Eval.rename {p : Program K} {s v : Store K} {t : ℕ} (h : Eval p s v t)
    (f : K → L) (hf : Injective f) (S : Store L) :
    Eval (p.rename f) (extend f s S) (extend f v S) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.bitNat_le_one
statement: lemma bitNat_le_one (x : Bool) : bitNat x ≤ 1

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.divideDigits_quotient_remainder
statement:
lemma divideDigits_quotient_remainder (a b : List Bool) (hb : 0<wordValue b) :
    wordValue (divideDigits b a.reverse [] []).1 = wordValue a % wordValue b ∧
    wordValue (divideDigits b a.reverse [] []).2 = wordValue a / wordValue b

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.divideDigits_spec
statement:
lemma divideDigits_spec (b l r q : List Bool) (hb : 0<wordValue b) (hr : wordValue r<wordValue b) :
    wordValue (divideDigits b l r q).1 < wordValue b ∧
    wordValue (divideDigits b l r q).2*wordValue b+wordValue (divideDigits b l r q).1 =
      (wordValue q*wordValue b+wordValue r)*2^l.length+wordValue l.reverse ∧
    (divideDigits b l r q).2.length = q.length+l.length ∧
    (divideDigits b l r q).1.length ≤ max r.length b.length

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_rename_from
statement:
lemma eval_rename_from (f : K → L) (hf : Injective f) (S : Store L)
    {p : Program K} {v : Store K} {t : ℕ} (h : Eval p (fun k => S (f k)) v t) :
    Eval (p.rename f) S (extend f v S) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_subtract
statement:
lemma eval_subtract (s : Store (Fin 5)) :
    ∃ t ≤ 17*((s 0).length+(s 1).length)+2*(s 2).length+2*(s 3).length+2*(s 4).length+19,
      Eval subtract s
        (update (update (update (update (update s 0 (subtractWord (s 0) (s 1) false).1) 1 []) 2 [])
          3 [(subtractWord (s 0) (s 1) false).2]) 4 []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_subtractLoop
statement:
lemma eval_subtractLoop (s : Store (Fin 5)) (c : Bool) (hc : s 3 = [c]) (hf : s 4 = [true]) :
    ∃ t ≤ 15*((s 0).length+(s 1).length)+7,
      Eval subtractLoop s (subFinish s c) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.extend_pull_store
statement:
lemma extend_pull_store {K L : Type} [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq L]
  (f : K → L) (hf : Function.Injective f) (S : RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Store L) :
  Function.extend f (fun k => S (f k)) S = S

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.extend_transfer_store
statement:
lemma extend_transfer_store (f : K → L) (hf : Injective f) (s : Store K) (S : Store L)
    (a b : K) :
    extend f (transfer a b s) S = transfer (f a) (f b) (extend f s S)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.extend_update_store
statement:
lemma extend_update_store (f : K → L) (hf : Injective f) (s : Store K) (S : Store L)
    (k : K) (w : List Bool) :
    extend f (update s k w) S = update (extend f s S) (f k) w

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.normalize_length_of_lt
statement:
lemma normalize_length_of_lt (a : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (h : wordValue a < 2^B) :
    (normalizeWord a).length ≤ B

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.reduceWord_spec
statement:
lemma reduceWord_spec (a b : List Bool) (_hb : 0<wordValue b)
    (ha : wordValue a < 2*wordValue b) :
    wordValue (reduceWord a b).1 < wordValue b ∧
    wordValue (reduceWord a b).1+bitNat (reduceWord a b).2*wordValue b = wordValue a ∧
    (reduceWord a b).1.length ≤ b.length

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_divBody
statement:
lemma eval_divBody (s : Store (Fin 10)) (hs : divScratch s) (x : Bool) (l : List Bool)
    (h6 : s 6=x::l) :
    ∃ t ≤ 110*((s 0).length+(s 5).length+2),
      Eval divBody s (update (update (update s 6 l) 0 (reduceWord (x::s 0) (s 5)).1)
        7 ((reduceWord (x::s 0) (s 5)).2::s 7)) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_divLoop
statement:
lemma eval_divLoop (s : Store (Fin 10)) (hs : divScratch s)
    (hb : 0<wordValue (s 5)) (hr : wordValue (s 0)<wordValue (s 5))
    (B : ℕ) (hB : (s 0).length ≤ B) (hbB : (s 5).length ≤ B) :
    ∃ t ≤ (s 6).length*(250*(B+1))+1,
      Eval divLoop s
        (update (update (update s 6 []) 0 (divideDigits (s 5) (s 6) (s 0) (s 7)).1)
          7 (divideDigits (s 5) (s 6) (s 0) (s 7)).2) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_divide
statement:
lemma eval_divide (s : Store (Fin 10)) (hs : divScratch s) (h6 : s 6=[]) (h7 : s 7=[])
    (hb : 0<wordValue (s 5)) :
    ∃ t ≤ 300*((s 0).length+1)*((s 5).length+1)+30,
      Eval divide s (update (update s 0 (wordValue (s 0)%wordValue (s 5)).bits)
        7 (wordValue (s 0)/wordValue (s 5)).bits) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_reduceOnce
statement:
lemma eval_reduceOnce (s : Store (Fin 10)) (hs : divScratch s) :
    ∃ t ≤ 100*((s 0).length+(s 5).length+1),
      Eval reduceOnce s (update (update s 0 (reduceWord (s 0) (s 5)).1)
        7 ((reduceWord (s 0) (s 5)).2::s 7)) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_reducePick
statement:
lemma eval_reducePick (s : Store (Fin 10)) (c : Bool) (hc : s 3 = [c]) (h9 : s 9 = []) :
    ∃ t ≤ 7*(s 8).length+2*(s 0).length+10,
      Eval reducePick s
        (update (update s 0 (if c then s 8 else s 0)) 7 ((!c)::s 7)) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_subtract10
statement:
lemma eval_subtract10 (s : Store (Fin 10)) :
    ∃ t ≤ 17*((s 0).length+(s 1).length)+2*(s 2).length+2*(s 3).length+2*(s 4).length+19,
      Eval subtract10 s
        (update (update (update (update (update s 0 (subtractWord (s 0) (s 1) false).1) 1 []) 2 [])
          3 [(subtractWord (s 0) (s 1) false).2]) 4 []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.wordValue_bits
statement: @[simp] lemma wordValue_bits (n : ℕ) : wordValue n.bits=n

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_fractionGcd
statement:
lemma eval_fractionGcd (s : Store (Fin 12)) (hs : fractionScratch s)
    (hcan0 : (wordValue (s 0)).bits=s 0) (hcan5 : (wordValue (s 5)).bits=s 5)
    (B : ℕ) (h0 : (s 0).length≤B) (h5 : (s 5).length≤B) :
    ∃ t ≤ (2*B+1)*(500*(B+1)^2+1)+1,
      Eval (gcdLoop.rename fractionArith) s
        (update (update s 0 (Nat.gcd (wordValue (s 0)) (wordValue (s 5))).bits) 5 []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_fractionQuotient
statement:
lemma eval_fractionQuotient (s : Store (Fin 12)) (hs : fractionScratch s)
    (hb : 0<wordValue (s 5)) (B : ℕ) (h0 : (s 0).length≤B) (h5 : (s 5).length≤B) :
    ∃ t ≤ 400*(B+1)^2,
      Eval (quotient.rename fractionArith) s
        (update s 0 (wordValue (s 0)/wordValue (s 5)).bits) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_gcdBody
statement:
lemma eval_gcdBody (s : Store (Fin 10)) (hs : gcdScratch s) (hb : 0<wordValue (s 5))
    (B : ℕ) (h0 : (s 0).length ≤ B) (h5 : (s 5).length ≤ B) :
    ∃ t ≤ 500*(B+1)^2,
      Eval gcdBody s (update (update s 0 (s 5)) 5 (wordValue (s 0)%wordValue (s 5)).bits) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_gcdLoop
statement:
lemma eval_gcdLoop (s : Store (Fin 10)) (hs : gcdScratch s)
    (hcan0 : (wordValue (s 0)).bits=s 0) (hcan5 : (wordValue (s 5)).bits=s 5)
    (B : ℕ) (h0 : (s 0).length≤B) (h5 : (s 5).length≤B) :
    ∃ t ≤ (2*B+1)*(500*(B+1)^2+1)+1,
      Eval gcdLoop s (update (update s 0 (Nat.gcd (wordValue (s 0)) (wordValue (s 5))).bits) 5 []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_gcdLoop_ordered
statement:
lemma eval_gcdLoop_ordered (f : ℕ) (s : Store (Fin 10)) (hs : gcdScratch s)
    (hcan0 : (wordValue (s 0)).bits=s 0) (hcan5 : (wordValue (s 5)).bits=s 5)
    (hab : wordValue (s 5)≤wordValue (s 0))
    (hf : wordValue (s 0)*wordValue (s 5)<2^f)
    (B : ℕ) (h0 : (s 0).length≤B) (h5 : (s 5).length≤B) :
    ∃ t ≤ f*(500*(B+1)^2+1)+1,
      Eval gcdLoop s (update (update s 0 (Nat.gcd (wordValue (s 0)) (wordValue (s 5))).bits) 5 []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_quotient
statement:
lemma eval_quotient (s : Store (Fin 10)) (hs : gcdScratch s)
    (hb : 0<wordValue (s 5)) (B : ℕ) (h0 : (s 0).length≤B) (h5 : (s 5).length≤B) :
    ∃ t ≤ 400*(B+1)^2,
      Eval quotient s (update s 0 (wordValue (s 0)/wordValue (s 5)).bits) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.fractionArith_val
statement: @[simp] lemma fractionArith_val (i : Fin 10) : (fractionArith i).val=i.val

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.fractionScratch_gcd
statement:
lemma fractionScratch_gcd (s : Store (Fin 12)) (hs : fractionScratch s) :
    gcdScratch (fun k => s (fractionArith k))

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.fractionScratch_update
statement:
lemma fractionScratch_update (s : Store (Fin 12)) (hs : fractionScratch s)
    (i : Fin 12) (hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 5 ∨ 10 ≤ i.val) (w : List Bool) :
    fractionScratch (update s i w)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.gcd_product_halving
statement:
lemma gcd_product_halving {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0<a) (hab : a≤b) :
    2*(a*(b%a)) ≤ a*b

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Binomial.eval_factorBlock
statement:
lemma eval_factorBlock (a b : Fin 18) (ha : 10≤a.val) (hb : 10≤b.val)
    (ha17 : a≠17) (hb17 : b≠17) (s : Store (Fin 18)) (hs : lowEmpty s) (h17 : s 17=[]) :
    ∃ t≤factorCost (s a).length (s b).length,
      Eval (factorBlock a b) s (update s b (s a).length.factorial.bits) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Binomial.eval_prepare
statement: lemma eval_prepare (n k : ℕ) : Eval prepare (input n k) (prepared n k) (7*n+12*k+17)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Binomial.lowEmpty_input
statement: lemma lowEmpty_input (n k : ℕ) : lowEmpty (input n k)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Binomial.lowEmpty_prepared
statement: lemma lowEmpty_prepared (n k : ℕ) : lowEmpty (prepared n k)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Binomial.lowEmpty_update
statement:
lemma lowEmpty_update (s : Store (Fin 18)) (hs : lowEmpty s) (j : Fin 18) (hj : 10≤j.val) (w : List Bool) :
    lowEmpty (update s j w)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_factorMul
statement:
lemma eval_factorMul (s : Store (Fin 10)) (hf : ∀ k : Fin 10, 2≤k.val → k.val<8 → s k=[])
    (B : ℕ) (ha : (s 0).length≤B) (hb : (s 1).length≤B) :
    ∃ t≤200*(B+1)^4, Eval (multiplyClean.rename factorMul) s
      (update (update s 0 (wordValue (s 0)*wordValue (s 1)).bits) 1 []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_factorial
statement:
theorem eval_factorial (n : ℕ) (s : Store (Fin 10))
    (hf : factorialScratch s) (h0 : s 0=[true]) (h8 : s 8=[true])
    (h9 : (s 9).length=n) :
    ∃ t≤n*(300*(1+n*(1+n)+1)^4+1)+1, ∃ v,
      Eval factorialLoop s v t ∧ v 0=n.factorial.bits ∧
      wordValue (v 8)=n+1 ∧ v 9=[] ∧ factorialScratch v

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_factorialBody
statement:
lemma eval_factorialBody (s : Store (Fin 10)) (hf : factorialScratch s)
    (B : ℕ) (h0 : (s 0).length≤B) (h8 : (s 8).length≤B) :
    ∃ t≤300*(B+1)^4, Eval factorialBody s
      (update (update (update s 0 (wordValue (s 0)*wordValue (s 8)).bits)
        8 (incrementWord (s 8))) 9 (s 9).tail) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_factorialCore
statement:
lemma eval_factorialCore (s : Store (Fin 10))
    (hs : ∀ k : Fin 10, k.val<9 → s k=[]) :
    ∃ t≤(s 9).length*(300*(1+(s 9).length*(1+(s 9).length)+1)^4+1)+2*(s 9).length+10,
    Eval factorialCore s (update (update s 0 (s 9).length.factorial.bits) 9 []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_factorialLoop
statement:
lemma eval_factorialLoop (n L : ℕ) (s : Store (Fin 10))
    (hf : factorialScratch s) (hcan : (wordValue (s 0)).bits=s 0)
    (hn : (s 9).length=n)
    (hp : (s 0).length+n*((s 8).length+n)≤L)
    (hi : (s 8).length+n≤L) :
    ∃ t≤n*(300*(L+1)^4+1)+1, ∃ v,
      Eval factorialLoop s v t ∧
      v 0 = (wordValue (s 0)*(wordValue (s 8)).ascFactorial n).bits ∧
      wordValue (v 8)=wordValue (s 8)+n ∧ v 9=[] ∧ factorialScratch v ∧
      (v 8).length≤(s 8).length+n

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_multiplyClean
statement:
lemma eval_multiplyClean (s : Store (Fin 8)) (hf : ∀ k : Fin 8, 2≤k.val → s k=[])
    (B : ℕ) (ha : (s 0).length≤B) (hb : (s 1).length≤B) :
    ∃ t≤200*(B+1)^4, Eval multiplyClean s
      (update (update s 0 (wordValue (s 0)*wordValue (s 1)).bits) 1 []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_unaryDiff
statement:
theorem eval_unaryDiff {a b flag : K} (hab : a≠b) (haf : a≠flag) (hbf : b≠flag)
    (s : Store K) :
    Eval (unaryDiff a b flag) s
      (update (update (update s a ((s a).drop (s b).length)) b [])
        flag (List.replicate ((s b).length-(s a).length) true++s flag))
      (5*(s b).length+1)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.factorial_bits_length
statement: lemma factorial_bits_length (n : ℕ) : n.factorial.bits.length≤1+n*(n+1)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.factorial_wordValue_bits
statement: @[simp] lemma factorial_wordValue_bits (n : ℕ) : wordValue n.bits=n

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Binomial.cost_bound
statement: lemma cost_bound (n k : ℕ) : cost n k≤3000000*(n+k+1)^10

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Binomial.eval_allFactors
statement:
lemma eval_allFactors (n k : ℕ) :
    ∃ t≤factorCost n 0+factorCost k 0+factorCost (n-k) 0+2,
      Eval allFactors (prepared n k) (factored n k) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Binomial.eval_choose
statement:
theorem eval_choose (n k : ℕ) : ∃ t≤cost n k,

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Binomial.eval_choose_polynomial
statement:
theorem eval_choose_polynomial (n k : ℕ) : ∃ t≤3000000*(n+k+1)^10,
    Eval choose (input n k) (update (input n k) 0 (n.choose k).bits) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Binomial.eval_cleanMul
statement:
lemma eval_cleanMul (s : Store (Fin 18))
    (hs : ∀ j : Fin 18, 2≤j.val → j.val<8 → s j=[])
    (B : ℕ) (h0 : (s 0).length≤B) (h1 : (s 1).length≤B) :
    ∃ t≤200*(B+1)^4, Eval cleanMul s
      (update (update s 0 (wordValue (s 0)*wordValue (s 1)).bits) 1 []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Binomial.eval_cleanQuotient
statement:
lemma eval_cleanQuotient (s : Store (Fin 18))

    (s : Store (Fin 18)) (h17 : s 17=[]) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Binomial.eval_ratio
statement:
lemma eval_ratio (n k : ℕ) (hk : k≤n) :

      (update (input n k) 0 (n.choose k).bits) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Binomial.factorCost_bound
statement: lemma factorCost_bound (j R : ℕ) (hR : 1≤R) (hj : j≤R) : factorCost j 0≤77000*R^10

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Binomial.width_bound
statement: lemma width_bound (n k R : ℕ) (hR : 1≤R) (hn : n≤R) (hk : k≤R) : width n k≤9*R^2

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.codeArray_append
statement:
@[simp] lemma codeArray_append (u v : List (List Bool)) :
    codeArray (u++v) = codeArray u++codeArray v

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.codeArray_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma codeArray_cons (w : List Bool) (ws : List (List Bool)) :
    codeArray (w::ws) = codeWord w++codeArray ws

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.codeArray_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma codeArray_nil : codeArray [] = []

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.codeArray_nonempty
statement: lemma codeArray_nonempty (w : List Bool) (ws : List (List Bool)) : codeArray (w::ws) ≠ []

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.codeArray_reverse_length
statement:
@[simp] lemma codeArray_reverse_length (ws : List (List Bool)) :
    (codeArray ws.reverse).length = (codeArray ws).length

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.codeWord_length
statement: @[simp] theorem codeWord_length (w : List Bool) : (codeWord w).length = 2*w.length+1

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.codeWord_pair
statement: lemma codeWord_pair (w : List Bool) : codeWord w = pairWord w++[true]

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_arrayRead
statement:
theorem eval_arrayRead (pre post : List (List Bool)) (w : List Bool) (s : Store (Fin 8))
    (h0 : s 0 = codeArray (pre++w::post)) (h1 : s 1 = [])
    (h2 : s 2 = []) (h3 : s 3 = []) (h4 : s 4 = List.replicate pre.length true)
    (h5 : s 5 = []) (h6 : s 6 = []) (h7 : s 7 = []) :
    ∃ t ≤ 50*(s 0).length+30,
      Eval arrayRead s (update (update s 4 []) 5 w) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_packLoop
statement:
lemma eval_packLoop (a b : Fin 3) (hab : a ≠ b) (s : Store (Fin 3)) :
    Eval (packLoop a b) s (update (update s a []) b (pairWord (s a).reverse++s b))
      (4*(s a).length+1)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_packRecord
statement:
lemma eval_packRecord (s : Store (Fin 3)) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_peekRecord
statement:
lemma eval_peekRecord (w tail : List Bool) (s : Store (Fin 8))
    (h0 : s 0 = codeWord w++tail) (h2 : s 2 = []) (h3 : s 3 = [])
    (h5 : s 5 = []) (h6 : s 6 = []) (h7 : s 7 = []) :
    Eval peekRecord s (update s 5 w) (18*w.length+22)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_recordMove
statement:
lemma eval_recordMove (w tail : List Bool) (s : Store (Fin 4))
    (h0 : s 0 = codeWord w++tail) (h2 : s 2 = []) (h3 : s 3 = []) :
    Eval recordMove s (update (update s 0 tail) 1 (codeWord w++s 1)) (9*w.length+12)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_recordMove_rename
statement:
lemma eval_recordMove_rename {K : Type} [DecidableEq K] (f : Fin 4 ↪ K)
    (w tail : List Bool) (s : Store K)
    (h0 : s (f 0) = codeWord w++tail) (h2 : s (f 2) = []) (h3 : s (f 3) = []) :
    Eval (recordMove.rename f) s
      (update (update s (f 0) tail) (f 1) (codeWord w++s (f 1))) (9*w.length+12)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_restore
statement:
lemma eval_restore (ws : List (List Bool)) (s : Store (Fin 8))
    (h1 : s 1 = codeArray ws) (h2 : s 2 = []) (h3 : s 3 = []) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_scan

lemma eval_scan (pre : List (List Bool)) (tail : List Bool) (s : Store (Fin 8))
    (h0 : s 0 = codeArray pre++tail) (h4 : s 4 = List.replicate pre.length true)
    (h2 : s 2 = []) (h3 : s 3 = []) :
    Eval scan s (update (update (update s 0 tail) 1 (codeArray pre.reverse++s 1)) 4 [])
      (scanCost pre)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_unpackLoop
statement:
lemma eval_unpackLoop (w tail : List Bool) (s : Store (Fin 3))
    (h0 : s 0 = codeWord w++tail) (h2 : s 2 = [true]) :
    Eval (Program.loop 2 unpackBody) s
      (update (update (update s 0 tail) 1 (w.reverse++s 1)) 2 []) (5*w.length+6)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_unpackRecord
statement:
lemma eval_unpackRecord (w tail : List Bool) (s : Store (Fin 3))
    (h0 : s 0 = codeWord w++tail) (h2 : s 2 = []) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.pairWord_append

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.pairWord_nil

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.restoreCost_bound

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.scanCost_bound

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.absoluteWord_length

lemma absoluteWord_length (a b : List Bool) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.absoluteWord_value

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_absolutize
statement:
lemma eval_absolutize (s : Store (Fin 5)) (c : Bool) (h3 : s 3=[c]) (h1 : s 1=[]) (h2 : s 2=[]) :
    ∃ t ≤ 30*(s 0).length+52, Eval absolutize s
      (update s 0 (wordValue (if c then incrementWord ((s 0).map Bool.not) else s 0)).bits) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_arrayWrite
statement:
theorem eval_arrayWrite (pre post : List (List Bool)) (old new : List Bool) (s : Store (Fin 8))
    (h0 : s 0 = codeArray (pre++old::post)) (h1 : s 1 = [])
    (h2 : s 2 = []) (h3 : s 3 = []) (h4 : s 4 = List.replicate pre.length true)
    (h5 : s 5 = new) :
    ∃ t ≤ 40*(s 0).length+6*new.length+30,
      Eval arrayWrite s (update (update (update s 0 (codeArray (pre++new::post))) 4 []) 5 []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_flipReverse
statement:
lemma eval_flipReverse {a b : K} (hab : a≠b) (s : Store K) :
    Eval (flipReverse a b) s
      (update (update s a []) b (((s a).map Bool.not).reverse ++ s b))
      (5*(s a).length+1)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_flipWord
statement:
lemma eval_flipWord {a b : K} (hab : a≠b) (s : Store K) (hb : s b=[]) :
    Eval (flipWord a b) s (update s a ((s a).map Bool.not)) (7*(s a).length+3)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_powerBody
statement:
lemma eval_powerBody (s : Store (Fin 10)) (hf : factorialScratch s)
    (B : ℕ) (h0 : (s 0).length≤B) (h8 : (s 8).length≤B) :
    ∃ t≤250*(B+1)^4, Eval powerBody s
      (update (update s 0 (wordValue (s 0)*wordValue (s 8)).bits) 9 (s 9).tail) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_powerCore
statement:
theorem eval_powerCore (s : Store (Fin 10)) (hf : factorialScratch s) (h0 : s 0=[])
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (s 9).length=n) :
    ∃ t≤n*(250*(2+(n+1)*(s 8).length)^4+1)+3,
      Eval powerCore s (update (update s 0 (wordValue (s 8)^n).bits) 9 []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_powerLoop
statement:
lemma eval_powerLoop (n B : ℕ) (s : Store (Fin 10))
    (hf : factorialScratch s) (hcan : (wordValue (s 0)).bits=s 0)
    (hn : (s 9).length=n) (hp : (s 0).length+n*(s 8).length≤B)
    (hb : (s 8).length≤B) :
    ∃ t≤n*(250*(B+1)^4+1)+1, Eval powerLoop s
      (update (update s 0 (wordValue (s 0)*wordValue (s 8)^n).bits) 9 []) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_replaceRecord
statement:
lemma eval_replaceRecord (old new tail : List Bool) (s : Store (Fin 8))
    (h0 : s 0 = codeWord old++tail) (h2 : s 2 = []) (h3 : s 3 = [])
    (h5 : s 5 = new) :
    Eval replaceRecord s (update (update s 0 (codeWord new++tail)) 5 [])
      (7*old.length+6*new.length+16)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_signedDifference
statement:
lemma eval_signedDifference (s : Store (Fin 5)) (h2 : s 2=[]) (h3 : s 3=[]) (h4 : s 4=[]) :
    ∃ t ≤ 100*((s 0).length+(s 1).length+1), Eval signedDifference s
      (update (update (update s 0 (((wordValue (s 0):ℤ)-(wordValue (s 1):ℤ)).natAbs).bits) 1 [])
        3 [decide (wordValue (s 0)<wordValue (s 1))]) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.wordValue_complement
statement:
lemma wordValue_complement (w : List Bool) :
    wordValue (w.map Bool.not)+wordValue w+1=2^w.length

name: OAI.RationalHitting.RationalCanonical.divInt_den
statement:
lemma divInt_den (a b : ℤ) (hb : b≠0) :
    (Rat.divInt a b).den = b.natAbs/Nat.gcd a.natAbs b.natAbs

name: OAI.RationalHitting.RationalCanonical.divInt_num_abs
statement:
lemma divInt_num_abs (a b : ℤ) (hb : b≠0) :

statement: lemma denominatorReg_inj : Injective denominatorReg

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.digits_bool_bits

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.encodedWord_bits

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_copy9
statement:
lemma eval_copy9 (s : Store (Fin 12)) (a b : Fin 12)
    (hab : a≠b) (ha : a≠9) (hb : b≠9) (h9 : s 9=[]) :

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_encodeWord
statement:
lemma eval_encodeWord (s : Store (Fin 4)) (h2 : s 2=[]) (h3 : s 3=[]) :

      (11*(s 0).length+7)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_encodeWord_rename
statement:
lemma eval_encodeWord_rename {K : Type} [DecidableEq K] (f : Fin 4 → K)
    (hf : Injective f) (s : Store K) (h2 : s (f 2)=[]) (h3 : s (f 3)=[]) :
    Eval (encodeWord.rename f) s
      (update (update s (f 0) []) (f 1) (encodedWord (s (f 0))++s (f 1)))
      (11*(s (f 0)).length+7)

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_fractionReduce
statement:
lemma eval_fractionReduce (s : Store (Fin 12)) (hs : fractionScratch s)
    (h10 : s 10=[]) (h11 : s 11=[])
    (hcan0 : (wordValue (s 0)).bits=s 0) (hcan5 : (wordValue (s 5)).bits=s 5)
    (hb : 0<wordValue (s 5)) (B : ℕ) (h0 : (s 0).length≤B) (h5 : (s 5).length≤B) :
    ∃ t ≤ 3000*(B+1)^3,
      Eval fractionReduce s
        (update (update s 0 (wordValue (s 0)/Nat.gcd (wordValue (s 0)) (wordValue (s 5))).bits)
          5 (wordValue (s 5)/Nat.gcd (wordValue (s 0)) (wordValue (s 5))).bits) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_fractionReduce_rename
statement:
lemma eval_fractionReduce_rename {K : Type} [DecidableEq K] (f : Fin 12 → K)
    (hf : Injective f) (s : Store K) (hs : fractionScratch (fun k => s (f k)))
    (h10 : s (f 10)=[]) (h11 : s (f 11)=[]) (A D B : ℕ)
    (h0 : s (f 0)=A.bits) (h5 : s (f 5)=D.bits) (hD : 0<D)
    (ha : A.bits.length≤B) (hd : D.bits.length≤B) :
    ∃ t ≤ 3000*(B+1)^3, Eval (fractionReduce.rename f) s
      (update (update s (f 0) (A/Nat.gcd A D).bits) (f 5) (D/Nat.gcd A D).bits) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_fractionSign
statement:
lemma eval_fractionSign (s : Store (Fin 16)) (a b : Bool) (h12 : s 12=[a]) (h13 : s 13=[b]) :
    ∃ t ≤ 4, Eval fractionSign s
      (update s 15 ((if s 0=[] then false else a ^^ b)::s 15)) t

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.eval_rationalEncode
statement:
theorem eval_rationalEncode (s : Store (Fin 16)) (a b : ℤ) (hb : b≠0)
    (h0 : s 0=a.natAbs.bits) (h5 : s 5=b.natAbs.bits)
    (h12 : s 12=[decide (a<0)]) (h13 : s 13=[decide (b<0)]) (h15 : s 15=[])
    (hs : ∀ i : Fin 16, i.val<12 → i≠0 → i≠5 → s i=[])
    (B : ℕ) (ha : a.natAbs.bits.length≤B) (hd : b.natAbs.bits.length≤B) :
    ∃ t ≤ 3100*(B+1)^3, Eval rationalEncode s
      (update (update (update s 0 []) 5 []) 14 (encodeRat (Rat.divInt a b)++s 14)) t

lemma eval_unaryLength {a b : K} (hab : a≠b) (s : Store K) :

      (update (update s a []) b (List.replicate (s a).length true ++ s b))
      (4*(s a).length+1)

      (TimeBound.variable*(2*p.bound+4)).eval

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Runtime.liftTerm_eq
statement:
lemma liftTerm_eq (N e : ℕ) (a t p r : ℤ)
    (u v x y k : ZMod (CyclotomicRing.dimension e)) (i j : Fin (CyclotomicRing.degree e)) :
    liftTerm (CyclotomicRing.dimension e) N (CyclotomicRing.degree e) a t p r
      u.val v.val i.val j.val x.val y.val k.val =
      if u=v+y then Generator.integerTest N e a t k (k-y)*
        CyclotomicRing.signedEntry e (-x*k+x*u) i j*p^x.val*r^y.val else 0

name: OAI.RationalHitting.StackLanguage.Runtime.lift_eq

    lift (CyclotomicRing.dimension e) N (CyclotomicRing.degree e) a t p r
      u.val v.val i.val j.val=
      IntegralLift.entry e (Generator.integerTest N e a t) p r u v i j

theorem first_long_of_not_short (D : Layer V A p) (q : ℕ) (h : ¬ D.HasShort q)
    (x : ℤ) : (q : ℤ) < D.first x - x

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Layer.first_shift
statement:
@[simp] theorem first_shift (D : Layer V A p) (x : ℤ) :
    D.first (x + p) = D.first x + p

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Layer.first_shift_int
statement:
theorem first_shift_int (L : Layer V A p) (m x : ℤ) :
    L.first (x + m * p) = L.first x + m * p

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Layer.full_turn
statement:
theorem full_turn (L : Layer V A p) (closed : SubstringClosed V) (hp : 0 < p)
    (per : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x) (t : ℤ) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A t (L.first t)) (textWord A t (L.first t)),
      P.cost = p ∧ ∀ x e, L.first x ≤ e → e ≤ L.last x →
        P.Visits (textWord A x e)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Layer.last_actual
statement: theorem last_actual (D : Layer V A p) (x : ℤ) : textWord A x (D.last x) ∈ V

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Layer.last_shift
statement:
@[simp] theorem last_shift (D : Layer V A p) (x : ℤ) :
    D.last (x + p) = D.last x + p

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Layer.meets_height
statement:
theorem meets_height (D : Layer V A p) (a Y : ℤ) (K : ℕ)
    (hfirst : D.first a ≤ Y) (hlast : Y ≤ D.last (a + K)) :
    ∃ x : ℤ, a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ a + K ∧ D.first x ≤ Y ∧ Y ≤ D.last x

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Layer.passage
statement:
theorem passage (L : Layer V A p) (closed : SubstringClosed V) (x : ℤ) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A x (L.first x))
        (textWord A (x + 1) (L.first (x + 1))),
      P.cost = (L.first (x + 1) - L.first x).toNat ∧
      ∀ e, L.first x ≤ e → e ≤ L.last x → P.Visits (textWord A x e)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Layer.segment
statement:
theorem segment (L : Layer V A p) (closed : SubstringClosed V) (t : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A t (L.first t))
        (textWord A (t + n) (L.first (t + n))),
      P.cost = (L.first (t + n) - L.first t).toNat ∧
      ∀ x e, t ≤ x → x < t + n → L.first x ≤ e → e ≤ L.last x →
        P.Visits (textWord A x e)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Layer.shift_int
statement:
theorem shift_int (L : Layer V A p) (m x : ℤ) :
    L.z (x + m * p) = L.z x + m * p

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Layer.shift_mul
statement:
theorem shift_mul (D : Layer V A p) (k : ℕ) (x : ℤ) :
    D.z (x + (k * p : ℕ)) = D.z x + (k * p : ℕ)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Layer.start_le_first
statement: theorem start_le_first (D : Layer V A p) (x : ℤ) : x ≤ D.first x

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Layer.turn
statement:
theorem turn (L : Layer V A p) (closed : SubstringClosed V)
    (per : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x) (t : ℤ) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A t (L.first t)) (textWord A t (L.first t)),
      P.cost = p ∧
      ∀ x e, t ≤ x → x < t + p → L.first x ≤ e → e ≤ L.last x →
        P.Visits (textWord A x e)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Loop.attach
statement:
theorem attach {ι : Type} (F : ι → Loop V) (I : Finset ι) (P : Loop V)
    (hmeet : ∀ i ∈ I, P.Meets (F i)) :
    ∃ Q : Loop V, Q.base = P.base ∧ Q.cost ≤ P.cost + ∑ i ∈ I, (F i).cost ∧
      (∀ w, P.Visits w → Q.Visits w) ∧
      (∀ i ∈ I, ∀ w, (F i).Visits w → Q.Visits w)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Loop.of_connected
statement:
theorem of_connected {ι : Type} (F : ι → Loop V) (I : Finset ι) (root : List α)
    (hroot : root ∈ V) (hconn : Connected F I root) :
    ∃ P : Path V root root, P.cost ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, (F i).cost ∧
      ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ w, (F i).Visits w → P.Visits w

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Loop.root_at
statement:
theorem root_at (closed : SubstringClosed V) (P : Loop V) (w : List α)
    (hw : P.Visits w) :
    ∃ Q : Path V [] [], Q.cost = P.cost + w.length ∧
      ∀ v, P.Visits v → Q.Visits v

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Loop.root_attachments
statement:
theorem root_attachments {ι : Type} (closed : SubstringClosed V)
    (P : Loop V) (F : ι → Loop V) (I : Finset ι) (p₀ : ℕ)
    (hmeet : ∀ i ∈ I, P.Meets (F i))
    (hshort : ∃ w, P.Visits w ∧ w.length ≤ p₀) :
    ∃ Q : Path V [] [], Q.cost ≤ P.cost + (∑ i ∈ I, (F i).cost) + p₀ ∧
      (∀ w, P.Visits w → Q.Visits w) ∧
      (∀ i ∈ I, ∀ w, (F i).Visits w → Q.Visits w)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Loop.saturate
statement:
theorem saturate {ι : Type} (F : ι → Loop V) (I : Finset ι) (P : Loop V) :
    ∃ Q : Loop V, Q.base = P.base ∧ Q.cost ≤ P.cost + ∑ i ∈ I, (F i).cost ∧
      (∀ w, P.Visits w → Q.Visits w) ∧
      (∀ i ∈ I, Q.Meets (F i) → ∀ w, (F i).Visits w → Q.Visits w) ∧
      (∀ w, Q.Visits w → P.Visits w ∨ ∃ i ∈ I, (F i).Visits w)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.appendSuffix_visits
statement:
theorem appendSuffix_visits (closed : SubstringClosed V) (a b c : List α)
    (h : a ++ (b ++ c) ∈ V) :
    (appendSuffix closed a (b ++ c) h).Visits (a ++ b)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.cost_appendSuffix
statement:
@[simp] theorem cost_appendSuffix (closed : SubstringClosed V) (a b : List α)
    (h : a ++ b ∈ V) : (appendSuffix closed a b h).cost = b.length

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.cost_copy
statement:
@[simp] theorem cost_copy (P : Path V s t) {s' t' : List α}
    (hs : s = s') (ht : t = t') : (P.copy hs ht).cost = P.cost

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.cost_deletePrefix
statement:
@[simp] theorem cost_deletePrefix (closed : SubstringClosed V) (a b : List α)
    (h : a ++ b ∈ V) : (deletePrefix closed a b h).cost = 0

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.cost_readGap
statement:
@[simp] theorem cost_readGap (h0 : ([] : List α) ∈ V) (w : List α)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ w, [a] ∈ V) : (readGap h0 w h).cost = w.length

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.cost_trans
statement:
@[simp] theorem cost_trans (P : Path V s t) (Q : Path V t u) :
    (P.trans Q).cost = P.cost + Q.cost

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.deletePrefix_visits
statement:
theorem deletePrefix_visits (closed : SubstringClosed V) (a b c : List α)
    (h : (a ++ b) ++ c ∈ V) :
    (deletePrefix closed (a ++ b) c h).Visits (b ++ c)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.end_suffix_written
statement: theorem end_suffix_written (P : Path V s t) : t <:+ s ++ P.written

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.length_written
statement: @[simp] theorem length_written (P : Path V s t) : P.written.length = P.cost

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.mem_of_visits
statement: theorem mem_of_visits (P : Path V s t) {w} (h : P.Visits w) : w ∈ V

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.root_loop
statement:
theorem root_loop (closed : SubstringClosed V) (w : List α) (hw : w ∈ V) :
    ∃ P : Path V [] [], P.cost = w.length ∧ P.Visits w

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.rotate
statement:
theorem rotate (P : Path V s s) {w : List α} (hw : P.Visits w) :
    ∃ Q : Path V w w, Q.cost = P.cost ∧ ∀ v, Q.Visits v ↔ P.Visits v

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.splice
statement:
theorem splice (P : Path V s s) (Q : Path V t t) (w : List α)
    (hP : P.Visits w) (hQ : Q.Visits w) :
    ∃ R : Path V s s, R.cost = P.cost + Q.cost ∧
      ∀ v, R.Visits v ↔ P.Visits v ∨ Q.Visits v

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.split
statement:
theorem split (P : Path V s t) {w : List α} (hw : P.Visits w) :
    ∃ (U : Path V s w) (D : Path V w t),
      U.cost + D.cost = P.cost ∧
      ∀ v, P.Visits v ↔ U.Visits v ∨ D.Visits v

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.visited_infix_written
statement:
theorem visited_infix_written (P : Path V s t) {w : List α} (hw : P.Visits w) :
    w <:+: s ++ P.written

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.visits_copy
statement:
@[simp] theorem visits_copy (P : Path V s t) {s' t' : List α}
    (hs : s = s') (ht : t = t') (w : List α) : (P.copy hs ht).Visits w ↔ P.Visits w

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.visits_end
statement: @[simp] theorem visits_end (P : Path V s t) : P.Visits t

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.Path.visits_start
statement: @[simp] theorem visits_start (P : Path V s t) : P.Visits s

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.agreement_bound
statement:
theorem agreement_bound (A D : ℤ → α) (p q : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hA : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x) (hD : ∀ x, D (x + q) = D x)
    (hne : A ≠ D) (a b : ℤ) (h : AgreeOn A D a b) : b - a < p + q

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.collective_link
statement:
theorem collective_link {V : Set (List α)} (closed : SubstringClosed V)
    (A : ℤ → α) (letters : ∀ x, [A x] ∈ V) (p k : ℕ)
    (per : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x)
    {ι : Type} (L : ι → Layer V A p) (lo hi : ι)
    (hlo : ∀ i x, (L lo).z x ≤ (L i).z x)
    (hhi : ∀ i x, (L i).z x ≤ (L hi).z x)
    {a b : ℤ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hR : textWord A a b ∈ V)
    (h₁ : (L hi).first a ≤ b + (k * p : ℕ))
    (h₂ : (L hi).first a - (L lo).last a ≤ (k * p : ℕ))
    (h₃ : b ≤ (L lo).last a + (k * p : ℕ)) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A a b) (textWord A a b),
      P.cost = k * p ∧ ∀ i, (L i).TouchedBy P

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.collective_short_sweep
statement:
theorem collective_short_sweep {V : Set (List α)} (closed : SubstringClosed V)
    (A : ℤ → α) (letters : ∀ x, [A x] ∈ V) (p k q : ℕ)
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) (per : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x)
    {ι : Type} (L : ι → Layer V A p) (hi : ι)
    (hhi : ∀ i x, (L i).z x ≤ (L hi).z x)
    (hlong : ∀ i, ¬ (L i).HasShort q)
    {a b t : ℤ} (hat : a ≤ t) (htb : t < b)
    (hR : textWord A a b ∈ V)
    (hH : (L hi).first t ≤ b + (k * p : ℕ))
    (hlen : b - a < p + q) (hagr : b - t < q) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A a b) (textWord A a b),
      P.cost = k * p ∧ (∀ i, (L i).TouchedBy P) ∧
      ∃ w, P.Visits w ∧ w.length ≤ q

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.cycle_collective_contact
statement:
theorem cycle_collective_contact [LinearOrder α]
    {V : Set (List α)} (closed : SubstringClosed V)
    (A D : ℤ → α) (letters : ∀ x, [A x] ∈ V) (p k q : ℕ)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hq : 0 < q)
    (per : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x) (perD : ∀ x, D (x + q) = D x)
    {ι : Type} (L : ι → Layer V A p) (lo hi : ι)
    (hlo : ∀ i x, (L lo).z x ≤ (L i).z x)
    (hhi : ∀ i x, (L i).z x ≤ (L hi).z x)
    {a b t : ℤ} (hat : a ≤ t) (htb : t < b)
    (hR : textWord A a b ∈ V) (hagree : AgreeOn A D a b) (hne : A ≠ D)
    (hmax : ∀ x, forward A x ≤ forward A t)
    (hbelow : ∀ x, forward D x ≤ forward A t)
    (hH : (L hi).first t ≤ b + (k * p : ℕ))
    (hband : (L hi).first a - (L lo).last a ≤ (k * p : ℕ))
    (hlast : b ≤ (L lo).last a + (k * p : ℕ)) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A a b) (textWord A a b),
      P.cost = k * p ∧ (∀ i, (L i).TouchedBy P) ∧
      ((∃ i, (L i).HasShort q) ∨ ∃ w, P.Visits w ∧ w.length ≤ q)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.eq_of_long_agreement
statement:
theorem eq_of_long_agreement (A D : ℤ → α) (p q : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hA : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x) (hD : ∀ x, D (x + q) = D x)
    (a : ℤ) (h : AgreeOn A D a (a + p + q)) : A = D

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.host_excursion_single
statement:
theorem host_excursion_single {V : Set (List α)} (closed : SubstringClosed V)
    (A : ℤ → α) (letters : ∀ x, [A x] ∈ V) (q p₀ : ℕ)
    (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (per : ∀ x, A (x + q) = A x)
    (a₀ b₀ e₀ : ℤ) (he₀ : a₀ + p₀ < e₀) (heb : e₀ ≤ b₀)
    (hshort : b₀ < a₀ + q + p₀) (hR : textWord A a₀ b₀ ∈ V) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A a₀ e₀) (textWord A a₀ e₀),
      P.cost = q ∧ P.Visits (textWord A a₀ b₀) ∧
      (∀ e, e₀ ≤ e → e ≤ b₀ → P.Visits (textWord A a₀ e)) ∧
      ∃ w, P.Visits w ∧ w.length < p₀

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.host_target_bounds
statement:
theorem host_target_bounds (a₀ b₀ a b e T : ℤ) (p₀ p : ℕ)
    (hmin : p₀ ≤ p) (horderA : a₀ ≤ a) (horderT : a ≤ T)
    (horderB : b₀ ≤ b)
    (hreq₁ : a + p < e) (hreq₂ : e ≤ b - p)
    (hleft : b₀ - a < p₀ + p) (hright : b - T < p + p₀)
    (hbase : b₀ < T + p₀) :
    let s := min (a + p) T
    let h := max e b₀
    a ≤ s ∧ s ≤ a + p ∧ s ≤ h ∧ h ≤ b ∧ e ≤ h ∧ h ≤ e + p ∧
      a₀ ≤ s ∧ s ≤ T ∧ b₀ ≤ h ∧ h < T + p₀

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.individual_link
statement:
theorem individual_link {V : Set (List α)} (closed : SubstringClosed V)
    (A : ℤ → α) (letters : ∀ x, [A x] ∈ V) (p q : ℕ)
    (per : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x) (L : Layer V A p)
    {a b : ℤ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hR : textWord A a b ∈ V)
    (hfirst : L.first a ≤ b) (hlast : b ≤ L.last a + p)
    (hlen : b - a < p + q) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A a b) (textWord A a b),
      P.cost = p ∧ L.TouchedBy P ∧ ∃ w, P.Visits w ∧ w.length ≤ q

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.join_band
statement:
theorem join_band {V : Set (List α)} (closed : SubstringClosed V)
    (A : ℤ → α) (letters : ∀ x, [A x] ∈ V) (p k : ℕ)
    (per : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x)
    {ι : Type} (L : ι → Layer V A p) (lo hi : ι)
    (hlo : ∀ i x, (L lo).z x ≤ (L i).z x)
    (hhi : ∀ i x, (L i).z x ≤ (L hi).z x)
    (t : ℤ) (hband : (L hi).first t - (L lo).last t ≤ (k * p : ℕ)) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A t ((L lo).last t)) (textWord A t ((L lo).last t)),
      P.cost ≤ k * p ∧ ∀ i, (L i).TouchedBy P

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.length_textWord
statement:
@[simp] theorem length_textWord (A : ℤ → α) (a b : ℤ) :
    (textWord A a b).length = (b - a).toNat

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.lex_at_le
statement:
theorem lex_at_le [LinearOrder α] {s t : Lex (ℕ → α)} (h : s ≤ t) (n : ℕ)
    (heq : ∀ j < n, s j = t j) : s n ≤ t n

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.maximal_rotation
statement:
theorem maximal_rotation [LinearOrder α] (A D : ℤ → α) (p q : ℕ)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) (hA : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x)
    (hD : ∀ x, D (x + q) = D x) (t : ℤ)
    (hmax : ∀ x, forward A x ≤ forward A t)
    (hbelow : ∀ x, forward D x ≤ forward A t) (hne : A ≠ D) :
    ∃ n < q, A (t + n) ≠ D (t + n)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.mem_textWord
statement:
theorem mem_textWord (A : ℤ → α) {a b : ℤ} {c : α} (hc : c ∈ textWord A a b) :
    ∃ i : ℤ, a ≤ i ∧ i < b ∧ A i = c

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.one_free_period
statement:
theorem one_free_period {V : Set (List α)} (closed : SubstringClosed V)
    (A : ℤ → α) (letters : ∀ x, [A x] ∈ V) (p k : ℕ)
    (per : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x)
    {ι : Type} (L : ι → Layer V A p) (lo hi : ι)
    (hlo : ∀ i x, (L lo).z x ≤ (L i).z x)
    (hhi : ∀ i x, (L i).z x ≤ (L hi).z x)
    (t : ℤ) (hband : (L hi).first t - (L lo).last t ≤ ((k - 1) * p : ℕ)) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A t ((L lo).last t)) (textWord A t ((L lo).last t)),
      P.cost ≤ (k - 1) * p ∧ ∀ i, (L i).TouchedBy P

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.ordered_windows
statement:
theorem ordered_windows {V : Set (List α)} (closed : SubstringClosed V)
    (A : ℤ → α) (letters : ∀ x, [A x] ∈ V)
    {a b c d : ℤ} (_hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) (hac : a ≤ c) (hbd : b ≤ d)
    (h₁ : textWord A a b ∈ V) (h₂ : textWord A c d ∈ V) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A a b) (textWord A c d),
      P.cost = (d - b).toNat ∧
      ∃ w, P.Visits w ∧ (w.length : ℤ) ≤ max 0 (b - c)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.ordered_windows_suffixes
statement:
theorem ordered_windows_suffixes {V : Set (List α)} (closed : SubstringClosed V)
    (A : ℤ → α) (letters : ∀ x, [A x] ∈ V)
    {a b c d : ℤ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) (hac : a ≤ c) (hbd : b ≤ d)
    (h₁ : textWord A a b ∈ V) (h₂ : textWord A c d ∈ V) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A a b) (textWord A c d),
      P.cost = (d - b).toNat ∧
      (∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ c → x ≤ b → P.Visits (textWord A x b)) ∧
      ∃ w, P.Visits w ∧ (w.length : ℤ) ≤ max 0 (b - c)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.periodic_emod
statement:
theorem periodic_emod (A : ℤ → α) (p : ℤ) (per : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x)
    (x : ℤ) : A (x % p) = A x

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.periodic_eq_of_forward_eq
statement:
theorem periodic_eq_of_forward_eq (A D : ℤ → α) (p q : ℕ)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) (hA : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x)
    (hD : ∀ x, D (x + q) = D x) (t : ℤ) (heq : forward A t = forward D t) :
    A = D

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.periodic_mod_at
statement:
theorem periodic_mod_at (A : ℤ → α) (p a x : ℤ)
    (per : ∀ y, A (y + p) = A y) : A (a + (x - a) % p) = A x

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.periodic_mul
statement:
theorem periodic_mul (A : ℤ → α) (p : ℕ) (per : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x)
    (k : ℕ) (x : ℤ) : A (x + (k * p : ℕ)) = A x

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.request_attachment
statement:
theorem request_attachment {V : Set (List α)} (closed : SubstringClosed V)
    (A : ℤ → α) (letters : ∀ x, [A x] ∈ V) (p : ℕ)
    (per : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x)
    {a e s h : ℤ} (hae : a ≤ e) (hsh : s ≤ h)
    (has : a ≤ s) (hsa : s ≤ a + p) (heh : e ≤ h) (hhe : h ≤ e + p)
    (hR : textWord A a e ∈ V) (hQ : textWord A s h ∈ V) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A s h) (textWord A s h),
      P.cost = p ∧ P.Visits (textWord A a e)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.same_period_agreement_bound
statement:
theorem same_period_agreement_bound (A D : ℤ → α) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hA : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x) (hD : ∀ x, D (x + p) = D x)
    (hne : A ≠ D) (a b : ℤ) (h : AgreeOn A D a b) : b - a < p

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.same_period_eq
statement:
theorem same_period_eq (A D : ℤ → α) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hA : ∀ x, A (x + p) = A x) (hD : ∀ x, D (x + p) = D x)
    (a : ℤ) (h : AgreeOn A D a (a + p)) : A = D

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.stream_eq_of_max
statement:
theorem stream_eq_of_max [LinearOrder α] (s d : Lex (ℕ → α)) (q : ℕ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hd : ∀ n, d (n + q) = d n)
    (hshift : toLex (fun n => s (n + q)) ≤ s) (hle : d ≤ s)
    (hprefix : ∀ n < q, s n = d n) : s = d

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.textWord_append
statement:
theorem textWord_append (A : ℤ → α) {a b c : ℤ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    textWord A a b ++ textWord A b c = textWord A a c

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.textWord_eq_of_agree
statement:
theorem textWord_eq_of_agree {A D : ℤ → α} {a b : ℤ} (h : AgreeOn A D a b) :
    textWord A a b = textWord D a b

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.textWord_infix
OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.textWord_self
statement: @[simp] theorem textWord_self (A : ℤ → α) (a : ℤ) : textWord A a a = []

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.textWord_translate
statement:
theorem textWord_translate (A : ℤ → α) (h : ℤ) (per : ∀ x, A (x + h) = A x)
    (a b : ℤ) : textWord A (a + h) (b + h) = textWord A a b

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.window_append
statement:
theorem window_append {V : Set (List α)} (closed : SubstringClosed V)
    (A : ℤ → α) {a b d : ℤ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbd : b ≤ d)
    (hw : textWord A a d ∈ V) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A a b) (textWord A a d),
      P.cost = (d - b).toNat ∧
      ∀ y, b ≤ y → y ≤ d → P.Visits (textWord A a y)

name: OAI.Superstring.Hierarchical.window_delete
statement:
theorem window_delete {V : Set (List α)} (closed : SubstringClosed V)
    (A : ℤ → α) {a b c : ℤ} (hac : a ≤ c) (hcb : c ≤ b)
    (hw : textWord A a b ∈ V) :
    ∃ P : Path V (textWord A a b) (textWord A c b), P.cost = 0 ∧
      ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ c → P.Visits (textWord A x b)

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Block.boundaries_unique
statement:
theorem boundaries_unique {r' : List α} {j' x' : ℕ}
    (h : Block A s r j) (h' : Block A s r' j')
    (hT : Occurs T r x) (hT' : Occurs T r' x') (hx : x + j = x' + j') :
    x = x' ∧ r.length = r'.length

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Block.encloses_matching
statement:
theorem Block.encloses_matching {A : ℤ → α} {T v w r : List α} {p t x y j : ℕ}
    (h : Block A w r j) (hr : Occurs T r y) (hv : Occurs T v x)
    (hmatch : Matches A v) (per : Function.Periodic A (p : ℤ))
    (hlen : t * p + w.length ≤ v.length) (hpos : y + j = x + t * p) :
    ∃ j', Block A v r j' ∧ y + j' = x

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Block.expand
statement:
theorem Block.expand {A : ℤ → α} {p t j j' : ℕ} {v w r : List α}
    (h : Block A w r j) (per : Function.Periodic A (p : ℤ)) (hj : j = j' + t * p)
    (hj' : 1 ≤ j') (hlen : j' + v.length < r.length) (hr : Occurs r v j') :
    Block A v r j'

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Block.inside
statement:
theorem inside (h : Block A s r j) (hT : Occurs T r x) (t : ℕ)
    (hxt : x < t) (htr : t < x + r.length - 1) :
    T[t]? = some (A ((t : ℤ) - ((x + j : ℕ) : ℤ)))

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Block.left
statement:
theorem left (h : Block A s r j) (hT : Occurs T r x) :
    T[x]? ≠ some (A ((x : ℤ) - ((x + j : ℕ) : ℤ)))

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Block.length_pos
statement: theorem length_pos (h : Block A s r j) : 0 < r.length

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Block.right
statement:
theorem right (h : Block A s r j) (hT : Occurs T r x) :
    T[x + r.length - 1]? ≠ some (A (((x + r.length - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((x + j : ℕ) : ℤ)))

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Block.shift
statement:
theorem Block.shift {A : ℤ → α} {p t j : ℕ} {v w r : List α}
    (h : Block A v r j) (per : Function.Periodic A (p : ℤ))
    (hv : Matches A v) (hw : Matches A w) (hlen : t * p + w.length ≤ v.length) :
    Block A w r (j + t * p)

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.count_fixed
statement: theorem count_fixed (D : Data α) (w : List α) : D.step D.count w = D.count w

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.count_le_number
statement:
theorem count_le_number (D : Data α) (T : List α)
    (hinput : ∀ w ∈ D.required, w <:+: T) (w : List α) : D.count w ≤ number T w

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.count_zero
statement:
theorem count_zero (D : Data α) (w : List α)
    (hw : w ∉ D.vertices ∨ w = []) : D.count w = 0

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.left_count
statement:
theorem left_count (D : Data α) (w : List α) :
    D.left D.count w = ∑ c ∈ D.alphabet, D.count (c :: w)

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.left_le_count
statement:
theorem left_le_count (D : Data α) {w : List α}
    (hw : w ∈ D.vertices) (hne : w ≠ []) : D.left D.count w ≤ D.count w

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.period_rule
statement:
theorem period_rule (D : Data α) {A : ℤ → α} {w v : List α} {p k : ℕ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hk : 0 < k) (hper : Function.Periodic A (p : ℤ))
    (hw : w ∈ D.vertices) (hne : w ≠ []) (hv : v ∈ D.vertices)
    (hmv : Matches A v) (hmw : Matches A w)
    (hlen : w.length + k * p = v.length)
    (htrigger : blocking D.vertices A v D.count < D.count v) :
    blocking D.vertices A w D.count + k + 1 ≤ D.count w

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.required_le_count
OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.right_count
statement:
theorem right_count (D : Data α) (w : List α) :

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.right_le_count
statement:
theorem right_le_count (D : Data α) {w : List α}
    (hw : w ∈ D.vertices) (hne : w ≠ []) : D.right D.count w ≤ D.count w

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.rule_congr
statement:
theorem rule_congr (D : Data α) {m n : List α → ℕ} {w v : List α} (p k : ℕ)
    (hvV : v ∈ D.vertices)
    (hmn : ∀ r ∈ D.vertices, w.length < r.length → m r = n r) :
    D.rule m w v p k = D.rule n w v p k

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.rule_le_count
statement:
theorem rule_le_count (D : Data α) {w v : List α} {p k : ℕ}
    (hw : w ∈ D.vertices) (hne : w ≠ [])
    (hv : v ∈ D.vertices) (hp : p ≤ v.length) (hk : k ≤ v.length) :
    D.rule D.count w v p k ≤ D.count w

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.stage_le_number
statement:
theorem stage_le_number (D : Data α) (T : List α)
    (hinput : ∀ w ∈ D.required, w <:+: T) (n : ℕ) (w : List α) :
    D.stage n w ≤ number T w

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.stage_stable
statement:
theorem stage_stable (D : Data α) (n : ℕ) (w : List α)
    (hdepth : D.depth < w.length + n) : D.stage (n + 1) w = D.stage n w

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.step_congr
OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.step_le_number
statement:
theorem step_le_number (D : Data α) (T : List α)
    (hinput : ∀ w ∈ D.required, w <:+: T)

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.weight_le_length
statement:
theorem weight_le_length (D : Data α) (T : List α)

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Occurs.append_init
statement:
theorem Occurs.append_init {T w : List α} {c : α} {x : ℕ}

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Occurs.at

theorem Occurs.at {T s : List α} {x i : ℕ} (h : Occurs T s x) (hi : i < s.length) :

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Occurs.cons_tail

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Occurs.factor

statement: theorem Occurs.refl (s : List α) : Occurs s s 0

statement:
theorem Occurs.unique {T r s : List α} {x : ℕ}

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Unblocked.period_prefix
statement:
theorem Unblocked.period_prefix {V : Finset (List α)} {A : ℤ → α}
    {T v w : List α} {p k : ℕ} (per : Function.Periodic A (p : ℤ))
    (hv : Matches A v) (hw : Matches A w) (hlen : w.length + k * p = v.length)
    {o : Occurrence T v} (ho : Unblocked V T A v o) (t : Fin (k + 1)) :
    Unblocked V T A w (periodOccurrence per hv hw hlen o t)

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.blockedOccurrence_injective
statement:
theorem blockedOccurrence_injective (V : Finset (List α)) (T : List α)

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.blocking_congr
OAI.Superstring.Counts.blocking_le_number

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.blocking_mono
OAI.Superstring.Counts.card_blockWitness
statement:
theorem card_blockWitness [DecidableEq α] (V : Finset (List α)) (T : List α)

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.coefficient_amplification
statement:
theorem coefficient_amplification [DecidableEq α] {A : ℤ → α} {p k : ℕ}
    {v w r : List α} (hp : 0 < p) (per : Function.Periodic A (p : ℤ))
    (hv : Matches A v) (hw : Matches A w) (hlen : w.length + k * p = v.length)
    (hb : 0 < coefficient A v r) : k + 1 ≤ coefficient A w r

statement:
theorem coefficient_pos_length [DecidableEq α] {A : ℤ → α} {s r : List α}

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.number_le_length

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.number_pos_of_infix

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.periodOccurrence_injective
statement:
theorem periodOccurrence_injective {A : ℤ → α} {T v w : List α} {p k : ℕ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (per : Function.Periodic A (p : ℤ))
    (hv : Matches A v) (hw : Matches A w)
    (hlen : w.length + k * p = v.length) (o : Occurrence T v) :
    Function.Injective (periodOccurrence per hv hw hlen o)

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.period_prefix
OAI.Superstring.Counts.period_rule_lower_bound
statement:
theorem period_rule_lower_bound [DecidableEq α] {V : Finset (List α)}
    {A : ℤ → α} {T v w : List α} {p k : ℕ} {m : List α → ℕ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hk : 0 < k) (per : Function.Periodic A (p : ℤ))
    (hv : Matches A v) (hw : Matches A w) (hlen : w.length + k * p = v.length)
    (hvV : v ∈ V) (hm : ∀ r ∈ V, w.length < r.length → m r ≤ number T r)
    (htrigger : blocking V A v m < m v) :
    blocking V A w m + k + 1 ≤ number T w

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.periodic_nat_add
statement:
theorem periodic_nat_add {A : ℤ → α} {p : ℕ} (per : Function.Periodic A (p : ℤ))

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.right_extension_number

theorem right_extension_number [DecidableEq α] (alphabet : Finset α) (T w : List α) :

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.singleton_number_sum

theorem singleton_number_sum [DecidableEq α] (C : Finset α) (T : List α) :

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.sum_increase
statement:
theorem sum_increase {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι] (I : Finset ι) (a b : ι → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ I, a i ≤ b i) {r : ι} (hr : r ∈ I) :
    (∑ i ∈ I, a i) + (b r - a r) ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, b i

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.unblocked_count_growth
statement:
theorem unblocked_count_growth [DecidableEq α] {V : Finset (List α)} {A : ℤ → α}
    {T v w : List α} {p k : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (per : Function.Periodic A (p : ℤ))
    (hv : Matches A v) (hw : Matches A w) (hlen : w.length + k * p = v.length)
    (hmore : blocking V A v (number T) < number T v) :
    blocking V A w (number T) + k + 1 ≤ number T w

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.balanced
statement:
theorem balanced (D : Data α) (hD : D.WellFormed) (s : List α) :
    D.up s + ∑ c ∈ D.alphabet, D.down (c :: s) =

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.down_add

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.right_bound

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.sum_left_all

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.sum_right_all
statement:
theorem sum_right_all (D : Data α) (hD : D.WellFormed) :
    (∑ s ∈ D.vertices, ∑ c ∈ D.alphabet, D.count (s ++ [c])) =

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.total_down

theorem total_down (D : Data α) (hD : D.WellFormed) :

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.total_up

name: OAI.Superstring.Counts.Data.up_add

name: OAI.ForestSpace.pair_perturbation
statement:

    (x a y : E) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hx : ‖x‖ = 1)
    (hpair : Real.sqrt (‖a‖^2+b) ≤ (‖a+y‖+‖a-y‖)/2) :
    Real.sqrt (1+b) ≤ (‖x+y‖+‖x-y‖)/2+2*‖x-a‖

name: OAI.ForestSpace.EquivalentNorm.bounded_trees_auc_zero
statement:
theorem EquivalentNorm.bounded_trees_auc_zero (hI : ¬FiniteDimensional ℝ E)
    (u : ℕ → List ℕ → E)
    (hu : ∀ h ≥ 1, ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length ≤ h → ‖u h s‖ = 1)
    (hd : ∀ h ≥ 1, ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h → ∀ j,
      1 ≤ ‖u h (s++[j])-u h s‖)
    (hweak : ∀ h ≥ 1, ∀ s : List ℕ, s.length < h →
      WeakNull (fun j => u h (s++[j])-u h s)) :
    aucModulus E R.N (α/(2*β)) = 0

name: OAI.ForestSpace.EquivalentNorm.child_gain
statement:
theorem EquivalentNorm.child_gain (hI : ¬FiniteDimensional ℝ E)
    {γ : ℝ} (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hγ : γ < aucModulus E R.N (α/(2*β)))
    (u : E) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (v : ℕ → E)
    (hd : ∀ j, 1 ≤ ‖v j-u‖) (hweak : WeakNull (fun j => v j-u)) :
    ∃ j, R.N u+γ*α/2 ≤ R.N (v j)

name: OAI.ForestSpace.EquivalentNorm.cofinite_unit

theorem EquivalentNorm.cofinite_unit (hI : ¬FiniteDimensional ℝ E) (F : Cofinite E) :

name: OAI.ForestSpace.EquivalentNorm.continuous

name: OAI.ForestSpace.EquivalentNorm.gain_extended
statement:
theorem EquivalentNorm.gain_extended {t γ : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    {x : E} (hx : R.N x = 1) (F : Cofinite E)
    (hF : ∀ y : E, y ∈ F.val → R.N y = 1 → 1+γ ≤ R.N (x+t•y))
    {w : E} (hw : w ∈ F.val) (hwn : t ≤ R.N w) :
    1+γ ≤ R.N (x+w)

name: OAI.ForestSpace.EquivalentNorm.support

name: OAI.ForestSpace.EquivalentNorm.vector_gain
statement:
theorem EquivalentNorm.vector_gain (hI : ¬FiniteDimensional ℝ E)
    {t γ : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ : γ < aucModulus E R.N t)
    {u : E} (hu : 0 < R.N u) : ∃ F : Cofinite E,
    ∀ w : E, w ∈ F.val → t*R.N u ≤ R.N w →
      (1+γ)*R.N u ≤ R.N (u+w)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.eval_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_add (F G : SymmetricForm K r j) (v : Fin j → (Fin r → K)) :
    eval (F + G) v = eval F v + eval G v

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.eval_basis
statement:
theorem eval_basis (F : SymmetricForm K r j) (a : Fin j → Fin r) :
    eval F (fun i => Pi.single (a i) (1 : K)) = F (tupleSym a)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.eval_comp_perm
statement:
theorem eval_comp_perm (F : SymmetricForm K r j)
    (v : Fin j → (Fin r → K)) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin j)) :
    eval F (v ∘ σ) = eval F v

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.eval_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_neg (F : SymmetricForm K r j) (v : Fin j → (Fin r → K)) :

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.eval_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_smul (c : K) (F : SymmetricForm K r j)

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.eval_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_sub (F G : SymmetricForm K r j) (v : Fin j → (Fin r → K)) :
    eval (F - G) v = eval F v - eval G v

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.eval_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_zero (v : Fin j → (Fin r → K)) :

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.exists_toMultilinearMap

theorem exists_toMultilinearMap

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.ofMultilinearMap_tupleSym

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.toMultilinearMap_add

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.toMultilinearMap_ofMultilinearMap

theorem toMultilinearMap_ofMultilinearMap

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.contract_add
statement:

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.contract_apply

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.contract_smul
statement:

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.contract_sub
statement:

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.SymmetricForm.contract_zero

theorem eval_contract (v : Fin r → K) (F : SymmetricForm K r (j + 1))

name: OAI.MetricEntropyDuality.FieldGraphSeparation.distance_gt
