name: OAI.ThreeManifold.Neck.turning_boundary_reduction
statement:
lemma turning_boundary_reduction {κ v : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (z₀ zL : TVec) :
    κ * v / 4 * ((zL - z₀) 0) ^ 2 ≤ κ * v / 2 * ((z₀ 0) ^ 2 + (zL 0) ^ 2)

name: OAI.ThreeManifold.Neck.turning_boundary_term
statement:
lemma turning_boundary_term (κ v : ℝ) (u z : TVec) :
    boundaryTerm !![-κ, 0; 0, 0] (v, u) (0, z) = κ * v * (z 0) ^ 2 / 2

name: OAI.ThreeManifold.PassageDynamics.actual_return_symmetry
statement:
lemma actual_return_symmetry {F₁ : ℝ → ℝ} (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F₁)
    {t v : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L)
    (ht : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt t (v s) s)
    (hv : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt v (-F₁ (t s) / 2) s)
    (h0 : t 0 = 0) (hL0 : t L = 0) (hpos : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 L, 0 < t s) :
    v (L / 2) = 0 ∧ IsMaxOn t (Icc 0 L) (L / 2) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, t (L - s) = t s ∧ v (L - s) = -v s

name: OAI.ThreeManifold.PassageDynamics.cannot_reach_equilibrium
statement:
lemma cannot_reach_equilibrium {F₁ : ℝ → ℝ} (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F₁)
    {t v : ℝ → ℝ} {a b c : ℝ} (hc : c ∈ Ioo a b)
    (ht : ∀ s ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt t (v s) s)
    (hv : ∀ s ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivAt v (-F₁ (t s) / 2) s)
    (hvc : v c = 0) (hFc : F₁ (t c) = 0) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc a b, t s = t c ∧ v s = 0

name: OAI.ThreeManifold.PassageDynamics.positive_return_has_stationary_maximum
statement:
lemma positive_return_has_stationary_maximum {t v : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (ht : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt t (v s) s)
    (h0 : t 0 = 0) (hL0 : t L = 0) (hpos : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 L, 0 < t s) :
    ∃ c ∈ Ioo 0 L, 0 < t c ∧ v c = 0 ∧ IsMaxOn t (Icc 0 L) c

name: OAI.ThreeManifold.PassageDynamics.return_midpoint
statement:
lemma return_midpoint {F₁ : ℝ → ℝ} (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F₁)
    {t v : ℝ → ℝ} {L c : ℝ} (hc : c ∈ Ioo 0 L)
    (ht : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt t (v s) s)
    (hv : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt v (-F₁ (t s) / 2) s)
    (h0 : t 0 = 0) (hL0 : t L = 0) (hpos : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 L, 0 < t s)

name: OAI.ThreeManifold.PassageDynamics.return_velocity_strictAnti
statement:
lemma return_velocity_strictAnti {F₁ : ℝ → ℝ} {t v : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L)
    (hv : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt v (-F₁ (t s) / 2) s)
    (ht : MapsTo t (Icc 0 L) (Icc 0 (t (L / 2))))
    (hanti : AntitoneOn F₁ (Icc 0 (t (L / 2))))
    (hforce : 0 < F₁ (t (L / 2))) (hvc : v (L / 2) = 0) :
    StrictAntiOn v (Icc 0 L) ∧ 0 < v 0 ∧

statement:
lemma scalar_equations_unique {F₁ : ℝ → ℝ} (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F₁)

OAI.ThreeManifold.ReturningCoefficients.actual_force_end_values

lemma actual_force_end_values (right : Bool) (δ : ℝ) (p : TVec) :
    pairing (deriv (coordinateCometric right δ) 0) p p = δ * a 0 * p 0 ^ 2 ∧
    pairing (deriv (coordinateCometric right δ) (1 / 8)) p p = δ * a (1 / 8) * p 0 ^ 2

name: OAI.ThreeManifold.ReturningCoefficients.actual_mixed_bound
statement:
lemma actual_mixed_bound {right : Bool} {δ T C : ℝ} {p : TVec}
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hC : 0 < C) (hT : T ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (hconc : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 1, ∀ q, 0 ≤ qform (-deriv (deriv (coordinateCometric right δ)) t) q)
    (hder : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 1, sqnorm (deriv (coordinateCometric right δ) t *ᵥ e) ≤ C ^ 2 * δ ^ 2)
    (hforce : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ pairing (deriv (coordinateCometric right δ) t) p p) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      |pairing (coordinateCometric right δ t) e p - p 0| ≤
        (a 0 + Real.sqrt (2 * C * a 0)) * δ * |p 0|

name: OAI.ThreeManifold.ReturningCoefficients.first_coefficient_bound
statement:
lemma first_coefficient_bound {L v₀ : ℝ} {F v : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hFc : ContinuousOn F (Icc 0 L)) (hvc : ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 L))
    (henergy : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, F s + v s ^ 2 = 1)
    (hchord : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..L, v s ^ 2) ≤ L * v₀ ^ 2 / 3) :
    (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..L, F s) + 4 * (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..L, v s ^ 2) ≤ L * (1 + v₀ ^ 2)

name: OAI.ThreeManifold.ReturningCoefficients.mixed_derivative_bound
statement:
lemma mixed_derivative_bound {D U : TMat} {a C δ p₁ : ℝ} {p e : TVec}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hD : Dᵀ = D) (hpos : ∀ q, 0 ≤ pairing D q q)
    (hee : pairing D e e ≤ 2 * C * δ)
    (hpp : pairing D p p ≤ δ * a * p₁ ^ 2)
    (hfirst : pairing (D + U) e p = δ * a * p₁) :
    |pairing U e p| ≤ (a + Real.sqrt (2 * C * a)) * δ * |p₁|

name: OAI.ThreeManifold.ReturningCoefficients.mixed_integral_bound
statement:
lemma mixed_integral_bound {L C δ p₁ : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hc : ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 L))
    (hb : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, |f s - p₁| ≤ C * δ * |p₁|) :
    |(∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..L, f s) - L * p₁| ≤ C * δ * L * |p₁|

name: OAI.ThreeManifold.ReturningCoefficients.mixed_variation_bound
statement:
lemma mixed_variation_bound {P P₁ : ℝ → TMat} {T t K p₁ : ℝ} {p e : TVec}
    (hT : T ≤ 1) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T)

    (hb : ∀ u ∈ Icc 0 T, |pairing (P₁ u) e p| ≤ K)

name: OAI.ThreeManifold.ReturningCoefficients.second_coefficient_bound

lemma second_coefficient_bound {L C δ : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}

name: OAI.ThreeManifold.ReturningPassage.actual_timing_margin
statement:
lemma actual_timing_margin {right : Bool} {δ L : ℝ} {p : TVec} {t v : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (hstar : 1 / 4 < t (L / 2)) (hT : t (L / 2) < 1)
    (hc : ∀ u ∈ Icc 0 1, ∀ q, 0 ≤ qform (-deriv (deriv (coordinateCometric right δ)) u) q)
    (ht : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt t (v s) s)
    (hv : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt v (-force right δ p (t s) / 2) s)
    (hrange : MapsTo t (Icc 0 L) (Icc 0 (t (L / 2))))
    (htconc : ConcaveOn ℝ (Icc 0 (L / 2)) t) (h0 : t 0 = 0)
    (hsym : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, t (L - s) = t s ∧ v (L - s) = -v s) :
    4 * v 0 ≤ Turning.beta * (δ * Turning.aZero) * p 0 ^ 2 * L

name: OAI.ThreeManifold.ReturningPassage.coefficient_expansion
statement:
lemma coefficient_expansion {L K : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) {R : ℝ → TMat} {v : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hR : ContinuousOn R (Icc 0 L)) (hv : ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 L))
    (hs : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, (R s)ᵀ = R s) (p e : TVec) (α : ℝ) :
    (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..L, pairing (R s) (p - α • e) (p - α • e) +
      4 * v s ^ 2 + α ^ 2 * K) =
    ((∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..L, pairing (R s) p p) + 4 * (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..L, v s ^ 2)) -
      2 * α * (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..L, pairing (R s) e p) +
      α ^ 2 * ((∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..L, pairing (R s) e e) + K * L)

statement:

statement:
lemma returning_normal_identity {right : Bool} {δ L m : ℝ} {p : TVec} {t v : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L)
    (hdet : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, (coordinateCometric right δ (t s)).det ≠ 0)
    (ht : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt t (v s) s)
    (hv : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt v (-force right δ p (t s) / 2) s)
    (h0 : t 0 = 0) (h1 : t L = 0) (hvL : v L = -v 0)
    {z z' : ℝ → TVec} {w w' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hzc : ContinuousOn z' (Icc 0 L)) (hwc : ContinuousOn w' (Icc 0 L))
    (hz : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt z (z' s) s)
    (hw : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt w (w' s) s)
    (hwa : w 0 = 0) (hwb : w L = 0)
    (hlin : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, HasDerivAt
      (fun r => metric (metricInverse right δ (t r)) (w r, z r)
        (momentumVelocity right δ p t v r)) m s) :
    (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..L, returnNormalDensity right δ p t v
      (fun r => (w r, z r)) (fun r => (w' r, z' r)) s) =
    (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..L,
      energyDensity (fun s => (coordinateCometric right δ (t s))⁻¹)
        (fun s => deriv (coordinateCometric right δ) (t s) *ᵥ p)
        (fun s => -forceDerivative right δ p (t s) / 2) z' w w' s) +
      δ * a 0 * v 0 / 2 * ((z 0 0) ^ 2 + (z L 0) ^ 2) -
        (p ⬝ᵥ (z L - z 0)) ^ 2 / L

        0 ≤ qform (-deriv (deriv (coordinateCometric right δ)) u) q ∧

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.mean_deficit_le
statement:
theorem mean_deficit_le {G : X → E} (hG : Integrable G μ)
    (hG2 : Integrable (fun x => ‖G x‖ ^ 2) μ) (a : E) (A : ℝ) :
    A - (∫ x, ‖G x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ A - ‖a‖ ^ 2 +
      2 * ‖a‖ * ‖(∫ x, G x ∂μ) - a‖

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.near_lexicographic_maximum
statement:
theorem near_lexicographic_maximum
    {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K) {A B : ℝ}
    (hfirst : ∀ p ∈ K, p.1 ≤ A)
    (hsecond : ∀ p ∈ K, p.1 = A → p.2 ≤ B)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ p ∈ K, A - δ < p.1 → p.2 ≤ B + ε

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.variance_le_of_moments
statement:
theorem variance_le_of_moments {G : X → E} (hG : Integrable G μ)
    (hG2 : Integrable (fun x => ‖G x‖ ^ 2) μ) (a : E) {M : ℝ}
    (hM : (∫ x, ‖G x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ M) :
    (∫ x, ‖G x - a‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ M - ‖a‖ ^ 2 +
      2 * ‖a‖ * ‖(∫ x, G x ∂μ) - a‖

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.vertical_variance_bound
statement:
theorem vertical_variance_bound
    {G H : X → E} (hG : Integrable G μ) (hG2 : Integrable (fun x => ‖G x‖ ^ 2) μ)
    (hH : Integrable H μ) (hH2 : Integrable (fun x => ‖H x‖ ^ 2) μ)
    {K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} (hvalues : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (‖G x‖ ^ 2, ‖H x‖ ^ 2) ∈ K)
    {A B ε C D : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbarrier : ∀ p ∈ K, p.2 ≤ B + ε + C * (A - p.1))
    (u v : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ D) (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ D) :
    (∫ x, ‖H x - v‖ ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ B - ‖v‖ ^ 2 + ε +
      C * (A - ‖u‖ ^ 2 + 2 * D * ‖(∫ x, G x ∂μ) - u‖) +
      2 * D * ‖(∫ x, H x ∂μ) - v‖

    (a h : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hn : 0 < n) (J : Segment) {g : ℝ × ℝ → E}
    (hg : IsBoundedField g) :
    (∫ p, g p ∂(Rectangle.mk (Segment.grid a h n hh hn) J).law) =
      (n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin n, ∫ p, g p ∂(Rectangle.mk (Segment.cell a h hh i) J).law

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Rectangle.integral_grid_y
statement:
theorem integral_grid_y {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (a h : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hn : 0 < n) (I : Segment) {g : ℝ × ℝ → E}
    (hg : IsBoundedField g) :
    (∫ p, g p ∂(Rectangle.mk I (Segment.grid a h n hh hn)).law) =
      (n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin n, ∫ p, g p ∂(Rectangle.mk I (Segment.cell a h hh i)).law

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Rectangle.integral_le_four_of_subset
statement:
theorem integral_le_four_of_subset (P Q : Rectangle) {g : Base → ℝ}
    (hg : IsBoundedField g) (hpos : ∀ p, 0 ≤ g p)
    (hsub : Q.closed ⊆ P.closed)
    (hx : P.x.length / 2 ≤ Q.x.length) (hy : P.y.length / 2 ≤ Q.y.length) :
    (∫ p, g p ∂Q.law) ≤ 4 * (∫ p, g p ∂P.law)

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Rectangle.law_eq
statement:
theorem law_eq (Q : Rectangle) : Q.law =

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Rectangle.law_eq_closed

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Rectangle.square_closed

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Rectangle.volume_closed

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Segment.ae_iff

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Segment.ae_mem

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Segment.cell_length

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Segment.grid_length

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Segment.integral_eq

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Segment.integral_grid

theorem integral_grid {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

      (n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin n, ∫ x, g x ∂(cell a h hh i).law

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Segment.length_pos
statement: theorem length_pos (I : Segment) : 0 < I.length

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.horizontal_mean_bound
statement:
theorem horizontal_mean_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace ι]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] (Q : Rectangle)
    {F : Base → E} {G : ι → Base → E} {C : NNReal} {C' : ι → NNReal}
    (hF : LipschitzWith C F) (hG : ∀ i, LipschitzWith (C' i) (G i))
    {σ : ℝ → ι} (hσ : Measurable σ) {R : ℝ}
    (hleft : ∀ᵐ y ∂Q.y.law, ‖G (σ y) (Q.x.lo, y) - F (Q.x.lo, y)‖ ≤ R)
    (hright : ∀ᵐ y ∂Q.y.law, ‖G (σ y) (Q.x.hi, y) - F (Q.x.hi, y)‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖(∫ p, column (G (σ p.2)) (1, 0) p ∂Q.law) -
      (∫ p, column F (1, 0) p ∂Q.law)‖ ≤ 2 * R / Q.x.length

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.norm_integral_rectangle_le_x
OAI.DoublingHilbert.norm_integral_rectangle_le_y
OAI.DoublingHilbert.vertical_mean_bound
statement:
theorem vertical_mean_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace ι]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] (Q : Rectangle)
    {F : Base → E} {G : ι → Base → E} {C : NNReal} {C' : ι → NNReal}
    (hF : LipschitzWith C F) (hG : ∀ i, LipschitzWith (C' i) (G i))
    {σ : ℝ → ι} (hσ : Measurable σ) {R : ℝ}
    (hbottom : ∀ᵐ x ∂Q.x.law, ‖G (σ x) (x, Q.y.lo) - F (x, Q.y.lo)‖ ≤ R)
    (htop : ∀ᵐ x ∂Q.x.law, ‖G (σ x) (x, Q.y.hi) - F (x, Q.y.hi)‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖(∫ p, column (G (σ p.1)) (0, 1) p ∂Q.law) -
      (∫ p, column F (0, 1) p ∂Q.law)‖ ≤ 2 * R / Q.y.length

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Rectangle.exists_row_integral_le

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Rectangle.integral_column_le_mul_grid

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Rectangle.integral_row_le_mul_grid
statement:
theorem integral_row_le_mul_grid (a h : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hn : 0 < n)

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Segment.cell_period_eq_grid
statement:
theorem cell_period_eq_grid (a h : ℝ) (N i : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hN : 0 < N) :
    cell a (N * h) (mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hN) hh) i =
      grid (a + i * (N * h)) h N hh hN

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Segment.cell_subset_grid
statement:
theorem cell_subset_grid (a h : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hn : 0 < n)

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Segment.exists_grid_inside
statement:
theorem exists_grid_inside (I : Segment) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsmall : h < I.length / 4) :
    ∃ (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n),
      I.lo ≤ (grid (a * h) h n hh hn).lo ∧
      (grid (a * h) h n hh hn).hi ≤ I.hi ∧
      I.length / 2 ≤ (grid (a * h) h n hh hn).length

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Segment.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {I J : Segment} (hlo : I.lo = J.lo) (hhi : I.hi = J.hi) : I = J

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.Segment.grid_subdivision
statement:
theorem grid_subdivision (a h : ℝ) (n N : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (hn : 0 < n) (hN : 0 < N) :
    grid a (N * h) n (mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hN) hh) hn =

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.ae_inColoredStrip_stripColor

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.color_in_block
statement:
theorem color_in_block (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) {h t : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (b : ℤ) (i : Fin N)
    (ht : t ∈ Ioo (((b : ℝ) * N + i) * h) (((b : ℝ) * N + i + 1) * h)) :

statement:
theorem exists_fine_level (N W : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hW : 0 < W) (w : Tuple)

statement:
theorem exists_good_le_integral {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X}

theorem exists_le_finite_mean {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (v : Fin n → ℝ) :

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.globalSheet_offset
OAI.DoublingHilbert.globalSheet_separation_sq
statement:
theorem globalSheet_separation_sq {f : constructedSet → E} {D : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzWith D f) (hlower : ∀ x y, dist x y ≤ dist (f x) (f y))
    (w : Tuple) (j : ℕ) (hj : w j = 0) {i m : ℕ} (him : i ≠ m)
    (hi : i < colors j) (hm : m < colors j) {p : Base} (hp : p ∈ sheetDomain w)
    (hip : allowed j i p) (hmp : allowed j m p) :
    2 * scale j ^ 2 ≤ ‖globalSheet hf (w.update j (i + 1)) p -
      globalSheet hf (w.update j (m + 1)) p‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.inColoredStrip_stripColor
statement:
theorem inColoredStrip_stripColor (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) {h t : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)

statement:
theorem measurable_stripColor (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : ℝ) :

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.norm_le_on_Icc_of_Ioo
statement:
theorem norm_le_on_Icc_of_Ioo {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    {g : ℝ → E} (hg : Continuous g) {a b R : ℝ} (hab : a < b)

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.oscillation_sq_le_segment_energy
statement:
theorem oscillation_sq_le_segment_energy {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (I : Segment) {f g : ℝ → E}
    (hg : IsBoundedField g)
    (hFTC : ∀ a b, (∫ x in a..b, g x) = f b - f a)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc I.lo I.hi) (hb : b ∈ Icc I.lo I.hi) :
    ‖f b - f a‖ ^ 2 ≤ I.length ^ 2 * (∫ x, ‖g x‖ ^ 2 ∂I.law)

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.scale_tendsto_zero
statement: theorem scale_tendsto_zero : Tendsto scale atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.stripColor_eq_of_mem_strip
statement:
theorem stripColor_eq_of_mem_strip (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) {h t : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)

statement:
theorem block_x (G : PeriodGrid j) (a : Fin G.nx) (b : Fin G.ny) :

statement:

    ∃ a : Fin G.nx, ∃ b : Fin G.ny,
      (∫ p, g p ∂(G.block a b).law) ≤ ∫ p, g p ∂G.rectangle.law

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.PeriodGrid.exists_inside
statement:
theorem exists_inside (Q : Rectangle)
    (hx : xPeriod j < Q.x.length / 4) (hy : yPeriod j < Q.y.length / 4) :
    ∃ G : PeriodGrid j, G.rectangle.closed ⊆ Q.closed ∧
      Q.x.length / 2 ≤ G.rectangle.x.length ∧
      Q.y.length / 2 ≤ G.rectangle.y.length

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.PeriodGrid.rectangle_x_subdivided

theorem rectangle_x_subdivided (G : PeriodGrid j) : G.rectangle.x =

statement: theorem interior_subset_closed (Q : Rectangle) : Q.interior ⊆ Q.closed

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.ae_horizontal_pair
statement:
theorem ae_horizontal_pair {f : constructedSet → E} {D : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzWith D f) (w : Tuple) (j : ℕ) (hj : w j = 0)
    (Q : Rectangle) (hQ : Q.closed ⊆ sheetDomain w) :

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.bounded_horizontalColumn
OAI.DoublingHilbert.bounded_verticalColumn
OAI.DoublingHilbert.color_on_cell
statement:
theorem color_on_cell (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (a : ℤ) (i : ℕ) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ Ioo (Segment.cell (a * h) h hh i).lo (Segment.cell (a * h) h hh i).hi) :
    stripColor N hN h t = residueColor N hN (a + i) ∧
      inColoredStrip h N (residueColor N hN (a + i)) t

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.horizontalColumn_mean
statement:
theorem horizontalColumn_mean {f : constructedSet → E} {D : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzWith D f) (w : Tuple) (j : ℕ) (hj : w j = 0)
    (Q : Rectangle) (hQ : Q.closed ⊆ sheetDomain w) :
    ‖(∫ p, horizontalColumn hf w j (1, 0) p ∂Q.law) -
      (∫ p, column (globalSheet hf w) (1, 0) p ∂Q.law)‖ ≤
      2 * D * scale j / Q.x.length

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.horizontal_mean_bound_stripes
statement:
theorem horizontal_mean_bound_stripes {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace ι]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] (a h : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hn : 0 < n)
    (J : Segment) {F : Base → E} {G : ι → Base → E}
    {C : NNReal} {C' : ι → NNReal}
    (hF : LipschitzWith C F) (hG : ∀ i, LipschitzWith (C' i) (G i))
    {σ : ℝ → ι} (hσ : Measurable σ) (c : Fin n → ι) {R : ℝ}
    (hcolor : ∀ i : Fin n, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (Segment.cell a h hh i).lo
      (Segment.cell a h hh i).hi, σ x = c i)
    (hbound : ∀ i : Fin n, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (Segment.cell a h hh i).lo
      (Segment.cell a h hh i).hi, ∀ y ∈ Ioo J.lo J.hi, ‖G (c i) (x, y) - F (x, y)‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖(∫ p, column (G (σ p.1)) (1, 0) p ∂(Rectangle.mk (Segment.grid a h n hh hn) J).law) -
      (∫ p, column F (1, 0) p ∂(Rectangle.mk (Segment.grid a h n hh hn) J).law)‖ ≤
      2 * R / h

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.residueColor_val

theorem residueColor_val (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (q : ℤ) :

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.verticalColumn_x_mean
statement:
theorem verticalColumn_x_mean {f : constructedSet → E} {D : NNReal}

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.verticalColumn_y_mean
statement:
theorem verticalColumn_y_mean {f : constructedSet → E} {D : NNReal}

    ‖(∫ p, verticalColumn hf w j (0, 1) p ∂Q.law) -
      (∫ p, column (globalSheet hf w) (0, 1) p ∂Q.law)‖ ≤

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.anisotropic_energy_bound
statement:
theorem anisotropic_energy_bound {f : constructedSet → E} {D : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzWith D f) (w : Tuple) (j : ℕ) (hj : w j = 0)
    (G : PeriodGrid j) (hQ : G.rectangle.closed ⊆ sheetDomain w)
    {A B C ε t : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1)
    (hfirst : ∀ z ∈ derivativeCompact f, z.1 ≤ A)
    (hbarrier : ∀ z ∈ derivativeCompact f, z.2 ≤ B + ε + C * (A - z.1))
    (u v : E) (hu : ‖u‖ ≤ 2 * D) (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 2 * D)
    (hnearu : A - ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ t) (hnearv : B - ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ t)
    (hbaseu : (∫ p, ‖column (globalSheet hf w) (1, 0) p - u‖ ^ 2 ∂G.rectangle.law) ≤ t ^ 2)
    (hbasev : (∫ p, ‖column (globalSheet hf w) (0, 1) p - v‖ ^ 2 ∂G.rectangle.law) ≤ t ^ 2)
    (hrx : scale j / G.rectangle.x.length ≤ t)
    (hry : scale j / G.rectangle.y.length ≤ t) :
    (∫ p, horizontalEnergy hf w j p ∂G.rectangle.law) ≤ horizontalCoefficient D * t ∧
    (∫ p, verticalEnergy hf w j p ∂G.rectangle.law) ≤
      2 * ε + 16 * C * (D : ℝ) ^ 2 / (widthFactor j : ℝ) + verticalCoefficient D C * t

        ((W : ℝ) ^ 2 * horizontalCoefficient D + verticalCoefficient D C) * t < η

name: OAI.DoublingHilbert.exists_nearmax_grid
statement:
theorem exists_nearmax_grid {f : constructedSet → E} {D : NNReal}
    (hf : LipschitzWith D f) (N W : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hW : 0 < W)
    {A B : ℝ} (hAB : (A, B) ∈ derivativeCompact f) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∃ (w : Tuple) (j : ℕ) (G : PeriodGrid j) (u v : E),
      colors j = N ∧ widthFactor j = W ∧ w j = 0 ∧
      G.rectangle.closed ⊆ sheetDomain w ∧
      ‖u‖ ≤ 2 * D ∧ ‖v‖ ≤ 2 * D ∧
      A - ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ t ∧ B - ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ t ∧
      (∫ p, ‖column (globalSheet hf w) (1, 0) p - u‖ ^ 2 ∂G.rectangle.law) ≤ t ^ 2 ∧
      (∫ p, ‖column (globalSheet hf w) (0, 1) p - v‖ ^ 2 ∂G.rectangle.law) ≤ t ^ 2 ∧
      scale j / G.rectangle.x.length ≤ t ∧ scale j / G.rectangle.y.length ≤ t

        ‖(addedSheet hf w j i (x, b) - globalSheet hf w (x, b)) -
          (addedSheet hf w j i (x, a) - globalSheet hf w (x, a))‖ ^ 2 ≤

    ∃ y ∈ Ioo J.lo J.hi, ∀ a ∈ Icc I.lo I.hi, ∀ b ∈ Icc I.lo I.hi,
      c * ‖(G (b, y) - F (b, y)) - (G (a, y) - F (a, y))‖ ^ 2 ≤

    (hz : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,f t = 0 → ‖f' t‖ ≤ r t) :

statement:
theorem round_reset_estimate {A P : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ} {p : ℝ → ℝ}
    {a b pmin α θ M C : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 < pmin+α+θ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hP : ∀ t,HasDerivAt P (A t-p t • P t-P t*P t) t)
    (hp : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,pmin ≤ p t)
    (hpos : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,∀ v : ι → ℝ,
      α*(∑ i,(v i)^2) ≤ ∑ i,∑ j,v i*P t i j*v j)
    (hforce : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      ‖A t-(p t*θ+θ^2) • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)‖ ≤ M)
    (hinit : ‖P a-θ • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)‖ ≤ C) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b,
      ‖P t-θ • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)‖ ≤
        C*Real.exp (-(pmin+α+θ)*(t-a))+M/(pmin+α+θ)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.LinearODE.slow_pulse_error_estimate
statement:
theorem slow_pulse_error_estimate
    {X Z ρ ρ₁ Q₁ L R L₁ R₁ : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    {a T γ c d c₁ d₁ C η : ℝ}
    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hcd : c+d=γ) (hcd₁ : c₁+d₁=γ)
    (hρ : Continuous ρ) (hρ₁ : Continuous ρ₁) (hQ₁ : Continuous Q₁)
    (hX : ∀ t,HasDerivAt X (ρ t-(L t*X t+X t*R t)) t)
    (hZ : ∀ t,HasDerivAt Z ((ρ₁ t-Q₁ t*X t-X t*Q₁ t)-(L₁ t*Z t+Z t*R₁ t)) t)
    (hbρ : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),‖ρ t‖ ≤ C*η/T)
    (hbρ₁ : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),‖ρ₁ t‖ ≤ C*η/T)
    (hbQ₁ : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),‖Q₁ t‖ ≤ C/T)
    (hL : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),∀ v : ι → ℝ,
      c*(∑ i,(v i)^2) ≤ ∑ i,∑ j,v i*L t i j*v j)
    (hR : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),∀ v : ι → ℝ,
      d*(∑ i,(v i)^2) ≤ ∑ i,∑ j,v i*R t i j*v j)
    (hL₁ : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),∀ v : ι → ℝ,
      c₁*(∑ i,(v i)^2) ≤ ∑ i,∑ j,v i*L₁ t i j*v j)
    (hR₁ : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),∀ v : ι → ℝ,
      d₁*(∑ i,(v i)^2) ≤ ∑ i,∑ j,v i*R₁ t i j*v j)
    (hinit : ‖X a‖ ≤ C*η) (hzinit : Z a=0) :
    (∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),‖X t‖ ≤ (C+C/γ)*η) ∧
    (∫ t in a..(a+T),‖X t‖) ≤ 2*C*η/γ ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),‖Z t‖ ≤ (C+2*C*(C+C/γ))*η/(γ*T)) ∧
    (∫ t in a..(a+T),‖Z t‖) ≤ C*η/γ+4*C^2*η/γ^2

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.LinearODE.slow_pulse_error_estimate_on
statement:
theorem slow_pulse_error_estimate_on
    {X Z ρ ρ₁ Q₁ L R L₁ R₁ : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    {a T γ c d c₁ d₁ C η : ℝ}
    (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hcd : c+d=γ) (hcd₁ : c₁+d₁=γ)
    (hρ : ContinuousOn ρ (Icc a (a+T))) (hρ₁ : ContinuousOn ρ₁ (Icc a (a+T))) (hQ₁ : ContinuousOn Q₁ (Icc a (a+T)))
    (hX : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),HasDerivAt X (ρ t-(L t*X t+X t*R t)) t)
    (hZ : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),HasDerivAt Z ((ρ₁ t-Q₁ t*X t-X t*Q₁ t)-(L₁ t*Z t+Z t*R₁ t)) t)
    (hbρ : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),‖ρ t‖ ≤ C*η/T)
    (hbρ₁ : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),‖ρ₁ t‖ ≤ C*η/T)
    (hbQ₁ : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),‖Q₁ t‖ ≤ C/T)
    (hL : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),∀ v : ι → ℝ,
      c*(∑ i,(v i)^2) ≤ ∑ i,∑ j,v i*L t i j*v j)
    (hR : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),∀ v : ι → ℝ,
      d*(∑ i,(v i)^2) ≤ ∑ i,∑ j,v i*R t i j*v j)
    (hL₁ : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),∀ v : ι → ℝ,
      c₁*(∑ i,(v i)^2) ≤ ∑ i,∑ j,v i*L₁ t i j*v j)
    (hR₁ : ∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),∀ v : ι → ℝ,
      d₁*(∑ i,(v i)^2) ≤ ∑ i,∑ j,v i*R₁ t i j*v j)
    (hinit : ‖X a‖ ≤ C*η) (hzinit : Z a=0) :
    (∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),‖X t‖ ≤ (C+C/γ)*η) ∧
    (∫ t in a..(a+T),‖X t‖) ≤ 2*C*η/γ ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Icc a (a+T),‖Z t‖ ≤ (C+2*C*(C+C/γ))*η/(γ*T)) ∧
    (∫ t in a..(a+T),‖Z t‖) ≤ C*η/γ+4*C^2*η/γ^2

      d*(∑ i,(v i)^2) ≤ ∑ i,∑ j,v i*R t i j*v j) :

    (hab : a ≤ b) (hρ : ContinuousOn ρ (Set.Icc a b)) (hQ : ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc a b)) (hX : ContinuousOn X (Set.Icc a b))
    (hZ : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,HasDerivAt Z ((ρ t-Q t*X t-X t*Q t)-(L t*Z t+Z t*R t)) t)

theorem quadratic_remainder {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} {C : ℝ}

    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) (3/2),HasDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    (hf' : ∀ x ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) (3/2),HasDerivAt f' (f'' x) x)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) (3/2),|f'' x| ≤ C) :
    ∀ q ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) (3/2),
      |f q-f 1-(q-1)*f' 1| ≤ C*(q-1)^2 ∧ |f' q-f' 1| ≤ C*|q-1|

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.LinearODE.actualBergerComparison_coercive
statement:
lemma actualBergerComparison_coercive {α p : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hα : Continuous α) (hp : Continuous p) {M Mp B β p₀ θ γ δ T τ r Z : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hMp : 0 ≤ Mp) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hαn : ∀ t,|α t| ≤ M) (hpn : ∀ t,|p t| ≤ Mp)
    (hAp : ∀ t,0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ α t*B) (hroot : β*B-p₀*θ-θ^2=0)
    (hscale : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,|α t-β| ≤ δ)
    (hpt : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,|p t-p₀| ≤ δ)
    (hpl : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,γ ≤ p t)
    (D : E →L[ℝ] E) {z : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hz : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,|z (τ*t)| ≤ Z)
    (hsmall : ((|B|+|θ|)/γ)*δ+
      τ*(|β/(p₀+2*θ)| * Z * ‖r • (B • (1:E →L[ℝ] E))+D‖) ≤ θ/2) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T,∀ x : E,
      (θ/2)*‖x‖^2 ≤ inner ℝ x (actualBergerComparison α p r B β p₀ θ τ D z t x)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.LinearODE.actual_berger_comparison_residuals
statement:
theorem actual_berger_comparison_residuals (r B β p₀ θ γ : ℝ) (D : R)
    {M Z : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hc : p₀+2*θ ≠ 0) (hroot : β*B-p₀*θ-θ^2=0) :
    ∃ C : ℝ,0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (α p : ℝ → ℝ) (Mp δ T τ : ℝ),
      Continuous α → Continuous p → 0 ≤ Mp → 0 ≤ δ → 0 ≤ τ →
      (∀ t,|α t| ≤ M) → (∀ t,|p t| ≤ Mp) →
      (∀ t,0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ α t*B) →
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,|α t-β| ≤ δ) →
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,|p t-p₀| ≤ δ) →
      (∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,γ ≤ p t) →
      ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,∀ z zd zh zhd : ℝ,
        |z| ≤ Z → |zd| ≤ Z → |zh| ≤ Z → |zhd| ≤ Z →
        1+τ*z ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) (3/2) →
        let v := scalarBaseline (fun s => α s*B) p θ t
        let S := bergerSlowGenerator r B β p₀ θ z D
        let Sd := bergerSlowGenerator r B β p₀ θ zd D
        let Sh := bergerSlowGenerator r B β p₀ θ zh D
        let Shd := bergerSlowGenerator r B β p₀ θ zhd D
        let Q := v • (1:R)+τ • S
        ‖α t • PulseTaylor.angular r (B • (1:R)) D (1+τ*z)-p t • Q-Q*Q-
          ((α t*B-p t*v-v^2) • (1:R)+(τ^2) • Sd)‖ ≤ C*(δ*τ+τ^2) ∧
        ‖(τ*zh) • (α t • PulseTaylor.angularD r (B • (1:R)) D (1+τ*z))-
          p t • (τ • Sh)-(τ • Sh)*Q-Q*(τ • Sh)-(τ^2) • Shd‖ ≤ C*(δ*τ+τ^2)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.LinearODE.berger_comparison_residuals
statement:
theorem berger_comparison_residuals (r B β p₀ θ : ℝ) (D : R)
    {M Z K : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hc : p₀+2*θ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ C : ℝ,0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ α p v δ τ z zd zh zhd : ℝ,
      0 ≤ δ → 0 ≤ τ → |α| ≤ M → |α-β| ≤ δ → |p-p₀| ≤ δ → |v-θ| ≤ K*δ →
      |z| ≤ Z → |zd| ≤ Z → |zh| ≤ Z → |zhd| ≤ Z →
      1+τ*z ∈ Set.Icc (1/2:ℝ) (3/2) →
      let S := bergerSlowGenerator r B β p₀ θ z D
      let Sd := bergerSlowGenerator r B β p₀ θ zd D
      let Sh := bergerSlowGenerator r B β p₀ θ zh D
      let Shd := bergerSlowGenerator r B β p₀ θ zhd D
      let Q := v • (1:R)+τ • S
      ‖α • angular r (B • (1:R)) D (1+τ*z)-p • Q-Q*Q-
        ((α*B-p*v-v^2) • (1:R)+(τ^2) • Sd)‖ ≤ C*(δ*τ+τ^2) ∧
      ‖(τ*zh) • (α • angularD r (B • (1:R)) D (1+τ*z))-
        p • (τ • Sh)-(τ • Sh)*Q-Q*(τ • Sh)-(τ^2) • Shd‖ ≤ C*(δ*τ+τ^2)

      ((A₀-p*v-v^2) • (1:R)+(τ^2) • Sdot) =

statement:
theorem actual_smooth_positive_word (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :

      (a : Fin n → ℝ) (U T : ℝ),0 ≤ U → (∀ j,|a j| ≤ U) → 0 < T → 2*C*U ≤ T →

      (∀ j x,-(B*‖x‖^2) ≤ inner ℝ x (D j x)) →

theorem christoffel_normalized (g : SmoothMetric n) (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n))
    {A q : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {h p : ℝ}
    (hmetric : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ i j, g.coeff y i j =
      rawPolarEntry J A (fun z => (1-A z)/(z ⬝ᵥ z))
        (fun z => A z*(q z-1)/(z ⬝ᵥ z)) y i j)
    (hS : x ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0) (hA0 : A x ≠ 0) (hq0 : q x ≠ 0)
    (hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ A x) (hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ q x)
    (hAd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i A x = (2*A x*h/(x ⬝ᵥ x))*x i)
    (hqd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i q x = (2*q x*p/(x ⬝ᵥ x))*x i)
    (k i j : Fin n) :
    christoffel g x k i j = normalizedConnectionCoeff J x (A x) (q x) h p k i j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.christoffel_of_rawPolar
statement:
theorem christoffel_of_rawPolar (g : SmoothMetric n) (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n))
    {A B C : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {D Ad Bd Cd : ℝ}
    (hcoeff : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ i j, g.coeff y i j = rawPolarEntry J A B C y i j)
    (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0) (hA0 : A x ≠ 0) (hD0 : D ≠ 0)
    (hBval : B x = (1-A x)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)) (hCval : C x = (D-A x)/(x ⬝ᵥ x))
    (hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ A x) (hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ B x)
    (hC : DifferentiableAt ℝ C x)
    (hAd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i A x = Ad*x i)
    (hBd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i B x = Bd*x i)
    (hCd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i C x = Cd*x i)
    (k i j : Fin n) :
    christoffel g x k i j =
    connectionCoeff J x (Ad/(2*A x)) (B x-Ad/2)
      (Ad*(1-(A x)⁻¹)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)+Bd/2)
      (Ad*(D⁻¹-(A x)⁻¹)/(2*(x ⬝ᵥ x))+Cd/(2*D)+C x*(D⁻¹-(A x)⁻¹)/(x ⬝ᵥ x))
      (-Cd/2-2*C x*(1-(A x)⁻¹)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)) (C x/A x) k i j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.connectionCoeff_divergence
statement:
lemma connectionCoeff_divergence (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n))
    {a b c d e f : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {ad bd cd dd ed fd : ℝ}
    (ha : DifferentiableAt ℝ a x) (hb : DifferentiableAt ℝ b x)
    (hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ c x) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ d x)
    (he : DifferentiableAt ℝ e x) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x)
    (had : ∀ i, coordDeriv i a x = ad*x i) (hbd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i b x = bd*x i)
    (hcd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i c x = cd*x i) (hdd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i d x = dd*x i)
    (hed : ∀ i, coordDeriv i e x = ed*x i) (hfd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i f x = fd*x i)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ k, coordDeriv k (fun y => connectionCoeff J y (a y) (b y) (c y) (d y) (e y) (f y) k i j) x) =
      (2*a x+(n:ℝ)*b x+bd*(x ⬝ᵥ x)-2*f x)*(1:Mat n) i j+
      (2*ad+cd*(x ⬝ᵥ x)+((n:ℝ)+2)*c x-2*d x)*x i*x j+
      (2*d x+ed*(x ⬝ᵥ x)+((n:ℝ)+2)*e x-2*fd)*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) i*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.connectionCoeff_inner_trace
statement:
lemma connectionCoeff_inner_trace (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n)) (x : Space n)
    (a b c d e f : ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ k, ∑ l, connectionCoeff J x a b c d e f l i k *
      connectionCoeff J x a b c d e f k j l) =
    2*a*b*(x ⬝ᵥ x)*(1:Mat n) i j+
    ((2*a+b+c*(x ⬝ᵥ x))^2+(a+d*(x ⬝ᵥ x)+f)^2+
      ((n:ℝ)-2)*a^2-2*a*b)*x i*x j+
    (2*(a+d*(x ⬝ᵥ x)+f)*(b+e*(x ⬝ᵥ x)-2*f)-
      ((n:ℝ)-2)*f^2-2*a*b)*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) i*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.connectionCoeff_outer_trace
statement:
lemma connectionCoeff_outer_trace (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n)) (x : Space n)
    (a b c d e f : ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ k, ∑ l, connectionCoeff J x a b c d e f k i j *
      connectionCoeff J x a b c d e f l k l) =
    (a*((n:ℝ)+1)+b+(c+d)*(x ⬝ᵥ x)+f)*
      (b*(x ⬝ᵥ x)*(1:Mat n) i j+(2*a+c*(x ⬝ᵥ x))*x i*x j+
        (e*(x ⬝ᵥ x)-2*f)*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) i*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) j)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.connectionCoeff_radial_contraction
statement:
lemma connectionCoeff_radial_contraction (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n)) (x : Space n)
    (a b c d e f : ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ k, connectionCoeff J x a b c d e f k i j * x k) =
      b*(x ⬝ᵥ x)*(1:Mat n) i j+(2*a+c*(x ⬝ᵥ x))*x i*x j+
        (e*(x ⬝ᵥ x)-2*f)*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) i*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.connectionCoeff_symmetric
statement:
lemma connectionCoeff_symmetric (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n)) (x : Space n)
    (a b c d e f : ℝ) (k i j : Fin n) :
    connectionCoeff J x a b c d e f k i j =
      connectionCoeff J x a b c d e f k j i

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.connectionCoeff_trace
statement:
lemma connectionCoeff_trace (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n)) (x : Space n)
    (a b c d e f : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    (∑ k, connectionCoeff J x a b c d e f k i k) =
      (a*((n:ℝ)+1)+b+(c+d)*(x ⬝ᵥ x)+f)*x i

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.connectionCoeff_trace_derivative
statement:
lemma connectionCoeff_trace_derivative (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n))
    {a b c d e f : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {ad bd cd dd fd : ℝ}
    (ha : DifferentiableAt ℝ a x) (hb : DifferentiableAt ℝ b x)
    (hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ c x) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ d x)
    (he : DifferentiableAt ℝ e x) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x)
    (had : ∀ i, coordDeriv i a x = ad*x i) (hbd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i b x = bd*x i)
    (hcd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i c x = cd*x i) (hdd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i d x = dd*x i)
    (hfd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i f x = fd*x i)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ k, coordDeriv j (fun y => connectionCoeff J y (a y) (b y) (c y) (d y) (e y) (f y) k i k) x) =
      (a x*((n:ℝ)+1)+b x+(c x+d x)*(x ⬝ᵥ x)+f x)*(1:Mat n) i j+
      (ad*((n:ℝ)+1)+bd+(cd+dd)*(x ⬝ᵥ x)+2*(c x+d x)+fd)*x i*x j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.connectionMatrix_trace
statement:
lemma connectionMatrix_trace (J : ComplexStructure ι) (x u : ι → ℝ)
    (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    (connectionMatrix J x a b c d e f u).trace =
      (a*((Fintype.card ι:ℝ)+1)+b+(c+d)*(x ⬝ᵥ x)+f)*(x ⬝ᵥ u)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.connectionMatrix_trace_product
statement:
lemma connectionMatrix_trace_product (J : ComplexStructure ι) (x u v : ι → ℝ)
    (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    (connectionMatrix J x a b c d e f u *
      connectionMatrix J x a b c d e f v).trace =
    2*a*b*(x ⬝ᵥ x)*(u ⬝ᵥ v) +
    ((2*a+b+c*(x ⬝ᵥ x))^2 + (a+d*(x ⬝ᵥ x)+f)^2 +
      ((Fintype.card ι:ℝ)-2)*a^2-2*a*b)*(x ⬝ᵥ u)*(x ⬝ᵥ v) +
    (2*(a+d*(x ⬝ᵥ x)+f)*(b+e*(x ⬝ᵥ x)-2*f) -
      ((Fintype.card ι:ℝ)-2)*f^2-2*a*b)*
        ((J.matrix *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ u)*((J.matrix *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ v)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.coordDeriv_radialSquare
statement:
lemma coordDeriv_radialSquare (x : Space n) (i : Fin n) :
    coordDeriv i (fun y : Space n => y ⬝ᵥ y) x = 2*x i

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.differentiableAt_linear_entry
statement:
lemma differentiableAt_linear_entry (M : Mat n) (x : Space n) (i : Fin n) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (M *ᵥ y) i) x

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.differentiableAt_radialSquare
statement:
lemma differentiableAt_radialSquare (x : Space n) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : Space n => y ⬝ᵥ y) x

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.divergence_delta_radial
statement:
lemma divergence_delta_radial {p : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {pd : ℝ}
    (hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ p x) (hpd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i p x = pd*x i)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ k, coordDeriv k (fun y => p y * (y i*(1:Mat n) k j+y j*(1:Mat n) k i)) x) =
      2*p x*(1:Mat n) i j+2*pd*x i*x j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.divergence_hopf_cubic
statement:
lemma divergence_hopf_cubic (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n))
    {p : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {pd : ℝ}
    (hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ p x) (hpd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i p x = pd*x i)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ k, coordDeriv k (fun y => p y * y k *
      (J.matrix *ᵥ y) i*(J.matrix *ᵥ y) j) x) =
      (pd*(x ⬝ᵥ x)+((n:ℝ)+2)*p x)*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) i*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.divergence_hopf_linear
statement:
lemma divergence_hopf_linear (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n))
    {p : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {pd : ℝ}
    (hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ p x) (hpd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i p x = pd*x i)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ k, coordDeriv k (fun y => p y *
      ((J.matrix *ᵥ y) j*J.matrix k i+(J.matrix *ᵥ y) i*J.matrix k j)) x) =
      -2*p x*(1:Mat n) i j-2*pd*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) i*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.divergence_hopf_mixed
statement:
lemma divergence_hopf_mixed (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n))
    {p : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {pd : ℝ}
    (hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ p x) (hpd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i p x = pd*x i)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ k, coordDeriv k (fun y => p y * (J.matrix *ᵥ y) k *
      (y i*(J.matrix *ᵥ y) j+y j*(J.matrix *ᵥ y) i)) x) =
      2*p x*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) i*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) j-2*p x*x i*x j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.divergence_radial_cubic
statement:
lemma divergence_radial_cubic {p : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {pd : ℝ}
    (hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ p x) (hpd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i p x = pd*x i)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ k, coordDeriv k (fun y => p y * y k * y i * y j) x) =
      (pd*(x ⬝ᵥ x)+((n:ℝ)+2)*p x)*x i*x j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.divergence_radial_delta
statement:
lemma divergence_radial_delta {p : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {pd : ℝ}
    (hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ p x) (hpd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i p x = pd*x i)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ k, coordDeriv k (fun y => p y * y k * (1:Mat n) i j) x) =
      ((n:ℝ)*p x+pd*(x ⬝ᵥ x))*(1:Mat n) i j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.firstKind_rawPolar
statement:
lemma firstKind_rawPolar (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n))
    {A B C : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {Ad Bd Cd : ℝ}
    (hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ A x) (hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ B x)
    (hC : DifferentiableAt ℝ C x)
    (hAd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i A x = Ad*x i)
    (hBd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i B x = Bd*x i)
    (hCd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i C x = Cd*x i)
    (l i j : Fin n) :
    (1/2:ℝ)*(coordDeriv i (fun y => rawPolarEntry J A B C y j l) x+
      coordDeriv j (fun y => rawPolarEntry J A B C y i l) x-
      coordDeriv l (fun y => rawPolarEntry J A B C y i j) x) =
      lowerConnectionCoeff J x (B x) (C x) Ad Bd Cd l i j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.gradient_normalAlpha
statement:
lemma gradient_normalAlpha {u : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {ud : ℝ}
    (hS : x ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0)
    (hu : DifferentiableAt ℝ u x)
    (hdu : ∀ i, coordDeriv i u x = (ud)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (i : Fin n) :
    coordDeriv i (fun y => normalAlpha (y ⬝ᵥ y) (u y)) x =
      normalAlphaD (x ⬝ᵥ x) (u x) ud*x i

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.gradient_normalBeta
statement:
lemma gradient_normalBeta {A u : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {ud : ℝ}
    (hS : x ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0)
    (hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ A x)
    (hu : DifferentiableAt ℝ u x)
    (hdA : ∀ i, coordDeriv i A x = (2*A x*u x)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (hdu : ∀ i, coordDeriv i u x = (ud)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (i : Fin n) :
    coordDeriv i (fun y => normalBeta (y ⬝ᵥ y) (A y) (u y)) x =
      normalBetaD (x ⬝ᵥ x) (A x) (u x) ud*x i

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.gradient_normalDelta
statement:
lemma gradient_normalDelta {q v : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {vd : ℝ}
    (hS : x ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0)
    (hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ q x)
    (hv : DifferentiableAt ℝ v x)
    (hdq : ∀ i, coordDeriv i q x = (2*q x*v x)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (hdv : ∀ i, coordDeriv i v x = (vd)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (i : Fin n) :
    coordDeriv i (fun y => normalDelta (y ⬝ᵥ y) (q y) (v y)) x =
      normalDeltaD (x ⬝ᵥ x) (q x) (v x) vd*x i

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.gradient_normalEpsilon
statement:
lemma gradient_normalEpsilon {A q u v : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {ud vd : ℝ}
    (hS : x ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0)
    (hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ A x)
    (hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ q x)
    (hu : DifferentiableAt ℝ u x)
    (hv : DifferentiableAt ℝ v x)
    (hdA : ∀ i, coordDeriv i A x = (2*A x*u x)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (hdq : ∀ i, coordDeriv i q x = (2*q x*v x)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (hdu : ∀ i, coordDeriv i u x = (ud)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (hdv : ∀ i, coordDeriv i v x = (vd)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (i : Fin n) :
    coordDeriv i (fun y => normalEpsilon (y ⬝ᵥ y) (A y) (q y) (u y) (v y)) x =
      normalEpsilonD (x ⬝ᵥ x) (A x) (q x) (u x) (v x) ud vd*x i

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.gradient_normalGamma
statement:
lemma gradient_normalGamma {A u : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {ud : ℝ}
    (hS : x ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0)
    (hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ A x)
    (hu : DifferentiableAt ℝ u x)
    (hdA : ∀ i, coordDeriv i A x = (2*A x*u x)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (hdu : ∀ i, coordDeriv i u x = (ud)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (i : Fin n) :
    coordDeriv i (fun y => normalGamma (y ⬝ᵥ y) (A y) (u y)) x =
      normalGammaD (x ⬝ᵥ x) (A x) (u x) ud*x i

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.gradient_normalZeta
statement:
lemma gradient_normalZeta {q v : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n}
    (hS : x ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0)
    (hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ q x)
    (hdq : ∀ i, coordDeriv i q x = (2*q x*v x)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (i : Fin n) :
    coordDeriv i (fun y => normalZeta (y ⬝ᵥ y) (q y)) x =
      normalZetaD (x ⬝ᵥ x) (q x) (v x)*x i

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.horizontalRicci_round
statement:
lemma horizontalRicci_round (m A b bd : ℝ) :
    horizontalRicciNumerator (m+1) A 1 b 0 bd =
      (m-1)*(1-A*(1+b)^2)-A*(b+bd+b^2)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.lowerConnection_hopf
statement:
lemma lowerConnection_hopf (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n)) (x : Space n)
    (B C Ad Bd Cd : ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    (J.matrix *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (fun l => lowerConnectionCoeff J x B C Ad Bd Cd l i j) =
      (Ad/2+Cd*(x ⬝ᵥ x)/2+C)*(x i*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) j+x j*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) i)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.lowerConnection_radial
statement:
lemma lowerConnection_radial (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n)) (x : Space n)
    (B C Ad Bd Cd : ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    x ⬝ᵥ (fun l => lowerConnectionCoeff J x B C Ad Bd Cd l i j) =
      (Ad+Bd*(x ⬝ᵥ x)/2)*x i*x j+(B-Ad/2)*(x ⬝ᵥ x)*(1:Mat n) i j-
        (Cd*(x ⬝ᵥ x)/2+2*C)*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) i*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.normalTraceD_identity
statement:
lemma normalTraceD_identity (N S A q u v ud vd : ℝ) (hS : S ≠ 0) :
    normalAlphaD S u ud*(N+1)+normalBetaD S A u ud+
      (normalGammaD S A u ud+normalDeltaD S q v vd)*S+
      2*(normalGamma S A u+normalDelta S q v)+normalZetaD S q v =
      normalTraceD N S u v ud vd

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.normalTrace_identity
statement:
lemma normalTrace_identity (N S A q u v : ℝ) (hS : S ≠ 0) :
    normalAlpha S u*(N+1)+normalBeta S A u+
      (normalGamma S A u+normalDelta S q v)*S+normalZeta S q =
      normalTrace N S u v

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.normalize_connection
statement:
lemma normalize_connection (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n)) {x : Space n}
    (hS : x ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0) {A q : ℝ} (hA : A ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (h p : ℝ) (k i j : Fin n) :
    connectionCoeff J x ((2*A*h/(x ⬝ᵥ x))/(2*A))
      ((1-A)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)-(2*A*h/(x ⬝ᵥ x))/2)
      ((2*A*h/(x ⬝ᵥ x))*(1-A⁻¹)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)+(-2*A*h-2+2*A)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)^2/2)
      ((2*A*h/(x ⬝ᵥ x))*((A*q)⁻¹-A⁻¹)/(2*(x ⬝ᵥ x))+
        (2*A*(q*(h+p)-h-q+1)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)^2)/(2*(A*q))+
        (A*(q-1)/(x ⬝ᵥ x))*((A*q)⁻¹-A⁻¹)/(x ⬝ᵥ x))
      (-(2*A*(q*(h+p)-h-q+1)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)^2)/2-
        2*(A*(q-1)/(x ⬝ᵥ x))*(1-A⁻¹)/(x ⬝ᵥ x))
      ((A*(q-1)/(x ⬝ᵥ x))/A) k i j = normalizedConnectionCoeff J x A q h p k i j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.normalized_ricci_one
statement:
lemma normalized_ricci_one (N S A q u v ud vd : ℝ) (hS : S ≠ 0) :
    let a := normalAlpha S u
    let b := normalBeta S A u
    let c := normalGamma S A u
    let d := normalDelta S q v
    let f := normalZeta S q
    let ad := normalAlphaD S u ud
    let cd := normalGammaD S A u ud
    let T := normalTrace N S u v
    let Td := normalTraceD N S u v ud vd
    2*ad+cd*S+(N+2)*c-2*d-Td+T*(2*a+c*S)-
      ((2*a+b+c*S)^2+(a+d*S+f)^2+(N-2)*a^2-2*a*b) =
      (radialRicciNumerator N u v ud vd-horizontalRicciNumerator N A q u v ud)/S^2

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.normalized_ricci_two
statement:
lemma normalized_ricci_two (N S A q u v ud vd : ℝ) (hS : S ≠ 0) :
    let a := normalAlpha S u
    let b := normalBeta S A u
    let d := normalDelta S q v
    let e := normalEpsilon S A q u v
    let f := normalZeta S q
    let ed := normalEpsilonD S A q u v ud vd
    let fd := normalZetaD S q v
    let T := normalTrace N S u v
    2*d+ed*S+(N+2)*e-2*fd+T*(e*S-2*f)-
      (2*(a+d*S+f)*(b+e*S-2*f)-(N-2)*f^2-2*a*b) =
      (verticalRicciNumerator N A q u v ud vd-horizontalRicciNumerator N A q u v ud)/S^2

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.normalized_ricci_zero
statement:
lemma normalized_ricci_zero (N S A q u v ud : ℝ) (hS : S ≠ 0) :
    let a := normalAlpha S u
    let b := normalBeta S A u
    let f := normalZeta S q
    let bd := normalBetaD S A u ud
    let T := normalTrace N S u v
    2*a+N*b+bd*S-2*f-T+T*b*S-2*a*b*S =
      horizontalRicciNumerator N A q u v ud/S

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.polarTensor_inverse
OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.polarTensor_mulVec
statement:
lemma polarTensor_mulVec (J : ComplexStructure ι) (x v : ι → ℝ) (A D : ℝ) :
    polarTensor J x A D *ᵥ v =
      A • v+(((1-A)/(x ⬝ᵥ x))*(x ⬝ᵥ v)) • x+
        (((D-A)/(x ⬝ᵥ x))*((J.matrix *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ v)) • (J.matrix *ᵥ x)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.polar_quadratic
statement:
lemma polar_quadratic (x z w : Space n) (a b c : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (a*(1:Mat n) i j+b*x i*x j+c*z i*z j)*w i*w j) =
      a*(w ⬝ᵥ w)+b*(x ⬝ᵥ w)^2+c*(z ⬝ᵥ w)^2

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.radialRicci_shape
statement:
lemma radialRicci_shape (m b bd p pd : ℝ) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    radialRicciNumerator (m+1) (b-p/m) p (bd-pd/m) pd =
      -m*(b+bd+b^2)-(m-1)/m*p^2

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.radial_scalar_budget
statement:
lemma radial_scalar_budget {m μ x C b bd p pd : ℝ}
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hc : 64*C^2 ≤ m*μ*x^2)
    (hb : b+bd+b^2 ≤ -μ/(64*x^10)) (hp : |p| ≤ C/x^6) :
    0 ≤ radialRicciNumerator (m+1) (b-p/m) p (bd-pd/m) pd

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.raise_lowerConnection
statement:
lemma raise_lowerConnection (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n)) (x : Space n)
    (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0) (A D B C Ad Bd Cd : ℝ) (k i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ l, polarTensor J x A⁻¹ D⁻¹ k l*lowerConnectionCoeff J x B C Ad Bd Cd l i j) =
    connectionCoeff J x (Ad/(2*A)) (B-Ad/2)
      (Ad*(1-A⁻¹)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)+Bd/2)
      (Ad*(D⁻¹-A⁻¹)/(2*(x ⬝ᵥ x))+Cd/(2*D)+C*(D⁻¹-A⁻¹)/(x ⬝ᵥ x))
      (-Cd/2-2*C*(1-A⁻¹)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)) (C/A) k i j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.ricci_normalized
statement:
theorem ricci_normalized (g : SmoothMetric n) (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n))
    {A q u v : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {ud vd : ℝ}
    (hΓ : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ k i j, christoffel g y k i j =
      normalizedConnectionCoeff J y (A y) (q y) (u y) (v y) k i j)
    (hS : x ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0)
    (hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ A x) (hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ q x)
    (hu : DifferentiableAt ℝ u x) (hv : DifferentiableAt ℝ v x)
    (hdA : ∀ i, coordDeriv i A x = (2*A x*u x)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (hdq : ∀ i, coordDeriv i q x = (2*q x*v x)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (hdu : ∀ i, coordDeriv i u x = ud/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (hdv : ∀ i, coordDeriv i v x = vd/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*x i)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    ricci g x i j =
      horizontalRicciNumerator n (A x) (q x) (u x) (v x) ud/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*(1:Mat n) i j+
      (radialRicciNumerator n (u x) (v x) ud vd-
        horizontalRicciNumerator n (A x) (q x) (u x) (v x) ud)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)^2*x i*x j+
      (verticalRicciNumerator n (A x) (q x) (u x) (v x) ud vd-
        horizontalRicciNumerator n (A x) (q x) (u x) (v x) ud)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)^2*
          (J.matrix *ᵥ x) i*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.ricci_of_connectionCoeff
statement:
theorem ricci_of_connectionCoeff (g : SmoothMetric n) (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n))
    {a b c d e f : Space n → ℝ} {x : Space n} {ad bd cd dd ed fd : ℝ}
    (hΓ : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ k i j, christoffel g y k i j =
      connectionCoeff J y (a y) (b y) (c y) (d y) (e y) (f y) k i j)
    (ha : DifferentiableAt ℝ a x) (hb : DifferentiableAt ℝ b x)
    (hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ c x) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ d x)
    (he : DifferentiableAt ℝ e x) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x)
    (had : ∀ i, coordDeriv i a x = ad*x i) (hbd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i b x = bd*x i)
    (hcd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i c x = cd*x i) (hdd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i d x = dd*x i)
    (hed : ∀ i, coordDeriv i e x = ed*x i) (hfd : ∀ i, coordDeriv i f x = fd*x i)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    let S := x ⬝ᵥ x
    let T := a x*((n:ℝ)+1)+b x+(c x+d x)*S+f x
    let Td := ad*((n:ℝ)+1)+bd+(cd+dd)*S+2*(c x+d x)+fd
    ricci g x i j =
      (2*a x+(n:ℝ)*b x+bd*S-2*f x-T+T*b x*S-2*a x*b x*S)*(1:Mat n) i j+
      (2*ad+cd*S+((n:ℝ)+2)*c x-2*d x-Td+T*(2*a x+c x*S)-
        ((2*a x+b x+c x*S)^2+(a x+d x*S+f x)^2+((n:ℝ)-2)*(a x)^2-2*a x*b x))*x i*x j+
      (2*d x+ed*S+((n:ℝ)+2)*e x-2*fd+T*(e x*S-2*f x)-
        (2*(a x+d x*S+f x)*(b x+e x*S-2*f x)-((n:ℝ)-2)*(f x)^2-2*a x*b x))*
          (J.matrix *ᵥ x) i*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.roundRicci_nonnegative

lemma roundRicci_nonnegative {m A b bd : ℝ}

    0 ≤ horizontalRicciNumerator (m+1) A 1 b 0 bd ∧
    0 ≤ verticalRicciNumerator (m+1) A 1 b 0 bd 0

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Cartesian.christoffel_logProfiles
statement:
theorem christoffel_logProfiles (g : SmoothMetric n) (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n))
    {A q u v : ℝ → ℝ} {x : Space n} (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (hg : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, g.coeff y =
      tensor (radialUnit y) (hopfUnit J y) (A (logRadius y)) (q (logRadius y)))
    (hA : HasDerivAt A (2*A (logRadius x)*u (logRadius x)) (logRadius x))
    (hq : HasDerivAt q (2*q (logRadius x)*v (logRadius x)) (logRadius x))
    (hA0 : A (logRadius x) ≠ 0) (hq0 : q (logRadius x) ≠ 0)
    (k i j : Fin n) :
    christoffel g x k i j = normalizedConnectionCoeff J x
      (A (logRadius x)) (q (logRadius x)) (u (logRadius x)) (v (logRadius x)) k i j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Cartesian.polarCoefficients_nonnegative
statement:
lemma polarCoefficients_nonnegative (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n))
    {x : Space n} (hx : x ≠ 0) {H R V : ℝ}
    (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (w : Space n) :
    0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, (H/(x ⬝ᵥ x)*(1:Mat n) i j+
      (R-H)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)^2*x i*x j+
      (V-H)/(x ⬝ᵥ x)^2*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) i*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) j)*w i*w j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Cartesian.ricci_logProfiles
statement:
theorem ricci_logProfiles (g : SmoothMetric n) (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n))
    {A q u v : ℝ → ℝ} {x : Space n} {ud vd : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (hg : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, g.coeff y =
      tensor (radialUnit y) (hopfUnit J y) (A (logRadius y)) (q (logRadius y)))
    (hA : ∀ t, HasDerivAt A (2*A t*u t) t)
    (hq : ∀ t, HasDerivAt q (2*q t*v t) t)
    (hA0 : ∀ t, A t ≠ 0) (hq0 : ∀ t, q t ≠ 0)
    (hu : HasDerivAt u ud (logRadius x)) (hv : HasDerivAt v vd (logRadius x))
    (i j : Fin n) :
    let t := logRadius x
    let S := x ⬝ᵥ x
    ricci g x i j =
      horizontalRicciNumerator n (A t) (q t) (u t) (v t) ud/S*(1:Mat n) i j+
      (radialRicciNumerator n (u t) (v t) ud vd-
        horizontalRicciNumerator n (A t) (q t) (u t) (v t) ud)/S^2*x i*x j+
      (verticalRicciNumerator n (A t) (q t) (u t) (v t) ud vd-
        horizontalRicciNumerator n (A t) (q t) (u t) (v t) ud)/S^2*
          (J.matrix *ᵥ x) i*(J.matrix *ᵥ x) j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Cartesian.tensor_eq_rawPolar
statement:
lemma tensor_eq_rawPolar (J : ComplexStructure (Fin n)) {x : Space n}
    (hx : x ≠ 0) (A q : Space n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    tensor (radialUnit x) (hopfUnit J x) (A x) (q x) i j =
      rawPolarEntry J A (fun y => (1-A y)/(y ⬝ᵥ y))
        (fun y => A y*(q y-1)/(y ⬝ᵥ y)) x i j

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.radialRicci_of_pulse_budget
statement:
theorem radialRicci_of_pulse_budget {m μ C : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hμ1 : μ ≤ 1/4) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ J, ∀ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      1/2 ≤ q t → |deriv q t| ≤ C/pulse j →
      t ∈ Set.Icc (time j) (time (j+1)) →
      0 ≤ radialRicciNumerator (m+1)
        (Scale.slope μ t-Pulses.logSlope q t/m) (Pulses.logSlope q t)
        (deriv (Scale.slope μ) t-deriv (Pulses.logSlope q) t/m)
        (deriv (Pulses.logSlope q) t)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.tangentRicci_of_pulse_budget
statement:
theorem tangentRicci_of_pulse_budget {m a μ qstar M C1 C2 : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hqstar : 1 ≤ qstar)
    (ha : Tendsto (Scale.profile μ) atTop (𝓝 a))
    (hH : ∀ q ∈ Set.Icc 1 qstar, 0 < m+1-2*q-(m-1)*a^2*q^(-1/m))
    (hV : ∀ q ∈ Set.Icc 1 qstar, 0 < (m-1)*q*(q-a^2*q^(-1/m))) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ J, ∀ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ q → 1/2 ≤ q t →
      1-M/pulse j ≤ q t → q t ≤ qstar+M/pulse j →
      |deriv q t| ≤ C1/pulse j → |deriv (deriv q) t| ≤ C2/(pulse j)^2 →
      time j ≤ t →
      0 < horizontalRicciNumerator (m+1)
        ((Scale.profile μ t)^2*(q t)^(-1/m)) (q t)
        (Scale.slope μ t-Pulses.logSlope q t/m) (Pulses.logSlope q t)
        (deriv (Scale.slope μ) t-deriv (Pulses.logSlope q) t/m) ∧
      0 < verticalRicciNumerator (m+1)
        ((Scale.profile μ t)^2*(q t)^(-1/m)) (q t)
        (Scale.slope μ t-Pulses.logSlope q t/m) (Pulses.logSlope q t)
        (deriv (Scale.slope μ) t-deriv (Pulses.logSlope q) t/m)
        (deriv (Pulses.logSlope q) t)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.tangent_budget_coordinates
statement:
theorem tangent_budget_coordinates {m a qstar : ℝ}
    (hH : ∀ q ∈ Set.Icc 1 qstar, 0 < m+1-2*q-(m-1)*a^2*q^(-1/m))
    (hV : ∀ q ∈ Set.Icc 1 qstar, 0 < (m-1)*q*(q-a^2*q^(-1/m))) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ (a' q b bd p pd q0 : ℝ), q0 ∈ Set.Icc 1 qstar →
      1/2 ≤ q → |a'-a| < δ → |q-q0| < δ →
      |b| < δ → |bd| < δ → |p| < δ → |pd| < δ →
      0 < horizontalRicciNumerator (m+1) (a'^2*q^(-1/m)) q (b-p/m) p (bd-pd/m) ∧
      0 < verticalRicciNumerator (m+1) (a'^2*q^(-1/m)) q (b-p/m) p (bd-pd/m) pd

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Berger.tangent_budget_tube
statement:
theorem tangent_budget_tube {m a qstar : ℝ}
    (hH : ∀ q ∈ Set.Icc 1 qstar, 0 < m+1-2*q-(m-1)*a^2*q^(-1/m))
    (hV : ∀ q ∈ Set.Icc 1 qstar, 0 < (m-1)*q*(q-a^2*q^(-1/m))) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ (X : Fin 6 → ℝ) (q : ℝ), q ∈ Set.Icc 1 qstar →
      dist X (staticJet a q) < δ → 0 < tangentH m X ∧ 0 < tangentV m X

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Cartesian.bergerMetric_ricciNonnegative
statement:
theorem bergerMetric_ricciNonnegative (c q u v : ℝ → ℝ)
    (J : ℝ → ComplexStructure (Fin n))
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ q)
    (hcp : ∀ t, 0 < c t) (hqp : ∀ t, 0 < q t)
    (hJ : ∀ t, (∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, J s = J t) ∨ (∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, q s = 1))
    {T : ℝ} (hc0 : ∀ t ≤ T, c t = 1) (hq0 : ∀ t ≤ T, q t = 1)
    (hdc : ∀ t, HasDerivAt c (2*c t*u t) t)
    (hdq : ∀ t, HasDerivAt q (2*q t*v t) t)
    (hu : Differentiable ℝ u) (hv : Differentiable ℝ v)
    (hR : ∀ t, 0 ≤ radialRicciNumerator n (u t) (v t) (deriv u t) (deriv v t))
    (hH : ∀ t, 0 ≤ horizontalRicciNumerator n (c t) (q t) (u t) (v t) (deriv u t))
    (hV : ∀ t, 0 ≤ verticalRicciNumerator n (c t) (q t) (u t) (v t) (deriv u t) (deriv v t)) :
    RicciNonnegative (bergerMetric c q J hc hq hcp hqp hJ hc0 hq0)

theorem all_time_log_bound {τ : ℕ → ℝ} {w : ℝ → ℝ} {d α C : ℝ}
    (hτ : Tendsto τ atTop atTop) (hpos : ∀ j, 0 < τ j)
    (hend : Tendsto (fun j => w (τ j) / τ j) atTop (𝓝 d))
    (hduration : Tendsto (fun j => (τ (j+1) - τ j) / τ j) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hlocal : ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (τ j) (τ (j+1)),
      w t ≤ w (τ j) + C * (τ (j+1) - τ j))
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hα : d < α) :
    ∀ᶠ t in atTop, w t ≤ α * t

lemma angular_rest (r : ℝ) (b D0 : E →L[ℝ] E) (D : Fin n → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (s : ℕ → Fin n → ℝ) {qstar t : ℝ} {j0 j : ℕ}
    (hlo : time j+3*pulse j+dwell j ≤ t) (hhi : t ≤ time (j+1)) :
    angular r b D0 D s qstar j0 t=b

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.AngularStream.angular_smooth
statement:
lemma angular_smooth (r : ℝ) (b D0 : E) (D : Fin n → E) (s : ℕ → Fin n → ℝ)
    {qstar : ℝ} (hq : 1 ≤ qstar) (j0 : ℕ)
    (hpos : ∀ j,j0 ≤ j → ∀ t i,packetStretch (s j) (pulse j) t i ≠ 0) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (angular r b D0 D s qstar j0)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.AngularStream.angular_symmetric
statement:
lemma angular_symmetric (r B : ℝ) (D0 : E →L[ℝ] E) (D : Fin n → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (s : ℕ → Fin n → ℝ) {qstar : ℝ} (hq : 1 ≤ qstar) (j0 : ℕ)
    (hpos : ∀ j,j0 ≤ j → ∀ t i,packetStretch (s j) (pulse j) t i ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) (3/2))
    (hD : ∀ d x y,inner ℝ (direction D0 D d x) y=inner ℝ x (direction D0 D d y))
    (t : ℝ) (x y : E) :
    inner ℝ (angular r (B • (1:E →L[ℝ] E)) D0 D s qstar j0 t x) y=
      inner ℝ x (angular r (B • (1:E →L[ℝ] E)) D0 D s qstar j0 t y)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.AngularStream.angular_uniform_bound
statement:
theorem angular_uniform_bound [NeZero n] (r : ℝ) (b D0 : E) (D : Fin n → E)
    {qstar : ℝ} (hq : 1 ≤ qstar) :
    ∃ C : ℝ,0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (s : ℕ → Fin n → ℝ) (j0 : ℕ),
      (∀ j,j0 ≤ j → ∀ t i,packetStretch (s j) (pulse j) t i ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) (3/2)) →
      ∀ t,‖angular r b D0 D s qstar j0 t‖ ≤ C

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.AngularStream.angular_update
statement:
lemma angular_update (r : ℝ) (b D0 : E) (D : Fin n → E) (s : ℕ → Fin n → ℝ)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) (qstar : ℝ) {j0 j : ℕ} (hj : j0 ≤ j) (hz : s j=0) (t : ℝ) :
    angular r b D0 D (Function.update s j x) qstar j0 t=
      angular r b D0 D s qstar j0 t+
        (nonlinearBergerWord r b D x (pulse j) ((t-time j)/pulse j)-b)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.CausalConstruction.causal_choice
statement:
theorem causal_choice (zero : P) (admissible : Set P)
    (good : ℕ → (ℕ → P) → P → Prop)
    (produce : ∀ j s,(∀ i < j,s i ∈ admissible) → (∀ i,j ≤ i → s i=zero) →
      ∃ x ∈ admissible,good j s x) :
    ∃ s : ℕ → P,(∀ j,s j ∈ admissible) ∧
      ∀ j,good j (fun i => if i < j then s i else zero) (s j)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.CausalConstruction.prefixes_stable

lemma prefixes_zero {zero : P} {choose : ℕ → (ℕ → P) → P} {n j : ℕ} (h : n ≤ j) :

    ∀ b,∃ c : ℝ,c ∈ Set.Ioo (1/2:ℝ) (3/2) ∧

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Transmission.comparison_ball
statement:
theorem comparison_ball (g' : E → E →L[ℝ] E) (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E)
    (hc : ContinuousAt g' 0) (h0 : g' 0=A.toContinuousLinearMap) :
    ∃ r : ℝ,0 < r ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:E) r,
      ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E-A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (g' x)‖ ≤ 1/4

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Transmission.full_leg_factor
statement:
lemma full_leg_factor (U V P B : R) (θ : ℝ) (D : Rˣ)
    (hD : (D:R)=U+θ • V) :
    (↑D⁻¹:R)*((U+V*P)*B)=
      (1+((↑D⁻¹:R)*V)*(P-θ • (1:R)))*B

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Transmission.robust_zero
statement:
theorem robust_zero {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] (f : E → E) (f' : E → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r, HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r,
      ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E - A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (f' x)‖ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hstart : ‖A.symm (f 0)‖ ≤ r / 2) :
    ∃ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) r, f x = 0

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Transmission.robust_zero_of_comparison
statement:
theorem robust_zero_of_comparison (f : E → E) (f' g' : E → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:E) r,HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    (hbase : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:E) r,
      ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E-A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (g' x)‖ ≤ 1/4)
    (herr : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:E) r,
      ‖A.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (f' x-g' x)‖ ≤ 1/4)
    (hstart : ‖A.symm (f 0)‖ ≤ r/2) :
    ∃ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:E) r,f x=0

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Transmission.uniform_attainment_tolerance
statement:
theorem uniform_attainment_tolerance (g : E → E) (g' : E → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (hg0 : g 0=0) (hgc : ContinuousAt g' 0)
    (hg'0 : g' 0=A.toContinuousLinearMap) :
    ∃ r ε : ℝ,0 < r ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ (f : E → E) (f' : E → E →L[ℝ] E),
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:E) r,HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x) →
        ‖f 0-g 0‖ ≤ ε →
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:E) r,‖f' x-g' x‖ ≤ ε) →
        ∃ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:E) r,f x=0

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Transmission.uniform_projected_attainment
statement:
theorem uniform_projected_attainment
    (Φ : E → F) (Φ' : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (L : F →L[ℝ] E) (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E)
    (hΦ : ContinuousAt Φ 0) (hΦ' : ContinuousAt Φ' 0)
    (hzero : L (Φ 0)=0) (hjet : L.comp (Φ' 0)=A.toContinuousLinearMap)
    {U : Set F} (hU : IsOpen U) (htgt : Φ 0 ∈ U) :
    ∃ r ε : ℝ,0 < r ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ (Ψ : E → F) (Ψ' : E → E →L[ℝ] F),
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:E) r,HasFDerivAt Ψ (Ψ' x) x) →
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:E) r,‖Ψ x-Φ x‖ ≤ ε) →
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:E) r,‖Ψ' x-Φ' x‖ ≤ ε) →
        ∃ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0:E) r,L (Ψ x)=0 ∧ Ψ x ∈ U

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Transmission.wholePeriodJet_apply
statement:
lemma wholePeriodJet_apply {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    (K Q B : R) (Q' B' : H →L[ℝ] R) (v : H) :
    wholePeriodJet K Q B Q' B' v=(1+K*Q)*(B' v)+(K*(Q' v))*B

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Transmission.wholePeriod_hasFDerivAt
statement:
lemma wholePeriod_hasFDerivAt {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    (K : R) {Q B : H → R} {Q' B' : H →L[ℝ] R} {x : H}
    (hQ : HasFDerivAt Q Q' x) (hB : HasFDerivAt B B' x) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => wholePeriod K (Q y) (B y))
      (wholePeriodJet K (Q x) (B x) Q' B') x

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.Transmission.wholePeriod_jet_error
statement:
lemma wholePeriod_jet_error {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    {K Q B Hval : R} {Q' B' H' : H →L[ℝ] R} {K₀ ε H₀ H₁ : ℝ}
    (hK : ‖K‖ ≤ K₀) (hQ : ‖Q‖ ≤ ε) (hB : ‖B-Hval‖ ≤ ε)
    (hH : ‖Hval‖ ≤ H₀) (hQ' : ‖Q'‖ ≤ ε) (hB' : ‖B'-H'‖ ≤ ε)
    (hH' : ‖H'‖ ≤ H₁) :
    ‖wholePeriodJet K Q B Q' B'-H'‖ ≤
      ε+K₀*ε*(H₁+ε)+K₀*ε*(H₀+ε)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.FiniteControl.SmoothWord.compact_amplitude_jet_bound
statement:
lemma compact_amplitude_jet_bound {K : Set H} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (amps : Fin n → H → ℝ) (amps' : Fin n → H → H →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ j,ContinuousOn (amps j) K) (hd : ∀ j,ContinuousOn (amps' j) K) :
    ∃ U : ℝ,0 ≤ U ∧ ∀ x ∈ K,∀ j,|amps j x| ≤ U ∧ ‖amps' j x‖ ≤ U

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.FiniteControl.SmoothWord.compact_ideal_packet_bound
statement:
theorem compact_ideal_packet_bound {K : Set H} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (amps : Fin n → H → ℝ) (amps' : Fin n → H → H →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ j,ContinuousOn (amps j) K) (hd : ∀ j,ContinuousOn (amps' j) K)
    (X : Fin n → E) :
    ∃ C : ℝ,0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x ∈ K,
      (∀ t,‖unitPacketCoefficient (fun j => amps j x) X t‖ ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ t,‖unitPacketJet (fun j => amps' j x) X t‖ ≤ C) ∧
      (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1,‖unitPacketCoefficient (fun j => amps j x) X t‖)+
        (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1,‖unitPacketJet (fun j => amps' j x) X t‖) ≤ 2*C

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.FiniteControl.SmoothWord.insertWord_compact_C1_bound
statement:
theorem insertWord_compact_C1_bound {K : Set H} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (r : ℝ) (b : E) (D : Fin n → E)
    (amps : Fin n → H → ℝ) (amps' : Fin n → H → H →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ x ∈ K,∀ j,HasFDerivAt (amps j) (amps' j x) x)
    (hc : ∀ j,ContinuousOn (amps j) K) (hd : ∀ j,ContinuousOn (amps' j) K) :
    ∃ T₀ C : ℝ,1 ≤ T₀ ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ T ≥ T₀,∀ x ∈ K,
      (∀ j t,packetStretch (fun i => amps i x) T t j ∈ Icc (1/2:ℝ) (3/2)) ∧
      ∀ (history : ℝ → E) (α : ℝ → ℝ) (M a : ℝ),0 ≤ M →
        (∀ t,|α t| ≤ M) → ∀ t,
        ‖insertWord history α r b D (fun i => amps i x) a T t-history t‖ ≤ M*C/T ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => insertWord history α r b D (fun i => amps i y) a T t) x‖ ≤ M*C/T

statement:
lemma exponential_error_linear {J G d : ℝ} (hJ : 0 ≤ J) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hGd : G*d ≤ 1) :
    Real.exp (2*J+J*(G*d))*(J*(G*d)) ≤ (Real.exp (3*J)*J*G)*d

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.LinearODE.finite_C1_norm
statement:
lemma finite_C1_norm {f : (i : β) → H → F i} {x : H} {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hf : ∀ i,DifferentiableAt ℝ (f i) x)
    (he : ∀ i,max ‖f i x‖ ‖fderiv ℝ (f i) x‖ ≤ η) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y i => f i y) x ∧
      max ‖(fun i => f i x)‖ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y i => f i y) x‖ ≤ η

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.LinearODE.linear_C1_error
statement:
lemma linear_C1_error (L : E →L[ℝ] F) {f g : H → E} {x : H} {η : ℝ}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x)
    (he : max ‖f x-g x‖ ‖fderiv ℝ f x-fderiv ℝ g x‖ ≤ η) :
    max ‖L (f x)-L (g x)‖
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => L (f y)) x-fderiv ℝ (fun y => L (g y)) x‖ ≤ ‖L‖*η

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.LinearODE.normalized_transmission_differentiableAt

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.LinearODE.actual_diagonal_normalizer
statement:
theorem actual_diagonal_normalizer {A : ι → ℝ → ℝ} {p : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ i,Continuous (A i)) (hp : Continuous p)
    (MA : ι → ℝ) {Mp t θ : ℝ} (hMA : ∀ i,0 ≤ MA i) (hMp : 0 ≤ Mp)
    (hAn : ∀ i s,|A i s| ≤ MA i) (hpn : ∀ s,|p s| ≤ Mp)
    (hAp : ∀ i s,0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ A i s) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    ∃ D : (Matrix ι ι ℝ)ˣ,
      (D:Matrix ι ι ℝ)=Matrix.diagonal (fun i => scalarU (A i) p t)+
        θ • Matrix.diagonal (fun i => scalarV (A i) p t) ∧
      (∀ i,0 < (D:Matrix ι ι ℝ) i i) ∧
      ‖(↑D⁻¹:Matrix ι ι ℝ)*Matrix.diagonal (fun i => scalarV (A i) p t)‖ ≤
        ‖diagonalL (ι:=ι)‖*θ⁻¹

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.LinearODE.actual_diagonal_restart
statement:
theorem actual_diagonal_restart (basis : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ E)
    {A : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E} {b : ℝ → ℝ} {lam : ι → ℝ → ℝ}
    {MA Mb c d : ℝ} (N : ι → ℝ) (l : ℝ)
    (hA : Continuous A) (hb : Continuous b) (hlam : ∀ i,Continuous (lam i))
    (hMA : 0 ≤ MA) (hMb : 0 ≤ Mb) (hN : ∀ i,0 ≤ N i)
    (hnA : ∀ t,‖A t‖ ≤ MA) (hnb : ∀ t,|b t| ≤ Mb) (hnlam : ∀ i t,|lam i t| ≤ N i)
    (hdiag : ∀ t ∈ Ico c d,orthogonalMatrix basis (A t)=Matrix.diagonal (fun i => lam i t)) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc c d,orthogonalMatrix basis (operatorValue A b l t)=
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => scalarU (fun s => lam i (c+s)) (fun s => b (c+s)) (t-c))*
        orthogonalMatrix basis (operatorValue A b l c)+
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => scalarV (fun s => lam i (c+s)) (fun s => b (c+s)) (t-c))*
        orthogonalMatrix basis (operatorVelocity A b l c)

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.LinearODE.diagonal_leg_normalizer
statement:
theorem diagonal_leg_normalizer (u v : ι → ℝ) {θ : ℝ}
    (hu : ∀ i,1 ≤ u i) (hv : ∀ i,0 ≤ v i) (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    ∃ D : (Matrix ι ι ℝ)ˣ,
      (D:Matrix ι ι ℝ)=Matrix.diagonal u+θ • Matrix.diagonal v ∧
      (∀ i,0 < (D:Matrix ι ι ℝ) i i) ∧
      ‖(↑D⁻¹:Matrix ι ι ℝ)*Matrix.diagonal v‖ ≤ ‖diagonalL (ι:=ι)‖*θ⁻¹

    ∃ T R H : ℝ,1 ≤ T ∧ 0 < R ∧ 1 ≤ H ∧

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.LinearODE.matrix_diagonal_restart
statement:
theorem matrix_diagonal_restart {lam : ι → ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ → ℝ}
    {F G : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ} {c d Mb : ℝ} (MA : ι → ℝ)
    (hlam : ∀ i,Continuous (lam i)) (hb : Continuous b)
    (hMA : ∀ i,0 ≤ MA i) (hMb : 0 ≤ Mb)
    (hnlam : ∀ i t,|lam i t| ≤ MA i) (hnb : ∀ t,|b t| ≤ Mb)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (Icc c d)) (hG : ContinuousOn G (Icc c d))
    (hdF : ∀ t ∈ Ico c d,HasDerivAt F (G t) t)
    (hdG : ∀ t ∈ Ico c d,HasDerivAt G
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => lam i t)*F t-b t • G t) t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc c d,F t=
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => scalarU (fun s => lam i (c+s)) (fun s => b (c+s)) (t-c))*F c+
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => scalarV (fun s => lam i (c+s)) (fun s => b (c+s)) (t-c))*G c

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.LinearODE.scalar_restart_on
statement:
theorem scalar_restart_on {A b f g : ℝ → ℝ} {c d MA Mb : ℝ}
    (hA : Continuous A) (hb : Continuous b) (hMA : 0 ≤ MA) (hMb : 0 ≤ Mb)
    (hnA : ∀ t,|A t| ≤ MA) (hnb : ∀ t,|b t| ≤ Mb)
    (hfc : ContinuousOn f (Icc c d)) (hgc : ContinuousOn g (Icc c d))
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Ico c d,HasDerivAt f (g t) t)
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ Ico c d,HasDerivAt g (A t*f t-b t*g t) t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc c d,f t=
      scalarU (fun s => A (c+s)) (fun s => b (c+s)) (t-c)*f c+
      scalarV (fun s => A (c+s)) (fun s => b (c+s)) (t-c)*g c

statement:
lemma PhysicalWord.defect_factor (S : PulseSystem E ι κ) (w : PhysicalWord κ) (H : PulseHistory S) :
    (fun x b => orthogonalMatrix (S.basis b) (slope (insertWord (H.history b) H.α S.r
      (S.B b • (1:E b →L[ℝ] E b)) (fun j => S.D b (w.slot j)) (fun j => w.amps j x) H.a H.T)
      H.drift (H.l b) (H.a+H.T))-S.θ b • (1:Matrix (ι b) (ι b) ℝ)) = w.defect S H

        (unitPacketCoefficient (fun j => w.amps j x) (fun j => bergerSlowGenerator S.r (S.B b) (S.β b) S.p₀ (S.θ b) 1 (S.D b (w.slot j))) t)) 1 1))=w.ideal S

name: OAI.HarmonicCounterexample.LinearODE.PhysicalWord.value_factor
statement:
lemma PhysicalWord.value_factor (S : PulseSystem E ι κ) (w : PhysicalWord κ) (H : PulseHistory S) :
    (fun x b => orthogonalMatrix (S.basis b) (Real.exp (-(∫ t in H.a..H.a+H.T,
      scalarBaseline (fun s => H.α (H.a+s)*S.B b) (fun s => H.drift (H.a+s)) (S.θ b) (max 0 (t-H.a)))) •
        (operatorValue (insertWord (H.history b) H.α S.r (S.B b • (1:E b →L[ℝ] E b))
          (fun j => S.D b (w.slot j)) (fun j => w.amps j x) H.a H.T) H.drift (H.l b) (H.a+H.T)*
        Ring.inverse (operatorValue (insertWord (H.history b) H.α S.r (S.B b • (1:E b →L[ℝ] E b))
          (fun j => S.D b (w.slot j)) (fun j => w.amps j x) H.a H.T) H.drift (H.l b) H.a)))) = w.value S H

name: OAI.RectangleGrid.band_extend
statement:
theorem band_extend (H : Set (P → X)) (V : Set (Q → X)) (T : Set (P × Q → X))
    (horizontal : ∀ f ∈ T, ∀ q, (fun p ↦ f (p,q)) ∈ H)
    (vertical : ∀ f ∈ T, ∀ p, (fun q ↦ f (p,q)) ∈ V)
    (fill : ∀ a ∈ H, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ p q, a p=b q →
      ∃ f ∈ T, (∀ x, f (x,q)=a x) ∧ (∀ y, f (p,y)=b y))
    (D : ℕ → P × Q → X) (lo hi : ℕ → P) (bot top : ℕ → Q)
    (join : ∀ i, D i (hi i,top i)=D (i+1) (lo (i+1),bot (i+1)))
    (k : ℕ) (G : Band T D lo hi bot top k) :
    ∃ F : Band T D lo hi bot top (k+1), ∀ i j, band k i j → F.tile i j=G.tile i j

name: OAI.RectangleGrid.diagonal_grid
statement:
theorem diagonal_grid (H : Set (P → X)) (V : Set (Q → X)) (T : Set (P × Q → X))
    (horizontal : ∀ f ∈ T, ∀ q, (fun p ↦ f (p,q)) ∈ H)
    (vertical : ∀ f ∈ T, ∀ p, (fun q ↦ f (p,q)) ∈ V)
    (fill : ∀ a ∈ H, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ p q, a p=b q →
      ∃ f ∈ T, (∀ x, f (x,q)=a x) ∧ (∀ y, f (p,y)=b y))
    (D : ℕ → P × Q → X) (hD : ∀ i, D i ∈ T)
    (lo hi : ℕ → P) (bot top : ℕ → Q)
    (join : ∀ i, D i (hi i,top i)=D (i+1) (lo (i+1),bot (i+1))) :
    ∃ f : ℕ → ℕ → P × Q → X, (∀ i j, f i j ∈ T) ∧
      (∀ i, f i i=D i) ∧
      (∀ i j y, f i j (hi i,y)=f (i+1) j (lo (i+1),y)) ∧
      (∀ i j x, f i j (x,top j)=f i (j+1) (x,bot (j+1)))

name: OAI.RectangleGrid.grid
statement:
theorem grid (H : Set (P → X)) (V : Set (Q → X)) (T : Set (P × Q → X))
    (horizontal : ∀ f ∈ T, ∀ q, (fun p ↦ f (p,q)) ∈ H)
    (vertical : ∀ f ∈ T, ∀ p, (fun q ↦ f (p,q)) ∈ V)
    (fill : ∀ a ∈ H, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ p q, a p=b q →
      ∃ f ∈ T, (∀ x, f (x,q)=a x) ∧ (∀ y, f (p,y)=b y))
    (a : ℕ → P → X) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ H) (lo hi : ℕ → P)
    (joinA : ∀ i, a i (hi i)=a (i+1) (lo (i+1)))
    (b : ℕ → Q → X) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ V) (bot top : ℕ → Q)
    (joinB : ∀ j, b j (top j)=b (j+1) (bot (j+1)))
    (corner : a 0 (lo 0)=b 0 (bot 0)) :
    ∃ f : ℕ → ℕ → P × Q → X, (∀ i j, f i j ∈ T) ∧
      (∀ i x, f i 0 (x,bot 0)=a i x) ∧
      (∀ j y, f 0 j (lo 0,y)=b j y) ∧
      (∀ i j y, f i j (hi i,y)=f (i+1) j (lo (i+1),y)) ∧
      (∀ i j x, f i j (x,top j)=f i (j+1) (x,bot (j+1)))

name: OAI.RectangleGrid.row
statement:
theorem row (H : Set (P → X)) (V : Set (Q → X)) (T : Set (P × Q → X))
    (vertical : ∀ f ∈ T, ∀ p, (fun q ↦ f (p,q)) ∈ V)
    (fill : ∀ a ∈ H, ∀ b ∈ V, ∀ p q, a p=b q →
      ∃ f ∈ T, (∀ x, f (x,q)=a x) ∧ (∀ y, f (p,y)=b y))
    (a : ℕ → P → X) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ H) (lo hi : ℕ → P)
    (join : ∀ i, a i (hi i)=a (i+1) (lo (i+1)))
    (b : Q → X) (hb : b ∈ V) (q : Q) (corner : a 0 (lo 0)=b q) :
    ∃ f : ℕ → P × Q → X, (∀ i, f i ∈ T) ∧
      (∀ i x, f i (x,q)=a i x) ∧ (∀ y, f 0 (lo 0,y)=b y) ∧
      (∀ i y, f i (hi i,y)=f (i+1) (lo (i+1),y))

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.exists_quadratic_operator_bound
statement:
theorem exists_quadratic_operator_bound {K : Set B} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (Q : B → E → ℝ) (P : B → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hQ : ContinuousOn (fun p : B × E ↦ Q p.1 p.2) (K ×ˢ univ))
    (hP : ContinuousOn P K)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ u, u ≠ 0 → 0 < Q x u)
    (hhom : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ (r : ℝ) u, Q x (r • u) = r ^ 2 * Q x u) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ u, Q x (P x u) ≤ C * Q x u

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.mixed_direction_identity
statement:
theorem mixed_direction_identity (P : E →L[ℂ] E) (D : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] E)
    (h₁ : P (D (1, 0)) = D (1, 0)) (h₂ : P (D (0, 1)) = 0)
    (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℂ) (hb₁ : b₁ ≠ 0) (hb₂ : b₂ ≠ 0) :
    D (a₁, a₂) = (a₁ / b₁) • P (D (b₁, b₂)) +
      (a₂ / b₂) • ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - P) (D (b₁, b₂)))

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.mixed_direction_norm_le
statement:
theorem mixed_direction_norm_le (P : E →L[ℂ] E) (D : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] E)
    (h₁ : P (D (1, 0)) = D (1, 0)) (h₂ : P (D (0, 1)) = 0)
    (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℂ) (hb₁ : b₁ ≠ 0) (hb₂ : b₂ ≠ 0) :
    ‖D (a₁, a₂)‖ ≤
      (‖a₁ / b₁‖ * ‖P‖ + ‖a₂ / b₂‖ * ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E - P‖) *
        ‖D (b₁, b₂)‖

statement:
theorem KahlerMetric.continuous_quadraticInChart (g : KahlerMetric X) (c : X.Carrier) :

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.KahlerMetric.exists_chart_metric_comparison
statement:
theorem KahlerMetric.exists_chart_metric_comparison (g : KahlerMetric X) (c : X.Carrier)
    {K : Set (Model n)} (hK : IsCompact K) (he : K ⊆ (extChartAt (model n) c).target) :
    ∃ C D : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < D ∧ ∀ z ∈ K, ∀ u : Model n,
      ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * metricInChart g.metric c z u u ∧
      metricInChart g.metric c z u u ≤ D * ‖u‖ ^ 2

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.KahlerMetric.exists_chart_speed_comparison
statement:
theorem KahlerMetric.exists_chart_speed_comparison (g : KahlerMetric X) (c : X.Carrier)
    {K : Set (Model n)} (hK : IsCompact K) (he : K ⊆ (extChartAt (model n) c).target) :
    ∃ C D : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < D ∧ ∀ x ∈ (extChartAt (model n) c).source,
      (extChartAt (model n) c) x ∈ K → ∀ v : Tangent X x,
      (@norm (Model n) _ (mfderiv (model n) (model n) (extChartAt (model n) c) x v)) ≤ C * metricNorm g x v ∧
      metricNorm g x v ≤ D * (@norm (Model n) _ (mfderiv (model n) (model n) (extChartAt (model n) c) x v))

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.KahlerMetric.exists_projection_bound_on_chartCompact
statement:
theorem KahlerMetric.exists_projection_bound_on_chartCompact (g : KahlerMetric X)
    (P : ProjectionField X) (hP : HolomorphicProjection P) (c : X.Carrier)
    {K : Set (Model n)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKt : K ⊆ (extChartAt (model n) c).target) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x ∈ (extChartAt (model n) c).source,
      (extChartAt (model n) c) x ∈ K → ∀ u : Tangent X x,
      g.metric x (P x u) (P x u) ≤ C * g.metric x u u

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.KahlerMetric.exists_uniform_projection_normBound
statement:
theorem KahlerMetric.exists_uniform_projection_normBound [CompactSpace X.Carrier]
    (g : KahlerMetric X) (P : ProjectionField X) (hP : HolomorphicProjection P) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x (u : Tangent X x),
      metricNorm g x (P x u) ≤ C * metricNorm g x u

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.KahlerMetric.exists_uniform_projection_quadraticBound
statement:
theorem KahlerMetric.exists_uniform_projection_quadraticBound [CompactSpace X.Carrier]

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.KahlerMetric.exists_uniform_splitting_bound
statement:
theorem KahlerMetric.exists_uniform_splitting_bound [CompactSpace X.Carrier]
    (g : KahlerMetric X) (S : HolomorphicSplitting X r₁ r₂) :
    ∃ C₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 < C₁ ∧ 0 < C₂ ∧
      (∀ x (u : Tangent X x), metricNorm g x (S.projection x u) ≤ C₁ * metricNorm g x u) ∧
      (∀ x (u : Tangent X x),
        metricNorm g x (complementaryProjection S x u) ≤ C₂ * metricNorm g x u)

statement:
theorem curveSpeed_eq_chart (g : KahlerMetric X) {f : ℂ → X.Carrier} {z : ℂ}

    (c : X.Carrier) (hc : f z ∈ (extChartAt (model n) c).source) :
    curveSpeed g f z = Real.sqrt (metricInChart g.metric c
      ((extChartAt (model n) c) (f z)) (deriv ((extChartAt (model n) c) ∘ f) z)

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.exists_quadratic_comparison
statement:
theorem exists_quadratic_comparison {K : Set B} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (Q T : B → E → ℝ)
    (hQ : ContinuousOn (fun p : B × E ↦ Q p.1 p.2) (K ×ˢ univ))
    (hT : ContinuousOn (fun p : B × E ↦ T p.1 p.2) (K ×ˢ univ))
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ u, u ≠ 0 → 0 < Q x u)
    (hhom : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ (r : ℝ) u, Q x (r • u) = r ^ 2 * Q x u)
    (hThom : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ (r : ℝ) u, T x (r • u) = r ^ 2 * T x u) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ u, T x u ≤ C * Q x u

    metricInChart g c ((extChartAt (model n) c) x)

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.mixed_direction_metric_norm_le
statement:
theorem mixed_direction_metric_norm_le (g : KahlerMetric X) (x : X.Carrier)
    (P : Tangent X x →L[ℂ] Tangent X x) (D : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] Tangent X x)
    (h₁ : P (D (1, 0)) = D (1, 0)) (h₂ : P (D (0, 1)) = 0)
    (C₁ C₂ : ℝ)
    (hC₁ : ∀ u, metricNorm g x (P u) ≤ C₁ * metricNorm g x u)
    (hC₂ : ∀ u, metricNorm g x ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Tangent X x) - P) u) ≤
      C₂ * metricNorm g x u)
    (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℂ) (hb₁ : b₁ ≠ 0) (hb₂ : b₂ ≠ 0) :
    metricNorm g x (D (a₁, a₂)) ≤
      (‖a₁/b₁‖ * C₁ + ‖a₂/b₂‖ * C₂) * metricNorm g x (D (b₁,b₂))

name: OAI.UniversalCoverSplitting.projectionInChart_forward
statement:
theorem projectionInChart_forward (P : ProjectionField X) (c : X.Carrier)
    {x : X.Carrier} (hx : x ∈ (extChartAt (model n) c).source) (u : Tangent X x) :
    projectionInChart P c ((extChartAt (model n) c) x)
      ((mfderiv (model n) (model n) (extChartAt (model n) c) x) u) =
    (mfderiv (model n) (model n) (extChartAt (model n) c) x) (P x u)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.density_pos

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.density_upper

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.entropy_lower_pointwise

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.foldMoment_integral_le

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.folded_pos
statement: lemma folded_pos {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (t : ι → ℝ) : 0 < folded h t

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.gamma1_eq_gaussianPDF
statement: lemma gamma1_eq_gaussianPDF (x : ℝ) : gamma1 x = gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.gamma1_even

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.gamma1_int

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.gamma1_integrable
statement: lemma gamma1_integrable : Integrable gamma1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.gamma1_le_inv_sqrt
statement: lemma gamma1_le_inv_sqrt (x : ℝ) : gamma1 x ≤ (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))⁻¹

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.gamma1_pos

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.gamma1_second_int

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.gamma1_second_integrable

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.gaussian_subgaussian

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.integral_fold
statement:
lemma integral_fold {φ : ℝ → ℝ} (hφ : Continuous φ) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
