name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.integral_law
statement:
lemma integral_law {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ t, g t ∂law h) = (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, density h t*g t)/totalMass h

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.integral_log_density
statement:
lemma integral_log_density {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    (∫ t, Real.log (density h t) ∂law h) = logMean h

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.law_ae_mem
statement: lemma law_ae_mem (h : ℝ) : ∀ᵐ t ∂law h, t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.law_isProbability
statement: lemma law_isProbability {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) : IsProbabilityMeasure (law h)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.logMean_lower
statement:
lemma logMean_lower {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    Real.log h-Real.log (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))-1/(2*totalMass h) ≤ logMean h

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.logMean_lower_of_half
statement:
lemma logMean_lower_of_half {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (ha : 1/2 ≤ totalMass h) :
    Real.log h-Real.log (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))-1 ≤ logMean h

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.logMean_upper
statement:
lemma logMean_upper {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    logMean h ≤ Real.log (2*h/Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.log_component
statement:
lemma log_component {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (x : ℝ) :
    Real.log (h*gamma1 (h*x)) = Real.log h-Real.log (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))-(h*x)^2/2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.log_density_bounds
statement:
lemma log_density_bounds {h t : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    Real.log (density h t) ∈ Icc
      (Real.log h-Real.log (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))-h^2/8)
      (Real.log h-Real.log (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))+Real.log 2)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.log_density_memLp
statement:
lemma log_density_memLp {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    MemLp (fun t => Real.log (density h t)) 2 (law h)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.log_density_variance
statement:
lemma log_density_variance {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    Var[fun t => Real.log (density h t); law h] ≤ ((Real.log 2+h^2/8)/2)^2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.logistic_lower
statement: lemma logistic_lower {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≤ 1) : alpha ≤ (1+Real.exp s)⁻¹

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.measurable_weight
statement:
lemma measurable_weight (h : ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun t => ENNReal.ofReal (density h t/totalMass h))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.one_sub_logistic
statement:
lemma one_sub_logistic (s : ℝ) :

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.probability_central
statement:
lemma probability_central {h t : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (ht : |t-1/2| ≤ (h^2)⁻¹) (e : Bool) :
    alpha ≤ probability h t e ∧ probability h t e ≤ 1-alpha

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.probability_le_one
statement:
lemma probability_le_one {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (t : ℝ) (e : Bool) :
    probability h t e ≤ 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.probability_pos
statement:
lemma probability_pos {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (t : ℝ) (e : Bool) :
    0 < probability h t e

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.probability_sum
statement:
lemma probability_sum {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (t : ℝ) :
    probability h t false + probability h t true = 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.probability_true_logistic
statement:
lemma probability_true_logistic {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (t : ℝ) :
    probability h t true = (1+Real.exp (h^2*(1/2-t)))⁻¹

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.totalMass_eq_integral
statement:
lemma totalMass_eq_integral {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    totalMass h = ∫ x in -h..h, gamma1 x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.totalMass_eq_probability
statement:
lemma totalMass_eq_probability {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.totalMass_le_one
statement: lemma totalMass_le_one {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) : totalMass h ≤ 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.totalMass_pos
statement: lemma totalMass_pos {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) : 0 < totalMass h

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.totalMass_tail
statement:
lemma totalMass_tail {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.wordMass_sum
statement:
lemma wordMass_sum [DecidableEq ι] {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (t : ι → ℝ) :

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.anchor_floorVector
OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.basis_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma basis_apply (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (i : ι) (a : ι → ℤ) (ha : a i = 1)
    (j : ι) : basis p hp i a ha j = matrix p i a j

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.basis_other
statement:
lemma basis_other (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (i : ι) (a : ι → ℤ) (ha : a i = 1)
    (j : ι) (hj : j ≠ i) : basis p hp i a ha j = (Pi.basisFun ℝ ι) j

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.basis_pivot
statement:
@[simp] lemma basis_pivot (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (i : ι) (a : ι → ℤ) (ha : a i = 1) :
    basis p hp i a ha i = generator p a

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.cellPoint_mem
statement:
lemma cellPoint_mem {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (C : Submodule (ZMod p) (ι → ZMod p))
    (t : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → ZMod p)
    (hz : residue p (floorVector p t) - z ∈ C) : cellPoint p t z ∈ codeLattice p C

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.cell_bits
statement:
lemma cell_bits (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (C : Submodule (ZMod p) (ι → ZMod p))
    (t : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → ZMod p)
    (hz : residue p (floorVector p t) - z ∈ C) (e : ι → Bool) :
    cellPoint p t z + (fun j => if e j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∈ codeLattice p C ∧
      ∀ j, (t j - cellPoint p t z j - (if e j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.cell_residual
statement:
lemma cell_residual {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (t : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → ZMod p) (j : ι) :
    (t-cellPoint p t z) j = ((z j).val + Int.fract ((p : ℝ)*t j))/(p : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.cell_residual_mem_grid
statement:
lemma cell_residual_mem_grid (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (t : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → ZMod p) :
    t-cellPoint p t z ∈ gridCell p z

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.covolume_lattice
statement:
lemma covolume_lattice (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (i : ι) (a : ι → ℤ) (ha : a i = 1) :
    ZLattice.covolume (lattice p hp i a ha) = (p : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.cube_mem_gridCell
statement:
lemma cube_mem_gridCell {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) {t : ι → ℝ} (ht : ∀ j, t j ∈ Ico 0 1) :
    t ∈ gridCell p (residue p (floorVector p t))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.det_matrix
statement:
lemma det_matrix (p : ℕ) (i : ι) (a : ι → ℤ) (ha : a i = 1) :
    (matrix p i a).det = (p : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.floorVector_gridCell
statement:
lemma floorVector_gridCell {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) {z : ι → ZMod p} {t : ι → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ gridCell p z) : floorVector p t = integerLift p z

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.generator_mem
statement:
lemma generator_mem (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (i : ι) (a : ι → ℤ) (ha : a i = 1) :
    generator p a ∈ lattice p hp i a ha

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.gridCell_disjoint
statement:
lemma gridCell_disjoint {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) {z w : ι → ZMod p} (hzw : z ≠ w) :
    Disjoint (gridCell p z) (gridCell p w)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.gridCell_eq_pi
statement:
lemma gridCell_eq_pi {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p : ℕ) (z : ι → ZMod p) :
    gridCell p z = Set.univ.pi (fun j => Ico (anchor p z j) (anchor p z j+(p : ℝ)⁻¹))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.gridCell_iUnion
statement:
lemma gridCell_iUnion {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    (⋃ z : ι → ZMod p, gridCell p z) = Set.univ.pi (fun _ : ι => Ico (0 : ℝ) 1)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.gridCell_measurable
statement: lemma gridCell_measurable (p : ℕ) (z : ι → ZMod p) : MeasurableSet (gridCell p z)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.gridCell_subset_cube
statement:
lemma gridCell_subset_cube {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (z : ι → ZMod p) (τ : ι → ℝ)
    (hτ : τ ∈ gridCell p z) (j : ι) : τ j ∈ Set.Ico 0 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.gridCell_volume
statement:
lemma gridCell_volume (p : ℕ) (z : ι → ZMod p) :
    volume (gridCell p z) = (ENNReal.ofReal ((p : ℝ)⁻¹))^Fintype.card ι

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.gridCell_volume_real
statement:
lemma gridCell_volume_real (p : ℕ) (z : ι → ZMod p) :
    volume.real (gridCell p z) = ((p : ℝ)⁻¹)^Fintype.card ι

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.independent_matrix
statement:
lemma independent_matrix (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (i : ι) (a : ι → ℤ) (ha : a i = 1) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (matrix p i a)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.integer_code_mem
statement:
lemma integer_code_mem {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (C : Submodule (ZMod p) (ι → ZMod p))
    (k : ι → ℤ) : (fun j => (k j : ℝ)) ∈ codeLattice p C

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.integer_mem
statement:
lemma integer_mem (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (i : ι) (a : ι → ℤ) (ha : a i = 1)
    (z : ι → ℤ) : (fun j => (z j : ℝ)) ∈ lattice p hp i a ha

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.integral_gridCells
statement:
lemma integral_gridCells {p : ℕ} [NeZero p] (hp : 0 < p) {f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    (∫ t in Set.univ.pi (fun _ : ι => Icc (0 : ℝ) 1), f t) =
      ∑ z : ι → ZMod p, ∫ t in gridCell p z, f t

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.lattice_eq_codeLattice
statement:
lemma lattice_eq_codeLattice (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (i : ι) (a : ι → ℤ) (ha : a i = 1) :
    lattice p hp i a ha = codeLattice p (Submodule.span (ZMod p) {residue p a})

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.line_lattice
statement:
theorem line_lattice (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (v : ι → ZMod p) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (_ : DiscreteTopology (codeLattice p (Submodule.span (ZMod p) {v}))),
      IsZLattice ℝ (codeLattice p (Submodule.span (ZMod p) {v})) ∧
      ZLattice.covolume (codeLattice p (Submodule.span (ZMod p) {v})) = (p : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.mem_lattice_iff
statement:
lemma mem_lattice_iff (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (i : ι) (a : ι → ℤ) (ha : a i = 1)
    (x : ι → ℝ) : x ∈ lattice p hp i a ha ↔
      ∃ (z : ι → ℤ) (m : ℤ), x = (fun j => (z j : ℝ)) + m • generator p a

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.normalized_lift
OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.residue_integerLift
statement:
lemma residue_integerLift {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (z : ι → ZMod p) :
    residue p (integerLift p z) = z

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.centralInterval_probability
statement:
lemma centralInterval_probability {h : ℝ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) :
    Real.exp (-(h^2)/8)/(h*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)) ≤ (law h).real (centralInterval h)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.centralInterval_subset
statement: lemma centralInterval_subset {h : ℝ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) : centralInterval h ⊆ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.centralInterval_volume
statement:
lemma centralInterval_volume {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    volume.real (centralInterval h) = 1/h^2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.central_count_tail
statement:
lemma central_count_tail {h : ℝ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) (hi : 0 < Fintype.card ι)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 2*r ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(h^2)/8)/(h*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))) :
    (cubeLaw h : Measure (ι → ℝ)).real
      {t | (∑ i, (centralInterval h).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (t i)) < r} ≤
      4/((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(h^2)/8)/(h*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.continuous_folded
statement: lemma continuous_folded (h : ℝ) : Continuous (folded h : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.continuous_good_mass
statement:
lemma continuous_good_mass {h c r : ℝ} (hh : 1 ≤ h) (hi : 0 < Fintype.card ι) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hr : 2*r ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(h^2)/8)/(h*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))) :
    1 - (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*((Real.log 2+h^2/8)/2)^2/c^2 -
      4/((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(h^2)/8)/(h*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))) ≤
    (cubeLaw h : Measure (ι → ℝ)).real
      {t | |Real.log (folded h t)-(Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*logMean h| < c ∧
        r ≤ ∑ i, (centralInterval h).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (t i)}

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.cubeLaw_density
statement:
lemma cubeLaw_density {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    (cubeLaw h : Measure (ι → ℝ)) =
      (volume.restrict cube).withDensity
        (fun t => ENNReal.ofReal (folded h t/(totalMass h)^Fintype.card ι))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.cubeLaw_isProbability
statement: lemma cubeLaw_isProbability {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) : IsProbabilityMeasure (cubeLaw h : Measure (ι → ℝ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.cubeLaw_real
statement:
lemma cubeLaw_real {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) {s : Set (ι → ℝ)} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (cubeLaw h).real s = (∫ t in s ∩ cube, folded h t)/(totalMass h)^Fintype.card ι

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.cube_integral
statement:
lemma cube_integral {h : ℝ} (_ : 0 < h) :
    (∫ t in (cube : Set (ι → ℝ)), folded h t) = (totalMass h)^Fintype.card ι

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.folded_chebyshev
statement:
lemma folded_chebyshev {h c : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (cubeLaw h : Measure (ι → ℝ)).real
      {t | c ≤ |Real.log (folded h t)-(Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*logMean h|} ≤
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*((Real.log 2+h^2/8)/2)^2/c^2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.law_real_of_subset
OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.log_folded
statement:
lemma log_folded {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (t : ι → ℝ) :
    Real.log (folded h t) = ∑ i, Real.log (density h (t i))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.pi_withDensity_ofReal
statement:
lemma pi_withDensity_ofReal {f : ∀ i, Ω i → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (f i) (μ i)) (hpos : ∀ i x, 0 ≤ f i x) :
    Measure.pi (fun i => (μ i).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f i x))) =
      (Measure.pi μ).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, f i (x i)))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.abs_sub_bitValue
statement:
lemma abs_sub_bitValue {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (e : Bool) :
    |t-bitValue e| ≤ 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.atom_eq_product
statement:
lemma atom_eq_product (h : ℝ) (t : ι → ℝ) (e : ι → Bool) :
    atom h t e = ∏ j, h*gamma1 (h*(t j-bitValue (e j)))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.block_prime
statement:
theorem block_prime {b μ : ℝ} (_ : 0 < b)
    (hμ : 4*b^(56/100 : ℝ) ≤ b*μ) (hr : Real.log 4 ≤ b^(56/100 : ℝ)) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ b*μ-4*b^(56/100 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log p ∧
      Real.log p ≤ b*μ-3*b^(56/100 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.continuousGood_measurable
statement:
lemma continuousGood_measurable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {h c r : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    MeasurableSet (continuousGood (ι := ι) h c r)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.density_rounding_upper
statement:
lemma density_rounding_upper {h s t δ : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (hd : |t-s| ≤ δ) :
    density h t ≤ exp (h^2*δ)*density h s

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_block_prime
statement:
theorem eventually_block_prime {μ : ℝ → ℝ} (hμ : Tendsto μ atTop atTop) :
    ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop, ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧
      b*μ b-4*b^(56/100 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log p ∧
      Real.log p ≤ b*μ b-3*b^(56/100 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_central_mean
statement:
lemma eventually_central_mean : ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop,
    2*b^(70/100 : ℝ) ≤ b*Real.exp (-(heightR b^2)/8)/(heightR b*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_height_bound
statement:
lemma eventually_height_bound {s c : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop, heightR b ≤ c*b^s

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_height_prime
statement:
lemma eventually_height_prime : ∀ᶠ b : ℕ in atTop, ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧
    (b : ℝ)*logMean (height b)-4*(b : ℝ)^(56/100 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log p ∧
    Real.log p ≤ (b : ℝ)*logMean (height b)-3*(b : ℝ)^(56/100 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_height_square_le
statement: lemma eventually_height_square_le : ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop, heightR b^2 ≤ b

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_log_variance_tail
statement:
lemma eventually_log_variance_tail : ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop,
    b*((Real.log 2+heightR b^2/8)/2)^2/((1/2 : ℝ)*b^(56/100 : ℝ))^2 ≤ b^(-(1/20 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_logpow_bound
statement:
lemma eventually_logpow_bound {s c : ℝ} (r : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop, (Real.log b)^r ≤ c*b^s

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_totalMass_half
statement: lemma eventually_totalMass_half : ∀ᶠ h : ℝ in atTop, 1/2 ≤ totalMass h

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.exp_small_upper
statement: lemma exp_small_upper {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1/2) : Real.exp η ≤ 1+2*η

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.gamma1_rounding
statement:
lemma gamma1_rounding (h : ℝ) {x y δ : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) (hy : |y| ≤ 1)
    (hd : |x-y| ≤ δ) :
    exp (-(h^2*δ))*gamma1 (h*y) ≤ gamma1 (h*x) ∧
      gamma1 (h*x) ≤ exp (h^2*δ)*gamma1 (h*y)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.gamma1_rounding_upper
statement:
lemma gamma1_rounding_upper (h : ℝ) {x y δ : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) (hy : |y| ≤ 1)
    (hd : |x-y| ≤ δ) : gamma1 (h*x) ≤ exp (h^2*δ)*gamma1 (h*y)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.gridMass_mono
statement:
lemma gridMass_mono {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    {E F : Finset (ι → ZMod p)} (hEF : E ⊆ F) : gridMass h p E ≤ gridMass h p F

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.gridMass_nonneg
statement:
lemma gridMass_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (E : Finset (ι → ZMod p)) :
    0 ≤ gridMass h p E

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.grid_anchor_mem_cube
statement:
lemma grid_anchor_mem_cube {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (z : ι → ZMod p) (j : ι) :
    anchor p z j ∈ Set.Icc 0 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.grid_distance
statement:
lemma grid_distance {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {p : ℕ} {z : ι → ZMod p} {t : ι → ℝ} (ht : t ∈ gridCell p z) (j : ι) :
    |t j-anchor p z j| ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.grid_folded_integrable
statement:
lemma grid_folded_integrable (h : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (z : ι → ZMod p) :
    IntegrableOn (folded h) (gridCell p z)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.heightR_exp
statement:
lemma heightR_exp {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (c : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-(heightR b^2)*c) = b^(-(9/4 : ℝ)*c)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.heightR_pos
statement: lemma heightR_pos {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 < b) : 0 < heightR b

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.heightR_sq
statement: lemma heightR_sq {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) : heightR b^2 = (9/4 : ℝ)*Real.log b

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.heightR_tendsto
statement: lemma heightR_tendsto : Tendsto heightR atTop atTop

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.height_tendsto
statement: lemma height_tendsto : Tendsto height atTop atTop

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.height_totalMass_power_loss
statement:
lemma height_totalMass_power_loss {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    0 ≤ 1-(totalMass (height b))^b ∧
      1-(totalMass (height b))^b ≤ 2*(b : ℝ)^(-(1/8 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.logMean_tendsto
statement: lemma logMean_tendsto : Tendsto logMean atTop atTop

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.prime_in_log_interval
statement:
lemma prime_in_log_interval {s r : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hr : Real.log 4 ≤ r) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ s ≤ Real.log p ∧ Real.log p ≤ s+r

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.remove_exp_factor
statement: lemma remove_exp_factor {a b η : ℝ} (h : b ≤ exp η*a) : exp (-η)*b ≤ a

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.square_difference_le
statement:
lemma square_difference_le {x y δ : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) (hy : |y| ≤ 1)
    (hd : |x-y| ≤ δ) : y^2-x^2 ≤ 2*δ

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.totalMass_power_loss
statement:
lemma totalMass_power_loss {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (b : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ 1-(totalMass h)^b ∧ 1-(totalMass h)^b ≤ 2*(b : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(h^2)/2)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_prime_power
statement:
lemma eventually_prime_power (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop, ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p →
      b*logMean (heightR b)-4*b^(56/100 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log p → b^k ≤ p

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_rounding_slack
statement:
lemma eventually_rounding_slack : ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop, ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p →
    b*logMean (heightR b)-4*b^(56/100 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log p →
      b*heightR b^2/p ≤ b^(-(1/20 : ℝ)) ∧
      b*heightR b^2/p ≤ (1/2 : ℝ)*b^(56/100 : ℝ) ∧
      p⁻¹ ≤ 1/(2*heightR b^2)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_rpow_ratio_bound
statement:
lemma eventually_rpow_ratio_bound {s t c : ℝ} (hst : s < t) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop, b^s ≤ c*b^t

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.grid_slack_of_fourth
statement:
lemma grid_slack_of_fourth {b h p : ℝ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsq : h^2 ≤ b) (hp : b^4 ≤ p) :
    b*h^2/p ≤ b^(-(2 : ℝ)) ∧ p⁻¹ ≤ 1/(2*h^2)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.numerical_count_tail
statement:
lemma numerical_count_tail {b m : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hm : 2*b^(70/100 : ℝ) ≤ m) : 4/m ≤ 2*b^(-(1/20 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.binaryAverage_append
statement:
lemma binaryAverage_append {k j : ℕ} (u : Fin k → G) (v : Fin j → G) (f : G → ℝ) (x : G) :
    binaryAverage (Fin.append u v) f x = binaryAverage v (binaryAverage u f) x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.binaryAverage_centered_second_moment
statement:
lemma binaryAverage_centered_second_moment (k : ℕ) (f : G → ℝ)
    (hf : (𝔼 x, f x) = 0) :
    (𝔼 w : Fin k → G, 𝔼 x, (binaryAverage w f x)^2) =
      (𝔼 x, (f x)^2) / (2 : ℝ)^k

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.binaryAverage_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma binaryAverage_cons {G : Type u} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] {k : ℕ} (a : G) (w : Fin k → G) (f : G → ℝ) :
    binaryAverage (Fin.cons a w) f = step a (binaryAverage w f)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.binaryAverage_eq_expect
statement:
lemma binaryAverage_eq_expect {k : ℕ} (w : Fin k → G) (f : G → ℝ) (x : G) :
    binaryAverage w f x = 𝔼 e : Fin k → Bool, f (x-subsetShift w e)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.binaryAverage_eq_sum
statement:
lemma binaryAverage_eq_sum {k : ℕ} (w : Fin k → G) (f : G → ℝ) (x : G) :
    binaryAverage w f x = (∑ e : Fin k → Bool, f (x-subsetShift w e)) / (2 : ℝ)^k

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.binaryAverage_mean
statement:
lemma binaryAverage_mean {k : ℕ} (w : Fin k → G) (f : G → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 x, binaryAverage w f x) = 𝔼 x, f x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.binaryAverage_mono
statement:
lemma binaryAverage_mono {G : Type u} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] {k : ℕ} (w : Fin k → G) {f g : G → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) (x : G) : binaryAverage w f x ≤ binaryAverage w g x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.binaryAverage_mul_const
statement:
lemma binaryAverage_mul_const {G : Type u} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] {k : ℕ} (w : Fin k → G) (f : G → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (x : G) :
    binaryAverage w (fun y => c * f y) x = c * binaryAverage w f x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.binaryAverage_nonneg
statement:
lemma binaryAverage_nonneg {k : ℕ} (w : Fin k → G) {f : G → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (x : G) : 0 ≤ binaryAverage w f x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.binaryAverage_sub_const
statement:
lemma binaryAverage_sub_const {G : Type u} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] {k : ℕ} (w : Fin k → G) (f : G → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (x : G) :
    binaryAverage w (fun y => f y - c) x = binaryAverage w f x - c

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.binaryAverage_variance
statement:
lemma binaryAverage_variance (k : ℕ) (f : G → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 w : Fin k → G, 𝔼 x, (binaryAverage w f x - (𝔼 y, f y))^2) =
      (𝔼 x, (f x - (𝔼 y, f y))^2) / (2 : ℝ)^k

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.binaryAverage_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma binaryAverage_zero {G : Type u} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] (w : Fin 0 → G) (f : G → ℝ) :
    binaryAverage w f = f

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.binarySum_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma binarySum_cons {G : Type u} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] {k : ℕ} (a : G) (w : Fin k → G) (f : G → ℝ) (x : G) :
    binarySum (Fin.cons a w) f x = binarySum w f x + binarySum w f (x-a)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.binarySum_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma binarySum_zero {G : Type u} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] (w : Fin 0 → G) (f : G → ℝ) (x : G) :
    binarySum w f x = f x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.exp_le_card_mul_potential
statement:
lemma exp_le_card_mul_potential (θ : ℝ) (f : G → ℝ) (x : G) :
    Real.exp (-θ * f x) ≤ (Fintype.card G : ℝ) * potential θ f

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.expect_append
statement:
lemma expect_append (k j : ℕ) (f : (Fin (k+j) → α) → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 w, f w) = 𝔼 u : Fin k → α, 𝔼 v : Fin j → α, f (Fin.append u v)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.expect_bool
statement: lemma expect_bool (f : Bool → ℝ) : (𝔼 b, f b) = (f false + f true)/2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.expect_cons
statement:
lemma expect_cons (k : ℕ) (f : (Fin (k + 1) → α) → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 w, f w) = 𝔼 a, 𝔼 w, f (Fin.cons a w)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.expect_correlation
statement:
lemma expect_correlation (f g : G → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 w, 𝔼 x, f x * g (x - w)) = (𝔼 x, f x) * 𝔼 x, g x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.expect_mono
statement:
lemma expect_mono {f g : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ a, f a ≤ g a) :
    (𝔼 a, f a) ≤ 𝔼 a, g a

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.expect_nonneg
statement: lemma expect_nonneg {f : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ a, 0 ≤ f a) : 0 ≤ 𝔼 a, f a

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.expect_prod
statement:
lemma expect_prod (f : α × β → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 z, f z) = 𝔼 a, 𝔼 b, f (a, b)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.expect_sub_left
statement:
lemma expect_sub_left (f : G → ℝ) (a : G) :
    (𝔼 x, f (a - x)) = 𝔼 x, f x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.expect_sub_right
statement:
lemma expect_sub_right (f : G → ℝ) (a : G) :
    (𝔼 x, f (x - a)) = 𝔼 x, f x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.expected_bad_fraction_le
statement:
lemma expected_bad_fraction_le (k : ℕ) (f : G → ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hμ : 0 < 𝔼 x, f x) :
    (𝔼 w : Fin k → G,
      probability (fun x => binaryAverage w f x < (1-δ) * (𝔼 y, f y))) ≤
      (𝔼 x, (f x - (𝔼 y, f y))^2) / ((2 : ℝ)^k * (δ * (𝔼 x, f x))^2)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.indicator_initial_potential
OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.lower_tail_le_variance
statement:
lemma lower_tail_le_variance {G : Type u} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] (f : G → ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hμ : 0 < 𝔼 x, f x) :
    probability (fun x => f x < (1-δ) * (𝔼 y, f y)) ≤
      (𝔼 x, (f x - (𝔼 y, f y))^2) / (δ * (𝔼 x, f x))^2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.potential_bound_binaryAverage
statement:
lemma potential_bound_binaryAverage {k : ℕ} (w : Fin k → G) (f : G → ℝ)
    {θ δ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (h : potential θ (binarySum w f) ≤
      Real.exp ((2 : ℝ)^k * (-θ+1) + ((2 : ℝ)^k-1)*(θ*δ))) (x : G) :
    1-δ-1/θ-Real.log (Fintype.card G)/(θ*(2 : ℝ)^k) ≤ binaryAverage w f x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.potential_bound_pointwise
statement:
lemma potential_bound_pointwise (θ a : ℝ) (f : G → ℝ)
    (h : potential θ f ≤ Real.exp a) (x : G) :
    -θ * f x ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card G) + a

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.potential_iteration_failure
statement:
lemma potential_iteration_failure (θ ε a : ℝ) (f : G → ℝ)
    (h₀ : potential θ f ≤ Real.exp a) (k : ℕ) :
    probability (fun w : Fin k → G =>
      Real.exp ((2 : ℝ)^k * a + ((2 : ℝ)^k - 1) * ε) <
        potential θ (binarySum w f)) ≤ (k : ℝ) * Real.exp (-ε)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.potential_pos
statement: lemma potential_pos (θ : ℝ) (f : G → ℝ) : 0 < potential θ f

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.potential_square
statement:
lemma potential_square (θ : ℝ) (f : G → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 w, potential θ (fun x => f x + f (x-w))) = (potential θ f)^2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.potential_step_failure
statement:
lemma potential_step_failure (θ ε : ℝ) (f : G → ℝ) :
    probability (fun w => Real.exp ε * (potential θ f)^2 <
      potential θ (fun x => f x + f (x-w))) ≤ Real.exp (-ε)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_append
statement:
lemma probability_append (k j : ℕ) (p : (Fin (k+j) → α) → Prop) :
    probability p = probability (fun z : (Fin k → α) × (Fin j → α) => p (Fin.append z.1 z.2))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_compl
statement:
lemma probability_compl [Nonempty α] (p : α → Prop) :
    probability (fun x => ¬ p x) = 1 - probability p

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_cons
statement:
lemma probability_cons (k : ℕ) (p : (Fin (k+1) → α) → Prop) :
    probability p = 𝔼 a, probability (fun w : Fin k → α => p (Fin.cons a w))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_cons_tail
statement:
lemma probability_cons_tail (k : ℕ) (p : (Fin (k+1) → α) → Prop) :
    probability p = 𝔼 w : Fin k → α, probability (fun a => p (Fin.cons a w))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_false
statement: lemma probability_false : probability (fun _ : α => False) = 0

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_fst
statement:
lemma probability_fst [Nonempty β] (p : α → Prop) :
    probability (fun x : α × β => p x.1) = probability p

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_gt_le
statement:
lemma probability_gt_le {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    probability (fun x => t < f x) ≤ (𝔼 x, f x) / t

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_le_of_pointwise
OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_le_one
statement: lemma probability_le_one [Nonempty α] (p : α → Prop) : probability p ≤ 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_mono
statement:
lemma probability_mono {p q : α → Prop} (h : ∀ x, p x → q x) :
    probability p ≤ probability q

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_nonneg
statement: lemma probability_nonneg (p : α → Prop) : 0 ≤ probability p

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_prod
statement:
lemma probability_prod (p : α × β → Prop) :
    probability p = 𝔼 a, probability (fun b => p (a,b))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_snd
statement:
lemma probability_snd [Nonempty α] (p : β → Prop) :
    probability (fun x : α × β => p x.2) = probability p

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_true
statement: lemma probability_true [Nonempty α] : probability (fun _ : α => True) = 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability_union_le
statement:
lemma probability_union_le (p q : α → Prop) :
    probability (fun x => p x ∨ q x) ≤ probability p + probability q

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.sampler_explicit_parameters
statement:
lemma sampler_explicit_parameters (f : G → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) {δ θ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ₁ : δ < 1) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hμ : 0 < 𝔼 x, f x) (k j : ℕ)
    (hsmall : 1/θ+Real.log (Fintype.card G)/(θ*(2 : ℝ)^j) ≤ δ) :
    probability (fun w : Fin (k+j) → G => ∃ x,
      (∑ e : Fin (k+j) → Bool, f (x-subsetShift w e)) / (2 : ℝ)^(k+j) <
        (1-3*δ)*(𝔼 y, f y)) ≤
      ((𝔼 x, (f x-(𝔼 y, f y))^2) /
        ((2 : ℝ)^k*(δ*(𝔼 y, f y))^2)) / Real.exp (-2*θ) +
          (j : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(θ*δ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.second_stage_failure
statement:
lemma second_stage_failure {p : G → Prop} [DecidablePred p] {θ δ : ℝ}
    (hθ : 0 < θ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hp : probability (fun x => ¬p x) ≤ Real.exp (-2*θ)) (k : ℕ) :
    probability (fun w : Fin k → G => ∃ x,
      binaryAverage w (fun y => if p y then 1 else 0) x <
        1-δ-1/θ-Real.log (Fintype.card G)/(θ*(2 : ℝ)^k)) ≤
      (k : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(θ*δ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.step_mean
statement: lemma step_mean (w : G) (f : G → ℝ) : (𝔼 x, step w f x) = 𝔼 x, f x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.step_nonneg
statement:
lemma step_nonneg {G : Type u} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] (w : G) {f : G → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (x : G) :
    0 ≤ step w f x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.step_second_moment
statement:
lemma step_second_moment (f : G → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 w, 𝔼 x, (step w f x) ^ 2) =
      ((𝔼 x, (f x) ^ 2) + (𝔼 x, f x) ^ 2) / 2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.subsetShift_append
statement:
lemma subsetShift_append {G : Type u} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] {k j : ℕ} (u : Fin k → G) (v : Fin j → G)
    (a : Fin k → Bool) (b : Fin j → Bool) :
    subsetShift (Fin.append u v) (Fin.append a b) = subsetShift u a + subsetShift v b

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.subsetShift_cons
statement:
lemma subsetShift_cons {G : Type u} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] {k : ℕ} (w : Fin (k+1) → G) (b : Bool) (e : Fin k → Bool) :
    subsetShift w (Fin.cons b e) = (if b then w 0 else 0) + subsetShift (Fin.tail w) e

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.two_stage_failure
statement:
lemma two_stage_failure (f : G → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) {δ θ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ₁ : δ < 1) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hμ : 0 < 𝔼 x, f x) (k j : ℕ) :
    probability (fun z : (Fin k → G) × (Fin j → G) => ∃ x,
      binaryAverage z.2 (binaryAverage z.1 f) x <
        (1-δ)*(𝔼 y, f y)*(1-δ-1/θ-Real.log (Fintype.card G)/(θ*(2 : ℝ)^j))) ≤
      ((𝔼 x, (f x-(𝔼 y, f y))^2) /
        ((2 : ℝ)^k*(δ*(𝔼 y, f y))^2)) / Real.exp (-2*θ) +
          (j : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(θ*δ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.two_stage_failure_three_delta
statement:
lemma two_stage_failure_three_delta (f : G → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) {δ θ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ₁ : δ < 1) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hμ : 0 < 𝔼 x, f x) (k j : ℕ)
    (hsmall : 1/θ+Real.log (Fintype.card G)/(θ*(2 : ℝ)^j) ≤ δ) :
    probability (fun z : (Fin k → G) × (Fin j → G) => ∃ x,
      binaryAverage z.2 (binaryAverage z.1 f) x < (1-3*δ)*(𝔼 y, f y)) ≤
      ((𝔼 x, (f x-(𝔼 y, f y))^2) /
        ((2 : ℝ)^k*(δ*(𝔼 y, f y))^2)) / Real.exp (-2*θ) +
          (j : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(θ*δ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.variance_eq
statement:
lemma variance_eq (f : G → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 x, (f x - (𝔼 y, f y))^2) = (𝔼 x, (f x)^2) - (𝔼 x, f x)^2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.bitMass_nonneg
statement:
lemma bitMass_nonneg {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) (e : Bool) :
    0 ≤ bitMass q e

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.bit_mixture
statement:
lemma bit_mixture (q : ℝ) (e : Bool) :
    (∑ s : Bool, bitMass (fairRate q) s*conditionalBit q s e) = bitMass q e

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.conditionalBit_nonneg
statement: lemma conditionalBit_nonneg (q : ℝ) (s e : Bool) : 0 ≤ conditionalBit q s e

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.conditionalMass_nonneg
statement: lemma conditionalMass_nonneg (q : I → ℝ) (s e : I → Bool) : 0 ≤ conditionalMass q s e

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.conditionalMass_split
statement:
lemma conditionalMass_split (q : I → ℝ) (s e : I → Bool) :
    conditionalMass q s e =
      (1/2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Selected s)) *
        if (fun j : Frozen s => e j)=(fun j : Frozen s => likelyBit (q j)) then 1 else 0

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.conditional_integral_eq_subcube
statement:
lemma conditional_integral_eq_subcube (q : I → ℝ) (s : I → Bool) (f : (I → Bool) → ℝ) :
    (∑ e, conditionalMass q s e*f e) =
      (∑ a : Selected s → Bool, f (filled q s a))/(2 : ℝ)^(Fintype.card (Selected s))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.count_eq_card_selected
statement: lemma count_eq_card_selected (s : I → Bool) : count s = (Fintype.card (Selected s) : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.count_sub_mean
statement:
lemma count_sub_mean (q : I → ℝ) (e : I → Bool) :
    count e - meanCount q = ∑ i, ((if e i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)-q i)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.expect_restrict
statement:
lemma expect_restrict {G : Type w} [Fintype G] [Nonempty G] (s : I → Bool)
    (f : (Selected s → G) → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 w : I → G, f (fun j : Selected s => w j)) = 𝔼 v : Selected s → G, f v

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.fairRate_le_one
statement: lemma fairRate_le_one (q : ℝ) : fairRate q ≤ 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.fairRate_nonneg
statement: lemma fairRate_nonneg {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1) : 0 ≤ fairRate q

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.few_selected_probability
statement:
theorem few_selected_probability {q : I → ℝ} (hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hq1 : ∀ i, q i ≤ 1)
    (hmean : 0 < meanCount q) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ meanCount q/2) :
    integral q (fun e => if count e < t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 4/meanCount q

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.integral_add
statement:
lemma integral_add (q : I → ℝ) (f g : (I → Bool) → ℝ) :
    integral q (fun e => f e+g e) = integral q f+integral q g

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.integral_const
statement: lemma integral_const (q : I → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : integral q (fun _ => c) = c

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.integral_coordinate
statement:
lemma integral_coordinate (q : I → ℝ) (i : I) (h : Bool → ℝ) :
    integral q (fun e => h (e i)) = ∑ a : Bool, bitMass (q i) a*h a

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.integral_count
statement: lemma integral_count (q : I → ℝ) : integral q count = meanCount q

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.integral_mixture
statement:
theorem integral_mixture (q : I → ℝ) (f : (I → Bool) → ℝ) :
    integral q f = integral (fun i => fairRate (q i))
      (fun s => ∑ e, conditionalMass q s e*f e)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.integral_mono
statement:
lemma integral_mono {q : I → ℝ} (hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hq1 : ∀ i, q i ≤ 1)
    {f g : (I → Bool) → ℝ} (hfg : ∀ e, f e ≤ g e) : integral q f ≤ integral q g

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.integral_prod
statement:
lemma integral_prod (q : I → ℝ) (h : I → Bool → ℝ) :
    integral q (fun e => ∏ i, h i (e i)) = ∏ i, ∑ a : Bool, bitMass (q i) a*h i a

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.integral_smul
statement:
lemma integral_smul (q : I → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (f : (I → Bool) → ℝ) :
    integral q (fun e => c*f e) = c*integral q f

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.integral_sub
statement:
lemma integral_sub (q : I → ℝ) (f g : (I → Bool) → ℝ) :
    integral q (fun e => f e-g e) = integral q f-integral q g

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.integral_sum
statement:
lemma integral_sum {J : Type v} [Fintype J] (q : I → ℝ) (f : J → (I → Bool) → ℝ) :
    integral q (fun e => ∑ j, f j e) = ∑ j, integral q (f j)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.integral_two_coordinates
statement:
lemma integral_two_coordinates (q : I → ℝ) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (h k : Bool → ℝ) :
    integral q (fun e => h (e i)*k (e j)) =
      (∑ a : Bool, bitMass (q i) a*h a)*(∑ a : Bool, bitMass (q j) a*k a)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.mixture_lower_bound
statement:
theorem mixture_lower_bound {q : I → ℝ} (hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hq1 : ∀ i, q i ≤ 1)
    (good : (I → Bool) → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
    (f : (I → Bool) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ e, 0 ≤ f e) (a : ℝ) (_ : 0 ≤ a)
    (hgood : ∀ s, good s → a ≤ ∑ e, conditionalMass q s e*f e) :
    (1-integral (fun i => fairRate (q i)) (fun s => if good s then 0 else 1))*a ≤ integral q f

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.productMass_nonneg
statement:
lemma productMass_nonneg {q : I → ℝ} (hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hq1 : ∀ i, q i ≤ 1)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.product_mixture
statement:
theorem product_mixture (q : I → ℝ) (e : I → Bool) :
    (∑ s, productMass (fun i => fairRate (q i)) s * conditionalMass q s e) = productMass q e

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.sum_bitMass
statement: lemma sum_bitMass (q : ℝ) : (∑ e : Bool, bitMass q e) = 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.sum_conditionalBit
statement: lemma sum_conditionalBit (q : ℝ) (s : Bool) : (∑ e : Bool, conditionalBit q s e) = 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.sum_conditionalMass
statement: lemma sum_conditionalMass (q : I → ℝ) (s : I → Bool) : (∑ e, conditionalMass q s e) = 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.sum_productMass
statement: lemma sum_productMass (q : I → ℝ) : (∑ e, productMass q e) = 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.variance_count
statement:
lemma variance_count (q : I → ℝ) :
    integral q (fun e => (count e - meanCount q)^2) = ∑ i, q i*(1-q i)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.cStar_pos
statement: lemma cStar_pos : 0 < cStar

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.delta_lt_one
statement: lemma delta_lt_one {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 < b) : delta b < 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.delta_pos
statement: lemma delta_pos {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) : 0 < delta b

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.delta_sq
statement:
lemma delta_sq {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    (delta b)^2 = Real.exp (-(1/5 : ℝ)*Real.log b)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.eventually_first_stage_log
statement:
lemma eventually_first_stage_log :
    ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop,
      Real.log 8 + (1/5 : ℝ)*Real.log b + 2*b^(65/100 : ℝ) ≤
        (Real.log 2/4)*b^(69/100 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.eventually_thresholds
statement:
lemma eventually_thresholds :
    ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop,
      1 < b ∧
      Real.log 8 + (1/5 : ℝ)*Real.log b + 2*b^(65/100 : ℝ) ≤
        (Real.log 2/4)*b^(69/100 : ℝ) ∧
      4/cStar ≤ b^(59/100 : ℝ) ∧
      b^(341/100 : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(Real.log 2/2)*b^(69/100 : ℝ)) ≤ cStar/4 ∧
      b^(1/2 : ℝ)*Real.exp (-cStar*b^(69/100 : ℝ)) ≤ 1/2 ∧
      b^(3/2 : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(cStar/2)*b^(59/100 : ℝ)) ≤ 1/2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.failure_tail_le
statement:
lemma failure_tail_le {b : ℝ} {s j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hs : b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ)) (hj : j ≤ s) (hsb : (s : ℝ) ≤ b) :
    Real.exp (-cStar*(s : ℝ)) + (j : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(theta s*delta b)) ≤
      Real.exp (-cStar*b^(69/100 : ℝ)) +
        b*Real.exp (-(cStar/2)*b^(59/100 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.failure_tail_le_rpow
statement:
lemma failure_tail_le_rpow {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (h₁ : b^(1/2 : ℝ)*Real.exp (-cStar*b^(69/100 : ℝ)) ≤ 1/2)
    (h₂ : b^(3/2 : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(cStar/2)*b^(59/100 : ℝ)) ≤ 1/2) :
    Real.exp (-cStar*b^(69/100 : ℝ)) +
      b*Real.exp (-(cStar/2)*b^(59/100 : ℝ)) ≤ b^(-1/2 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.first_stage_ratio_le
statement:
lemma first_stage_ratio_le {b V μ : ℝ} {s k : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hs : b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ)) (hk : (s : ℝ)/2-1 ≤ (k : ℝ))
    (hμ : 1/2 ≤ μ) (hV : V ≤ Real.exp (2*b^(65/100 : ℝ)))
    (hlog : Real.log 8+(1/5 : ℝ)*Real.log b+2*b^(65/100 : ℝ) ≤
      (Real.log 2/4)*b^(69/100 : ℝ)) :
    (V/((2 : ℝ)^k*(delta b*μ)^2))/Real.exp (-2*theta s) ≤
      Real.exp (-cStar*(s : ℝ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.half_counts
statement:
lemma half_counts (s : ℕ) :
    (s : ℝ)/2-1 ≤ (s/2 : ℕ) ∧ (s : ℝ)/2 ≤ (s-s/2 : ℕ) ∧ s-s/2 ≤ s

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.log_eight
statement: lemma log_eight : Real.log 8 = 3*Real.log 2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.log_four
statement: lemma log_four : Real.log 4 = 2*Real.log 2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.potential_errors_le
statement:
lemma potential_errors_le {b L : ℝ} {s j : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hs : b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ)) (hj : (s : ℝ)/2 ≤ (j : ℝ))
    (hL : L ≤ b^4) (hpow : 4/cStar ≤ b^(59/100 : ℝ))
    (hpoly : b^(341/100 : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(Real.log 2/2)*b^(69/100 : ℝ)) ≤ cStar/4) :
    1/theta s+L/(theta s*(2 : ℝ)^j) ≤ delta b

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.rpow_delta_identity
statement:
lemma rpow_delta_identity {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    b^(69/100 : ℝ)*delta b = b^(59/100 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.tendsto_rpow_mul_exp_neg_rpow
statement:
lemma tendsto_rpow_mul_exp_neg_rpow (p : ℝ) {a c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (fun b : ℝ => b^p * Real.exp (-c*b^a)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.tendsto_rpow_ratio
statement:
lemma tendsto_rpow_ratio {p q : ℝ} (h : p < q) :
    Tendsto (fun b : ℝ => b^p/b^q) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.theta_delta_lower
statement:
lemma theta_delta_lower {b : ℝ} {s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hs : b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ)) :
    (cStar/2)*b^(59/100 : ℝ) ≤ theta s*delta b

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.theta_pos
statement:
lemma theta_pos {b : ℝ} {s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ)) :
    0 < theta s

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.two_pow_eq_exp
statement: lemma two_pow_eq_exp (j : ℕ) : (2 : ℝ)^j = Real.exp ((j : ℝ)*Real.log 2)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.Numeric.two_pow_lower
OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.sampler_at_thresholds
statement:
lemma sampler_at_thresholds {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (hlog : Real.log 8+(1/5 : ℝ)*Real.log b+2*b^(65/100 : ℝ) ≤
      (Real.log 2/4)*b^(69/100 : ℝ))
    (hpow : 4/cStar ≤ b^(59/100 : ℝ))
    (hpoly : b^(341/100 : ℝ)*Real.exp (-(Real.log 2/2)*b^(69/100 : ℝ)) ≤ cStar/4)
    (hG : Real.log (Fintype.card G) ≤ b^4)
    (f : G → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hupper : ∀ x, f x ≤ Real.exp (b^(65/100 : ℝ)))
    (hmean : 1/2 ≤ 𝔼 x, f x) (s : ℕ)
    (hs : b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ)) (hsb : (s : ℝ) ≤ b) :
    probability (fun w : Fin s → G => ∃ x,
      (∑ e : Fin s → Bool, f (x-subsetShift w e))/(2 : ℝ)^s <
        (1-3*b^(-1/10 : ℝ))*(𝔼 y, f y)) ≤
      Real.exp (-cStar*b^(69/100 : ℝ)) +
        b*Real.exp (-(cStar/2)*b^(59/100 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.uniform_boolean_sampling
statement:
theorem uniform_boolean_sampling :
    ∃ b₀ : ℝ, 1 < b₀ ∧ ∀ b : ℝ, b₀ ≤ b →
      ∀ (G : Type u) [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G],
        Real.log (Fintype.card G) ≤ b^4 →
        ∀ f : G → ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → (∀ x, f x ≤ Real.exp (b^(65/100 : ℝ))) →
        (1/2 ≤ 𝔼 x, f x) → (𝔼 x, f x) ≤ 2 →
        ∀ s : ℕ, b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ) → (s : ℝ) ≤ b →
        probability (fun w : Fin s → G => ∀ x,
          (1-3*b^(-1/10 : ℝ))*(𝔼 y, f y) ≤
            (∑ e : Fin s → Bool, f (x-subsetShift w e))/(2 : ℝ)^s) ≥
          1-Real.exp (-cStar*b^(69/100 : ℝ))-
            b*Real.exp (-(cStar/2)*b^(59/100 : ℝ)) ∧
        probability (fun w : Fin s → G => ∃ x,
          (∑ e : Fin s → Bool, f (x-subsetShift w e))/(2 : ℝ)^s <
            (1-3*b^(-1/10 : ℝ))*(𝔼 y, f y)) ≤ b^(-1/2 : ℝ)

OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.alpha_le_half
statement: lemma alpha_le_half : alpha ≤ 1/2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.alpha_pos
statement: lemma alpha_pos : 0 < alpha

OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.badMixture_nonneg
OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.biasedAverage_of_badMixture_le
statement:
theorem biasedAverage_of_badMixture_le {b A ε : ℝ} {q : I → ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hq1 : ∀ i, q i ≤ 1) (f : G → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (w : I → G) (hw : badMixture b A q f w ≤ ε) (x : G) :
    (1-ε)*A ≤ biasedAverage q w f x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.component_failure_mean_le
statement:
lemma component_failure_mean_le {b A δ : ℝ} (f : G → ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hthreshold : ∀ s : ℕ, b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ) → (s : ℝ) ≤ b →
      SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability (fun w : Fin s → G => ∃ x,
        (∑ e : Fin s → Bool, f (x-SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.subsetShift w e))/(2 : ℝ)^s < A) ≤ δ)
    (hb : (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤ b) (s : I → Bool) :
    (𝔼 w : I → G, if componentGood b A f w s then (0 : ℝ) else 1) ≤
      (if count s < b^(69/100 : ℝ) then 1 else 0)+δ

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.conditional_shift_average
statement:
lemma conditional_shift_average (q : I → ℝ) (s : I → Bool) (w : I → G) (f : G → ℝ) (x : G) :
    (∑ e, conditionalMass q s e*f (x-groupShift w e)) =
      fairAverage (fun j : Selected s => w j) f
        (x-∑ j : Frozen s, if likelyBit (q j) then w j else 0)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.eventually_mixture_parameters
statement:
lemma eventually_mixture_parameters : ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop,
    1 < b ∧ b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ alpha*b^(70/100 : ℝ) ∧ 3*b^(-1/10 : ℝ) ≤ 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.expected_badMixture_le
statement:
theorem expected_badMixture_le {b A δ : ℝ} {q : I → ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hq1 : ∀ i, q i ≤ 1) (f : G → ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hthreshold : ∀ s : ℕ, b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ) → (s : ℝ) ≤ b →
      SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability (fun w : Fin s → G => ∃ x,
        (∑ e : Fin s → Bool, f (x-SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.subsetShift w e))/(2 : ℝ)^s < A) ≤ δ)
    (hb : (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤ b)
    (hmean : 0 < meanCount (fun i => fairRate (q i)))
    (ht : b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ meanCount (fun i => fairRate (q i))/2) :
    (𝔼 w : I → G, badMixture b A q f w) ≤ 4/meanCount (fun i => fairRate (q i))+δ

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.expected_badMixture_uniform_le
statement:
lemma expected_badMixture_uniform_le {b A : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (f : G → ℝ)
    (hthreshold : ∀ s : ℕ, b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ) → (s : ℝ) ≤ b →
      SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability (fun w : Fin s → G => ∃ x,
        (∑ e : Fin s → Bool, f (x-SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.subsetShift w e))/(2 : ℝ)^s < A) ≤ b^(-1/2 : ℝ))
    (hcard : (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤ b) {q : I → ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hq1 : ∀ i, q i ≤ 1)
    (hmean : 2*alpha*b^(70/100 : ℝ) ≤ meanCount (fun i => fairRate (q i)))
    (ht : b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ alpha*b^(70/100 : ℝ)) :
    (𝔼 w : I → G, badMixture b A q f w) ≤ (2/alpha+1)*b^(-1/2 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.fairAverage_reindex
statement:
lemma fairAverage_reindex {I : Type u} {J : Type v} {G : Type w} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] (E : I ≃ J) (w : J → G) (f : G → ℝ) (x : G) :
    fairAverage (fun i => w (E i)) f x = fairAverage w f x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.filled_groupShift
statement:
lemma filled_groupShift {I : Type u} {G : Type w} [Fintype I] [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] (q : I → ℝ) (s : I → Bool) (a : Selected s → Bool) (w : I → G) :
    groupShift w (filled q s a) =
      groupShift (fun j : Selected s => w j) a +
        ∑ j : Frozen s, if likelyBit (q j) then w j else 0

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.groupShift_reindex
statement:
lemma groupShift_reindex {I : Type u} {J : Type v} {G : Type w} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] (E : I ≃ J) (w : J → G) (e : J → Bool) :
    groupShift (fun i => w (E i)) (fun i => e (E i)) = groupShift w e

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.sampler_finite_index
statement:
lemma sampler_finite_index {b : ℝ} (f : G → ℝ) (A δ : ℝ) (hthreshold :
    ∀ s : ℕ, b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ (s : ℝ) → (s : ℝ) ≤ b →
      SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability (fun w : Fin s → G => ∃ x,
        (∑ e : Fin s → Bool, f (x-SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.subsetShift w e))/(2 : ℝ)^s < A) ≤ δ)
    (hs : b^(69/100 : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card I : ℝ)) (hsb : (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤ b) :
    SingleLatticeCovering.Sampler.probability (fun w : I → G => ∃ x, fairAverage w f x < A) ≤ δ

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.usable_anchor_selection
statement:
theorem usable_anchor_selection :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 1 < B ∧ ∀ b : ℝ, B ≤ b →
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤ b → Real.log (Fintype.card G) ≤ b^4 →
      ∀ f : G → ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → (∀ x, f x ≤ Real.exp (b^(65/100 : ℝ))) →
      (1/2 ≤ 𝔼 x, f x) → (𝔼 x, f x) ≤ 2 →
      ∀ (F : Z → ℝ) (E : Finset Z) (q : Z → I → ℝ), (∀ z, 0 ≤ F z) →
        (∀ z i, 0 ≤ q z i) → (∀ z i, q z i ≤ 1) →
        (∀ z ∈ E, 2*alpha*b^(70/100 : ℝ) ≤ meanCount (fun i => fairRate (q z i))) →
      ∃ w : I → G, ∃ U : Finset Z, U ⊆ E ∧
        (∀ z ∈ U, ∀ x, (1-b^(-1/20 : ℝ))*(1-3*b^(-1/10 : ℝ))*(𝔼 y, f y) ≤
          biasedAverage (q z) w f x) ∧
        SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mass F (E \ U) ≤
          (2/alpha+1)*b^(-9/20 : ℝ)*SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mass F E ∧
        SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mass F E -
          (2/alpha+1)*b^(-9/20 : ℝ)*SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mass F E ≤
            SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mass F U ∧
        SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mass F U ≤ SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mass F E

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Bits.usable_anchor_selection_uniform
statement:
theorem usable_anchor_selection_uniform :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 1 < B ∧ ∀ b : ℝ, B ≤ b →
      ∀ (I : Type u) [Fintype I] (Z : Type v) [Fintype Z]
        (G : Type w) [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G],
      (Fintype.card I : ℝ) ≤ b → Real.log (Fintype.card G) ≤ b^4 →
      ∀ f : G → ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → (∀ x, f x ≤ Real.exp (b^(65/100 : ℝ))) →
      (1/2 ≤ 𝔼 x, f x) → (𝔼 x, f x) ≤ 2 →
      ∀ (F : Z → ℝ) (E : Finset Z) (q : Z → I → ℝ), (∀ z, 0 ≤ F z) →
        (∀ z i, 0 ≤ q z i) → (∀ z i, q z i ≤ 1) →
        (∀ z ∈ E, 2*alpha*b^(70/100 : ℝ) ≤ meanCount (fun i => fairRate (q z i))) →
      ∃ w : I → G, ∃ U : Finset Z, U ⊆ E ∧
        (∀ z ∈ U, ∀ x, (1-b^(-1/20 : ℝ))*(1-3*b^(-1/10 : ℝ))*(𝔼 y, f y) ≤
          biasedAverage (q z) w f x) ∧
        SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mass F (E \ U) ≤
          (2/alpha+1)*b^(-9/20 : ℝ)*SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mass F E ∧
        SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mass F E -
          (2/alpha+1)*b^(-9/20 : ℝ)*SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mass F E ≤
            SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mass F U ∧
        SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mass F U ≤ SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mass F E

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.card_direction
statement:
lemma card_direction (W : Type*) [Zero W] [Fintype W] :
    Fintype.card (Direction W) = Fintype.card W - 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.collision_factor_le_twice
statement:
lemma collision_factor_le_twice {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [Field K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Fintype V] [Nontrivial V] (U : Finset V) :
    (U.card : ℝ)*(Fintype.card (Direction K) : ℝ)/(Fintype.card (Direction V) : ℝ) ≤
      2*(Fintype.card K : ℝ)*((U.card : ℝ)/(Fintype.card V : ℝ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.collision_indicator_le
statement:
lemma collision_indicator_le {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [Field K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Fintype V] (U : Finset V) (v : Direction V) (z : V) :
    (if collision (K := K) U v z then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      ∑ w ∈ U, ∑ a : Direction K,
        if (v : V)=(a : K)⁻¹ • (w-z) then (1 : ℝ) else 0

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.collision_of_two
statement:
lemma collision_of_two {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [Field K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Fintype V] {U : Finset V} {v x : V} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    {a b : K} (hab : a ≠ b) (hb : x-b • v ∈ U) :
    collision (K := K) U v (x-a • v)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.collision_probability_le
statement:
lemma collision_probability_le (U : Finset V) (z : V) :
    (𝔼 v : Direction V, if collision (K := K) U v z then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      (U.card : ℝ)*(Fintype.card (Direction K) : ℝ)/(Fintype.card (Direction V) : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.direction_point_prob
statement:
lemma direction_point_prob (z : V) :
    (𝔼 v : Direction V, if (v : V)=z then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      1 / (Fintype.card (Direction V) : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.exists_sparse_line
statement:
theorem exists_sparse_line [Nontrivial V] {U : Finset V} {f : V → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hsupp : ∀ x, x ∉ U → f x = 0) :
    ∃ v : Direction V,
      (1-(U.card : ℝ)*(Fintype.card (Direction K) : ℝ)/(Fintype.card (Direction V) : ℝ)) *
        ((Fintype.card K : ℝ)*(𝔼 x, f x)) ≤ (𝔼 x, lineMax (K := K) f v x) ∧
      (𝔼 x, lineMax (K := K) f v x) ≤ (Fintype.card K : ℝ)*(𝔼 x, f x)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.gaussian_window_sparse_line
statement:
theorem gaussian_window_sparse_line [Nontrivial V] (U : Finset V) (F : V → ℝ)
    (hF0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ F z) (t r : ℝ)
    (hFl : ∀ z ∈ U, Real.exp (t-r) ≤ F z)
    (hFu : ∀ z ∈ U, F z ≤ Real.exp (t+r))
    (hpl : Real.exp (t-4*r) ≤ (Fintype.card K : ℝ))
    (hpu : (Fintype.card K : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (t-3*r))
    (hM : usableMass U F ≤ 2) :
    ∃ v : Direction V,
      usableMass U F - 4*usableMass U F*Real.exp (-2*r) ≤
        (𝔼 x, lineMax (K := K) (sparseWeight (K := K) U F) v x) ∧
      (𝔼 x, lineMax (K := K) (sparseWeight (K := K) U F) v x) ≤ usableMass U F ∧
      ∀ x, 0 ≤ lineMax (K := K) (sparseWeight (K := K) U F) v x ∧
        lineMax (K := K) (sparseWeight (K := K) U F) v x ≤ Real.exp (5*r)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.lineMax_le
statement:
lemma lineMax_le {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [Field K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Fintype V] {f : V → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, f x ≤ c) (v x : V) :
    lineMax (K := K) f v x ≤ c

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.lineMax_le_sum
statement:
lemma lineMax_le_sum {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [Field K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Fintype V] {f : V → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (v x : V) :
    lineMax (K := K) f v x ≤ lineSum (K := K) f v x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.lineMax_nonneg
statement:
lemma lineMax_nonneg {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [Field K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Fintype V] {f : V → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (v x : V) :
    0 ≤ lineMax (K := K) f v x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.line_loss_le_collision
statement:
lemma line_loss_le_collision {U : Finset V} {f : V → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hsupp : ∀ x, x ∉ U → f x = 0)
    (v : Direction V) (x : V) :
    lineSum (K := K) f v x - lineMax (K := K) f v x ≤
      ∑ a : K, if collision (K := K) U v (x-a • (v : V)) then f (x-a • (v : V)) else 0

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.mean_direction_loss_le
statement:
lemma mean_direction_loss_le {U : Finset V} {f : V → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hsupp : ∀ x, x ∉ U → f x = 0) :
    (𝔼 v : Direction V,
      ((Fintype.card K : ℝ)*(𝔼 x, f x) - (𝔼 x, lineMax (K := K) f v x))) ≤
      ((U.card : ℝ)*(Fintype.card (Direction K) : ℝ)/(Fintype.card (Direction V) : ℝ)) *
        ((Fintype.card K : ℝ)*(𝔼 x, f x))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.mean_lineSum
statement:
lemma mean_lineSum (f : V → ℝ) (v : V) :
    (𝔼 x, lineSum (K := K) f v x) = (Fintype.card K : ℝ) * (𝔼 x, f x)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.mean_line_loss_le
statement:
lemma mean_line_loss_le {U : Finset V} {f : V → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hsupp : ∀ x, x ∉ U → f x = 0)
    (v : Direction V) :
    (Fintype.card K : ℝ)*(𝔼 x, f x) - (𝔼 x, lineMax (K := K) f v x) ≤
      (Fintype.card K : ℝ)*(𝔼 z, if collision (K := K) U v z then f z else 0)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.mean_sparseWeight
statement:
lemma mean_sparseWeight {K : Type u} {V : Type v} [Field K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Fintype V] (U : Finset V) (F : V → ℝ) :
    (Fintype.card K : ℝ)*(𝔼 z, sparseWeight (K := K) U F z) = usableMass U F

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Blocks.usable_density_le
statement:
lemma usable_density_le {V : Type v} [AddCommGroup V] [Fintype V] {U : Finset V} {F : V → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hF : ∀ z ∈ U, a ≤ F z) :
    (U.card : ℝ)/(Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ usableMass U F / a

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.choose_usable
statement:
theorem choose_usable (F : Z → ℝ) (E : Finset Z) (q : W → Z → ℝ) (δ ε : ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ z, 0 ≤ F z) (hq : ∀ w z, 0 ≤ q w z)
    (hqavg : ∀ z ∈ E, (𝔼 w, q w z) ≤ δ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ w : W, ∃ U : Finset Z, U ⊆ E ∧
      (∀ z ∈ U, q w z ≤ ε) ∧
      mass F (E \ U) ≤ δ*mass F E/ε ∧
      mass F E - δ*mass F E/ε ≤ mass F U ∧ mass F U ≤ mass F E

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.WeightedSelection.mean_loss_le
statement:
lemma mean_loss_le {Z : Type u} {W : Type v} [Fintype Z] [Fintype W] [Nonempty W] (F : Z → ℝ) (E : Finset Z) (q : W → Z → ℝ) (δ : ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ z, 0 ≤ F z) (hqavg : ∀ z ∈ E, (𝔼 w, q w z) ≤ δ) :
    (𝔼 w, loss F E q w) ≤ δ*mass F E

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.anchor_mem_cube
statement:
lemma anchor_mem_cube {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (z : ι → ZMod p) (j : ι) :
    anchor p z j ∈ Set.Icc 0 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.ConstructionA.lineMax_anchor
statement:
lemma lineMax_anchor {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (U : Finset (ι → ZMod p))
    (F : (ι → ZMod p) → ℝ) (v x : ι → ZMod p)
    (hg : 0 < lineMax (K := ZMod p) (sparseWeight (K := ZMod p) U F) v x) :
    ∃ z ∈ U, x-z ∈ Submodule.span (ZMod p) {v} ∧
      lineMax (K := ZMod p) (sparseWeight (K := ZMod p) U F) v x = F z / p

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eligible_window
statement:
lemma eligible_window {p : ℕ} [NeZero p] {h μ D r : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h)
    {z : ι → ZMod p} (hz : z ∈ gridEligible h μ D r p) :
    Real.exp ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*μ-D) ≤ folded h (anchor p z) ∧
    folded h (anchor p z) ≤ Real.exp ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ)*μ+D)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_atom_exponent
statement:
lemma eventually_atom_exponent :
    ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop, 5*b^(56/100 : ℝ)+1 ≤ (alpha/2)*b^(70/100 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_line_collision
statement:
lemma eventually_line_collision : ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop,
    Real.exp (-2*b^(56/100 : ℝ)) ≤ b^(-(1/20 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_logMean_height_le
statement: lemma eventually_logMean_height_le : ∀ᶠ b : ℕ in atTop, logMean (height b) ≤ (b : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.eventually_previous_cap
statement:
lemma eventually_previous_cap : ∀ᶠ b : ℝ in atTop, ∀ a : ℝ, 1 ≤ a →
    a ≤ b^((1 : ℝ)/(9/10)) → 5*a^(56/100 : ℝ) ≤ b^(65/100 : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.gridMass_eq_usableMass
statement:
lemma gridMass_eq_usableMass {p : ℕ} [NeZero p] (h : ℝ) (E : Finset (ι → ZMod p)) :
    gridMass h p E = Blocks.usableMass E (fun z => folded h (anchor p z))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.group_log_bound
statement:
lemma group_log_bound {a b p : ℕ} [NeZero p] (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (ha : logMean (height a) ≤ (a : ℝ))
    (hab : (a : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ)^((1 : ℝ)/(9/10)))
    (hp : Real.log p ≤ (a : ℝ)*logMean (height a)-3*(a : ℝ)^(56/100 : ℝ)) :
    Real.log (Fintype.card (Fin a → ZMod p)) ≤ (b : ℝ)^4

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.line_mean_error
statement:
lemma line_mean_error {M g D ε τ : ℝ} (hM : |M-1| ≤ D*ε) (hM2 : M ≤ 2)
    (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hτε : τ ≤ ε) (hgl : M-4*M*τ ≤ g) (hgu : g ≤ M) :
    |g-1| ≤ (D+8)*ε

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.mean_fairRate_lower
statement:
lemma mean_fairRate_lower {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {h r : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (t : ι → ℝ)
    (hN : r ≤ ((Finset.univ.filter fun j => |t j-1/2| ≤ (h^2)⁻¹).card : ℝ)) :
    2*Bits.alpha*r ≤ Bits.meanCount (fun j => Bits.fairRate (probability h (t j) true))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.probability_eq_bitMass
statement:
lemma probability_eq_bitMass {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (t : ℝ) (e : Bool) :
    probability h t e = Bits.bitMass (probability h t true) e

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.window_line_choice
statement:
lemma window_line_choice {b p : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) [Fact p.Prime]
    (U : Finset (Fin b → ZMod p)) (hU : U ⊆ gridEligible (height b) (logMean (height b))
      ((b : ℝ)^(56/100 : ℝ)) ((b : ℝ)^(70/100 : ℝ)) p)
    (hh : 0 < height b)
    (hpl : (b : ℝ)*logMean (height b)-4*(b : ℝ)^(56/100 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log p)
    (hpu : Real.log p ≤ (b : ℝ)*logMean (height b)-3*(b : ℝ)^(56/100 : ℝ))
    (hM : usableMass U (fun z => folded (height b) (anchor p z)) ≤ 2) :
    ∃ v : Direction (Fin b → ZMod p),
      usableMass U (fun z => folded (height b) (anchor p z)) -
        4*usableMass U (fun z => folded (height b) (anchor p z))*Real.exp (-2*(b : ℝ)^(56/100 : ℝ)) ≤
        (𝔼 x, lineMax (K := ZMod p) (sparseWeight (K := ZMod p) U (fun z => folded (height b) (anchor p z))) v x) ∧
      (𝔼 x, lineMax (K := ZMod p) (sparseWeight (K := ZMod p) U (fun z => folded (height b) (anchor p z))) v x) ≤
        usableMass U (fun z => folded (height b) (anchor p z)) ∧
      ∀ x, 0 ≤ lineMax (K := ZMod p) (sparseWeight (K := ZMod p) U (fun z => folded (height b) (anchor p z))) v x ∧
        lineMax (K := ZMod p) (sparseWeight (K := ZMod p) U (fun z => folded (height b) (anchor p z))) v x ≤
          Real.exp (5*(b : ℝ)^(56/100 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Folded.wordMass_eq_productMass
statement:
lemma wordMass_eq_productMass {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (t : ι → ℝ) (e : ι → Bool) :
    wordMass h t e = Bits.productMass (fun j => probability h (t j) true) e

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.bits_injective
statement: lemma bits_injective (b : ℕ) (lam : Fin b → ℝ) : Function.Injective (bits b lam)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.bits_scalar
statement:
lemma bits_scalar (b : ℕ) (lam : Fin b → ℝ) (e : Fin b → Bool) (j : Fin b) :

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.join_subset_product
statement:
lemma join_subset_product (P : E → Finset V) (point : E → W)
    (S : Set V) (T : Set W) (hP : ∀ e, ↑(P e) ⊆ S) (hp : ∀ e, point e ∈ T) :
    ↑(join P point) ⊆ S ×ˢ T

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.mem_join
statement:
lemma mem_join (P : E → Finset V) (point : E → W) (x : V × W) :
    x ∈ join P point ↔ ∃ e, x.1 ∈ P e ∧ x.2 = point e

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.sum_join
statement:
lemma sum_join (P : E → Finset V) (point : E → W) (hp : Function.Injective point)
    (f : V × W → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ join P point, f x = ∑ e, ∑ x ∈ P e, f (x,point e)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.weighted_join
statement:
theorem weighted_join (P : E → Finset V) (point : E → W) (hp : Function.Injective point)
    (preWeight : E → V → ℝ) (block : E → ℝ) (weight : V × W → ℝ)
    (prob g : E → ℝ) (a c d s : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hprob : ∀ e, 0 ≤ prob e) (hg : ∀ e, 0 ≤ g e)
    (hb : ∀ e, c*d*prob e ≤ block e)
    (hpreWeight : ∀ e, a*g e ≤ ∑ x ∈ P e, preWeight e x)
    (hweight : ∀ e, ∀ x ∈ P e, weight (x,point e) = preWeight e x * block e)
    (hs : s ≤ ∑ e, prob e*g e) :
    a*c*d*s ≤ ∑ x ∈ join P point, weight x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.g_nonneg
statement: lemma g_nonneg (B : Block) (x : B.Group) : 0 ≤ B.g x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.roundingLoss_nonneg

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.shift_grid_bits
statement:
lemma shift_grid_bits (A B : Block) (w : Fin B.b → A.Group) (y : A.Vec)
    (lam : B.Vec) (e : Fin B.b → Bool) :
    A.grid (y-A.shift B w (bits B.b lam e)) =

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.weight_bits

lemma weight_bits (B : Block) (y lam : B.Vec) (e : Fin B.b → Bool) :

lemma blockSum_le (c : Chain B) (f g : Block → ℝ) (h : c.Every (fun B => f B ≤ g B)) :

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.blockSum_nonneg
statement:

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.coefficient_bounds
statement:
theorem coefficient_bounds (c : Chain B) (loss : Block → ℝ)
    (hl : c.Every (fun B => loss B ∈ Set.Icc 0 1)) :
    0 ≤ c.coefficient loss ∧ c.coefficient loss ≤ 1 ∧
      1-c.coefficient loss+loss B ≤ c.blockSum (fun B => B.roundingLoss+2*loss B)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.coefficient_nonneg

lemma coefficient_nonneg (c : Chain B) (loss : Block → ℝ) (hc : c.Good loss) :
