name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.inverse_power_sum
statement:
theorem inverse_power_sum (c : Chain B) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hc : c.Halving) (hpos : c.Every (fun B => 0 < B.b)) :
    c.blockSum (fun B => (B.b : ℝ)^(-a)) ≤ (B.b : ℝ)^(-a)/(1-(2 : ℝ)^(-a))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.last_subLast
statement:
@[simp] lemma last_subLast (c : Chain B) (y : c.Vec) (t : B.Vec) :
    c.last (c.subLast y t) = c.last y-t

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.mul_deficit
statement:
lemma mul_deficit {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ 1) (hy : y ≤ 1) :
    1-x*y ≤ (1-x)+(1-y)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.weight_pos
statement: lemma weight_pos (c : Chain B) (y l : c.Vec) : 0 < c.weight y l

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.append_injective
statement:
lemma append_injective {m b : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (fun x : (Fin m → ℝ) × (Fin b → ℝ) => Fin.append x.1 x.2)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.eventually_nextSize_half
statement: lemma eventually_nextSize_half : ∀ᶠ b : ℕ in atTop, 2*nextSize b ≤ b

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.mem_concat
statement:
lemma mem_concat {m b : ℕ} (P : (Fin b → Bool) → Finset (Fin m → ℝ))
    (lam : Fin b → ℝ) (x : Fin (m+b) → ℝ) :
    x ∈ concat P lam ↔ ∃ e, ∃ v ∈ P e, x=Fin.append v (bits b lam e)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.nextSize_relation
statement: lemma nextSize_relation (b : ℕ) : (b : ℝ) ≤ (nextSize b : ℝ)^((1 : ℝ)/(9/10))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.regular_mean
statement:
lemma regular_mean {A : ℝ} {B : Block} (hB : Regular A B) (hsmall : blockLoss A B ≤ 1/2) :
    1/2 ≤ (𝔼 x, B.g x) ∧ (𝔼 x, B.g x) ≤ 2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.suffixBinary_concat
OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.suffixBinary_subset
statement:
lemma suffixBinary_subset {m : ℕ} {P Q : Finset (Fin m → ℝ)}
    (hP : SuffixBinary P) (hQ : Q ⊆ P) : SuffixBinary Q

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.appendEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma appendEquiv_apply (m n : ℕ) (x : (Fin m → ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    appendEquiv m n x = Fin.append x.1 x.2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.appendEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma appendEquiv_symm_apply (m n : ℕ) (y : Fin (m+n) → ℝ) :
    (appendEquiv m n).symm y =
      (fun j => y (Fin.castAdd n j),fun j => y (Fin.natAdd m j))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.finProduct_covolume
statement:
lemma finProduct_covolume {m n : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ))
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin n → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [DiscreteTopology N]
    [IsZLattice ℝ L] [IsZLattice ℝ N] :
    ZLattice.covolume (finProduct L N) = ZLattice.covolume L * ZLattice.covolume N

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.image_covolume
statement:
lemma image_covolume (L : Submodule ℤ (ι → ℝ)) (e : (ι → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (ι → ℝ))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] :
    ZLattice.covolume (image L e) = |LinearMap.det e.toLinearMap| * ZLattice.covolume L

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.mem_finProduct
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_finProduct {m n : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ))
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin n → ℝ)) (x : Fin (m+n) → ℝ) :
    x ∈ finProduct L N ↔
      (fun j => x (Fin.castAdd n j)) ∈ L ∧ (fun j => x (Fin.natAdd m j)) ∈ N

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.mem_image
statement:
lemma mem_image {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (L : Submodule ℤ (ι → ℝ)) (e : (ι → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (ι → ℝ)) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    x ∈ image L e ↔ ∃ l ∈ L, e l=x

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.single_left
statement:
lemma single_left {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) :
    (Pi.single (Fin.castAdd n i) (1 : ℝ) : Fin (m+n) → ℝ) =
      Fin.append (Pi.single i 1) 0

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.single_right
statement:
lemma single_right {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    (Pi.single (Fin.natAdd m i) (1 : ℝ) : Fin (m+n) → ℝ) =
      Fin.append 0 (Pi.single i 1)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.triangular_append
statement:
@[simp] lemma triangular_append {m n : ℕ}
    (e : (Fin m → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin m → ℝ))
    (f : (Fin n → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) (S : (Fin n → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin m → ℝ))
    (x : Fin m → ℝ) (y : Fin n → ℝ) :
    triangular e f S (Fin.append x y) = Fin.append (e x+S y) (f y)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.triangular_det
statement:
lemma triangular_det {m n : ℕ}
    (e : (Fin m → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin m → ℝ))
    (f : (Fin n → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) (S : (Fin n → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin m → ℝ)) :
    LinearMap.det (triangular e f S).toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.det e.toLinearMap * LinearMap.det f.toLinearMap

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.triangular_lattice_covolume
statement:
theorem triangular_lattice_covolume {m n : ℕ}
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin n → ℝ))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [DiscreteTopology N] [IsZLattice ℝ L] [IsZLattice ℝ N]
    (e : (Fin m → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin m → ℝ))
    (f : (Fin n → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) (S : (Fin n → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin m → ℝ)) :
    ZLattice.covolume (image (finProduct L N) (triangular e f S)) =
      |LinearMap.det e.toLinearMap| * ZLattice.covolume L *
        (|LinearMap.det f.toLinearMap| * ZLattice.covolume N)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.lattice_covolume
statement: lemma lattice_covolume (B : Block) : ZLattice.covolume B.lattice = (B.p : ℝ)⁻¹

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.linear_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma linear_apply (B : Block) (l : B.Vec) : B.linear l = B.h • l

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.linear_det
statement: lemma linear_det (B : Block) : LinearMap.det B.linear.toLinearMap = B.h^B.b

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.physical_covolume
statement:
lemma physical_covolume (B : Block) :
    ZLattice.covolume (image B.lattice B.linear) = B.det

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.selected_weight_le
statement:
lemma selected_weight_le (B : Block) (y l : B.Vec) (hl : B.Selected y l)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : ∀ z ∈ B.usable, ∀ t : B.Vec, t ∈ gridCell B.p z →
      ∀ e : Fin B.b → Bool, atom B.h t e/(B.p : ℝ) ≤ q) : B.weight y l ≤ q

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.shiftDimMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma shiftDimMap_apply (B : Block) (d : ℕ) (w : Fin d → B.Group) (l : Fin d → ℝ) :
    B.shiftDimMap d w l = B.shiftDim d w l

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.shiftDim_grid_bits
statement:
lemma shiftDim_grid_bits (B : Block) (d : ℕ) (w : Fin d → B.Group) (y : B.Vec)
    (lam : Fin d → ℝ) (e : Fin d → Bool) :
    B.grid (y-B.shiftDim d w (bits d lam e)) =
      B.grid (y-B.shiftDim d w lam)-Bits.groupShift w e

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.shiftMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma shiftMap_apply (A B : Block) (w : Fin B.b → A.Group) (l : B.Vec) :
    A.shiftMap B w l = A.shift B w l

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.terminal_index
statement:
lemma terminal_index (B : Block) (y : B.Vec) (t : Fin B.terminalDim → ℝ) (z : B.Group) :
    ∃ l ∈ integerLattice B.terminalDim,
      (∀ j, |t j-l j| ≤ 1) ∧ B.grid (y-B.terminalShift l)=z

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.full_covolume
statement: lemma full_covolume (c : Chain B) : ZLattice.covolume c.fullLattice = c.det

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.full_residual
statement:
lemma full_residual (c : Chain B) (y : c.FullVec) (v : c.Vec) (t : Fin B.terminalDim → ℝ) :
    y-c.fullLinear (Fin.append v t) = Fin.append
      (c.subLast (fun j => y (Fin.castAdd B.terminalDim j)) (B.terminalShift t)-c.linear v)
      (fun j => y (Fin.natAdd c.dim j)-t j)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.full_weight
statement:
lemma full_weight (c : Chain B) (y : c.FullVec) (v : c.Vec) (t : Fin B.terminalDim → ℝ) :
    c.det*gamma (y-c.fullLinear (Fin.append v t)) =
      c.weight (c.subLast (fun j => y (Fin.castAdd B.terminalDim j)) (B.terminalShift t)) v *
        gamma (fun j => y (Fin.natAdd c.dim j)-t j)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.gamma_append
statement:
lemma gamma_append {m n : ℕ} (x : Fin m → ℝ) (y : Fin n → ℝ) :
    gamma (Fin.append x y) = gamma x*gamma y

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.mem_raw
statement: lemma mem_raw (c : Chain B) (l : c.Vec) : l ∈ c.rawLattice ↔ c.RawMem l

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.physical_covolume
statement: lemma physical_covolume (c : Chain B) : ZLattice.covolume c.physicalLattice = c.det

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.residual_append
statement:
lemma residual_append (c : Chain A) (B : Block) (w : Fin B.b → A.Group)
    (y l : (Chain.append c B w).Vec) :
    y-(Chain.append c B w).linear l =
      Fin.append
        (c.subLast (fun j => y (Fin.castAdd B.b j))
          (A.shift B w (fun j => l (Fin.natAdd c.dim j))) -
          c.linear (fun j => l (Fin.castAdd B.b j)))
        (fun j => y (Fin.natAdd c.dim j)-B.h*l (Fin.natAdd c.dim j))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.subLast_eq_sub
statement:
lemma subLast_eq_sub (c : Chain B) (y : c.Vec) (t : B.Vec) :
    c.subLast y t = y-c.injectLast t

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.weight_eq
statement:
lemma weight_eq (c : Chain B) (y l : c.Vec) :
    c.weight y l = c.det*gamma (y-c.linear l)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.binaryExpansion
statement:
lemma binaryExpansion (k n : ℕ) (hn : n < 2^k) :
    ∃ e : Fin k → Bool, (∑ j, if e j then 2^(j : ℕ) else 0) = n

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.integerLattice_covolume
statement: lemma integerLattice_covolume (n : ℕ) : ZLattice.covolume (integerLattice n) = 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.integer_mem
statement: lemma integer_mem (n : ℕ) (k : Fin n → ℤ) : (fun j => (k j : ℝ)) ∈ integerLattice n

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.terminal_exhaustion
statement:
theorem terminal_exhaustion (b p : ℕ) [NeZero p] :
    Function.Surjective (fun e : Fin (b*Nat.clog 2 p) → Bool =>
      ∑ i, if e i then terminalColumns b p i else 0)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.shiftDim_bound
statement:
lemma shiftDim_bound (B : Block) (d : ℕ) (w : Fin d → B.Group) (l : Fin d → ℝ)
    {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hl : ∀ j, |l j| ≤ S) (j : Fin B.b) :
    |B.shiftDim d w l j| ≤ B.h*((d : ℝ)*S)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Block.shift_bound
statement:
lemma shift_bound (A B : Block) (w : Fin B.b → A.Group) (l : B.Vec)
    {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hl : ∀ j, |l j| ≤ S) (j : Fin A.b) :
    |A.shift B w l j| ≤ A.h*((B.b : ℝ)*S)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.blockSum_add
statement:
lemma blockSum_add (c : Chain B) (f g : Block → ℝ) :
    c.blockSum (fun Q => f Q+g Q) = c.blockSum f+c.blockSum g

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.blockSum_dim
statement: lemma blockSum_dim (c : Chain B) : c.blockSum (fun Q => (Q.b : ℝ)) = (c.dim : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.coefficient_half
statement:
lemma coefficient_half (c : Chain B) (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (cutoff : ℕ)
    (hcut : 1 ≤ cutoff) (hc : c.Halving)
    (hr : c.Every (fun Q => cutoff ≤ Q.b ∧
      Q.roundingLoss ≤ (Q.b : ℝ)^(-(1/100 : ℝ)) ∧ blockLoss A Q ≤ 1/2))
    (hsmall : (1+2*A)*(cutoff : ℝ)^(-(1/100 : ℝ))/(1-(2 : ℝ)^(-(1/100 : ℝ))) ≤ 1/2) :
    1/2 ≤ c.coefficient (blockLoss A)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.denominators_pos
statement: lemma denominators_pos (c : Chain B) : ∀ j, 0 < c.denominators j

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.dim_last_le
statement: lemma dim_last_le (c : Chain B) (hc : c.Halving) : c.dim+B.b ≤ 2*c.first.b

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.every_le_first
statement: lemma every_le_first (c : Chain B) (hc : c.Halving) : c.Every (fun Q => Q.b ≤ c.first.b)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.full_inverse_coordinate_bound
statement:
lemma full_inverse_coordinate_bound (c : Chain B) (x : c.FullVec) {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hx : ∀ j, |c.fullLinear x j| ≤ (Fin.append c.heights (fun _ => 1)) j*S) :
    ∀ j, |x j| ≤ S*((c.fullDim+2 : ℕ) : ℝ)^c.fullDim

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.full_raw_rational
statement:
lemma full_raw_rational (c : Chain B) (l : c.FullVec) (hl : l ∈ c.fullRaw) :
    ∀ j, ∃ k : ℤ, l j=(k : ℝ)/(c.fullDenominators j : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.full_residual_physical
statement:
lemma full_residual_physical (c : Chain B) (y l : c.FullVec) (hl : c.FullResidual y l) :
    ∀ j, |(y-c.fullLinear l) j| ≤ (Fin.append c.heights (fun _ => 1)) j

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.full_residual_square
statement:
lemma full_residual_square (c : Chain B) (y l : c.FullVec) (hl : c.FullResidual y l) :
    (∑ j, ((y-c.fullLinear l) j)^2) ≤ c.radiusSq+(B.terminalDim : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.heights_nonneg
statement: lemma heights_nonneg (c : Chain B) : ∀ j, 0 ≤ c.heights j

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.heights_square_sum
statement: lemma heights_square_sum (c : Chain B) : ∑ j, c.heights j^2 = c.radiusSq

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.injectLast_bound
statement:
lemma injectLast_bound (c : Chain B) (t : B.Vec) {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (ht : ∀ j, |t j| ≤ B.h*S) : ∀ j, |c.injectLast t j| ≤ c.heights j*S

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.inverse_coordinate_bound
statement:
lemma inverse_coordinate_bound (c : Chain B) (x : c.Vec) {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hx : ∀ j, |c.linear x j| ≤ c.heights j*S) :
    ∀ j, |x j| ≤ S*((c.dim+2 : ℕ) : ℝ)^c.dim

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.last_le_first
statement: lemma last_le_first (c : Chain B) (hc : c.Halving) : B.b ≤ c.first.b

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.mem_alphabets
statement:
lemma Chain.mem_alphabets {B : Block} (c : Chain B) (z l : c.FullVec)
    (hz : ∀ j, 0 ≤ z j ∧ z j < 1) (hl : c.FullResidual (c.fullLinear z) l)
    (hmem : l ∈ c.fullRaw) : ∀ j, l j ∈ c.alphabets j

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.radius_bound
statement:
lemma radius_bound (c : Chain B) (A : ℝ)
    (hc : c.Halving) (hr : c.Every (Regular A))
    (hp : c.Every (fun Q => 1 ≤ Q.b)) :
    c.radiusSq ≤ (9/2 : ℝ)*(c.first.b : ℝ)*Real.log ((c.first.b : ℝ)+1)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.raw_coordinate_bound
statement:
lemma raw_coordinate_bound (c : Chain B) (z l : c.FullVec)
    (hz : ∀ j, 0 ≤ z j ∧ z j < 1) (hl : c.FullResidual (c.fullLinear z) l) :
    ∀ j, |l j| ≤ (c.alphabetRadius : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.raw_rational
statement:
lemma raw_rational (c : Chain B) (l : c.Vec) (hl : c.RawMem l) :
    ∀ j, ∃ k : ℤ, l j=(k : ℝ)/(c.denominators j : ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.residual_physical
statement:
lemma residual_physical (c : Chain B) (y l : c.Vec) (hl : c.Residual y l) :
    ∀ j, |(y-c.linear l) j| ≤ c.heights j

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.selected_cap
statement:
lemma selected_cap (c : Chain B) (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (hc : c.Every (AtomBound (fun Q => Real.exp (-k*(Q.b : ℝ)^(70/100 : ℝ)))))
    (y l : c.Vec) (hl : c.Selected y l) :
    c.weight y l ≤ Real.exp (-k*(c.first.b : ℝ)^(70/100 : ℝ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.terminal_bound
statement:
lemma terminal_bound (c : Chain B) (A : ℝ) {cutoff M Q : ℕ}
    (hr : Regular A B) (hstop : nextSize B.b < cutoff)
    (hM : (cutoff : ℝ)^((1 : ℝ)/(9/10)) ≤ M)
    (hQ : Real.exp ((M : ℝ)^2) ≤ Q)
    (hlog : logMean (height B.b) ≤ (B.b : ℝ)) :
    B.b ≤ M ∧ B.p ≤ Q ∧ B.terminalDim ≤ M*Nat.clog 2 Q

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.inverse_factor_bound
statement:
lemma inverse_factor_bound (m n : ℕ) :
    (n+1)*(m+2)^m ≤ (m+n+2)^(m+n)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.succ_le_two_power
statement: lemma succ_le_two_power (n : ℕ) : n+1 ≤ 2^n

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.suffixBinary_fixed
statement:
lemma suffixBinary_fixed {m n : ℕ} (P : Finset (Fin m → ℝ)) (t : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hP : SuffixBinary P) : SuffixBinary (P.image (fun v => Fin.append v t))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.appendPoint_disjoint
statement:
lemma appendPoint_disjoint {q : ℕ} (v : ℝ) (s t : Finset ((Fin q → ℝ) × α)) :
    Disjoint (s.image (appendPoint v)) (t.image (appendPoint (v+1)))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.appendPoint_injective
statement:
lemma appendPoint_injective {q : ℕ} (v : ℝ) :
    Function.Injective (appendPoint (α := α) (q := q) v)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.failure_eq_intersection
statement:
lemma failure_eq_intersection (π : E →+ T) (U : α → Set T) {q : ℕ} (p : Pattern α q)
    (Z : Fin q → E) :
    p.failure π U Z = ⋂ l ∈ p.points, translate (U l.2) (π (linearShift Z l.1))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.labelProduct_eq_prod
statement:
lemma labelProduct_eq_prod {q : ℕ} (p : Pattern α q) (η : α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    p.labelProduct η = ∏ l ∈ p.points, η l.2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.linearShift_snoc
statement:
lemma linearShift_snoc {q : ℕ} (Z : Fin (q+1) → E) (x : Fin q → ℝ) (v : ℝ) :
    linearShift Z (Fin.snoc x v) = linearShift (Fin.init Z) x + v • Z (Fin.last q)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.measurableSet_failure
statement:
lemma measurableSet_failure [MeasurableSpace T] [MeasurableAdd₂ T] [MeasurableNeg T]
    (π : E →+ T) {U : α → Set T} (hU : ∀ a, MeasurableSet (U a))
    {q : ℕ} (p : Pattern α q) (Z : Fin q → E) : MeasurableSet (p.failure π U Z)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.mem_failure_iff
statement:
lemma mem_failure_iff (π : E →+ T) (U : α → Set T) {q : ℕ} (p : Pattern α q)
    (Z : Fin q → E) (x : T) :
    x ∈ p.failure π U Z ↔
      ∀ l ∈ p.points, x ∈ translate (U l.2) (π (linearShift Z l.1))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.points_card
statement: lemma points_card {q : ℕ} (p : Pattern α q) : p.points.card = p.size

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.points_nonempty
statement: lemma points_nonempty {q : ℕ} (p : Pattern α q) : p.points.Nonempty

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.size_le_two_pow
statement: lemma size_le_two_pow {q : ℕ} (p : Pattern α q) : p.size ≤ 2^q

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.size_pos
statement: lemma size_pos {q : ℕ} (p : Pattern α q) : 0 < p.size

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.weight_eq
statement:
lemma weight_eq {q : ℕ} (p : Pattern α q) (L : ℝ≥0∞) (η : α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    p.weight L η = L^(p.size-1) * p.labelProduct η

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.weight_ne_top
statement:
lemma weight_ne_top {q : ℕ} (p : Pattern α q) {L : ℝ≥0∞} (hL : L ≠ ∞)
    {η : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hη : ∀ a, η a ≠ ∞) : p.weight L η ≠ ∞

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.weight_ne_zero
statement:
lemma weight_ne_zero {q : ℕ} (p : Pattern α q) {L : ℝ≥0∞} (hL : L ≠ 0)
    {η : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hη : ∀ a, η a ≠ 0) : p.weight L η ≠ 0

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.lintegral_overlap
statement:
lemma lintegral_overlap {A B : Set T} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    ∫⁻ t, μ (A ∩ translate B t) ∂μ = μ A * μ B

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.measurableSet_translate
statement:
lemma measurableSet_translate {A : Set T} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (t : T) :
    MeasurableSet (translate A t)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.measurable_overlap
statement:
lemma measurable_overlap {T : Type*} [AddCommGroup T] [MeasurableSpace T] [MeasurableAdd₂ T] [MeasurableNeg T] (μ : Measure T) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsAddLeftInvariant μ] [IsNegInvariant μ] {A B : Set T} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    Measurable (fun t => μ (A ∩ translate B t))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.measure_translate
statement: lemma measure_translate {T : Type*} [AddCommGroup T] [MeasurableSpace T] [MeasurableAdd₂ T] [MeasurableNeg T] (μ : Measure T) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsAddLeftInvariant μ] [IsNegInvariant μ] (A : Set T) (t : T) : μ (translate A t) = μ A

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.overlap_common_translate
statement:
lemma overlap_common_translate (A B : Set T) (a b : T) :
    μ (translate A a ∩ translate B (a+b)) = μ (A ∩ translate B b)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.restrictColumns_self
statement:
@[simp] lemma restrictColumns_self {E : Type*} {d : ℕ} (Z : Fin d → E) :
    restrictColumns (le_refl d) Z = Z

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.restrictColumns_snoc
statement:
lemma restrictColumns_snoc {E : Type*} {q d : ℕ} (h : q ≤ d) (Z : Fin d → E) (z : E) :
    restrictColumns (h.trans (Nat.le_succ d)) (Fin.snoc Z z) = restrictColumns h Z

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.simultaneous_choice
statement:
lemma simultaneous_choice (s : Finset I) (f : I → X → ℝ≥0∞) (w : I → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, Measurable (f i))
    (hw0 : ∀ i ∈ s, w i ≠ 0) (hwt : ∀ i ∈ s, w i ≠ ∞)
    (hfint : ∀ i ∈ s, ∫⁻ x, f i x ∂μ ≤ w i)
    (L : ℝ≥0∞) (hL : (s.card : ℝ≥0∞) < L) :
    ∃ x, ∀ i ∈ s, f i x ≤ L * w i

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.simultaneous_shear
statement:
theorem simultaneous_shear (D : ℕ) (P : (q : ℕ) → Finset (Pattern α q))
    (hP : SliceClosed P D)
    (hQ : (∑ q ∈ Finset.range (D+1), ((P q).card : ℝ≥0∞)) < L) :
    ∃ Z : Fin D → E, ∀ q (hq : q ≤ D) (p : Pattern α q), p ∈ P q →
      μ (p.failure π U (restrictColumns hq Z)) ≤
        L^(p.size-1) * p.labelProduct η

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.simultaneous_shear_aux
statement:
theorem simultaneous_shear_aux (D : ℕ) (P : (q : ℕ) → Finset (Pattern α q))
    (hP : SliceClosed P D) (hcard : ∀ q ≤ D, ((P q).card : ℝ≥0∞) < L) :
    ∃ Z : Fin D → E, ∀ q (hq : q ≤ D) (p : Pattern α q), p ∈ P q →
      μ (p.failure π U (restrictColumns hq Z)) ≤ p.weight L η

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.translate_add
statement:
lemma translate_add {T : Type*} [AddCommGroup T] [MeasurableSpace T] [MeasurableAdd₂ T] [MeasurableNeg T] (A : Set T) (a b : T) :
    translate A (a+b) = translate (translate A a) b

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.translate_inter
statement:
lemma translate_inter {T : Type*} [AddCommGroup T] [MeasurableSpace T] [MeasurableAdd₂ T] [MeasurableNeg T] (A B : Set T) (t : T) :
    translate (A ∩ B) t = translate A t ∩ translate B t

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.alphabet_log_card
statement:
lemma alphabet_log_card (c : Chain B) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hc : c.Every (fun B => Real.log (B.p : ℝ) ≤ R)) (j : Fin c.fullDim) :
    Real.log ((c.alphabets j).card+1 : ℝ) ≤
      Real.log 8+(c.fullDim : ℝ)*Real.log ((c.fullDim : ℝ)+2)+R

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.denominator_log_le
OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.every_and

lemma every_and {P Q : Block → Prop} (c : Chain B) (hP : c.Every P) (hQ : c.Every Q) :

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.full_denominator_log_le
statement:
lemma full_denominator_log_le (c : Chain B) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.Chain.regular_primes_log_bound

lemma regular_primes_log_bound (c : Chain B) (A : ℝ) (hc : c.Halving)

    c.Every (fun W => Real.log (W.p : ℝ) ≤ (c.first.b : ℝ)^2)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.add_eq_univ_of_measure_sum
statement:
lemma add_eq_univ_of_measure_sum {A B : Set T} (hB : MeasurableSet B)
    (h : 1 < μ.real A + μ.real B) : A+B = univ

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.circle_torsion_card
statement:
lemma circle_torsion_card (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card {x : AddCircle (1 : ℝ) // k • x = 0} ≤ k

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.complete_almost_cover
statement:
theorem complete_almost_cover {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (L : Submodule ℤ (RealSpace n)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (K : Set (RealSpace n)) (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hhole : holeProportion L K ≤ 1/(n : ℝ)^(2*n)) :
    ∃ (L' : Submodule ℤ (RealSpace n)) (_ : DiscreteTopology L'),
      IsZLattice ℝ L' ∧ K+(L' : Set (RealSpace n)) = univ ∧
      (volume K).toReal / ZLattice.covolume L' ≤
        Real.exp 1 * ((volume K).toReal / ZLattice.covolume L)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.completion
statement:
theorem completion {n : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (RealSpace n))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (K : Set (RealSpace n))
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hhole : holeProportion L K < (1-holeProportion L K)/(k : ℝ)^n) :
    ((1+(k : ℝ)⁻¹) • K)+(L : Set (RealSpace n)) = univ

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.contractLattice_covolume
statement:
lemma contractLattice_covolume {n : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (RealSpace n))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ZLattice.covolume (contractLattice L a ha.ne') = a⁻¹^n * ZLattice.covolume L

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.cover_contractLattice
statement:
lemma cover_contractLattice {n : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (RealSpace n)) (K : Set (RealSpace n))
    (a : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hcover : a • K+(L : Set (RealSpace n)) = univ) :
    K+(contractLattice L a ha : Set (RealSpace n)) = univ

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.latticeProjection_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma latticeProjection_eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (RealSpace n))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (x : RealSpace n) :
    latticeProjection L x = 0 ↔ x ∈ L

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.latticeProjection_image_eq_univ_iff
statement:
lemma latticeProjection_image_eq_univ_iff {n : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (RealSpace n))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (K : Set (RealSpace n)) :
    latticeProjection L '' K = univ ↔ K+(L : Set (RealSpace n)) = univ

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.latticeProjection_surjective
statement:
lemma latticeProjection_surjective {n : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (RealSpace n))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] : Function.Surjective (latticeProjection L)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.measureReal_image_le_kernel
statement:
lemma measureReal_image_le_kernel (f : T →+ T) [Fintype f.ker]
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f μ μ) {A : Set T} (hA : MeasurableSet (f '' A)) :
    μ.real (f '' A) ≤ (Fintype.card f.ker : ℝ)*μ.real A

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.measure_image_le_kernel
statement:
lemma measure_image_le_kernel {T : Type*} [AddCommGroup T] [TopologicalSpace T] [IsTopologicalAddGroup T] [MeasurableSpace T] [BorelSpace T] [CompactSpace T] (μ : Measure T) [IsAddHaarMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : T →+ T) [Fintype f.ker]
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f μ μ) {A : Set T} (hA : MeasurableSet (f '' A)) :
    μ (f '' A) ≤ (Fintype.card f.ker : ℝ≥0∞)*μ A

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.mem_contractLattice
statement:
lemma mem_contractLattice {n : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (RealSpace n))
    (a : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (x : RealSpace n) :
    x ∈ contractLattice L a ha ↔ a • x ∈ L

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.one_add_inv_pow_le_exp
statement:
lemma one_add_inv_pow_le_exp (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (1+(n : ℝ)⁻¹)^n ≤ Real.exp 1

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.preimage_image_eq_kernel_union
statement:
lemma preimage_image_eq_kernel_union {T : Type*} [AddCommGroup T] [TopologicalSpace T] [IsTopologicalAddGroup T] [MeasurableSpace T] [BorelSpace T] [CompactSpace T] (f : T →+ T) (A : Set T) :
    f ⁻¹' (f '' A) = ⋃ z : f.ker, (fun x : T => x-z) ⁻¹' A

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.projection_dilate_nsmul
statement:
lemma projection_dilate_nsmul {n : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (RealSpace n))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (K : Set (RealSpace n))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (fun t : Torus n => k • t) '' (latticeProjection L '' ((k : ℝ)⁻¹ • K)) =
      latticeProjection L '' K

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.real_nsmul_regular
statement: lemma real_nsmul_regular (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) : IsSMulRegular ℝ k

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.small_hole_strict

lemma small_hole_strict {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {δ : ℝ}

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.torus_measure_image_nsmul

lemma torus_measure_image_nsmul (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0)

    (torusMeasure n).real ((fun x : Torus n => k • x) '' A) ≤

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.torus_torsion_card

lemma torus_torsion_card (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :

OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.height_split

statement:
lemma slice_image {q : ℕ} (s : Finset ((Fin q → ℝ) × α)) (a v : ℝ) :

statement:

statement:

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.slice_split_right

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.Pattern.slice_union

lemma slice_union {q : ℕ} (s t : Finset ((Fin (q+1) → ℝ) × α)) (v : ℝ) :

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.mem_allPatterns

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.mem_alphabetPoints

statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_encodeFamily (S : (q : ℕ) → Finset (Finset ((Fin q → ℝ) × α)))
    (q : ℕ) (p : Pattern α q) : p ∈ encodeFamily S q ↔ p.points ∈ S q

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.small_subsets_card
statement:
lemma small_subsets_card {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (k : ℕ) :
    (s.powerset.filter (fun t => t.card ≤ k)).card ≤ (s.card+1)^k

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.source_card_le_two_pow
statement:
lemma source_card_le_two_pow {α : Type*} {q : ℕ}
    {s : Finset ((Fin q → ℝ) × α)} (hs : SourcePattern s) : s.card ≤ 2^q

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.source_simultaneous_shear
statement:
theorem source_simultaneous_shear (D : ℕ)
    (S : (q : ℕ) → Finset (Finset ((Fin q → ℝ) × α)))
    (hsource : ∀ q ≤ D, ∀ s ∈ S q, SourcePattern s)
    (hslice : SourceSliceClosed S D)
    (hQ : (∑ q ∈ Finset.range (D+1), ((S q).card : ℝ≥0∞)) < L) :
    ∃ Z : Fin D → E, ∀ q (hq : q ≤ D) (s : Finset ((Fin q → ℝ) × α)), s ∈ S q →
      μ (⋂ l ∈ s, translate (U l.2) (π (linearShift (restrictColumns hq Z) l.1))) ≤
        L^(s.card-1) * ∏ l ∈ s, η l.2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.complete_almost_cover_projection
statement:
theorem complete_almost_cover_projection {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (Γ : Submodule ℤ (RealSpace n)) [DiscreteTopology Γ] [IsZLattice ℝ Γ]
    (π : RealSpace n →ₜ+ Torus n) (hsurj : Function.Surjective π)
    (hker : ∀ x, π x = 0 ↔ x ∈ Γ)
    (K : Set (RealSpace n)) (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hhole : 1-(torusMeasure n).real (π '' K) ≤ 1/(n : ℝ)^(2*n)) :
    ∃ (L' : Submodule ℤ (RealSpace n)) (_ : DiscreteTopology L'),
      IsZLattice ℝ L' ∧ K+(L' : Set (RealSpace n)) = univ ∧
      (volume K).toReal / ZLattice.covolume L' ≤
        Real.exp 1*((volume K).toReal / ZLattice.covolume Γ)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.completion_with_projection
statement:
theorem completion_with_projection {n : ℕ}
    (Γ : Submodule ℤ (RealSpace n)) (π : RealSpace n →ₜ+ Torus n)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective π) (hker : ∀ x, π x = 0 ↔ x ∈ Γ)
    (K : Set (RealSpace n)) (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hhole : 1-(torusMeasure n).real (π '' K) <
      (torusMeasure n).real (π '' K)/(k : ℝ)^n) :
    ((1+(k : ℝ)⁻¹) • K)+(Γ : Set (RealSpace n)) = univ

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.projection_image_eq_univ
statement:
lemma projection_image_eq_univ {n : ℕ}

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.projection_mem_image_iff
statement:
lemma projection_mem_image_iff {n : ℕ}
    (Γ : Submodule ℤ (RealSpace n)) (π : RealSpace n →+ Torus n)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Completion.projection_scalar_image

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.add_lattice_cover_iff
statement:
lemma add_lattice_cover_iff {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℤ E]
    (Γ : Submodule ℤ E) (K : Set E) (x z : E) (hz : z ∈ Γ) :
    x+z ∈ K+(Γ : Set E) ↔ x ∈ K+(Γ : Set E)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.all_height_hole_bound
statement:
theorem all_height_hole_bound {m D : ℕ}
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ))
    (hints : ∀ k : Fin D → ℤ, (fun j => (k j : ℝ)) ∈ N)
    (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ)) (Z : Fin D → (Fin m → ℝ))
    (K : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcell : ∀ z : Fin D → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ z j ∧ z j < 1) →
      torusMeasure m (horizontalHole L K (joinedLattice L N M Z) (M z)) ≤ ε) :
    ∀ y : Fin D → ℝ, torusMeasure m (horizontalHole L K (joinedLattice L N M Z) y) ≤ ε

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.appendTorus_measurePreserving
statement:
lemma appendTorus_measurePreserving (m D : ℕ) :
    MeasurePreserving (appendTorus m D) ((torusMeasure m).prod (torusMeasure D))
      (torusMeasure (m+D))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.appendTorus_surjective
statement: lemma appendTorus_surjective (m D : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (appendTorus m D)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.columnMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma columnMap_apply {m D : ℕ} (Z : Fin D → (Fin m → ℝ)) (l : Fin D → ℝ) :
    columnMap Z l = Shear.Pattern.linearShift Z l

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.covered_of_section
statement:
lemma covered_of_section {m D : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ))
    (Z : Fin D → (Fin m → ℝ)) (K : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ))
    (x : Fin m → ℝ) (y l : Fin D → ℝ) (hl : l ∈ N)
    (J : Set (Fin m → ℝ)) (hJ : ∀ j ∈ J, Fin.append j (y-M l) ∈ K)
    (hx : latticeProjection L (x-columnMap Z l) ∈ latticeProjection L '' J) :
    Fin.append x y ∈ K+(joinedLattice L N M Z : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.finite_family_lattice_shear
statement:
theorem finite_family_lattice_shear {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {m D : ℕ}
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ))
    (K : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ)) (J : α → Set (Fin m → ℝ))
    (hJ : ∀ a, IsCompact (J a)) (u : α → ℝ) (labels : Finset α)
    (hhole : ∀ a ∈ labels, torusMeasure m ((latticeProjection L '' J a)ᶜ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-u a/2)))
    (alphabet : ℕ → Finset ℝ) (Lstar : ℝ) (hLstar : 1 ≤ Lstar)
    (hcost : ((∑ q ∈ Finset.range (D+1),
      (allPatterns alphabet labels q).card : ℕ) : ℝ) < Lstar) :
    ∃ Z : Fin D → (Fin m → ℝ), ∀ (y : Fin D → ℝ)
      (s : Finset ((Fin D → ℝ) × α)), s ∈ allPatterns alphabet labels D →
      (∀ l ∈ s, l.1 ∈ N) →
      (∀ l ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ J l.2, Fin.append j (y-M l.1) ∈ K) →
      ∀ A : ℝ, A ≤ ∑ l ∈ s, u l.2 →
        torusMeasure m (horizontalHole L K (joinedLattice L N M Z) y) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((2^D : ℕ)*Real.log Lstar-A/2))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.horizontalHole_reduce
statement:
lemma horizontalHole_reduce {m D : ℕ}
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ))
    (Z : Fin D → (Fin m → ℝ)) (K : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ))
    (y₀ k : Fin D → ℝ) (hk : k ∈ N) :
    horizontalHole L K (joinedLattice L N M Z) (y₀+M k) ⊆
      Shear.translate (horizontalHole L K (joinedLattice L N M Z) y₀)
        (latticeProjection L (columnMap Z k))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.horizontal_hole_subset
statement:
lemma horizontal_hole_subset {α : Type*} {m D : ℕ}
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ))
    (Z : Fin D → (Fin m → ℝ)) (K : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ))
    (J : α → Set (Fin m → ℝ)) (y : Fin D → ℝ)
    (s : Finset ((Fin D → ℝ) × α))
    (hraw : ∀ l ∈ s, l.1 ∈ N)
    (hsection : ∀ l ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ J l.2, Fin.append j (y-M l.1) ∈ K) :
    horizontalHole L K (joinedLattice L N M Z) y ⊆
      ⋂ l ∈ s, Shear.translate ((latticeProjection L '' J l.2)ᶜ)
        (latticeProjection L (Shear.Pattern.linearShift Z l.1))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.joinedProjection_append
statement:
@[simp] lemma joinedProjection_append {m D : ℕ}
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology N] [IsZLattice ℝ N]
    (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ)) (Z : Fin D → (Fin m → ℝ))
    (x : Fin m → ℝ) (z : Fin D → ℝ) :
    joinedProjection L N M Z (Fin.append x (M z)) =
      Fin.append (latticeProjection L (x-columnMap Z z)) (latticeProjection N z)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.joinedProjection_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma joinedProjection_eq_zero_iff {m D : ℕ}
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology N] [IsZLattice ℝ N]
    (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ)) (Z : Fin D → (Fin m → ℝ))
    (x : Fin (m+D) → ℝ) : joinedProjection L N M Z x = 0 ↔ x ∈ joinedLattice L N M Z

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.joinedProjection_surjective
statement:
lemma joinedProjection_surjective {m D : ℕ}
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology N] [IsZLattice ℝ N]
    (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ)) (Z : Fin D → (Fin m → ℝ)) :

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.joined_covolume
statement:
lemma joined_covolume {m D : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ))
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [DiscreteTopology N]
    [IsZLattice ℝ L] [IsZLattice ℝ N]
    (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ)) (Z : Fin D → (Fin m → ℝ)) :
    ZLattice.covolume (joinedLattice L N M Z) =
      ZLattice.covolume L * ZLattice.covolume (image N M)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.joined_point_mem
statement:
lemma joined_point_mem {m D : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ))
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ))
    (Z : Fin D → (Fin m → ℝ)) {h : Fin m → ℝ} {l : Fin D → ℝ}
    (hh : h ∈ L) (hl : l ∈ N) :
    Fin.append (h+columnMap Z l) (M l) ∈ joinedLattice L N M Z

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.productProjection_append
statement:
@[simp] lemma productProjection_append {m D : ℕ}
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology N] [IsZLattice ℝ N]
    (x : Fin m → ℝ) (z : Fin D → ℝ) :
    productProjection L N (Fin.append x z) =
      Fin.append (latticeProjection L x) (latticeProjection N z)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.productProjection_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma productProjection_apply {m D : ℕ}
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology N] [IsZLattice ℝ N]
    (x : Fin (m+D) → ℝ) : productProjection L N x =
      Fin.append (latticeProjection L (fun j => x (Fin.castAdd D j)))
        (latticeProjection N (fun j => x (Fin.natAdd m j)))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.productProjection_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma productProjection_eq_zero_iff {m D : ℕ}
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology N] [IsZLattice ℝ N]

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.productProjection_surjective
statement:
lemma productProjection_surjective {m D : ℕ}

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.exponential_pattern_bound
statement:
lemma exponential_pattern_bound {α : Type*} {q : ℕ}
    (s : Finset ((Fin q → ℝ) × α)) (hs : SourcePattern s)
    (u : α → ℝ) (L A : ℝ) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hA : A ≤ ∑ l ∈ s, u l.2) :
    ENNReal.ofReal L^(s.card-1) * (∏ l ∈ s, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-u l.2/2))) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((2^q : ℕ)*Real.log L-A/2))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.finite_weight_load_bounds
statement:
lemma finite_weight_load_bounds {A : Type*} (s : Finset A) (w u : A → ℝ)
    (κ ρ c C ε : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hweight : κ ≤ ∑ x ∈ s, w x)
    (hlo : ∀ x ∈ s, c*ρ*w x ≤ u x)
    (hup : ∀ x ∈ s, u x ≤ C*ρ*w x)
    (hcap : ∀ x ∈ s, w x ≤ ε) :
    c*κ*ρ ≤ ∑ x ∈ s, u x ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, u x ≤ C*ρ*ε

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.retain_source_pattern
statement:
lemma retain_source_pattern {α : Type*} {q : ℕ}
    (s : Finset ((Fin q → ℝ) × α)) (hs : SourcePattern s)
    (u : α → ℝ) (τ A : ℝ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hload : A+(2^q : ℕ)*τ ≤ ∑ l ∈ s, u l.2) :
    ∃ t : Finset ((Fin q → ℝ) × α), t ⊆ s ∧ SourcePattern t ∧
      (∀ l ∈ t, τ ≤ u l.2) ∧ A ≤ ∑ l ∈ t, u l.2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Shear.retained_load
statement:
lemma retained_load {A : Type*} (s : Finset A) (u : A → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    (∑ x ∈ s, u x) - (s.card : ℝ)*τ ≤ ∑ x ∈ s.filter (fun x => τ ≤ u x), u x

statement:
lemma labelPattern_mem_all {α : Type*} {D : ℕ}

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.mem_labelPattern
statement:
lemma mem_labelPattern {α : Type*} {D : ℕ} (P : Finset (Fin D → ℝ))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.retained_mem_all
statement:
lemma retained_mem_all {α : Type*} {D : ℕ}
    (A : ℕ → Finset ℝ) (labels : Finset α)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.section_labeled_retained
statement:
theorem section_labeled_retained {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {m D : ℕ}
    (P : Finset (Fin D → ℝ)) (hP : P.Nonempty) (hPb : SuffixBinary P)
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) (hraw : ∀ l ∈ P, l ∈ N)
    (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ)) (y : Fin D → ℝ)
    (K : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ)) (J : α → Set (Fin m → ℝ))
    (u : α → ℝ) (w : (Fin D → ℝ) → ℝ) (κ ρ c C ε τ A : ℝ)
    (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hweight : κ ≤ ∑ l ∈ P, w l) (hcap : ∀ l ∈ P, w l ≤ ε)
    (hsection : ∀ l ∈ P, ∃ a : α,
      (∀ j ∈ J a, Fin.append j (y-M l) ∈ K) ∧ c*ρ*w l ≤ u a ∧ u a ≤ C*ρ*w l)
    (hload : A+(2^D : ℕ)*τ ≤ c*κ*ρ)
    (alphabet : ℕ → Finset ℝ) (halph : ∀ l ∈ P, ∀ j : Fin D, l j ∈ alphabet j.val) :
    ∃ s : Finset ((Fin D → ℝ) × α),
      s ∈ Shear.allPatterns alphabet (Finset.univ.filter (fun a => τ ≤ u a ∧ u a ≤ C*ρ*ε)) D ∧
      (∀ l ∈ s, l.1 ∈ N) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ J l.2, Fin.append j (y-M l.1) ∈ K) ∧
      A ≤ ∑ l ∈ s, u l.2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.suffix_card_le
statement:
lemma suffix_card_le {D : ℕ} (P : Finset (Fin D → ℝ)) (hPb : SuffixBinary P) :

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.sum_labelPattern
statement:
lemma sum_labelPattern {α : Type*} {D : ℕ} (P : Finset (Fin D → ℝ))

    ∑ l ∈ labelPattern P a, f l = ∑ l ∈ P, f (l,a l)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.finite_patterns_to_cover
statement:
theorem finite_patterns_to_cover {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {m D : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ m+D)
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology N] [IsZLattice ℝ N]
    (hints : ∀ k : Fin D → ℤ, (fun j => (k j : ℝ)) ∈ N)
    (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ))
    (K : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ)) (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (J : α → Set (Fin m → ℝ)) (hJ : ∀ a, IsCompact (J a))
    (u : α → ℝ) (labels : Finset α)
    (hhole : ∀ a ∈ labels, torusMeasure m ((latticeProjection L '' J a)ᶜ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-u a/2)))
    (alphabet : ℕ → Finset ℝ) (Lstar A : ℝ) (hLstar : 1 ≤ Lstar)
    (hcost : ((∑ q ∈ Finset.range (D+1),
      (allPatterns alphabet labels q).card : ℕ) : ℝ) < Lstar)
    (herror : Real.exp ((2^D : ℕ)*Real.log Lstar-A/2) ≤ 1/((m+D : ℕ) : ℝ)^(2*(m+D)))
    (hpatterns : ∀ z : Fin D → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ z j ∧ z j < 1) →
      ∃ s : Finset ((Fin D → ℝ) × α), s ∈ allPatterns alphabet labels D ∧
        (∀ l ∈ s, l.1 ∈ N) ∧
        (∀ l ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ J l.2, Fin.append j (M z-M l.1) ∈ K) ∧
        A ≤ ∑ l ∈ s, u l.2) :
    ∃ (Λ : Submodule ℤ (Fin (m+D) → ℝ)) (_ : DiscreteTopology Λ),
      IsZLattice ℝ Λ ∧ K+(Λ : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ)) = Set.univ ∧
      (volume K).toReal / ZLattice.covolume Λ ≤
        Real.exp 1*((volume K).toReal /
          (ZLattice.covolume L*ZLattice.covolume (image N M)))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.joined_holes_to_cover
statement:
theorem joined_holes_to_cover {m D : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ m+D)
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology N] [IsZLattice ℝ N]
    (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ)) (Z : Fin D → (Fin m → ℝ))
    (K : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ)) (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hhole : ∀ y, torusMeasure m (horizontalHole L K (joinedLattice L N M Z) y) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (1/((m+D : ℕ) : ℝ)^(2*(m+D)))) :
    ∃ (Λ : Submodule ℤ (Fin (m+D) → ℝ)) (_ : DiscreteTopology Λ),
      IsZLattice ℝ Λ ∧ K+(Λ : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ)) = Set.univ ∧
      (volume K).toReal / ZLattice.covolume Λ ≤
        Real.exp 1*((volume K).toReal /
          (ZLattice.covolume L*ZLattice.covolume (image N M)))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.quotient_hole_bound
statement:
theorem quotient_hole_bound {m D : ℕ}
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology N] [IsZLattice ℝ N]
    (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ)) (Z : Fin D → (Fin m → ℝ))
    (K : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ)) (hK : IsCompact K) (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hhole : ∀ y, torusMeasure m (horizontalHole L K (joinedLattice L N M Z) y) ≤ ε) :
    torusMeasure (m+D) ((joinedProjection L N M Z '' K)ᶜ) ≤ ε

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.CoverGeometry.quotient_real_hole_bound
statement:
lemma quotient_real_hole_bound {m D : ℕ}
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (N : Submodule ℤ (Fin D → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology N] [IsZLattice ℝ N]
    (M : (Fin D → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin D → ℝ)) (Z : Fin D → (Fin m → ℝ))
    (K : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ)) (hK : IsCompact K) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hhole : ∀ y, torusMeasure m (horizontalHole L K (joinedLattice L N M Z) y) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε) :
    1-(torusMeasure (m+D)).real (joinedProjection L N M Z '' K) ≤ ε

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.affineEquiv_eq_linear_add
statement:
lemma affineEquiv_eq_linear_add {n : ℕ}
    (e : (Fin n → ℝ) ≃ᵃ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : e x=e.linear x+e 0

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.affine_image_cover
statement:
lemma affine_image_cover {n : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin n → ℝ))
    (e : (Fin n → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) (t : Fin n → ℝ)
    (K : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) (hcover : K+(L : Set (Fin n → ℝ))=Set.univ) :
    (fun x => e x+t) '' K+(image L e : Set (Fin n → ℝ))=Set.univ

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.affine_image_density
statement:
lemma affine_image_density {n : ℕ} (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin n → ℝ))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (e : (Fin n → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)) (t : Fin n → ℝ)
    (K : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (volume ((fun x => e x+t) '' K)).toReal / ZLattice.covolume (image L e) =
      (volume K).toReal / ZLattice.covolume L

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.affine_image_volume
statement:
lemma affine_image_volume {n : ℕ} (e : (Fin n → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ))
    (t : Fin n → ℝ) (K : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    volume ((fun x => e x+t) '' K) = ENNReal.ofReal |LinearMap.det e.toLinearMap| * volume K

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.LatticeGeometry.pull_back_cover
statement:
lemma pull_back_cover {n : ℕ} (e : (Fin n → ℝ) ≃ᵃ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ))
    (K : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin n → ℝ))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (hcover : e '' K+(L : Set (Fin n → ℝ))=Set.univ) {d : ℝ}
    (hd : (volume (e '' K)).toReal/ZLattice.covolume L ≤ d) :
    ∃ (Λ : Submodule ℤ (Fin n → ℝ)) (_ : DiscreteTopology Λ), IsZLattice ℝ Λ ∧
      K+(Λ : Set (Fin n → ℝ))=Set.univ ∧ (volume K).toReal/ZLattice.covolume Λ ≤ d

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sections.ball_finite_net
statement:
lemma ball_finite_net {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [IsAddHaarMeasure μ] {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ∃ S : Finset E, (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (3*(m : ℝ)^2)^(finrank ℝ E) ∧
      (∀ a ∈ S, ‖a‖ ≤ R) ∧
      ∀ y : E, ‖y‖ ≤ R → ∃ a ∈ S, dist y a ≤ R/(m : ℝ)^2

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.labeled_chain_to_cover
statement:
theorem labeled_chain_to_cover {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {B : Block} (c : Chain B)
    {m : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ m+c.fullDim)
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (K : Set (Fin (m+c.fullDim) → ℝ)) (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hV : 0 < (volume K).toReal)
    (J : α → Set (Fin m → ℝ)) (hJ : ∀ a, IsCompact (J a))
    (κ ρ csec Csec ε τ A Lstar : ℝ)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hc : 0 ≤ csec) (hC : 0 ≤ Csec) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hcov : ZLattice.covolume L volume=(volume K).toReal/(ρ*c.det))
    (hpat : ∀ y : c.FullVec, ∃ P : Finset c.FullVec,
      P.Nonempty ∧ SuffixBinary P ∧
      (∀ l ∈ P, l ∈ c.fullRaw ∧ c.FullResidual y l ∧
        c.det*gamma (y-c.fullLinear l) ≤ ε) ∧
      κ ≤ ∑ l ∈ P, c.det*gamma (y-c.fullLinear l))
    (hsection : ∀ v : c.FullVec, (∑ j, (v j)^2) ≤ c.radiusSq+(B.terminalDim : ℝ) →
      ∃ a : α, (∀ j ∈ J a, Fin.append j v ∈ K) ∧
        csec*(volume K).toReal*gamma v ≤ (volume (J a)).toReal ∧
        (volume (J a)).toReal ≤ Csec*(volume K).toReal*gamma v)
    (hhole : ∀ a, τ ≤ (volume (J a)).toReal/ZLattice.covolume L volume →
      (volume (J a)).toReal/ZLattice.covolume L volume ≤ Csec*ρ*ε →
      torusMeasure m ((latticeProjection L '' J a)ᶜ) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-((volume (J a)).toReal/ZLattice.covolume L volume)/2)))
    (hload : A+(2^c.fullDim : ℕ)*τ ≤ csec*κ*ρ)
    (hLstar : 1 ≤ Lstar)
    (hcost : ((∑ q ∈ Finset.range (c.fullDim+1),
      (allPatterns c.alphabetSeq
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun a => τ ≤ (volume (J a)).toReal/ZLattice.covolume L volume ∧
          (volume (J a)).toReal/ZLattice.covolume L volume ≤ Csec*ρ*ε)) q).card : ℕ) : ℝ) < Lstar)
    (herror : Real.exp ((2^c.fullDim : ℕ)*Real.log Lstar-A/2) ≤
      1/((m+c.fullDim : ℕ) : ℝ)^(2*(m+c.fullDim))) :
    ∃ (Λ : Submodule ℤ (Fin (m+c.fullDim) → ℝ)) (_ : DiscreteTopology Λ),
      IsZLattice ℝ Λ ∧ K+(Λ : Set (Fin (m+c.fullDim) → ℝ)) = Set.univ ∧
      (volume K).toReal / ZLattice.covolume Λ volume ≤ Real.exp 1*ρ

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Vertical.prepared_chain_to_cover
statement:
theorem prepared_chain_to_cover {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {B : Block} (c : Chain B)
    {m : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ m+c.fullDim)
    (L : Submodule ℤ (Fin m → ℝ)) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (K : Set (Fin (m+c.fullDim) → ℝ)) (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (J : α → Set (Fin m → ℝ)) (hJ : ∀ a, IsCompact (J a)) (u : α → ℝ)
    (κ ρ csec Csec ε τ A Lstar : ℝ)
    (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hc : 0 ≤ csec) (hC : 0 ≤ Csec) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hpat : ∀ y : c.FullVec, ∃ P : Finset c.FullVec,
      P.Nonempty ∧ SuffixBinary P ∧
      (∀ l ∈ P, l ∈ c.fullRaw ∧ c.FullResidual y l ∧
        c.det*gamma (y-c.fullLinear l) ≤ ε) ∧
      κ ≤ ∑ l ∈ P, c.det*gamma (y-c.fullLinear l))
    (hsection : ∀ v : c.FullVec, (∑ j, (v j)^2) ≤ c.radiusSq+(B.terminalDim : ℝ) →
      ∃ a : α, (∀ j ∈ J a, Fin.append j v ∈ K) ∧
        csec*ρ*(c.det*gamma v) ≤ u a ∧ u a ≤ Csec*ρ*(c.det*gamma v))
    (hhole : ∀ a, τ ≤ u a → u a ≤ Csec*ρ*ε →
      torusMeasure m ((latticeProjection L '' J a)ᶜ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-u a/2)))
    (hload : A+(2^c.fullDim : ℕ)*τ ≤ csec*κ*ρ)
    (hLstar : 1 ≤ Lstar)
    (hcost : ((∑ q ∈ Finset.range (c.fullDim+1),
      (allPatterns c.alphabetSeq
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun a => τ ≤ u a ∧ u a ≤ Csec*ρ*ε)) q).card : ℕ) : ℝ) < Lstar)
    (herror : Real.exp ((2^c.fullDim : ℕ)*Real.log Lstar-A/2) ≤
      1/((m+c.fullDim : ℕ) : ℝ)^(2*(m+c.fullDim))) :
    ∃ (Λ : Submodule ℤ (Fin (m+c.fullDim) → ℝ)) (_ : DiscreteTopology Λ),
      IsZLattice ℝ Λ ∧ K+(Λ : Set (Fin (m+c.fullDim) → ℝ)) = Set.univ ∧
      (volume K).toReal / ZLattice.covolume Λ ≤
        Real.exp 1*((volume K).toReal /(ZLattice.covolume L*c.det))

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sections.canonical_marginal_lower
statement:
theorem canonical_marginal_lower [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F]
    (μ : Measure E) [OuterRegular μ] (ν : Measure F) [IsOpenPosMeasure ν]
    {K : Set (E × F)} (hK : IsCompact K) {g : F → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Continuous g)
    {S : ℝ} (hae : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ‖y‖ < S → g y ≤ μ (fiber K y)) :
    ∀ y : F, ‖y‖ < S → g y ≤ μ (fiber K y)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sections.centered_affine_image
statement:
theorem centered_affine_image {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (b : Basis (Fin D) ℝ F) (hunit : ∀ i, ‖b i‖ ≤ 1)
    (hcoord : ∀ y : F, ∀ i, |b.repr y i| ≤ ‖y‖)
    (μ : Measure E) [IsAddHaarMeasure μ] (ν : Measure F) [IsAddHaarMeasure ν]
    {K : Set (E × F)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hproj : ∀ v : F, ‖v‖ ≤ 6*(D : ℝ)*R → ∃ x : E, (x,v) ∈ K) :
    ∃ e : (E × F) ≃ᵃ[ℝ] (E × F), IsCompact (e '' K) ∧ Convex ℝ (e '' K) ∧
      (μ.prod ν) (e '' K)=(μ.prod ν) K ∧
      (∀ y, μ (fiber (e '' K) y)=μ (fiber K y)) ∧
      (∀ y : F, ‖y‖ ≤ 2*R → (0,y) ∈ e '' K)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sections.coordinate_marginal_to_labels
statement:
theorem coordinate_marginal_to_labels {m D : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hD : 0 < D)
    {K : Set (Fin (m+D) → ℝ)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    (hV : 0 < (volume K).toReal) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hsmall : R^2/(m : ℝ)^2 ≤ 1)
    (hlower : ∀ y : Fin D → ℝ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ ≤ 6*(D : ℝ)*R →
      (volume K).toReal*Folded.gamma y/2 ≤ (volume (coordinateFiber K y)).toReal) :
    ∃ e : (Fin (m+D) → ℝ) ≃ᵃ[ℝ] (Fin (m+D) → ℝ),
      IsCompact (e '' K) ∧ Convex ℝ (e '' K) ∧ volume (e '' K)=volume K ∧
      ∃ S : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D)), (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (3*(m : ℝ)^2)^D ∧
        ∃ J : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin D) → Set (Fin m → ℝ),
          (∀ a ∈ S, IsCompact (J a) ∧ Convex ℝ (J a) ∧ (interior (J a)).Nonempty) ∧
          ∀ y : Fin D → ℝ, (∑ j, (y j)^2) ≤ R^2 → ∃ a ∈ S,
            (∀ x ∈ J a, Fin.append x y ∈ e '' K) ∧
            (Real.exp (-1)/8)*(volume (e '' K)).toReal*Folded.gamma y ≤ (volume (J a)).toReal ∧
            (volume (J a)).toReal ≤ (Real.exp 1/8)*(volume (e '' K)).toReal*Folded.gamma y

lemma eventually_fiber_subset {E : Type*} {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {K : Set (E × F)} (hK : IsCompact K)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sections.fiber_sectionShear_measure
statement:
lemma fiber_sectionShear_measure {E : Type*} {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F] (μ : Measure E) [IsAddHaarMeasure μ]
    (T : F →ᵃ[ℝ] E) (K : Set (E × F)) (y : F) :
    μ (fiber (sectionShear T '' K) y)=μ (fiber K y)

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sections.finite_section_labels
statement:
theorem finite_section_labels
    (μ : Measure E) [IsAddHaarMeasure μ] (ν : Measure F) [IsAddHaarMeasure ν]
    {K : Set (E × F)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    {R V : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hV : 0 < V) (hm : 2 ≤ finrank ℝ E)
    (hcenter : ∀ z : F, ‖z‖ ≤ 2*R → (0,z) ∈ K)
    (hlower : ∀ y : F, ‖y‖ ≤ R → V*gaussian F y/2 ≤ (μ (fiber K y)).toReal)
    (hsmall : R^2/(finrank ℝ E : ℝ)^2 ≤ 1) :
    ∃ S : Finset F, (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (3*(finrank ℝ E : ℝ)^2)^(finrank ℝ F) ∧
      ∃ J : F → Set E, (∀ a ∈ S, IsCompact (J a) ∧ Convex ℝ (J a) ∧ (0 : E) ∈ J a ∧
        (μ (J a)).toReal=V*gaussian F a/8) ∧
      ∀ y : F, ‖y‖ ≤ R → ∃ a ∈ S, J a ⊆ fiber K y ∧
        (Real.exp (-1)/8)*V*gaussian F y ≤ (μ (J a)).toReal ∧
          (μ (J a)).toReal ≤ (Real.exp 1/8)*V*gaussian F y

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sections.gaussian_marginal_to_sections
statement:
theorem gaussian_marginal_to_sections {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (b : Basis (Fin D) ℝ F) (hunit : ∀ i, ‖b i‖ ≤ 1)
    (hcoord : ∀ y : F, ∀ i, |b.repr y i| ≤ ‖y‖)
    (μ : Measure E) [IsAddHaarMeasure μ] (ν : Measure F) [IsAddHaarMeasure ν]
    {K : Set (E × F)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hconv : Convex ℝ K)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hV : 0 < ((μ.prod ν) K).toReal)
    (hm : 2 ≤ finrank ℝ E)
    (hlower : ∀ y : F, ‖y‖ ≤ 6*(D : ℝ)*R →
      ((μ.prod ν) K).toReal*gaussian F y/2 ≤ (μ (fiber K y)).toReal)
    (hsmall : R^2/(finrank ℝ E : ℝ)^2 ≤ 1) :
    ∃ e : (E × F) ≃ᵃ[ℝ] (E × F), IsCompact (e '' K) ∧ Convex ℝ (e '' K) ∧
      (μ.prod ν) (e '' K)=(μ.prod ν) K ∧
      ∃ S : Finset F, (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (3*(finrank ℝ E : ℝ)^2)^D ∧
        ∃ J : F → Set E,
          (∀ a ∈ S, IsCompact (J a) ∧ Convex ℝ (J a) ∧ (interior (J a)).Nonempty) ∧
          ∀ y : F, ‖y‖ ≤ R → ∃ a ∈ S, J a ⊆ fiber (e '' K) y ∧
            (Real.exp (-1)/8)*((μ.prod ν) (e '' K)).toReal*gaussian F y ≤ (μ (J a)).toReal ∧
            (μ (J a)).toReal ≤ (Real.exp 1/8)*((μ.prod ν) (e '' K)).toReal*gaussian F y

name: OAI.SingleLatticeCovering.Sections.gaussian_near
statement:
lemma gaussian_near {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F] {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {a y : F} (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ R) (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ R)
    (hya : dist y a ≤ R/(m : ℝ)^2) (hsmall : R^2/(m : ℝ)^2 ≤ 1) :
    Real.exp (-1)*gaussian F y ≤ gaussian F a ∧
      gaussian F a ≤ Real.exp 1*gaussian F y

name: OAI.WeakPinned.Bounded.conditional_integral_eq
statement:
lemma conditional_integral_eq
    (R : Measure Ω) (Q : Measure E) (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure R] [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (e : Ω → E) (z : Ω → X) (w : Ω → Y)
    (he : Measurable e) (hz : Measurable z) (hw : Measurable w)
    (hmz : R.map (fun r => (e r,z r))=Q.prod μ)
    (hmw : R.map (fun r => (e r,w r))=Q.prod ν)

    (heq : ∀ᵐ r ∂ R,f (e r,z r)=g (e r,w r)) :

statement:
lemma mixture_pair_test_bound (w : I → ℝ) (p : I → V → ℝ) (F : I → V → ℝ)
    (g h : V → ℝ) (A₁ A₂ C H₁ H₂ : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i,0≤w i) (hp : ∀ i x,0≤p i x) (hpsum : ∀ i,∑ x,p i x=1)
    (hC : 0≤C) (hF : ∀ i x,|F i x|≤C) (hh : ∀ x,|h x|≤H₂)
    (hA₁ : |A₁|≤H₁) :
    |(∑ r,tripleWeight w p r*(F r.1 r.2.1*g r.2.2.1*h r.2.2.2))-
      (∑ r,edgeWeight w p r*F r.1 r.2)*A₁*A₂|≤
      C*(H₂*(∑ i,w i*|(∑ z,p i z*g z)-A₁|)+H₁*(∑ i,w i*|(∑ z,p i z*h z)-A₂|))

      ContinuousMap.const Time v + h • primitive
        (SmoothPaths.applyField
          (SmoothPaths.superpose (hVs.continuous_fderiv (by simp)) (trajectory hV h hh x))
          (tangentPath hV h hh x v))

name: OAI.SmoothODE.trajectory_eq
statement:
theorem trajectory_eq {V : E → E} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : LipschitzWith K V)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : ‖h‖₊ * K < 1) (x : E) :
    picard hV.continuous h x (trajectory hV h hh x) = trajectory hV h hh x

name: OAI.SmoothODE.contDiff_homeomorph_pow
statement:
theorem contDiff_homeomorph_pow (f : E ≃ₜ E) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f : E → E))
    (n : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ((f ^ n : E ≃ₜ E) : E → E)

name: OAI.SmoothODE.continuous_variation
statement:
theorem continuous_variation {V : E → E} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : LipschitzWith K V)
    (hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (h : ℝ) (hh : ‖h‖₊ * K < 1) (x v : E) :
    Continuous (variation hV h hh x v)

name: OAI.SmoothODE.curve_linear_component
statement:
theorem curve_linear_component {F : Type u10} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {V : E → E} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : LipschitzWith K V)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : ‖h‖₊ * K < 1) (L : E →L[ℝ] F) (v : F)
    (hL : ∀ z, L (V z) = v) (x : E) (t : Time) :
    L (curve hV h hh x t) = L x + (t : ℝ) • h • v

name: OAI.SmoothODE.exists_transport
statement:
theorem exists_transport {V : E → E} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : LipschitzWith K V)
    (hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) {B : E → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    (hB : Differentiable ℝ B)
    (hInv : ∀ z a b, fderiv ℝ B z (V z) a b + B z (fderiv ℝ V z a) b +
      B z a (fderiv ℝ V z b) = 0)
    {F : Type u13} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (L : E →L[ℝ] F) (v : F) (hL : ∀ x, L (V x) = v) (T : ℝ) :
    ∃ f : E ≃ₜ E, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f : E → E) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f.symm : E → E) ∧
      (∀ x a b, B (f x) (fderiv ℝ (f : E → E) x a) (fderiv ℝ (f : E → E) x b) = B x a b) ∧
      (∀ x, L (f x) = L x + T • v)

name: OAI.SmoothODE.homeomorph_pow_linear_component
statement:
theorem homeomorph_pow_linear_component {F : Type u12} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (f : E ≃ₜ E) (L : E →L[ℝ] F) (v : F) (hL : ∀ x, L (f x) = L x + v)
    (n : ℕ) (x : E) : L ((f ^ n) x) = L x + n • v

name: OAI.SmoothODE.homeomorph_pow_preserves_tensor
statement:
theorem homeomorph_pow_preserves_tensor (f : E ≃ₜ E)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f : E → E))
    {B : E → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ x a b, B (f x) (fderiv ℝ (f : E → E) x a)
      (fderiv ℝ (f : E → E) x b) = B x a b) (n : ℕ) (x a b : E) :
    B ((f ^ n) x) (fderiv ℝ ((f ^ n : E ≃ₜ E) : E → E) x a)
      (fderiv ℝ ((f ^ n : E ≃ₜ E) : E → E) x b) = B x a b

name: OAI.SmoothODE.step_linear_component
statement:
@[simp] theorem step_linear_component {F : Type u11} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {V : E → E} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : LipschitzWith K V)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : ‖h‖₊ * K < 1) (L : E →L[ℝ] F) (v : F)
    (hL : ∀ z, L (V z) = v) (x : E) :
    L (step hV h hh x) = L x + h • v

name: OAI.SmoothODE.step_preserves_tensor
statement:
theorem step_preserves_tensor {V : E → E} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : LipschitzWith K V)
    (hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (h : ℝ) (hh : ‖h‖₊ * K < 1)
    {B : E → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hB : Differentiable ℝ B)
    (hInv : ∀ z a b, fderiv ℝ B z (V z) a b +
      B z (fderiv ℝ V z a) b + B z a (fderiv ℝ V z b) = 0) (x a b : E) :
    B (step hV h hh x) (fderiv ℝ (step hV h hh) x a)
      (fderiv ℝ (step hV h hh) x b) = B x a b

name: OAI.SmoothODE.tangentPath_one
statement:
theorem tangentPath_one {V : E → E} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : LipschitzWith K V)
    (hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (h : ℝ) (hh : ‖h‖₊ * K < 1) (x v : E) :
    tangentPath hV h hh x v ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ = fderiv ℝ (step hV h hh) x v

name: OAI.SmoothODE.variation_coe
statement:
theorem variation_coe {V : E → E} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : LipschitzWith K V)
    (hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (h : ℝ) (hh : ‖h‖₊ * K < 1) (x v : E) (t : Time) :
    variation hV h hh x v t = tangentPath hV h hh x v t

name: OAI.SmoothODE.variation_one
statement:
theorem variation_one {V : E → E} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : LipschitzWith K V)
    (hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (h : ℝ) (hh : ‖h‖₊ * K < 1) (x v : E) :
    variation hV h hh x v 1 = fderiv ℝ (step hV h hh) x v

name: OAI.SmoothODE.variation_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem variation_zero {V : E → E} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : LipschitzWith K V)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : ‖h‖₊ * K < 1) (x v : E) : variation hV h hh x v 0 = v

name: OAI.SmoothODE.curve_injective
statement:
theorem curve_injective {V : E → E} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : LipschitzWith K V)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : ‖h‖₊ * K < 1) (t : Time) :
    Function.Injective (fun x => curve hV h hh x t)

name: OAI.SmoothODE.curve_of_const_along
statement:
theorem curve_of_const_along {V : E → E} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : LipschitzWith K V)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : ‖h‖₊ * K < 1) (x v : E)
    (hc : ∀ t : Time, V (x + (t : ℝ) • h • v) = v) :
    EqOn (curve hV h hh x) (fun t => x + t • h • v) (Icc 0 1)

name: OAI.SmoothODE.curve_spaceTime_mapsTo
statement:
theorem curve_spaceTime_mapsTo {V : ℝ × E → ℝ × E} {K : ℝ≥0}
    (hV : LipschitzWith K V) (h : ℝ) (hh : ‖h‖₊ * K < 1)
    {U : Set E} (hTime : ∀ z, (V z).1 = 1)
    (hOut : ∀ z, z.2 ∉ U → (V z).2 = 0) (x : ℝ × E) (hx : x.2 ∈ U) (t : Time) :
    (curve hV h hh x t).2 ∈ U

name: OAI.SmoothODE.curve_spaceTime_outside
statement:
theorem curve_spaceTime_outside {V : ℝ × E → ℝ × E} {K : ℝ≥0}
    (hV : LipschitzWith K V) (h : ℝ) (hh : ‖h‖₊ * K < 1)
    {U : Set E} (hTime : ∀ z, (V z).1 = 1)
    (hOut : ∀ z, z.2 ∉ U → (V z).2 = 0) (x : ℝ × E) (hx : x.2 ∉ U) (t : Time) :
    curve hV h hh x t = (x.1 + (t : ℝ) * h, x.2)

name: OAI.SmoothODE.exists_spaceTime_transport
statement:
theorem exists_spaceTime_transport {V : ℝ × E → ℝ × E} {K : ℝ≥0}
    (hV : LipschitzWith K V) (hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) {U : Set E}
    (hTime : ∀ z, (V z).1 = 1) (hOut : ∀ z, z.2 ∉ U → (V z).2 = 0)
    {B : (ℝ × E) → (ℝ × E) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E) →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ z, z.2 ∈ U → DifferentiableAt ℝ B z)
    (hInv : ∀ z, z.2 ∈ U → ∀ a b, fderiv ℝ B z (V z) a b +
      B z (fderiv ℝ V z a) b + B z a (fderiv ℝ V z b) = 0) (T : ℝ) :
    ∃ f : (ℝ × E) ≃ₜ (ℝ × E),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f : (ℝ × E) → (ℝ × E)) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f.symm : (ℝ × E) → (ℝ × E)) ∧
      (∀ x, (f x).1 = x.1 + T) ∧
      (∀ x, x.2 ∉ U → (f x).2 = x.2) ∧
      (∀ x, x.2 ∈ U → (f x).2 ∈ U ∧ ∀ a b,
        B (f x) (fderiv ℝ (f : (ℝ × E) → (ℝ × E)) x a)
          (fderiv ℝ (f : (ℝ × E) → (ℝ × E)) x b) = B x a b)

name: OAI.SmoothODE.homeomorph_pow_preserves_tensor_on
statement:
theorem homeomorph_pow_preserves_tensor_on (f : E ≃ₜ E)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f : E → E)) {U : Set E} (hU : MapsTo f U U)
    {B : E → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ a b, B (f x) (fderiv ℝ (f : E → E) x a)
      (fderiv ℝ (f : E → E) x b) = B x a b) (n : ℕ) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    (f ^ n) x ∈ U ∧ ∀ a b,
      B ((f ^ n) x) (fderiv ℝ ((f ^ n : E ≃ₜ E) : E → E) x a)
        (fderiv ℝ ((f ^ n : E ≃ₜ E) : E → E) x b) = B x a b

name: OAI.SmoothODE.step_preserves_tensor_on
statement:
theorem step_preserves_tensor_on {V : E → E} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : LipschitzWith K V)
    (hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (h : ℝ) (hh : ‖h‖₊ * K < 1)
    {B : E → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hB : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ B z)
    (hInv : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ a b, fderiv ℝ B z (V z) a b +
      B z (fderiv ℝ V z a) b + B z a (fderiv ℝ V z b) = 0) (x : E) (hpath : ∀ t : Time, curve hV h hh x t ∈ U) (a b : E) :
    B (step hV h hh x) (fderiv ℝ (step hV h hh) x a)
      (fderiv ℝ (step hV h hh) x b) = B x a b

statement:
theorem exists_lipschitz_spaceTimeField
    {A : (ℝ × E) → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    {γ : E → E →L[ℝ] ℝ} {ρ : ℝ → ℝ} {U : Set E}
    (hA : ∀ z, z.2 ∈ U → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A z)
    (hi : ∀ z, z.2 ∈ U → (A z).IsInvertible)
    (hγ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ γ) (hρ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ρ) (hs : tsupport γ ⊆ U)
    (hcγ : HasCompactSupport γ) (hcρ : HasCompactSupport ρ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith K (fun z => ((1 : ℝ), spatialField A γ ρ z))

name: OAI.Moser.extendedOneForm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendedOneForm_apply (γ : E → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (β : ℝ → ℝ)
    (z a : ℝ × E) : extendedOneForm γ β z a = β z.1 * γ z.2 a.2

name: OAI.Moser.fderiv_extendedOneForm
statement:
theorem fderiv_extendedOneForm {γ : E → E →L[ℝ] ℝ} {β : ℝ → ℝ} {z : ℝ × E}
    (hγ : DifferentiableAt ℝ γ z.2) (hβ : DifferentiableAt ℝ β z.1)
    (a b : ℝ × E) :
    fderiv ℝ (extendedOneForm γ β) z a b =
      deriv β z.1 * a.1 * γ z.2 b.2 + β z.1 * fderiv ℝ γ z.2 a.2 b.2

name: OAI.Moser.hasCompactSupport_spatialField
statement:
theorem hasCompactSupport_spatialField
    (A : (ℝ × E) → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    {γ : E → E →L[ℝ] ℝ} {ρ : ℝ → ℝ}

statement:
theorem oneForm_spatialField {A : (ℝ × E) → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    (γ : E → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ × E)
    (hA : (A z).IsInvertible) (hsk : ∀ a b, A z a b = -A z b a) :
    γ z.2 (spatialField A γ ρ z) = 0

name: OAI.Moser.spaceTimeTensor_apply
statement:
theorem spaceTimeTensor_apply {W : E → TwoTensor E} {γ : E → E →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    {β : ℝ → ℝ} {z : ℝ × E} (hγ : DifferentiableAt ℝ γ z.2)
    (hβ : DifferentiableAt ℝ β z.1) (a b : ℝ × E) :
    spaceTimeTensor W γ β z a b = spatialTensor W γ β z a.2 b.2 +
      deriv β z.1 * (a.1 * γ z.2 b.2 - b.1 * γ z.2 a.2)

name: OAI.Moser.spaceTimeTensor_kernel
statement:
theorem spaceTimeTensor_kernel {W : E → TwoTensor E} {γ : E → E →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    {β : ℝ → ℝ} {z : ℝ × E} (hγ : DifferentiableAt ℝ γ z.2)
    (hβ : DifferentiableAt ℝ β z.1)
    (hi : (spatialTensor W γ β z).IsInvertible)
    (hsk : ∀ a b, W z.2 a b = -W z.2 b a) :
    spaceTimeTensor W γ β z (1, spatialField (spatialTensor W γ β) γ (deriv β) z) = 0

name: OAI.Moser.spaceTimeTensor_skew

OAI.ComplexPotential.ddc_logNormSq_complex_line
statement:
theorem ddc_logNormSq_complex_line (J : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hsk : ∀ a b, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) a (J b) = -inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (J a) b)
    (hJ : ∀ a, ‖J a‖ = ‖a‖) (hJJ : ∀ a, J (J a) = -a)
    (δ : ℝ) {x : E} (hx : ‖x‖^2 + δ ≠ 0) (a : E) :
    ddc J (logNormSq δ) x a (J a) = ‖a‖^2 / (‖x‖^2 + δ) -
      ((inner (𝕜 := ℝ) x a)^2 + (inner (𝕜 := ℝ) x (J a))^2) / (‖x‖^2 + δ)^2

name: OAI.ComplexPotential.ddc_scalar_comp
statement:
theorem ddc_scalar_comp (J : E →L[ℝ] E) {φ : E → ℝ} {h : ℝ → ℝ} {x : E}
    (hφ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ φ x) (hh : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ h (φ x)) (a b : E) :
    ddc J (h ∘ φ) x a b = deriv h (φ x) * ddc J φ x a b +
      deriv (deriv h) (φ x) *
        (fderiv ℝ φ x b * fderiv ℝ φ x (J a) -
          fderiv ℝ φ x a * fderiv ℝ φ x (J b)) / 4

name: OAI.ComplexPotential.ddc_scalar_comp_complex_line
statement:
theorem ddc_scalar_comp_complex_line (J : E →L[ℝ] E) (hJ : ∀ a, J (J a) = -a)
    {φ : E → ℝ} {h : ℝ → ℝ} {x : E}
    (hφ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ φ x) (hh : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ h (φ x)) (a : E) :
    ddc J (h ∘ φ) x a (J a) = deriv h (φ x) * ddc J φ x a (J a) +
      deriv (deriv h) (φ x) * ((fderiv ℝ φ x a)^2 + (fderiv ℝ φ x (J a))^2) / 4

name: OAI.ComplexPotential.exists_potential_transport
statement:
theorem exists_potential_transport (J : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hsk : ∀ a b, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) a (J b) = -inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (J a) b)
    (hJ : ∀ a, ‖J a‖ = ‖a‖)
    {U C : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hC : IsCompact C) (hCU : C ⊆ U)
    {τ T : E → ℝ} (hτ : ∀ x ∈ U, IsPSHAt J τ x) (hT : ∀ x ∈ U, IsPSHAt J T x)
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ U, x ∉ C → T x = τ x) :
    ∃ F : E ≃ₜ E, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F : E → E) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F.symm : E → E) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∉ U → F x = x) ∧ (∀ x, F x ∈ U ↔ x ∈ U) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ a b,
        ddc J (fun y => ‖y‖^2 + τ y) (F x) (fderiv ℝ (F : E → E) x a)
          (fderiv ℝ (F : E → E) x b) = ddc J (fun y => ‖y‖^2 + T y) x a b

theorem exteriorD_smul_one {γ : E → E →L[ℝ] ℝ} {s : E → ℝ} {x : E}

    exteriorD (fun y => s y • γ y) x a b = s x * exteriorD γ x a b +
      fderiv ℝ s x a * γ x b - fderiv ℝ s x b * γ x a

name: OAI.ComplexPotential.dc_comp
statement:
theorem dc_comp (J : E →L[ℝ] E) (K : F →L[ℝ] F) {f : E → F} {φ : F → ℝ} {x : E}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) (hφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ (f x))
    (hCR : ∀ a, fderiv ℝ f x (J a) = K (fderiv ℝ f x a)) :
    dc J (φ ∘ f) x = pullbackOneForm f (dc K φ) x

name: OAI.ComplexPotential.ddc_comp
statement:
theorem ddc_comp (J : E →L[ℝ] E) (K : F →L[ℝ] F) {f : E → F} {φ : F → ℝ} {x : E}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x) (hφ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ φ (f x))
    (hCR : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ a, fderiv ℝ f y (J a) = K (fderiv ℝ f y a)) (a b : E) :
    ddc J (φ ∘ f) x a b = ddc K φ (f x) (fderiv ℝ f x a) (fderiv ℝ f x b)

name: OAI.ComplexPotential.exists_ball_from_logarithmic_pole
statement:
theorem exists_ball_from_logarithmic_pole (J : E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hsk : ∀ a b, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) a (J b) = -inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (J a) b)
    (hJ : ∀ a, ‖J a‖ = ‖a‖) (hJJ : ∀ a, J (J a) = -a)
    {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hU0 : (0 : E) ∈ U)
    {τ H : E → ℝ} (hτ : ∀ x ∈ U, IsPSHAt J τ x) (hτ0 : τ 0 = 0)
    (hH : ∀ x ∈ U, x ≠ 0 → IsPSHAt J H x)
    (hcompact : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < 1 → IsCompact {x | x ∈ U ∧ τ x ≤ s})
    {s₀ α C ρ : ℝ} (hs₀ : s₀ < 1) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (htail : ∀ x ∈ U, s₀ ≤ τ x → H x = τ x)
    (hpole : ∀ x ∈ U, x ≠ 0 → ‖x‖ ≤ ρ → H x ≤ α * Real.log (‖x‖^2) + C)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (haα : a < α) :
    ∃ F : E ≃ₜ E, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F : E → E) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F.symm : E → E) ∧
      (∀ x : E, ‖x‖^2 < a → F x ∈ U) ∧
      ∀ x : E, ‖x‖^2 < a → ∀ v w : E,
        ddc J (fun y => ‖y‖^2 + τ y) (F x) (fderiv ℝ (F : E → E) x v)
          (fderiv ℝ (F : E → E) x w) = standardTensor J v w

statement:
theorem exists_inner_radius {μ α R : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) (hμα : μ < α)
    (hR : 0 < R) (M C : ℝ) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < R ∧ ∀ (t δ H : ℝ), 0 < t → t ≤ r^2 → 0 < δ →
      H ≤ α * Real.log t + C → H + 2 ≤ μ * Real.log (t + δ) - M

name: OAI.TensorCalculus.exteriorD_pullbackOneForm
statement:
theorem exteriorD_pullbackOneForm {f : E → F} {γ : F → F →L[ℝ] ℝ} {x : E}
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x) (hγ : DifferentiableAt ℝ γ (f x)) (a b : E) :
    exteriorD (pullbackOneForm f γ) x a b =
      exteriorD γ (f x) (fderiv ℝ f x a) (fderiv ℝ f x b)

name: OAI.TensorCalculus.fderiv_pullbackOneForm
statement:
theorem fderiv_pullbackOneForm {f : E → F} {γ : F → F →L[ℝ] ℝ} {x : E}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x)
    (hγ : DifferentiableAt ℝ γ (f x)) (a b : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (pullbackOneForm f γ) x a b =
      fderiv ℝ γ (f x) (fderiv ℝ f x a) (fderiv ℝ f x b) +
        γ (f x) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x a b)

name: OAI.TensorCalculus.pullbackOneForm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pullbackOneForm_apply (f : E → F) (γ : F → F →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x a : E) :
    pullbackOneForm f γ x a = γ (f x) (fderiv ℝ f x a)

name: OAI.ComplexPotential.exists_ball_from_holomorphic_zero
statement:
theorem exists_ball_from_holomorphic_zero {Ω : Set E} (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hΩ0 : (0 : E) ∈ Ω)
    {f : E → F} (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f Ω)
    (hfzero : ∀ x ∈ Ω, f x = 0 ↔ x = 0)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (ho : f =O[𝓝 (0 : E)] (fun x : E => ‖x‖^k))
    (hcompact : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < 1 → IsCompact {x | x ∈ Ω ∧ ‖f x‖^2 ≤ s})
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hak : a < (k : ℝ)) :
    let : InnerProductSpace ℝ E := InnerProductSpace.complexToReal
    ∃ Q : E ≃ₜ E, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Q : E → E) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Q.symm : E → E) ∧
      (∀ x : E, ‖x‖^2 < a → Q x ∈ Ω ∧ ‖f (Q x)‖^2 < 1) ∧
      ∀ x : E, ‖x‖^2 < a → ∀ v w : E,
        ddc (complexStructure E) (fun y => ‖y‖^2 + ‖f y‖^2) (Q x)
          (fderiv ℝ (Q : E → E) x v) (fderiv ℝ (Q : E → E) x w) =
            standardTensor (complexStructure E) v w

name: OAI.PolarStrips.norm_coefficient
statement:

      (k : ℝ)^2*PlanarLens.density k w

name: OAI.PolarStrips.phase_form_formula
statement:
theorem phase_form_formula (b : κ → R ι) (k : ℕ) {z : C ι}
    (hz : z ∈ domain (fun j => functional (b j))) (v w : C ι) :
    phaseForm (fderiv ℝ (phase b k) z v) (fderiv ℝ (phase b k) z w) =
      phaseForm (parts v) (parts w) + ∑ j,
        (k : ℝ)^2*PlanarLens.density k (functional (b j) z) *
          ((functional (b j) v).re*(functional (b j) w).im -
            (functional (b j) w).re*(functional (b j) v).im)

name: OAI.PolarStrips.phase_pullback
statement:
theorem phase_pullback (b : κ → R ι) (k : ℕ) {z : C ι}
    (hz : z ∈ domain (fun j => functional (b j))) (v w : C ι) :
    let : InnerProductSpace ℝ (C ι) := InnerProductSpace.complexToReal
    phaseForm (fderiv ℝ (phase b k) z v) (fderiv ℝ (phase b k) z w) =
      ddc (complexStructure (C ι)) (fun x => ‖x‖^2 + ‖tuple (fun j => functional (b j)) k x‖^2) z v w

statement:
