    {e : F} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) {ρ ε : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hfixed : ∀ (y : E) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → s < ε → η (y, s • e) = (y, s • e)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (degreeMap η e ρ)

name: OAI.SmoothLinking.degreeMap_eq_self
statement:
theorem degreeMap_eq_self {η : E × F → E × F} {e : F} (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) {z : E × ℝ} (hz : 0 < z.2+ρ)
    (hη : η (z.1, (z.2+ρ) • e) = (z.1, (z.2+ρ) • e)) :
    degreeMap η e ρ z = z

name: OAI.SmoothLinking.degreeMap_identity_outside
statement:
theorem degreeMap_identity_outside {η : E × F → E × F} {e : F} (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    {ρ R : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hfixed : ∀ (y : E) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → R ≤ ‖(y,s)‖ → η (y, s • e) = (y, s • e))
    (z : E × ℝ) (hz : R+ρ ≤ ‖z‖) : degreeMap η e ρ z = z

name: OAI.SmoothLinking.norm_translate_le
statement:
theorem norm_translate_le (z : E × ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) :
    ‖z‖ ≤ ‖(z.1, z.2+ρ)‖ + ρ

name: OAI.SmoothLinking.sphere_linking
statement:
theorem sphere_linking [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {η : E × F → E × F} (hη : ContDiff ℝ ∞ η) {e : F} (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    {ρ ε R : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hR : ρ < R)
    (hnear : ∀ (y : E) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → s < ε → η (y, s • e) = (y, s • e))
    (hfar : ∀ (y : E) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → R ≤ ‖(y,s)‖ → η (y, s • e) = (y, s • e)) :
    ∃ (y : E) (s : ℝ), 0 < s ∧ ‖(y,s)‖ < R ∧ (η (y, s • e)).1 = 0 ∧ ‖(η (y, s • e)).2‖ = ρ

name: OAI.FiniteLinking.exists_critical
statement:
theorem exists_critical (l : H ≃L[ℝ] E × F) {Φ : H → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ)
    {e : F} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) {a b ρ ε R : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hba : a ≤ b) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hR : ρ < R)
    (hpos : ∀ z : F, ‖z‖ = ρ → 2*a ≤ Φ (l.symm (0,z)))
    (hnear : ∀ (y : E) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → s < ε → Φ (l.symm (y,s • e)) ≤ a/2)
    (hfar : ∀ (y : E) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → R ≤ ‖(y,s)‖ → Φ (l.symm (y,s • e)) ≤ a/2)
    (hupper : ∀ (y : E) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ‖(y,s)‖ < R → Φ (l.symm (y,s • e)) ≤ b)
    (hcoercive : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x, C ≤ ‖x‖ → 1 ≤ ‖gradient Φ x‖) :
    ∃ x : H, a ≤ Φ x ∧ Φ x ≤ b ∧ gradient Φ x = 0

name: OAI.GradientDescent.contDiff_field
statement:
theorem contDiff_field {Φ σ : E → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ) (hσ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ σ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (field Φ σ ε)

name: OAI.GradientDescent.contDiff_gradient
statement:
theorem contDiff_gradient {Φ : E → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (gradient Φ)

name: OAI.GradientDescent.denom_pos
statement:
theorem denom_pos (Φ : E → ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (x : E) :
    0 < ‖gradient Φ x‖^2+ε^2

name: OAI.GradientDescent.energyCutoff_contDiff
statement:
theorem energyCutoff_contDiff {Φ : E → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ) (a : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (energyCutoff Φ a)

name: OAI.GradientDescent.energyCutoff_mem
statement:
theorem energyCutoff_mem (Φ : E → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (x : E) :
    energyCutoff Φ a x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

name: OAI.GradientDescent.energyCutoff_one
statement:
theorem energyCutoff_one (Φ : E → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {x : E} (hx : a ≤ Φ x) :
    energyCutoff Φ a x = 1

name: OAI.GradientDescent.energyCutoff_zero
statement:
theorem energyCutoff_zero (Φ : E → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {x : E} (hx : Φ x ≤ a/2) :
    energyCutoff Φ a x = 0

name: OAI.GradientDescent.exists_cutoff_field
statement:
theorem exists_cutoff_field {Φ : E → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ)
    {a b ε M : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hε : 0 < ε) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgrad : ∀ x, a ≤ Φ x → Φ x ≤ b → ε ≤ ‖gradient Φ x‖) :
    ∃ (V : E → E) (K : ℝ≥0), ContDiff ℝ ∞ V ∧ LipschitzWith K V ∧
      (∀ x, ‖V x‖ ≤ 1/ε) ∧ (∀ x, fderiv ℝ Φ x (V x) ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ x, Φ x ≤ a/2 → V x = 0) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ M → a ≤ Φ x → Φ x ≤ b → fderiv ℝ Φ x (V x) ≤ -1)

name: OAI.GradientDescent.exists_uniform_gradient_lower
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_gradient_lower {Φ : E → ℝ} (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ)
    {a b : ℝ} (hnocrit : ∀ x, a ≤ Φ x → Φ x ≤ b → gradient Φ x ≠ 0)
    (hcoercive : ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ x, R ≤ ‖x‖ → 1 ≤ ‖gradient Φ x‖) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x, a ≤ Φ x → Φ x ≤ b → ε ≤ ‖gradient Φ x‖

name: OAI.GradientDescent.field_decrease
statement:
theorem field_decrease (Φ : E → ℝ) {σ : E → ℝ} {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    {x : E} (hσ : σ x = 1) (hx : ε ≤ ‖gradient Φ x‖) :
    fderiv ℝ Φ x (field Φ σ ε x) ≤ -1

name: OAI.GradientDescent.field_eq_zero
statement:
theorem field_eq_zero {Φ σ : E → ℝ} {ε : ℝ} {x : E} (hσ : σ x = 0) :
    field Φ σ ε x = 0

name: OAI.GradientDescent.field_hasCompactSupport
statement:
theorem field_hasCompactSupport {Φ σ : E → ℝ} (hσ : HasCompactSupport σ) (ε : ℝ) :
    HasCompactSupport (field Φ σ ε)

name: OAI.GradientDescent.field_nonincrease
statement:
theorem field_nonincrease (Φ : E → ℝ) {σ : E → ℝ} (hσ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ σ x)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (x : E) : fderiv ℝ Φ x (field Φ σ ε x) ≤ 0

name: OAI.GradientDescent.field_norm_le
statement:
theorem field_norm_le (Φ : E → ℝ) {σ : E → ℝ} (hσ : ∀ x, σ x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (x : E) : ‖field Φ σ ε x‖ ≤ 1/ε

name: OAI.GradientDescent.field_rate
statement:
theorem field_rate (Φ σ : E → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (x : E) :
    fderiv ℝ Φ x (field Φ σ ε x) = -(2*σ x/(‖gradient Φ x‖^2+ε^2))*‖gradient Φ x‖^2

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.coe_integral_norm_fourth
statement:
theorem coe_integral_norm_fourth {ι : Type u95} [Fintype ι] (k : ι → ℤ) (a : ι → ℂ) :
    (((∫ t : Time, ‖eval k a t‖^4 ∂μ) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ∑ p : ι × ι, ∑ q : ι × ι,
        if k p.1+k p.2 = k q.1+k q.2 then conj (a p.1*a p.2)*(a q.1*a q.2) else 0

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.continuous_eval
statement:
theorem continuous_eval {ι : Type u90} [Fintype ι] (k : ι → ℤ) (a : ι → ℂ) :
    Continuous (eval k a)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.integrable_continuous
statement:
theorem integrable_continuous {G : Type u91} [NormedAddCommGroup G]
    {f : Time → G} (hf : Continuous f) : Integrable f μ

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.integral_conj_eval_mul
statement:
theorem integral_conj_eval_mul {ι : Type u92} {κ : Type u93} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (k : ι → ℤ) (l : κ → ℤ) (a : ι → ℂ) (b : κ → ℂ) :
    (∫ t : Time, conj (eval k a t) * eval l b t ∂μ) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, if k i = l j then conj (a i) * b j else 0

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.integral_conj_fourier_mul
statement:
theorem integral_conj_fourier_mul (k l : ℤ) :
    (∫ t : Time, conj (fourier k t) * fourier l t ∂μ) = if k = l then 1 else 0

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.integral_fourier
statement:
theorem integral_fourier (k : ℤ) :
    (∫ t : Time, fourier k t ∂μ) = if k = 0 then 1 else 0

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.integral_norm_fourth_le_pairs
statement:
theorem integral_norm_fourth_le_pairs {ι : Type u98} [Fintype ι] (k : ι → ℤ) (a : ι → ℂ) :
    (∫ t : Time, ‖eval k a t‖^4 ∂μ) ≤
      ∑ p : ι × ι, ∑ q : ι × ι,
        if k p.1+k p.2 = k q.1+k q.2 then
          (‖a p.1‖*‖a p.2‖)*(‖a q.1‖*‖a q.2‖) else 0

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.integral_norm_sq
statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq {ι : Type u94} [Fintype ι] (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k)
    (a : ι → ℂ) : (∫ t : Time, ‖eval k a t‖^2 ∂μ) = ∑ i, ‖a i‖^2

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.norm_sq_re
statement: theorem norm_sq_re (z : ℂ) : ‖z‖^2 = (conj z*z).re

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.positive_L4
statement:
theorem positive_L4 {ι : Type u99} [Fintype ι] (k : ι → ℕ)
    (hk : Function.Injective k) (hk0 : ∀ i, 0 < k i) (a : ι → ℂ) :
    (∫ t : Time, ‖eval (fun i => (k i : ℤ)) a t‖^4 ∂μ) ≤
      (∑ i, (k i : ℝ)*‖a i‖^2)^2

name: OAI.WeightedSchur.reciprocal_pair_rows
statement:
theorem reciprocal_pair_rows {ι : Type u97} [Fintype ι] (k : ι → ℕ)
    (hk : Function.Injective k) (hk0 : ∀ i, 0 < k i) (p : ι × ι) :
    (∑ q : ι × ι, if k p.1+k p.2 = k q.1+k q.2 then
      1 / ((k q.1 : ℝ)*(k q.2 : ℝ)) else 0) ≤ 1

name: OAI.WeightedSchur.sum_le
statement:
theorem sum_le {ι : Type u96} [Fintype ι] (r : ι → ι → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    (hr : ∀ {i j}, r i j → r j i) (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (x : ι → ℝ)
    {C : ℝ} (hrow : ∀ i, (∑ j, if r i j then 1/w j else 0) ≤ C) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, if r i j then x i*x j else 0) ≤ C * ∑ i, w i*x i^2

name: OAI.WeightedSchur.two_mul_le_weighted
statement:
theorem two_mul_le_weighted {w v : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (hv : 0 < v) (x y : ℝ) :
    2*x*y ≤ w*x^2/v + v*y^2/w

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.average_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem average_apply (f : C(Time, ℝ)) : average f = ∫ t : Time, f t ∂μ

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.contDiff_gradient_function

theorem contDiff_potential (k : ι → ℤ) {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) :

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.fourierCoeff_eval
statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_eval (k : ι → ℤ) (a : ι → ℂ) (j : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeff (eval k a) j = ∑ i, if j = k i then a i else 0

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.gradient_potential
OAI.FourierPolynomial.hasGradientAt_potential
OAI.FourierPolynomial.integral_fourier_mul_conj
statement:
theorem integral_fourier_mul_conj (k : ℤ) (f : C(Time, ℂ)) :
    (∫ t : Time, conj (f t) * fourier k t ∂μ) = conj (fourierCoeff f k)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.integral_inner_loop
statement:
theorem integral_inner_loop (k : ι → ℤ) (f : C(Time, Vector κ)) (a : Coeff ι κ) :
    (∫ t : Time, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (f t) (loop k a t) ∂μ) =
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (project k f) a

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.integral_loop_coord_sq
statement:
theorem integral_loop_coord_sq (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k)
    (a : Coeff ι κ) (j : κ) :
    (∫ t : Time, ‖loop k a t j‖^2 ∂μ) = ∑ i, ‖a (i,j)‖^2

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.integral_loop_norm_fourth_le
statement:
theorem integral_loop_norm_fourth_le (k : ι → ℕ)
    (hk : Function.Injective k) (hk0 : ∀ i, 0 < k i) (a : Coeff ι κ) :
    (∫ t : Time, ‖loop (fun i => (k i : ℤ)) a t‖^4 ∂μ) ≤
      (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) * (∑ p : ι × κ, (k p.1 : ℝ)*‖a p‖^2)^2

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.integral_loop_norm_sq
statement:
theorem integral_loop_norm_sq (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k) (a : Coeff ι κ) :
    (∫ t : Time, ‖loop k a t‖^2 ∂μ) = ‖a‖^2

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.loopCLM_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem loopCLM_apply (k : ι → ℤ) (a : Coeff ι κ) : loopCLM k a = loop k a

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.loop_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem loop_apply (k : ι → ℤ) (a : Coeff ι κ) (t : Time) :
    loop k a t = ∑ i, fourier (k i) t • mode a i

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.loop_coord
statement:
theorem loop_coord (k : ι → ℤ) (a : Coeff ι κ) (t : Time) (j : κ) :
    loop k a t j = eval k (fun i => a (i,j)) t

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.mode_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem mode_apply (a : Coeff ι κ) (i : ι) (j : κ) : mode a i j = a (i,j)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.project_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem project_apply (k : ι → ℤ) (f : C(Time, Vector κ)) (p : ι × κ) :
    project k f p = fourierCoeff (fun t => f t p.2) (k p.1)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.project_bessel
statement:
theorem project_bessel (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k) (f : C(Time, Vector κ)) :
    ‖project k f‖^2 ≤ ∫ t : Time, ‖f t‖^2 ∂μ

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.project_bounded
statement:
theorem project_bounded (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k)
    (f : C(Time, Vector κ)) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hf : ∀ t, ‖f t‖ ≤ B) :
    ‖project k f‖ ≤ B

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.project_loop
statement:
theorem project_loop (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k) (a : Coeff ι κ) :
    project k (loop k a) = a

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.vector_norm_fourth_le
statement:
theorem vector_norm_fourth_le (z : Vector κ) :
    ‖z‖^4 ≤ (Fintype.card κ : ℝ) * ∑ j, ‖z j‖^4

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.contDiff_energy
statement: theorem contDiff_energy (w : α → ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (energy w)

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.diagCLM_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem diagCLM_apply (w : α → ℝ) (a : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) : diagCLM w a = diag w a

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.diag_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem diag_apply (w : α → ℝ) (a : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) (p : α) :
    diag w a p = w p • a p

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.energy_eq_inner
statement:
theorem energy_eq_inner (w : α → ℝ) (a : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) :
    energy w a = inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (diag w a) a

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.energy_lower
statement:
theorem energy_lower (w : α → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (hw : ∀ p, d ≤ w p)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) : d*‖a‖^2 ≤ energy w a

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.energy_mul
statement:
theorem energy_mul (w : α → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (a : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) :
    energy (fun p => r*w p) a = r*energy w a

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.energy_nonpos
statement:
theorem energy_nonpos (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ p, w p ≤ 0)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) : energy w a ≤ 0

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.energy_single
statement:
theorem energy_single [DecidableEq α] (w : α → ℝ) (p : α) (z : ℂ) :
    energy w (PiLp.single 2 p z) = w p * ‖z‖^2

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.energy_smul
statement:
theorem energy_smul (w : α → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (a : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) :
    energy w (r • a) = r^2*energy w a

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.gradient_energy
statement:
theorem gradient_energy (w : α → ℝ) (a : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) :
    gradient (energy w) a = (2 : ℝ) • diag w a

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.hasGradientAt_energy
statement:
theorem hasGradientAt_energy (w : α → ℝ) (a : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) :
    HasGradientAt (energy w) ((2 : ℝ) • diag w a) a

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.inner_diag
statement:
theorem inner_diag (w : α → ℝ) (a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) :
    inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (diag w a) b = ∑ p, w p * inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (a p) (b p)

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.norm_diag_lower
statement:
theorem norm_diag_lower (w : α → ℝ) {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hw : ∀ p, d ≤ |w p|)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) : d*‖a‖ ≤ ‖diag w a‖

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.norm_diag_sq
statement:
theorem norm_diag_sq (w : α → ℝ) (a : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) :
    ‖diag w a‖^2 = ∑ p, (w p)^2*‖a p‖^2

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.norm_diag_upper
statement:
theorem norm_diag_upper (w : α → ℝ) {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hw : ∀ p, |w p| ≤ d)
    (a : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) : ‖diag w a‖ ≤ d*‖a‖

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.real_inner_eq_sum
statement:
theorem real_inner_eq_sum (a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) :
    inner (𝕜 := ℝ) a b = ∑ p, inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (a p) (b p)

name: OAI.DiagonalQuadratic.self_adjoint
statement:
theorem self_adjoint (w : α → ℝ) (a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ α) :
    inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (diag w a) b = inner (𝕜 := ℝ) a (diag w b)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.contDiff_action
statement:
theorem contDiff_action (k : ι → ℤ) {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (action k H)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.critical_norm_bound
statement:
theorem critical_norm_bound (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k)
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (d : κ → ℝ) {γ B : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hgap : ∀ i j, γ ≤ |Real.pi*(k i : ℝ)-d j|)
    (hrem : ∀ z, ‖gradient H z-(2 : ℝ) • diag d z‖ ≤ B) (a : Coeff ι κ)
    (ha : gradient (action k H) a = 0) : ‖a‖ ≤ B/(2*γ)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.gradient_action
statement:
theorem gradient_action (k : ι → ℤ) {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H)
    (a : Coeff ι κ) : gradient (action k H) a =
      (2 : ℝ) • diag (fun p => Real.pi*(k p.1 : ℝ)) a - project k (gradLoop k hH a)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.gradient_action_remainder
statement:
theorem gradient_action_remainder (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k)
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (d : κ → ℝ) (a : Coeff ι κ) :
    gradient (action k H) a =
      (2 : ℝ) • diag (fun p => Real.pi*(k p.1 : ℝ)-d p.2) a-project k (remainderLoop k hH d a)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.gradient_coercive
statement:
theorem gradient_coercive (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k)
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (d : κ → ℝ) {γ B : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hgap : ∀ i j, γ ≤ |Real.pi*(k i : ℝ)-d j|)
    (hrem : ∀ z, ‖gradient H z-(2 : ℝ) • diag d z‖ ≤ B) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ a : Coeff ι κ, C ≤ ‖a‖ → 1 ≤ ‖gradient (action k H) a‖

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.hasGradientAt_action
statement:
theorem hasGradientAt_action (k : ι → ℤ) {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H)
    (a : Coeff ι κ) :
    HasGradientAt (action k H)
      ((2 : ℝ) • diag (fun p => Real.pi*(k p.1 : ℝ)) a - project k (gradLoop k hH a)) a

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.integral_energy
statement:
theorem integral_energy (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k) (d : κ → ℝ)
    (a : Coeff ι κ) :
    (∫ t : Time, energy d (loop k a t) ∂μ) = energy (fun p => d p.2) a

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.loop_diag
statement:
theorem loop_diag (k : ι → ℤ) (d : κ → ℝ) (a : Coeff ι κ) (t : Time) :
    loop k (diag (fun p => d p.2) a) t = diag d (loop k a t)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.loop_smul
statement:
theorem loop_smul (k : ι → ℤ) (r : ℝ) (a : Coeff ι κ) :
    loop k (r • a) = r • loop k a

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.loop_zero
statement: theorem loop_zero (k : ι → ℤ) : loop k (0 : Coeff ι κ) = 0

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.norm_gradient_lower
statement:
theorem norm_gradient_lower (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k)
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (d : κ → ℝ) {γ B : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hgap : ∀ i j, γ ≤ |Real.pi*(k i : ℝ)-d j|)
    (hrem : ∀ z, ‖gradient H z-(2 : ℝ) • diag d z‖ ≤ B) (a : Coeff ι κ) :
    2*γ*‖a‖ ≤ ‖gradient (action k H) a‖+B

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.potential_lower
OAI.FourierPolynomial.potential_nonneg
statement:
theorem potential_nonneg (k : ι → ℤ) {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ∀ z, 0 ≤ H z)
    (a : Coeff ι κ) : 0 ≤ potential k H a

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.potential_upper_fourth
statement:
theorem potential_upper_fourth (k : ι → ℕ) (hk : Function.Injective k)
    (hk0 : ∀ i, 0 < k i) {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : Continuous H)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hup : ∀ z, H z ≤ C*‖z‖^4) (a : Coeff ι κ) :
    potential (fun i => (k i : ℤ)) H a ≤
      C*(Fintype.card κ : ℝ)*(∑ p : ι × κ, (k p.1 : ℝ)*‖a p‖^2)^2

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.project_add
statement:
theorem project_add (k : ι → ℤ) (f g : C(Time, Vector κ)) :
    project k (f+g) = project k f + project k g

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.project_sub
statement:
theorem project_sub (k : ι → ℤ) (f g : C(Time, Vector κ)) :
    project k (f-g) = project k f - project k g

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.remainderLoop_apply
statement:
theorem remainderLoop_apply (k : ι → ℤ) {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H)
    (d : κ → ℝ) (a : Coeff ι κ) (t : Time) :
    remainderLoop k hH d a t = gradient H (loop k a t)-(2 : ℝ) • diag d (loop k a t)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.action_cone_far
statement:
theorem action_cone_far [DecidableEq ν] [DecidableEq κ]
    (k : ι → ℤ) (hk0 : ∀ i, k i ≤ 0) (l : ν → ℕ) (hl0 : ∀ i, 0 < l i)
    (hkl : Function.Injective (Sum.elim k (fun i => (l i : ℤ))))
    (i₀ : ν) (hl1 : l i₀ = 1) (j₀ : κ)
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : Continuous H) (d : κ → ℝ) (C η : ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ j, η ≤ d j) (hd0 : Real.pi+η ≤ d j₀)
    (hlo : ∀ z, energy d z-C ≤ H z) (a : Coeff ι κ) (s : ℝ) :
    action (Sum.elim k (fun i => (l i : ℤ))) H
      ((positiveScale l hl0).symm (a,s • PiLp.single 2 (i₀,j₀) (1 : ℂ))) ≤
      C-η*(‖a‖^2+s^2)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.action_cone_upper
statement:
theorem action_cone_upper [DecidableEq ν] [DecidableEq κ]
    (k : ι → ℤ) (hk0 : ∀ i, k i ≤ 0) (l : ν → ℕ) (hl0 : ∀ i, 0 < l i)
    (i₀ : ν) (hl1 : l i₀ = 1) (j₀ : κ)
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ∀ z, 0 ≤ H z) (a : Coeff ι κ) (s : ℝ) :
    action (Sum.elim k (fun i => (l i : ℤ))) H
      ((positiveScale l hl0).symm (a,s • PiLp.single 2 (i₀,j₀) (1 : ℂ))) ≤ Real.pi*s^2

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.action_positive_lower
statement:
theorem action_positive_lower (k : ι → ℤ) (l : ν → ℕ)
    (hl : Function.Injective l) (hl0 : ∀ i, 0 < l i)
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : Continuous H) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hup : ∀ z, H z ≤ C*‖z‖^4) (b : Coeff ν κ) :
    Real.pi*‖b‖^2-C*(Fintype.card κ : ℝ)*‖b‖^4 ≤
      action (Sum.elim k (fun i => (l i : ℤ))) H ((positiveScale l hl0).symm (0,b))

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.cone_scaled_single
statement:
theorem cone_scaled_single [DecidableEq ν] [DecidableEq κ]
    (l : ν → ℕ) (hl0 : ∀ i, 0 < l i) (i₀ : ν) (hl1 : l i₀ = 1) (j₀ : κ)
    (a : Coeff ι κ) (s : ℝ) :
    (positiveScale l hl0).symm (a,s • PiLp.single 2 (i₀,j₀) (1 : ℂ)) =
      joinCoeff a (s • PiLp.single 2 (i₀,j₀) (1 : ℂ))

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.contDiff_meanAction
statement:
theorem contDiff_meanAction {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (meanAction hH)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.critical_action_eq
OAI.FourierPolynomial.energy_joinCoeff
statement:
theorem energy_joinCoeff (w : (ι ⊕ ν) × κ → ℝ) (a : Coeff ι κ) (b : Coeff ν κ) :
    energy w (joinCoeff a b) = energy (fun p => w (Sum.inl p.1,p.2)) a +
      energy (fun p => w (Sum.inr p.1,p.2)) b

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.energy_scaled
statement:
theorem energy_scaled (k : ν → ℕ) (hk : ∀ i, 0 < k i) (b : Coeff ν κ) :
    energy (fun p => (k p.1 : ℝ))
      (diag (fun p => (Real.sqrt (k p.1 : ℝ))⁻¹) b) = ‖b‖^2

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.exists_link_epsilon
statement:
theorem exists_link_epsilon {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < ε → Real.pi*s^2 ≤ a/2

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.exists_link_far
statement:
theorem exists_link_far {ρ η : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hη : 0 < η) (C : ℝ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ρ < R ∧ ∀ u s : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → R ≤ max u |s| → C-η*(u^2+s^2) ≤ 0

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.finite_critical
statement:
theorem finite_critical [DecidableEq ν] [DecidableEq κ]
    (k : ι → ℤ) (hk0 : ∀ i, k i ≤ 0) (l : ν → ℕ)
    (hl : Function.Injective l) (hl0 : ∀ i, 0 < l i)
    (hkl : Function.Injective (Sum.elim k (fun i => (l i : ℤ))))
    (i₀ : ν) (hl1 : l i₀ = 1) (j₀ : κ)
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (hH0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ H z)
    (d₀ d : κ → ℝ) {C M η γ B : ℝ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hη : 0 < η) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hup : ∀ z, H z ≤ M*‖z‖^4)
    (hd : ∀ j, η ≤ d₀ j) (hd0 : Real.pi+η ≤ d₀ j₀)
    (hlo : ∀ z, energy d₀ z-C ≤ H z)
    (hgap : ∀ i j, γ ≤ |Real.pi*((Sum.elim k (fun i => (l i : ℤ)) i : ℤ) : ℝ)-d j|)
    (hrem : ∀ z, ‖gradient H z-(2 : ℝ) • diag d z‖ ≤ B) :
    ∃ x : Coeff (ι ⊕ ν) κ,
      linkLevel κ M ≤ action (Sum.elim k (fun i => (l i : ℤ))) H x ∧
      action (Sum.elim k (fun i => (l i : ℤ))) H x ≤ max C (linkLevel κ M) ∧
      gradient (action (Sum.elim k (fun i => (l i : ℤ))) H) x = 0

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.intervalIntegral_eq_average
statement:
theorem intervalIntegral_eq_average {E : Type u113} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (f : Time → E) : (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, f (t : Time)) = ∫ t : Time, f t ∂μ

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.joinCoeff_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem joinCoeff_inl (a : Coeff ι κ) (b : Coeff ν κ) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    joinCoeff a b (Sum.inl i,j) = a (i,j)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.joinCoeff_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem joinCoeff_inr (a : Coeff ι κ) (b : Coeff ν κ) (i : ν) (j : κ) :
    joinCoeff a b (Sum.inr i,j) = b (i,j)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.leftCoeff_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftCoeff_apply (a : Coeff (ι ⊕ ν) κ) (p : ι × κ) :
    leftCoeff a p = a (Sum.inl p.1,p.2)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.linkLevel_bound
statement:
theorem linkLevel_bound {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    2*linkLevel κ M ≤ Real.pi*(linkRadius κ M)^2-
      M*(Fintype.card κ : ℝ)*(linkRadius κ M)^4

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.linkLevel_pos
statement: theorem linkLevel_pos {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) : 0 < linkLevel κ M

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.linkRadius_pos
statement: theorem linkRadius_pos {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) : 0 < linkRadius κ M

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.linkRadius_sq
statement:
theorem linkRadius_sq {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    (linkRadius κ M)^2 = Real.pi/(2*(M*(Fintype.card κ : ℝ)+1))

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.loop_joinCoeff
statement:
theorem loop_joinCoeff (k : ι → ℤ) (l : ν → ℤ) (a : Coeff ι κ) (b : Coeff ν κ) :
    loop (Sum.elim k l) (joinCoeff a b) = loop k a + loop l b

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.mode_velocityCoeff
statement:
theorem mode_velocityCoeff (k : ι → ℤ) (a : Coeff ι κ) (i : ι) :
    mode (velocityCoeff k a) i = (2*(Real.pi : ℂ)*Complex.I*(k i : ℂ)) • mode a i

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.norm_joinCoeff_sq
statement:
theorem norm_joinCoeff_sq (a : Coeff ι κ) (b : Coeff ν κ) :
    ‖joinCoeff a b‖^2 = ‖a‖^2+‖b‖^2

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.norm_project_grad
statement:
theorem norm_project_grad (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k)
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (d : κ → ℝ) {B D : ℝ}
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hd : ∀ j, |d j| ≤ D)
    (hrem : ∀ z, ‖gradient H z-(2 : ℝ) • diag d z‖ ≤ B) (a : Coeff ι κ) :
    ‖project k (gradLoop k hH a)‖ ≤ B+2*D*‖a‖

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.norm_velocityCoeff_critical
OAI.FourierPolynomial.rightCoeff_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightCoeff_apply (a : Coeff (ι ⊕ ν) κ) (p : ν × κ) :
    rightCoeff a p = a (Sum.inr p.1,p.2)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.splitEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem splitEquiv_symm (d : ν → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0)
    (a : Coeff ι κ) (b : Coeff ν κ) :
    (splitEquiv d hd).symm (a,b) = joinCoeff a (diag (fun q => (d q.1)⁻¹) b)

name: OAI.L2Paths.exists_periodic_subsequence
statement:
theorem exists_periodic_subsequence [ProperSpace E] (u : ℕ → C(Time,E)) {D R : ℝ}
    (hmod : ∀ n (t s : Segment), dist (u n (t.val : Time)) (u n (s.val : Time))^2 ≤ D^2*dist t s)
    (hbound : ∀ n (t : Segment), ‖u n (t.val : Time)‖ ≤ R) :
    ∃ x : C(Time,E), ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (u ∘ φ) Filter.atTop (𝓝 x)

name: OAI.L2Paths.exists_subsequence
statement:
theorem exists_subsequence [ProperSpace E] (u : ℕ → C(Segment,E)) {D R : ℝ}
    (hmod : ∀ n (t s : Segment), dist (u n t) (u n s)^2 ≤ D^2*dist t s)
    (hbound : ∀ n (t : Segment), ‖u n t‖ ≤ R) :
    ∃ x : C(Segment,E), ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (u ∘ φ) Filter.atTop (𝓝 x)

name: OAI.L2Paths.integral_sq_le
statement:
theorem integral_sq_le (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ t in a..b, f t)^2 ≤ (b-a)*(∫ t in a..b, (f t)^2)

name: OAI.L2Paths.norm_bound
statement:
theorem norm_bound (x v : ℝ → E) (hv : Continuous v)
    (hd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt x (v t) t) {A D : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hxm : (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ‖x t‖^2) ≤ A^2)
    (hvm : (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ‖v t‖^2) ≤ D^2)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) : ‖x t‖ ≤ A+D

name: OAI.L2Paths.norm_sub_sq_le
statement:
theorem norm_sub_sq_le (x v : ℝ → E) (hv : Continuous v)
    (hd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt x (v t) t) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ‖x b-x a‖^2 ≤ (b-a)*(∫ t in a..b, ‖v t‖^2)

name: OAI.L2Paths.norm_sub_sq_le_global
statement:
theorem norm_sub_sq_le_global (x v : ℝ → E) (hv : Continuous v)
    (hd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt x (v t) t) {D : ℝ}
    (hD : (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ‖v t‖^2) ≤ D^2)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    ‖x b-x a‖^2 ≤ D^2*|b-a|

statement: @[simp] theorem coefficient_apply (n : ℤ) (f : C(Time,ℂ)) : coefficient n f = fourierCoeff f n

name: OAI.PeriodicFourier.coefficient_const
statement:
theorem coefficient_const (n : ℤ) (c : ℂ) :

statement:
theorem coefficient_eq_on (f : C(Time,ℂ)) (n : ℤ) :

statement:
theorem derivative_coefficient (v : C(Time,ℂ)) (hzero : coefficient 0 v = 0)
    {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (2*(Real.pi : ℂ)*Complex.I*(n : ℂ)) * coefficient n (periodicPrimitive v hzero) = coefficient n v

statement: theorem contDiff_gradPath {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (gradPath hH)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.coordPath_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem coordPath_apply (j : κ) (x : C(Time,Vector κ)) (t : Time) : coordPath j x t = x t j

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.critical_H1_bounds
statement:
theorem critical_H1_bounds (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k)
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (d : κ → ℝ) {γ B D : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hd : ∀ j, |d j| ≤ D)
    (hgap : ∀ i j, γ ≤ |Real.pi*(k i : ℝ)-d j|)
    (hrem : ∀ z, ‖gradient H z-(2 : ℝ) • diag d z‖ ≤ B) (a : Coeff ι κ)
    (ha : gradient (action k H) a = 0) :
    (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ‖loop k a (t : Time)‖^2) ≤ (B/(2*γ))^2 ∧
    (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ‖loop k (velocityCoeff k a) (t : Time)‖^2) ≤
      (B+2*D*(B/(2*γ)))^2

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.critical_coefficient
statement:
theorem critical_coefficient (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k)
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (a : Coeff ι κ)
    (ha : gradient (action k H) a = 0) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    PeriodicFourier.coefficient (k i) (coordPath j (gradPath hH (loop k a))) =
      (2*(Real.pi : ℂ)*(k i : ℂ))*PeriodicFourier.coefficient (k i) (coordPath j (loop k a))

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.critical_loop_bound
statement:
theorem critical_loop_bound (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k)
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (d : κ → ℝ) {γ B D : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hd : ∀ j, |d j| ≤ D)
    (hgap : ∀ i j, γ ≤ |Real.pi*(k i : ℝ)-d j|)
    (hrem : ∀ z, ‖gradient H z-(2 : ℝ) • diag d z‖ ≤ B) (a : Coeff ι κ)
    (ha : gradient (action k H) a = 0) (t : L2Paths.Segment) :
    ‖loop k a (t.val : Time)‖ ≤ B/(2*γ)+(B+2*D*(B/(2*γ)))

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.critical_modulus
statement:
theorem critical_modulus (k : ι → ℤ) (hk : Function.Injective k)
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (d : κ → ℝ) {γ B D : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hd : ∀ j, |d j| ≤ D)
    (hgap : ∀ i j, γ ≤ |Real.pi*(k i : ℝ)-d j|)
    (hrem : ∀ z, ‖gradient H z-(2 : ℝ) • diag d z‖ ≤ B) (a : Coeff ι κ)
    (ha : gradient (action k H) a = 0) (t s : L2Paths.Segment) :
    dist (loop k a (t.val : Time)) (loop k a (s.val : Time))^2 ≤
      (B+2*D*(B/(2*γ)))^2*dist t s

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.critical_subsequence
statement:
theorem critical_subsequence {α : ℕ → Type} [∀ n, Fintype (α n)]
    (k : (n : ℕ) → α n → ℤ) (hk : ∀ n, Function.Injective (k n))
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (d : κ → ℝ) {γ B D : ℝ}
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hd : ∀ j, |d j| ≤ D)
    (hgap : ∀ n i j, γ ≤ |Real.pi*(k n i : ℝ)-d j|)
    (hrem : ∀ z, ‖gradient H z-(2 : ℝ) • diag d z‖ ≤ B)
    (a : (n : ℕ) → Coeff (α n) κ) (ha : ∀ n, gradient (action (k n) H) (a n) = 0) :
    ∃ x : C(Time,Vector κ), ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => loop (k (φ n)) (a (φ n))) atTop (𝓝 x)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.limit_coefficient
statement:
theorem limit_coefficient {α : ℕ → Type} [∀ n, Fintype (α n)]
    (k : (n : ℕ) → α n → ℤ) (hk : ∀ n, Function.Injective (k n))
    (hex : ∀ m : ℤ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, m ∈ Set.range (k n))
    {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H)
    (a : (n : ℕ) → Coeff (α n) κ) (ha : ∀ n, gradient (action (k n) H) (a n) = 0)
    (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (hφ : StrictMono φ) (x : C(Time,Vector κ))
    (ht : Tendsto (fun n => loop (k (φ n)) (a (φ n))) atTop (𝓝 x)) (m : ℤ) (j : κ) :
    PeriodicFourier.coefficient m (coordPath j (gradPath hH x)) =
      (2*(Real.pi : ℂ)*(m : ℂ))*PeriodicFourier.coefficient m (coordPath j x)

name: OAI.FourierPolynomial.positive_action_limit
statement:
theorem positive_action_limit {α : ℕ → Type} [∀ n, Fintype (α n)]
    (k : (n : ℕ) → α n → ℤ) {H : Vector κ → ℝ} (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H)
    (a : (n : ℕ) → Coeff (α n) κ) (ha : ∀ n, gradient (action (k n) H) (a n) = 0)
    {L : ℝ} (hL : ∀ n, L ≤ action (k n) H (a n))
    (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (x : C(Time,Vector κ))
    (ht : Tendsto (fun n => loop (k (φ n)) (a (φ n))) atTop (𝓝 x)) :
    L ≤ meanAction hH x

    {m : ℝ} (hm : ∀ z, H₀ z ≤ m) (hH₀0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ H₀ z)
    (d : κ → ℝ) (hd : ∀ j, 0 ≤ d j) (hda : Real.pi < d j₀)
    (hdb : ∀ j, j ≠ j₀ → d j < Real.pi) (hda2 : d j₀ < 2*Real.pi)
    {T δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hmag : Real.pi*(T+δ) < m*d j₀)
    {U : Set (Vector κ)} (hU : ∀ z ∈ U, energy d z ≤ T)
    (he : ∀ z ∉ U, H₀ z = m)
    (hslow : ∀ x : ℝ → Vector κ, (∀ t, x t ∈ U) → x 1 = x 0 →
      (∀ t, HasDerivAt x (Complex.I • gradient (full H₀ d T δ) (x t)) t) → ∀ t, x t = x 0)
    {x : ℝ → Vector κ}

    (hRm : Real.pi*R < m) :
    ∃ b T δ : ℝ, 0 < b ∧ b ≤ Real.pi/4 ∧ 0 < δ ∧ 0 < T ∧
      Real.pi*(T+δ) < m*(3*Real.pi/2) ∧
      ∀ z : Vector κ, ‖z‖^2 ≤ M → ‖z j₀‖^2 ≤ R →
        energy (weights j₀ (3*Real.pi/2) b) z < T

    Real.pi+b ≤ weights j₀ (3*Real.pi/2) b j₀ ∧
    (∀ j, |weights j₀ (3*Real.pi/2) b j| ≤ 3*Real.pi/2) ∧
    (∀ j, j ≠ j₀ → weights j₀ (3*Real.pi/2) b j < Real.pi) ∧
    (∀ m : ℤ, ∀ j, b ≤ |Real.pi*(m:ℝ)-weights j₀ (3*Real.pi/2) b j|)

lemma energy_finset_sum_right {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {ι : Type uι} (s : Finset ι)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.energy_harmonic_right
statement:
lemma energy_harmonic_right {n d : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f : Space n → ℝ}
    {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (hp : p.IsHomogeneous d)
    (hΔp : laplacePolynomial p = 0) :
    energy f (polynomialFunction p) = eigenvalue n d *
      mean (fun u : Sphere n => f u * polynomialFunction p u)

lemma energy_sub_self {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f g : Space n → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) :
    energy (fun x => f x - g x) (fun x => f x - g x) =
      energy f f - 2 * energy f g + energy g g

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.polynomialRotation_twice
statement:
lemma polynomialRotation_twice {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) :
    polynomialRotation i j (polynomialRotation i j p) =
      X i ^ 2 * pderiv j (pderiv j p) + X j ^ 2 * pderiv i (pderiv i p) -
      X i * X j * pderiv j (pderiv i p) - X i * X j * pderiv i (pderiv j p) -
      X i * pderiv i p - X j * pderiv j p +
      (if i = j then 2 * (X i * pderiv i p) else 0)

statement:
lemma sum_polynomialRotation_homogeneous {n d : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hp : p.IsHomogeneous d) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, polynomialRotation i j (polynomialRotation i j p) =

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.sum_polynomialRotation_twice
statement:

      2 * (radiusPolynomial n * laplacePolynomial p) -
      2 * eulerPolynomial (eulerPolynomial p) -
      2 * ((n : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) - 2) * eulerPolynomial p

lemma seminorm_approximation {n : ℕ} (g : Seminorm ℝ (Space n)) :
    ∃ F R : ℕ → C(Sphere n, ℝ),
      (∀ j, F j = restrictContinuous (normSmooth g (shrinkingBump n j))
        (normSmooth_contDiff g _).continuous) ∧
      (∀ j u, R j u = fderiv ℝ (normSmooth g (shrinkingBump n j)) u u) ∧
      Tendsto F atTop (𝓝 (restrictContinuous g (seminorm_continuous n g))) ∧
      Tendsto R atTop (𝓝 (restrictContinuous g (seminorm_continuous n g)))

    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hc : ConvexOn ℝ univ f)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ 1 G) (hI : ContDiff ℝ 1 I)
    (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ I z) (hrel : ∀ z, deriv G z ^ 2 = b ^ 2 * deriv I z) :
    energy (G ∘ f) (G ∘ f) ≤ ((n : ℝ) - 1) * b ^ 2 *
      mean (fun u : Sphere n => I (f u) * fderiv ℝ f u u)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.continuous_W_comp
statement:
lemma continuous_W_comp {n : ℕ} (f : C(Sphere n, ℝ)) (hf : ∀ u, 0 < f u) :

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.continuous_e_comp
statement:
lemma continuous_e_comp {n : ℕ} (f : C(Sphere n, ℝ)) (hf : ∀ u, 0 < f u) :

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_D
statement:
lemma mean_D {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) [NeZero n] (f : C(Sphere n, ℝ)) :
    mean (fun u => D n (f u)) = mean (fun u => (f u)^exponent n) - 1 -
      mean (fun u => G n (f u))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_L
statement:
lemma mean_L {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) [NeZero n] (f : C(Sphere n, ℝ)) :
    mean (fun u => L n (f u)) = coefficient n *
      ((((n : ℝ)-1)*beta n^2 * mean (fun u => I n (f u)*f u) -
        2*n*mean (fun u => (G n (f u))^2))/(weight n*(2*n+8)) +
          mean (fun u => (D n (f u))^2)/(1-weight n))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_M_of_normalized
statement:
lemma mean_M_of_normalized {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (f : C(Sphere n, ℝ)) (hf : ∀ u, 0 < f u)
    (hnorm : mean (fun u => (f u)⁻¹ ^ n) = 1) :
    mean (fun u => M n (f u)) = mean (fun u => (f u) ^ exponent n) - 1

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_W_of_normalized
statement:
lemma mean_W_of_normalized {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (f : C(Sphere n, ℝ)) (hf : ∀ u, 0 < f u)
    (hnorm : mean (fun u => (f u)⁻¹ ^ n) = 1) :
    mean (fun u => W n (f u)) = mean (fun u => (f u)^exponent n) -
      mean (fun u => (f u)^(exponent n-1))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_add
statement:
lemma mean_add {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f g : Sphere n → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) :
    mean (fun u => f u + g u) = mean f + mean g

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_centered_square
statement:
lemma mean_centered_square {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (f : C(Sphere n, ℝ)) :
    mean (fun u => (f u - mean f) ^ 2) = variance f

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_const_mul
statement:
lemma mean_const_mul {n : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (f : Sphere n → ℝ) :
    mean (fun u => c * f u) = c * mean f

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_div_const
statement:
lemma mean_div_const {n : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (f : Sphere n → ℝ) :
    mean (fun u => f u / c) = mean f / c

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_e_zero
statement:
lemma mean_e_zero {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (f : C(Sphere n, ℝ)) (hf : ∀ u, 0 < f u)
    (hnorm : mean (fun u => (f u)⁻¹ ^ n) = 1) : mean (fun u => e n (f u)) = 0

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_first_power_ge_one
statement:
lemma mean_first_power_ge_one {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) [NeZero n]
    (f : C(Sphere n, ℝ)) (hf : ∀ u, 0 < f u)
    (hnorm : mean (fun u => (f u)⁻¹ ^ n) = 1) : 1 ≤ mean f

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_mono
statement:
lemma mean_mono {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f g : Sphere n → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g)
    (h : ∀ u, f u ≤ g u) : mean f ≤ mean g

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_mul_const
statement:
lemma mean_mul_const {n : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (f : Sphere n → ℝ) :
    mean (fun u => f u * c) = mean f * c

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_nonneg
statement: lemma mean_nonneg {n : ℕ} {f : Sphere n → ℝ} (h : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u) : 0 ≤ mean f

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_square_remainder
OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_sub
statement:
lemma mean_sub {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f g : Sphere n → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) :
    mean (fun u => f u - g u) = mean f - mean g

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.norm_Q_le_variance
statement:
lemma norm_Q_le_variance {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (f : C(Sphere n, ℝ)) :
    ‖Q n (toH n f)‖ ^ 2 ≤ variance f

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.norm_mean_ranges
statement:
lemma norm_mean_ranges {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) [NeZero n]
    (f : C(Sphere n, ℝ)) (hf : ∀ u, 0 < f u)
    (hnorm : mean (fun u => (f u)⁻¹ ^ n) = 1) :
    let m := mean (fun u => (f u) ^ exponent n) - 1
    let ell := mean (fun u => (f u) ^ (exponent n - 1)) - 1
    let t := mean (fun u => G n (f u))
    0 ≤ m ∧ 0 ≤ ell ∧ ell ≤ ((exponent n : ℝ) - 1) / exponent n * m ∧
      0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ beta n * m

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.scalar_correction
statement:
lemma scalar_correction {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) {m t : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 ≤ m) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (htb : t ≤ Scalar.beta n * m) :
    Scalar.coefficient n * ((2*n : ℝ) * t^2 / (Scalar.weight n * (2*n+8)) -
      (m-t)^2/(1-Scalar.weight n)) ≤
      (2*(Scalar.exponent n : ℝ)-1)/(Scalar.exponent n : ℝ)^2 * m^2

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.scalar_expectation
statement:
lemma scalar_expectation {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) [NeZero n]
    (f : C(Sphere n, ℝ)) (hf : ∀ u, 0 < f u) :
    mean (fun u => L n (f u)) ≤ 2*mean (fun u => W n (f u)) ∧
      (mean (fun u => L n (f u)) = 2*mean (fun u => W n (f u)) ↔ ∀ u, f u = 1)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.weighted_norm_bound
statement:
lemma weighted_norm_bound {E : Type uE} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (a b : E)
    {w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (hw1 : w < 1) :
    ‖a+b‖^2 ≤ ‖a‖^2/w + ‖b‖^2/(1-w)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.weighted_square_bound
statement:
lemma weighted_square_bound {a b w : ℝ} (hw : 0 < w) (hw1 : w < 1) :
    (a+b)^2 ≤ a^2/w + b^2/(1-w)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.abs_pow_contDiff_two
statement: lemma abs_pow_contDiff_two {r : ℕ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x : ℝ => |x|^r)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.abs_pow_posPower
statement:
lemma abs_pow_posPower {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (x : ℝ) :
    |x|^r = posPower r x + posPower r (-x)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.casimir_posPower_inner
statement:
lemma casimir_posPower_inner {n r : ℕ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) (u x : Sphere n) :
    casimir (fun y => posPower r ⟪(u : Space n),y⟫) x =
      (r : ℝ)*((r : ℝ)-1)*posPower (r-2) ⟪(u : Space n),(x : Space n)⟫ -
      eigenvalue n r*posPower r ⟪(u : Space n),(x : Space n)⟫

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.casimir_scalar_inner
statement:
lemma casimir_scalar_inner {n : ℕ} (u x : Space n) {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ t, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t, HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t) :
    casimir (fun y => f ⟪u,y⟫) x =
      f'' ⟪u,x⟫*(‖u‖^2*‖x‖^2-⟪u,x⟫^2)-
        ((n : ℝ)-1)*f' ⟪u,x⟫*⟪u,x⟫

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.continuous_gradient_of_contDiff
statement:
lemma continuous_gradient_of_contDiff {n : ℕ} {f : Space n → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) :

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.inner_generator
statement:
lemma inner_generator {n : ℕ} (u x : Space n) (i j : Fin n) :

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_casimir_comm
statement:
lemma mean_casimir_comm {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f g : Space n → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g) :
    mean (fun u : Sphere n => f u*casimir g u) =
      mean (fun u : Sphere n => g u*casimir f u)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_gradient_casimir
statement:
lemma mean_gradient_casimir {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f g : Space n → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g) :
    mean (fun x : Sphere n => ⟪sphereGradient f x,sphereGradient g x⟫) =
      -mean (fun x : Sphere n => f x*casimir g x)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.posPower_contDiff_one

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.posPower_contDiff_two

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.posPower_mul

lemma posPower_mul {r : ℕ} (x : ℝ) :

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.posPower_mul_sq
statement:
lemma posPower_mul_sq {r : ℕ} (x : ℝ) :

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.rotDeriv_scalar_linear
statement:
lemma rotDeriv_scalar_linear {n : ℕ} (T : Space n →L[ℝ] Space n)
    (L : Space n →L[ℝ] ℝ) {f f' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ t, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t) (x : Space n) :
    rotDeriv T (f ∘ L) x = f' (L x)*L (T x)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.rotDeriv_scalar_linear_twice
statement:
lemma rotDeriv_scalar_linear_twice {n : ℕ} (T : Space n →L[ℝ] Space n)
    (L : Space n →L[ℝ] ℝ) {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ t, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t, HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t) (x : Space n) :
    rotDeriv T (rotDeriv T (f ∘ L)) x =
      f'' (L x)*(L (T x))^2+f' (L x)*L (T (T x))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.sphereGradient_continuous

lemma sphereGradient_continuous {n : ℕ} {f : Space n → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) :

statement:
lemma sphereGradient_inner {n : ℕ} (f : Space n → ℝ) (x w : Space n) :

statement:

    ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, ⟪u,generator n i j x⟫*⟪w,generator n i j x⟫ =

statement:

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.sum_rotDeriv_inner
statement:
lemma sum_rotDeriv_inner {n : ℕ} (f : Space n → ℝ) (x : Sphere n) (w : Space n) :
    (1/2 : ℝ)*(∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n,
      rotDeriv (generator n i j) f x*⟪w,generator n i j x⟫) = ⟪sphereGradient f x,w⟫

name: OAI.PettyProjection.gauge_volume
statement:
lemma gauge_volume {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {K : Set (Space n)}
    (hc : Convex ℝ K) (h0 : K ∈ 𝓝 (0 : Space n))
    (hp : ∀ u : Sphere n, 0 < gauge K (u : Space n)) :
    volume.real K = kappa n * mean (fun u : Sphere n => (gauge K (u : Space n))⁻¹ ^ n)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.gauge_volume_lintegral
statement:
lemma gauge_volume_lintegral {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {K : Set (Space n)}
    (hc : Convex ℝ K) (h0 : K ∈ 𝓝 (0 : Space n))
    (hp : ∀ u : Sphere n, 0 < gauge K (u : Space n)) :
    volume K = ∫⁻ u : Sphere n, ENNReal.ofReal ((gauge K (u : Space n))⁻¹ ^ n / n)
      ∂surface n

    (s φ : C(Sphere n,ℝ)) (hs : ∀ u, 0 < s u) :
    ∃ m M : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ 0 < M ∧
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), ∀ u, m ≤ (s+t • φ) u ∧ (s+t • φ) u ≤ M)

statement:
lemma quotient_bounds {a b z t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (hl : t*a ≤ z) (hh : z ≤ t*b) :

name: OAI.PettyProjection.quotient_perturb_bound
statement:
lemma quotient_perturb_bound {a b c t r m B : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (ht : m ≤ b+t*c) (hr : m ≤ b+r*c) (ha : |a| ≤ 1) (hc : |c| ≤ B) :

name: OAI.PettyProjection.selected_max_tendsto

    (hc : ∀ u : U, ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ × U => f p.1 p.2) (0,u))
    (hm : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), ∀ u, f t u ≤ f t (a t))

    Tendsto a (𝓝 0) (𝓝 u₀)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.wulff_active_unique
statement:
lemma wulff_active_unique {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (s : C(Sphere n,ℝ))
    (hs : ∀ u, 0 < s u) {x : Space n} (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (gauge (wulff s)) x)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.wulff_gauge_param_lipschitz
statement:
lemma wulff_gauge_param_lipschitz {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (s φ : C(Sphere n,ℝ))
    {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) {T : Set ℝ} (hT : ∀ t ∈ T, ∀ u, m ≤ (s+t • φ) u)
    (u : Sphere n) : LipschitzOnWith ⟨‖φ‖/m^2,by positivity⟩
      (fun t : ℝ => gauge (wulff ⇑(s+t • φ)) (u : Space n)) T

name: OAI.PettyProjection.wulff_gauge_param_sub_le
statement:
lemma wulff_gauge_param_sub_le {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (s φ : C(Sphere n,ℝ))
    {m t r : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (ht : ∀ u, m ≤ (s+t • φ) u)
    (hr : ∀ u, m ≤ (s+r • φ) u) (u : Sphere n) :
    gauge (wulff ⇑(s+t • φ)) (u : Space n)-gauge (wulff ⇑(s+r • φ)) (u : Space n) ≤
      (‖φ‖/m^2)*|t-r|

name: OAI.PettyProjection.wulff_gradient_of_active
statement:
lemma wulff_gradient_of_active {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (s : C(Sphere n,ℝ))
    (hs : ∀ u, 0 < s u) {x : Space n} {u : Sphere n}
    (hu : wulffMax s x = ⟪x,(u : Space n)⟫ / s u)
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (gauge (wulff s)) x) :

name: OAI.PettyProjection.wulff_invpow_param_lipschitz
statement:
lemma wulff_invpow_param_lipschitz {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (s φ : C(Sphere n,ℝ)) (hs : ∀ u,0 < s u) :
    ∃ T ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ u : Sphere n,
      LipschitzOnWith C (fun t : ℝ => (gauge (wulff ⇑(s+t • φ)) (u : Space n))⁻¹ ^ n) T

name: OAI.PettyProjection.wulff_sphere_gauge_bounds

name: OAI.PettyProjection.shadow_gauge_formula
statement:
theorem shadow_gauge_formula {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {K : Set (Space n)}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hc : Convex ℝ K) (h0 : K ∈ 𝓝 (0 : Space n)) (u : Sphere n) :
    2*shadowVolume K u = n*kappa n*mean (fun v : Sphere n =>
      (gauge K (v : Space n))⁻¹^n*|⟪∇ (gauge K) (v : Space n),(u : Space n)⟫|)

lemma mean_sign_gradient_radial {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f : Space n → ℝ}

statement:
lemma mean_weighted_gradient {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f : Space n → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) {ρ ρ' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hρ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ρ) (hρ' : Continuous ρ') (hd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt ρ (ρ' t) t)
    (v w : Space n) :
    mean (fun x : Sphere n => ρ ⟪v,(x : Space n)⟫*⟪sphereGradient f x,w⟫) =
      ((n : ℝ)-1)*mean (fun x : Sphere n => ρ ⟪v,(x : Space n)⟫*f x*⟪(x : Space n),w⟫) -
      mean (fun x : Sphere n => f x*ρ' ⟪v,(x : Space n)⟫*
        (⟪v,w⟫-⟪v,(x : Space n)⟫*⟪(x : Space n),w⟫))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.softAbs_pos
statement: lemma softAbs_pos {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (t : ℝ) : 0 < softAbs ε t

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.softAbs_sq
statement: lemma softAbs_sq {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (t : ℝ) : (softAbs ε t)^2 = t^2+ε

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.softAbs_tendsto
statement:
lemma softAbs_tendsto (t : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => softAbs (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) t) atTop (𝓝 |t|)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.softCorrection_tendsto
statement:
lemma softCorrection_tendsto (t : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => t*softSlope (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) t) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.softSign_contDiff
statement: lemma softSign_contDiff {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (softSign ε)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.softSign_tendsto
statement:
lemma softSign_tendsto (t : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => softSign (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) t) atTop (𝓝 (Real.sign t))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.sphereGradient_linear_inner
statement:
lemma sphereGradient_linear_inner {n : ℕ} (w : Space n) (x : Sphere n) (v : Space n) :
    ⟪sphereGradient (fun y => ⟪w,y⟫) x,v⟫ = ⟪w,v⟫-⟪w,(x : Space n)⟫*⟪(x : Space n),v⟫

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.sphereGradient_product_scalar_inner
OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.sphereGradient_scalar_inner
statement:
lemma sphereGradient_scalar_inner {n : ℕ} {ρ ρ' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hρ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt ρ (ρ' t) t) (v x w : Space n) :
    ⟪sphereGradient (fun y => ρ ⟪v,y⟫) x,w⟫ =
      ρ' ⟪v,x⟫*(⟪v,w⟫-⟪v,x⟫*⟪x,w⟫)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.cosineConstant_pos
statement: lemma cosineConstant_pos (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : 0 < cosineConstant n

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.cosine_const
statement: lemma cosine_const {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (c : ℝ) : cosine (fun _ : Sphere n => c) = fun _ => c

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.cosine_continuous
statement:
lemma cosine_continuous {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f : Sphere n → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Continuous (cosine f)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.cosine_harmonic
statement:
lemma cosine_harmonic {n j : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) [NeZero n]
    {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ} (hp : p.IsHomogeneous (2*j))
    (hΔ : laplacePolynomial p = 0) (u : Sphere n) :
    cosine (fun x => polynomialFunction p x) u = higherFactor n j 1*polynomialFunction p u

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.cosine_harmonic_odd
OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.cosine_neg
statement:
lemma cosine_neg {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (f : Sphere n → ℝ) (u : Sphere n) :
    cosine f (sphereMap (LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ) u) = cosine f u

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.cosine_projection_even
statement:
lemma cosine_projection_even {n j : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) [NeZero n] (f : C(Sphere n, ℝ)) :
    (harmonicSpace n (2*j)).starProjection (toH n (cosineMap f)) =
      higherFactor n j 1 • (harmonicSpace n (2*j)).starProjection (toH n f)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.cosine_projection_odd
statement:
lemma cosine_projection_odd {n d : ℕ} [NeZero n] (f : C(Sphere n, ℝ)) (hd : Odd d) :
    (harmonicSpace n d).starProjection (toH n (cosineMap f)) = 0

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.cosine_selfadj
OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.eigenvalue_odd_sub_even_ne_zero
statement:
lemma eigenvalue_odd_sub_even_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (m j : ℕ) :
    eigenvalue n (2*m+1)-eigenvalue n (2*j) ≠ 0

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.eigenvalue_sub_even
statement:
lemma eigenvalue_sub_even {n j : ℕ} (s : ℕ) :
    eigenvalue n s-eigenvalue n (2*j) =
      ((s : ℝ)-2*j)*((s : ℝ)+2*j+n-2)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.higherFactor_odd_ne_zero
statement:
lemma higherFactor_odd_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (j m : ℕ) :
    higherFactor n j (2*m+1) ≠ 0

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.higherFactor_step
statement:
lemma higherFactor_step {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (j : ℕ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) :
    (s-2*j)*(s+2*j+n-2)*higherFactor n j s =
      s*(s+n-2)*higherFactor n j (s-2)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.higherFactor_succ
statement:
lemma higherFactor_succ (n j : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    higherFactor n (j+1) s = higherFactor n j s*((s-2*j)/(s+n+2*j))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.higherFactor_tendsto
statement:
lemma higherFactor_tendsto (n j : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => higherFactor n j (2*m+1)) atTop (𝓝 1)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.higherFactor_zero
statement: lemma higherFactor_zero (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) : higherFactor n 0 s = 1

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.higherKernel_const_independent
statement:
lemma higherKernel_const_independent {n : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (u v : Sphere n) :
    higherKernel r u (fun _ => 1) = higherKernel r v (fun _ => 1)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.higherKernel_const_pos
statement:
lemma higherKernel_const_pos {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (r : ℕ) (u : Sphere n) :
    0 < higherKernel r u (fun _ => 1)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.higherKernel_const_recurrence
statement:
lemma higherKernel_const_recurrence {n r : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hr : 3 ≤ r) (u : Sphere n) :
    eigenvalue n r*higherKernel r u (fun _ => 1) =
      (r : ℝ)*((r : ℝ)-1)*higherKernel (r-2) u (fun _ => 1)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.higherKernel_const_rotation
statement:
lemma higherKernel_const_rotation {n : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (u : Sphere n)
    (U : Space n ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Space n) :
    higherKernel r (sphereMap U u) (fun _ => 1) = higherKernel r u (fun _ => 1)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.higherKernel_eigenfunction
statement:
lemma higherKernel_eigenfunction {n j : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) [NeZero n]
    (u : Sphere n) {f : Space n → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (heig : ∀ x : Sphere n, casimir f x = -eigenvalue n (2*j)*f x) :
    higherKernel 1 u (fun x => f x)/higherKernel 1 u (fun _ => 1) =
      higherFactor n j 1*f u

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.higherKernel_harmonic
statement:
lemma higherKernel_harmonic {n j : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) [NeZero n]
    (u : Sphere n) {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ} (hp : p.IsHomogeneous (2*j))
    (hΔ : laplacePolynomial p = 0) :
    higherKernel 1 u (fun x => polynomialFunction p x)/higherKernel 1 u (fun _ => 1) =
      higherFactor n j 1*polynomialFunction p u

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.higherKernel_normalized_recurrence
statement:
lemma higherKernel_normalized_recurrence {n r d : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hr : 3 ≤ r)
    (u : Sphere n) {f : Space n → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (heig : ∀ x : Sphere n, casimir f x = -eigenvalue n d*f x) :
    (eigenvalue n r-eigenvalue n d)*(higherKernel r u (fun x => f x)/higherKernel r u (fun _ => 1)) =
      eigenvalue n r*(higherKernel (r-2) u (fun x => f x)/higherKernel (r-2) u (fun _ => 1))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.higherKernel_peak
statement:
lemma higherKernel_peak {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (u : Sphere n) {f : Sphere n → ℝ}
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    Tendsto (fun r : ℕ => higherKernel r u f / higherKernel r u (fun _ => 1))
      atTop (𝓝 (f u))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.higherKernel_recurrence
statement:
lemma higherKernel_recurrence {n r d : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hr : 3 ≤ r)
    (u : Sphere n) {f : Space n → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (heig : ∀ x : Sphere n, casimir f x = -eigenvalue n d*f x) :
    (eigenvalue n r-eigenvalue n d)*higherKernel r u (fun x => f x) =
      (r : ℝ)*((r : ℝ)-1)*higherKernel (r-2) u (fun x => f x)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_abs_inner
statement:
lemma mean_abs_inner {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (u : Sphere n) :
    mean (fun x : Sphere n => |⟪(u : Space n),(x : Space n)⟫|) = cosineConstant n

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_cosine
statement:
lemma mean_cosine {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f : Sphere n → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) :
    mean (cosine f) = mean f

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_pos_inner_even
statement:
lemma mean_pos_inner_even {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (u : Sphere n) {f : Space n → ℝ}
    (heven : Function.Even f) (hf : Continuous f) :
    mean (fun x : Sphere n => |⟪(u : Space n),(x : Space n)⟫| *f x) =
      2*higherKernel 1 u (fun x => f x)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_sphere_even_mul_odd
statement:
lemma mean_sphere_even_mul_odd {n d : ℕ} {f : Sphere n → ℝ}
    (heven : ∀ u, f (sphereMap (LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ) u) = f u)
    {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ} (hp : p.IsHomogeneous d) (hd : Odd d) :
    mean (fun u : Sphere n => f u*polynomialFunction p u) = 0

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.polynomialFunction_even
statement:
lemma polynomialFunction_even {n d : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hp : p.IsHomogeneous d) (hd : Even d) : Function.Even (polynomialFunction p)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.posPower_eq_max_pow
statement:
lemma posPower_eq_max_pow {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (x : ℝ) :
    posPower r x = max x 0 ^ r

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.casimir_const
statement: lemma casimir_const {n : ℕ} (c : ℝ) : casimir (fun _ : Space n => c) = 0

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.casimir_continuous
statement:
lemma casimir_continuous {n : ℕ} {f : Space n → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) :
    Continuous (casimir f)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.casimir_projection
statement:
lemma casimir_projection {n d : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f : Space n → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) :
    (harmonicSpace n d).starProjection (toH n (casimirMap f hf)) =
      -eigenvalue n d • (harmonicSpace n d).starProjection (toH n (restrictContinuous f hf.continuous))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.cosine_sub_smul
OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.harmonic_inner_ne
statement:
lemma harmonic_inner_ne {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) [NeZero n] {d e : ℕ} (hde : d ≠ e)
    {v w : H n} (hv : v ∈ harmonicSpace n d) (hw : w ∈ harmonicSpace n e) :
    ⟪v,w⟫ = 0

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.harmonic_projection_of_mem_ne
statement:
lemma harmonic_projection_of_mem_ne {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) [NeZero n] {d e : ℕ} (hde : d ≠ e)
    {v : H n} (hv : v ∈ harmonicSpace n e) : (harmonicSpace n d).starProjection v = 0

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.inner_Q_Q
statement:
lemma inner_Q_Q {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (x y : H n) :
    ⟪Q n x,Q n y⟫ = ⟪Q n x,y⟫

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_casimir_zero
statement:
lemma mean_casimir_zero {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f : Space n → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) :
    mean (fun x : Sphere n => casimir f x) = 0

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_signOperator
statement:
lemma mean_signOperator {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (a : ℝ) {f : Space n → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) : mean (signOperator a f hf) = mean (fun x : Sphere n => f x)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.mean_signOperator_expand
statement:
lemma mean_signOperator_expand {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (a : ℝ) {f g : Space n → ℝ}
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g) :
    mean (fun x : Sphere n => f x*signOperator a g hg x) =
      mean (fun x : Sphere n => f x*cosine (fun y : Sphere n => g y) x) -
        a*mean (fun x : Sphere n => f x*cosine (fun y : Sphere n => casimir g y) x)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.radialField_continuous
statement:
lemma radialField_continuous {n : ℕ} {f : Space n → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Continuous (radialField f)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.signFactor_abs_le_four
statement:
lemma signFactor_abs_le_four {n j : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hj : 2 ≤ j) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    |signFactor n j a| ≤ (1+a*(4*(n+2)))/((n+1)*(n+3))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.signFactor_abs_step
statement:
lemma signFactor_abs_step {n j : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hj : 1 ≤ j) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    |signFactor n (j+1) a| ≤ |signFactor n j a|

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.signField_continuous
statement:
lemma signField_continuous {n : ℕ} (k : ℝ) {f : Space n → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) :
    Continuous (signField k f)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.signOperator_apply
statement:
lemma signOperator_apply {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (a : ℝ) {f : Space n → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (u : Sphere n) :
    signOperator a f hf u = cosine (fun x : Sphere n => f x) u -
      a*cosine (fun x : Sphere n => casimir f x) u

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.signOperator_projection_even
statement:
lemma signOperator_projection_even {n j : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) [NeZero n]
    (a : ℝ) {f : Space n → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) :
    (harmonicSpace n (2*j)).starProjection (toH n (signOperator a f hf)) =
      signFactor n j a • (harmonicSpace n (2*j)).starProjection (toH n (restrictContinuous f hf.continuous))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.signOperator_projection_odd
statement:
lemma signOperator_projection_odd {n d : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (a : ℝ) {f : Space n → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hd : Odd d) :
    (harmonicSpace n d).starProjection (toH n (signOperator a f hf)) = 0

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.signedPair_radial_radial
statement:
lemma signedPair_radial_radial {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f g : Space n → ℝ}
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) :
    signedPair (radialField f) (radialField g) = cosineConstant n *
      mean (fun u : Sphere n => f u*cosine (fun v : Sphere n => g v) u)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.signedPair_tangent_radial
statement:
lemma signedPair_tangent_radial {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f g : Space n → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hg : Continuous g) :
    signedPair (tangentField f) (radialField g) = -cosineConstant n *
      mean (fun u : Sphere n => g u*cosine (fun v : Sphere n => casimir f v) u)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.signedPair_tangent_tangent
statement:
lemma signedPair_tangent_tangent {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {f g : Space n → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g) :
    signedPair (tangentField f) (tangentField g) = ((n : ℝ)-1)*
      signedPair (radialField f) (tangentField g)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.tangentField_continuous
statement:
lemma tangentField_continuous {n : ℕ} {f : Space n → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) :
    Continuous (tangentField f)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.hilbertSum_hasSum_inner
statement:
lemma hilbertSum_hasSum_inner
    (h : IsHilbertSum ℝ (fun i => F i) (fun i => (F i).subtypeₗᵢ)) (x y : E) :
    HasSum (fun i => ⟪(F i).starProjection x,(F i).starProjection y⟫) ⟪x,y⟫

name: OAI.PettyProjection.hilbertSum_multiplier_selfadj
statement:
lemma hilbertSum_multiplier_selfadj
    (h : IsHilbertSum ℝ (fun i => F i) (fun i => (F i).subtypeₗᵢ))
    (x y tx ty : E) (c : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (F i).starProjection tx = c i • (F i).starProjection x)
    (hy : ∀ i, (F i).starProjection ty = c i • (F i).starProjection y) :
    ⟪x,ty⟫ = ⟪tx,y⟫

name: OAI.PettyProjection.hilbertSum_norm_le_of_projection_bound
statement:
lemma hilbertSum_norm_le_of_projection_bound
    (h : IsHilbertSum ℝ (fun i => F i) (fun i => (F i).subtypeₗᵢ))
    (x y : E) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hp : ∀ i, ‖(F i).starProjection y‖ ≤ c*‖(F i).starProjection x‖) :
    ‖y‖ ≤ c*‖x‖

name: OAI.PettyProjection.inner_projection_both
statement:
lemma inner_projection_both (K : Submodule ℝ E) [CompleteSpace K] (x y : E) :
    ⟪K.starProjection x,K.starProjection y⟫ = ⟪x,K.starProjection y⟫

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.ae_bound_of_limit
statement:
lemma ae_bound_of_limit {n : ℕ} {F : ℕ → Sphere n → Space n}
    {F₀ : Sphere n → Space n} {B : ℝ} (hFB : ∀ j u, ‖F j u‖ ≤ B)
    (hFlim : ∀ᵐ u ∂sigma n, Tendsto (fun j => F j u) atTop (𝓝 (F₀ u))) :
    ∀ᵐ u ∂sigma n, ‖F₀ u‖ ≤ B

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.coefficient_sign_factor
statement:
lemma coefficient_sign_factor {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    ((1+(2/(Scalar.exponent n : ℝ)+((n : ℝ)-1)/(Scalar.exponent n : ℝ)^2)*
      (4*(n+2)))/((n+1)*(n+3))) = Scalar.coefficient n

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.gaugeField_absolute_integrable
statement:
lemma gaugeField_absolute_integrable {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (f g : Seminorm ℝ (Space n)) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    Integrable (fun z : Sphere n × Sphere n =>
      |⟪gaugeField f k z.1,gaugeField g k z.2⟫|) ((sigma n).prod (sigma n))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.gaugeField_measurable_bound
statement:
lemma gaugeField_measurable_bound {n : ℕ} (g : Seminorm ℝ (Space n)) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (gaugeField g k) (sigma n) ∧
      ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ᵐ u ∂sigma n, ‖gaugeField g k u‖ ≤ B

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.gaugeMoment_ranges
statement:
lemma gaugeMoment_ranges {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) [NeZero n]
    (g : Seminorm ℝ (Space n)) (hg : ∀ u : Sphere n, 0 < g u)
    (hnorm : mean (fun u : Sphere n => (g u)⁻¹^n) = 1) :
    1 ≤ gaugeMoment g (exponent n-1) ∧ gaugeMoment g (exponent n-1) ≤ gaugeMoment g (exponent n)

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.gaugeTail_of_one
statement:
lemma gaugeTail_of_one {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (g : Seminorm ℝ (Space n)) (k : ℕ)
    (hg : ∀ u : Sphere n, g u = 1) : gaugeTail g k = 0

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.gradient_pow
OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.normSmooth_powerField_bound
statement:
lemma normSmooth_powerField_bound {n : ℕ} (g : Seminorm ℝ (Space n)) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ j (u : Sphere n),
      ‖signField (k : ℝ) (fun x => normSmooth g (shrinkingBump n j) x^k) u‖ ≤ B

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.normSmooth_powerField_tendsto
statement:
lemma normSmooth_powerField_tendsto {n : ℕ} (g : Seminorm ℝ (Space n)) (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ᵐ (u : Sphere n) ∂sigma n,
      Tendsto (fun j => signField (k : ℝ) (fun x => normSmooth g (shrinkingBump n j) x^k) u)
        atTop (𝓝 (signField (k : ℝ) (fun x => g x^k) u))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.normSmooth_power_restrict_tendsto
statement:
lemma normSmooth_power_restrict_tendsto {n : ℕ} (g : Seminorm ℝ (Space n)) (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun j => restrictContinuous (fun x => normSmooth g (shrinkingBump n j) x^k)
      ((normSmooth_contDiff g _).continuous.pow k)) atTop
      (𝓝 (restrictContinuous (fun x => g x^k) ((seminorm_continuous n g).pow k)))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.norm_gradient_eq
statement:
lemma norm_gradient_eq {n : ℕ} (f : Space n → ℝ) (x : Space n) :
    ‖∇ f x‖ = ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.norm_signField_le
statement:
lemma norm_signField_le {n : ℕ} (k : ℝ) (f : Space n → ℝ) (u : Sphere n) :
    ‖signField k f u‖ ≤ |f u| + 2*|k⁻¹| *‖fderiv ℝ f u‖

name: OAI.PettyProjection.Spherical.norm_signedPair_tendsto
statement:
lemma norm_signedPair_tendsto {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (f g : Seminorm ℝ (Space n)) (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun j => signedPair
      (signField (k : ℝ) (fun x => normSmooth f (shrinkingBump n j) x^k))
      (signField (k : ℝ) (fun x => normSmooth g (shrinkingBump n j) x^k))) atTop
      (𝓝 (signedPair (signField (k : ℝ) (fun x => f x^k))
        (signField (k : ℝ) (fun x => g x^k))))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.RelativeGauge.minimizer_field_representation
statement:
lemma minimizer_field_representation
    (hμ : Integrable (fun x : Space n => ‖x‖) μ)
    (hq : ∀ x : Space n,x≠0 → 0 < cosineSeminorm μ hμ x)
    (g : RelativeGauge (⊤ : Submodule ℝ (Space n))) (hgn : supportFunctional μ g.body=1)
    (hmin : ∀ q : RelativeGauge (⊤ : Submodule ℝ (Space n)),supportFunctional μ q.body=1 →
      Spherical.objective (regime n) g.toSeminorm≤Spherical.objective (regime n) q.toSeminorm)
    (φ : Space n → ℝ) (hφ : Continuous φ) (heven : ∀ x,φ (-x)=φ x)
    (hh : ∀ a : ℝ,0 < a → ∀ x,φ (a • x)=a*φ x) :
    (∫ x,φ x ∂μ)*gaugeMoment g.toSeminorm (Scalar.exponent n-1)=
      mean (fun u : Sphere n => φ (gaugeField g.toSeminorm (Scalar.exponent n) u))

name: OAI.PettyProjection.RelativeGauge.normalized_representation
statement:
theorem normalized_representation {μ : Measure (Space n)}
    (hμ : Integrable (fun x : Space n => ‖x‖) μ)
    (hq : ∀ x : Space n,x≠0 → 0<cosineSeminorm μ hμ x) (b : Bool)
    (g : RelativeGauge (⊤ : Submodule ℝ (Space n))) (hgn : supportFunctional μ g.body=1)
    (hmin : ∀ q : RelativeGauge (⊤ : Submodule ℝ (Space n)),supportFunctional μ q.body=1 →
      objective b g.toSeminorm≤objective b q.toSeminorm)
    (φ : Space n → ℝ) (hφ : Continuous φ) (heven : ∀ x,φ (-x)=φ x)
    (hh : ∀ a : ℝ,0<a → ∀ x,φ (a • x)=a*φ x) :
    (∫ x,φ x ∂μ)*(if b then 1 else objective false g.toSeminorm)=
      mean (fun u : Sphere n => (if b then 1 else g u)*φ (∇ (fun x => g x) (u:Space n)))

    (hμ : Integrable (fun x : Space n => ‖x‖) μ)
    (hq : ∀ x : Space n,x≠0 → 0 < cosineSeminorm μ hμ x)
    (g : RelativeGauge (⊤ : Submodule ℝ (Space n))) (hgn : supportFunctional μ g.body=1)
    (hmin : ∀ q : RelativeGauge (⊤ : Submodule ℝ (Space n)),supportFunctional μ q.body=1 →
      Spherical.objective (regime n) g.toSeminorm≤Spherical.objective (regime n) q.toSeminorm)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (φ : Space n → ℝ) (hφ : Continuous φ) (heven : ∀ x,φ (-x)=φ x)
    (hh : ∀ r : ℝ,0 < r → ∀ x,φ (r • x)=r*φ x) :
    (∫ x,φ x ∂μ)*gaugeMoment (g.scale a ha).toSeminorm (Scalar.exponent n-1)=
      supportFunctional μ (g.scale a ha).body*
        mean (fun u : Sphere n => φ (gaugeField (g.scale a ha).toSeminorm (Scalar.exponent n) u))

    (hb : ∀ x : E, ‖x‖=1 → r x=x) :
    ∃ (z : E → E) (C : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith C z ∧
      (∀ x∈closedBall (0:E) 1, z x=r x-x) ∧ (∀ x,1≤‖x‖ → z x=0)
